### 1. [Thinking with Images without Coordinates](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14265v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14265

**作者：** Meng Cao、Haoze Zhao、Yi Wang、Ian Reid、Xiaodan Liang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14265v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14265v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P0

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 TiCO，把「thinking with images」式视觉推理重构为 latent 空间中的语义证据发现：用专用 probe token 估计相似度分布，并在空间连通分量上做重要性采样，从而在不使用像素坐标的情况下生成多样化的证据区域。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉证据筛选、latent 表示和 LOOK 的收益/成本直接相关；其「无坐标、用相似度分布采样证据」的思路可供核查，同时需检验采样出的证据是否真被答案使用、以及推理效率提升的来源。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Thinking with Images without Coordinates

**abstract/A1：** Recent advances in multi-modal large language models have shifted toward the "thinking with images" paradigm to improve reasoning faithfulness, yet existing methods rely heavily on explicit coordinate- based grounding. We identify two fundamental limitations in this approach, i.e., a semantic gap where sparse regressions miss high-dimensional latent structures, and a resolution gap due to the granularity mismatch between patch-level tokens and pixel-level coordinates. To address these, we propose TiCO (Thinking with images without COordinates). It reformulates visual reasoning as a semantic evidence discovery process within the latent space, and evidence is injected as token-level regions without pixel coordinates. Specifically, TiCO utilizes a dedicated probe token to estimate similarity distributions and performs importance sampling over spatially connected components to generate diverse, semantically dominant evidence rollouts. Extensive experiments across multiple high-resolution and general visual reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that our TiCO consistently outperforms state-of-the-art coordinate-based methods with significantly improved inference efficiency.

</details>

### 2. [Adaptive Look, Flexible Thought: Learning How and How Long to Think in Multimodal Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15810v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15810

**作者：** Quanlin Chen、Xiuwei Chen、Kun Xiang、Zehua Ma、Chunjin Ye、Boqiang Guo、Xianming Liu、Xiaodan Liang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15810v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15810v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P0

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 L2T 统一多模态推理框架：把工具产生的视觉状态离散为视觉 token，与文本推理共享自回归空间，并引入模态感知路由奖励和难度感知快慢策略，联合优化「怎么算」与「算多久」；实验显示在保持竞争力的同时吞吐提升 1.7–3.6 倍。

**相关性简评：** 直接对应 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的联合决策问题：视觉工具调用与文本推理长度的耦合优化、路由奖励与难度自适应深度，可供核查视觉 token 是否真被答案使用及动态计算的收益成本。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Adaptive Look, Flexible Thought: Learning How and How Long to Think in Multimodal Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** The introduction of long chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning and external tools has substantially improved the performance of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on general and reasoning tasks. However, existing fast-slow reasoning paradigms mainly regulate textual reasoning length, while visual computation introduced by external tools or visual tokens is often treated as an auxiliary component. This separation prevents MLLMs from jointly optimizing visual perception and textual reasoning. To address this issue, we propose L2T (adaptive Look, flexible Thought), a unified reasoning framework that jointly optimizes the form and depth of computation. L2T first discretizes tool-produced visual states into visual tokens, bringing visual perception and textual reasoning into a shared autoregressive space. Based on this unified representation, L2T introduces a modality-aware routing reward to select appropriate reasoning modes and a difficulty-aware fast-slow strategy to adapt reasoning depth according to task complexity. Experiments on general perception and reasoning-intensive tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of L2T. Compared with explicit tool-calling approaches, L2T maintains competitive performance while achieving 1.7--3.6 times higher throughput.

</details>

### 3. [Dynamic K-Head: Difficulty-Supervised Budget Selection for Continuous Latent Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17679v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17679

**作者：** Ying Li、Yuqi Chen、Sixuan Li、Yunfeng Cai

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17679v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17679v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P0

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Dynamic K-Head：在连续 latent 推理中按问题难度、于 rollout 前预测 latent 更新次数 K，并与 reasoner 联合训练；同时在 CoDI+Llama 3.2 1B 上指出仅计 latent 更新数会低估端到端成本，主张统一核算 latent 更新、特殊 token 与解码文本。

**相关性简评：** 直接对应 LVR 中动态计算与停止决策（K 的选择）及推理成本度量，其「预算与准确率非单调」观察可供核查 latent 步数收益的边界。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Dynamic K-Head: Difficulty-Supervised Budget Selection for Continuous Latent Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Chain-of-thought (CoT) improves reasoning but incurs substantial autoregressive rationale cost. Continuous CoT moves intermediate computation into recurrent hidden states, yet typically uses a fixed number of updates even though the best budget varies across questions and accuracy need not improve monotonically with $K$. We introduce Dynamic K-Head, a question-conditioned, pre-rollout budget selector. It is jointly trained with the reasoner under selected budgets, using difficulty supervision based on scores assigned from the question alone. We also show that latent-update count can misrepresent end-to-end cost because a short latent rollout can shift computation into a longer explicit continuation. We therefore count latent updates, implementation-specific special tokens, and all decoded text. Instantiated with CoDI on Llama 3.2 1B and GSM8K, Dynamic K-Head reaches 54.44% exact-match accuracy at 12.03 average reasoning/output tokens, compared with 52.31% at 15.21 tokens for fixed-$K=6$ CoDI---a 2.12-point gain with 20.9% lower token cost. Across three out-of-distribution arithmetic datasets, it reduces cost by 19.3--25.7% while improving accuracy by 0.30--2.22 points. These results demonstrate that difficulty-supervised budget selection can improve both accuracy and efficiency, while stable budget selection remains a central challenge.

</details>

### 4. [Seeing Depth but Choosing Cues in Vision-Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17976v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17976

**作者：** Zhengtao Zou、Pekka Marttinen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17976v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17976v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P0

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该研究在渲染场景与真实照片中构造深度信息与图像平面线索（表观大小、垂直位置）相冲突的条件，结合表征分析与干预，检验 VLM 判断物体远近时是否真正使用深度；发现正确答案常可从目标物体的视觉表征中解码，且通过物体级写回强化模型自身的深度读出即可纠正冲突下的错误决策，无需更新参数或真值深度标注。

**相关性简评：** 直接对应「内部状态是否保留视觉信息、最终答案是否使用该信息」这一核心问题，其「表征可解码但未被答案采用」的错配与物体级 write-back 干预，可供核查 LVR 中的视觉旁路、信息坍缩与 latent 内容利用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Seeing Depth but Choosing Cues in Vision-Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Do vision-language models use depth information to judge which object is closer, or rely on image-plane cues? We investigate this question through controlled depth--cue conflicts, representation analysis, and interventions. Among the many image-plane cues relevant to depth perception, we focus on apparent size and vertical position. We compare depth judgments under cue-consistent and cue-conflict conditions in both rendered scenes and real-world photographs. Across model families and scales, depth judgments systematically shift toward misleading cues. Yet the correct depth order remains decodable from the queried objects' visual representations, including when the model answers incorrectly. Image and category controls support interpreting this signal as image-dependent depth information beyond the two target cues. Strengthening the model's own depth readout through object-level write-back can correct conflict decisions without updating model parameters or using ground-truth depth annotations. Interventions show that the effect of this correction depends on the direction and target tokens of the written signal, while its strength varies across architectures and domains. Together, these findings reveal a mismatch between a model's ability to represent depth and use this information when deciding the answer. VLMs can retain useful depth information while allowing competing image-plane cues to exert greater influence on their answers.

</details>

### 5. [GeoReader: Learning Latent Geometry for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18694v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18694

**作者：** Rong Li、Shijie Li、Jiangyong Huang、Lingdong Kong、Jiaming Zhou、Dongyue Lu、Zeying Gong、Baoxiong Jia、Junwei Liang、Siyuan Huang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.LG、cs.MM

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18694v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18694v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P0

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** GeoReader 训练轻量 Geometric Reader 将 RGB 预测的几何结构转成 VLM 可直接读取的连续输入 token，以冻结 VLM 解码的几何描述作训练监督，再冻结 Reader、按问题条件注入几何来微调 VLM 做空间问答，推理时不再生成几何链式思考。

**相关性简评：** 直接触及「视觉几何信息是否被内部状态保留并被答案使用」：文中报告把已对齐 latent 置零后精度不变，指向 latent 内容未被利用的信息坍缩问题，可供核查几何证据筛选与 latent 贡献分配的具体做法。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GeoReader: Learning Latent Geometry for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Vision-language models (VLMs) struggle with metric and multi-view relationships that remain implicit in RGB observations. Geometry foundation models recover this structure from RGB, but existing methods either fuse the estimated features with visual tokens and learn to use them from question answering alone, or align VLM latents with geometry features. Capturing geometry, however, does not ensure its use: zeroing the aligned latents of a released feature-alignment model leaves its accuracy unchanged. We introduce GeoReader, a framework that learns geometric representations for the VLM that reads them. First, we train lightweight Geometric Readers to produce continuous input tokens, supervising them with geometry descriptions decoded by a frozen VLM, so that the Readers express geometry in a form the target model can already read. We then freeze the Readers to preserve this interface while fine-tuning the VLM on spatial QA, with geometry injection conditioned on the question. Geometry descriptions serve only as training targets: at inference, the VLM answers directly from the continuous geometric tokens without generating a geometry chain of thought. With geometry predicted from RGB images, our approach reaches 94.3 on MindCube-Tiny with Qwen3-VL-4B and, with a multi-source QA mixture, an average of 72.5 across six additional spatial benchmarks with Qwen3.5-9B. These results suggest that a useful geometric representation is one the receiving model can use, not merely one from which geometry can be reconstructed.

**comment/C1：** 35 pages, 11 figures, 15 tables; Project Page at https://iris0329.github.io/georeader-homepage/ GitHub Repo at https://github.com/iris0329/GeoReader

</details>

### 6. [How Vision Transformers Represent Position: A Mechanistic Comparison of Absolute and Rotary Positional Encodings](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13992v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.13992

**作者：** Mahmoud Mannes、Nikhil Maturi、Parva Mehta、Jiwon Jeong、Aravind Singaram Kannappan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13992v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.13992v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文用稀疏自编码器与因果干预，比较 ViT 中绝对位置嵌入（APE）与旋转位置嵌入（RoPE）编码空间位置的内部机制差异，并验证二者对分类的因果重要性。

**相关性简评：** 直接诊断视觉模型内部如何构建、保留和重建位置与几何结构，并涉及专门化注意力头，与「几何/任务必要信息是否留在内部状态」及位置、注意力结构对 latent 相似度影响的考察线索直接相关，可供核查其干预方法能否迁移到 LVR 的表征诊断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** How Vision Transformers Represent Position: A Mechanistic Comparison of Absolute and Rotary Positional Encodings

**abstract/A1：** Positional embeddings encode the spatial position of each image patch in a Vision Transformer (ViT), allowing the model to distinguish different spatial arrangements of visual content. However, we know little about how the choice of embedding shapes a vision transformer's internal representation. In this work, we show that Absolute Positional Embeddings (APE) and Rotary Positional Embeddings (RoPE) encode spatial position through different internal mechanisms: APE stores position in explicit features, while RoPE builds it inside attention and rebuilds it when it is withheld. Specifically, in APE models, sparse autoencoders recover causal row- and column-specific features, whereas interventions on RoPE reveal distinct rotary components that separately encode row and column information. Additionally, causal interventions selectively disabling RoPE's row or column rotations show that decodable row and column information can be independently removed and, once rotations are restored, partly reconstructed, in part by axis-specialized attention heads. Both mechanisms are causally important for classification: permuting APE's positional features across patches reduces top-1 accuracy by 24--31 points, and ablating the rotations of RoPE's primary rebuilding head reduces it more than ablating those of any other head. Our findings show that the choice of positional encoding fundamentally changes how spatial information is organized and processed inside Vision Transformers. More broadly, our work demonstrates how mechanistic analysis can reveal how models construct, reconstruct, and maintain structured representations, providing a basis for targeted interventions in vision models.

</details>

### 7. [Token-Budgeted Candidate Retrieval for 3D Scene-Grounded VLMs: Category Names vs. Pairwise Geometry](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14207v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14207

**作者：** Michał Zakrzewski、Mariia Shpir、Taras Rumezhak

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14207v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14207v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在固定 token 预算下比较 3D 场景 VLM 的候选物体筛选策略（物体类别名匹配 vs. 成对几何打分），并用修正后的 3DGraphLLM 检验筛选方式对下游定位精度的影响。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 关注的视觉证据筛选、支持集组合和预算受限推理直接相关；其「语义检索在各 K 上优于手工几何线索」的诊断可供核查基于几何的支持选择假设，但该工作停留在输入上下文选择层面，尚未涉及 latent 状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Token-Budgeted Candidate Retrieval for 3D Scene-Grounded VLMs: Category Names vs. Pairwise Geometry

**abstract/A1：** Under a fixed context budget, which objects and relations should a 3D scene-grounded VLM see first? On ScanNet indoor referring benchmarks (Dai et al., 2017), matching the query to object category names outperforms pairwise geometry scoring at every reported K. The gaps are largest at high recall. Analytic pairwise cues beat per-object cue scoring and query-agnostic kNN graphs, including on paraphrases. MiniLM and BGE-small still score higher on those splits. We evaluate token-budgeted candidate retrieval with axis-aligned boxes, a token-ratio metric, training-free baselines, two small encoders that match q to each object's category name, and QCRR (Query-Conditioned Relation Retrieval), a deterministic pairwise-geometry scorer. Across ScanRefer gt\_val plus a custom 20% scan-id split of Nr3D and Sr3D (35,504 queries; not official ReferIt3D val), additive noun matching reaches R@10 0.864 on ScanRefer against QCRR's 0.626; MiniLM and BGE-small reach 0.911 to 0.913 on ScanRefer and 0.941 to 0.947 on Nr3D. A corrected 3DGraphLLM harness (native Acc@0.25 0.67 on the full graph, n=300 ScanRefer queries) shows that context selection changes downstream accuracy under a matched object budget (Random 0.44, QCRR 0.56, MiniLM 0.67, oracle 0.70). Semantic retrieval beats hand-designed geometry on that harness. We will release the protocol, retriever implementations, and per-query outputs so new selectors can be swapped in without rewriting the analysis.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Physical World AI (non-archival)

</details>

### 8. [RealityBench: Simulated Environments to Evaluate a Vision Language Model's Ability to Document Human Physical Work](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14397v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14397

**作者：** Andrew Perrault、Anmol Takiar、Dominik Wienecki、Arnab Nandi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14397v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14397v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 构建 RealityBench：用 Blender 模拟 11 种真实体力工作场景，让 26 个 VLM 判定某视角是否可作为工作凭证（acceptability）并理解任务相关状态（documentation），发现模型主要弱在读测量、小部件与空间关系。

**相关性简评：** 作为 VLM 视觉失败诊断基准，可直接核查模型是否保留测量值、部件与空间关系等细粒度证据，其「视角是否足够」的判定也与证据筛选和停止决策的收益—成本问题相关。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RealityBench: Simulated Environments to Evaluate a Vision Language Model's Ability to Document Human Physical Work

**abstract/A1：** Augmenting worker capabilities in the physical world through guidance has been a decades-long goal for AI agents. One key supporting capability is to understand what the worker is doing, seeing through the human's camera or smart glasses, and assist them in documentation. Despite advances in vision language models, their capabilities in these settings remain uncertain and are challenging to benchmark because most physical work data is proprietary, and involves too much variability to study in a principled manner. Unlike structured settings such as kitchens and warehouses that have predictable lighting, geometry, and objects, field-facing tasks such as rooftop solar installation and vehicle repair are unconstrained and high variance. Here, we model real-world physical work in Blender across eleven environments, incorporating variants in both image acceptability and documentation. The acceptability task asks whether a particular view would be suitable proof-of-work and documentation asks whether an agent can understand the task-relevant state of the environment from that view. Across 26 vision-language models, we find that top models largely solve documentation when the answer is text in frame, but are weak at reading measurements and at judging small parts and spatial relations, such as whether a tape measure leans. Acceptability is harder to pin down because human raters disagree with each other. Measured against a scorer that agrees with the raters' majority about as often as a single rater does, the best models cannot be distinguished from a single non-author rater, at a cost within the range of a human pass. In the three environments where we can trace acceptability errors, most wrong rejections come from misreading the scene rather than the requirement. On the three documentation questions for which we have real images, model rankings on rendered frames transfer to real images.

**comment/C1：** 28 pages, 3 figures, 14 tables. Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/relantic/realitybenc

</details>

### 9. [SceneForesee: Learning Scene Evolution for Spatiotemporal Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14439v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14439

**作者：** Chaoyue Li、Shoudong Han、Haoyang Wu、Boxue Yang、Sijia Chen、Yufan Chen、Ruping Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14439v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14439v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出「场景演化理解」任务与 SceneForesee 基准（含时间配对、实体对应与事件标注），并给出 EvoSee 框架，通过共享候选状态与联合分配来预测未来轨迹和事件、更新实体与场景表示，在多模态模型上取得了提升。

**相关性简评：** 其跨时间跟踪同一实体、以观测运动作为 Visual Evidence 并选择候选状态更新场景表示，与 LVR 关注的实体关系保留、内部状态更新和视觉证据筛选直接相关，可供核查预测表示能否承载实体连续性与后续推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SceneForesee: Learning Scene Evolution for Spatiotemporal Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Large multimodal models (LMMs) need to understand how entities move and interact as a scene develops. This requires following the same entities over time and relating their observed motion to subsequent changes. We formulate Scene Evolution Understanding (SEU), a task for predicting and interpreting this change. Given observed video, a model estimates entity histories and predicts one scene continuation through future trajectories and Events, accompanied by Visual Evidence from observed motion and a scene description. We construct SceneForesee, a benchmark for evaluating entity continuity and scene evolution reasoning through paired observed and future scenes with shared entity identities. It contains 144.57K temporal pairs, 1.05M entity correspondences, and 272.49K Events paired with observed evidence. We propose a spatiotemporal reasoning framework, EvoSee, that learns future geometry and Event semantics through shared candidate states and joint assignment. It selects one continuation per entity from observation and uses the selected changes for entity refinement, retention, and scene representation. On SceneForesee, EvoSee outperforms Qwen3.5-9B by 10.45 points in Combined Point-F1 and 17.24 points in Event Global F1. On the 4D reasoning benchmark Dyn-Bench, it improves question answering accuracy and grounding J&amp;F by 4.8 and 3.58 points over their respective base systems. These results support scene evolution as both a prediction target and a dynamic representation that brings predicted entity changes into spatiotemporal reasoning.The project is available at https://github.com/mikubaka88/SceneForesee-Spatiotemporal-Reasoning.

</details>

### 10. [Are Multimodal Benchmarks Really Useful? Item-Level Multimodal Benchmark Diagnosis via Structure-Response Co-Calibration](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14542v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14542

**作者：** Shiqi Zhang、Weixin Zeng、Ziheng Zhang、Jiuyang Tang、Xiang Zhao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14542v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14542v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SRCoD 框架，从基准内容与目标答案估计样本级多模态信息结构，并以此作为软结构锚点进行模态条件项目反应建模，输出 item 级诊断画像，判断每道题对多模态证据的依赖程度，以识别只靠单一模态或选项规律即可作答的捷径题。

**相关性简评：** 属于 VLM 多模态推理的基准诊断与失败分析，与「视觉证据是否被真正使用」直接相关；其 item 级模态依赖信号可供核查是否用于评估 LOOK 的必要性、视觉旁路与证据筛选。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Are Multimodal Benchmarks Really Useful? Item-Level Multimodal Benchmark Diagnosis via Structure-Response Co-Calibration

**abstract/A1：** Multimodal benchmarks are central to evaluating whether models can reason over information from multiple modalities. However, existing literature has revealed that some benchmarks may contain shortcut items that can be answered from a single modality or from answer-option regularities alone, thus failing to reflect models' true cross-modal inference ability. Existing methods for assessing benchmarks typically rely either on intrinsic item structure or extrinsic model response behavior, which are not adequate for a comprehensive diagnosis. To fill in this gap, we propose SRCoD, a structure-response co-calibrated diagnosis framework for item-level diagnosis of modality dependence in multimodal benchmarks. SRCoD estimates sample-wise multimodal information structure from benchmark content and target answers, and uses this signal as a soft structural anchor for modality-conditioned item response modeling. The learned model produces a calibrated item-level diagnostic profile that reflects how strongly an item depends on different forms of modality evidence, enabling fine-grained benchmark analysis beyond aggregate accuracy. SRCoD also provides interpretable attribution of the diagnosis results. Extensive experiments under two complementary protocols, i.e., benchmark-refinement oriented validation and human-labeled item validation, demonstrate that SRCoD outperforms state-of-the-art benchmark diagnosis methods.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 34 pages, including appendices

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14609

**作者：** ZiAn Wang、Ruiqi Liu、Zhengbo Zhang、Yi Han、Jialiang Shen、Ruoxin Chen、Manni Cui、Ximo Zhu、Jin Jiang、Mingzhe Liu、Linhao Wang、Wenhao Wang、Shu Wu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出「图像事实性评估」任务与经专家审核的 EviLens 基准（10,174 张图像、十二类事实错误），并构建多模态 ReAct 智能体 EviScene，交替进行视觉检查、外部检索与证据分析，用教师轨迹 SFT 加特权 on-policy 自蒸馏训练紧凑策略。

**相关性简评：** 其「检查—检索—证据分析」循环及用新发现细化问题、回看图像细节的机制，可能为 LVR 中证据获取、动态计算与停止决策提供参照；训练侧的特权自蒸馏轨迹可供核查贡献分配与监督信号的设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** EviScene: Beyond "Is It AI?" for Agentic Image Factuality Assessment

**abstract/A1：** Determining whether an image is AI-generated does not establish whether the situation it depicts is factually supported. We formulate Image Factuality Assessment: given an image and a generic verification instruction, a system returns a supported or refuted verdict with an evidence-grounded explanation. Without a supplied textual claim, the system must progressively refine factual questions during investigation and align external evidence with the specific situation depicted. We introduce EviLens, an expert-reviewed benchmark of 10,174 supported and refuted images from controlled construction and web collection, covering twelve factual error types and evaluating both verdict accuracy and evidence sufficiency. We develop EviScene, a multimodal ReAct agent that interleaves visual inspection, external retrieval, and evidence analysis, using new findings to refine its questions and revisit relevant image details. We train a compact policy with supervised fine-tuning on reviewed teacher trajectories, followed by privileged on-policy self-distillation applied to verified decisions from the policy's own investigations. On the 1,527-image test set, the trained Qwen3.5-9B agent achieves 79.05% balanced accuracy and a Strict Evidence Sufficiency Rate (SESR) of 52.26%, improving over the same-backbone base agent by 6.71 and 9.37 percentage points, respectively. Its SESR is the highest among the evaluated agents.Code, models, and data will be released at https://github.com/wangzian828/EVISCENE and https://huggingface.co/ZiAnwang/EviScene.

</details>

### 12. [SPARE: Shared Perception and Adaptive Retrieval of Evidence for Streaming Video Understanding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14671v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14671

**作者：** Senbin Xu、Zijun Zhang、Xinhua Wu、Li He、Jubo Feng、Li Qiao、Zhen Gao、Yan Zhang、Jixiang Luo、Rongrong Ji

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14671v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14671v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SPARE，用于流式视频理解的框架：用轻量 gate 判断近期观测是否已足以回答问题，不足时再通过多模态检索补充历史片段，并以 LoRA 指令微调让模型联合使用当前与检索到的证据、证据仍不足时选择弃答；同时让理解与检索分支共享视觉编码器。

**相关性简评：** 其「证据是否充分」的 gate 与弃答机制可直接对应 LVR 中 STOP 决策与证据筛选问题，且强调相关性与证据充分性不等价，可供核查何时停止获取证据、历史上下文干扰等线索；但工作聚焦流式视频应用，未涉及 latent 推理状态，需人工确认可迁移程度。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SPARE: Shared Perception and Adaptive Retrieval of Evidence for Streaming Video Understanding

**abstract/A1：** Streaming video understanding requires answering questions from the observed video, with evidence drawn from recent observations or earlier events. Historical context can improve recall but may interfere with judgments based on recent frames. Its usefulness depends on both when it is introduced and which clips are selected, while relevance alone does not guarantee sufficient evidence for an answer. We propose SPARE, a framework that combines adaptive historical retrieval with visual encoder sharing. A lightweight gate predicts whether recent observations provide sufficient evidence to answer the question. When additional evidence is predicted to be necessary, a multimodal embedding model retrieves relevant historical clips to supplement the current context. LoRA instruction tuning trains the understanding model to use recent observations and retrieved history jointly and abstain when the evidence remains insufficient. To reduce redundant visual parameters, the understanding and retrieval branches share a visual encoder while retaining separate language backbones. Four linear adapters align the shared features with the retrieval model through distillation at the visual token and final retrieval embedding levels. With visual-only inputs, SPARE achieves 77.78% on the evaluated Real-time and Backward task groups of OVO-Bench and 73.31% on StreamingBench. Compared with Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct evaluated at 2 fps, SPARE improves accuracy by 20.68 percentage points on OVO-Bench and 14.15 percentage points on StreamingBench.

</details>

### 13. [HumanPhys: A Human-Centric Physical-World Perception Benchmark for Real-World Visual Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14679v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14679

**作者：** Yiming Zhang、Enzhi Zhou、Junan Lin、Dulan Zhou、Weiqiang Wang、Yuge Huang、Jian Liu

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14679v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14679v1>)

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 HumanPhys，一个以人为中心的真实世界物理感知基准及同流程生成的训练语料，题目覆盖深度、人际距离、视线角、位移速度、轨迹、眨眼、形变、光照与相机自运动等物理量，标签由传感器标定、元数据或渲染器状态程序化导出，并在六个维度上评测多家开源与闭源 MLLM。

**相关性简评：** 其物理量标签与六维诊断可用于核查 VLM 是否在内部状态中保留几何、深度与运动等任务必要视觉信息，属主线关心的表示与诊断资源；但论文未涉及 latent 推理状态生成，能否支撑内部表示层面的因果分析需进一步核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** HumanPhys: A Human-Centric Physical-World Perception Benchmark for Real-World Visual Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** We introduce HumanPhys, a human-centric benchmark for real-world physical perception, and a training corpus emitted by the same pipeline. Each question targets a physically grounded quantity related to people, including depth, inter-person distance, gaze angle, displacement, velocity, heading-step trajectory, blink count, and contact-deformation strength. The rendered probes additionally test illumination inference from body and face cues and camera ego-motion, both with and without a person in the frame. All labels are derived programmatically from sensor calibration, source metadata, or renderer state, rather than written by annotators or produced by estimators on the benchmark frames. HumanPhys systematically probes six dimensions of human-centric physical perception: spatial state, kinematics, blink events, deformation, illumination, and camera pose. To the best of our knowledge, no existing MLLM benchmark-and-training corpus jointly supervises this set of human-centered physical quantities under direct metadata- or renderer-derived labels. The six dimensions appear only partially dissociable across the tested MLLMs. We benchmark a range of open- and closed-source MLLMs on HumanPhys and find that all six capability dimensions remain challenging for current models. We hope HumanPhys will support future research on multimodal systems that perceive and reason about people in the physical world.

</details>

### 14. [How Should a Camera-First AI Agent Work?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14772v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14772

**作者：** Xiaofan Wu、Xi Zeng、Miaoxia Chen、Peishan Chen、Shuyan Li、Chen Wang、Jiyun Yao、Hanyong Zhong、Jiahao Zhu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.HC、cs.LO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14772v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14772v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 一篇立场/契约论文，把时敏「相机优先」智能体的核心障碍归结为时间而非识别能力，形式化「短暂目标交互」并提出分离硬记忆截止与软推理截止的双截止架构（常开非语义快路径、主动记忆机制、延迟推理层），在 MOT17 轨迹窗口上做一致性检验，并以前沿模型实测延迟校准单路径基线。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 的 LOOK/STOP 和证据获取直接相关：硬记忆截止对应「错过即不可恢复」的视觉证据保留问题，软推理截止与 1.2–9.3 s 延迟测量可供核查 THINK/LOOK 的时序预算、证据筛选与停止决策成本。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** How Should a Camera-First AI Agent Work?

**abstract/A1：** Camera-first agents must act on the visual world as it unfolds. We argue that the central obstacle for future camera-first agents is not recognition ability - multimodal models (vision-language and live/streaming alike) generalize well through language and remain the right tool for semantic reasoning - but time. Many visual targets are ephemeral: they appear, are query-relevant, and leave within a short window. Binding memory to the same end-to-end path as reasoning means that by the time a monolithic pipeline completes, the evidence is gone. We formalize this as Ephemeral-Target Interaction (ETI) and a Perceptual Deadline Contract separating a hard memory deadline from a soft reasoning deadline, grounded in the bounded, passive nature of sensory and working memory. We propose a two-deadline architecture: an always-on, bounded, non-semantic fast path; an active remembering mechanism that commits a moment to durable memory before it is overwritten (event-driven in v1); and a deferred deliberation layer (multimodal model + tools). We instantiate the contract on real MOT17 track windows, a consistency check, and calibrate the single-path baseline from measured frontier-model latency: even a short answer takes 1.2-9.3 s, and an agentic identify-and-search longer. Answers can be late; evidence cannot be missed.

**comment/C1：** 8 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Position/contract paper on time-critical camera-first agents (systems/timing).Primary cs.AI;

</details>

### 15. [VC-OPD: Visual Counterfactual On-Policy Distillation for Grounded Vision-Language Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14939v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14939

**作者：** Jiahe Feng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14939v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14939v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对 GRPO 类序列级奖励难以做 token 级信用分配、而标准 on-policy distillation 又对模板化与视觉无关 token 同等加权的问题，提出 VC-OPD：先用教师监督预热稳定输出格式，再用原图与「证据被破坏的反事实图」两次教师评估，以两者的分布差估计 token 的视觉依赖度并对蒸馏损失加权，配合质量守恒归一化把学习容量转向真正依赖图像证据的推理 token。

**相关性简评：** 反事实图像对比给出的 token 级视觉依赖权重，可作为判断推理状态是否真正使用视觉证据、筛选有贡献 token 以及缓解视觉旁路和信息坍缩的参考线索；但该工作停留在训练期监督重加权，未涉及 latent 状态的生成与更新，其权重估计是否等价于因果贡献仍需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** VC-OPD: Visual Counterfactual On-Policy Distillation for Grounded Vision-Language Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** GRPO-style reinforcement learning has advanced vision-language reasoning, but its sequence-level rewards provide limited credit assignment for individual reasoning tokens. On-policy distillation (OPD) addresses this issue by providing dense supervision on student-generated trajectories, yet standard OPD assigns similar importance to all teacher-preferred tokens, including template phrases and visually irrelevant continuations. We introduce Visual Counterfactual On-Policy Distillation (VC-OPD), a grounding-aware distillation method that prioritizes tokens whose correctness depends on image-specific evidence. After a teacher-supervised warm start that stabilizes response formats and reduces noisy rollouts, VC-OPD performs on-policy distillation with two teacher evaluations for each student trajectory: one under the original image and one under a counterfactual image with corrupted instance-specific evidence. The original-image teacher distribution determines the distillation target, while the original--counterfactual teacher gap estimates token-level visual dependence and softly reweights the loss. To avoid unstable response-level update scales, VC-OPD further applies mass-preserving normalization to the token weights. This design preserves the dense supervision of OPD while shifting learning capacity toward visually grounded reasoning tokens. Experiments on multimodal reasoning benchmarks show that VC-OPD improves visual reasoning performance and produces more effective token-level distillation.

</details>

### 16. [Self-Evolving Visual Agent via Margin Reward](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15084v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15084

**作者：** Wenxi Yang、Yuzhong Zhao、Baochang Zhang、Yunfan Liu、Qixiang Ye

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15084v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15084v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Marvo 自演化框架：challenger 从无标注图像生成问答，solver 用强化学习学习工具调用，并以「有无工具时解题表现的差值」作为 margin reward 构建自适应课程；在 agent 推理、视觉搜索等基准上平均准确率提升最多 7.1%。

**相关性简评：** 工具调用何时触发、视觉证据获取带来多少增益，与 LVR 关注的 LOOK 收益、证据筛选和动态计算决策直接相关；margin reward 可能为「是否需要额外视觉信息」提供可核查的训练信号。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Self-Evolving Visual Agent via Margin Reward

**abstract/A1：** Visual agents that interleave reasoning with tool invocation have posed a promising direction for multimodal tasks. However, learning effective tool invocation usually relies on curated question-answer pairs or expert demonstrations at scale, which are expensive to acquire. In this study, we propose Marvo, a simple-yet-effective self-evolution approach that enables learning tool invocation from unlabeled images. Marvo consists of two agents: (1) a challenger that generates question-answer pairs from unlabeled images, and (2) a solver that learns tool invocation by solving questions through reinforcement learning. To encourage effective tool invocation, a good training question should be difficult enough to warrant tool use, yet remain within the solver's capabilities. To this end, we introduce a margin reward to the challenger, defined as solver's performance difference with and without access to tools. With the margin reward, we create an adaptive curriculum that encourages the solver to learn effective tool invocation. Across benchmarks covering agentic reasoning, visual search, mathematical, and general real-world reasoning, Marvo improves average accuracy by up to 7.1\\% --- demonstrating margin reward as a preferred way to scale question complexity without human supervision.

</details>

### 17. [GesBench: When and Where Do Multimodal Language Models Perceive Social Meaning?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15129v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15129

**作者：** Zonghuan Li、Hayley Hung、Chirag Raman

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15129v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15129v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 GesBench，用累积的子话语片段测量多模态 LLM 何时形成稳定的说话人意图与社会可供性判断，并以人类注视引导的破坏实验检验人关注区域是否对模型判断具有功能作用，从而把社会意义评估从「最终是否识别」转向「何时、何处形成」。

**相关性简评：** 其「何时形成稳定解释」与注视引导破坏所考察的视觉证据因果作用，可为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、动态计算与停止决策提供基准设计线索，但对象是社会意义理解而非 latent 推理，与内部状态的关联尚需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GesBench: When and Where Do Multimodal Language Models Perceive Social Meaning?

**abstract/A1：** Human social perception is incremental: we infer intent before an utterance is complete, revise our interpretation as new cues arrive, and attend to specific facial, gestural, or prosodic signals that shape social meaning. Current multimodal LLM benchmarks largely evaluate final-answer understanding over complete episodes, rewarding post-hoc recognition of social meaning rather than the unfolding perception required for real-time interaction. Drawing on interactionally embedded Gestalt principles of multimodal human communication, we introduce GesBench: a human-grounded benchmark for cue-level social perception in multimodal LLMs. GesBench uses cumulative sub-utterance clips to measure when models form stable interpretations of speaker intention and social affordance, and human gaze-guided corruption to evaluate whether regions attended by humans are functionally important for model judgments. Built from more than 6000 utterance-level clips from scripted and unscripted conversational datasets, GesBench includes human annotations of unfolding judgments and gaze on a representative subset. Across open and closed multimodal models, we find a clear human-model gap: humans form predictive understandings early and revise more often, while models often hedge or repeat across different clips. GesBench shifts social evaluation from whether models eventually recognize meaning to when and where that meaning is formed. Our codes are publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/status/GesBench-share-212C.

</details>

### 18. [Genesis: Visual Augmentation Primitives for Multimodal Chain-of-Thought Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15565v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15565

**作者：** Fan Yang、Lifeng Chen、Yipu Wang、Han Wang、Feilong Chen、Yidong Ma、Zhiyang Chen、Chaoyang Zhao、Lingxiang Wu、Hanqi Jiang、Yibo Chen、Xu Tang、Yao Hu、Ming Tang、Xiaojie Jin、Xiaolong Zheng、Jinqiao Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15565v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15565v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Visual Augmentation Primitives 训练数据增强流程：用视觉生成模型从种子图像合成多样逼真样本及对应推理文本，构建连贯的多模态推理链，并配合基于 rubric 的强化学习对中间步骤的逻辑性、完整性和一致性打分，同时构建 UNREAL 基准评估超写实场景的视觉推理。

**相关性简评：** 论文直接针对多模态 CoT 停留在语言空间、各步未锚定视觉证据的问题，与 LVR 关注的视觉旁路、证据筛选和轨迹监督密切相关，可供核查其合成数据与中间步骤奖励是否真正约束了视觉信息使用，不过其方法仍为训练期数据与奖励设计，未涉及 latent 状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Genesis: Visual Augmentation Primitives for Multimodal Chain-of-Thought Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Recent multimodal large language models achieve promising results on visual reasoning tasks, approaching human-level performance on existing STEM benchmarks. However, these capabilities degrade under complex real-world scenes. We identify that chain-of-thought reasoning remains largely confined to the linguistic space, rarely anchoring each step in visual evidence. The main cause is the absence of such data during training. In this work, we introduce a training data augmentation pipeline, \\textbf{Visual Augmentation Primitives} (VAP), which leverages state-of-the-art vision generative models to synthesize diverse photorealistic training samples and corresponding reasoning text. VAP introduces some basic operators and applies them to a seed image and gets a variant. It also constructs coherent multimodal reasoning chains throughout the generation process. Such training data force models to perceive visual content and perform logical reasoning according to them at every step. We further introduce multimodal chain-of-thought rubric-based reinforcement learning to enhance this. It rewards not only text reasoning but also visual reasoning by scoring intermediate reasoning steps for logical validity, completeness, and consistency. Moreover, we construct the UNREAL benchmark to systematically evaluate visual reasoning on hyperrealistic scenes across controllable difficulty levels. Experiments show that a 4B model built on this framework surpasses 8B baselines, with performance improving consistently as the model scales to 32B, validating the scaling law for visual reasoning.

</details>

### 19. [FireNav: Decision-Oriented Reconstruction Evidence Routing for Vision-Language Navigation in Indoor Fire Environments](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15595v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15595

**作者：** Hongbo Ding、Xiang Chen、Jiangxin Dong、Jinshan Pan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15595v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15595v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 FireNav，面向室内火灾场景的视觉语言导航：保留原生视觉 token，将 latent 重建特征作为辅助证据，由轻量路由器依据视觉特征、任务上下文和历史执行状态决定是否纳入及贡献强度，并用决策效用校准（比较同一状态下有/无候选证据的动作预测损失）监督证据选择；同时贡献配对的 FireVLN-Bench 基准。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉证据筛选、latent 内容是否真正被使用、贡献分配与监督等关注点直接相关；其「路由器按需接纳辅助证据」和「同状态下有无证据的损失对比」可能为判断 latent 证据何时有益、如何按贡献监督提供可核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FireNav: Decision-Oriented Reconstruction Evidence Routing for Vision-Language Navigation in Indoor Fire Environments

**abstract/A1：** In real-world indoor fire environments, visual degradation severely impairs instruction grounding, waypoint prediction, and long-horizon exploration in vision-language navigation (VLN). Although image restoration offers a natural means to mitigate such visual degradation, existing methods primarily optimize reconstruction fidelity, which does not necessarily translate into better navigation decisions and may even corrupt task-critical cues when applied indiscriminately. In this paper, we present FireNav, a decision-oriented reconstruction evidence routing framework that aligns visual restoration with navigation utility in VLN. To advance this task, we first contribute FireVLN-Bench, a paired indoor fire navigation benchmark with clean references preserving task semantics, safety supervision, and matched settings for continuous navigation and robot execution with simulated dynamics. Our FireNav retains native visual tokens and treats latent reconstruction features as auxiliary evidence, where a lightweight router leverages visual features, task context, and prior execution states to determine whether such evidence should be admitted and how strongly it should contribute to the visual tokens. To learn when reconstruction is beneficial, we further introduce decision utility calibration, which compares action prediction losses with and without candidate evidence under the same state, thereby supervising evidence selection according to its contribution to waypoint, heading, and arrival prediction. Experiments demonstrate that FireNav consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both navigation success and path efficiency across evaluation settings.

**comment/C1：** https://firenav-bench.github.io/FireNav

</details>

### 20. [From Stages to States: Unified Iterative Reasoning for MLLMs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15620v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15620

**作者：** Chuang Yu、Xuefei Ma、Yuanhao Feng、Wuxiong Zeng、Bo Wang、Minghong Cai、Dongming Wu、Fei Zhou、Chen Tang、Wenwen Tong、Lewei Lu、Xiangyu Yue

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15620v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15620v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 ReState，把多模态推理从按预设阶段分别优化的 stage-centric 流程改为 state-driven 的统一迭代过程，用统一推理状态建模（URSM）在共享状态空间内联合学习推理构建、正确推理保持与错误纠正，并以闭环推理状态学习（CRSL）在训练中引入自生成历史状态、推理时递归更新状态，另构建跨八个视觉推理领域的 VersaCoT-10K 数据集。

**相关性简评：** 其「推理状态转移 + 递归更新 + 缩小训练-推理状态差距」与 LVR 关注的状态生成、迭代自精炼和监督方式直接相关，可供核查该状态是否保留视觉证据、是否实质区别于 token 级 MCoT，以及是否涉及停止决策。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** From Stages to States: Unified Iterative Reasoning for MLLMs

**abstract/A1：** Multimodal Chain-of-Thought (MCoT) substantially enhances the complex reasoning capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) by explicitly modeling intermediate reasoning processes. However, most learning-based MCoT methods follow a stage-centric paradigm, where different reasoning behaviors are assigned to predefined stages and optimized separately. This results in fragmented reasoning and a training-inference reasoning-state gap. To address these limitations, we propose ReState, a unified iterative reasoning framework that reformulates multimodal reasoning from a stage-driven pipeline into a state-driven dynamic process. It comprises two complementary components: Unified Reasoning State Modeling (URSM) and Closed-Loop Reasoning-State Learning (CRSL). URSM unifies reasoning construction, correct reasoning preservation, and erroneous reasoning correction as reasoning-state transitions within a shared state space, enabling these heterogeneous reasoning behaviors to be learned jointly. CRSL further incorporates self-generated historical reasoning states during training and recursively updates the current state during inference, thereby mitigating the reasoning-state gap and enabling iterative self-refinement without requiring an additional reflection module, critic, or independent correction stage. Furthermore, we construct VersaCoT-10K, a high-quality CoT dataset spanning eight visual reasoning domains, which provides diverse supervision for multi-domain reasoning and reasoning-state refinement. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ReState exhibits strong adaptability across different MLLM backbones and achieves strong performance on multiple public reasoning benchmarks, supporting the shift from stage-centric reasoning toward state-centric reasoning. Our data and code are available at https://github.com/YuChuang1205/ReState

**comment/C1：** Under review

</details>

### 21. [PhySimCode: A Benchmark and Evaluation Method for Physics Video to Code Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15722v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15722

**作者：** Souraja Kundu、Aditya Gupta、Joel Julin、Yizhou Zhao、Liuyue Xie、Laszlo A. Jeni

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15722v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15722v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 PhySimCode 基准：仅给原始视频，要求 MLLM 推断物理规律、恢复参数并生成可运行仿真代码，含 16 万余程序化样本与 2430 视频评测集，从定律正确性、仿真等价性、代码可执行性和参数恢复四方面评测十个模型。

**相关性简评：** 其核心发现「模型能陈述物理定律却难以从视频推断规律、参数恢复率极低」与 LVR 关注的视觉证据是否真正进入推理状态、视觉旁路与信息坍缩直接对应，可作为诊断性对照基准；结构化 CoT 与参数恢复指标可供核查，但论文本身未涉及 latent 推理状态的生成或使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PhySimCode: A Benchmark and Evaluation Method for Physics Video to Code Generation

**abstract/A1：** Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are good at video understanding and code generation, but it remains unclear whether they can recover the physical laws underlying videos, a capability essential for converting videos into executable simulations and for providing structured physical supervision in robotics. Captioning motion video does not imply that a model has inferred its governing dynamics, estimated quantitative parameters, or can regenerate the observed scene from code. Existing video-physics benchmarks evaluate plausibility, property estimation, or future-state prediction, but offer limited insight into whether models can translate visual dynamics into runnable simulation code. We introduce PhySimCode, a benchmark for physics video-to-code generation: given only a raw video, a model must infer the relevant physics, recover parameter values, and generate runnable Python that reproduces the input video. The dataset contains 160.6K procedurally generated samples spanning 162 physics phenomena across analytic SciPy simulations and PyBullet-rendered rigid-body, articulated, fluid, and contact-rich scenes; each sample bundles the simulation code, physical parameters, rendered video, and a structured chain-of-thought covering observations, laws, ODEs, numerical methods, and validation checks. We evaluate ten state-of-the-art closed- and open-source MLLMs along physical-law correctness, simulation equivalence, code executability, and parameter recovery. Models reliably state physics laws (4.27-4.93/5) yet score only 1.51-2.47/5 on inferring them from video, and the best system (Claude Sonnet 4.6) recovers just 7.7% of ground-truth parameters within $\\pm 20\\%$, exposing a substantial video-to-simulation gap. The 2,430-video evaluation set is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/SourajaKundu123/PhySimCode and the evaluation code at https://github.com/SourajaKundu/PhySimCode

**comment/C1：** 34 pages, 8 figures, 20 tables. Project page: https://sourajakundu.github.io/PhySimCode/

</details>

### 22. [Geometric Parrots: Rule Absence vs. Rule Fragility in Spatial and Physical Reasoning for Vision-Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16170v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16170

**作者：** Bilal Jawaid、Hamza Hanif、Muhammad Maaz Uddin、Anas Zafar、Inad Alqurashi、Aizan Zafar、Osama Farooqui、Sheheryar Khan、Ferhat Sadak、Shaina Raza、Rizwan Qureshi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16170v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16170v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 GRIP，一个由确定性代码程序化生成场景与精确标注的几何、空间、视觉与物理推理基准（34 个域、10 万图、60 万问答），并设计「双环评估」：闭环用五步组合式问题阶梯定位推理失败环节，开环在同伴模型回答或无依据的用户断言下重新诱答，从而把答案变化区分为纠正与屈服，以分离「规则缺失」与「规则脆弱」两种失败模式。

**相关性简评：** 该工作直接诊断 VLM 在几何与空间推理上是否真正依赖视觉证据，其可控挑战下的答案翻转与组合式阶梯，可供核查模型内部状态是否保留任务必要视觉信息、以及答案对视觉旁路与外部提示的依赖程度。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Geometric Parrots: Rule Absence vs. Rule Fragility in Spatial and Physical Reasoning for Vision-Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Vision-language models (VLMs) can answer many geometric and physical reasoning questions correctly, yet still behave inconsistently in interaction, for example, abandoning a correct answer when confronted with a confident but incorrect user assertion. Standard single-turn accuracy cannot distinguish such capitulations from beneficial corrections because it scores each response in isolation. We introduce GRIP, a controlled benchmark with 34 procedurally generated reasoning domains, 100,000 images, and 600,000 questions spanning geometric, spatial, visual, and physical reasoning. Each scene is generated by deterministic code, and every answer is derived directly from the underlying scene state, providing exact ground truth without human annotation. On GRIP, we propose Dual-Loop Evaluation. A closed loop probes each image with a five-step compositional question ladder to localize where reasoning fails. An open loop then re-elicits the model's answer under controlled challenges, including peer-model responses and unsupported user assertions. Because ground truth is known exactly, answer changes can be signed as corrections (wrong-to-right) or capitulations (right-to-wrong), separating two failure modes: rule absence and rule fragility. The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/bilaljawaid980/GRIP-Benchmark, with further details at https://bilaljawaid980.github.io/grip-benchmark/.

</details>

### 23. [Learning Temporal Evidence Selection for Video Anomaly Understanding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16299v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16299

**作者：** Hangil Park、Seungheon Kim、Tae-Kyun Kim

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16299v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16299v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把视频异常理解中的时间采样重新表述为与下游生成对齐的证据选择问题，提出语义条件化的 Temporal Sampling Q-Former：以自动抽取的 CLIP 物体标签作为采样器条件（不并入生成提示），在视觉 token 空间学习软时间选择权重，并在生成前合并重复选择。

**相关性简评：** 直接涉及「视觉证据筛选」与 LOOK 式决策：其采样目标对齐到解释效用而非异常显著性，可供核查可学习证据选择如何影响多模态推理的证据使用与监督方式。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning Temporal Evidence Selection for Video Anomaly Understanding

**abstract/A1：** Video anomaly understanding (VAU) aims to generate language-level interpretations of anomalous events in long videos, requiring visual evidence that supports explanation beyond anomaly detection alone. Existing VAU pipelines commonly rely on anomaly-centric or predefined temporal sampling strategies, which efficiently emphasize suspicious moments but overlook contextual cues, object interactions, and temporally distributed evidence needed for reasoning. Motivated by recent progress in learnable temporal selection for long-video question answering, we revisit VAU temporal sampling as a downstream-aligned evidence selection problem. We introduce the semantic-conditioned Temporal Sampling Q-Former that learns to select temporal visual evidence through the VAU generation objective. Since generic VAU prompts provide weak video-specific guidance, we condition the sampler on CLIP-embedded object tags automatically extracted from the input video. These tags are used only for temporal evidence selection and are not appended to the LLM generation prompt, separating sampler conditioning from prompt augmentation. The proposed sampler operates in visual-token space, computes soft temporal selection weights from frame-level representations, and merges duplicated selections before response generation. Experiments on HIVAU-70K show that our model achieves the best performance among the compared fine-tuned models, while ablations demonstrate that learnable temporal sampling improves over fixed anomaly-focused sampling and that CLIP-embedded object-tag conditioning further improves over generic-prompt conditioning. Our results suggest that temporal sampling in VAU should be aligned with explanation-oriented evidence utility rather than anomaly saliency alone.

</details>

### 24. [ReTAC: Residual Test-Time Agentic Computation for Video Spatial Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16315v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16315

**作者：** Yike Wu、Keyan Chen、Qixiong Wang、Xi Xiang、Maofei Que、Xiaolong Jiang、Xiaoqin Zhang、Ling Shao、Shijian Lu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16315v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16315v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出免训练的多智能体测试时框架 ReTAC，用于视频空间推理：只在基模型未解决的需求上追加计算，并用阶段对齐验证把失败定位到规划、感知或推理，再按依赖只重算受影响状态。

**相关性简评：** 其「计算该分配到哪里、保留哪些有效中间状态」的实证结论，与 LVR 关注的动态计算、证据筛选、失败定位和状态复用/缓存直接相关，可供核查 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的收益与成本线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ReTAC: Residual Test-Time Agentic Computation for Video Spatial Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Test-time agentic computation can improve multimodal large language models (MLLMs) through planning, tool use, iterative perception, and reflection, but indiscriminate computation may duplicate resolved work, introduce noisy evidence, and perturb correct predictions. We propose that such computation should be residual: allocate additional computation only to requirements unresolved by the base model and, after a localized failure, recompute only the affected states. We instantiate this formulation in ReTAC, a training-free multiagent framework for video spatial reasoning. ReTAC organizes supplementary computation around unresolved requirements. It plans ordered steps to acquire missing spatial evidence and combines the observations with compatible native evidence for reasoning. In addition, it uses stage-aligned verification to localize failures to planning, perception, or reasoning. Dependency-based recovery recomputes only affected states while reusing unaffected ones. Extensive experiments show that ReTAC achieves the highest overall score among the compared methods across three mainstream MLLMs and two widely adopted benchmarks. Further analyses show that gains from additional computation depend not only on how much is used, but also on where it is allocated and which valid intermediate states are preserved.

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16357v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16357v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 VideoSlate，一个以共享证据为中心的有状态提交控制框架：用类型化证据「黑板」连接候选片段、来源、构造与验证观察，由相对当前采纳片段的 certifier 判断修订支持度，控制器据此决定修订或保留，从而把证据积累与状态更新分离，用于视频时序定位与 grounded 问答。

**相关性简评：** 其「采纳/保留」提交控制与证据积累—状态更新分离，直接对应 LVR 关注的证据筛选与 STOP/停止决策问题，可供核查显式采纳决策如何约束下游视觉证据的流向与修订时机。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** VideoSlate: Stateful Commit Control for Temporally Grounded Agentic Video Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Agentic video reasoning systems gather and assess video evidence across stages, selecting relevant spans as visual evidence for answering questions. New candidates and observations prompt reassessment of the current span, but revisions can correct localization errors or discard useful evidence already present in the adopted span. Systems therefore need to connect evidence organization across stages with temporal state control, allowing accumulated information to jointly inform revision assessment while explicit adoption decisions govern how assessment outcomes affect downstream visual evidence. We introduce VideoSlate, a stateful commit-control framework built around shared evidence. A typed evidence blackboard links candidate spans, provenance, construction, and verifier observations, enabling an incumbent-relative certifier to assess revision support from the candidate, current span, and related proposals. Based on certification, the controller authorizes a revision or retains the current span, separating evidence accumulation from state updates and recording each decision and its evidence on the blackboard. Extensive evaluations across video grounding and grounded question-answering benchmarks show that VideoSlate can improve temporal localization through selective revision.

### 26. [Teaching Vision-Language Models to Decline: Support Completion Against Mirage](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16465v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16465

**作者：** Alfaj Uddin Ahmed、Md. Shaown Miah、Md Arid Hasan、Syed Ishtiaque Ahmed、Sayeed Shafayet Chowdhury

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16465v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16465v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把 VLM「mirage」现象（对从未展示的图像作答、答案未被证据支持）归因于训练目标中缺乏拒答激励，提出支持补全训练 TIDE：同一问题搭配空白图、同域错误图与域外图并将目标设为拒答，证明图像盲预测器在 TIDE 下每例至少次优 1.04 nats，并在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 上将无效证据幻景率从 0.759 降到 0.097。

**相关性简评：** 直接涉及答案是否真正依赖视觉证据、视觉旁路与拒答/停止决策；其「答或拒的决策误差受表示区分有效与无效证据的能力下界约束」这一结论，可供核查 latent 状态中的证据筛选与 STOP 判据时参考。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Teaching Vision-Language Models to Decline: Support Completion Against Mirage

**abstract/A1：** Vision-language models answer questions about images they were never shown, a failure called mirage. Such an answer can be correct without being justified by the evidence, and the difference matters wherever a model's output is checked by someone who did not see its input. We locate the failure in the training objective: cross-entropy separates a model that reads the image from one that ignores it by only the conditional mutual information between answer and image, and no training example rewards declining. We formalise support completion, TIDE, which also shows each training question with a blank image, a same-domain wrong image and an out-of-domain image, with targets that decline, and prove that under TIDE every image-blind predictor is suboptimal by at least 1.04 nats per example, that the optimum declines exactly on the counterfactual kinds while keeping its behaviour on valid images, and that for any finite model the error of its answer-or-decline decision, declining on valid input plus answering on invalid input, is bounded below by how well its representation separates valid from invalid evidence. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B under a frozen held-out protocol with two judges, the three-condition predecessor of TIDE reduced the invalid-evidence mirage rate from 0.759 to 0.097 and the blank-image rate from 0.700 to 0.003 at a false-abstention cost of 0.126; label-free grounding raised the rate to 0.859, a likelihood-advantage contrast moved it only to 0.718 because its empty-image term carries no gradient, and grounding applied after support completion re-opened the mirage. The four-condition protocol on three base models, with seeds and component ablations, is in progress and not reported here.

**comment/C1：** 23 pages, 10 figures. Includes supplementary material

</details>

### 27. [Code-Interactive Visual Reasoning for Financial Candlestick Understanding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16587v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16587

**作者：** Chenxi Zhang、Youwei Pang、Xiaoqi Zhao、Ziliang Gan、Rongjunchen Zhang、Shanshan Feng、Hao Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对金融 K 线图理解，提出 Fin-Thinker：模型生成并执行代码定位视觉元素、对齐多面板并完成数值计算，再用返回观测引导后续推理；配套构建 32K 可重放校验的代码—观测轨迹，采用视觉代码微调、金融过程监督与执行反馈强化学习三阶段训练，并发布按答案正确性、代码执行与证据接地分别评测的基准。

**相关性简评：** 论文关注视觉证据获取、证据接地与「答案正确但无证据支撑」的诊断，并把证据接地与答案正确性分开评测，对 LVR 的「LOOK/证据筛选」与轨迹监督、贡献分配问题有可比线索；但推理状态属显式代码与外部观测，而非内部 latent，需核查其接地指标与过程监督设计能否迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Code-Interactive Visual Reasoning for Financial Candlestick Understanding

**abstract/A1：** Financial candlestick understanding requires locating visual elements, aligning them across trading dates and panels, and combining observations through numerical and financial reasoning. Answer accuracy alone does not reveal whether predictions are supported by chart evidence. We introduce Code-Interactive Financial Candlestick Reasoning and present Fin-Thinker, a model based on Qwen3.5-9B that generates and executes code to acquire evidence and perform computations. The model uses the returned observations to guide subsequent reasoning. To train these capabilities, we construct FinKLine-32K with 32,184 replay-verified code-observation trajectories collected through teacher-guided student exploration. These include successful solutions with and without error recovery. Our three-stage training framework combines foundational visual-code fine-tuning, financial process supervision of successful reasoning and corrective continuations, and execution-feedback reinforcement learning. For evaluation, we introduce FinKLineBench with 1,200 questions across 138 financial task types to assess answer correctness, code execution, and evidence grounding separately. On FinKLineBench, Fin-Thinker improves strict accuracy by 13.1 and 33.2 percentage points over the best-performing direct-answer baseline among those evaluated and its base model with sandbox access, respectively. Training-stage ablations further show that financial process supervision and execution-feedback reinforcement learning yield successive improvements in both answer accuracy and GPT-5.6-judged grounded accuracy.

</details>

### 28. [Detecting Chain-of-Thought Hijacking in Backdoored Multimodal Large Reasoning Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16598v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16598

**作者：** Zhifang Zhang、Qi Wei、Weitong Chen、Olaf Maennel、Wei Emma Zhang、zuomin ren、Lei Feng、Miao Xu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16598v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16598v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究多模态大推理模型中的 CoT 劫持后门：提出用「信念惯性」量化推理片段的累积下一 token 熵与其引发的答案信念修正之差，并进一步限定到图像依赖片段得到 visual belief inertia（VBI），据此构建免训练的测试时检测器 InertiaGuard。

**相关性简评：** 直接涉及多模态推理链的忠实性诊断，其「答案是否由视觉证据驱动」「哪一段推理真正改变答案」的度量思路，可能与 LVR 中视觉旁路、证据贡献分配及 latent 轨迹监督问题相互参照核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Detecting Chain-of-Thought Hijacking in Backdoored Multimodal Large Reasoning Models

**abstract/A1：** Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning enables multimodal large reasoning models (MLRMs) to solve complex visual problems, but also exposes them to CoT hijacking: an adversary implants a backdoor through poisoned fine-tuning so that a visual trigger induces a hijacking turn, redirecting an otherwise faithful reasoning chain to an attacker-chosen answer. However, since the hijack acts within the reasoning chain, existing multimodal backdoor defenses designed for MLLMs that answer directly struggle to detect it. Moreover, inspecting the chain itself does not reliably expose the hijack, since the hijacking turn can resemble honest self-correction in form. In this paper, we find that honest reasoning tends to revise its answer at high-entropy "aha moments", whereas a hijack can overturn a confident answer through a near-deterministic turn. To quantify this contrast, we formalize this phenomenon as belief inertia, the cumulative next-token entropy of a reasoning span minus the answer-belief revision it induces, with markedly lower values for hijacked spans than for honest reasoning spans. Since hijacking tokens are also image-dependent, we further improve detection by restricting the measure to image-dependent spans, yielding visual belief inertia (VBI). Building on this, we propose InertiaGuard, a training-free, test-time detector that flags a trace when its VBI falls below a threshold calibrated on a small set of clean traces. Across various attacks and benchmarks, InertiaGuard achieves higher detection performance than existing baselines, while generalizing to different model architectures and trigger types.

</details>

### 29. [PathPilot: An Adaptive Question-Conditioned Multi-Magnification Navigation Agent for Whole-Slide Image Analysis](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16734v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16734

**作者：** Zhengyang Xu、Han Li、Jingsong Liu、Ayako Ura、Shihui Zu、Shaohua Kevin Zhou、Nassir Navab、Peter Schüffler

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16734v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16734v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** PathPilot 提出面向全切片图像的多倍率导航 agent：CrossMagLoc 从病理医生观看行为学习倍率相关的诊断定位并融合相邻倍率信息，EviRegionSearch 则以问题为条件逐步累积证据、按剩余证据需求自适应选择下一步动作，直至证据充分，并在五个队列的 QA 上优于同类方法。

**相关性简评：** 该工作按证据充分度决定继续观察还是停止、并跨倍率选择观察位置，与 LVR 关注的多尺度视觉证据筛选及 LOOK/STOP 的收益—成本直接相关，可供核查其证据累积与停止判据能否迁移到 latent 推理工作区。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PathPilot: An Adaptive Question-Conditioned Multi-Magnification Navigation Agent for Whole-Slide Image Analysis

**abstract/A1：** The diagnostic capability of WSI agents relies on effective slide navigation to identify diagnostically relevant regions and efficiently integrate evidence across the slide. While in clinical practice, pathologists dynamically examine slides across multiple scales, integrating global and cellular evidence in a sequential manner, existing AI navigation approaches mostly operate at a single fixed magnification or rely on predefined magnification traversal. This mismatch prevents existing methods from modeling cross-magnification interactions and adaptive magnification selection inherent to real diagnostic workflows. We propose PathPilot, a clinically consistent multi-magnification WSI navigation agent that explicitly models cross-magnification localization and evidence-adaptive exploration. Specifically, we introduce a CrossMagLoc that learns magnification-specific diagnostic localization from pathologist viewing behavior and integrates information from adjacent magnifications to identify the diagnostically most relevant region within the current ROI, thereby providing a diagnostically informed starting point for subsequent question-conditioned exploration. We further introduce an EviRegionSearch that starts question-conditioned exploration from this region, progressively accumulating question-relevant evidence and adaptively determining the next navigation action according to the remaining evidence requirement. Their iterative interaction enables PathPilot to sequentially explore across ROIs and magnifications until sufficient evidence is acquired. Extensive QA evaluations across five cohorts demonstrate consistent superiority over competing SOTA methods on inter/external cohorts, respectively, validating question-conditioned evidence acquisition across regions and magnifications that mirrors the sequential, knowledge-driven navigation of pathologists.

</details>

### 30. [FoveaTree: Information-Density Trees for Query-Guided Visual Token Pruning in Video Large Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16744v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16744

**作者：** Zihan Meng、Weidong Chen、Dexiang Hong、Xinyan Liu、Zhendong Mao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16744v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16744v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对 Video LLM 视觉 token 过多导致的推理开销，提出免训练的 FoveaTree 两阶段视觉 token 剪枝：先用合并增益密度估计衡量区域合并造成的特征失真，构建四叉树密度图指导丢弃、合并与保留；再利用存活单元和继承的树拓扑，在中间层修正 text-to-vision 注意力。

**相关性简评：** 直接关联视觉证据筛选与内部状态中的视觉细节保留：其密度估计与注意力修正试图缓解层级盲剪枝和注意力漂移，可供核查在有限 token 预算下哪些任务必要视觉信息被保留，以及注意力结构（含 sink、位置效应）如何影响视觉证据取舍。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FoveaTree: Information-Density Trees for Query-Guided Visual Token Pruning in Video Large Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Video large language models (Video LLMs) encode each frame into hundreds of visual tokens, making video inference expensive. Existing methods reduce this cost through similarity-based merging or attention-based selection but face two challenges: Hierarchy-blind Pruning, which overlooks regional compressibility and can discard critical evidence, and Attention Drift, where positional effects and attention sinks shift text-to-vision attention away from task relevance. We propose FoveaTree, a two-stage, training-free visual-token pruning framework. First, Merge-Gain Density Estimation measures the feature distortion caused by regional merging and constructs a quadtree-derived density map to guide token dropping, merging, and retention. Second, Attention Tree Pruning uses the surviving units and inherited tree topology to refine text-to-vision attention in intermediate LLM layers, preserving relevant regional evidence while removing low-relevance content. We evaluate FoveaTree on InternVL3.5-8B and Qwen3-VL-8B across five video question-answering benchmarks and one captioning benchmark at 50%, 30%, and 10% visual-token retention. FoveaTree consistently achieves overall state-of-the-art performance across the evaluated settings, offering a strong accuracy-efficiency trade-off.

</details>

**内容简述：** 论文提出把地理空间矢量几何作为 VLM 的一种原生空间模态，构建保留矢量对象空间结构与排列的几何表示，并设计几何交互策略使其在多模态计算中按查询的空间关系与视觉、语言内容交互，在五个空间推理任务上平均准确率约提升 11%。

**相关性简评：** 直接触及 VLM 空间推理中的表示问题：几何与任务必要信息如何被显式组织并与视觉、语言共同参与推理，可供核查其「空间基座」究竟是输入模态注入还是真正进入内部推理状态，以及它能否缓解大尺度下视觉观测不足导致的参照与关系恢复困难。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Geospatial Vector Geometry as a Native Spatial Modality for Vision-Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Geospatial reasoning links VLMs to real-world action and decision making. Reliable reasoning requires accurate spatial information and effective spatial representations. However, current VLMs obtain this information mainly from language and vision. At larger geographic scales, limited visual observations make it difficult to establish accurate spatial references and recover precise spatial relations. This leads to a bottleneck for VLM spatial perception and reasoning. This paper proposes that geospatial vector geometry can become a native spatial modality within a VLM and introduces GeoVec-VLM. First, we develop a structured geometry representation that preserves the spatial structure and arrangement of vector objects, building an explicit spatial basis. Second, we introduce a geometry interaction strategy that brings this basis into multimodal computation, where it interacts with visual content and language references according to the queried spatial relations. Together, these designs allow perception and reasoning to operate on shared geometric references. Across five spatial reasoning tasks, GeoVec-VLM improves mean accuracy by about 11\\% relative to the strongest baseline, maintains its gains under geographic transfer, and shows greater geometric consistency. Our results show that geospatial vector geometry offers a promising internal spatial basis for VLM spatial reasoning. https://github.com/TXFR/GeoVector-VLM

</details>

### 32. [X-Ragent: Tool-Augmented Reinforcement Learning for Evidence-Grounded Chest X-Ray Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16811v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16811

**作者：** Yi Wang、Zhenlong Yuan、Yuchan Guo、Maolei Huang、Zijian Song、Dapeng Zhang、Rongbin Tan、Jiyuan Wang、Zhiyuan Wang、Fangfang Lin、Shuhan Song、Huawei Cao

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 X-Ragent 后训练框架，将「是否需要辅助证据」的学习与「量化测量是否有效」的门控解耦，用 Rad-CoT 轨迹数据做 SFT 后再以准确率门控的 GRPO 优化，在三个胸片基准上取得最好结果。

**相关性简评：** 其「选择性寻求证据＋只接纳有效测量」直接对应 LOOK 的时机决策与视觉证据筛选，且门控奖励只在诊断正确时计入过程分，可供核查证据选择与贡献分配的训练信号设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** X-Ragent: Tool-Augmented Reinforcement Learning for Evidence-Grounded Chest X-Ray Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Chest X-ray (CXR) interpretation often requires integrating visual findings with task-specific evidence rather than relying on direct visual recognition alone. While tool-augmented medical agents can supply such evidence via external modules, they often lack explicit mechanisms for learning when auxiliary evidence is needed and for preventing inapplicable quantitative evidence from entering diagnostic reasoning. To address this, we propose X-Ragent, a post-training framework for tool-augmented reinforcement learning that decouples learned auxiliary-evidence seeking from validity-gated quantitative measurement acquisition for evidence-grounded CXR reasoning. We construct Rad-CoT, a 7.7K-sample corpus combining causally ordered tool-augmented trajectories with report-style diagnostic reasoning, and use it to initialize Qwen3-VL-8B via agentic supervised fine-tuning (SFT). We then optimize the policy with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) using an accuracy-gated reward that applies process-level terms for measurement consistency and auxiliary-tool cost only to correct trajectories, preventing plausible process behavior from compensating for an incorrect diagnosis. Across three CXR benchmarks, X-Ragent achieves the strongest results, including an 8.6-point improvement on the fully held-out ChestAgentBench. By seeking evidence selectively and admitting only valid measurements, X-Ragent supports more faithful and evidence-grounded CXR reasoning.

</details>

### 33. [Neos: Learning to Interleave Search and Visual Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17043v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17043

**作者：** Ekko He、Jack Hong、Shilin Yan、Xintong Zhang、Yujie Zhang、Wenjie Li、Haoran Sun、Kaixun Jiang、Jiyuan Fu、Guannan Zhang、Hongwei Xue

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17043v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17043v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** Neos 是一个多模态深度搜索框架，通过构造带中间视觉依赖、过滤文本捷径的训练任务，引入可训练的多模态证据接口（MEI），并以策略 RL 与 MEI SFT 交替的智能体-环境协同演化，让模型学会获取并利用视觉证据指导后续搜索。

**相关性简评：** 与「使用与训练」主线直接相关：MEI 将检索内容转为目标条件观测，参考引导的信用分配区分成功与失败轨迹中的关键决策，可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、视觉旁路与贡献分配问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Neos: Learning to Interleave Search and Visual Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Recent multimodal deep search agents have advanced tool use and visual content retrieval, yet they still struggle to convert intermediate visual evidence into actionable guidance for subsequent search, limiting their effectiveness in long-horizon settings. To address this gap, we present Neos, a multimodal deep search framework that learns both how to acquire evidence and how to use it to guide subsequent decisions. To make this coupling learnable, Neos constructs training tasks with intermediate visual dependencies while filtering out textual shortcuts, and introduces a lightweight, trainable Multimodal Evidence Interface (MEI) that transforms retrieved content into goal-conditioned observations. At its core, an agent-environment co-evolution procedure treats MEI as a co-adaptive component of this loop. Specifically, reference-guided credit assignment uses verified successful trajectories to localize critical policy errors while preserving credit for useful decisions in failed searches, whereas rollout feedback selects informative local evidence-processing interactions for MEI supervised fine-tuning (SFT). By alternating policy reinforcement learning (RL) with MEI SFT, Neos allows the policy's evolving evidence requests to shape MEI training and the adapted MEI to reshape subsequent observations, closing the loop between evidence acquisition and evidence-conditioned action. Across ten benchmarks, Neos-9B and Neos-35B demonstrate leading performance among specialized multimodal deep-search agents.

</details>
