### 34. [Rethinking LLM-Guided Visual Question Answering: Does Deeper Knowledge Integration Really Help?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17079v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17079

**作者：** Aneerban Saha、Vijay Kumar、Sameer Madhav D.、Priyam Srivastava、Dhruv Bansal

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17079v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17079v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 用 Llama 3.3 70B 生成结构化推理引导、视觉焦点概念、干扰项与外部知识，在冻结 ViT + FLAN-T5 上系统比较决策级 late fusion 与注意力矩阵注入两种整合深度；OK-VQA 上数据稀缺微调时浅层融合最佳（39.4% vs 31.8%），并附一套问题改写扩充训练数据的流程。

**相关性简评：** 该文直接检验「引导越深越好」的假设，其浅层融合优于注意力注入的负结果，可供核查 LVR 中推理状态或视觉证据应在何处注入、以及注意力修改是否易造成视觉旁路与贡献分配失配。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Rethinking LLM-Guided Visual Question Answering: Does Deeper Knowledge Integration Really Help?

**abstract/A1：** Knowledge-based Visual Question Answering (VQA) requires reasoning that extends beyond visible image content, demanding external commonsense and factual knowledge. While recent work leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) as knowledge sources, the question of how deeply such guidance should be integrated into a vision language architecture remains underexplored. In this work, we generate structured reasoning guidance, visual focus concepts, distractor elements and external knowledge using Llama~3.3~70B and systematically compare two integration strategies within a unified frozen ViT + FLAN-T5 framework on the OK-VQA benchmark: decision level late fusion and attention-matrix injection. Contrary to the prevailing assumption that deeper integration is superior, we find that shallow late fusion achieves the strongest results (39.4% exact match, +10.0 over the no guidance baseline), outperforming deep attention modification (31.8%) under data scarce fine-tuning. We further contribute an LLM based augmentation pipeline that expands training data more than tenfold via question paraphrasing. Our findings indicate that integration depth must be matched to the data regime.

**comment/C1：** 13 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at ADCIS 2026

### 35. [EgoProbe: Benchmarking Long-Range and Exact Memory in Streaming Egocentric Videos](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17128v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17128

**作者：** Haokai Pang、Yuqian Fu、Yifei Wang、Yujiao Shen、Tianwen Qian、Mohamed Elhoseiny、Hongbo Fu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17128v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17128v1>)

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 EgoProbe 基准，用事件驱动数据引擎并配合人工核验构造 EgoProbe-Base 与 EgoProbe-Echo 两个子集，分别考察流式自我中心视频中的长程回忆，以及存在相似干扰事件时对指定事件细节的精确回忆，并发现模型即使答对粗粒度问题也常丢失目标事件细节。

**相关性简评：** 该基准直接触及视觉细节与事件绑定信息是否在长时程内部状态中保留、干扰下细节是否坍缩的问题，可供核查「LOOK/证据筛选与信息保留」以及缓存、位置等状态结构对精确回忆的影响，也提供了一个诊断失败模式的测试床。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** EgoProbe: Benchmarking Long-Range and Exact Memory in Streaming Egocentric Videos

**abstract/A1：** Egocentric video provides a continuous first-person record of everyday activities, making it a natural foundation for wearable AI assistants. Unlike offline video understanding, streaming systems must process observations as they arrive, while queries may refer to experiences from the distant past. Recent work has begun to explore whether information can be recalled across long temporal gaps. Yet remembering how far is only part of the challenge: recurring objects, actions, and locations also require models to remember exactly which detail belongs to which event. We introduce EgoProbe, a benchmark that evaluates streaming egocentric memory along these two complementary dimensions: long-range retention, i.e., how far, and event-specific recall under interference, i.e., how exact. Built on long-form egocentric videos, EgoProbe uses an event-grounded data engine to extend recall intervals, identify related events, and construct event-grounded distractors, followed by human verification. It contains two subsets: EgoProbe-Base, which evaluates long-range recall without intervening related events, and EgoProbe-Echo, which challenges models with similar intervening events and event-grounded distractors. EgoProbe-Echo adopts coarse-to-fine multi-turn probing: the first turn evaluates coarse-grained event recall, while the second tests whether the model can retrieve the target-specific detail associated with the designated event. Extensive evaluation across diverse models reveals substantial limitations in long-range recall, with further challenges in recovering target-event details among related experiences. Even when models correctly answer coarse-grained questions, they often fail to recall the specific details of the designated event. EgoProbe exposes this underexplored failure mode and provides a testbed for advancing long-range and exact memory in streaming egocentric video understanding.

**comment/C1：** 22 pages, 9 figures, 8 tables

</details>

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ChemExplain: A Multimodal Benchmark for Explanatory Chemical Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Current chemistry benchmarks primarily evaluate outcome prediction or reaction pathway generation, but rarely test whether a model can explain why an observed chemical effect occurs. We introduce ChemExplain, a benchmark of 1,180 multiple-choice chemistry questions drawn from 383 peer-reviewed papers. Each question pairs a molecular or reaction image with an observed chemical effect and four candidate explanations, each associated with a different structural feature visible in the image. Answering requires the model to perceive the depicted structure, apply chemical knowledge, and identify which feature most directly explains the effect, a capability we term explanatory attribution. The correct feature-mechanism relation is derived from supporting evidence in the source paper rather than invented by the question-generation LLM. We construct the benchmark automatically with a multi-agent framework that applies progressive quality control at three stages and validate it with eight chemistry domain experts. The strongest evaluated model reaches 78.6% accuracy, leaving considerable room for improvement. On a 600-question expert-reviewed subset, reasoning-trace analysis classifies 71.4% of the strongest model's errors as attribution failures. Attribution is also the largest error category for the open-source and chemistry-specific models included in our analysis.

</details>

### 37. [When Left Is Right? Camera-Motion Understanding beyond Screen](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17242v1>)

**内容简述：** 论文提出 CameraVLM：用 camera tokens 表示屏幕外相机运动、flow tokens 表示屏幕内主体与背景的光流动态，并以两阶段训练让语言模型参与对齐，使两者连同相机运动语义一起学习，用于相机左右运动方向判断。

**相关性简评：** 与「几何及任务必要信息是否保留在内部状态」和「答案是否真正使用 latent 内容」两条线索直接相关：其「表示必须由语言模型解释、而非训练成独立位姿/深度估计器」的论点，可供核查视觉旁路与信息坍缩问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When Left Is Right? Camera-Motion Understanding beyond Screen

**abstract/A1：** Can a vision-language model tell left from right? Modern VLMs solve visual puzzles and follow hour-long videos, yet when asked whether the camera moved left or right, most do no better than a coin flip. Adding camera-motion data or geometric representations has been tried, separately, and neither closes the gap. We argue that camera-motion understanding needs two conditions at once: the representation must couple off-screen camera motion with on-screen flow dynamics, and it must be interpreted by the language model rather than trained as a standalone pose or depth estimator. We propose CameraVLM, which pairs a motion-state representation with state-language alignment. Camera tokens capture how the camera moves off screen, flow tokens capture how the subject and background move on screen, and a two-stage training strategy keeps language in the loop so that both are learned together with camera-motion semantics. With only 9B parameters, CameraVLM outperforms all open-source and camera-motion-specific models by a wide margin across three benchmarks and more than 20 baselines, and matches or surpasses GPT-6 Astra as well as human viewers in a 48-participant study. Project page: https://3dagentworld.github.io/CameraVLM/

</details>

### 38. [WIRE: Weight Space Implicit Representation Encoding of Frozen Video LLMs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17355v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17355

**作者：** Ameen Ali、Tamim Zoabi、Lior Wolf、Chaim Baskin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17355v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17355v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 WIRE，用问题条件的双向选择性扫描把每帧压成少量 carrier token，将冻结视频 LLM 中部分视频条件计算从输入激活搬到超网络生成的临时低秩权重更新（LoRA）里，prefill 后合并更新，解码仍走原骨干，从而缩短序列、缩小 KV cache 并降低 prefill 成本。

**相关性简评：** 直接触及「视觉细节在压缩后是否仍保留于内部状态」这一表示问题：其全分辨率特征 readout 驱动的权重空间修正，可能为缓解视觉信息坍缩、把视觉状态写入权重的 LVR 设计提供可核查线索，但论文面向效率而非 latent 推理，需读原文确认细节保留与推理收益。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** WIRE: Weight Space Implicit Representation Encoding of Frozen Video LLMs

**abstract/A1：** Video language models represent a video as a long sequence of visual embeddings in a decoder's input. Every visual embedding is processed by every decoder layer during prefill, stored in the key value cache, and attended by every generated token, so a long video raises prefill, memory, and generation cost at once. We present WIRE (Weight Space Implicit Representation Encoding), which reduces this recurring cost by moving part of the video conditioned computation of a frozen video language model from its input activations into a temporary low rank update of its weights. WIRE keeps a short explicit visual context, so the update acts as a correction rather than a replacement of the video. WIRE first compresses the full resolution embeddings of each frame into a small set of carrier tokens using a question conditioned bidirectional selective scan, and physically contracts the decoder input so every decoder layer, cache entry, and decoding step operates on the shorter sequence. Hypernetworks at selected decoder layers read the compressed forward pass together with a readout of the full resolution features removed by contraction and generate LoRA updates to the attention and feedforward projections. The updates are merged after prefill, so autoregressive decoding runs the unmodified frozen backbone. On Qwen3-VL-8B, WIRE with 16 carrier tokens per frame contracts the visual stream by $3.5\\times$, reduces decoder prefill time by $3.35\\times$ at 256 frames and $4.14\\times$ at 1024 frames, shrinks the key value cache proportionally, and keeps per token decoding latency approximately constant. Across nine benchmark settings at 256 frames, it obtains the highest average accuracy among efficient video language models we evaluate under a common 256 frame budget.

</details>

### 39. [TwinPrune: Density-Aware Two-Phase Token Pruning for Vision-Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17530v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17530

**作者：** Kai Liu、Anqi Li、Junxian Li、Zhixin Wang、Zhikai Chen、Renjing Pei、Yulun Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17530v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17530v1>)

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出统一的空间密度打分，同时用于 VLM 推理两阶段的 token 剪枝：prefill 的二部合并与 decode 的 KV 淘汰，在七个模型变体上验证，并指出现有 decode 剪枝工作只用 prefill 探针评测的陷阱。

**相关性简评：** 视觉 token/KV 的保留与筛选直接关系 LVR 关注的「视觉细节是否留在内部状态」；其 prefill/decode 分阶段探针设计可供核查「丢弃全部视觉 KV 是否影响答案」的视觉旁路与信息坍缩评测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TwinPrune: Density-Aware Two-Phase Token Pruning for Vision-Language Models

**abstract/A1：** We propose a unified spatial-density signal to score token importance for both inference phases: bipartite merge for prefill and KV eviction for decode, yielding measurable gains in each stage. To isolate the two phases, we split benchmarks by scoring logic. Prefill probes (MMBench, POPE, ScienceQA) evaluate only the first decoded token; their accuracy reflects prefill logits argmax before any decode KV eviction. Full-pipeline probes (TextVQA, DocVQA, MM-Vet) assess the complete generated sequence and capture both phases. We identify a critical evaluation pitfall: decode pruning claims validated solely on prefill probes measure prefill quality, not decode performance. Experiments show discarding all visual KV during decode barely affects prefill-probe accuracy but degrades TextVQA and MM-Vet drastically; this insensitivity stems from the scoring rule, not compression intensity.Evaluated on seven model variants (InternVL-3.5, Qwen3-VL, LLaVA-1.5) and three full-pipeline benchmarks, our method achieves a three-way Pareto frontier across compute, memory and accuracy. Density-based prefill compression maintains strong accuracy, scales linearly with visual token count, and delivers 100x faster token selection at high resolution. For decode, density top-k KV eviction consistently outperforms strong baselines H2O, SnapKV and StreamingLLM on TextVQA and MM-Vet across three retention ratios. At 0.125 keep ratio on TextVQA, it surpasses H2O by 9.6 points; InternVL-3.5 models (2B to 38B) maintain a 7 to 10 point advantage. Compression scales favorably with model size: every measured 8B to 38B model transition reduces accuracy loss instead of worsening it. We suggest MM-Vet or DocVQA as mandatory full-pipeline validation for any decode-phase claims. Our code is available at https://github.com/Kai-Liu001/TwinPrune

**comment/C1：** Our code is availabel at https://github.com/Kai-Liu001/TwinPrune

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TacitVLA: Reasoning Vision-Language-Action Models Without Reasoning Latency

**abstract/A1：** Textual reasoning before acting has improved vision-language-action (VLA) models, but at the cost of latency: every action conditioned on the reasoning text must wait for autoregressive decoding. We show that actions do not need to wait for or condition on the generated reasoning to benefit from it, because the reasoning supervision already improves the backbone representation. We introduce TacitVLA, a reasoning VLA whose action expert never attends to the reasoning it generates for the current call. On long-horizon tasks where the reasoning text also serves as episodic memory, it can generate each entry during action execution rather than before acting. We evaluate it in a controlled study on four benchmarks spanning manipulation and autonomous driving, memory and non-memory tasks: RoboMME, RMBench, LIBERO, and PhysicalAI-AV. On all four, TacitVLA matches the performance of its explicit-reasoning counterpart at up to 3.4x lower latency, and matches the latency of the same architecture trained without reasoning at up to +17.1% success. In absolute terms, it surpasses the best previously published results on the RoboMME Counting suite (82.7% vs. 66.8%) and RMBench (77.5% vs. 56.5%), and reaches 72.9% on LIBERO-Plus and a 52.5% scene score on the public split of the PhysicalAI-AV closed-loop driving challenge. Project page: https://tacitvla.github.io.

### 41. [MemAct: Streaming Spatial Understanding with Memory and Active Exploration](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17640v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17640

**作者：** Yuxi Wei、Wei Huang、Qirui Chen、Lu Hou、Xiaojuan Qi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** MemAct 提出一个共享 VLM 的流式空间理解框架：模型增量写入结构化历史记忆、按需检索记录与过去帧，并通过移动、转向主动获取新证据，在统一推理循环中决定继续探索或作答；配套约 1M 训练样例的数据生成管线与含 2 万主 QA、2 千 Timing 问题的 MemAct-bench，并用监督微调加基于累计证据增益、动作成本与终止作答质量的反事实动作优化来改进探索与停止。

**相关性简评：** 与 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的收益—成本问题直接相关：记忆写入与检索涉及视觉证据筛选和历史状态保留，主动移动与 Timing 评测涉及何时继续获取证据与停止决策，其反事实动作优化可供核查 LVR 中贡献分配与监督设计；但未涉及 latent 状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MemAct: Streaming Spatial Understanding with Memory and Active Exploration

**abstract/A1：** Spatial understanding is essential for embodied agents navigating and interacting with the physical world. As observations arrive incrementally, agents must reason in a streaming manner. Yet streaming understanding must also be closed-loop: task-relevant evidence may require both recalling past observations and actively acquiring new views. Existing streaming approaches largely emphasize processing incoming observations, leaving task-driven active exploration underexplored. We introduce MemAct, a framework for streaming spatial understanding with memory and action. A shared vision--language model incrementally writes structured historical memory, retrieves records and past frames on demand, and acquires additional evidence through movement and turning. Retrieved evidence and action observations inform subsequent decisions, enabling the agent to continue exploring or answer within a unified reasoning loop. We develop the MemAct suite, a data generation pipeline and collection across real and simulated environments, with approximately 1M training examples for spatial reasoning, memory writing, retrieval, and exploration. Its MemAct-bench comprises 20,000 main QA pairs evaluating current-observation understanding, historical evidence use, and active exploration, plus 2,000 separate Timing questions. MemAct combines supervised fine-tuning for memory and interaction with counterfactual action optimization using cumulative evidence gains, action costs, and terminal answer quality to improve exploration and stopping decisions. Experiments show that MemAct outperforms existing spatial understanding and streaming baselines and approaches frontier multimodal models on MemAct-bench while retaining streaming inference efficiency.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Open-o3-Video-v2，将视频推理建模为统一的 agentic 证据获取与 grounding 过程：模型识别缺失信息、主动获取新观测、定位支撑推理的时刻与对象并写入轨迹，再用 CoT 数据与 CS-GRPO 训练。

**相关性简评：** 直接对应 LVR 关注的「何时再看、看什么、何时停止」与视觉证据筛选问题；其 CS-GRPO 对线索覆盖与步进增益的奖励、对冗余检索的惩罚，可供核查证据获取与停止决策的监督与成本权衡设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Open-o3-Video-v2: Seek, Ground, and Reason with Verifiable Spatio-Temporal Evidence

**abstract/A1：** Reliable video reasoning requires models to produce correct answers and expose supporting visual evidence. Open-o3-Video enables verifiable reasoning by embedding timestamps and object-level bounding boxes into reasoning traces, but is restricted to frames from an initial sparse sampler. We introduce Open-o3-Video-v2, which formulates video reasoning as a unified agentic evidencegrounded process. The model identifies missing information, acquires additional observations, grounds the moments and objects supporting its reasoning, and writes this evidence into the trajectory before continuing or answering. To support this behavior, we construct STGR-v2-CoT135K, including 52K multi-turn agentic grounded reasoning trajectories, and STGR-v2-RL-13K for reinforcement learning. We further propose Clue-Seek GRPO (CS-GRPO), which tracks how tool calls change accumulated evidence, rewards clue coverage and step-wise gains, and penalizes excessive, repetitive, or uninformative retrieval. On V-STaR, Open-o3-Video-v2-4B achieves 40.4% mAM and 56.3% mLGM, outperforming its Qwen3-VL-4B backbone by 8.5% and 12.6%, respectively. It also delivers consistent gains across general video understanding, long-video reasoning, and temporal grounding benchmarks. These results show that active evidence acquisition and verifiable object-level grounding are complementary for reliable video reasoning. The code and models are released at https://msalab-pku.github.io/projects/Open-o3-Video-v2.

**comment/C1：** Extension of Open-o3-Video (https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.20579). V2 extends single-pass grounded reasoning to agentic multi-turn evidence seeking and grounding, enabling models to actively acquire and reason over missing visual evidence. We further introduce STGR-v2-CoT-135K and CS-GRPO to improve evidence acquisition and grounded reasoning

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 RoTA-Bench，用交互式 3D-to-2D 投影对齐评测 VLM 的空间推理：模型观察旋转物体，在有限动作预算内连续选择旋转以恢复目标轮廓，并据此诊断人机差距、图像空间与姿态空间进展的分离以及交互历史敏感性。

**相关性简评：** 该基准把视觉证据转化为多步几何动作并给出失败诊断，可用作核查 VLM 是否维持内部几何状态、如何依据反馈更新动作与停止的评测场景；其动作预算和「轮廓重合提升但姿态变差」现象可供考查视觉旁路与证据使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RoTA-Bench: Evaluating 3D Spatial Reasoning through Interactive Projection Alignment

**abstract/A1：** Can vision-language models turn 2D observations into 3D understanding that supports precise action? This requires inferring object geometry, anticipating the effects of rotation, and refining actions through visual feedback. We introduce RoTA-Bench to evaluate these abilities through interactive 3D-to-2D projection alignment. Given a target silhouette, a model observes a rotated object and chooses successive rotations to recover the target projection within a limited action budget. Our automated pipeline constructs silhouette-preserving 3D objects from 2D icons and uses reversible initialization to guarantee solvability, yielding 674 tasks and a stratified 100-task test set. Empirically, we find that (i) a substantial human-model gap persists: GPT-5.6-Sol succeeds on only 17% of tasks, whereas 20 undergraduate participants collectively complete the test set four times with a 100% success rate; (ii) image-space and pose-space progress can diverge: at matched states, the model more often improves silhouette overlap while worsening pose alignment than humans (19.4% vs. 10.9%); and (iii) fine-grained control is sensitive to interaction history: removing it leaves 96.8% of the model's actions at a coarse 30-degree step size and sharply reduces observed task success. These findings highlight the challenge of converting visual evidence into precise 3D control, beyond recognizing or matching individual images.

**comment/C1：** 31 pages, 2 figures

</details>

### 44. [MedEvo: Medical Reasoning Evolution through Knowledge Navigation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17690v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17690

**作者：** Xiaoliang Wang、Zhuo Chen、Chuanyang Zheng、Quanbin Wang、Jiangwei Lao、Yingao Liu、Jiajia Liu、Jinming Cao、Honglin Lin、Zhihong Lu、Hao Jin、Jian Wang、Lijun Wu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CV、cs.LG、q-bio.QM

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** MedEvo 面向医学多模态推理，用标签分类与错误类型诊断定位失败轨迹中首个关键错误，保留有效前缀并让同一学生模型重生成错误后缀，再按能力缺口挑选数据迭代；仅用 SFT 即在多个基准上提升准确率，并报告失败轨迹包含可保留的推理、修复成功不等于学习价值等观察。

**相关性简评：** 直接触及「轨迹训练、贡献分配与监督」主线：如何判断轨迹中哪些片段有效、错误由谁引起、监督信号该落在哪一步，可供核查其错误定位与数据选择能否迁移到 latent 推理的信用分配与视觉证据筛选；但该工作为训练期方法，不涉及 latent 状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MedEvo: Medical Reasoning Evolution through Knowledge Navigation

**abstract/A1：** Medical multimodal reasoning models are typically trained on teacher-generated rationales, discarding the valid reasoning in students' own failed trajectories, while general-domain correction methods offer little guidance for errors in image reading, anatomical context, or differential diagnosis. We propose MedEvo, which uses medical knowledge, namely a tag taxonomy and error-type diagnosis, to navigate both trajectory repair and data selection. For each failed rollout, a gold-blind auditor locates the first consequential error and provides a minimal, answer-free hint; the same student retains the valid prefix and regenerates the erroneous suffix. After each round, MedEvo identifies capability gaps across medical tags on a held-out feedback set and prioritizes related questions for new rollouts and repairs. With supervised fine-tuning (SFT) alone, MedEvo raises Qwen3.5-9B mean accuracy across seven benchmarks from 65.57% to 69.12% (47.40% to 54.50% on the multimodal track of MedXpertQA (MedXpertQA-MM)), surpassing teacher-distillation SFT (66.93%). It also raises Qwen3.5-35B and Qwen3.5-397B mean accuracy from 67.91% to 73.04% and from 71.83% to 74.95%, respectively. Our analyses show that failed trajectories contain reasoning worth preserving, that repair success does not imply learning value, and that independent feedback is key to sustained improvement.

**comment/C1：** Project: https://pork-pay.github.io/MedEvo/; GitHub: https://github.com/pork-pay/MedEvo

</details>

### 45. [From Token Correction to Claim Admission: Training-Free Hallucination Mitigation for Large Vision-Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17706v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17706

**作者：** Hyeonggeun Han、Taehyun Cho、Sangwoo Hong

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17706v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17706v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出免训练的 EGVCA 框架，用图像条件与视觉空输入下 claim 似然的差值衡量图像依赖支持，仅在支持充分时接纳语义 claim，在 CHAIR、POPE、MME 上降低物体幻觉且保持描述质量。

**相关性简评：** 以「视觉空输入」为对照量化答案对图像证据的依赖，可供核查 VLM 是否真正使用视觉证据、是否存在视觉旁路，其 claim 级接纳判据也与视觉证据筛选和证据充分性决策的表述有具体联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** From Token Correction to Claim Admission: Training-Free Hallucination Mitigation for Large Vision-Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Large vision-language models often exhibit object hallucination, generating claims that are not supported by the input image. To mitigate this issue, we propose Evidence-Guided Visual Claim Admission (EGVCA), a training-free framework that admits a semantic claim only when it receives sufficient image-dependent support. EGVCA measures this support by comparing the claim likelihood under the observed image and a visual-null input. For captioning, it controls semantic expansion without altering token generation. For binary visual question answering, it combines atomic visual support with the image-induced change in the model's native Yes--No margin. Experiments on CHAIR, POPE, and MME across three LVLM backbones show that EGVCA substantially reduces object hallucination while preserving caption quality. It achieves the highest POPE F1 in eight of nine backbone--sampling settings and improves the native MME total score on all three backbones. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of claim-level admission as a simple alternative to token-level distribution correction.

</details>

### 46. [MHVF: Training-Free GUI Grounding via Verification-Guided Multi-Hypothesis Search](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17792v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17792

**作者：** Minghua Chen、Xingming Liao、Weiqiang Zhong、Zhuowei Wang

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17792v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17792v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出免训练的多假设验证框架 MHVF 用于 GUI grounding：从多次全屏预测构造空间假设，借缩放的局部视图重新定位，并在标记局部视图中验证候选与指令的一致性，用验证分驱动第二轮局部搜索并对两级候选排序。

**相关性简评：** 直接对应「多假设＋视觉证据筛选」这一兴趣点：其验证分驱动的第二轮搜索与候选排序可供核查 GET EVIDENCE 与停止决策的收益成本，但假设与验证都在文本坐标空间而非 latent 状态，能否迁移到内部推理状态需读原文判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MHVF: Training-Free GUI Grounding via Verification-Guided Multi-Hypothesis Search

**abstract/A1：** GUI grounding enables web agents to translate natural-language instructions into actionable interface locations. However, dense layouts and small, visually similar controls can lead models toward plausible but incorrect elements, while refinement around a single prediction may leave alternative targets unexplored. We propose the Multi-Hypothesis Verification Framework (MHVF) for training-free GUI grounding. It combines multi-hypothesis exploration with local visual verification using a single pretrained vision-language model. To explore alternative targets, MHVF constructs spatial hypotheses from multiple full-screen predictions and examines the corresponding regions through zoomed re-localization. To resolve ambiguity among the resulting candidates, it verifies their agreement with the instruction in marked local views. Verification scores then guide a second round of local search and rank candidates retained from both search levels for final selection. Experiments with five general-purpose and GUI-specific models across eight benchmark settings demonstrate improvements in grounding accuracy in most settings. MHVF improves UI-Venus-Ground-7B by 4.3 and 2.1 percentage points on Mind2Web and VisualWebBench, respectively, and raises Qwen2.5-VL-7B's accuracy on ScreenSpot-Pro from 23.6% to 53.6%.

**comment/C1：** 11 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables

</details>

### 47. [What Makes a Good Visual Representation for Spatial Understanding in MLLMs?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17844v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17844

**作者：** Xiaohu Huang、Yumin Guo、Kai Han

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17844v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17844v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文系统探究 MLLM 空间理解中「什么样的视觉表示有用」：比较来自 3D 几何、自监督图像/视频、VLM 与生成模型的 latent 特征或显式深度/点图，经蒸馏或融合注入后，发现表示的 3D 结构与收益强相关，且表示形式决定其适用的注入机制，最终将两类表示蒸馏进单一 MLLM 并在静态 3D、动态 4D 基准上验证。

**相关性简评：** 研究视觉表示是否在内部状态中保留几何与跨视角一致的细节，以及融合（视觉旁路）与蒸馏（监督目标）两种注入方式的收益差异，直接对应「任务必要视觉信息是否保留」与「视觉证据如何进入推理状态」，其中的跨视角一致性度量可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** What Makes a Good Visual Representation for Spatial Understanding in MLLMs?

**abstract/A1：** Spatial understanding is a necessary step in moving multimodal large language models (MLLMs) toward reasoning about the 3D physical world. Their visual pretraining data, however, is almost entirely 2D, so the visual tokens processed by MLLMs often lack inherent 3D structural information. A growing number of methods inject such structure by transferring representations from external vision or geometry models, and collectively establish that such transfer helps. Behind these methods lies a largely underexplored question: what makes a visual representation good for spatial understanding? To answer it, we first separate what is transferred from how it is transferred, and then trace the resulting differences back to properties of the representations themselves. What we transfer comes from 3D geometry models, self-supervised image and video models, vision-language models, and generative models, in the form of latent features or explicit depth and point maps. We transfer it either by distillation, using it as a supervision target, or by fusion, feeding it as an additional input. We find that a representation's 3D structure correlates strongly with how much it helps, measured by cross-view consistency for latent features and by depth and reconstruction accuracy for explicit geometry. We further show that the form of a representation dictates the mechanism it needs. Latent features gain as much from fusion as from distillation; explicit geometry gains little from fusion, and most of its distillation gain depends on a geometry decoding head. Guided by these findings, we distill both latent features and explicit geometry into a single MLLM. Taking only RGB video as input, it consistently improves over its base model on both static 3D and dynamic 4D spatial reasoning benchmarks.

**comment/C1：** Extended version of Neurips 2025 paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.01946

</details>

### 48. [Visual Dependence Does Not Imply Answerability: A Systematic Analysis of Answerability Signals in Frozen InstructBLIP](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17902v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17902

**作者：** Minjun Kim、Hyunmin Song、Changwon Lim

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17902v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17902v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文在 UNK-VQA 分层子集上用冻结 InstructBLIP 系统评估多类答案可答性信号，涵盖预测不确定性、跨模态对齐、视觉定位、视觉依赖、内部表示与学习探针，发现其区分能力普遍很弱（AUROC 约 0.50–0.54），并据此论证视觉依赖不等于证据充分。

**相关性简评：** 属于 VLM 推理诊断与负结果，直接关联视觉证据是否充分、证据筛选与停止决策：其结果表明内部表示、不确定性与视觉依赖可能无法单独作为可答性代理，可供核查 LVR 的证据充分性判断与 LOOK/STOP 收益。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Visual Dependence Does Not Imply Answerability: A Systematic Analysis of Answerability Signals in Frozen InstructBLIP

**abstract/A1：** Visual question answering models often produce plausible responses even when the available visual evidence is insufficient to support a valid answer. Although prior work has introduced benchmarks and abstention mechanisms for unanswerable visual questions, it remains unclear which signals derived from a frozen vision-language model reliably indicate answerability on unseen image-question pairs. We systematically evaluate answerability signals on a stratified 10K subset of UNK-VQA using frozen InstructBLIP, covering predictive uncertainty, cross-modal alignment, visual grounding, visual dependence, internal representations, and learned probes. Answerability discrimination remains weak, with test AUROC largely confined to 0.50-0.54. CLIP alignment yields the highest point estimate but does not significantly outperform generation confidence under paired bootstrap analysis. Targeted removal of question-relevant visual evidence causes substantially larger changes in answer confidence than same-size random masking, yet intervention sensitivity provides essentially no answerability discrimination. Increasing probe capacity, combining multiple signals, and adding reason-aware supervision do not provide robust improvements, while post-freeze cross-validation yields similarly weak discrimination. Selective-answering analysis shows limited usable coverage under low-risk operating criteria. Failure-mode analysis shows that the relative utility of individual signals varies across perturbation mechanisms. Taken together, these results show that, on our UNK-VQA subset with frozen InstructBLIP, visual dependence, uncertainty, semantic alignment, and static representations are not robust standalone proxies for answerability. Our findings emphasize the need to distinguish a model's reliance on visual evidence from whether that evidence is sufficient to support an answer.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables

</details>

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 MERIT 三阶段框架，直接在表格图像上做多模态证据推理：先以重建、定位和颜色条件监督适配表格编码器，再用带证据选择轨迹的监督微调，最后以证据、计算、答案与格式的多重奖励做强化学习，并评估视觉输入与各训练组件的贡献。

**相关性简评：** 论文把「视觉证据获取」诊断为瓶颈，并显式训练证据选择、对中间步骤分别给奖励，与 LVR 关注的视觉证据筛选、轨迹监督和贡献分配问题直接相关，其编码器适配与视觉输入消融结果值得核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MERIT: Multimodal Evidence Reasoning over Image Tables

**abstract/A1：** Table reasoning with language models typically assumes access to clean textual tables. In practice, tables are often serialized into text, which can corrupt cell contents, distort structural relationships, and discard visual cues, leaving the model to reason over incomplete evidence. In contrast, table images retain this information, but using it requires both accurate perception and reasoning grounded in the relevant cells. To address this, we propose MERIT (Multimodal Evidence Reasoning over Image Tables), a three-stage framework for learning to reason over table images, with serialized tables serving as optional auxiliary inputs (if provided). Our analysis identifies visual evidence acquisition as a bottleneck, motivating table-specific encoder adaptation through reconstruction, localization, and color-conditioned supervision. Building on the adapted representations, supervised fine-tuning teaches explicit evidence selection and reasoning using verified trajectories. Finally, reinforcement learning refines the policy with separate rewards for evidence correctness, calculation, final answers, and output format. By providing feedback on intermediate steps, the framework targets retrieval and computational errors that final-answer supervision alone does not distinguish. We evaluate the approach on table question answering and fact verification, analyze the contributions of visual inputs and training components, and assess generalization to additional datasets with different table structures and visual presentations.

</details>

### 50. [Mitigating Cross-Modal Hallucinations by Correcting Modality Misrouting in Omnimodal LLMs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18141v1>)

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18141v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18141v1>)

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文发现 omnimodal LLM 在音视频干扰下存在「modality misrouting」现象：相当一部分联合预测错误的样本，其任务相关的单模态分支仍能给出正确答案，说明证据可恢复却未被联合预测采用；为此提出免训练的推理期方法 CaRe，用文本模态探针定位候选的模态特异性反事实分支，在预测冲突时由反事实与融合表示的差异计算残差方向，用以引导原始多模态状态，并按反事实分支置信度调节干预强度。

**相关性简评：** 「单模态分支仍可恢复正确答案」的诊断与 LVR 关注的视觉旁路、证据保留却未被使用高度对应，其反事实残差方向引导也可供核查是否为在推理期把模态证据注入内部状态的可借鉴手段。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Mitigating Cross-Modal Hallucinations by Correcting Modality Misrouting in Omnimodal LLMs

**abstract/A1：** Omnimodal large language models (OLLMs) are susceptible to cross-modal hallucinations under audio-visual interference. We find that, for a substantial fraction of incorrect joint predictions, the question-relevant unimodal branch can still recover the correct answer, suggesting that task-relevant evidence can remain recoverable from the relevant modality even when it is not reflected in the joint prediction. We refer to this recoverable failure pattern as \\emph{modality misrouting}. We propose CaRe (Conflict-aware Residual Intervention), a training-free inference-time method for identifying and correcting modality misrouting. CaRe uses a text-only modality probe to identify a candidate modality-specific counterfactual branch, and flags potential misrouting when its prediction conflicts with the original joint prediction. For such cases, CaRe computes a residual direction from the discrepancy between the counterfactual and fused representations and uses it to steer the original multimodal state toward the relevant modality evidence, while retaining both modalities in the original audio-visual inference path. The intervention strength is adapted based on the confidence of the counterfactual branch. Experiments on CMM and AVHBench across two OLLMs show that CaRe consistently outperforms the evaluated inference-time hallucination-mitigation baselines.

**comment/C1：** 21 pages, 10 figures

</details>

### 51. [Looped Reasoning Finishes Earlier Than You Think](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18174v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18174

**作者：** Sumin Park、T. Konstantin Rusch

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18174v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18174v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究循环推理（looped reasoning）中 latent 轨迹的振荡、循环与漂移如何影响推理计算并拖慢收敛，提出具规范等变与逐 token 相位旋转对称的循环架构 QRR，使对称方向上的运动与推理相关动力学解耦，从而在商空间中更快收敛。

**相关性简评：** 直接关涉 loop 式 latent 推理的状态更新与收敛/停止行为；其「缓慢衰减振荡模式对收敛形成瓶颈」「商表示与推理相关动力学可解耦」的论点，可供核查 THINK/STOP 的收益成本与长度泛化机制。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Looped Reasoning Finishes Earlier Than You Think

**abstract/A1：** Looped reasoning with dynamic depth can be viewed as relaxation toward solution attractors in a learned dynamical landscape. In practice, however, latent trajectories often oscillate, cycle, or drift rather than cleanly converge to stable fixed points. How these non-stationary dynamics contribute to reasoning and constrain convergence remains unclear. We show that slowly decaying oscillatory modes can impose their convergence rate on coupled latent dynamics, creating a bottleneck. Yet damping these modes indiscriminately can disrupt the reasoning computation they support. This tension motivates an architectural approach: introducing rotational degrees of freedom along which symmetry-generated rotational motion leaves the reasoning-relevant quotient dynamics unchanged by construction. We propose QRR (Quotient Recurrent Reasoner), a gauge-equivariant recurrent architecture with an exact per-token phase-rotation symmetry. Motion along these symmetry directions leaves the quotient representation unchanged and is dynamically decoupled from reasoning-relevant dynamics. Empirically, QRR achieves stable and faster convergence to solution roots in quotient space, without forming a dominant slow oscillatory bottleneck, while matching or surpassing recent recurrent reasoning models on Sudoku, Maze, and Mini-ARC.

**comment/C1：** 25 pages

</details>

### 52. [Urbex: Agentic Spatial Grounding for City-Scale 3D Scenes](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18356v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18356

**作者：** Yu Wang、Rui Dai、Wei Chen、Yi Wang、Bo Dang、Kaikui Liu、Xiangxiang Chu、Yansheng Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18356v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18356v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Urbex，把城市级 3D grounding 形式化为主动空间搜索：VLM 智能体可查询地标、放局部区域、渲染斜视图并提交边界框，并用强化学习在 CityRefer 上优化这套工具使用策略，实现无需候选框的定位。

**相关性简评：** 其「主动取证据—再决定是否提交」的工具策略与 LVR 关注的 LOOK/STOP、动态计算和停止决策直接对应，RL 奖励与 shaping 设计可供核查如何监督工具调用与贡献分配。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Urbex: Agentic Spatial Grounding for City-Scale 3D Scenes

**abstract/A1：** City-scale 3D grounding is commonly formulated as candidate ranking, which requires precomputed instance proposals and becomes inefficient in large outdoor scenes. We propose Urbex, an agentic vision-language framework that instead casts grounding as active spatial search. Urbex represents a city-scale 3D scene as an interactive multi-view environment, allowing a VLM agent to query landmarks, zoom into local regions, render oblique views, and commit a grounded bounding box. We optimize this tool-use policy with reinforcement learning on CityRefer, using smooth localization rewards and lightweight shaping rewards for efficient exploration. Experiments show that Urbex achieves the best Hit@1 and IoU on CityRefer, supports candidate-free grounding without ground-truth boxes, and is substantially faster than the strongest city-scale ranking baseline. Zero-shot results on STPLS3D-Refer further indicate improved cross-scene robustness.

**comment/C1：** NeurIPS 2026. 23 pages, 10 figures. Code: https://github.com/AMAP-ML/Urbex

</details>

### 53. [ReDiS: Reasoning-Diagnosis Self-Evolution for Multimodal Reasoning in Remote Sensing](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18388v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18388

**作者：** Yi Liu、Wentao Jiang、Shuo Ni、Zhiming Luo、Di Wang、Zengmao Wang、Jing Zhang、Bo Du

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18388v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18388v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 面向遥感多模态推理，提出 ReDiS 自演化框架：由共享骨干派生的 Reasoner 探索视觉证据与答案候选，Diagnoser 评估整个候选集并给出可信度反馈，两者协同演化；另设 Failure-Triggered Recovery 处理全错样本组中优势消失的问题，在 LHRS-Bench、MME-RS、CHOICE 上验证。

**相关性简评：** 把候选生成与候选评估分离、并针对组内全错时相对优势失效做结果级纠正，直接触及 LVR 关心的轨迹训练、贡献分配与监督可靠性问题，其视觉证据候选的探索方式也值得核查；惟该工作面向遥感域且未涉及内部 latent 状态或信息坍缩，迁移到 LVR 需研究者自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ReDiS: Reasoning-Diagnosis Self-Evolution for Multimodal Reasoning in Remote Sensing

**abstract/A1：** Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential for remote sensing understanding, yet reliable reasoning remains challenging when tasks require fine-grained visual grounding and multi-step inference. Existing approaches typically rely on either costly pre-constructed reasoning trajectories or self-generated signals such as response consistency, which can reinforce shared errors and provide unreliable supervision. We introduce \\textbf{Reasoning--Diagnosis Self-Evolution (ReDiS)}, a framework that separates reasoning exploration from candidate evaluation while allowing the two processes to evolve jointly. ReDiS instantiates two role-specific experts from a shared multimodal backbone: a \\textbf{Reasoner} that explores diverse visual evidence--answer candidates and a \\textbf{Diagnoser} that jointly evaluates the complete candidate set and provides credibility-aware feedback. As the Reasoner evolves, it exposes new candidate distributions and failure modes; the Diagnoser adapts to these changes and, in turn, reshapes the learning signal for subsequent exploration. To handle groups in which all sampled answers are incorrect and group-relative advantages vanish, we further introduce \\textbf{Failure-Triggered Recovery (FTR)}, which provides minimal outcome-level correction without prescribing intermediate reasoning trajectories. Experiments on LHRS-Bench, MME-RS, and CHOICE show consistent improvements over Qwen3.5 backbones at 0.8B, 2B, and 4B scales. ReDiS improves category-averaged accuracy by 6.47 percentage points at 0.8B, while ReDiS-4B achieves the highest average performance among the compared remote sensing MLLMs.

</details>

### 54. [Bifocal: Training-Free Mixed Granularity Visual Token Pruning for Multimodal LLMs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18399v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18399

**作者：** Peiran Yin、Hao Wu、Zihao Yang、Fengyu Zhou、Yijuan Liang、Haozhe Hu、Xudong Wang、Wei Zhang、Xiaoyu Shen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18399v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18399v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文系统评测十种视觉 token 剪枝方法在三个 MLLM 家族、五类能力上的表现，指出通用 VQA 高分常以 OCR、visual grounding 等细粒度任务的大幅退化为代价，并提出免训练的两阶段混合粒度剪枝方法 Bifocal，分别分配 query 相关与图像内在证据预算并加入池化粗表示。

**相关性简评：** 直接关系「视觉证据筛选」与内部状态是否保留任务必要细粒度细节：其失败诊断（单一重要性排序忽略任务互补证据、稀疏 patch 破坏空间完整性）可供核查视觉旁路与信息坍缩对推理任务的影响，混合粒度预算设计也可能提供视觉证据留存的对照思路。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Bifocal: Training-Free Mixed Granularity Visual Token Pruning for Multimodal LLMs

**abstract/A1：** Visual token pruning for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) appears highly effective, with existing methods retaining over 95% of unpruned performance on common VQA benchmarks using a quarter of the visual tokens or fewer. However, our extensive evaluation of ten methods across three MLLM families and five ability groups reveals a critical gap: strong general performance often comes at the cost of severe degradation on fine-grained tasks such as OCR and visual grounding. We trace these failures to two limitations of the prevailing paradigm of retaining the highest-ranked native patches. A single importance ranking overlooks the complementary evidence required by different tasks, while sparse patch selection disrupts both image content and spatial integrity. To address these limitations, we propose Bifocal, a training-free, two-stage pruning method built on a mixed-granularity framework. It allocates separate budgets to query-focused and image-intrinsic evidence, complemented by a pooled coarse representation of the entire image. Before the LLM, Bifocal matches question words to visual regions through a soft conjunction balanced against norm-debiased image saliency, while selecting image-intrinsic evidence to maximize representational coverage. Inside the LLM, it further prunes tokens using density-adjusted text-to-image attention. With roughly a quarter of the original visual tokens, Bifocal is the only evaluated method to retain over 90% of unpruned performance in every ability group across all three models, and ranks first on average in all nine model-budget settings. The code is available at: https://github.com/EIT-NLP/Bifocal

</details>

### 55. [Reading Right, Acting Wrong: Diagnosing Decision Failures of System One Models in Agent Loops](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18579v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18579

**作者：** Yubo Li、Ramayya Krishnan、Rema Padman

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18579v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18579v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在涵盖模拟环境、客服策略、工具使用、网页导航与编码的冻结 agent 决策状态基准上，为每个「下一步动作」问题配上同一状态的事实探针并独立作答，从而行为性地区分模型是「误读状态」还是「读对却行动错误」；在十七个 System One 快速系统与一个推理模型上发现多数错误源于正确读取后的组合失败，且错误跨系统聚集在同一状态上，缺失的往往是下一个子目标。

**相关性简评：** 其「读对但用错」的诊断框架与 LVR 关心的 latent 内容是否真正被答案使用、信息坍缩和视觉旁路问题直接相关，事实探针与代码组合修复的做法可供核查推理状态中证据保留与贡献分配的成因。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Reading Right, Acting Wrong: Diagnosing Decision Failures of System One Models in Agent Loops

**abstract/A1：** System One models choose an agent's next action by scoring a supplied set of options in a single pass. This makes them fast and cheap, but when they choose wrongly there is nothing to inspect: did the model misread what the agent has seen, or read it correctly and still act wrongly? We answer behaviorally. On a frozen benchmark of agent decision states from simulated environments, customer-service policies, tool use, web navigation and coding, we pair every next-action question with factual probes about the same state, each answered independently. Across seventeen fast systems and a reasoning model, the answer is consistent: most wrong actions follow correct reading, and the more accurate a system, the more of its errors take this form. These errors are not noise; they gather on the same states across systems of every kind. Where the probed facts provably determine the action, models that read every fact still fail to combine them, and their own answers, composed by code, repair the failure. On real states, what is missing is often not a fact but the next sub-goal.

**comment/C1：** Initial version released to encourage open discussion and share preliminary findings. Evaluations of additional open-source System One models are ongoing

</details>

### 56. [Rethinking Projector Training in Multimodal LLMs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18598v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18598

**作者：** Fabian Gröger、Naël Ouerghemi、Shuo Wen、Maria Brbić

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18598v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18598v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文重新审视多模态 LLM 中 projector 对齐阶段的作用：发现仅用 10%–20% 数据即可恢复大部分下游收益、不同数据训出的 projector 可线性插值，据此提出 PORTAL——无需配对图文数据与梯度优化，仅用各模态汇总统计量，在共享主子空间上以最优传输对齐视觉与语言特征的高斯近似来初始化 projector。

**相关性简评：** 其诊断「projector 主要完成粗对齐、多种 projector 等价」直接关系到 LVR 关心的视觉细节是否必须保留到内部状态、信息坍缩程度，以及无配对数据下 latent 视觉状态与语言状态的初始化，可供核查视觉信息进入 LLM 前的损失与可替换性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Rethinking Projector Training in Multimodal LLMs

**abstract/A1：** Multimodal LLMs are typically trained by first aligning a vision encoder with a language model via projector training on large image-caption datasets, followed by joint training of the full multimodal model. Despite its widespread use, the role of the projector training stage remains poorly understood. We find that (i) using only $10$ to $20\\%$ of the data for training the projector already recovers most downstream performance gains, and (ii) projectors trained on different datasets can be linearly interpolated while largely preserving performance. These results suggest that projector training mainly performs a coarse alignment, which many different projectors achieve equally well. Motivated by these findings, we propose PORTAL, a training-free projector initialization that requires neither paired image-caption data nor gradient-based optimization, but only per-modality summary statistics. PORTAL computes an optimal-transport-based map between Gaussian approximations of the vision and language feature distributions on a shared principal subspace, so that the projector training stage can be skipped entirely. Without any paired data, PORTAL matches the standard pipeline trained on 558k image-caption pairs across six LLM backbones, two vision encoders, and 16 benchmarks. It outperforms that pipeline in $3$ of $7$ (vision encoder, LLM) settings and reaches an average $98\\%$ of its score across the other four.

**comment/C1：** NeurIPS 2026 camera-ready

</details>

### 57. [Segment Where You Look: Attention as the Interface Between Language Models and Segmenters](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18729v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18729

**作者：** Eslam Abdelrahman、Hamza Omar Alkaf、Yuheng Li、Siddharth Srinivasan Iyer、Nanxuan Zhao、Eli Shechtman、Krishna Kumar Singh、Mohamed Elhoseiny

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18729v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18729v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究「VLM 如何把指称位置传给像素解码器」这一接口：指出主流做法把位置压缩进单个无空间索引的 \[SEG\] 隐状态，而 \[SEG\] 对图像 token 的注意力天然定义在 patch 网格上；通过探测冻结的分割 VLM 比较二者，并提出 AttnSeg，用注意力头的可学习带符号组合作为解码器的稠密空间提示，配合注意力引导监督与两阶段训练。

**相关性简评：** 其探针式诊断直接比较隐状态与注意力图对空间/视觉证据的保留程度（注意力高出 18–22 gIoU，且隐状态还依赖图像），可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态是否真正携带任务必要的视觉与几何信息，以及注意力结构能否作为潜在状态的空间证据筛选信号。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Segment Where You Look: Attention as the Interface Between Language Models and Segmenters

**abstract/A1：** Vision-language models (VLMs) that segment from language must pass the location of the referent to a pixel decoder. The dominant interface compresses it into the hidden state of a single \[SEG\] token, a d-dimensional vector with no spatial index, and leaves the decoder, which never sees the expression, to recover the referent's extent. We show that the VLM already computes a better signal: the \[SEG\] token's attention over the image tokens, which is defined on the patch grid by construction. Probing a frozen segmentation VLM, we find that this attention yields 18 to 22 more gIoU than the \[SEG\] hidden state when read by the same probe, that it gains nothing from the image where the hidden state does, and that it is concentrated in the late layers. Building on these findings, we introduce AttnSeg, which replaces the \[SEG\] embedding with this attention as the decoder's prompt. A learned, signed combination of the attention heads forms a dense spatial prompt, and an attention-guidance objective supervises it directly. A two-stage recipe first trains the VLM to localize without the decoder, then trains the decoder to refine, within the budget of standard fine-tuning. Applied to Sa2VA, AttnSeg improves ReasonSeg by 6.4 gIoU and GS-Eval by 10.2 at 4B (4.2 and 9.6 over the same model fine-tuned on the same data), and by 8.8 and 11.3 at 14B. The gains reach 13 to 18 gIoU on object parts, multiple objects, and single objects, where the referent must be singled out, and are negligible on stuff regions, which the decoder already recovers unaided. Code and models are available at https://eslambakr.github.io/attseg\_project\_page/

</details>

### 58. [Game2Real-Bench: Do Toy Games Reveal and Transfer to Real-World Visual Reasoning?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18834v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18834

**作者：** Qingan Liu、Juntong Feng、Yue Zhu、Yujie Cheng、Xinzhe Han、Shuai Hao、Yunzhi Zhuge、Haiwen Diao、Huchuan Lu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18834v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18834v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Game2Real-Bench，构造 1000 个可执行验证的程序生成游戏样本与 400 个按共享推理需求对齐的真实世界样本，评测 25 个 VLM 在细粒度感知、空间推理、约束推理与序列规划上的表现，并研究单样本游戏到真实的迁移。

**相关性简评：** 作为 VLM 视觉推理的诊断性基准，其「游戏—真实」高相关以及迁移中约束推理提升、细粒度感知下降的现象，可供核查视觉证据筛选与任务必要信息在真实场景中的保留与使用情况。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Game2Real-Bench: Do Toy Games Reveal and Transfer to Real-World Visual Reasoning?

**abstract/A1：** Visual reasoning is an important capability for vision-language models (VLMs) to understand visual evidence, spatial structure, constraints, and state changes. Existing evaluations mainly rely on real-world data or procedurally generated tasks. Real-world data preserve natural complexity, while procedural games provide controllable generation and verifiable solutions. However, it remains unclear whether abilities measured in toy games correspond to real-world visual reasoning and whether game examples can support transfer. We introduce Game2Real-Bench, a benchmark that studies these connections across four capability groups, including fine-grained perception, spatial reasoning, constraint reasoning, and sequential planning. We construct 1,000 procedurally generated game samples with executable verification and curate 400 real-world samples aligned by shared reasoning requirements rather than visual similarity. We evaluate 25 representative VLMs and observe strong game-to-real consistency, with Pearson and Spearman correlations of 0.935. We further study one-shot game-to-real transfer on four models. Constraint reasoning improves for several models, while fine-grained perception declines with game demonstrations. We also construct Game2Real-Dataset with nearly 24K verified game samples across 18 tasks and 65 QA families. Our benchmark, dataset, and code are available at https://github.com/QingAnLiu/Game2Real-Bench.

**comment/C1：** 32 pages, 8 figures, 11 tables

</details>

### 59. [RepProbe: Can Video Language Models Count Repeated Actions? A Diagnostic Benchmark](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18844v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18844

**作者：** Mahsa Khoshnoodi、Sarah Adel Bargal

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18844v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18844v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 RepProbe，一个含 42K 真实与合成视频片段的诊断基准，片段恰好包含 k∈\[1,20\] 次完整动作重复，并控制片段位置、时间覆盖与时长，用于评估视频语言模型的重复计数能力；结果显示计数准确率在高计数时崩塌，且用线性探针发现：即使模型报错，末层表示中仍可线性解码出计数信息，失败主要发生在输出阶段，答案集中于少数偏好数字。

**相关性简评：** 该工作直接诊断「内部状态保留任务信息、而输出未加使用」的解耦，与 LVR 关注的答案是否使用 latent 内容、信息坍缩与证据被弃置高度同构，可作为视觉推理中表示—输出脱节的对照与待核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RepProbe: Can Video Language Models Count Repeated Actions? A Diagnostic Benchmark

**abstract/A1：** Repetition counting requires identifying and enumerating action cycles over time. While state-of-the-art video language models describe actions fluently, they fail to reliably count how many times an action repeats. To investigate this limitation, we introduce RepProbe, a benchmark of 42K real and synthetic video clips containing exactly k in \[1, 20\] complete repetitions, with controls for clip position, temporal coverage, and duration. These controls allow us to study the counting failure directly and locate where in the model it arises. Counting accuracy collapses at high counts across the video language models we evaluate, and controlled experiments show this collapse is not explained by frame sampling alone. We compare model outputs with linear probes trained on the final-layer representations used to generate those outputs. We find a consistent representation-to-output dissociation: substantial count information remains linearly decodable even when models fail to report the correct count. Further analysis shows this failure arises primarily at the output stage, where answers concentrate on a small set of preferred numbers rather than the available count information. The dissociation holds on both real and synthetic videos and is not explained by clip duration, position, or scene content. These results indicate that models encode repetition structure but do not reliably report it in their outputs. Project page: https://arenaa.github.io/RepProbe-webpage/

</details>

### 60. [Visual Tokens on Demand: Visual Budgeting for Scalable and Efficient Multi-Image Reasoning in Multimodal LLMs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18858v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18858

**作者：** Aimon Rahman、Joymallya Chakraborty、Vidit Bansal、Abhishek Dan

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究多图场景下的可扩展高效推理，提出 mmVB 轻量即插即用模块，依据查询与跨图上下文为每张图分配 token 预算，在不重训基座模型、不访问注意力矩阵的前提下将视觉输入 token 减少 9x，TTFT 提速 5x，并在八个多图推理基准上保留 94.4% 全分辨率准确率。

**相关性简评：** 其按查询动态丢弃跨图冗余、保留比较/计数/证据定位所需视觉细节的做法，与 LVR 关注的视觉细节保留与视觉证据筛选直接相关；可供核查的线索是预算决策是否被后续推理真正使用，以及压缩是否造成信息坍缩而非单纯降本。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Visual Tokens on Demand: Visual Budgeting for Scalable and Efficient Multi-Image Reasoning in Multimodal LLMs

**abstract/A1：** Multimodal large language models have advanced rapidly, but most remain optimized for single-image inputs. Multi-image reasoning is costly because each image adds many visual tokens, increasing encoding and attention demands. Existing techniques that address the above issue, including visual token pruning, token merging, visual token compression, learned resampling, hierarchical compression, retrieval-augmented visual reasoning, and memory-based architectures, have largely been designed for single-image scenarios, where redundancy is primarily spatial and local. Multi-image reasoning introduces additional challenges: redundancy may occur across images, task-relevant evidence may be sparse or distributed, and aggressive per-image compression can remove details needed for comparison, counting, temporal reasoning, retrieval, or evidence grounding. Moreover, existing token-reduction methods are often either (i) training-free but inference-inefficient, typically relying on accessing attention matrices to get token-importance that may be impractical to access with memory-efficient attention implementations such as FlashAttention, or (ii) training-dependent, requiring the base MLLM to be retrained or adapted to a new compressed-token paradigm. In this work, we study scalable multi-image reasoning and understanding without retraining the base model and without accessing attention matrices at inference time. To this end, we propose mmVB, a lightweight plug-and-play module that assigns query-conditioned per-image token budgets via cross-image context, adding only 1.6M trainable parameters while reducing visual input tokens by 9x. This reduction yields 5x faster time-to-first-token and 7x fewer prefill FLOPs, while maintaining 94.4% of full-resolution accuracy across eight multi-image reasoning benchmarks.

</details>

### 61. [Splicing Hints into Reasoning Traces: Learning from Demonstrator Failures](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13996v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.13996

**作者：** Hamed Mahdavi、Pouria Mahdavinia、Majid Farhadi、Vasant Honavar

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13996v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.13996v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SPLICE：用一个仅见参考解的第二个模型在推理模型生成轨迹时逐步验证进展，在最后已验证步骤截断失败轨迹并拼接自适应增强的提示，从而离线构造含修复样本的数据集；蒸馏微调后在 AIME 与奥林匹克证明上优于用未编辑轨迹蒸馏的模型。

**相关性简评：** 虽为纯文本数学推理、无视觉输入也无显式 latent，但其「按步验证—截断失败前缀—注入提示」的轨迹监督与离线数据构造方式，可能为 LVR 的中间状态监督、贡献分配和轨迹训练数据构造提供可核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Splicing Hints into Reasoning Traces: Learning from Demonstrator Failures

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards improves mathematical reasoning when a final answer can be checked, but a correct answer does not certify the derivation behind it, and proof problems offer no answer to check. Replacing the check with a reasoning model as an in-loop verifier faces a fundamental obstacle: the policy must already produce occasional correct attempts for any reward to exist, which it may never do at olympiad level. We instead move verification and repair out of the training loop and into offline data generation with SPLICE, a workflow in which a second model, given only a reference solution, edits a reasoning model's traces as they are generated: it verifies progress, truncates a failed trace at its last verified step, and splices in an adaptively strengthened hint until progress resumes. The resulting dataset includes repaired examples whose sampled unaided trajectory failed, with failed continuations removed and progress repeatedly checked against the reference solution. A model finetuned on SPLICE traces outperforms the same model distilled from the reasoning model's unedited traces on AIME and, under a grading protocol validated against human grades, on olympiad proofs. The trained model's own traces show a corresponding behavioral signature: at difficult points it announces a branch in the style of the spliced hints and takes riskier steps, with predictive entropy rising there and just after, a pattern absent from the model trained on unedited traces.

**comment/C1：** 39 pages, 3 figures

</details>

### 62. [PreSO: Privileged Representation Isolation for On-Policy Self-Distillation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14001v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14001

**作者：** Yuhang Yang、Mingxuan Xia、Chao Ye、Shuai Zhu、Shouqing Yang、Haobo Wang、Shenzhi Yang、Zhengqing Zang、Chenglong Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14001v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14001v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** PreSO 研究 on-policy self-distillation 中哪些特权信息值得蒸馏：用紧凑提示限制解特定细节，从跨问题表示偏移估计低秩子空间，把特权诱导的修正投影到该子空间并加到学生表示上，形成表示级蒸馏目标，在数学基准上验证。

**相关性简评：** 属纯文本推理工作，但其表示级监督线索可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据蒸馏、特权视觉信息隔离，以及 latent 状态中可复用结构与实例细节的筛选设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PreSO: Privileged Representation Isolation for On-Policy Self-Distillation

**abstract/A1：** On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) uses a self-teacher conditioned on privileged information to turn the sparse outcome signal of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) into dense token-level supervision. Yet the teacher's advantage may depend on information unavailable to the student at inference, raising a central question: which privileged changes are worth distilling? We use cross-problem recurrence as an empirical cue for potentially reusable guidance. Comparing the representation shifts induced by full solutions and compact hints, we find that hint-induced shifts are more concentrated and directionally consistent across problems, and yield more sustained downstream gains despite revealing less information. Motivated by this association, we propose Privileged Representation Isolation for On-Policy Self-Distillation (PreSO). At the source, PreSO uses compact hints to limit the solution-specific detail entering the privileged shift. At the target, it estimates a leading low-rank subspace from shifts pooled across related problems, projects the privilege-induced correction onto this subspace, and adds it to the student's unprivileged representation to form the representation-level distillation target. The selected subspace serves as an operational proxy for recurring structure, rather than a guaranteed separation of transferable and instance-specific information. On five competition-level mathematics benchmarks, PreSO consistently outperforms strong baselines across Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B, improving average accuracy over the base model by 6.8, 9.0, and 10.0 points. Beyond peak accuracy, PreSO attains the highest final-checkpoint average at every model scale, with improvements that persist through the end of training.

</details>

### 63. [OPMD: On-Policy Mechanism Distillation Beyond Output Supervision](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14022v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14022

**作者：** Yingdong Shi、Zhihong Li、Changming Li、Jingyi Yu、Quan Li、Kan Ren

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14022v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14022v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 OPMD，在 on-policy distillation 的输出监督之外，先构造与学生兼容的教师、把教师中间表示变换为学生下游计算可用的中间状态，再从自采样轨迹中内化这些状态，并在三个教师—学生设定上取得更高平均准确率，且可扩展到多教师蒸馏。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本的机制级监督，其「学生可用的中间状态」构造与 on-policy 内化可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的训练目标设计、中间表示可用性（而非仅几何对齐匹配）和贡献分配提供可供核查的方法线索，但与视觉证据筛选和推理期状态生成无直接关联。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** OPMD: On-Policy Mechanism Distillation Beyond Output Supervision

**abstract/A1：** On-policy distillation (OPD) improves language-model by supervising a student on prefixes sampled from its own policy, but its supervision remains confined to the output space. Consequently, OPD transfers what a teacher predicts without supervising the intermediate computation that produces those predictions. Simply distilling intermediate representations like representation matching is insufficient since teacher and student representations may differ geometrically, and even well-aligned hidden states need not be usable by the student's subsequent computation. We introduce On-Policy Mechanism Distillation (OPMD), which transfers teacher-derived intermediate computation while explicitly accounting for its compatibility with the student. OPMD first constructs a student-compatible teacher that transforms teacher representations into intermediate states usable by the student's downstream computation, then it internalizes these states from on-policy trajectories. OPMD achieves the highest average accuracy among the evaluated distillation baselines in all three teacher--student settings, and generalizes to multi-teacher distillation and cross-family supervised fine-tuning. Further analyses show that mechanism supervision yields more effective reasoning and meaningfully alters the student's intermediate computation and solution strategies, supporting that it transfers information beyond output supervision alone. Together, these results establish mechanism-level supervision as an effective way to move on-policy distillation beyond output supervision, enabling students to learn inner mechanisms they can use and internalize.

**comment/C1：** 21 pages, 6 figures

</details>

### 64. [Rotate the Loop: Blockwise Conformality for Looped Transformers](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14030v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14030

**作者：** Alexey Zemtsov、Albina Klepach、Vadim Lomshakov、Andrei Polubarov、Nikita Lyubaykin、Alexander Derevyagin、Vladislav Kurenkov、Alexander Nikulin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14030v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14030v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究 looped transformer 在循环步数上的状态保持能力，指出其取决于循环间残差所经线性映射的形式，并提出分块共形注入：把残差拆成坐标对齐的若干组、在组内做旋转，使每组拥有各自的时间尺度而组内几何保持精确；在末位 token 状态追踪和语言建模任务上报告了性能提升。

**相关性简评：** 该文为纯文本工作，但其对循环残差映射几何如何决定跨步「写—读」可行性的分析，可供核查 LVR 中 loop 式 latent 状态更新、深度与长度泛化以及信息坍缩的具体线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Rotate the Loop: Blockwise Conformality for Looped Transformers

**abstract/A1：** Looped transformers reuse one shared block across many recurrent steps, so depth becomes a quantity that can be spent at runtime rather than a stack of distinct layers. Those extra steps help only if a write made on one recurrent step is still readable on later ones, and that depends on the linear map applied to the residual between recurrent steps. We show that whether the loop learns to track state is a geometric question about the form of this map, and we propose blockwise conformal injections: the residual splits into coordinate-aligned groups and rotates inside each one, so every group has its own timescale while the geometry stays exact within it. Our experiments show a performance increase on a demanding form of state tracking - last-token accuracy when the rest of the prefix is already correct - and on language modelling, where a signal written earlier has to be retrieved at the end of the sequence.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop "Transitioning from Pre-Training to Post-Training"

</details>

### 65. [One Model, Multiple Compute Budgets: Multi-Ratio ConceptMoE for Flexible Compute Across Turns](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14074v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14074

**作者：** Yiyang Fu、Zihao Huang、Dongchen Han、Shukai Gong、Zhen Dong、Qiyang Min、Daquan Zhou

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14074v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14074v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Multi-Ratio ConceptMoE，在单一共享骨干内联合支持 2/4/8 三档 token→概念压缩比（CR2/CR4/CR8），通过比例专属边界路由器与跨比例训练实现同一上下文的混合比例处理，并在多轮对话基准上比较精度与 FLOPs 权衡。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本模型，但其「token→概念」压缩与多比例路由可能为 LVR 的 latent 状态压缩、动态计算预算分配及跨压缩比监督提供可核查线索，值得留意被压缩掉的视觉或任务必要信息是否仍可恢复。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** One Model, Multiple Compute Budgets: Multi-Ratio ConceptMoE for Flexible Compute Across Turns

**abstract/A1：** Large language models typically support different inference budgets through separate model sizes or fixed compute configurations. In multi-turn interactions, however, compute demand can vary substantially across turns. Using a high-compute model for every turn wastes computation, while routing among independent models may require rebuilding model-specific history states after switches. We therefore ask whether a single shared model can support multiple compute budgets that can be flexibly assigned across turns. We introduce Multi-Ratio ConceptMoE, which jointly supports token-to-concept compression ratios of 2, 4, and 8 (CR2/CR4/CR8) within a shared backbone. Lightweight full-token modules reduce compression-independent cost, ratio-specific boundary routers support distinct compression levels, and cross-ratio training enables mixed-ratio processing within the same context. Across PTBench and SFTBench, the three fixed modes outperform their compute-matched MoE baselines in all 6 comparisons while remaining competitive with independently trained fixed-ratio specialists. On CodeChat and CoSQL, mixed-ratio inference improves the accuracy--compute trade-off, outperforming the Large MoE by 5.87 and 2.68 percentage points while reducing FLOPs by 41.1% and 12.3%, respectively. Under the same turn-wise budget schedule, Multi-Ratio ConceptMoE further reduces FLOPs by 78.4% and 46.9% relative to routing among independent models. These results demonstrate that a single shared model can provide multiple compute budgets for flexible compute allocation across turns.

</details>

### 66. [Cross-Modal Latent Influence: Patch-Level Training Sample Attribution for Vision-Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14190v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14190

**作者：** Laura Yao、Shixing Yu、Jie Peng、Promit Ghosal、Kyra Gan、Tianlong Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14190v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14190v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 MOSAIC：学习一个共享的稀疏图像—文本 latent 空间（概念在单模态内稀疏、支持在连续图像区域上、与描述短语对齐且近似去相关），再用 EK-FAC 把训练样本影响沿这些概念分解，定位到具体文本短语和图像 patch，并在 Qwen、Gemma 的 captioning、胸片理解与 VQA 上评估。结果显示概念更局部连贯、不损害任务表现，且按影响排序的 latent 消融比按激活或频率排序更能改变输出。

**相关性简评：** 其「把多模态 latent 概念化 + 度量其对输出的因果影响 + patch/短语级定位」的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据是否保留、latent 状态的贡献分配与视觉旁路诊断提供可核查的分析工具；但论文关注训练样本归因与可解释性，不涉及推理期 latent 状态的生成与更新，迁移需自行设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Cross-Modal Latent Influence: Patch-Level Training Sample Attribution for Vision-Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Explaining a vision--language model (VLM) prediction requires tracing training-example influence to the multimodal evidence that mediates it, yet existing attribution methods largely operate only at the sample level. Recent latent-mediated influence methods provide feature-level attribution in language models, but lack the multimodal and spatial structure needed to ground influence in VLMs. We introduce MOSAIC (Multimodal Orthogonalized Sparse Autoencoders for Influence Characterization). It learns a shared sparse image--text latent space whose concepts are 1) sparse within each modality, 2) supported on contiguous image regions, 3) aligned to the phrases that describe them, and 4) approximately decorrelated. It then applies EK-FAC to decompose training-example influence through these concepts and localize their contributions to specific text phrases and image regions. We evaluate MOSAIC on Qwen and Gemma across captioning, chest X-ray understanding, and visual question answering. The learned features are more localized and coherent without degrading task behavior, and ablating influence-ranked latents changes model outputs more than ablating latents ranked by activation or frequency. We find that visual evidence can substantially reorganize training-data attribution while preserving more of the shared latent structure. MOSAIC thus connects where model behavior comes from with what multimodal evidence carries that influence.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 fixed-first training：训练前期固定较浅的循环深度，只在最后阶段才在多个深度上训练，并在 200M 与 1B 的 looped transformer 上比较计算开销与各推理深度下的 NLL、下游表现。

**相关性简评：** 其「深度仅在收尾阶段展开」的训练安排与监督方式，可能为 latent 循环推理中轨迹训练、深度泛化与 THINK 计算预算分配提供可核查的线索，但本文为纯语言设定，未涉及视觉或多模态推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Adaptive-Depth Is a Finishing Stage

**abstract/A1：** Looped transformers reuse the same layer multiple times, allowing inference compute to be adjusted without changing the model. Recent adaptive-depth methods train the model across multiple loop depths from the beginning of training. We introduce fixed-first training, which varies model depth only during a short final phase of training. At 200M parameters, training a model of fixed-depth 2 for the first 67% of the run reduces modeled training compute by 45% while keeping mean negative log-likelihood (NLL) across inference depths within 0.5% of training across depths throughout. At 1B parameters, training initially at depth 4 reduces modeled compute by 31% to 37% and wall-clock time by 32% to 39%, while keeping final NLL within 0.8% and downstream differences within the observed seed variation. These results show that training over the full range of depths can be reserved for a short finishing phase with only small changes in performance.

### 68. [Layer-wise Input Recoverability in Deep Neural Networks](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14290v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14290

**作者：** Maxwell Spiridonov、Alireza Rahmansetayesh、Pierre Baldi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14290v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14290v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文用逐输入 patch 的重建探针与 R² 指标，测量 CNN 各卷积层输出还能恢复多少该层输入，并在九个 ImageNet 模型上比较预训练、随机与重建优化编码器，还用单属性随机控制（复制奇异向量、奇异值谱、激活稀疏度）归因可恢复性来源。

**相关性简评：** 其「隐藏状态能恢复多少输入视觉信息」的探针范式与深度相关的压缩趋势，可供核查 LVR 中视觉细节保留与信息坍缩的度量与层级分析；单属性控制思路或许能用于区分 latent 内容受何种表示属性影响，但该文只做 CNN 图像分类，迁移到 VLM 推理需自行验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Layer-wise Input Recoverability in Deep Neural Networks

**abstract/A1：** The inner workings of deep neural networks are still not well understood. The information bottleneck framework, which characterizes deep networks by the mutual information between their hidden representations and the network's input, has been used to identify compression of input information with respect to an input image and output labels. We instead study how much of a layer's own input is recoverable from the layer's output in convolutional neural networks (CNNs). A convolutional layer applies its filters to one input patch at a time, so we evaluate recoverability on sampled input patches with a reconstruction-based probe and not on the entire feature map. The probe's size thus depends on channels and kernel size and not on feature map size, which lets our method scale to deep CNNs with wide feature maps. For each layer, we compare pretrained, random, and reconstruction-optimized encoders, using linear and linear-plus-residual-MLP decoders. We measure recoverability as $R^2$ between input patches and their reconstructions on a held-out set. Across nine ImageNet CNNs, recoverability generally decreases with depth but is more consistently predicted by the compression of the layer. Learning-attributed recoverability, the difference between pretrained and random encoders, is not uniform across architectures. We introduce single-property random controls, which transfer one pretrained property onto a random encoder, and find that each control changes recoverability with a consistent sign across models: copying pretrained singular vectors tends to raise recoverability, while copying the pretrained singular-value spectrum or activation sparsity lowers it.

</details>
