<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Measuring the Inference Energy Efficiency of Open-Weight LLMs across Benchmarks, Reasoning Modes, and Hardware

**abstract/A1：** Benchmark scores tell us what an LLM can do, but not how much energy is required to deliver that capability. We directly measure this trade-off for 86 open-weight model checkpoints, evaluated on seven benchmarks and six hardware platforms ranging from a consumer GPU to an eight-GPU server. We find large differences in energy efficiency even among models with similar capability. Most configurations lie away from the score--energy Pareto frontier: they use a median of 2.6--4.8$\\times$ more energy than another configuration that scores at least as well, with differences reaching 27$\\times$. Reasoning can improve capability, but enabling thinking increases energy by about 3.7$\\times$ on average, and the benefit depends strongly on the model family and output budget. Generated-token count is also an imperfect proxy for energy, misordering 18--24\\% of model pairs. In contrast, FP8 reduces energy by roughly a quarter with little change in score, while changing hardware largely rescales energy without changing the relative ranking of models. These results show that capability alone gives an incomplete picture of efficiency. We argue that benchmark scores should be reported together with measured energy consumption under a specified serving regime and output budget.

</details>

### 70. [Coarse-Graining Recursive Expert Computation: Continuation-Relative Interfaces and Failure Modes](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14413v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14413

**作者：** Shihua Yu、Yanzhi Wang、Tianchi Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CC、cs.CE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14413v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14413v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出以「后续计算」为参照的评估框架，用下游任务质量与总执行成本作为联合判据，考察能否用更廉价模块替换递归计算序列，并在两个冻结预训练语言模型及一个递归专家原型上做了对比实验。

**相关性简评：** 其边界表示、跳过计算摘要与下游损失分解，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态压缩、循环计算替换以及「答案是否真正使用 latent 内容」的诊断，提供可核查的评估协议与训练目标选择线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Coarse-Graining Recursive Expert Computation: Continuation-Relative Interfaces and Failure Modes

**abstract/A1：** Computational coarse-graining aims to replace a sequence of updates with a cheaper module while preserving task performance. We present a continuation-relative evaluation framework that assesses replacements through the computation that follows them, using downstream task quality and total execution cost as joint criteria. The framework distinguishes boundary representations, summaries of skipped computation, executed operations, and downstream loss. It makes interfaces and permitted deployment information explicit, combines fine-path references with directly trained controls using the same shortened architecture, and accounts for selection overhead. An exact loss decomposition separates replacement effects at a fixed downstream action from effects of changing that action. A finite construction shows how retained information can reduce the stipulated cost of zero-error prediction under fixed information and controller restrictions. Experiments in two frozen pretrained language models show that representation fidelity and task loss can favor different fitting objectives. In a prespecified comparison on a 1.7-billion-parameter model, next-token-loss training lowers in-distribution negative log-likelihood by 0.1901 nats per scored token compared with reconstructing the skipped blocks' output, using the same optimizer and update count. This ranking reverses in all nine paired comparisons under distribution shift. In a recursive expert prototype, the jointly adapted candidate lowers task error relative to frozen-bank and router-only baselines, but trails directly trained controls, and the tested input-only selectors fail the joint quality-cost criteria. Together, the protocol and studies provide explicit criteria and diagnostics for distinguishing useful computational replacement from local approximation gains within specified interfaces and evaluation settings.

</details>

### 71. [Learning to Extrapolate in Depth with Looped Transformers](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14456v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14456

**作者：** Huitao Yang、Jianhao Huang、Zixuan Wang、Baharan Mirzasoleiman

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14456v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14456v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究 looped transformer 的深度外推问题：在 all-pairs 图连通性任务上，证明训练深度 K 下群体训练会收敛到由单一有效参数支配的更新规则，并给出有限外推窗口的两端与可保证更难图恢复的测试深度和认证深度收益。

**相关性简评：** 其「循环块复用—迭代次数在传播不足与伪连接之间的权衡」线索，可能与 LVR 中 loop 式 latent 状态更新、循环次数（STOP）选择及深度/长度泛化的预测工作区相关，可供核查；但任务为图连通性，非视觉多模态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning to Extrapolate in Depth with Looped Transformers

**abstract/A1：** Looped transformers reuse a single block across iterations, raising a natural question: how far can a block trained at one depth be safely extrapolated to greater depths? We study this question for all-pairs graph connectivity, where harder graphs require longer-range information propagation. We show that under exchangeability and symmetric positive initialization, population training at depth K converges to an update rule governed by a single effective parameter that balances graph propagation against fitting structure unresolved at training depth. This trade-off creates a finite extrapolation window: too few test-time loops provide insufficient propagation, while too many eventually create false connections. We derive explicit endpoints for this window and bound the graph hardness solvable beyond training as a function of training depth and hardness. In particular, a test depth chosen solely from the training distribution can guarantee recovery on substantially harder graphs, with a certified depth gain that grows exponentially as training depth outpaces training hardness. Experiments validate the predicted windows and show how compute budget and initialization affect the optimal training depth.

</details>

### 72. [Learning after Execution with Action-Specific Credit](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14573v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14573

**作者：** Yufeng Tian、Jiahao Tang、Minghao Wu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14573v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14573v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把程序执行结果当作中间状态而非终端反馈，让同一策略在其上再做一次纠正式学习，并提出 action-specific credit：初始动作按最终轨迹结果给信用，纠正动作按相对中间状态的改进给信用；在 image-to-TikZ 可执行视觉测试台（945 条留出样例）上验证该训练方式能提升单次调用渲染成功率（92.70% 对单阶段 GRPO 的 88.25%）。

**相关性简评：** 其针对「同一策略两段动作、共享同一最终目标」的信用分配设计，可能为 latent 推理中多步状态更新、视觉证据筛选步骤的贡献分配与监督提供可核查线索；但该文推理发生在程序文本而非 latent 状态，属训练期方法，与主线的 LVR 表示问题仍有距离。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning after Execution with Action-Specific Credit

**abstract/A1：** Execution is often used as terminal feedback: it scores a generated program, but the resulting state is not used for another learning action. Learning after execution instead uses the execution result as an intermediate state that supports an additional learning interaction for the same policy. This creates a credit-assignment problem because the two actions share the same final objective but play different roles in the trajectory. Accordingly, action-specific credit assigns the initial action credit from the final trajectory outcome and the corrective action credit for improvement over the intermediate state. Image-to-TikZ serves as an executable visual testbed for this setting. On 945 held-out examples, learning after execution strengthens the shared policy under single-call inference and also produces a post-execution corrective capability. Single-call render success reaches 92.70\\%, compared with 88.25\\% for continued single-stage GRPO after the same number of additional training iterations. This corrective capability is not reproduced by continued single-stage training and depends on the intermediate state. Alternative credit definitions also induce different group-relative preferences over the same trajectories. Together, these results suggest that executable tasks contain useful learning structure beyond a terminal reward. Code is available at https://github.com/tianyufengcn/Learning-after-Execution.

</details>

### 73. [TGuide: Faster Autoregressive Video Diffusion via Historical Trajectory Guidance](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14657v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14657

**作者：** Zhuo Chen、Bin Zou、Fanyue Wei、Lixin Duan、Angela Yao、Wen Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14657v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14657v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 TGuide，用轻量的 Anchor-Transport-Correct 预测器结合历史采样轨迹（当前 chunk 前一步特征与前一 chunk 同时刻特征，经空间检索与自适应校正）来加速少步自回归视频扩散去噪，并在自身自回归 rollout 上训练预测器以抑制误差累积，在 4 步生成器上取得至多 1.89× 加速。

**相关性简评：** 其「跨片段同阶段特征复用」「在自生成轨迹上训练以缓解误差累积」「训练 81 帧却泛化到 333 帧」等线索，可能为 LVR 的 latent 状态更新、轨迹监督与长度泛化提供可核查的方法借鉴；但任务与视觉推理主线相距较远，需确认迁移可行性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TGuide: Faster Autoregressive Video Diffusion via Historical Trajectory Guidance

**abstract/A1：** Can autoregressive video diffusion be accelerated further when only four denoising steps remain? Existing feature caching approaches struggle in this regime, as large feature changes between denoising timesteps undermine both direct reuse and lightweight predictors. We observe that features across video chunks remain strongly correlated at matching denoising timesteps, offering a complementary source of guidance. Building on this insight, we introduce TGuide, a framework that accelerates autoregressive video diffusion through a lightweight Anchor-Transport-Correct (ATC) predictor guided by historical sampling trajectories. Our ATC combines two complementary references: the current chunk's preceding-step features preserve its spatial structure, while the previous chunk's same-timestep features provide information at the target denoising stage. By integrating these references through spatial retrieval and adaptive correction, ATC improves velocity prediction accuracy despite the large gaps between denoising steps. To mitigate error accumulation across both denoising steps and video chunks, we train the predictor on its own autoregressive rollouts, allowing it to adapt to states shaped by its own earlier predictions. An optional confidence-aware scheduler further adjusts the quality-efficiency trade-off. Experiments on Self Forcing, Causal Forcing, and HY-WorldPlay show that TGuide preserves generation quality while achieving denoising speedups of up to $1.89\\times$ over the original 4-step generators. On Self Forcing, TGuide generalizes from 81-frame training videos to 333-frame generation, approximately four times the training length, while exceeding the original model's VBench score.

**comment/C1：** 23 pages, 5 figures. Project page: https://zhuochen02.github.io/tguide/

</details>

### 74. [MORE: Learning Motion-Oriented Registers for Driving World Models and Planning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14871v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14871

**作者：** Yingdong Gu、Haoyu Wang、Shaocheng Yan、Zhenjun Zhao、Hao Han、Pengcheng Shi、Xianfei Li、Qinghua Tan、Wenlong Liao、Tao He、Jiayuan Li、Pai Peng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14871v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14871v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 MORE，在 V-JEPA 视频预训练中学习少量 motion-oriented registers，将其作为驾驶世界模型与规划共享的紧凑状态接口，并以 blockwise register-masking 目标塑造寄存器空间的预测结构。

**相关性简评：** 其把密集 patch 监督经紧凑状态瓶颈传递、并显式塑造状态空间预测结构的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的信息坍缩与任务必要信息保留提供可核查线索；但论文属驾驶世界模型方向，未涉及推理期 latent 生成机制。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MORE: Learning Motion-Oriented Registers for Driving World Models and Planning

**abstract/A1：** By predicting future states, latent world models provide rich self-supervision for end-to-end driving, but often inherit dense features from pretrained visual encoders as their world-state interface. This creates a mismatch: visual pretraining produces information-rich, spatially dense features, but their adaptation for motion-conditioned world modeling and planning is deferred to downstream training. The dense grid also makes future prediction more computationally expensive as visual resolution increases. We therefore argue that video pretraining should directly learn state representations suited to downstream world modeling and planning, rather than relying on downstream training to adapt inherited visual features. We propose \*\*\*MORE\*\*\*, a V-JEPA framework that learns \*\*M\*\*otion-\*\*O\*\*riented \*\*RE\*\*gisters during video pretraining as a shared state interface for driving world models and planning. MORE injects temporally aligned ego motion into a small set of registers and uses them as the sole context for masked patch prediction, channeling dense patch-level supervision through a compact state bottleneck. A complementary blockwise register-masking objective further shapes predictive structure in the register space. During downstream training, the same register space defines the future states predicted by the world model and provides shared scene memory for trajectory generation and scoring. On NAVSIM-v2, MORE outperforms the state of the art by 1.6 in EPDMS, while achieving superior efficiency with only 1/10 the inference latency of DriveLaW. These results support learning the state interface for world modeling and planning directly during video pretraining.

</details>

### 75. [Recurrent In-Context Learning for Tabular Foundation Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14998v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14998

**作者：** Tejas Vaidhya、Gaurav Sahu、Irina Rish

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14998v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14998v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 作者提出 Tab-Loop，把表格基础模型 TabICLv2 的 12 个独立参数 ICL 块换成 4 个共享参数块重复应用 k 次，在同等预训练与推理算力下以少 62% 参数达到与 baseline 相当的 log loss、准确率和 Elo；由于权重共享，深度变成推理期可选变量，准确率在训练范围之外仍能维持，且用更深循环继续训练可扩展有效深度。

**相关性简评：** 其「共享参数块循环堆叠 + 推理期选深度 + 超出训练循环数仍不退化」的结论，可能为 LVR 中 loop 式推理状态更新、动态计算分配与深度泛化提供可核查的方法线索；但任务为表格 ICL、无视觉状态，需核查该深度外推行为能否迁移到 VLM 推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Recurrent In-Context Learning for Tabular Foundation Models

**abstract/A1：** Tabular foundation models adapt to new datasets through in-context learning (ICL), and, like most transformers, they tie computational depth to the number of independently parameterized layers. We ask whether the ICL stage of such a model needs a distinct set of parameters for every layer, or only depth. We introduce Tab-Loop, which replaces the 12 untied ICL blocks of TabICLv2 with 4 tied blocks applied $k$ times and changes nothing else: the encoders, decoder, synthetic prior and training recipe are shared with an untied baseline trained for the same compute. At matched pretraining compute (18.2 EFLOP) and matched inference compute (12 block applications), Tab-Loop matches the baseline with 62\\% fewer parameters (10.4M vs.\\ 27.6M): held-out log loss is 0.4583 vs.\\ 0.4588, mean accuracy on 200 TALENT datasets is 84.10\\% vs.\\ 83.92\\%, and Elo on 38 TabArena datasets is 1409 vs.\\ 1396. A 4-block untied control with Tab-Loop's parameter count, which sees 32\\% more training tables for the same compute, trails both (83.46\\%; Elo 1343). Because weights are shared, depth becomes a choice made at inference. Accuracy rises with the number of loops through the trained range and holds beyond it, and continued training with deeper loops extends the useful range, reaching the baseline's stage-2 scores at 4--5$\\times$ its inference compute. At this scale, the ICL stage of a tabular foundation model needs depth more than it needs distinct parameters.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15081

**作者：** Silvère Gangloff、Jan Hula

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15081v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15081v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在小规模离散网格世界（由共同基座加若干额外规则构成的类数独谜题）上训练单一深度循环模型，按四级新颖度测试规则迁移，并比较符号规则描述、两个已解样例与无规则信息基线三种输入条件。

**相关性简评：** 其深度循环推理模型、以及用「描述／样例／无信息基线」对比来检验规则信息是否真被使用、跨规则组合泛化的评测框架，可能为 LVR 的循环状态更新、视觉或规则旁路与贡献分配、长度泛化提供可核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Knowledge transfer between simple discrete worlds

**abstract/A1：** Adapting to a new world and reasoning correctly about which outcomes are possible under rules one has not met before is a basic capacity underlying general intelligence. We study it in small discrete worlds: sets of grid configurations consistent with a shared set of rules, concretely Sudoku-like puzzles built from a common base and a handful of extra rules. We train a single depth-recurrent model on many combinations of rules and test it at four levels of novelty: a new puzzle, a new combination of known rules, a pairing of rules never seen together, and a rule instance not seen at all during training. The model receives the active rules either as a symbolic description or as two solved examples, and a model that gets no rule information is used as a baseline. At recombining rules it was trained on, the description matches or exceeds examples ($99\\%$ against $95\\%$ on new combinations). On rule instances whose components never co-occurred in training, the description falls below the no-information baseline while examples stay above it. The framework allows us to test many such generalization regimes in more systematic way than benchmarks such as ARC-AGI and provides new ground for evaluating depth-recurrent reasoning models, which are typically tested on saturated Sudoku benchmarks.

</details>

### 77. [Anchors Enhance Controllability and Reasoning of Diffusion Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15097v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15097

**作者：** Feiyu Qu、Zheng Huang、Andrea Zanette

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15097v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15097v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 AnchorDLM：用 RL 训练的 anchor generator 为每个查询产生一段短语及其插入位置，作为控制 token 初始化冻结扩散语言模型的输出序列，引导后续去噪，并用 DFM 视角把位置选择解释为重塑初始速度场；在代码生成与数学推理上验证可控性与推理性能提升。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本、非视觉，但「同时优化控制内容与其插入位置、以生成结果奖励做 RL 监督」可能为 LVR 中视觉证据注入的位置选择、latent 状态初始化与贡献分配提供可核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Anchors Enhance Controllability and Reasoning of Diffusion Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Diffusion language models (DLMs) offer new opportunities for controllable text generation. However, their controllability, defined as the ability to satisfy task constraints while preserving their original capabilities, remains underexplored. DLMs' bidirectional attention allows control tokens to guide generation from arbitrary positions in the output sequence, but effective guidance depends on the compatibility between their content and placement. To this end, we propose AnchorDLM, a framework in which an anchor generator produces an anchor consisting of a short output fragment and its position for each query. The anchor is placed as control tokens at the specified position to initialize the output sequence of a frozen DLM and guide subsequent denoising. We train the anchor generator with reinforcement learning (RL) to jointly optimize anchor content and placement, using rewards computed from the DLM's generated outputs based on answer correctness and constraint satisfaction. Moreover, through the lens of discrete flow matching (DFM), we interpret anchor placement as helping to reshape the initial velocity field that guides generation. Experiments on code generation and mathematical reasoning across five DLM backbones show that AnchorDLM improves controllability and further yields gains in reasoning performance across diverse benchmarks.

</details>

**作者：** Vladimir Kirill Bickov、Neil Yorke-Smith

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.NE、math.OC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15106v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15106v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文将 latent recursion 引入图组合优化：把 CVRP 实例编码为边 token，用紧凑 transformer 反复更新其 latent 表示，输出头得到边热图后由自回归解码器构造可行解，并检验在更大规模实例上的零样本泛化。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RELAGRAM: Recursive Latent Graph Model for the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem

**abstract/A1：** Latent recursion repeatedly processes internal representations through the same neural network. Recent work has shown this approach to be effective on structured reasoning tasks such as Sudoku and maze solving. However, whether latent recursion can support neural routing remains unclear. We introduce RELAGRAM (Recursive Latent Graph Model), a novel approach that brings latent recursion to graph combinatorial optimization. RELAGRAM encodes a capacitated vehicle routing problem (CVRP) instance as edge tokens; a compact transformer recurrently updates the latent representations of these tokens. An output head maps the answer state to an edge heatmap, from which an autoregressive decoder constructs a feasible solution. On CVRP-100 instances, the 0.53M-parameter RELAGRAM achieves gaps to a PyVRP reference of 13.4%, 9.8%, and 8.3% under greedy decoding, eightfold symmetry augmentation, and 256-candidate search, respectively. Trained only on CVRP-100, RELAGRAM generalizes zero-shot to CVRP-500 and CVRP-1000, achieving gaps of 15.6% and 21.7% under 256-candidate search. Together, these results demonstrate that latent recursion is a promising approach to neural routing.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 MLxOR workshop. Paper contains 6 pages (4 main text, 1 references, 1 appendix); 1 figure and 3 tables

**内容简述：** 提出 Structural Chain-of-Thought，让模型生成可执行计算图替代自由文本推理，答案由图确定性执行得到，并以图结构强化学习（奖励结构有效性、答案正确、与参考图节点重合）训练；在五个基准、四个模型族上优于监督图训练，生成长度最多缩短 5–6 倍，且答案更多由图推导而非事后合理化。

**相关性简评：** 虽属纯文本推理，但「可执行结构化中间状态＋节点级奖励」与 LVR 的 latent 状态监督、贡献分配以及答案是否真正使用中间内容（faithfulness）问题高度同构，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Structural Chain-of-Thought: Reasoning with Executable Computational Graphs

**abstract/A1：** Chain-of-thought prompting enables reasoning in large language models but produces explanations that are difficult to verify, expensive to generate, and not always faithful. We introduce a Structural Chain-of-Thought framework where models generate executable computational graphs instead of free-form reasoning. The final answer is obtained by deterministically executing the graph. The model is trained using graph-based reinforcement learning that rewards structural validity, answer correctness, and node overlap with reference graphs. Experiments across five benchmarks and four model families show that our method consistently improves accuracy over supervised graph training and can reduce generation length by up to 5-6x compared with standard GRPO and chain-of-thought supervised training. Our faithfulness experiments reveal that models trained with our approach tend to rely on deriving their answers from the generated graphs rather than producing post-hoc rationalizations as usually in chain-of-thought reasoning.

</details>

### 80. [DeltaNet-PC: Test-Time Memory Without Backpropagation Through Time](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15185v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15185

**作者：** Todd Morrill、Richard Zemel

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15185v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15185v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 DeltaNet-PC，把每步记忆更新 ΔS\_t 当作 latent 变量而非缓慢学习的权重，从预测编码的概率模型推导出无需 BPTT 的逐字序列记忆更新规则，并与 DeltaNet 等线性注意力做法建立联系；实验考察容量扩展、内存占用、从证据推断语境（bank 河岸 vs 银行）以及键值联想记忆的精确召回。

**相关性简评：** 其「逐步状态更新本身即 latent 变量、用局部预测误差而非 BPTT 更新」的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的产生与监督、以及免反向传播的轨迹训练提供可供核查的方法线索，语境消歧实验也与视觉证据筛选问题相关；但该工作只面向序列记忆，未涉及视觉或多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DeltaNet-PC: Test-Time Memory Without Backpropagation Through Time

**abstract/A1：** Test-time memorization of sequential information is a foundational capability for any intelligent system that needs to rapidly store and retrieve data, as demonstrated by the attention mechanism in large language models. However, Transformers and linear attention variants are trained via backpropagation through time (BPTT), which has drawbacks such as its enormous memory requirements. Predictive coding (PC), an algorithm that optimizes a prediction-error energy function with local updates, offers a compelling solution but still lacks test-time memory for sequential data. We develop a solution to this problem by treating the per-step memory update $ΔS\_t$ as a latent variable, as opposed to a slow weight to be learned. By taking the log probability of a standard PC-based probabilistic model, we derive a PC-native solution for verbatim sequence memory, and relate our update rule to common choices in the linear attention literature (e.g., DeltaNet). We present an extensive set of empirical tests to probe our system's properties, including its scaling capacity, memory footprint, and ability to infer a context from evidence (e.g., bank (river) vs. bank (money)). We show how DeltaNet-PC can be used for storing single sequences of data, multiple sequences of data, and key-value associative memory pairs with perfect recall accuracy.

</details>

### 81. [Running Fewer Loops Removes Refusal Behaviour in Recurrent-Depth Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15218v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15218

**作者：** Seyedarmin Azizi、Erfan Baghaei Potraghloo、Arya Fayyazi、Saeid Shokoufa、Massoud Pedram

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15218v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15218v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究循环深度语言模型在减少循环次数时的安全退化：在四个 Ouro 检查点与 Huginn-0125 上，用四种手段（含不生成文本的探测）显示减半深度仍保留约 89% 数学准确率，但配合有害请求的比例从 0.038 升到 0.205；线性分类器在单循环内部状态仍能高度判别有害请求，而从内部状态移除单一方向即可复现拒绝消失，运行时早退与按请求选深度均无法修复，随机深度训练则可恢复有害/无害拒绝的分离度。

**相关性简评：** 该工作是纯文本循环深度模型，其「少算力即少循环」的深度—行为权衡、内部状态仍线性可读却未被下游使用、以及单方向因果移除，可能为 LVR 中停止/深度决策、latent 状态的贡献分配与监督设计提供可供核查的线索，但需研究者自行迁移到多模态推理场景。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Running Fewer Loops Removes Refusal Behaviour in Recurrent-Depth Language Models

**abstract/A1：** A recurrent-depth language model reuses one block of weights several times in a row. The number of repetitions, which we call loops, is chosen when the model runs, not when it is trained, and running fewer is cheaper and faster, so a deployment may choose to do it. Running fewer loops also makes these models less safe, and the loss of safety is larger than the loss of anything else we measured. We study four released Ouro checkpoints and Huginn-0125. At half of its trained depth, Ouro-1.4B-Thinking still solves 0.692 of the GSM8K maths problems, against 0.775 at full depth, keeping 89% of its accuracy. Over the same reduction, the rate at which it helps with harmful requests rises from 0.038 to 0.205, 5.3 times higher. The information is not lost: a linear classifier reads whether a request is harmful from the model's internal state after a single loop, with an ROC AUC of 0.967 against 0.986 at full depth. What the missing loops remove is the refusal that should follow. We measure the effect with four instruments, one generating no text at all, and reproduce it on a second model family. Removing a single direction from Ouro-1.4B's internal state at full depth drops its refusal rate on harmful prompts from 0.950 to 0.130, identifying what the shallow model is missing. Two run-time repairs do not help: the models' early-exit rules do not spend more loops on harmful requests, and choosing a depth per request does not recover the loss. Changing the training does. Standard safety training makes the shallow model safe only by refusing 0.865 of harmless requests, while training at randomly chosen depths reaches a separation of +0.399 between harmful and harmless refusal at one loop, against +0.118. On Huginn-0125 it keeps harmful help at or below 0.040 at every depth from 1 to 32 loops, where standard training reaches 0.194, and it costs no accuracy at full depth.

</details>

### 82. [Understanding Unified VLMs: From Attention Probing to Guidance Tuning for Multimodal Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15227v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15227

**作者：** Zhengyang Luo、Xiaoyu Qiu、Zhiheng Tan、Yuchen Liang、Yingbin Liang、Liyue Shen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15227v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15227v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究统一 VLM（自回归与 masked-diffusion 两种范式）如何在共享 Transformer 中处理条件，逐注意力头探测 CFG 两分支的激活差异，发现对条件变化敏感的功能特化头，并据此提出免训练推理期干预 HeadTuned-CFG，在 T2I 与 I2T 上均获增益。

**相关性简评：** 其按注意力头探测条件敏感性的诊断思路，可能用于定位承载视觉条件与证据的内部状态结构（对应注意力结构、缓存与位置影响），HeadTuned-CFG 的免训练推理期引导则可供 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与 latent 内容使用方式的线索核查；但原文面向生成而非推理，迁移需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Understanding Unified VLMs: From Attention Probing to Guidance Tuning for Multimodal Generation

**abstract/A1：** Unified vision-language models (VLMs) perform both text-to-image (T2I) and image-to-text (I2T) generation with one shared Transformer backbone, yet how the backbone processes the condition in either direction remains poorly understood. We study this question from the perspective of conditional guidance: we probe every attention head to show the activation difference between two branches of classifier-free guidance (CFG) with different conditional guidance. On two unified VLMs of autoregressive and masked-diffusion paradigms, the probing reveals a subset of heads that are more sensitive to the change of condition while others are agnostic to it. This characteristic pattern holds in both T2I and I2T generation and is largely stable across data samples, demonstrating the internal mechanism of unified VLMs. Motivated by this, we propose a new inference-time intervention approach for unified multimodal generation, named \\textit{HeadTuned-CFG}, which uses the probed condition-change awareness to select and tune the conditional guidance at the attention-head level. Experiments show consistent benefits in both multimodal generation directions of unified VLMs without additional training, and in particular substantial improvements over strong baselines in T2I generation. These results further support the key finding of our probing analysis: the observed pattern of functional specialization is an intrinsic property of unified VLMs.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在提供当前工件状态与候选动作的确定性工具工作流中，用 Qwen 1.7B/8B/27B 比较不同工作流长度下的监督学习，并交叉训练期与评估期使用的状态表示，考察长程 agent 的学习与迁移。

**相关性简评：** 其「紧凑 vs 完整状态」的交叉表示协议，以及「紧凑掩码不查阅目标动作」所暗示的信息坍缩与表示敏感迁移，可能为 LVR 中内部状态保留哪些任务必要信息、视觉旁路与长度泛化提供可核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** State Representation Shapes Long-Horizon Agent Learning and Transfer: An Empirical Study

**abstract/A1：** An end-to-end success rate alone cannot distinguish failure to learn an action from failure to apply it as task state changes. We study this distinction in deterministic tool workflows that provide the current artifact state and candidate action recipes. Using 1.7B, 8B, and 27B Qwen models, we compare supervised learning across workflow horizons and cross the state representation used for training with the one used at evaluation. Horizon-matched supervision yields high completion, but an H4-trained 1.7B model transfers poorly to longer workflows under full-state observations. In an H16 crossover, compact-trained 1.7B adapters complete 50/50 held-out tasks in compact view and 0/50 in full view for each of three paired training seeds; full-trained outcomes vary across seeds. A separate 8B adapter pair shows a similar asymmetry. The view dependence also appears in paired-choice tasks where both candidate calls are executable and the correct choice depends on table contents; here, the compact mask does not consult the target action. An explicit relevance cue improves full-view execution but does not close the gap for the tested checkpoint. In a separate 27B ScienceWorld study, compact-state training improves local accuracy under both views, indicating that the transfer pattern depends on the task and observation construction. Together, these experiments identify representation-sensitive transfer as a bottleneck in the controlled workflows, without isolating content reduction from other changes to the observation.

</details>

### 84. [CacheLink: Functional KV Transport for Zero-Prefill Cross-Model Context Handoff](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15509v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15509

**作者：** Haomiao Qiu、Yining Tang、Zijia Song、Ruizi Han、Ziyue Qiao、Miao Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15509v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15509v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究跨模型 KV 缓存的零预填上下文交接，发现 K/V 重建误差与接收方实际效用关系很弱，转而提出 CacheLink，以接收方注意力与下一 token 行为为监督直接学习耦合的 K/V 校正。

**相关性简评：** 其「重建保真度不是接收方效用的好代理」这一诊断，以及用接收方行为而非重构误差衡量状态可用性的做法，可能可迁移到 LVR 中 latent 状态转移与视觉信息是否真正被使用的评价，供核查如何以注意力与预测分布判断 latent 内容是否保留任务必要信息。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CacheLink: Functional KV Transport for Zero-Prefill Cross-Model Context Handoff

**abstract/A1：** KV caches make long-context serving efficient by reusing past computation, but model switching breaks this reuse and forces the receiver to prefill the context again. We study \\emph{zero-prefill cross-model context handoff}: translating a sender cache into a receiver-compatible state so that the receiver can continue directly without prefilling same context. Existing affine transport methods show that receiver KV states can be substantially reconstructed from sender caches. However, through extensive analyses, we find that reconstruction fidelity is a poor proxy for receiver utility. Similar K/V reconstruction errors can lead to substantially different attention patterns, predictive distributions, and downstream accuracy, because conventional reconstruction objectives overlook the query-dependent functional importance of K and V in receiver attention. We thus introduce CACHELINK, which learns a coupled K/V correction through the receiver behavior directly. Across four independently trained sender--receiver pairs and seven evaluation panels, CACHELINK improves the equal-weight mean over all methods for every pair. In matched diagnostics, CACHELINK changes K/V squared error by less than 0.4% while substantially changing receiver attention and next-token behavior. At 32K context, it reduces handoff latency by up to $7.27\\times$ relative to receiver re-prefill. Our findings verify that reconstruction fidelity alone is insufficient and that preserving the receiver computation induced by the transported cache is important for effective cross-model KV transport.

</details>

**作者：** Li Nanbo、Firas Laakom、Yilan Zhang、Piotr Piękos、Yimeng Chen、Liangyu Wang、Yifan Xu、Mateusz Ostaszewski、Dandan Guo、Wenyi Wang、Yanning Dai、Yuhui Wang、Jürgen Schmidhuber

**内容简述：** 论文提出 NoteBank：一种免训练、即插即用的稀疏情景记忆，在后续查询未知前先写入选中的文本片段，用主干自身特征完成写入与寻址，并通过原生前向计算「回放」检索到的证据，将线性注意力模型在百万级 token 检索上的准确率大幅提升，同时几乎不增加算力与存储。

**相关性简评：** 「解耦循环状态与长期存储、按需检索并以原生前向回放证据」这一接口，可能与 LVR 关于状态容量、视觉证据筛选与检索式 latent 推理的讨论相关，可供核查；但论文对象是纯文本线性注意力，向多模态推理的可迁移性尚未验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** History Replays Itself: Unleashing Long-Context Capability in Linear Attention

**abstract/A1：** Linear attention promises the efficiency needed for long-context language modelling, yet its fixed-size recurrent state must simultaneously support ongoing computation and preserve information from an ever-growing history. This coupling has reinforced a prevailing view that the state's memory capacity defines the model's long-context capability. We challenge this presumed ceiling: \\emph{recurrent computation need not bear the full burden of long-term storage}. We introduce NoteBank, a sparse episodic memory that archives selected text before future queries are known, uses the backbone's native features for writing and addressing, and reads retrieved evidence through its native forward computation via replay. This \\emph{training-free, plug-and-play} interface requires no external embedding model, separately trained retriever, or separate neural reader. At one million tokens, it raises Gated DeltaNet's mean accuracy across six RULER retrieval tasks from 1.7% to 70.3%, with no observed significant retrieval degradation from 4K to 1M tokens. This recovery adds $\\leqslant$0.025% to analytical FLOPs, with persistent context storage approximately 1/2,600 that of a Transformer's full MHA KV cache at matched width, depth, and precision. Experiments extend from three 1.3B recurrent backbones to Mamba-2-8B and post-trained Qwen3.5-9B, demonstrating gains on LongBench v1/v2 and MemoryAgentBench. Together, these results show that sparse evidence storage and native replay can substantially expand the long-context capability of pretrained linear attention models while retaining the efficiency of recurrent computation.

**comment/C1：** See our project in https://nanboli.github.io/notebank-page

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 LVRL：借助预训练 LLM 的上下文学习能力估计策略相关的状态价值，无需微调独立 critic，并用初始与终止状态的已知价值校准预测，从而由价值差得到步级信用分配；进一步扩展出 LVOPD，在 online policy distillation 中把教师监督集中在价值下降的动作上，在 AppWorld、BabyAI、SWE-bench Verified 等 agentic 基准上评测。

**相关性简评：** 稀疏结果奖励下的步级信用分配与「只监督关键步骤」的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理步骤的贡献分配与轨迹级监督提供可核查的方法线索；但该工作面向纯文本智能体、无视觉状态，其价值估计能否迁移到 latent 状态仍需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LLM Value Functions for Credit Assignment in Agentic RL

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement learning (RL) for large language model (LLM) agents remains challenging in long-horizon tasks with sparse outcome rewards, where assigning credit to individual actions is difficult. Methods such as GRPO assign the same trajectory-level advantage to all actions, while critic-based methods require learning an additional value function that can be costly and unstable. We introduce LLM Value Function RL (LVRL), which uses the pretrained knowledge and in-context learning ability of an LLM to estimate policy-aware state values without finetuning a separate critic. LVRL conditions the value model on group context and calibrates its predictions using known values at the initial and terminal states, enabling step-level credit assignment from estimated value differences. We further extend this idea to learning from an expert policy through on-policy distillation (OPD), introducing LLM Value Function OPD (LVOPD), which focuses teacher supervision on actions associated with decreases in estimated value. We evaluate our approach across diverse agentic benchmarks: AppWorld, BabyAI, and SWE-bench Verified. Across policy scales (4B to 32B), LVRL consistently and substantially outperforms both GRPO and PPO. On AppWorld and SWE-bench Verified, LVRL yields absolute improvements of up to 13.6 and 8.6 percentage points over GRPO. Notably, on tasks requiring extended exploration like BabyAI, LVRL bridges the gap from total failure to 75.0% success. Furthermore, LVOPD yields consistent improvements over standard distillation baselines on AppWorld. Finally, Monte-Carlo analysis confirms that our frozen critic accurately identifies semantic pitfalls and recoveries, proving that LVRL extracts robust, policy-aware step-level credit from sparse terminal outcomes.

</details>

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15850v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15850v1>)

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文研究 SAE 特征的发现分数（激活与行为的共变）能否识别干预效应，将「干预归因」定义为指定干预对模型输出的一阶效应，给出梯度分解解释线性探针预测与干预归因之间的差距，并在四组模型-SAE 上验证梯度预测在符号与幅度上更贴近真实干预效果。

**相关性简评：** 其中「观测相关性不等于因果贡献」的论证与梯度可估的归因目标，可供核查 LVR 中如何判断 latent 推理状态是否真被答案使用、以及视觉证据筛选与贡献分配的监督信号设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** What Do Sparse Autoencoder Feature Discovery Scores Identify? From Activations to Interventions

**abstract/A1：** Sparse autoencoder (SAE) features are typically discovered from how their activations co-vary with behaviour, yet they are often used through interventions such as steering or ablation. We take intervention attribution, the first-order effect of a specified intervention on the model output, as our estimand. For a broad class of response functions, we show that observational feature-discovery evidence generally does not identify this attribution, and derive an exact gradient-based decomposition of the gap between linear-probe predictions and intervention attribution. Across four model-SAE pairs, median probe-to-attribution magnitude ratios range from tens to hundreds, while attributions closely track small-step steering. For single-latent ablations with nonzero effects, gradient predictions match the realized sign in 91-97% of cases, compared with 17-35% for probe-implied changes. Attribution-selected sets also produce larger absolute mean ablation effects on held-out prompts than sets selected by correlation, rank tests or probe coefficients. Together, these results establish intervention attribution as a principled, gradient-estimable target for selecting SAE features for intervention.

</details>

### 88. [The Sharp Directions Are Against You: Curvature Analysis of Activation Steering](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16084v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16084

**作者：** Seyedarmin Azizi、Arya Fayyazi、Parsa Razmara、Erfan Baghaei Potraghloo、Souvik Kundu、Massoud Pedram

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16084v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16084v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文分析推理期激活引导（activation steering）为何脆弱：提出 steering Hessian，刻画行为损失对引导向量方向的二阶曲率，区分导致行为剧烈反转的 sharp 方向与稳健的 flat 方向；在 3 个模型家族、4 类行为任务、36 组条件下证明，剔除模长占比仅 1–5% 的 sharp 分量即可在近似保持方向与模长的情况下大幅降低曲率，并在开放生成与越狱实验中优于标准 CAA。

**相关性简评：** 该文给出的内部表示扰动曲率诊断可供核查：类似分析或可用于检验 LVR 中 latent 推理状态干预的鲁棒性，以及定位「模长极小却主导输出变化」的因果贡献分量；但原研究限于纯文本模型的行为控制，能否迁移到多模态 latent 状态需人工核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The Sharp Directions Are Against You: Curvature Analysis of Activation Steering

**abstract/A1：** Activation steering adds a vector to a language model's internal representations at inference time. It is a lightweight alternative to fine-tuning for behavioral control. The standard construction, contrastive activation addition (CAA), is fragile, as on many inputs it shifts behavior in the wrong direction. To explain this fragility, we first study the geometry of the steering vector. We introduce steering Hessian, the matrix of second order derivative of the model's behavioral loss with respect to the steering vector. It captures the output behavior response sensitivity of the model under small perturbations of the steering vector along each direction. Its top eigenvectors are sharp directions: tiny perturbations along them can cause large, erratic, input-dependent behavioral swings. Bottom eigenvectors are flat directions: behavior is robust along them. Removing the sharp component of a steering vector approximately preserves its direction and magnitude (cosine &gt; 0.974, norm reduction &lt; 3% for typical settings) while reducing the vector's directional curvature by up to 12x (median 4x across 36 conditions). We evaluate on three model families (Qwen2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, Mistral-7B), with four behavioral tasks, and 36 token-level conditions. Steering along sharp directions reverses the intended behavior in every condition tested, with anti-steer rates of 53-100%. Sharp directions account for only 1-5% of the CAA vector's squared norm. However, they drive a disproportionate share of the gap between the steered and unsteered next-token distributions during autoregressive generation. We term this one-line correction as sharp removal; it outperforms standard CAA in open-ended generation across all 25 conditions tested. A jailbreaking experiment further shows that sharp directions act as noise rather than signal: they disrupt coherent behavioral control regardless of steering polarity.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 89. [Phantom Merge: When Your Large Language Model Agents Pick One but Tell You About Another](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16141v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16141

**作者：** Wangshu Zhu、Qianwen Guo、Yushun Dong

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16141v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16141v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文指出 LLM agent 存在「Phantom Merge」实体-证据绑定失败，即把无支撑声明归给错误实体，并在四个领域、四个骨干上刻画其普遍性与子类型；随后提出两阶段框架：用发射前隐状态的表示读出结合 Jacobian 功能信息做声明级风险估计（AGR），再以固定锚点校正（FAC）修正或删除被标记声明。

**相关性简评：** 其「隐状态表示读出＋Jacobian」的声明级风险估计，与 LVR 关心的「内部状态是否保留任务必要证据、输出是否真正使用 latent 内容」直接呼应，可供核查该探针方法能否迁移到视觉证据筛选与实体-视觉绑定失败的诊断。原文并非视觉任务，迁移属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Phantom Merge: When Your Large Language Model Agents Pick One but Tell You About Another

**abstract/A1：** LLM agents increasingly operate over multiple entities, where reliable response generation requires not only retrieving relevant evidence but also preserving its association with the correct entity. We identify Phantom Merge (PM), an entity-evidence binding failure in which an agent attributes unsupported claims to its committed entity, potentially even when the task is completed correctly. We formalize PM at the claim level and characterize its prevalence and error subtypes across four agent domains and four backbone families. To address this problem, we propose a two-stage framework for claim-level risk estimation and correction. First, Anchor-Grounded Risk (AGR) combines a representational readout of the agent's pre-emission hidden state with Jacobian-based functional information, providing complementary slot-level and anchor-value risk scores. Second, Fixed-Anchor Correction (FAC) audits flagged claims and selectively revises them using observed anchor evidence or removes them when no supported replacement is available. On the held-out Shopping detection cohort, AGR-slot achieves an AUROC of 96.2% and an average precision of 97.3%, outperforming the evaluated detection baselines. In the end-to-end Shopping mitigation evaluation, FAC reduces trajectory-level PM from 51.4% to 6.2%, with an output-to-original claim ratio of 80.7%. These results demonstrate the prevalence of entity-specific grounding failures and the effectiveness of combining internal risk estimation with evidence-constrained claim correction. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/LabRAI/PhantomMerge.

</details>

### 90. [When a Conceptor Complement Becomes Gain: Operator Geometry and Behavioral Attribution in Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16325v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16325

**作者：** Shuhul Razdan、R Balamurugan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16325v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16325v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在语言模型激活干预中研究行为归因：保持目标中心与增益不变、仅移除概念子补（conceptor complement）拟合的协方差滤波矩阵，用 1920 条响应的配对比较与几何孔径扫描检验该矩阵是否带来额外的目标抑制收益。

**相关性简评：** 其「固定共享分量、只移除被检验的拟合矩阵、直接检验输出后果」的归因设计，可能为 LVR 中 latent 内容与增益/尺度等成分的贡献分配和因果作用核查提供方法线索，但是否可迁移到多模态推理状态仍需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When a Conceptor Complement Becomes Gain: Operator Geometry and Behavioral Attribution in Language Models

**abstract/A1：** When a steering intervention changes a language model's behavior, which part of the intervention deserves the credit? We test this question for a target-centered, scaled conceptor complement by removing its fitted covariance filter while preserving the same target-specific center and gain. At the original aperture $α=.05$ and gain $β=2$, all 21 fitted maps across three models and seven targets expand every direction at the generation intervention layers. The matrix correction is $0.093\\%$--$7.815\\%$ of the matched-control displacement on held-out extraction activations. In 480 paired comparisons within a 1,920-response study, retaining the matrix changes many individual texts but does not establish a consistent additional target-suppression benefit on the four-target panel. A geometric aperture sweep shows that the operating regime changes with the filter setting. Separately, an invertible soft filter preserves what an unrestricted affine readout can recover, whereas dedicated erasure methods reduce prediction by newly fitted probes. Together, the results show why a whole-intervention comparison cannot by itself attribute generated behavior to the fitted matrix: analyze the complete transformation, hold shared components fixed, and test its output consequences directly.

**comment/C1：** 50 pages. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 NeurReps Workshop (Symmetry and Geometry in Neural Representations). Code: https://github.com/shuhulx/ConceptorComplementGain

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16441

**作者：** Subhadeep Roy、Christoph Leiter、Steffen Eger

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16441v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16441v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 VisExMEM：一种无参考图像—文本评测器，把描述拆成原子断言、定位对应视觉证据并逐条验证，再汇总为全局分数；基于 Qwen3.5 训练 4B/9B 模型（多任务 SFT、反事实精炼、evidence-aware GDPO），并发布含 8.7K 原子断言的 AGITA-Bench。

**相关性简评：** 其「断言分解—视觉证据定位—逐条验证」流程与 evidence-aware GDPO，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选以及「答案是否真正用到视觉内容」的监督与贡献归因提供可核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** VisExMEM: Visual Evidence-Based Explainable Multimodal Evaluation Metric

**abstract/A1：** Current image-text evaluation often relies on a global score, which gives limited insight into which semantic details are supported by the image. Explainable metrics provide rationales, but the visual evidence supporting those rationales can still be difficult to verify. We introduce VisExMEM, a reference-free evaluator that decomposes captions into atomic claims, localizes visual evidence, verifies each claim, and averages claim-level support into a global score. Explanations use the same evidence and decisions. We train Qwen3.5-based 4B and 9B models on 100K samples with multi-task SFT, counterfactual refinement, and evidence-aware GDPO. Across eight benchmarks, VisExMEM-9B achieves the highest descriptive composite among open-source evaluators in our comparison, exceeding VQAScore by 11.7 points while remaining competitive with GPT-5.6 Sol. We also introduce AGITA-Bench, containing 600 human-annotated image-text pairs and 8.7K atomic claims for global and claim-level evaluation. For untuned Qwen3.5 and GPT-5.6 Sol controls, decomposed prompting raises the same composite by 3.6-5.1 points relative to holistic prompting. Human evaluation shows that VisExMEM explanations outperform prior explainable metrics and approach GPT-5.6 Sol.

</details>

### 92. [Before Attention Sinks Form: Hidden-State Geometry Reveals and Modulates Their Formation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16745v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16745

**作者：** Fan Yang、Yue Song

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16745v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16745v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究 attention sink 形成之前是否已出现可测的隐状态几何变化：在同模型同层比较不同 prompt，发现 sink 形成前约 2–3 层存在 prompt 特定的谱信号，并只对后层隐状态奇异值做干预，在多个模型上因果改变后续 sink 行为。

**相关性简评：** 其「用隐状态谱摘要读出转变前的状态、再以谱干预做因果验证」的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的预测、贡献分配与因果作用检验提供方法线索，需核查能否迁移到多模态推理状态；本身不直接研究视觉或多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Before Attention Sinks Form: Hidden-State Geometry Reveals and Modulates Their Formation

**abstract/A1：** Attention sinks are usually studied after they have formed. We ask whether a measurable hidden-state change appears beforehand and whether changing that geometry alters what happens later. To remove network depth as a shortcut, we compare prompts in the same model and at the same layer. When sink timing varies across prompts, simple spectral summaries of the hidden states add information beyond current attention, with the clearest prompt-specific signal in a short window about two to three layers before sink formation. The predictive strength varies across cohorts, so we treat the spectrum as a readout of a pre-sink state change rather than a universal warning statistic. The signal is broader than one measured extreme activation. We then modify only the singular values of the post-layer hidden states after current attention has already been computed. These interventions change later sink behavior in Qwen2.5, GLM-Z1, and GPT-OSS relative to norm-matched random spectral perturbations. In Qwen2.5, the immediate suppressive effect is accompanied by a reduction in next-layer query--key preference for position~0, and the learned spectral directions remain stable when estimated from substantially less training data. Together, the results show that attention sinks are preceded by a short spectral reorganization of hidden states, and directly perturbing this geometry can causally alter subsequent sink formation.

</details>

### 93. [AUGUstus: Autonomous Driving VLA Model with Unified Generation and Understanding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16985v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16985

**作者：** Yuqi Ye、Caigao Jiang、Zhuonan Wang、Congyuan Pei、Chao Qu、Changhao Peng、Junhong Lin、Qize Yu、Zetian Song、Guangzhao Fu、Chongruo Wu、Shiyu Huang、Shuchang Zhou、Honggou Yang、Wei Gao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16985v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16985v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出自动驾驶 VLA 模型 AUGUstus，将扩散式动作生成与自回归 CoT 理解统一在一个模型中，并采用先动作后 CoT 的排序与联合 GRPO 训练，使 CoT 仅在训练期监督共享表示、推理期只输出动作以降低延迟。

**相关性简评：** 其「CoT 只在训练期提供监督、推理期不使用」的设计，与 LVR 中语言轨迹监督如何塑造并写入共享表示、以及推理期是否真正使用 latent 内容的贡献分配问题可能相关，可供核查；但整体面向驾驶规划，与视觉推理主线的距离需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AUGUstus: Autonomous Driving VLA Model with Unified Generation and Understanding

**abstract/A1：** Vision-language-action (VLA) models show strong potential for end-to-end autonomous driving by leveraging world knowledge and understanding to excel in long-tail scenarios. However, current VLAs have two limitations: 1) Degeneration into vision-action (VA) models. For low latency, regression/flow-based methods directly generate actions but underuse VLM understanding, causing unsafe, unexplainable actions. 2) Autoregressive high latency. Autoregressive methods sequentially generate chain-of-thought (CoT) and action tokens, fully leveraging VLM understanding, but high latency hinders deployment. To enable low-latency deployment while using CoT to assist action generation, we propose AUGUstus, an Autonomous-driving VLA model with Unified Generation and Understanding. We unify diffusion-based action generation and autoregressive CoT understanding in one model, where understanding only serves generation. Joint CoT supervision preserves VLM spatial understanding in shared representation for safer, more accurate trajectories. AUGUstus-mode orders action generation before CoT, so CoT supervises reliable actions during training while inference needs only action output, enabling low latency. AUGUstus-GRPO, a unified GRPO algorithm, jointly optimizes action and CoT, improving action performance. Experiments show AUGUstus achieves 94.6 PDMS on NAVSIMv1 and 90.7 EPDMS on NAVSIMv2, SOTA planning without scorer module. On nuScenes, it achieves average L2 error 0.27 m and average collision rate 0.05%, best among compared methods. To validate AUGUstus practicality, we train on in-house data with 512 NVIDIA H800 GPUs for ~2 days, evaluate on an internal 1,000 km dataset, and preliminarily deploy on a real vehicle, achieving 12 Hz operation. Project page: https://augustus-ad.github.io

</details>

**作者：** Zekun Shi、Alastair James Arthur Price

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 FreeSolo 原生稀疏注意力：短程滑动窗口分支加长程分支，直接对筛选出的关键单元做 token 注意力；FS-L 通过短程 CPT 学习查询相关选择前的前缀剪枝，FS-B 用平衡树搜索，目标是在不做长上下文微调时获得零样本长度外推。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FreeSolo: Linear-time Sparse Attention with Zero-Shot Length Extrapolation

**abstract/A1：** Linear-time sequence models typically store long-context information in a recurrent state. A fixed-size state limits how much information can be stored, while hybrid architectures that add full attention for better recall incur quadratic sequence cost. Alternatively, sparse attention with continued pretraining (CPT) can extend the effective context length. Generalization beyond the trained length remains challenging, however, and CPT can be costly. We introduce FreeSolo, a native sparse attention mechanism with a short-range sliding window branch and a long-range branch that selects keypoint cells for direct token attention. Its linear-time variant, FS-L, learns to prune the prefix before query-dependent selection through short CPT. FS-B searches balanced trees with $O(N\\log^2 N)$ algorithmic cost including radix-sort construction. FreeSolo demonstrates better zero-shot length extrapolation than the baselines without long-context fine-tuning.

</details>

### 95. [RL Post-Training Diffusion Language Models Along Their Own Generation Paths](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17266v1>)

**作者：** Vaibhav Singh、Eugene Belilovsky

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17266v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17266v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对扩散语言模型 RL 后训练中的「轨迹盲」问题，提出 PACT：联合学习策略与一个对每个去噪中间状态打分的标量势函数，以终末奖励锚定，并用一致性损失匹配已揭示 token 的策略-参考对数概率比与势变化，在四个文本推理任务上提升 LLaDA-8B-Instruct。

**相关性简评：** 其用终末奖励锚定的标量势对每个中间去噪状态分配贡献、无需序列似然估计的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的贡献分配与轨迹监督提供训练侧借鉴，但论文为纯文本扩散模型，能否迁移到多模态推理状态需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RL Post-Training Diffusion Language Models Along Their Own Generation Paths

**abstract/A1：** Diffusion language models are a promising and more efficient alternative to autoregressive models. However, most RL post-training techniques are not easily adapted to these models. One issue is that diffusion language models generate answers through many intermediate states, deciding at each step which masked positions to reveal and which tokens to place in them. Many existing RL methods used in this setting approximate intractable sequence likelihoods or weight every denoising step by the same advantage, without explicitly distinguishing how these intermediate states of the denoising trajectory affect the expected reward. To address this issue of trajectory blindness, we introduce PACT (Potential-Anchored Consistency of Transitions). Motivated by a reward-tilted reference distribution, PACT jointly learns the policy and a scalar potential that scores each intermediate state, anchored by terminal reward. For each sampled denoising transition, a consistency loss matches the policy-to-reference log-probability ratio of revealed tokens to the change in this potential. This formulation requires neither sequence-likelihood estimation nor importance-ratio clipping. On four tasks, PACT improves LLaDA-8B-Instruct by +9.9 points on GSM8K, +12.0 on MATH500, +55.7 on Countdown, and +72.6 on Sudoku, and reaches the best average accuracy across the four tasks reported for this model, +3.7 points over the next best method. Further compared to AGRPO, it reaches that baseline's best accuracy in about half the training compute on GSM8K.

**comment/C1：** 9 pages, 6 figures

</details>

### 96. [Budgeted KV-Cache Repair for Evolving Contexts](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17338v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17338

**作者：** Han Yu、Wenhui Zhu、Jincheng Cao、Rui Cai、Yuanda Xu、Zhengze Zhou、Xiwen Chen、Hao Wang、Xuanzhao Dong、Han Shi、Menglin Zhou、Shayan Mohajer Hamidi、Lin Su、Mina Razghandi、Sayan Ghosh、Qing Lan、Rohit Jain、Alborz Geramifard

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17338v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17338v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究语言模型智能体更新上下文后，KV 缓存中仍残留已删除内容影响的问题，提出在给定预算下只重算保留后缀的一小部分来恢复任务性能，并用基于嵌入分数的 Semantic-Unit Refresh 把预算分配给查询相关的语义区域，另设计分层打包执行器加速碎片化重算。

**相关性简评：** 其「刷新连续区域优于刷新孤立 token」的发现与预算分配、重要性打分机制，可供核查 LVR 中哪些内部状态需保留或重算、以及缓存与注意力结构对 latent 状态的影响，并关联动态计算的收益-成本权衡；但面向纯文本任务，属方法借鉴线索而非直接主线。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Budgeted KV-Cache Repair for Evolving Contexts

**abstract/A1：** Language-model agents revise their working context as information becomes obsolete, but deleting text does not erase its influence on cached computation. Later key-value (KV) states remain conditioned on the deleted content, while recomputing the entire retained suffix can be costly. We introduce budgeted KV-cache repair: recovering task performance by recomputing a user-chosen fraction of the retained suffix. Comparing repair allocations under identical relevance scores and token budgets, we find that refreshing coherent regions can substantially outperform refreshing isolated tokens. This finding motivates Semantic-Unit Refresh (SUR), which allocates the budget to query-relevant text regions using inexpensive embedding scores, without training or an auxiliary transformer forward. To execute these repairs efficiently, a layer-packed executor processes selected states together at each layer while preserving full causal cache access. Across five models, SUR achieves strong recovery in controlled deletion tasks while recomputing only 2-5% of the suffix. On four natural multi-hop QA datasets, it achieves near-full-recompute exact match at a 5% budget with lower post-edit latency. The executor accelerates fragmented refresh by up to 16.1x over interval-wise execution.

</details>

### 97. [JustOPD: On-Policy Distillation from Autoregressive to Diffusion Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17397v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17397

**作者：** Zikun Zhang、Jiayuan Sheng、David D. Yao、Wenpin Tang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17397v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17397v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 JustOPD，一种从自回归语言模型到扩散语言模型的 on-policy 蒸馏方法：训练时用自回归 rollout 让学生的生成过程对齐教师的从左到右解码，从而在推理阶段仍保留 DLM 的灵活生成顺序，并在数学推理上稳定优于基座 DLM。

**相关性简评：** 虽为纯文本工作，但其「跨解码顺序差异做蒸馏对齐、且不牺牲推理期并行/任意顺序生成」的思路，可能为用 AR 教师训练 parallel 或 diffusion 式 latent 推理状态生成器提供监督与轨迹对齐线索，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** JustOPD: On-Policy Distillation from Autoregressive to Diffusion Language Models

**abstract/A1：** On-policy distillation (OPD) is a post-training approach for large language models (LLMs) that enables a student model to learn a teacher model's distribution from sequences sampled from the student's own policy. Despite its promising capability, OPD for diffusion language models (DLMs) remains underexplored and existing studies primarily focuses on DLM-to-DLM distillation. The limited availability of strong teacher DLMs and the flexible generation order of DLMs impose additional technical challenges as well. However, it remains unclear how to effectively distill knowledge from a strong autoregressive language model (ARM) into a weaker DLM, given the mismatch between the left-to-right decoding of ARMs and the flexible decoding order of DLMs. Inspired by Ni et al. (2026), we propose JustOPD, an ARM-to-DLM on-policy distillation method that uses autoregressive rollouts during training to align the student's generation process with the ARM teacher's left-to-right decoding. This alignment enables effective distillation from ARM teachers while preserving the DLM's flexible generation-order capability at inference time. Experiments using Qwen3-14B as the teacher and Dream-7B as the student demonstrate that JustOPD consistently improves mathematical reasoning performance over the base DLM across multiple divergence choices.

**comment/C1：** 24 Pages, 1 figure

</details>

### 98. [A Sense of Proprioception in Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17495v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17495

**作者：** Jonas Geiping

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17495v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17495v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出语言模型的「本体感受」类比：用 SFT 与 on-policy 训练让模型能自我报告 MoE 路由决策、token 熵、decision depth、logit lens 等内部状态，并评估其对情境意识、可读性与副现象性的影响。

**相关性简评：** 其「把内部状态转成可验证信号再做监督」的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态是否可读、是否被真正使用（视觉旁路、信息坍缩）提供诊断与贡献分配的核查线索；epiphenomenality 评估尤其值得对照。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A Sense of Proprioception in Language Models

**abstract/A1：** In humans, proprioception corresponds to the sense of self-movement or position, e.g. understanding the position of one's arm. This sense is often less well-understood and in popular understanding sometimes conflated with introspection. But, notably, proprioception is a separate sense, with dedicated receptors and verifiable outcomes. On the other hand though, language models cannot observe their own internal states during training (and for example answer the question which experts activated in a certain layer of an MoE) and so cannot accurately report on them. Yet, such information is, by virtue of being internal to the model, both accessible, and readily constructed into verifiable signals. We argue that this provides the basis for a digital analog of proprioception. As such, we train models through SFT and on-policy training to equip them with this ability. We show that modern models can be trained to understand a range of subtypes of proprioception, such as routing decision awareness, token entropy, decision depth or logit lens information, without affecting model capabilities. We then run these models through a broad evaluation of situational awareness, legibility, and epiphenomenality, to evaluate in what ways access to proprioception changes model behavior.

**comment/C1：** 28 pages, 22 figures, preprint

</details>

### 99. [Merit: Making every modality earn its contribution in multimodal attention decoding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17507v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17507

**作者：** Ali Alavi、Donald S. Williamson

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17507v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17507v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 MERIT，一种结合 EEG、眼动、头动与场景视频的多模态听觉注意力解码器及评估方法：按输入流打乱测试样本、用精度下降与 Shapley 值拆分各模态贡献，并加入两条捷径阻断检查。

**相关性简评：** 其「打乱输入流 + 跨模态分配贡献 + 阻断捷径」的评估设计，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉旁路、模态贡献分配以及「latent/视觉证据是否真正被使用」的判定问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Merit: Making every modality earn its contribution in multimodal attention decoding

**abstract/A1：** More than 1.5 billion people have hearing loss. When several people talk at once, hearing aids amplify every voice alike. Auditory attention decoding (AAD) aims to solve this by reading a listener's brain signals to find the attended talker, letting the device amplify only them. A real device will not see the brain alone; smart glasses and earbuds also track eyes, head, and scene. These behavioral signals help, as people often look at who they listen to. However, they show where a listener looks, not whom they hear. A decoder relying heavily on them fails when a listener cannot move their head or listens without looking - exactly when a brain-based device is needed. A multimodal decoder must use these signals without letting them replace the electroencephalogram (EEG). Accuracy alone cannot show whether it does. We present MERIT, a decoder and evaluation method asking: how much accuracy does each input earn? MERIT shuffles each input stream across test examples, measures the accuracy drop, and splits the result across streams using Shapley values. It also blocks two shortcuts: candidate audio is checked before training so it cannot reveal the answer, and the scoring function cannot beat chance if it ignores the brain. On a public dataset with EEG, eye tracking, head motion, and scene video, MERIT improves on the published benchmark, reaching 0.82 four-way accuracy within listeners and 0.74 on unseen listeners (chance is 0.25). The measurement reveals what accuracy hides: adding behavioral streams raises overall accuracy but almost halves the brain's share of it. On two other datasets, the same tests find a label imbalance in a widely used benchmark and flag results that accuracy alone would report as brain decoding.

</details>

### 100. [Executable Prefix Values for Locating Agent Failures](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17633v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17633

**作者：** Bingyu Shen、Jiaqi Tang、Lan Wei、Yi Sheng、J. Jenny Li、Boyang Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17633v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17633v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文检验 LLM agent 失败轨迹中人／LLM 判官标注的「首个错误」究竟指向原因还是症状：从重建的中间状态重启 agent，估计每步成功率（前缀价值 V(h\_t)）及失败的「不可逆点」，并在 SWE-bench Verified 的 150 个任务上比较按测量重启点与按判官标注重启的效果。

**相关性简评：** 其前缀价值曲线与重启验证提供了估计推理步骤因果贡献、定位决定性步骤的方法线索，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 步骤的贡献分配与停止决策；「判官标注不落在成功概率下降处」的发现也提示对 latent 轨迹监督信号的谨慎。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Executable Prefix Values for Locating Agent Failures

**abstract/A1：** Work on debugging LLM agents treats the "first mistake" marked by a human or LLM judge as ground truth for where a trajectory failed. We ask whether such labels point at causes or symptoms, and make the distinction executable: we restart the agent from reconstructed intermediate states of a failed trajectory and estimate its prefix value V(h\_t), the probability of success from each step, with a certified point of no return (PNR) for a failure. On 150 SWE-bench Verified tasks with two frozen open-weight agents, we build such curves for 47 and 60 failed trajectories and probe every step labeled by four frontier judges under the Traverse rubric. We find that the labels do not mark what a controller needs. Judges of different lineages agree on the exact step in only 21/57 cases, and the newest judges flag mistakes in 8/10 and 10/10 successful runs. For 66% of the labels, the agent's success probability does not drop at the labeled step; only 7/188 answers name the decisive step. Restarting at the measured restart point raises expected success from 0.44 to 0.57 offline, and real restarts confirm the advantage, whereas restarting at a judge's label does not (-0.08 to -0.03). We release our code, curves, and labels.

**comment/C1：** 46 pages, 12 figures, 60 tables

</details>

### 101. [Evidence-First Agentic Verification](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17724v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17724

**作者：** Reza Sanayei、Razvan-Gabriel Dumitru、Sunjie Hou、MohammadHossein Rezaei、Haris Riaz、Robert Vacareanu、Minglai Yang、Ying Liu、Mihai Surdeanu、Daniel Yue Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17724v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17724v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Sauron，一个「先取证后采信」的 agentic verifier：联合检查环境状态与执行轨迹，独立验证 claim 后才采信，用有界查询与相关标准的联合核查降低上下文开销，并为每条判定附可审计证据；在 2,586 条人工标注标准、故障注入套件和 TRAIL 上评估。

**相关性简评：** 其证据优先、逐条回溯来源的核查流程与可审计证据链，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、答案是否真正依赖 latent 内容的核验以及 RL 奖励的可靠性提供可借鉴的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Evidence-First Agentic Verification

**abstract/A1：** Long-horizon, semi-verifiable agentic tasks often rely on rubric-based evaluation, but the evidence needed to assess these tasks can be spread across the environment state and the execution trace. A judge may overlook this evidence or accept unsupported claims, including an agent's own reports of success. When rubric verdicts serve as reinforcement-learning rewards, such errors can reinforce undesirable behavior. We introduce Sauron, an evidence-first agentic verifier that investigates both state and trace and relies on a claim only after independently validating it against its source. Bounded queries and joint investigation of related criteria reduce context use and redundant work, and each verdict carries an auditable receipt of its supporting evidence. Across 2,586 human-labeled criteria from 100 personal-assistant episodes, Sauron achieves the highest F1 of five verifiers on all eight backbones tested while costing less than Gandalf, the strongest baseline. With GPT-5.6 Sol, it reaches 0.96 F1 versus Gandalf's 0.92 at 23% lower cost, with a wider margin on process criteria. On a paired fault-injection suite covering 13 families, several of which simulate reward hacking, Sauron detects 97% of injected failures while flagging only 2% of clean controls, outperforming baselines even when they are given the full trace. On TRAIL, a benchmark for detecting and localizing real agent errors, Sauron leads both Gandalf and TRAIL's own judge on all three quality metrics.

</details>

### 102. [Checking the Checkers: A Synthesis of Verifier Noise and Robustness in RLVR](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17824v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17824

**作者：** Savyasachi Gupta、Aniruddha Srinivas Joshi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17824v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17824v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 综述 58 项研究，梳理 RLVR 中规则检查器、单元测试与 LLM 评判等验证器的错误类型、对训练的影响及缓解手段，并整理对比表与报告协议。

**相关性简评：** 虽为纯文本 RLVR 综述，但其关于「错误结构比错误率更重要」、可被策略触发的假阳性导致plateau或塌缩的结论，可供核查 latent 推理训练中轨迹监督质量、奖励劫持与贡献分配问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Checking the Checkers: A Synthesis of Verifier Noise and Robustness in RLVR

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a principal recipe for improving the reasoning of large language models (LLMs). It rests on the assumption that the checker scoring each response is itself correct. In practice, rule-based checkers reject correct answers in unexpected formats, unit tests accept incorrect programs, and LLM judges can be led to approve empty or adversarial responses. This work surveys 58 studies that measure, analyze, or mitigate such verifier errors. We ask what errors verifiers make, how they affect training, which mitigations work against which errors, and how the findings extend to self-generated, rubric- and judge-based, and verifier-free rewards. The evidence suggests that the structure of an error matters more than its rate. Random errors mostly slow learning, though under a fixed budget or KL regularization they also lower final accuracy. False positives that the policy can learn to trigger can cause plateaus or collapse, sometimes even with a low initial error rate. Whether a verifier wrongly rejects or accepts depends on what it checks and who built it, not on its family. Its errors shift as the policy improves, and most mitigations have been tested against only one kind of error. We compile the findings into comparison tables, reconcile apparent conflicts in the literature, and propose a reporting protocol to make future results comparable.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at the International Conference on Artificial Intelligence Centric Systems, Services, and Applications (AISSA 2026)

</details>

### 103. [ECMR: Evidence-Aware Deliberation Control for Multi-Agent LLM Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17869v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17869

**作者：** Yuan Liu、Haoyue Peng、Fanliang Hu、Lei Huang、Wenli Cai

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.MA

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17869v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17869v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把多智能体 LLM 的固定审议流程诊断为「语义虚假共识」，提出证据感知控制器 ECMR：在冻结的角色化 LLM 上逐步汇总答案集中度、支持多样性与独立性、矛盾、角色行为、验证历史与剩余预算，据此选择提议、质疑、验证、仲裁、多样化、纠错或停止，并形式化为有限时域预算控制。

**相关性简评：** 其状态条件化控制、风险触发验证与停止/仲裁决策，可能为 LVR 的 THINK/LOOK/STOP 成本权衡、证据筛选与贡献分配提供可核查的控制器设计线索，但论文限于纯文本多智能体，迁移到视觉侧需自行验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ECMR: Evidence-Aware Deliberation Control for Multi-Agent LLM Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Multi-agent Large Language Model (LLM) systems typically commit to a deliberation protocol before inference. A fixed protocol cannot allocate computation differently to resolved and unresolved instances, and it may mistake repeated support for independent confirmation. We study this failure as semantic false consensus: a confident group answer supported by narrow, duplicated, or correlated rationales. We introduce ECMR, an evidence-aware controller over frozen role-conditioned LLMs. At each step, ECMR summarizes answer concentration, support diversity and independence, contradictions, role behavior, verification history, and remaining budget, then selects whether to propose, challenge, verify, arbitrate, diversify, correct a role, or stop. We formulate this decision as finite-horizon budgeted control and derive sufficient conditions under which state conditioning, risk-triggered verification, and role correction improve cost-adjusted utility. Across a declared held-out evaluation of 9,000 records from MedQA, CaseHOLD, and FinQA, ECMR-Full increases pooled accuracy from 62.1% to 84.9%, reduces false-consensus rate from 40.7% to 17.0%, and raises evidence-support rate from 58.0% to 88.7%. State shuffling loses 11.7 accuracy points with only 0.7 fewer rounds, while harder traces shift from early stopping toward arbitration. ECMR-Full uses the largest token budget, yielding the strongest absolute reliability rather than uniformly superior token efficiency.

**comment/C1：** 32 pages, including references and technical appendices

</details>

**内容简述：** 论文提出 LoopREG：在扩散 Transformer 中反复应用共享块，并用预训练视觉编码器对其表示施加对齐监督，从而在测试时增加循环访问次数仍能改善生成；在 ImageNet 256×256 上把 SiT-B/2 的 FID 从 15.08 降至 4.91，且效果可持续到 SiT-L/2 与 SiT-XL/2。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LoopREG: Representation Supervision Enables Test-Time Recurrent Depth in Diffusion Transformers

**abstract/A1：** Reusing Transformer blocks offers a way to increase diffusion-model computation at test time, but naive recurrence can degrade generation beyond its training depth. We introduce LoopREG, a representation-supervised recurrent diffusion Transformer that repeatedly applies a shared block at the state supervised by a pretrained visual encoder. Alignment is applied after the final recurrent visit during training; inference extends the same learned operator to additional visits. On ImageNet 256 x 256, LoopREG reduces SiT-B/2 FID from the local REG baseline's 15.08 to 4.91 at 400K training steps, a 67.41% reduction. Within a checkpoint trained with two visits, one extra inference visit improves FID from 14.71 to 5.34 with unchanged weights. The benefit persists on SiT-L/2 and SiT-XL/2. Controlled interventions show that useful recurrence follows the location of representation supervision, while REPA alignment produces a smaller extrapolation benefit. These results make representation-supervised recurrence a practical route to improving diffusion generation through additional inference depth.
