### 105. [PaceReasoner: Label-Free Learning to Answer Briefly from Long Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17900v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17900

**作者：** Changguo Jia、Zhiyou Xiao、Xinbei Ma、Geng Chen、Weiming Zhang、Yiming Xu、Tianqi Zhao、Minghui Zhou

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17900v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17900v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 PaceReasoner：一种无标签的测试时强化学习框架，用模型自身 LONG 模式的响应通过渐进式置信加权共识监督 SHORT 模式，并以行为奖励和模式比例控制器平衡长短两种推理模式，在多个模型与基准上提升短推理准确率。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本推理效率工作，不涉及视觉；但其用长轨迹共识做无标签监督、奖励驱动模式切换与比例控制的机制，可供核查是否能迁移到 VLM 推理中 STOP 决策、长短模式取舍与轨迹监督的设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PaceReasoner: Label-Free Learning to Answer Briefly from Long Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Extended chain-of-thought reasoning improves problem-solving performance but increases inference cost and latency, motivating more accurate answers with shorter reasoning. We introduce PaceReasoner, a label-free test-time reinforcement learning framework that uses a model's LONG responses to improve its SHORT-mode accuracy. Both modes share a trainable policy, creating a need for reliable supervision, sufficient SHORT training samples, and continued LONG responses to guide learning. PaceReasoner combines all-response and LONG-only answer consensus through progressive, confidence-weighted supervision. A behavior reward gradually shifts from encouraging SHORT exploration to rewarding agreement with LONG answers, while a ratio controller regulates the balance between modes. Across three model backbones and four benchmarks, PaceReasoner improves average SHORT accuracy over the baselines by 7.4--13.5 percentage points, with fewer than 25 reasoning tokens per response on average. Ablations support the key components, and cross-dataset results demonstrate transfer beyond the adaptation set.

</details>

### 106. [Match the Canvas, Not Just the Answer: Predictability-Aware SFT for Diffusion Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18001v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18001

**作者：** Miao Li、Hanyang Jiang、Hengyu Fu、Baihe Huang、Yating Liu、Yuhang Cai、Changkun Guan、Zhongzhu Chen、Jiecheng Lu、Michael A. Boateng、Pascal Van Hentenryck

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18001v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18001v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文分析扩散语言模型 SFT 中随机掩码与并行解码不一致造成的监督错位（掩盖错误、惩罚解码本可消解的不确定性、可见输入长度影响答案形式），提出 PACS：用模型自身可预测性选择注意力可见的输入长度，并在置信度引导的揭示时刻附近监督相应 token，在推理与代码基准上提升平均准确率。

**相关性简评：** 虽为纯文本 DLM 训练方法，但其「按模型可预测性分配可见上下文与监督时机」的线索可能为 LVR 中并行/扩散式推理状态的训练监督与动态计算分配提供借鉴，值得核查其掩码与长度选择是否可用于 latent 步骤的监督设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Match the Canvas, Not Just the Answer: Predictability-Aware SFT for Diffusion Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Diffusion language models (DLMs) enable flexible parallel generation by resolving tokens according to the model's evolving predictability rather than a fixed left-to-right order. This flexibility, however, introduces training choices absent from standard autoregressive teacher forcing: which reference tokens are visible when a target is supervised and how much generation space is allocated. Standard supervised fine-tuning (SFT) typically makes these choices through random masking, independently of inference. Our analysis shows how this training-inference mismatch can misdirect supervision. Random masking can conceal prediction errors or penalize uncertainty that decoding would otherwise resolve, while the attention-visible input length can change which response formulations the model favors, even when the underlying solution is unchanged. Motivated by these findings, we propose Predictability-Aware Canvas Selection and Supervision (PACS), an SFT method. PACS uses the model's own predictability to select each example's attention-visible input length and supervises reference tokens immediately before their confidence-guided revelation. Across reasoning and code-generation benchmarks, PACS consistently achieves the highest mean accuracy among the compared SFT methods, with gains of up to 12.84 percentage points over vanilla SFT on individual benchmarks. Code will be released upon publication.

</details>

### 107. [SHELDON: Reasoning through Dual Search over Hypothesis and Observation Spaces](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18025v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18025

**作者：** Harshit Joshi、Priyank Shethia、Monica S. Lam

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18025v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18025v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SHELDON，一种受假说-演绎法与科学发现双空间模型启发的测试时推理框架，把假说空间与观察空间分开表示并联合搜索，主动寻找当前假说无法解释的新观察以驱动新假说生成，在诊断、抽象推理与优化基准上取得提升。

**相关性简评：** 该工作对「证据获取」与「当前假说」的解耦与联合搜索，可供核查 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK 分离、视觉证据筛选与探索漂移等问题，但其为纯文本推理框架，与视觉状态表示无直接关联，迁移需谨慎。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SHELDON: Reasoning through Dual Search over Hypothesis and Observation Spaces

**abstract/A1：** Test-time scaling has enabled LLMs to solve increasingly complex reasoning, discovery, and optimization tasks. However, existing approaches often gather observations while seeking evidence for current hypotheses, then generate new hypotheses conditioned on those hypotheses and their associated evidence. This couples observation discovery to existing hypotheses, favoring local refinements over exploration of unknown hypotheses regions. Inspired by the hypothetico-deductive method (Hempel, 1945) and dual-space models of scientific discovery (Klahr &amp; Dunbar, 1988), we introduce SHELDON, a scientific reasoning harness that separately represents and jointly explores hypothesis and observation spaces. By actively seeking new observations along with new hypotheses, SHELDON can discover observations that its current hypotheses do not explain. These unexplained observations expose gaps in its understanding, motivate new investigations, and guide the generation of hypotheses beyond refinements of existing ones. Across diagnosis, abstract reasoning, and optimization benchmarks, SHELDON outperforms evaluated baselines by up to 26.7 points. Additional analysis shows that SHELDON generates up to 4.5x more novel solutions.

**comment/C1：** 16 pages main text, 34 total. Preprint

</details>

### 108. [Chain of Thought Monitoring Can Fail Even When CoT Is Necessary](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18105v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18105

**作者：** Lennart Bürger、Piotr Komorowski、Moritz Weckbecker、Evgenii Kortukov、Aakriti Jain、Sebastian Lapuschkin、Wojciech Samek

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18105v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18105v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把「CoT 对答案是否必要」细化为四级必要性层次，并在最低三层用干预实验测量 CoT 的可监控性，在困难医学诊断等任务上发现：即便 CoT 是必要的，仍存在关键属性（如患者性别、临床特征）影响答案却几乎不被表述的监控失败。

**相关性简评：** 其「必要性—可监控性」的干预式因果归因框架，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 推理状态是否真正因果地贡献答案、以及轨迹监督与贡献分配的可靠性；但该工作为纯文本设定，与视觉多模态推理的迁移线索仍需人工确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Chain of Thought Monitoring Can Fail Even When CoT Is Necessary

**abstract/A1：** Chain of Thought (CoT) monitoring is used by frontier labs to detect misbehaviour of AI systems. Yet, its reliability remains poorly understood. We attribute this to the lack of a successful organizing principle that leads to generalizable conclusions about monitoring reliability in different regimes. Recent work attributes monitoring failures to the CoT not being necessary for the answer, and argues that CoT becomes monitorable when it is necessary. We show that this binary necessary/not-necessary organizing principle is too coarse by demonstrating that monitoring failures persist even if the CoT is necessary for the answer. In response, we introduce a more fine-grained organizing principle based on a hierarchy of four CoT necessity levels. Building on this hierarchy, we develop a framework for measuring CoT monitorability at the three lowest levels via intervention experiments. We demonstrate monitoring failures at all three of these levels on realistic, hard prediction tasks. On a difficult medical-diagnosis task, patient sex and a clinical attribute influence the answer in at least 19% and 24% of correct responses with a necessary CoT, respectively, yet their influence is almost never articulated. These results show that even when CoT is necessary, it is not guaranteed to be monitorable.

</details>

### 109. [LoOPSD: On-Policy Self-Distillation with Looped Teachers](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18162v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18162

**作者：** Wei Fan、Qingyue Yang、Chao-Hong Tan、Qian Chen、Wen Wang、Xiangang Li、Kejiang Chen、Weiming Zhang、Nenghai Yu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18162v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18162v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 LoOPSD：在保持权重不变的前提下搜索层执行顺序（重复哪些层），构造出比学生更强的「循环教师」，再以学生在自生成前缀上的预测为对象做 on-policy 自蒸馏，并交替进行搜索与蒸馏、每轮由更新后的学生重建教师。在数学与逻辑推理任务上带来准确率提升，并报告多轮蒸馏继续增益。

**相关性简评：** 该文研究的是文本推理上的层执行搜索与自蒸馏，本身不涉及视觉或多模态；但「以重复层构造更强教师、把额外算力转成能力」的机制，可能为 LVR 中循环式潜在状态更新与训练期监督来源（如何把额外计算转化为可迁移状态）提供可核查的线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LoOPSD: On-Policy Self-Distillation with Looped Teachers

**abstract/A1：** On-policy self-distillation improves a model using guidance from the model itself, but it still requires a teacher that provides more useful predictions than the student. Existing approaches obtain such guidance by giving the teacher additional context or instructions. We ask whether it can instead come from changing how the same model uses its own layers. To address this, we introduce LoOPSD, which searches over a model's layer execution order to construct a stronger teacher and distills its advantage into the student. Specifically, we keep the model weights unchanged while searching for layers to repeat, and use the resulting teacher's predictions on student-generated prefixes to guide learning. We then alternate search and distillation, rebuilding the teacher from the updated student in each round so that the student progressively absorbs the gains from alternative layer execution. Experiments on mathematical and logical reasoning tasks show improvements across models. On GSM8K with a 400-token thinking budget, LoOPSD raises Qwen3-1.7B accuracy from 42.30% to 79.61%; subsequent distillation rounds yield further gains beyond the first round. Together, these findings show that by searching layer execution to construct teachers, we can turn a model's additional computation into improved student capabilities, opening a new avenue for self-distillation to derive supervision from the model's own computation.

**comment/C1：** Under Review

</details>

**title/T1：** A Few More Tokens Ahead: Reinforcing Parallelism in Diffusion LLMs

**abstract/A1：** Parallel generation is widely regarded as an inherent advantage of diffusion large language models. Yet our fixed-quota evaluation of four representative models reveals severe degradation across mathematics and code, with all scores below 15% at 16 tokens per step. Token-level probes identify local predictive potential near the observed prefix, especially in mathematical text. We propose RePara, which reinforces short consecutive token blocks through group-relative policy optimization and reduces rollout and log-probability recomputation costs. On LLaDA and SDAR, \\ours improves GSM8K and MATH-500 accuracy over JustGRPO under reduced denoising budgets, with a 1.96x training-step speedup in our LLaDA/MATH setup.

### 111. [Efficient Safety Guardrails through Latent Dual-Hypothesis Reasoning with On-Demand Trace Reconstruction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18304v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18304

**作者：** Md Asiful Islam、Fahmida Alam、Mihai Surdeanu

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 LR-Guard，将冻结教师模型对「安全/不安全」两种提示解读的分析蒸馏为紧凑 latent 表示，联合训练使这些表示同时支持安全分类与对教师显式推理轨迹的重建，从而在不需要逐步生成中间文本的情况下给出解释，并报告约 19.4 倍推理加速。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本护栏任务，不涉及视觉证据；但其「latent 表示联合预测与按需重建显式推理轨迹」的监督设计，可能为核查 LVR 中 latent 是否真正携带可用推理内容、以及 latent 相对显式推理的收益与成本提供方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Efficient Safety Guardrails through Latent Dual-Hypothesis Reasoning with On-Demand Trace Reconstruction

**abstract/A1：** Guardrail approaches that rely on reasoning-based large language models (LLM) improve safety decisions, but come with substantial inference overhead due to the explicit reasoning. We introduce LR-Guard (Latent Reasoning Guardrail), an efficient and explainable guardrail that jointly learns structured latent reasoning and on-demand reasoning reconstruction. Our method distills a frozen teacher's analysis of safe and unsafe prompt interpretations and their comparison into compact latent representations. Joint training optimizes these representations for both safety prediction and reconstruction of the teacher's explicit reasoning traces, enabling human-readable explanations without requiring intermediate text generation for every decision. Experiments show that LR-Guard outperforms its explicit-reasoning teacher in most in-domain and out-of-domain settings on safety classification and explanation extraction, while achieving a 19.4x inference speedup at batch size one. Further, reconstructed reasoning traces from the latent information exhibit high semantic similarity to the teacher's explicit reasoning.

</details>

### 112. [Multi-Stream Residual Computation in Diffusion Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18407v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18407

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该工作为 masked diffusion language model 引入多条跨深度持久的 residual stream 与自适应路由，在预训练重建任务上降低困惑度，并通过因果干预分析可见证据与掩码预测在路由上的分工。

**相关性简评：** 多流残差与角色条件路由为 latent 状态的多路读写、早期表示保留与证据累积提供方法线索，可供核查其在 VLM latent 推理信息坍缩与视觉证据筛选问题上的可迁移性；但原文为纯文本扩散模型，无多模态验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Multi-Stream Residual Computation in Diffusion Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Diffusion language models reconstruct masked tokens in parallel, offering an alternative to autoregressive generation. Yet their Transformer backbones typically carry visible evidence and evolving masked predictions through a single residual stream. We equip masked diffusion models with multiple residual streams that persist through depth and adaptive routing between them, then investigate how they support these complementary roles. On the pretraining task, two streams reduce reconstruction perplexity by 5.71% on validation data and 5.13% on average across external corpora compared with standard residual connections. We observe that, without predefined roles, visible and masked positions learn distinct routing patterns. Causal interventions show that this distinction organizes read and write routing, while token-specific write strength remains important within each role. Guided by these findings, a model trained with role-conditioned routing recovers half the validation gain from adding a second stream. State interventions explain the benefit of the additional stream: it preserves early token representations for later reuse while evidence accumulates at masked positions. This mechanism recurs at a larger model scale, showing how persistent streams support context preservation alongside prediction refinement.

**comment/C1：** 24 pages

</details>

### 113. [Order-Consistent Latent Geometry for Reliable Short-Horizon Planning in World Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18570v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18570

**作者：** Junlin Wu、Wen Fan、Dandan Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18570v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18570v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究世界模型中用终端欧氏潜距离对候选动作序列排序的可靠性，指出「路径上不出现次序反转」正是经典 self-approaching 条件，证明潜序列折线插值的锐角弯折会导致有限步候选次序反转，并以六分支实验（含零填充三维基线）验证该排序失效。

**相关性简评：** LVR 中也常用 latent 距离/相似度做候选筛选、假设比较或停止判断，该文提供的「无反转」几何兼容条件可供核查这类排序是否可靠，以及维度冗余对角度容量的影响；但原文面向世界模型短程规划，迁移到 VLM 推理只是可能线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Order-Consistent Latent Geometry for Reliable Short-Horizon Planning in World Models

**abstract/A1：** Latent planners often rank candidate action sequences by terminal Euclidean distance to a goal latent. Exact agreement with transition distance would make this score ideal, but is stronger than planning requires: along a transition-shortest rollout, the essential requirement is that latent distance does not reverse true transition progress. We show that this pathwise no-reversal requirement is precisely the classical self-approaching condition. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to identify self-approachingness as a planner-facing compatibility condition for terminal Euclidean latent planning and to connect its violation to an exact finite-horizon candidate-order reversal. Because visual world models predict discrete latent sequences, we analyze their polygonal interpolation. We prove that an acute bend creates a nonempty region in which terminal Euclidean distance ranks a transition-worse candidate ahead of one that makes genuine progress, even under exact rollouts. We further interpret latent dimension as angular capacity through a classical spherical-code bound. A controlled six-branch experiment, including a zero-padded three-dimensional baseline, validates the predicted ordering failure and separates angular arrangement from ambient dimensionality.

**comment/C1：** Accepted for poster presentation at STEAI 2026 (ECCV 2026 Workshop)

</details>

**相关性简评：** 其把「记忆可访问性—搜索分配—最终输出」分开审计的做法，以及匿名化配对、前设方向预测的设计，可能为核查 LVR 中 latent 内容是否被答案真正使用、视觉旁路与贡献分配提供方法线索，可供人工核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Auditing Future-Memory Use in Point-in-Time Language Agents

**abstract/A1：** Point-in-time (PIT) agents can recall post-cutoff facts even when their external evidence respects a historical cutoff. We examine whether this access predicts evidence gathering in 48 historical company-comparison tasks. Independent closed-book revenue probes identify the better-remembered company for each model on tasks with unequal recall, fixing the predicted direction before agent runs. We then compare paired runs with real or anonymized company identities while keeping external evidence PIT-valid. Both Qwen and DeepSeek recalled future facts, but neither supported the prespecified shift toward the better-remembered company. Qwen's four allocation estimates on 28 unequal-recall tasks were negative, with descriptive intervals spanning zero. A prospective DeepSeek replication showed an inverse pattern across all four metrics on 20 such tasks, with intervals below zero. These estimates remained negative after each company, pair, and future-fact omission, and all four post-hoc max-T-adjusted sign-flip p-values were below .05. In a prospectively specified follow-up, explicit future facts produced small estimated shifts away from the supplied-fact company, with intervals spanning zero, while final choices shifted toward it. The mechanism behind the natural inverse pattern remains unresolved. These findings support separate assessments of memory accessibility, search allocation, and final outputs alongside cutoff checks on external evidence.

**comment/C1：** 18 pages

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文重新检验 SDPO 与 OPSD 两种自我蒸馏方法（以特权信息为条件模仿自身预测），在代码、科学、工具调用与数学推理任务上发现其增益不能稳定泛化到未见问题，主要来自过拟合或已有推理行为的迁移，且自我蒸馏梯度与直接优化期望回报的策略梯度对齐很弱。

**相关性简评：** 其「特权信息是否真正被用于推理」的诊断与梯度—回报对齐分析，可供核查 LVR 中监督信号是否真正驱动 latent 内容参与答案、以及贡献分配方向是否有效，属可借鉴的训练与评价线索，但论文为纯文本推理，未涉及视觉状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Does self-distillation improve reasoning?

**abstract/A1：** Self-distillation is an emerging approach that trains a model to imitate its own predictions when conditioned on privileged information, such as correct answers or environmental feedback. Recent methods have reported better sample efficiency and generalization than reinforcement learning (RL), but it remains unclear whether these gains extend beyond in-distribution evaluations and whether they stem from privileged distillation. In this paper, we revisit two representative methods, Self-Distillation Policy Optimization (SDPO) and On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), across code, science, tool use, and math reasoning tasks. We find that their reported gains do not consistently generalize to unseen problems and are largely explained by overfitting or transferring existing reasoning behavior, rather than effectively using privileged information. Moreover, self-distillation gradients show weak alignment with policy gradients that directly optimize expected reward, questioning whether they provide an effective direction for policy improvement. Our experiments across Qwen3 models (1.7B-14B) and OLMo-3-7B suggest that effectively leveraging privileged information to improve reasoning remains an open challenge. Our code is available at https://github.com/sleepypandu/does-sd-improve-reasoning

**comment/C1：** 33 pages, 11 figures, 24 tables

</details>

### 116. [Can an Agent Learn to Predict Its Own Failure? Outcome-Grounded Confidence Calibration in LLM Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18614v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18614

**作者：** Ashutosh Hathidara

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18614v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18614v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究 LLM agent 能否用自报的每步置信度预测整段 episode 的最终成败，在 GRPO 下借助同一任务 rollout 组提供的成功标签与 proper scoring rule 校准该置信度，并在 ALFWorld、TextWorld、WebShop 上以离线与在线 RL 检验 AUROC、校准误差和选择性执行。

**相关性简评：** 「以最终结果校准逐步置信度」提供了一条把 episode 级标签回传到单步的训练线索，可能启发 LVR 中 STOP 决策与逐步贡献分配的监督方式，可供核查；但该工作为纯文本 agent、无视觉输入与 latent 推理状态，其可迁移性尚需判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Can an Agent Learn to Predict Its Own Failure? Outcome-Grounded Confidence Calibration in LLM Agents

**abstract/A1：** Controlling an acting LLM agent means deciding, at each step of a long-horizon task, whether to trust its next action, abstain, or hand off to a human. That decision needs a per-step confidence signal predicting whether the current rollout will eventually succeed. The agent's own self-reported verbalized confidence is the natural candidate, but existing reinforcement learning methods calibrate it against the correctness of a decision at the current step. We propose a method to calibrate it against the eventual outcome of a multi-step episode: under GRPO, the group of rollouts for a task supplies success labels, and a proper scoring rule scores each step's confidence against the realized outcome. In offline RL on recorded trajectories of a Qwen2.5-7B agent in ALFWorld, TextWorld, and WebShop environments, the AUROC of step confidence against episode outcome rises from near chance to 0.68-0.85, and the top-10% of steps the agent is most confident about succeed ~4.3x more often than average. In online RL on the live ALFWorld agent, four calibration rewards improve early-step AUROC, expected calibration error goes from 0.42 to below 0.12, and selective execution improves over both the untrained agent and a format-only RL control, without degrading task success. We also introduce an evaluation protocol that separates episode depth, task difficulty, and attempt-level foresight, which shows where the gain lies: the trained agent recognizes from its first step which tasks it will fail, while telling a succeeding attempt from a failing one at the same task is harder, with some early-window signal emerging on TextWorld.

</details>

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 VideoJev，把视频理解与交互建模为结构化决策任务：用共享打分头对时间区间与文本选项打分，替代自回归答案解码，统一时间定位与多选视频问答，并以 Cached 与 Joint 推理复用视觉计算、支持多查询单次前向。

**相关性简评：** 以打分头替代 AR 解码、并用缓存/联合推理复用视觉计算，可能为 LVR 中非自回归的推理状态生成与视觉状态缓存复用提供方法线索，可供核查；但原文未涉及 latent 状态的显式构造与使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** VideoJev: System One Model for Video Understanding and Interaction

**abstract/A1：** Visual agents must turn video observations into timely decisions to track progress and choose what to do next. Building on the emerging System One paradigm, we introduce VideoJev, a family of models that cast video understanding and interaction as structured decision tasks. We adapt pretrained multimodal large language models (MLLMs) by replacing autoregressive answer decoding with a shared head that scores temporal intervals and textual options against video evidence. These scores yield event spans or answer choices, unifying temporal grounding and multiple-choice video question answering. This combines the semantic flexibility of MLLMs with efficient decisions that agents can use directly. As an interaction unfolds, new goals and intermediate results prompt further queries about the same visual history. VideoJev therefore reuses visual computation through Cached inference for queries as they arrive and Joint inference for multiple queries in a single forward pass. Across three temporal grounding benchmarks, VideoJev-4B and VideoJev-35B-A3B improve mean mIoU over their backbones by 6.7 and 10.8 points, respectively, with measured inference speedups of $2.8$-$3.1\\times$. On four video QA benchmarks, both achieve performance comparable to their backbones in Thinking mode, with measured inference speedups exceeding $100\\times$. These results offer a unified, reusable decision interface for composing structured visual judgments into complex, open-ended workflows.

**comment/C1：** 23 pages. Project page: https://mcg-nju.github.io/VideoJev

</details>

**内容简述：** 该工作把递归 Transformer 中「深监督＋截断递归」的训练流程搬到消息传递网络上，用于数独、N 皇后与 SAT 等算法推理任务，得到参数极小的模型（约 16k 参数在 Sudoku-Extreme 上近 99% 准确率），并分析梯度截断代价与图上信息传递轮数的关系及零样本迁移到更大规模实例的表现。

**相关性简评：** 论文对循环深度、梯度截断与深监督的权衡，以及「鲁棒性 vs 尺寸迁移」的分析，可能为 LVR 中 loop 式 latent 状态更新、训练监督与长度泛化提供可核查的方法线索，需确认其结论能否迁移到多模态内部推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Tiny Recursive Message Passing

**abstract/A1：** Message passing neural networks have shown remarkable performance in algorithmic and constraint reasoning, due to their ability to encode the structure of the task directly in the architecture. Recent work has shown that better results can be achieved using recursive transformers trained with deep supervision and truncated recursions, which make extremely deep loops stable to train, and equipped with test-time procedures such as discrete deduction lattices. In this work, we apply the same procedures to message passing networks, and show that the two ingredients are complementary, and lead to parameter efficient models: we obtain about $99\\%$ test accuracy on Sudoku-Extreme with a model of $16$k parameters that trains in about $10$ minutes on an H100, or in $9$ hours on a CPU. We further show that the cost of truncating gradients grows with the number of rounds information needs to cross the graph, making the choice of wiring a trade-off between robustness to truncation and transfer across problem sizes. We conclude by showing that our models transfer zero-shot to larger instances than those seen during training, outperforming popular neural baselines on N-queens and Boolean satisfiability with a fraction of their parameters.

### 119. [ACED-Bench: Evaluating How LLM Agents Acquire and Act on Causal Evidence](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14381v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14381

**作者：** Yiwei Chen、Amila Weerasinghe、Siddharth Biswal、Utkrisht Rajkumar、Olcay Boz、Taylor Berg-Kirkpatrick、Rose Yu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14381v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14381v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ACED-Bench 神经符号基准，把自然语言科学场景与隐藏概率图模型的因果世界分离，用 180 个核心任务考察 LLM 智能体能否选择干预实验、利用有限证据做出因果决策，并以证据账本定位失败环节。

**相关性简评：** 其按「选错干预、丢失相关证据、证据已足仍继续」定位失败的方式，可能为 LVR 中 LOOK/STOP 的收益成本衡量与视觉证据筛选提供可借鉴的评测思路；但该工作为纯文本因果智能体任务、无视觉 latent 状态，具体迁移线索需进一步核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ACED-Bench: Evaluating How LLM Agents Acquire and Act on Causal Evidence

**abstract/A1：** Large language models are increasingly used as scientific assistants, yet we still lack reliable ways to evaluate whether they can investigate a system rather than merely answer a prompt. A useful evaluation must let agents choose experiments, interpret finite evidence, and make causal decisions, while keeping the environment coherent across repeated observations and interventions and preserving objective ground truth. We introduce ACED-BENCH (Active Causal Evidence and Decision Benchmark), a neuro-symbolic benchmark built around this requirement. The key idea is to separate the readable scientific surface from the formal causal world: LLMs generate natural-language scenarios and task text, while hidden probabilistic graphical models define the causal graph, data-generating process, intervention semantics, validation checks, and oracle answers. This yields scientific worlds that are natural for agents to investigate but exact enough for scalable, programmatic evaluation. The main leaderboard ACED-CORE contains 180 tasks: 60 set-valued causal ancestry/descendancy questions and 120 constrained causal-decision tasks. We also report ACED-QUAL, a 150-question yes/no qualification check using the same hidden-PGM interface. We evaluate seven contemporary LLMs and two earlier-generation models across three active agent designs. ACED-QUAL checks whether agents can use the interface to draw conclusions from evidence, while ACED-CORE tests whether they can decide what evidence to collect and when to commit to an answer. Evidence-ledger analysis localizes failures within the investigation: agents test the wrong intervention, lose relevant evidence, or continue after sufficient evidence has appeared. These results suggest that reliable AI co-scientists need explicit support for experiment design, evidence retention, answer commitment, and stopping.

</details>

### 120. [Certify the Decision, Not Every Score: Exact Top-k Selection from Few Evaluations](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14996v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14996

**作者：** Yuhe Sui、Yingzhi Tang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14996v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14996v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P1

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Certified Adaptive Selection（CAS）：对 Expected Shortfall 维护上下界，一旦剩余不确定性无法改变结果即停止并返回精确 top-k；在算法选择矩阵上验证预测引导的查询策略可接近事后最小评估次数，且预测只决定下一个评估对象、不参与结论授权。

**相关性简评：** 其「带证书的停止判定＋预测只决定采集、不授权决策＋事后最小证据量」框架，可能为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的收益与成本、证据何时充分、以及 latent 预测内容能否被信任为答案提供可核查的类比。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Certify the Decision, Not Every Score: Exact Top-k Selection from Few Evaluations

**abstract/A1：** Choosing a few robust algorithms or schedules can require evaluating every candidate under many adverse scenarios, even though an agent only needs to identify the winners. A predictor may suggest those winners, but cannot rule out a surprise in an unevaluated scenario. We introduce Certified Adaptive Selection (CAS), which returns the exact top-$k$ set as soon as remaining uncertainty cannot change it. CAS keeps guaranteed lower and upper bounds on Expected Shortfall (ES), the average loss in the worst scenarios. Its stopping test compares the worst admissible selected candidate with the best admissible excluded one; for information-disjoint Cartesian intervals this one-cut test is necessary and sufficient. Prediction has a separate role: selecting the next outcome to evaluate, never authorizing the decision. For empirical ES with exact unit-cost queries, we compute in polynomial time the fewest evaluations that could have proved the realized decision in hindsight. Our prediction-guided agent CAS-PG is exact for every predictor, including adversarial ones. On two public algorithm-selection matrices, CAS-PG certifies the exact top three after 630 of 3150 and 981 of 2200 replayed queries, or $1.14$ and $1.18$ times that hindsight minimum. Without historical outcomes, its transcript-only variant requires $1.28$ and $1.37$ times the minimum, outperforming the tested non-predictive certified policies. Separately, a prediction-free CAS policy avoids $93.0\\%$ of exact recourse solves in synthetic energy scheduling. One certificate thus supports several acquisition policies and separately proved risk/cost extensions: prediction changes the work, not the justified choice.

</details>

**相关性简评：** 其失败诊断（原生模型难以可靠感知事件，工具辅助可提升事件恢复但难以一致地解释和跟踪状态）可为 LVR 中证据获取（LOOK）的收益与成本、以及跨时间状态维持提供可核查的评测参照；但论文聚焦视频游戏域且不分析内部表示，与 latent 推理的直接关联需进一步核查。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Video-Arena: A Scalable Agentic Video Benchmark for Spatiotemporal Capability

**abstract/A1：** Understanding and tracking a dynamic world are fundamental to visual intelligence. Existing video benchmarks provide limited insight into whether models can maintain a coherent understanding of evolving world state. Building such a benchmark from real-world videos is challenging because the underlying world state is partially observable, making annotations hard to obtain. To close this gap, we introduce Video-Arena, a benchmark that turns competitive games into scalable, verifiable tests of how well models understand evolving world states from videos. Specifically, inspired by how humans understand dynamic events, we evaluate spatiotemporal world state understanding and tracking through three task categories: perceiving critical events, interpreting state updates, and tracking the resulting states. Our pipeline can generate videos and aligned reference labels from game records at scale. To keep evaluation affordable and reproducible, we curate a golden set of 180 tasks across 9 games and run evaluations under two protocols: native visual understanding and tool-assisted agentic analysis. The best-performing systems achieve F1 scores of and under the two protocols, respectively. The result highlights that native models struggle to perceive events reliably, while tool-assisted systems improve event recovery but still struggle to interpret state updates and track the resulting states consistently over time. Our project page is in https://videoarena-bench.github.io

### 122. [Metric-Driven Reinforcement Learning for Object Hallucination Reduction in LVLM-Based Image Captioning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14976v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14976

**作者：** Thanh Nguyen、Hee Suk Yoon、Tung Minh Luu、Eunseop Yoon、Chang D. Yoo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出一个完全由 NLP 指标驱动的强化学习框架来减少 LVLM 图像描述中的物体幻觉，设计 Object Consistency Score 同时刻画物体描述的正确性与覆盖率，并结合 KL 正则与冻结主干上的轻量 PPO adapter 微调，在 COCO 与 Visual Genome 上报告最高约 41% 与 29% 的幻觉下降。

**相关性简评：** 物体一致性奖励直接对应「答案是否正确使用视觉证据」这一主线问题，其 token 级 KL 密集监督、无人工标注的奖励设计与 adapter 训练方式可供核查如何抑制视觉旁路与信息坍缩；但工作不涉及 latent 推理状态，需读原文确认奖励是否真正约束了视觉信息的使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Metric-Driven Reinforcement Learning for Object Hallucination Reduction in LVLM-Based Image Captioning

**abstract/A1：** Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have excelled in joint visual and language understanding, particularly in image captioning. However, LVLMs remain prone to object hallucination, describing non-existent entities in the given image. Previous remedies, including dataset-enhanced supervised training and reinforcement learning from human feedback, show promise but rely heavily on costly human involvement, limiting scalability. To address this, we propose a reinforcement learning framework to mitigate object hallucination in LVLM-based image captioning, driven entirely by natural language processing (NLP) metrics. While optimizing reinforcement learning solely on NLP metrics offers scalability, it also introduces pitfalls: reward hacking, sparse feedback, and costly training. Our framework sidesteps these by introducing an Object Consistency Score (OCS) capturing both correctness and coverage of objects, incorporating KL-regularization for denser token-level guidance, and designing a lightweight PPO variant that fine-tunes adapters atop a frozen LVLM backbone, achieving efficiency and stability. Extensive experiments on the InstructBLIP baseline demonstrate the effectiveness and generalizability of our framework, achieving a substantial hallucination reduction of up to 41\\% on the COCO dataset and 29\\% on the Visual Genome. Furthermore, the framework can enhance caption quality by incorporating complementary evaluation metrics such as BERTScore and METEOR. These results reveal a broader insight in multimodal learning: LVLMs can effectively self-correct hallucinations using metric feedback, motivating deeper exploration into scalable reinforcement frameworks that significantly reduce human effort.

**comment/C1：** 20 pages, IEEE ACCESS 2026

</details>

### 123. [ClinEdge: An Expert-Graded Benchmark of Real Patient Edge Cases Where Frontier Multimodal Models Fail](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15239v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15239

**作者：** Anurag Sharma、Aditya Sharma、Sapna Baalwan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15239v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15239v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ClinEdge，用 32 例真实去标识化临床病例、224 条专家评分，评测七个前沿多模态系统在真实边缘病例上的表现，并归纳出 18 种反复出现的失败模式。

**相关性简评：** 其记录的多模态失败模式，如「读到图像第一个发现就停止」与「信任误导性病史而忽略正确影像」，与 LVR 关注的 LOOK/STOP 权衡及视觉证据旁路可能直接呼应，可作为推理失败诊断线索核查；但属临床领域基准，与 latent 状态机制无直接关联。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ClinEdge: An Expert-Graded Benchmark of Real Patient Edge Cases Where Frontier Multimodal Models Fail

**abstract/A1：** Most benchmarks for large language models in medicine are built from licensing examinations and theoretical questions. The few that draw on real clinical data do so only in part, and rarely require a model to read a patient's own imaging. ClinEdge addresses this gap with 32 real, de-identified patient cases from active clinical practice, each evaluated across seven frontier systems for a total of 224 expert-graded evaluations. Each case pairs primary imaging with a short vignette, contains a feature known to defeat pattern-matched reasoning, and is scored against the patient's documented clinical course. The suite is built for depth rather than volume. Grading followed a two-stage expert process. First, a senior orthopaedic surgeon graded all 224 responses on a weighted rubric and a pass-or-fail verdict. Second, a panel of nineteen physicians, largely senior specialists at teaching medical colleges, independently reviewed every case and every one of the 224 grades. All seven production systems were evaluated through their public interfaces, and all 224 conversations are preserved as replayable links. Performance was poor across all systems, and the failures were shared: different vendors missed the same findings and converged on the same wrong plans. From the experts' notes we catalogue 18 recurring failure modes in five families. The models stop reading an image at the first finding. They give generic plans and lean toward over-treatment. They trust a misleading history over correct imaging. Their answers vary across systems and runs, and change with question format. Failing answers were delivered fluently and without any expressed uncertainty. Four cases are released in full; the remaining 28 are held out, and we invite frontier AI labs and healthcare AI companies to evaluate their models against them (research@futrbridge.com)

**comment/C1：** 14 pages, 5 figures. 32 real, de-identified clinical cases; 224 expert-graded evaluations across seven frontier multimodal AI systems

</details>

### 124. [VL-DocIR: A Benchmark for Vision-Based Long Document Information Retrieval](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17057v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17057

**作者：** Simon Ott、Yufan Chen、Ruiping Liu、Junwei Zheng、Jiale Wei、Di Wen、Kunyu Peng、Jiaming Zhang、Rainer Stiefelhagen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17057v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17057v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 VL-DocIR，一个页级视觉长文档检索基准：由 29,641 篇 HTML 文档渲染出 388,548 张页面图像，含 271,760 条查询，覆盖单页、文档内多页与跨文档三类证据结构，并评测主流单向量/多向量视觉检索器及文档上下文打分、查询拆分、重排等诊断设置。

**相关性简评：** 其「证据完整」的多页与跨文档检索设定及失败模式分析（跨文档明显更难、文档上下文打分对文档内多页查询更有用），可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与跨页证据聚合的评价与成本，但论文聚焦检索排序，未涉及 latent 推理状态本身。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** VL-DocIR: A Benchmark for Vision-Based Long Document Information Retrieval

**abstract/A1：** Vision-based document retrieval has improved rapidly, but current evaluation settings still emphasize short documents and single relevant pages. This leaves an important gap between leaderboard performance and realistic long-document retrieval, where the evidence needed to answer a query may span multiple pages or even multiple documents. We present VL-DocIR, a page-level benchmark for evidence-complete visual long-document retrieval. VL-DocIR is built from 29,641 HTML-born documents rendered into 388,548 page images from Wikipedia, arXiv, PubMed, and SEC proxy statements. It contains 271,760 queries across 23 domains and six evidence structures, covering single-page, within-document multi-page, and cross-document evidence configurations. Evidence annotations are grounded to rendered pages and HTML element identifiers, and queries are filtered with a cleaning pipeline targeting clarity, correctness, closedness, and the absence of explicit layout references. We evaluate leading single-vector and multi-vector visual retrievers together with diagnostic retrieval settings such as document-context scoring, query splitting, reranking, and round-robin ensembles. The strongest evaluated configuration reaches 69.3 nDCGAll@10 and 80.6 RecallAll@10 under structure-balanced Macro evaluation, but source- and evidence-structure breakdowns show that cross-document retrieval remains substantially harder than single-page retrieval, and that document-context scoring is especially helpful for within-document multi-page queries. VL-DocIR exposes these failure modes and provides a more demanding target for visual long-document retrieval. The new dataset and code will be made publicly available at https://yufanchen96.github.io/VL-DocIR.

**comment/C1：** Accepted by NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 125. [Adaptive-Group Process Rewards for GUI Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17710v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17710

**作者：** Zirui Shang、Yang Liu、Xin Shu、Zhi Gao、Xinxiao Wu、Lifeng Fan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17710v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17710v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出自适应分组过程奖励框架，把 GUI 轨迹动态划分为语义连贯的子目标组，在动作级（依据视觉变化与组内后续动作）和组级（子目标完成度与整体贡献）估计过程奖励，并结合 GRPO 的结果优势训练 GUI agent。

**相关性简评：** 论文处理长程 GUI 轨迹中的证据定位与贡献分配，与 LVR 关心的「哪些视觉与上下文证据支持推理状态和停止决策」以及轨迹训练监督直接相关，可供核查其分组与组级上下文聚合能否类比 latent 状态的内容筛选与使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Adaptive-Group Process Rewards for GUI Agents

**abstract/A1：** Training graphical user interface (GUI) agents with reinforcement learning suffers from sparse outcome rewards, leading to inefficient learning. Process rewards offer a promising direction for credit assignment to intermediate actions; however, accurately evaluating an action requires identifying evidence across long-horizon GUI trajectories, as its value may depend on information beyond its immediate state and observation. In this paper, we propose an adaptive-group process reward framework that dynamically partitions a GUI trajectory into semantically coherent subgoal groups, enabling process reward estimation at both the action and group levels. At the action level, a critic evaluates each action based on the visual changes and subsequent actions within the group for action correctness and contribution to the subgoal. At the group level, the framework aggregates action-level evaluations to assess subgoal completion and contribution to the overall task, and further refines these assessments by leveraging the context of all groups in the trajectory. The process reward of each action is obtained by combining its action-level evaluation with the refined group-level evaluation. We further augment GRPO's outcome advantage with the proposed process rewards to provide finer-grained guidance for GUI agent training. Experiments on process reward benchmarks and downstream RL training demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

</details>

### 126. [Safety for Whom? Benchmarking Understanding Beyond Refusal in Egocentric Multimodal Assistants](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17728v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17728

**作者：** Yewon Han、Jisu Jeon、Suhyun Choi、Juan Yeo、Minsoo Jo、Gihoon Kim、Hyunggyu Lim、Taesup Kim

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.HC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17728v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17728v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 STOU 基准，包含 2,902 条第一视角视频-音频与视频-文本查询，按潜在受害对象（用户自身、在场他人、社会公众）区分危害，并将安全理解（识别用户意图、危害是否存在及其目标、后续后果）与拒绝行为解耦评分，据此评测 10 个开源与闭源多模态/全模态 LLM。

**相关性简评：** 其「拒答却不理解」「理解却仍协助」的诊断与多模态推理评价相关，可供核查 VLM 输出是否真正依赖视觉证据、理解与行为是否脱节，但未涉及 latent 状态生成或视觉细节保留，联系主要在评价层面。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Safety for Whom? Benchmarking Understanding Beyond Refusal in Egocentric Multimodal Assistants

**abstract/A1：** Egocentric multimodal assistants see through the user's eyes and guide what the user does next, so their outputs directly shape physical actions, including those that affect bystanders. Yet existing safety evaluations do not distinguish whom a response would harm, and score only whether a model refuses. Pooling all harms into one refusal rate hides two failures: a model may protect one target but not another, and it may refuse without understanding the risk, or understand it and comply anyway. We present STOU, a benchmark of 2,902 egocentric video-audio and video-text queries whose potential harm targets the user (Self), co-present individuals (The Others), or society at large (Others). Our evaluation decouples safety understanding from refusal behavior: beyond refusal, we score whether the model recognizes the user's intent, the presence and target of harm, and its downstream consequences. Across 10 open and closed source omnimodal and multimodal LLMs, we find that refusal varies systematically with the harm target, and that models often recognize a harm yet still assist with it. These results show that refusal rates alone cannot certify an assistant as safe, and that safety alignment must account for who would be harmed. Project page: https://onedayoneyeah.github.io/safety-for-whom

</details>

### 127. [MMTA: Benchmarking Multimodal Temporal Analysis with Time Series, Text, and Vision](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17856v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17856

**作者：** Ziyang Zhang、Shenyi Li、Yilin Wang、Ziyun Cui、Bowen Zhou、Wen Wu、Chao Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17856v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17856v1>)

**研究分类：** MAIN · 直接相关

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 MMTA——涵盖时间序列、文本与视觉三种模态的跨模态互补基准（九大领域、3,524 条测试样本，含分类与预测），评测八个 MLLM 后指出把时间序列写成文本会带来超长 token 序列并削弱与视觉证据的细粒度对齐，并提出带时间序列编码器与模态感知 token 布局的 TimeOmni-v。

**相关性简评：** 其对长视频下「视觉证据是否真正进入内部状态并细粒度对齐」的失败诊断与 LVR 的证据保留、LOOK 收益问题相关，时间位置对齐与模态感知布局设计可供核查是否能迁移到 latent 状态表示。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MMTA: Benchmarking Multimodal Temporal Analysis with Time Series, Text, and Vision

**abstract/A1：** Time-series analysis is increasingly studied in multimodal settings, yet most benchmarks pair temporal signals with text or with visualizations derived from the same signal. This leaves open whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can integrate time series with real-world visual evidence. We introduce MMTA (multimodal temporal analysis), a benchmark of tri-modal tasks with diverse cross-modal complementarity patterns among time series, text, and vision. MMTA spans nine domains -- robotics, autonomous driving, human action, manufacturing, AR assistance, healthcare, recommendation, finance, and climate -- under video+TS and image+TS layouts, with a 3,524-sample test split covering classification and forecasting. The benchmark standardizes heterogeneous real-world sources into a shared schema with domain-specific prompts, provenance documentation, and success-weighted metrics that penalize both wrong answers and failed generations. Evaluating eight open-source and proprietary MLLMs reveals a shared bottleneck: representing time series as text creates very long token sequences and weakens fine-grained alignment with visual evidence, especially in long-video settings. We then introduce TimeOmni-v, a multimodal LLM extension with a dedicated time-series encoder, temporal positional alignment, modality-aware token layout, and a forecasting head. TimeOmni-v improves long-video classification and time-series inference efficiency, showing that MMTA not only exposes representation and grounding failures but also motivates targeted model design.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets Track. Project page: https://windowso.github.io/MMTA/

</details>

### 128. [OmniCompass: A Holistic Benchmark for Omni-Modal Video Grounding and Understanding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18829v1>)

**作者：** Xuyang Liu、Shihao Wang、Xinyu Wei、Minghan Li、Zeqing Wang、Zuhao Yang、Zichen Wen、Lei Zhang

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18829v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18829v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 OmniCompass 全模态视频定位与理解基准，分 VL 与 AV 两条评测轨道，各含时序定位、空间定位和问答三类任务，每个实例在「纯文本」与「文本+图像」两种配对设置下评测 50 个 MLLM。

**相关性简评：** 同一目标在纯文本与文本+图像配对设置下的表现差异，可供核查模型是否真正使用视觉证据（视觉旁路、证据筛选），时序/空间定位对应「何时/何处」证据获取；但以视频理解评测为主，与 latent 状态生成无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** OmniCompass: A Holistic Benchmark for Omni-Modal Video Grounding and Understanding

**abstract/A1：** With the rapid development of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), evaluating their video understanding capabilities has become increasingly important. Existing video understanding benchmarks cover only part of the evaluation dimensions, limiting systematic diagnosis of omni-modal video understanding. We introduce OmniCompass, a holistic benchmark for omni-modal video grounding and understanding. OmniCompass defines two evaluation tracks: OmniCompass-VL assesses vision-language models on tasks requiring visual evidence, while OmniCompass-AV assesses omni-modal models on tasks requiring joint audio-visual evidence. Each track includes three complementary tasks: temporal grounding (TG), spatial grounding (SG), and question answering (QA), assessing when a referenced target appears, where it is, and what happens. QA covers five perception and three reasoning categories in OmniCompass-VL, and three perception and two reasoning categories in OmniCompass-AV. OmniCompass-VL contains 820 videos and 2,460 instances across domains and three duration types: short, medium, and long. A narrative- and audio-rich subset forms OmniCompass-AV with 240 videos and 720 instances. Each instance is evaluated under two paired settings: text-only and text+image, specifying the same target through text and visual-language guidance. All instances are manually annotated with multi-round quality verification. Evaluations of 50 MLLMs show that open-source models still lag behind proprietary counterparts, particularly in audio-visual understanding. Precise temporal and spatial grounding remains challenging even for leading models, and their predictions still exhibit inconsistencies across the paired target specifications.

**comment/C1：** Homepage: https://omnicompass.netlify.app/

### 129. [Plan-Bench: Can Existing VLMs Go Well Beyond Perception to Reason and Plan in Embodied Worlds?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18836v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Plan-Bench，围绕三个互补维度、16 个子类和 699 条样本，评测 VLM 在具身场景下的高层推理与多步规划能力，并刻意隔离动作执行的影响；对 28 个模型的测试显示最强模型仅 75.0% 准确率，模型规模总体带来提升。

**相关性简评：** 作为多模态推理诊断基准，其空间信息整合、时序状态推理与多步规划评测与「视觉证据是否被真正使用、何时停止并决策」的问题相关，可供核查其任务设计与指标能否用于评价 LVR 的推理—决策链条；但论文不涉及 latent 状态生成，联系主要在评测层面。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Plan-Bench: Can Existing VLMs Go Well Beyond Perception to Reason and Plan in Embodied Worlds?

**abstract/A1：** Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance in visual perception and spatial reasoning, leading to growing interest in using them as high-level planners for embodied AI. However, physical tasks require models to integrate spatial information, reason over temporal states, and generate multi-step plans under various constraints, raising the question of whether current VLMs can reliably support such reasoning and planning independently of execution. We introduce Plan-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating the high-level reasoning and multi-step planning capabilities of VLMs relevant to embodied worlds, while isolating the influence of action execution. It covers three complementary dimensions, spanning 16 subclasses and 699 curated samples. Extensive evaluation of 28 VLMs reveals room for improvement, with even the strongest model achieving only 75.0% accuracy. We further find that model scaling generally improves these capabilities. Ablation studies also indicate larger models show increasing potential as high-level planners. Overall, Plan-Bench provides a lightweight probe for evaluating VLMs' reasoning and planning capabilities relevant to embodied environments and assessing their potential as decision makers for physical tasks. Our benchmark and code are available at https://github.com/MinneFeng/Plan-Bench.

### 130. [Latent Algorithmic Structure Precedes Grokking: A Mechanistic Study of ReLU MLPs on Modular Arithmetic](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2603.23784v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2603.23784

**作者：** Anand Swaroop

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2603.23784v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2603.23784v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文用 DFT 提取 ReLU MLP 在模加法任务上的权重频率与相位，发现输入权重趋于近二值方波、输出权重满足相位和关系，并用按此参数重构的理想化 MLP 证明算法结构在记忆阶段已被大量编码，grokking 更像是对其逐步锐化而非新发现算法。

**相关性简评：** 其「结构先于泛化」的证据链与 DFT 提取加理想化重建的检验手段，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态是否在训练早期就已编码任务算法结构，以及把表示锐化与实际使用区分开的分析思路，属于方法层面的借鉴线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Latent Algorithmic Structure Precedes Grokking: A Mechanistic Study of ReLU MLPs on Modular Arithmetic

**abstract/A1：** Grokking-the phenomenon where validation accuracy of neural networks on modular addition of two integers rises long after training data has been memorized-has been characterized in previous works as producing sinusoidal input weight distributions in transformers and multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs). We find empirically that ReLU MLPs in our experimental setting instead learn near-binary square wave input weights, where intermediate-valued weights appear exclusively near sign-change boundaries, alongside output weight distributions whose dominant Fourier phases satisfy a phase-sum relation $φ\_{\\mathrm{out}} = φ\_a + φ\_b$; this relation holds even when the model is trained on noisy data and fails to grok. We extract the frequency and phase of each neuron's weights via DFT and construct an idealized MLP: Input weights are replaced by perfect binary square waves and output weights by cosines, both parametrized by the frequencies, phases, and amplitudes extracted from the dominant Fourier components of the real model weights. This idealized model achieves 95.5% accuracy when the frequencies and phases are extracted from the weights of a model trained on noisy data that itself achieves only 0.23% accuracy. This suggests that grokking does not discover the correct algorithm, but rather sharpens an algorithm substantially encoded during memorization, progressively binarizing the input weights into cleaner square waves and aligning the output weights, until generalization becomes possible.

**comment/C1：** 9 pages, 5 figures

</details>

### 131. [Selective Knowledge Control for Continual GUI Agent Learning over Application Streams](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06530v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2609.06530

**作者：** Zirui Shang、Xin Shu、Yang Liu、Zhi Gao、Xinxiao Wu、Lifeng Fan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06530v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.06530v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出激活条件的选择性知识控制方法：在多应用序列上持续训练 GUI agent，依据前向激活把 MLP 神经元分为承载特有知识与共享知识两类，分别截断梯度与正交投影梯度，并持续合并新识别的关键神经元，以缓解灾难性遗忘。

**相关性简评：** 按激活区分「共享/特有」知识并选择性截断或正交投影梯度的做法，可能为 LVR 中如何在更新 latent 推理状态时避免覆盖视觉证据与已学推理模式提供线索，可供核查其是否可迁移到推理状态训练。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Selective Knowledge Control for Continual GUI Agent Learning over Application Streams

**abstract/A1：** Continual learning is a crucial capability for Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents to adapt to evolving applications while retaining knowledge acquired from previous applications. Such application streams pose a challenging knowledge modeling problem: new applications often share underlying knowledge with past ones, yet also introduce specific knowledge that must not interfere with historical knowledge. In this paper, we propose activation-conditioned selective knowledge control, a lightweight method that achieves selective knowledge retention via neuron-level gradient manipulation. Our method maintains a compact historical knowledge state to protect highly activated MLP neurons that preserve previous knowledge. When a new application arrives, it performs real-time gradient surgery conditioned on forward activation. Concretely, the protected neurons are categorized into two types: unactivated neurons holding specific knowledge, whose gradients are truncated to prevent interference; and activated neurons holding shared knowledge, whose gradients are orthogonally projected to preserve stability while enabling adaptation. After each application stage, newly identified critical neurons are merged into the historical state for future learning. Empirical evaluations on multi-app sequential benchmark demonstrate that our method effectively mitigates catastrophic forgetting on prior applications while sustaining robust adaptation to new ones.

</details>

### 132. [Quasi-Binarized Autoencoders: An Architecture-Independent Information Bottleneck for Medical Image Anomaly Detection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09670v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.09670

**作者：** Shouhei Hanaoka、Takahiro Nakao、Atsushi Takamatsu、Takeharu Yoshikawa、Osamu Abe

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.09670v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.09670v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 quasi-binarizing（QB）层，将每个 latent 元素压缩到 \[0,1\] 并加入尺度为 1/ε 的 Laplace 噪声，使图像与重建之间的互信息上界只依赖 ε 与 QB 元素数量、与编解码器结构无关，并据此构建七层注意力 U-Net（QBAE）用于医学图像异常检测。

**相关性简评：** 其「架构无关的互信息上界」提供了量化 latent 信息容量、抑制恒等映射的具体方法线索，可能可供核查 LVR 中内部视觉状态保留与信息坍缩控制；但论文属医学图像异常检测，未涉及多模态推理，迁移仅为推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Quasi-Binarized Autoencoders: An Architecture-Independent Information Bottleneck for Medical Image Anomaly Detection

**abstract/A1：** Unsupervised anomaly detection, which learns only from normal images, is a central task in medical image analysis and remains an open problem. Reconstruction-based methods pass an image through an encoder-decoder network trained on normal data and detect anomalies from the residual between the image and its reconstruction. This works only if the information passed from the encoder to the decoder is limited; otherwise the network learns an identity mapping and reconstructs anomalies too. This limit is usually imposed through architectural choices, tuned per dataset, that cannot be stated in bits. We introduce the quasi-binarizing (QB) layer, which squashes each latent element into \[0, 1\] and adds Laplace noise of scale 1/epsilon. Each element is then epsilon-locally differentially private, and the mutual information between an image and its reconstruction is bounded by a quantity that depends only on epsilon and the number of QB elements, whatever the encoder and decoder. Placing a QB layer on every encoder-decoder path, including all skip connections, we build QBAE, a seven-level attention U-Net with 32,768 QB elements. On the seven datasets of the MedIAnomaly benchmark, QBAE with one architecture and one configuration reaches a mean image-level AUROC of 0.828, the highest among methods that do not adapt to each dataset, and the best reported results on BraTS2021 (AUROC 0.911, pixel-level AP 0.838). The noise is kept at test time, so that every reconstruction satisfies the bound. Without input corruption, the bottleneck alone prevents identity collapse (mean AUROC 0.805 vs. 0.590). Code is available at https://github.com/hanaokalog/MedIAnomalyQB.

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、q-bio.QM

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** MRFlow 把虚拟细胞扰动预测重构为单细胞群体间的条件传输问题：将对照与扰动细胞嵌入变分 latent 空间，用条件 flow matching 向量场把对照群体输运到扰动群体，该向量场分解为共享 latent 响应算子构成的对角字典与低秩条件修正，再加谱控制的残差场刻画非线性细胞级变异。

**相关性简评：** 其「latent 空间中由向量场生成并更新状态、共享算子与条件修正解耦」的做法，可能为 LVR 的推理状态生成与更新、共享与任务特定结构分配提供可核查线索，但属于单细胞生物学领域，迁移性需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MRFlow: Mechanism-Structured Residual Flow Matching for Virtual Cell Perturbation Prediction

**abstract/A1：** Predicting cellular responses to chemical and genetic perturbations is a central test for AI virtual cells, yet many single-cell models reduce each condition to an average expression shift. This target is misaligned with perturbation biology: rare states, resistant subpopulations, and context-dependent effect sizes may coexist under the same intervention. MRFlow treats virtual-cell prediction as conditional transport between empirical single-cell measures. Control and perturbed cells are embedded in a variational latent state space, greedy low-cost supervision is constructed over detached minibatch states, and a conditional flow-matching vector field transports control populations toward perturbed populations. The field decomposes into a mechanism-structured affine dictionary, which recombines shared latent response operators with a low-rank condition-specific correction, and a spectrally controlled residual field for nonlinear cell-level variation. Genetic perturbations are encoded through a regulatory-graph GCN, chemical perturbations through Morgan fingerprints, and both enter the same conditional dynamics interface. Across eight gene and drug perturbation benchmarks, MRFlow attains the highest composite score while preserving competitive raw performance on differential-expression and distributional metrics. The results support latent distribution transport as a principled and empirically effective formulation for perturbation-aware virtual cell modeling.

</details>

### 134. [DoSA: Dots Sparse Attention](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13990v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.13990

**作者：** Fanxu Meng、Taosong Fang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13990v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.13990v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 DoSA，用种子集下界与残差上界构造证书，使稀疏注意力的 Top-K 打分只在候选仍可能入选时才做完整计算，在保持精确选择的同时降低写作回与选择开销，并在 GPU 上实现。

**相关性简评：** 其「以界证书判断是否值得完整打分」的条件计算与精确筛选思路，可能可供核查 latent 推理中视觉证据／键值筛选与动态计算的成本问题；但论文面向纯文本 LLM 注意力加速，未涉及多模态状态或推理使用，联系属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DoSA: Dots Sparse Attention

**abstract/A1：** Sparse attention visits few keys, yet finding them can still require scoring every key with every indexer head. We introduce DoSA (Dots Sparse Attention), a lossless method for making this computation conditional while preserving exact token selection. Its central observation is that Top-K selection requires sufficient evidence to reject a candidate, not necessarily its full score. A seed set supplies a lower bound on the winning threshold. Nonnegative head projections and joint residual bounds upper-bound positive contributions, while activation-informed aggregation bounds the magnitude subtracted by negative heads. The certificate directs full scoring toward candidates that remain eligible; exact-score filtering further reduces writeback and selection work. We establish the certificate and its exact-selection conditions, and analyze how geometry and selection margins govern its effectiveness. Our GPU implementation accelerates the complete Indexer by up to 2.74 times over SGLang and 1.69 times over LiteTopK across English, Chinese, and code workloads. End-to-end evaluation on GLM-5.2 and DeepSeek-V3.2 achieves up to 1.94 times and 1.50 times time-to-first-token speedups over the two baselines, respectively.

</details>

### 135. [Predict Before You Modify: Learning Improvement Dynamics for Self-Evolving Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13991v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.13991

**作者：** Zixuan Xie、Chang Xu、Yuhua Jiang、Li Zhao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13991v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.13991v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出可编辑的「改进动态模型」（IDM）：在评估前预测某个修改的任务级结果并据此指导可选修订，评估后用观测到的结果继续训练 IDM，使预测知识跨代累积。基于 HyperAgents，在多语言编码、论文评审、机器人奖励设计、奥数评分四类任务上对比验证。

**相关性简评：** 其「先预测结果、再决定是否修改/评估」的可学习动态预测器，可能为 LVR 中是否继续 latent 计算与停止决策、以及轨迹训练里的监督与贡献分配提供方法线索，但领域差异较大，迁移可行性尚需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Predict Before You Modify: Learning Improvement Dynamics for Self-Evolving Agents

**abstract/A1：** Self-evolving agents improve through repeated cycles of modification and evaluation. However, existing methods receive feedback on modifications only after costly evaluations, and aggregate scores may obscure distinctions between failures that require different repairs. We introduce predictive self-evolution through an editable Improvement Dynamics Model (IDM). Before evaluation, the IDM predicts task-level outcomes of a proposed modification and guides an optional revision. After evaluation, past modifications and their observed outcomes are used to improve the IDM, allowing predictive knowledge to accumulate across generations. The system can thus improve how it solves tasks, proposes modifications, and predicts their effects. Building on HyperAgents, we evaluate this approach across multilingual coding, paper review, robotics reward design, and Olympiad-level mathematical grading. Our approach outperforms HyperAgents across all four domains, with up to 46% higher average performance over generations. Gains also persist under matched token budgets that include both agent evolution and task evaluation, and extend to held-out tasks. Forecast accuracy improves as the IDM evolves, and the learned predictive knowledge transfers to improve evolution in a new domain.

</details>

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** GameSmith 用 LLM 在固定模板内合成并校验大量二人零和游戏，先用大模型自博弈蒸馏、再用自博弈强化学习微调小型 LLM，其中 CRAB 通过位置的收缩期望回报估计为每个决策分配优势，从而提升通用推理基准成绩。

**相关性简评：** 其「逐决策信用分配」与自博弈轨迹训练，可能为 LVR 中推理轨迹的贡献分配与监督提供可核查的方法线索；但工作属纯文本游戏后训练，不涉及视觉状态或 latent 推理，迁移需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GameSmith: Scaling Zero-Sum Self-Play with Synthesised Games

**abstract/A1：** Post-training large language models (LLMs) on two-player zero-sum games provides a verifiable reward, and the gains have been shown to transfer to general reasoning. Existing pipelines, however, rely on a handful of hand-written games and on advantage estimators tied to them, so both the supply of games and the advantage estimate on a large corpus limit scaling. We present GameSmith, which scales both. An LLM synthesises games inside templates whose reward, observation, and hidden-information code is fixed. Each game is verified by seed-paired replay and by an independent re-implementation of its specification, then expanded into encoding, rule, and size variants, giving 26 new games in 29 families and 336 verified variants from the three SPIRAL templates. The model is distilled from the self-play of a larger teacher (Qwen3-32B) on these games and then trained by self-play reinforcement learning with CRAB, an advantage estimator that credits each decision against a shrinkage estimate of the expected return of its position and is defined on every variant. On Qwen3-4B-Base, distillation raises the 13-benchmark mean pass@1 from 45.5 to 62.5, above the three SPIRAL games at the same budget, and self-play with CRAB reaches 64.9. The ordering holds across models, and transfer grows with the number of game families.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SharedSAE，在 SDXL 的四个 U-Net 注意力块与全部 50 个去噪步上共享同一稀疏字典，用块级低秩输入适配器与时间条件模块对齐各块残差分布并吸收时间非平稳性，实现跨层跨步的概念定位与抑制，并观察到概念表示随去噪由最早下采样块向中后期块重新分布。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SharedSAE: a unified sparse dictionary across u-net blocks and denoising time for diffusion models

**abstract/A1：** Concept representations in diffusion models drift across network depth and denoising time, yet existing sparse autoencoders offer only per-block or per-timestep dictionaries, leaving no single feature dictionary for localization and intervention in the network. We present Shared Sparse Autoencoder (SharedSAE), which learns one sparse dictionary shared across four U-Net attention blocks and all 50 denoising steps of SDXL 1.0. A block-specific low-rank input adapter aligns the residual distribution of each block before the shared encoder, and a temporal conditioning module with a shared timestep branch and a block-timestep correction branch absorbs temporal non-stationarity. Despite spanning both axes, Shared SAE preserves a coherent dictionary structure. Built on the shared dictionary, localized feature suppression reduces the number of NudeNet-positive generations in the I2P detector-positive subset from 139 to 1. Tracing sparse features across the trajectory further reveals that concept representations are redistributed across U-Net blocks during generation, shifting from the earliest downsampling block toward intermediate and later blocks as denoising proceeds. SharedSAE thus provides a unified, interpretable, and intervention-ready representation space for diffusion models, enabling concept analysis and erasure at any covered block and denoising step.

</details>

**内容简述：** 论文提出 SemTree，将规则决策表示为语义决策树：节点是带 Yes/No/Unknown 判定的自然语言问题，由可插拔语义 judge 回答，分支结构按该 judge 实际给出的答案编译；执行路径即决策推理过程，支持节点级修复回放，纠正后的节点转为 judge 的训练标签，并用工具型 LLM 编辑器在观察执行结果后改问题与子树。

**相关性简评：** 节点级错误定位、回放修复与「纠正节点即标签」的监督闭环，可能为 LVR 中推理轨迹的贡献分配与训练监督提供可核查线索；按 judge 实际回答而非预设逻辑编译分支，也涉及推理结构是否需匹配真实执行器的问题，但论文并非视觉或多模态推理工作。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SemTree: Judge-Aware Semantic Decision Trees for Inspectable and Repairable Rule Decisions

**abstract/A1：** Rule decisions such as content moderation, advertising compliance, and eligibility checks combine several conditions, exemptions, and missing-information cases, and an error can be fixed only once the failing condition is known. We introduce SemTree, a framework that represents a rule decision as a semantic decision tree: each node is a natural-language question with explicit Yes/No/Unknown criteria, a pluggable semantic judge answers it, and the branching structure is compiled on the answers that this judge actually gives. The executed path is the reasoning behind every decision, so errors are repaired where they occur: a reviewer corrects a single node and replays the rule, corrected nodes become training labels for the judge, and a tool-using LLM editor revises questions and subtrees while observing execution results. On all 8,276 ShARC test cases, a tree executed by a hosted judge reaches 67.70% accuracy with 2.99 questions per case, on par with asking the same judge for the final label (68.23%); an earlier tree compiled for a different judge scores 47.87% when executed by this judge, while a new tree compiled on this judge's answers to a 12-question initial pool already scores 64.39%. Node-level repair raises BANKING77 accuracy from 82.04% to 86.16%, an explicit exemption node cuts the false positives of a Chinese e-commerce moderation clause from 24 to 5, and a trained editor raises the development accuracy of edited trees from 64.47% to 73.35%.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 VH-GPO：当 GRPO 组内全部轨迹失败、相对优势坍缩为零时，用冻结教师从学生到达的状态修复失败，再借助环境验证选取最早的交接点把控制权交回学生，使成功经验仍由学生生成；在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上提升成功率且额外 token 开销很小。

**相关性简评：** 其「何时把控制权交回学生」的验证式交接涉及轨迹训练中的贡献分配与监督问题，可能为 LVR 中教师辅助与 latent 状态的接管/停止时机提供可供核查的方法线索，但原文是纯文本智能体 RL，未触及视觉或多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** VH-GPO: Verified Handoff for LLM Agent Reinforcement Learning

**abstract/A1：** Group-relative reinforcement learning methods such as GRPO train large language model (LLM) agents by comparing rollouts for the same task. When every trajectory in a group fails with the same reward, relative advantages collapse toward zero, leaving no useful learning signal. A frozen teacher can recover from a student-visited state, but letting it complete the task makes the recovered suffix entirely teacher-generated. We ask: after repairing a student failure, when should control return to the student? We propose outcome-verified teacher-student handoff, instantiated in Verified Handoff for Group Policy Optimization (VH-GPO). The teacher provides enough support to reach a state from which the student can succeed, then returns control so that successful experience is again student-generated. Given an environment-verified teacher recovery, VH-GPO selects the earliest independently confirmed handoff point found within a bounded search budget. With Qwen2.5-1.5B, VH-GPO increases success rates over GRPO from 59.38% to 94.79% on ALFWorld and from 71.62% to 77.34% on WebShop. Improvements also hold with the 7B student, for which additional teacher and student output tokens amount to 1.77% and 2.61% of regular student rollout output tokens on ALFWorld and WebShop, respectively. Ablation studies demonstrate the effectiveness of the key components. These results support using verified teacher assistance to repair failures while reinforcing the student's ability to complete tasks independently.

</details>

**内容简述：** 提出跨域框架 CoEvoke，用受控扰动制造可恢复难点、以受限参考引导调查，在 4130 个软件工程与推理任务上采集 4567 条含检查—反馈—修复的可重构轨迹，并据此训练判断与验证模型。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CoEvoke: Evoking Multi-Agent Collaboration for Trajectory Collection

**abstract/A1：** Training multi-agent collaboration requires trajectories of checking, feedback, and repair, yet task-solving rollouts may end in immediate approval or repeat unsuccessful attempts without useful correction. We introduce CoEvoke, a cross-domain framework that evokes these interactions during trajectory collection. Controlled perturbations create recoverable difficulties, while restricted reference-based guidance directs investigation. The resulting dataset contains 4,567 reconstructable trajectories over 4,130 software-engineering and reasoning tasks, linking public interactions to evidence, decisions, and task-native outcomes. Separate experiments over 2,287 same-task pairs show feedback increases of 47.72-100 percentage points across seven perturbation groups; guidance has smaller, model-dependent effects. With identical training tasks, decision-record counts, and updates, perturbation-enriched judge training improves ACPBench-Hard success from 35.38% to 42.12% (+6.73 points). SWE verifier training gains 7.60-9.40 points over interface-matched untrained references. Workflow and post-training evaluations preserve task-solving topology with unperturbed inputs and no private-reference guidance. These results support designing collection conditions to obtain corrective supervision that improves collaborative decisions with frozen solving agents.

### 141. [Historical Anchors for Scientific Forecasting on Human-Aware Knowledge Graphs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14023v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14023

**作者：** Siu Tin Wu、Ryan C. Barron、Phoebe Upton Sanderbeck、Kim Ø. Rasmussen、George Tompkins、Maksim E. Eren

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14023v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14023v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Query–Anchor Agreement（QAA）这一不需未来标签或额外模型的诊断：比较模型为目标预测的候选与目标已知历史样例最相似候选之间的收敛程度，用以选择超图路径采样的预算，并据此重排科学连接预测结果。

**相关性简评：** 其无标签的收敛判据与「双视角共同支持才提升候选」的受限融合，可能可供核查 LVR 中何时停止扩展计算、如何在无监督信号下做证据筛选与 STOP 决策的问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Historical Anchors for Scientific Forecasting on Human-Aware Knowledge Graphs

**abstract/A1：** Predicting which scientific connections will form next can point researchers toward the most promising leads. One successful approach learns representations by sampling paths through publication networks, represented by a hypergraph, that connect scientific entities, concepts, and researchers, approximating how knowledge and expertise move through the literature. Sampled paths are then used to train an embedding model to forecast scientific connections such as a property of a material. Performance, however, depends strongly on how many paths are sampled: too little sampling yields incomplete representations, while further sampling can eventually weaken prediction quality. The best sampling budget is therefore often identifiable only after future discoveries are known. We introduce Query--Anchor Agreement (QAA), a diagnostic requiring no future labels or separately trained model. QAA can be used to select a sampling budget, and refine or re-rank the resulting forecast to improve forecasting scientific connections. QAA compares the candidates a model predicts for a target with those most similar to the target's known historical examples, and identifies when these two views converge. Across thermoelectric-material and COVID-19 drug-repurposing benchmarks, repeated random-seed runs, and three sampling policies, QAA-selected budgets fall on average 1.86 percentage points below hindsight-optimal selection for broad candidate recovery. Further, promoting candidates supported by both views, under a capped fusion that bounds the anchor contribution, improves broad recovery across all six benchmark-policy settings, which define the types of network walks used for sampling.

</details>
