### 142. [Contrastive Covariance Subspaces for Activation Steering](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14025v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14025

**作者：** Alexandros Xenos、Manos Plitsis、Niki Foteinopoulou、Yannis Panagakis、Ioannis Patras

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14025v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14025v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出免训练的 Contrastive Covariance Steering，用对比方差目标闭式求解低维子空间，将 steering 向量投影以压掉与目标概念纠缠的混淆方向，在多个 LLM 与 steering 领域上优于基线，并扩展到多轮对话。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 关心内部状态是否保留任务必要信息相关：该文从隐激活中分离「概念方向」与混淆方向的闭式子空间投影，可能可供核查用于区分推理相关 latent 与风格、视觉旁路等无关变化。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Contrastive Covariance Subspaces for Activation Steering

**abstract/A1：** Activation steering controls large language model behavior by adding a direction to hidden activations during inference. For steering to work well, that direction must be a pure signal for the target concept: any confound entangled with it, such as an incidental topic or writing style, is injected into the residual stream alongside the concept itself and degrades the generated text. We introduce Contrastive Covariance Steering (CCS), a training-free method that eliminates this confound variation. CCS projects steering vectors to a low-dimensional subspace obtained in closed form by solving a contrastive variance objective, which retains the directions along which the target concept varies while suppressing directions shared with the other classes. Across three LLMs and four steering domains, CCS consistently beats all baseline steering methods in all $12$ model-domain settings. The largest relative improvement occurs on AxBench and Emotion where we outperform the next strongest steering baseline by $48$ to $70\\%$ and $13$ to $27\\%$, respectively. Furthermore, CCS outperforms naive difference-of-means steering by up to $151\\%$, showcasing the importance of deconfounding concepts. A toy experiment verifies our motivation on why: planting a topic nuisance into the training data reduces unprojected steering by $46\\%$, whereas CCS loses only $12\\%$ and recovers most of the gap to an oracle that explicitly deletes the planted direction. A human study with $23$ raters on $296$ generations reproduces the LLM judge's ranking. Our extensive ablation verifies the importance of our method's components and robustness to the number of nuisance classes. Finally, we extend our method to multi-turn conversations, where CCS sustains both concept expression and fluency, matching system prompt performance as other steering methods drift.

</details>

### 143. [Pick the Mixture, Not the Samples: Combinatorial Data Selection for LLMs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14028v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14028

**作者：** Luyang Zhang、Jialu Wang、Bebei Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14028v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14028v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把 LLM 指令微调的数据选择形式化为组合数据选择（CDS），将样本归因打分与子集选择分离，并建模样本间的非加性交互，提出先决定各数据域取多少样本、再在域内按归因分数排序的两阶段算法 Mixture-then-Select。

**相关性简评：** 其「归因—选择」解耦与跨域互补、域内冗余的建模思路，可能为 LVR 训练中推理轨迹或监督样本的筛选与贡献分配提供可核查的方法线索，但论文本身不涉及多模态推理或推理期 latent 状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Pick the Mixture, Not the Samples: Combinatorial Data Selection for LLMs

**abstract/A1：** Data selection for LLM fine-tuning faces two facts about real training: data pools draw from many distinct domains, and evaluation spans diverse tasks. As a result, the same sample helps different tasks differently, and samples interact during training so that a subset's value is not the sum of its parts. Current data-selection methods leave these realities largely unaddressed. We formalize them as Combinatorial Data Selection (CDS), a framework that separates attribution (how samples are scored) from selection (which subset to pick) and models the non-additive interactions among samples. On a real instruction-tuning data pool, we find substantial cross-domain complementarity (joint utility exceeds the sum of singletons), alongside redundancy within domains. Inspired by this, we propose Mixture-then-Select, a two-stage algorithm that first decides how many samples to take from each domain, then ranks samples within each domain by attribution score. Theoretically, the gap to the optimal subset is linear in the selection size and independent of data pool size. Empirically, Mixture-then-Select outperforms strong baselines by 20 to 54%, is robust across attribution methods, and works across different models and data pool sizes. The framework also extends to the data purchasing problem under a budget constraint when sample prices vary. Our findings suggest that allocating selection across domains offers a promising path toward more efficient and effective data selection for modern LLMs.

</details>

### 144. [PLDiv: Measuring Dataset Diversity and Semantic Collapse via Persistence Landscapes](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14031v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14031

**作者：** Yang Ba、Michelle V. Mancenido、Rong Pan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CV、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14031v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14031v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 PLDiv，用 persistence landscapes 从数据的几何表示刻画结构多样性，将邻域随样本逐步连接而演化的过程汇总为可解释标量，无需任务监督，并在文本生成、图像嵌入、指令数据集与推理轨迹上评估其检测语义坍缩的能力。

**相关性简评：** 其以表示几何度量多样性并检测语义坍缩的思路，可能可供核查 latent 推理状态或推理轨迹是否出现信息坍缩与多样性退化，但论文不涉及 VLM 推理机制或 latent 生成，迁移可行性需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PLDiv: Measuring Dataset Diversity and Semantic Collapse via Persistence Landscapes

**abstract/A1：** Modern data pipelines increasingly combine human-created and human-curated data with AI-generated data for model training and evaluation. As datasets grow, they often add semantically redundant samples rather than expanding semantic coverage, which deteriorates the quality of the whole dataset. Existing diversity metrics primarily summarize lexical variation, entropy, or pairwise similarity, but provide limited characterization of the shape of the underlying data distribution. In this paper, we propose PLDiv, a diversity metric derived from persistence landscapes that quantifies the structural organization of a dataset from its geometric representation. PLDiv summarizes how data neighborhoods evolve as nearby samples progressively connect, producing an interpretable scalar measure of structural diversity without requiring task-specific supervision. Whether measuring intrinsic diversity in text generations or image embeddings, or detecting semantic collapse in instruction datasets and reasoning trajectories, PLDiv performs competitively against evaluated baselines and aligns strongly with diversity labels during semantic collapse. Consequently, it effectively supports applications in synthetic data monitoring, dataset construction, data augmentation, and generative model evaluation.

</details>

**相关性简评：** 对偶上界可充当搜索停止与结果验证的信号，结构化记忆与纯分数记忆的对比涉及状态表示，可能为 LVR 的 STOP 决策、搜索验证与 latent 状态/记忆设计提供可核查线索，但领域与视觉多模态推理相距较远。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Auditing LLM Program Search for Bermudan Stopping with Primal--Dual Certificates

**abstract/A1：** LLM program-search agents are usually judged by the score that drives their search. We study LLM-driven search over Python exercise policies for Bermudan options, an optimal stopping problem where a trusted evaluator owns the simulation and a dual upper bound~$U$. For any policy, $0 \\le V^\\star - L\_π\\le U - L\_π$; we report Monte Carlo estimates of both bounds with their sampling error. We audit 24 generation attempts from two pipelines, a six-pair feedback-representation ablation, and a holdout evaluated after selection was frozen. No selected generated program improves on Ridge LSMC consistently or by more than Monte Carlo uncertainty; holdout gap scores lie within $0.002$ of it. On six one-dimensional puts, a high-precision binomial reference places Ridge within Monte Carlo noise of optimal and attributes 99\\% of the estimated gap to dual-bound looseness, so this dual audits validity but cannot certify progress at the search's scale. Structured memory showed no benefit over score-only memory in this ablation. Whether search \`\`worked'' depends on reporting rules: retaining the initial reference, freezing selection before holdout, and counting failures.

### 146. [The Silent Failures in Agentic Data Science](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14115v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14115

**作者：** Xue Li、Hongqian Xia、Daniel Gomm、Aécio Santos、Cornelius Wolff、Madelon Hulsebos

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14115v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14115v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文主张对 agentic data science 的评估不应只看下游预测性能与代码正确性，进而在 220 个数据科学任务上大规模分析常见 agent 框架与模型的失败模式，构建可复用测试套件检验六类具体方法学失败，并与 Kaggle 优胜方案做定性对比，发现多数解至少含一种失败且数据泄漏与预测表现正相关。

**相关性简评：** 其「超出准确率」的评估立场与失败模式分类思路，可能为 LVR 评测中识别视觉旁路、答案未真正依赖视觉证据等「高分但方法错误」现象提供线索，可供核查其测试套件设计能否迁移到 latent 内容使用与贡献分配的诊断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The Silent Failures in Agentic Data Science

**abstract/A1：** Large language models have significantly lowered the barrier to writing code. Naturally, this has also led to the development of data science agents that promise automating the design and execution of data science from task formulation to model development. Existing evaluations of agentic data science (agentic DS) assess downstream predictive performance and code correctness, providing preliminary insight in agentic DS capabilities. We argue that these evaluations overlook the fundamental principles of data science: methodological data science- and domain knowledge. As such, only assessing downstream performance masks methodological failures such as data leakage and inappropriate validation, limiting the development of robust agentic DS systems. In this paper, we evaluate agentic DS beyond accuracy from three different angles: 1) a large-scale analysis of failure modes in common agentic DS frameworks and models across 220 data science tasks, 2) a reusable and extensible test suite with curated data science tasks that test for six specific failures in a controlled manner, and 3) a qualitative assessment of agentic DS pipelines against expert solutions on Kaggle competitions. We find that the majority of agentic solutions contain at least one failure mode despite the complexity of agentic harness or model capacity. Moreover, we identify a positive correlation between the occurrence of data leakage failures and predictive performance, confirming the necessity to evaluate agents beyond accuracy. Our qualitative analysis shows that DS agents generally lack problem solving creativity and domain knowledge, compared to competition-winning data scientists. We believe that principled failure mode analysis, as presented here, should be integral part of agentic DS evaluations, and that the insights we surface will be key in developing trustworthy agentic DS pipelines.

**comment/C1：** preprint

</details>

### 147. [Correction Training for Diffusion Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14136v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14136

**作者：** Donghoon Ahn、Runqian Wang、Alexei A. Efros、Taesung Park、Yash Belhe

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14136v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14136v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对扩散模型迭代采样中的 exposure bias 与误差累积，训练一个以基础模型预测为输入、以同一真值为目标的修正器，在每个去噪步迭代精修 clean-sample 预测，并可将精修结果蒸馏回基础模型以摊薄额外推理开销。

**相关性简评：** 其「对自身中间预测反复精修、再把额外迭代计算蒸馏回单次前向」的做法，可能与 LVR 中 latent 状态的迭代更新、误差累积以及推理计算摊销（loop 训练与蒸馏）相关，可供核查，但论文本身是图像生成任务。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Correction Training for Diffusion Models

**abstract/A1：** Iterative sampling in diffusion models can lead to error accumulation due to exposure bias. The denoiser is trained on real images interpolated with noise, but at inference its inputs are constructed from its own imperfect predictions from the earlier steps, something it has never seen at training time. This might be one reason diffusion models often struggle without additional help, such as CFG. We introduce a correction step for diffusion models which attempts to reduce this training-inference gap. The corrector takes the base model's prediction as input and is trained against the same ground-truth target. This makes correction an explicit learning task, with training inputs provided by the base model. During sampling, at each denoising step, we iteratively refine the denoiser's clean-sample prediction. This allows us to correct predictions at intermediate denoising steps, preventing early artifacts from persisting into the final sample. Although the corrector is trained only on predictions from the base denoiser, it can be applied repeatedly to its own outputs at inference for better results. This simple framework leads to substantial improvement in sample quality while largely preserving diversity. We evaluate our method across DiT, SiT, and JiT. Our method substantially improves upon previously reported FID scores for unguided generation and, notably, unconditional generation, where producing high-quality samples without guidance has been particularly challenging. Our method achieves performance competitive with classifier-free guidance (CFG), and combining correction with CFG further improves diversity and reduces oversaturation typical of CFG. Finally, we show that the additional inference cost of correction can be amortized by distilling the refined predictions back into the base diffusion model, retaining the quality gains without additional inference-time overhead.

**comment/C1：** Project page: https://sunovivid.github.io/correction-training/

</details>

**相关性简评：** 其密集过程奖励与检查点式评测可能为 LVR 中间 latent 状态的逐步评价、轨迹监督与停止决策提供可供核查的思路，但论文本身面向文本终端 agent，与视觉/多模态推理没有直接联系。

**title/T1：** Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench 2.0: Automating Diverse Task Construction and Measuring Sustained Agent Progress

**abstract/A1：** Long-horizon terminal benchmarks measure whether an agent can sustain progress through extended workflows with process rewards, not only whether its final state passes a binary check. We present Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench 2.0 (LHTB 2.0), an extension of Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench that preserves its 46 original tasks while correcting task and evaluation-infrastructure defects and extending 31 tasks. LHTB 2.0 contains 77 tasks across 13 domains and eight task types. The extended tasks are produced through a systematic reconstruction-task pipeline. We start from a working scientific or engineering artifact, then use a parameterized reference implementation to generate multiple scenarios, reveal six as behavioral evidence, hold out three for evaluation, and use dense progress ladders to reward partial progress while preventing memorization of public outputs. We also extend the evaluation horizon from 90 minutes to three hours and record verifier checkpoints every 30 minutes, enabling direct measurement of sustained progress within a run. Across 1,145 scored model-task runs from 15 frontier models, GPT-6-astra leads with dense mean reward 0.69 and 37 tasks at R at least 0.95, followed by GPT-5.6-sol with dense mean reward 0.67 and 32 tasks at the same threshold. On the 30 reconstruction tasks, binary verifier scores average 0.221, whereas dense ladder scores average 0.653, showing that outcome-only evaluation discards substantial intermediate progress. LHTB 2.0 provides a broader, hardened, and process-aware testbed for studying reliable agent execution over hours.

### 149. [TrajCFG: Token-Wise Classifier-Free Guidance via Denoising Trajectory Feedback](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14153v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14153

**作者：** Jingyu Liu、Hao Jiang、Yikang Ding、Huafeng Shi、Xu Yang、Xiaoqiang Liu、Guoxin Zhang、Pengfei Wan、Kun Gai

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14153v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14153v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出免训练的 TrajCFG：在 flow-matching 采样中依据引导速度方向的历史变化，为每个 latent token 分配有界且自适应的 CFG 强度。方法复用标准 CFG 预测、不增加模型调用，并通过消融与文本到视频、图像、音频视频、3D 等生成任务验证其有效性。

**相关性简评：** 其「按 token 依据轨迹历史反馈动态分配引导强度」的机制，可能与 LVR 中随推理步动态分配计算或引导、逐 token 更新状态的设计相通，可供核查；但论文面向生成采样而非多模态推理，联系需较多验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TrajCFG: Token-Wise Classifier-Free Guidance via Denoising Trajectory Feedback

**abstract/A1：** Classifier-free guidance (CFG) typically applies a shared scale to all latent tokens, although their velocity predictions evolve differently during sampling. We introduce Trajectory-Adaptive Classifier-Free Guidance (TrajCFG), a training-free method for flow-matching models that adapts token-wise guidance using historical changes in guided velocity direction. TrajCFG maps this feedback to bounded scales, assigning stronger guidance to larger directional changes and weaker guidance to more consistent directions. It combines adjacent-step and interval-normalized longer-span feedback, reusing standard CFG predictions without additional model evaluations. Controlled diagnostics and ablations examine the roles of directional feedback, token-wise allocation, and history-span fusion. Experiments on text-to-video, image-to-video, text-to-audio-video, text-to-image, and image-to-3D generation show improvements over base samplers across multiple backbones. For text-to-video generation, TrajCFG improves VBench Total scores by 0.30-0.75 points over the strongest evaluated baseline on each of three backbones. These results support historical directional feedback as a broadly applicable signal for fine-grained guidance allocation. The project page is available at https://jyliu-98.github.io/trajcfg-project-page/.

### 150. [Visualizing the World Model in an Agent's Value Function](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14186v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14186

**作者：** Shawheen Naderi、Fatemeh Akherati、Yubei Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该工作在 Crafter 环境中对 PPO 智能体的价值函数做反事实干预，即固定状态其余部分只改动单一变量，以此检验仅以奖励为目标训练的价值函数是否内含世界模型式的概念（如钻石可采集条件、水食对健康的影响、背包启发式）。

**相关性简评：** 其「固定状态其余维度、只做定向改动」的内部状态探测思路可供核查，可能用于诊断 VLM 的 latent 状态是否真正保留任务必需的视觉与实体关系信息，而非被视觉旁路绕过。但对象为 RL 价值函数而非多模态推理，需较多迁移验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Visualizing the World Model in an Agent's Value Function

**abstract/A1：** Could model-free reinforcement learning algorithms actually be learning a model of the environment? In this work, we apply counterfactual interventions which hold everything about a state fixed, besides a targeted change, to explore if the value function of a Proximal Policy Optimization agent forms a world model of the Crafter environment. Despite only being trained to optimize reward, we discover that the value function learns concepts such as the rules governing when a diamond is collectible, water and food having an impact on health, heuristics regarding inventory, and more. Finally, we discuss the safety implications of our visualizations and some shortcomings of current reinforcement learning agents that will prevent us from building truly advanced machine intelligence.

### 151. [Learnable Low-Rank Polynomial Sketch for Effective Linear Attention](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14219v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14219

**作者：** Zongyue Qin、Haoran Deng、Jason Cong、Yizhou Sun

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14219v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14219v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 LLoPS，用可学习的低秩多项式 sketch 近似多项式核，在理论上获得比既有方法更小的近似误差，并在多种基准上优于线性注意力基线。

**相关性简评：** 不直接研究多模态推理，但线性注意力的核近似与低秩状态压缩可能为长上下文 VLM 推理中的注意力结构与缓存/隐状态表示提供线索，可供核查其低秩 sketch 是否可用于压缩推理状态或视觉记忆。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learnable Low-Rank Polynomial Sketch for Effective Linear Attention

**abstract/A1：** Softmax attention in Transformers suffers from quadratic complexity in sequence length, making it impractical for long-context applications. Linear attention alleviates this issue by replacing the exponential kernel with alternative functions that enable linear-time computation. Among existing linear attention approaches, recent studies have shown that polynomial kernels are particularly effective, as they exhibit sparse and spiky behavior similar to softmax attention, which emphasizes large dot products while suppressing irrelevant interactions. However, the exact computation of high-degree polynomial kernels is infeasible for high-dimensional representations. As a result, prior work relies on approximate polynomial kernels. This introduces a non-negligible approximation error. In this paper, we show that, from the perspective of polynomial kernel approximation, existing linear attention methods are still suboptimal. We propose \\textbf{L}earnable \\textbf{Lo}w-Rank \\textbf{P}olynomial \\textbf{S}ketch (LLoPS), a principled and flexible framework for approximating polynomial kernels with linear attention. Our method learns a low-rank polynomial sketch that provably achieves a strictly smaller approximation error than existing approaches. Experiment results show that LLoPS achieves the highest performance across extensive benchmarks, comparing with various linear attention baselines.

**comment/C1：** Neurips 2026

</details>

### 152. [Do Artificial Neural Networks Need Dendritic Nanotubes? Two Reasons for Shrinking Importance Estimates in Continual Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14258v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14258

**作者：** Saurav K. Aryal

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.NE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14258v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14258v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究持续学习中基于正则化的参数重要性估计：受树突纳米管启发用随机横向连接扩散重要性标签，证明其等价于向层均值做线性收缩，并通过 EWC（样本量导致的方差效应）、SI、MAS（重要性度量的偏差）多组实验解释增益与失效条件。

**相关性简评：** 其关于有限样本重要性估计的收缩、方差与偏差分离分析，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态或视觉 token 的贡献分配与训练监督提供借备案线索，但原论文不涉及多模态推理，迁移可行性待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Do Artificial Neural Networks Need Dendritic Nanotubes? Two Reasons for Shrinking Importance Estimates in Continual Learning

**abstract/A1：** Regularization-based continual learning protects each parameter in proportion to an estimate of its importance, yet these estimates come from finite samples and heuristics and are used as if they were exact. We report four studies that start from a biologically inspired mechanism and end with a statistical explanation of it. Motivated by dendritic nanotubes, we let transient lateral links diffuse importance tags between hidden units. Links between co-active units gave no significant gain, but random links with lifetimes of 25 or 200 steps raised final accuracy on 20-task Permuted MNIST by 1.5 to 2.6 points. We show that random diffusion implements linear shrinkage of importance toward the layer mean in expectation. A simulation of the link process alone predicts shrinkage weights of 0.23 and 0.52 for these lifetimes, and graph-free shrinkage at 0.25 and 0.5 reproduces both the accuracy and the dispersion of the consolidated importance, while every activity-dependent rule did worse than random links. A five-seed screen across EWC, SI, and MAS found nominal gains for SI and MAS on Permuted MNIST and losses on task-incremental Split CIFAR-100, where forgetting was small and shrinkage cost plasticity. Varying the number of importance samples then separates two mechanisms on Permuted MNIST. For EWC, the gain fell by about ten points per tenfold increase in samples, from 19.6 points with 10 samples to -0.4 with 1000, a variance effect. For MAS, a gain of about one point persisted at 1000 samples, consistent with a bias in the importance measure rather than noise. Shrinkage had no detectable effect for MAS on a domain-incremental CIFAR-100 benchmark. Finally, we show that a standard heteroscedastic empirical Bayes rule shrinks the largest Fisher-type estimates most, which may explain its poor results, and point to a log-scale alternative.

**comment/C1：** Github: https://github.com/Saurav-K-Aryal/Do-Artificial-Neural-Networks-Need-Dendritic-Nanotubes-.git 21 pages, 3 figures, 10 tables. Simulation and figure scripts are included as ancillary files

</details>

### 153. [The RNN Homunculus: Learning to Gate Long-Term Memory](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14279v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14279

**作者：** Zeyu Fan、Alexandru-Dragos Manolache、Jan van Gemert

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14279v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14279v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文用受控的序列分类任务研究门控 RNN 的「门学习」问题，发现当全部训练样本都要求长程记忆时门控结构同样受梯度消失困扰，而加入短依赖样本可让模型学到能覆盖长程样本并跨类别泛化的解，学习良好时性能可持平或超过 Mamba、xLSTM。

**相关性简评：** 其门控循环状态的训练与数据设计线索，可能为 latent/loop 推理的状态更新、监督方式与长度泛化提供借鉴，但结论能否迁移到多模态 latent 推理尚需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The RNN Homunculus: Learning to Gate Long-Term Memory

**abstract/A1：** Learning long-range dependencies with recurrent neural networks (RNNs) is difficult because of the vanishing gradient problem. Gated recurrent neural networks like GRUs and LSTMs address this problem and are commonly explained by their ability to create additive copy paths through time. This explanation is correct, but incomplete: useful RNN gate values must themselves be learned, which is typically done with another RNN. We study this gate-learning problem through carefully controlled sequence classification tasks. Our analysis shows that gated architectures struggle when all training samples require long-range memory and thus equally suffer from the vanishing gradient problem. We intervene by adding short-dependency samples which let gated models learn solutions that capture long-dependency samples, but also generalize across different class labels. When properly learned, gated RNNs match or even exceed the test accuracy of modern architectures like Mamba and xLSTM. Overall, our results highlight gate learning as a central part of learning long-range memory and show how training data can support this process by exposing the same task over shorter dependencies.

**comment/C1：** 20 pages, including references and appendices

</details>

### 154. [GeoFix: Geometry Fixing for 4D Consistent Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14293v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14293

**作者：** Yeobin Hong、Hyojun Go、Dohun Lee、Jeongjae Lee、Sunghwan Hong、Federico Tombari、Zhaochong An、Jong Chul Ye、Konrad Schindler、Dominik Narnhofer

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14293v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14293v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 GeoFix，用单一的跨视角深度一致性奖励（适用于训练与推理期对齐）提升 4D 生成视频的几何一致性与视觉质量，并按相机视场重叠度校准该奖励以纠正「移动小被误判为几何更好」的偏差。

**相关性简评：** 其「奖励随观测重叠度系统性漂移、需按混淆变量校准」的做法，可能为 latent 相似度评价中深度、位置、缓存等结构性混淆的识别与校正提供可供核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GeoFix: Geometry Fixing for 4D Consistent Generation

**abstract/A1：** Video diffusion models increasingly serve as priors for 4D generation, but the generated videos often lack geometric consistency. Recent approaches address this through post-training by designing geometric rewards, yet this can degrade texture and fine detail, requiring auxiliary appearance rewards and careful reward balancing. To address this challenge, we propose GeoFix, a unified framework that improves geometric consistency and visual quality with a single geometric reward, applicable to both training and inference-time reward alignment. Our reward measures cross-view depth consistency in static scene regions, targeting structural inconsistencies without directly constraining appearance or penalizing valid object motion. Crucially, depth agreement increases with camera field-of-view overlap even in real videos and 4D datasets, allowing a smaller camera movement to be mistaken for better geometry. We account for this effect by calibrating the reward against the overlap-dependent trend. GeoFix achieves a 39% improvement in WorldScore 3D consistency and a 4% increase in VBench Quality Score.

**comment/C1：** Project Page: https://yeobinhong.github.io/GeoFix/

</details>

### 155. [ConicFlow: constrained Inference-time optimal control for flow matching models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14307v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14307

**作者：** Shervin Khalafi、Kasra Fallah、Sung Cho、Dongsheng Ding、James Anderson、Alejandro Ribeiro

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CV、cs.LG、eess.SY

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14307v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14307v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 把 flow matching 模型的约束采样在推理时形式化为最优控制问题，用滚动时域原始-对偶算法在短窗口内优化轨迹，平衡偏离预训练轨迹与奖励，并给出次优性边界与实验。

**相关性简评：** 其滚动时域控制、对偶乘子刻画约束难度、终端估计等做法，可能为 LVR 中受约束的 latent 轨迹生成与动态计算分配提供方法线索，需核查与原推理设定的匹配度。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ConicFlow: constrained Inference-time optimal control for flow matching models

**abstract/A1：** We propose ConicFlow, which frames constrained sampling from a flow matching model at inference time as an optimal control problem that balances deviation from the pretrained trajectory against reward, subject to hard terminal constraints. We discretize this problem and adapt receding-horizon control, optimizing only a short window of the trajectory at each step for computational tractability. We address the resulting sequence of receding-horizon subproblems with a receding-horizon primal-dual algorithm. Its dual multipliers capture the difficulty of satisfying each constraint and are refined throughout sampling, steering generation toward feasible final samples. We further propose a terminal-estimate variant that avoids accumulating local truncation errors by evaluating the reward and constraints at the predicted terminal point rather than at the end of the current horizon. Under standard regularity assumptions, we establish finite-horizon guarantees on suboptimality. Under convex-affine structure, we derive a sharper bound that scales linearly with omitted horizon length, and we show that the terminal-estimate variant is provably tighter when the flow dynamics change slowly. Experiments in both low- and high-dimensional settings with a recent large-scale flow matching model show that ConicFlow achieves high reward and strong constraint satisfaction while deviating less from the pretrained flow than recent baselines.

</details>

### 156. [MvFFN: Multi-view Floor plan Feed-forward Network for Unposed Wide-Baseline Panorama Layout Reconstruction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14315v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14315

**作者：** Yuguang Li、Yichuan Deng、Zixuan Liu、Ivaylo Boyadzhiev、Xiuyuan Wu、Xinyu Zou、Linda Shapiro、Alex Colburn

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14315v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14315v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对稀疏、无位姿、大基线全景图的户型重建，提出 MOIS（每张全景每个竖直列只预测自身及顺时针相邻两面墙）与 MvFFN（联合预测粗相机位姿、稠密几何与墙面语义），再用 Layout Chaining 后处理聚合出共享坐标的多房间户型图，并发布 ZInD-CrossView 数据集。

**相关性简评：** 其「严格局部预测 + 重叠预测确定性聚合，而非直接学习单一全局输出」的思路，可能为 LVR 中多视角 latent 状态的组合与跨视角一致性提供方法线索，可核查其聚合方式能否迁移到 latent 状态的跨视图融合。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MvFFN: Multi-view Floor plan Feed-forward Network for Unposed Wide-Baseline Panorama Layout Reconstruction

**abstract/A1：** Reconstructing accurate camera poses and floor-plan layouts from sparse, unposed, wide-baseline RGB panoramas remains a challenging open problem. Direct multi-room floor-plan prediction is especially difficult in this setting: pose, geometry, semantics, and global layout structure are tightly coupled, yet a complete floor-plan is hard to learn as a single global output. Our key insight is to keep the model's predictions strictly local. Multi-view Ordered Wall Instance Segmentation (MOIS) is designed around this concept. Each panorama column predicts only the wall it observes plus the next two adjacent walls in clockwise order. The global wall partition, room layouts, and shared coordinates emerge from deterministic aggregation of overlapping local predictions. Building on MOIS, we propose Multi-view floor-plan Feed-Forward Network (MvFFN), which jointly predicts coarse camera poses, dense global geometry, and per-wall semantic outputs. A downstream Layout Chaining (LC) post processing pipeline then assembles these predictions into multi-room floor-plans with shared global coordinates, consistent wall identities, and connected room structure. The dense MOIS predictions recover cross-view wall identity and local within-room connectivity more accurately than composed modular baselines, and the assembled layouts substantially outperform prior methods on wall and junction level accuracy. We also introduce the ZInD-CrossView dataset, which augments ZInD with globally unique wall instances and cross-view segmentation labels for this task.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 157. [EV-JEPA: Elastic V-JEPA for Any Device and Cross-Device Inference](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14324v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14324

**作者：** Anxhelo Diko、Jieyu Lin、Stefano Ambrogio、Ziyun Li、Mahmoud Assran、Théo Moutakanni、Barbara De Salvo、Chiao Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14324v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14324v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 EV-JEPA，通过 Transition-Aware Triplet Training 一次训练可调宽度的 V-JEPA，使其能在窄/宽配置及跨设备分片下运行，并扩展到弹性 token 压缩。

**相关性简评：** 其宽度弹性与混合切换点联合训练，可能可供核查为 LVR 中可变计算预算、动态状态长度与延迟—精度权衡的训练监督线索，但论文本身不涉及推理状态生成或视觉证据使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** EV-JEPA: Elastic V-JEPA for Any Device and Cross-Device Inference

**abstract/A1：** Foundation models like V-JEPA are increasingly deployed across a heterogeneous edge-cloud continuum spanning smart glasses, phones, robots, and servers. Yet, they are typically trained as rigid, fixed-capacity networks bound to one device, supporting neither reconfigurable compute budgets nor collaborative execution. Existing approaches address only one axis at a time: slimmable and NAS-based methods provide width elasticity but assume single-device inference, whereas split-computing methods enable cross-device collaboration only for fixed partitions and static capacities. We introduce Elastic V-JEPA (EV-JEPA), a single model trained once and deployable everywhere along the continuum. Its width is reconfigurable, and it is natively partitionable across heterogeneous devices. At its core is Transition-Aware Triplet Training (T3). At each step we pick a narrow and a wide width, and train three paths: each width alone, plus a hybrid path that runs the early layers narrow and the rest wide. The hybrid switch point is where one device hands off to another, so the same weights learn both single-device and cross-device execution. Across various benchmarks, EV-JEPA falls within 1 accuracy point of independently trained baselines while improving over previous elastic training approaches by up to 11 accuracy points. Narrow-to-wide cross-device hybrid execution recovers to within 1.1 points of the highest-capacity standalone model and supports many-to-one, any-to-any, and variable-split configurations. Finally, we show that the elastic principle extends beyond the backbone to an elastic token compression mechanism that exposes controllable trade-offs among on-device computation, latency, and accuracy.

</details>

### 158. [TraceSampler: Making Sampling Errors Predictable and Correctable for Accelerated Generative Sampling](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14332v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14332

**作者：** George Matthew、Guoqiang Zhang、Kenta Niwa

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14332v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14332v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** TraceSampler 是一种后训练方法，用于加速扩散/Rectified Flow 等连续时间生成模型的低步采样：把端点误差建模为样本相关的预测问题，用高阶参考积分作监督，将高维误差分解为共享残差结构、轨迹导出方向与低秩余项，并由浅层 MLP 头预测系数，经两阶段残差修正（中间评估结果被下一步复用）降低误差。

**相关性简评：** 原文「从采样轨迹预测高维误差、分解为共享/轨迹方向/低秩余项并做两阶段修正」的思路，可能可供核查 latent 推理循环中的状态漂移预测、残差修正与中间评估复用；但该文面向图像生成采样而非视觉推理，迁移性属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TraceSampler: Making Sampling Errors Predictable and Correctable for Accelerated Generative Sampling

**abstract/A1：** Accurate sampling from continuous-time generative models can require many model evaluations. Low-step sampling reduces cost, but coarse updates introduce endpoint errors that can accumulate and degrade generation quality. We introduce TraceSampler, a post-training method that corrects these errors without modifying the pretrained model. Rather than optimising low-step updates directly, TraceSampler models endpoint error as a sample-specific prediction problem. A higher-step reference integration over the same interval provides the supervised target, while a compact representation makes high-dimensional error predictable from the sampling trace. This representation combines shared residual structure, trace-derived directions, and a low-rank remainder, so shallow per-step MLP heads predict sample-dependent coefficients. These coefficients drive a two-stage learned residual correction: the first stage predicts the full endpoint residual, while an intermediate backbone evaluation provides new trace information to predict the remaining residual; this evaluation is reused by the following step. TraceSampler is evaluated with Rectified Flow on CIFAR-10, SiT-XL/2 on ImageNet-256, and SD3.5 Medium for text-to-image generation. At 10 steps, it reduces trajectory MSE relative to matched-step Euler by 90.5% on CIFAR-10 and 85.6% on ImageNet-256, while achieving FID scores of 2.692 and 2.189, close to 120-step Heun references of 2.601 and 2.056 with 24$\\times$ fewer backbone evaluations. On SD3.5 Medium, TraceSampler improves image quality and prompt following; at 10 steps, ImageReward rises from 0.752 to 0.906 while trajectory MSE falls by 70.7%. These gains preserve Euler's backbone-evaluation budget, add less than 0.4% inference FLOPs, and incur negligible wall-clock overhead, showing that coarse-step sampling error can be made predictable from the sampling trace and efficiently corrected.

</details>

### 159. [Which Metadata Matters for LLM Tool Selection in MCP? Evidence from Controlled Factor-Level Interventions](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14334v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14334

**作者：** Xiaofan Li、Fengchun Qiao、Xing Gao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.SE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14334v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14334v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究 MCP 场景下工具元数据（服务器名、工具名、描述、参数 schema）如何影响 LLM 的工具选择：先对 36 万余个工具做元数据统计，再用跨 5 个模型、5 类任务的单因素受控干预结合条件 logistic 回归估计效应，发现参数 schema 引起的选择偏移最大且最稳定，模型偏好分离的顶层参数，描述解释参数也有增益，而名称效应较弱。

**相关性简评：** 「每次只改一个元数据因子 + 位置平衡 + 回归估计」的受控干预范式，可能可供核查用于归因 VLM/LVR 中哪类输入因素（如证据形式、位置、格式）真正驱动模型决策，并检验位置偏置。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Which Metadata Matters for LLM Tool Selection in MCP? Evidence from Controlled Factor-Level Interventions

**abstract/A1：** In Model Context Protocol (MCP) systems, LLMs select tools from metadata rather than from their implementations. Names and descriptions summarize what a tool does, while the parameter schema specifies the fields a tool accepts and how they are organized. Our analysis of metadata for 367,174 MCP tools reveals substantial schema variation among functionally similar tools. Many of these tools share names and similar descriptions but expose different parameter schemas. This raises a key question: can parameter-schema differences influence tool selection before any call is made? We study this question through controlled metadata interventions across five LLMs and five tasks. Each comparison changes exactly one metadata factor (server name, tool name, description, or parameter schema) while keeping the others fixed. We balance tool positions and use conditional logistic regression to estimate position-adjusted effects. We find that: (1) parameter-schema changes produce the largest and most consistent selection shifts among the tested interventions. Models tend to favor separate top-level parameters over grouped or composite forms. (2) Descriptions that explain parameters also tend to increase selection, while name effects are weaker and less consistent. (3) Targeted comparisons show that schema effects depend on the specific parameter names and on how the request represents the same information. When only one schema satisfies an explicit request requirement, all five models select the compatible tool despite position preferences. These results show that parameter schemas influence not only how tools are called, but also whether they are selected. For MCP developers and evaluators, schema design and tool ordering can therefore affect which implementation is invoked even when functionality is unchanged.

</details>

### 160. [Continuous-Time Cloth Dynamics with Physics-Informed Neural ODEs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14342v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14342

**作者：** Yingdong Ru、Lipeng Zhuang、Zhuo He、Gerardo Aragon Camarasa

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14342v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14342v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ContinuousCloth：以弹簧-质点 ODE 作为物理约束嵌入神经轨迹模型，实现连续时间布料动力学求解，支持任意时间戳查询并用自动微分得到位移、速度与加速度；评估涵盖纯物理设定的精度与加速，以及在稀疏噪声观测下的插值与参数估计。

**相关性简评：** 其连续时间 neural ODE 的隐状态演化与以物理方程充当归纳偏置的训练方式，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的连续更新、以及噪声观测下的监督与一致性约束提供可核查的方法线索，但论文属物理仿真领域，与 VLM 推理无直接关联。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Continuous-Time Cloth Dynamics with Physics-Informed Neural ODEs

**abstract/A1：** We present ContinuousCloth, a continuous-time, physics-informed neural solver for deformable cloth dynamics that enforces a spring--mass ODE within a neural trajectory model. Unlike classical time-stepping simulators that return trajectories only on a discrete integration grid, ContinuousCloth supports querying at arbitrary timestamps and computing displacement, velocity, and acceleration via automatic differentiation. We evaluate ContinuousCloth along two dimensions. In a physics-only setting, ContinuousCloth achieves trajectory accuracy comparable to high-precision solvers across six diverse boundary-condition scenarios while reducing runtime by up to 17.4 times. When fused with sparse and noisy observations, the spring--mass ODE acts as a strong inductive bias for downstream tasks: interpolation and parameter estimation. That is, ContinuousCloth reduces interpolation error by 7.3 times over a data-only neural baseline in simulation and 2.4 times on real-world cloth sequences, and achieves 2.6 times lower parameter error than a differentiable-solver baseline under high-noise conditions, demonstrating consistent robustness under realistic measurement imperfections.

</details>

### 161. [On the Depth Transfer of Neural Optimizers via L-Smoothness](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14344v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14344

**作者：** Maximilian Wong、Chenyu Xu、Jiajin Li、Yiping Lu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、math.OC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14344v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14344v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文在 L-smoothness 框架下把超参深度迁移归结为损失的 Lipschitz 与光滑常数如何随深度 K 变化，证明逆深度残差分支缩放 α=Θ(1/K) 可使两常数与深度无关，并给出 AdamW、Muon、MOGA 的学习率设定，在 GPT-2（深度 2–128）与 CIFAR-100 ResNet 上验证学习率迁移。

**相关性简评：** 逆深度残差缩放与「深度无关的光滑常数」这一结论，可能为 loop/latent 循环推理模型在迭代深度变化时的残差缩放与学习率选择提供训练线索，可供核查其是否适用于推理期状态更新的循环结构。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** On the Depth Transfer of Neural Optimizers via L-Smoothness

**abstract/A1：** Scaling deep learning models efficiently requires predictable performance transfer across compute regimes. Establishing reliable hyperparameter transfer allows optimal training dynamics and structural choices to be discovered on low-cost proxy models, avoiding catastrophic failures during massive-scale training. Existing depth-transfer analyses are architecture-specific and heuristic: hyperparameter transfer is only justified through toy blocks, and both rely on infinite-depth dynamics, a specific initialization, and feature-learning criteria. Building on $L$-smoothness framework of Xu et al. (2026), we understand hyperparameter transfer as how do the Lipschitz and $L$-smoothness constants of the loss scale with the depth $K$? We show that inverse-depth residual branch scaling $α=Θ(1/K)$ is sufficient to make both constants depth-independent at fixed width, uniformly over the bounded parameter domain and for arbitrary $p\\to q$ geometries. Because the bounds depend on each residual branch only through its Lipschitz and smoothness constants, the argument applies to general residual networks (including branches of block depth $\\geq 2$ such as transformer and ResNet blocks) without assumptions on initialization or correlations between layer weights. Since the smoothness constant controls the curvature penalty in the descent inequality, our bounds motivate a learning-rate scale without an additional depth-dependent curvature correction for updates bounded in the prescribed norm. This provides a geometric explanation of inverse-depth residual scaling and its application to the operator-norm geometries associated with AdamW, Muon, and MOGA. Learning-rate sweeps on GPT-2 (depths 2--128) and CIFAR-100 ResNets (8--32 residual blocks) confirm that Muon and MOGA exhibit stable learning-rate transfer under these prescriptions, with a common optimal rate across a 64-fold increase in depth.

</details>

### 162. [Learning Transferable World-Action Models from Task-Paired Human Videos](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14351v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14351

**作者：** Jeongeun Park、Taekyung Kim、Dongyoon Han、Sangdoo Yun

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14351v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14351v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 WATCH，一种跨视频预训练方式：以多样环境中成对的人类演示为数据，在给定一个演示的视频与动作条件下，联合预测另一演示的动作与未来帧，从而学到可跨场景和本体迁移的任务相关交互，并在机器人后训练中提升上下文成功率。

**相关性简评：** 原文明确指出视频内下一帧预测会让模型依赖上下文与未来共有的外观而非可迁移交互，其跨视频配对预测目标可能为抑制 LVR 中的视觉旁路与信息坍缩、约束 latent 状态保留任务必要内容提供训练期线索，属机器人领域，需核查其表示分析是否可迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning Transferable World-Action Models from Task-Paired Human Videos

**abstract/A1：** World-action models inherit broad visual and physical priors from video pre-training. However, standard within-video next-frame prediction allows them to rely on appearance shared between the context and future, rather than learning interactions that transfer across scenes and embodiments. We introduce WATCH, a cross-video pre-training that learns from task-paired human demonstrations collected across diverse environments. Conditioned on the video and actions of one demonstration, the model jointly predicts another demonstration's actions and future frames from its current observation. Predicting one demonstration from another encourages the model to learn task-relevant interactions that transfer across scenes and demonstrators. Our pre-training shows that these capabilities can be learned from readily scalable human-human pairs alone, without requiring matched human-robot demonstrations. Analyses before robot post-training show improved motion alignment across embodiments and better action and video prediction on unseen robots, with representations closer to those learned from robot pairs. After robot post-training, WATCH improves MimicDroid in-context success from 40.9% to 68.3% with Cosmos Policy and from 59.8% to 77.7% with Cosmos3, with the largest gains on the unseen levels. Gains persist under context-free post-training across robot embodiments. WATCH outperforms within-video pre-training and co-training baselines, supporting cross-video prediction as a scalable approach to learning transferable world-action representations.

**comment/C1：** Project Page: https://watch-wam.github.io/

</details>

### 163. [ConformalGuard: False-Positive-Controlled Action Gating for LM Classifiers](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14365v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14365

**作者：** Bishnu Bista、Dhanraj Haibatrao Jadhav、Vibha Choudhary、Gaurav Saxena、Arun Pandiyan Perumal、Arjun Subedi、Jignesh Ammineni

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14365v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14365v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 ConformalGuard，一个模型无关的校准层，为固定打分函数的 LM 分类器在部署时提供有限样本的假阳性（介入触发率）控制，并在 BERT、Claude Sonnet 4 与 GPT-4o 的邮件语料上比较 conformal 校准、温度缩放与保序回归。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接关系；但其「对行动门控施加有限样本错误率保证」的思路，可能为推理中是否继续获取证据（LOOK/STOP 门控）的阈值与校准提供可核查的方法线索，迁移可行性未经作者验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ConformalGuard: False-Positive-Controlled Action Gating for LM Classifiers

**abstract/A1：** Language model classifiers are increasingly deployed for high-stakes decisions such as phishing screening, content moderation, and fraud triage, yet validation-set thresholds provide no finite-sample control of deployment-time false positives. We present ConformalGuard, a model-agnostic calibration layer that wraps a fixed scoring function with finite-sample control over the rate at which legitimate inputs trigger an intervention tier. Our contribution is empirical and operational, not a new conformal theorem: zero-shot LM API scores can be coarse enough (10--11 unique values here) to make temperature scaling and isotonic regression operationally identical to raw thresholding for low-FPR action gating. We compare these methods with conformal calibration for fine-tuned BERT, Claude Sonnet 4, and GPT-4o on public email corpora. For Claude, conformal calibration reduces FPR from 0.040 to 0.008 while recall falls from 0.938 to 0.875. For deterministic GPT-4o scores, the 1% operating point is too conservative to deploy (recall 0.564); three-run stochastic averaging raises recall to 0.732 at FPR 0.005. At 2% prevalence with BERT, conformal calibration removes 25 false-positive reviews per 10,000 emails (95% CI \[10, 43\]). The guarantee is legitimate-event-rate control under exchangeability; discrimination, workload effects, and robustness to shift remain empirical.

**comment/C1：** 12 pages. Published at COLM 2026. Code: https://github.com/bishnubista/conformalguard-colm-2026

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14395

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CY

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14395v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14395v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文审计 177 项多模态与单模态临床预测模型对比研究，量化 AUROC 增益与基准做法（是否对每个数据源单独建模、剔除最强来源模型后的增益变化），并统计决策效用评估与前瞻验证的缺失情况。

**相关性简评：** 其按数据源消融、以单模态基线衡量模态边际贡献的审计思路，可供核查 LVR 中答案是否真正依用视觉证据、如何量化视觉旁路的贡献，属于方法层面的借鉴线索而非直接竞争。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Clinical value claims in multimodal AI outpace supporting evidence

**abstract/A1：** Multimodal prediction models add a data source, such as imaging or an assay, to clinical information, and health systems must decide whether that added test is worth acquiring. We audited 177 studies comparing multimodal with unimodal models: 81 from a systematic review and 96 from a probability sample of 2025-2026 PubMed records. Gains in the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) were smaller when a study fitted a separate model for every data source (adjusted difference, -0.030; 95% CI, -0.056 to -0.005). Within 78 such studies, leaving out the strongest source's model would have raised the average gain from 0.046 to 0.108. This complete benchmarking fell from 69.1% of review studies to an estimated 46.0% of recent ones. An estimated 22% assessed decision utility and none evaluated a model prospectively, yet most claimed potential clinical usefulness or improved care (84.0% and an estimated 87.7%).

</details>

### 165. [Sparse-TD-JEPA: Improving Zero-Shot Reinforcement Learning With Sparse Latent Task Representations](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14400v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14400

**作者：** Duaa Nakshbandi、Zhiyu An、Wan Du

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14400v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14400v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文指出基于后继特征的零样本强化学习中，任务编码器若产生稠密潜表示会使推断奖励弥散、目标状态与背景对比不足；为此在训练期对任务编码器潜空间加 L1 稀疏惩罚，实例化为 Sparse-TD-JEPA，在 DMC 与 OGBench 的 65 个任务上提升了性能。

**相关性简评：** 「仅训练期加稀疏约束以集中任务相关信息、增强潜空间对比」这一线索，可能与 LVR 中如何让内部状态保留任务必要信息、筛选有效视觉证据并缓解信息坍缩的问题相关，可供核查其稀疏监督是否能迁移到 VLM latent 推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Sparse-TD-JEPA: Improving Zero-Shot Reinforcement Learning With Sparse Latent Task Representations

**abstract/A1：** Successor-feature-based zero-shot reinforcement learning methods pre-train a task encoder and successor-feature predictor on offline, reward-free data, then recover a policy at test time by solving a closed-form linear regression over a small labeled dataset. We identify an underexplored limitation of this approach: when the task encoder produces dense representations, the inferred reward signal becomes diffuse across the state space, reducing the contrast between goal-relevant states and the background and providing a weaker signal for the policy to follow. We address this limitation by introducing an l1 sparsity penalty that concentrates reward-predictive structure into a smaller effective subspace of the task encoder's latent space. The penalty is applied only during training and requires no architectural change or modification to the closed-form inference procedure. We instantiate this approach as Sparse-TD-JEPA, a single-line of code addition based on Temporal-Difference Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (TD-JEPA) that significantly improved its performance in zero-shot reinforcement learning. We evaluate Sparse-TD-JEPA on 65 tasks across the DeepMind Control (DMC) Suite and OGBench, covering locomotion, navigation, trajectory stitching, puzzle solving, and robotic manipulation. Sparse-TD-JEPA improves over TD-JEPA in all 13 domain-level comparisons. On DMC, it increases the average return from 661 +- 6 to 714 +- 3. On OGBench, it increases the average success rate from 38.0 +- 0.8 to 48.4 +- 2.3, with improvements of 13.4-18.0 percentage points on the evaluated antmaze navigation and stitching domains. Overall, Sparse-TD-JEPA achieves the highest mean performance among established zero-shot baselines in nine of the 13 domains. Analysis further shows that sparsity produces a sharper and more task-informative inferred reward landscape.

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.SC

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SAT-RL：用强化学习训练 LLM 通过多轮调用 Z3 等符号求解器完成逻辑推理，结合可验证合成数据、求解器增强轨迹的监督热身与工具感知奖励，在域内和域外逻辑任务上提升表现。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SAT-RL: Training Language Models for Logical Reasoning with Symbolic Solvers

**abstract/A1：** Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance in mathematical and logical reasoning, yet they still suffer from the curse of complexity and struggle as problem difficulty increases with the number of constraint interactions and the size of the search space. In contrast, satisfiability solvers such as Z3 provide scalable and verifiable reasoning through constraint solving under formal theories, but lack the flexibility to interpret natural-language problem descriptions. In this work, we propose SAT-RL, a reinforcement-learning (RL) framework that trains LLMs to interact with symbolic solvers through multi-turn tool execution. SAT-RL leverages synthetic data generation with verifiable solutions, supervised warm-up on solver-augmented traces, and solver-grounded reinforcement learning with tool-aware rewards. Experiments show that SAT-RL substantially improves symbolic reasoning with tools on both in-domain and out-of-domain logic tasks. Our code is available on https://github.com/sunjia72/SAT-RL.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14409

**作者：** Alex Gower

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.ET、cs.NE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14409v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14409v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 PotentialEP：用 Energy Matching 配合 Equilibrium Propagation 训练 CIFAR 规模的扩散/流生成模型，并证明加入线性注入项的预测编码网络松弛后的可见层状态天然携带所需梯度，从而免去逐步反向传播。

**相关性简评：** 其松弛式状态收敛与免反向传播的信用分配机制，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的轨迹训练与贡献分配提供可核查线索，但该工作面向图像生成、未涉及多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PotentialEP: Backprop-Free Training of CIFAR-Scale Generative Models via Equilibrium Propagation

**abstract/A1：** Generating an image with a diffusion or flow-matching model typically involves integrating a velocity field for hundreds of sequential steps. That computation suits a GPU poorly and an analog neuromorphic substrate well, where one fast, low-power physical relaxation could replace the whole sequence. Two things are needed: a generative algorithm whose computation is a relaxation, and a way to train it without backpropagation, whose global gradient transport is hard to realise in analog. Energy Matching supplies the first, sampling by gradient-descent relaxation on a time-independent potential - but obtaining the gradient that descent follows is itself a backward pass, once per integration step. We prove that a predictive coding network with a single linear injection term added to its energy relaxes to a state whose visible layer carries that gradient inherently, with an error that vanishes for small injection strengths. An Energy Matching model trained by backpropagation can therefore be loaded into this network unchanged and sampled by relaxation alone, matching the original model's FID to within 0.04 at CIFAR-10 and ImageNet-32 scale. The network can also be trained without backpropagation: Equilibrium Propagation reproduces backpropagation's parameter updates to a cosine similarity of 0.9998, and training end to end with those updates reaches an FID of 3.64 on unconditional CIFAR-10 against 3.54 for backpropagation. To our knowledge this is the first CIFAR-10 generative model trained with Equilibrium Propagation, and the first at competitive quality by any backpropagation-free rule. This quality does not require group normalisation or attention: an architecture of only convolutions and pointwise nonlinearities, both native to an analog crossbar, reaches an FID of 3.51 when trained by backpropagation.

**comment/C1：** Under review at ICLR 2027. Code: github.com/alexgower/EnergyMatchingEqProp

</details>

### 168. [Design Choices for Multimodal Transformer Learning with Missing and Longitudinal Healthcare Data](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14436v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14436

**作者：** Rita Cordeiro Mendes、Maria Manuel Pereira、Carlos Santiago、Catarina Barata

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14436v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14436v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在三个癌症数据集上系统比较多模态 Transformer 的设计选择：模态级与特征级 tokenization、注意力掩码与插补两类缺失处理策略、以及纵向时间信息的编码与建模方式，用于生存分类与离散时间生存预测。

**相关性简评：** 其模态级/特征级 tokenization 粒度与缺失模态下的注意力掩码、插补策略，可能为 LVR 中视觉细节应保留到何种表示粒度、以及视觉证据缺失或信息坍缩时的状态处理提供可供核查的方法线索；但该工作面向临床表格/纵向数据，与 VLM 推理的联系需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Design Choices for Multimodal Transformer Learning with Missing and Longitudinal Healthcare Data

**abstract/A1：** Multimodal learning offers the potential to improve predictions by integrating complementary information from heterogeneous data sources. However, multimodal datasets are frequently incomplete, raising important questions about how models should handle missing information. Although recent approaches increasingly rely on Transformer-based architectures for multimodal fusion, incomplete multimodal data introduces challenges such as missing modalities and intra-modal missingness, which motivate key architectural design choices, such as tokenization granularity. In addition, many datasets are longitudinal, with observations collected across multiple time points. The sequential nature of the Transformer architectures provides a natural framework for modeling such data, but introduces additional considerations, such as how temporal information should be represented. In this study, we systematically investigate these design choices using three different cancer datasets. We compare modality-level and feature-level tokenization and evaluate attention masking and imputation as strategies for handling missing information, both naturally occurring in the datasets and synthetically induced. We further investigate approaches for incorporating temporal information in our training process and how to model it. Experiments are conducted with unimodal and multimodal configurations, as well as different levels of missingness for binary survival classification and multiple time encoding strategies for discrete-time survival prediction. Our results show that while multimodal outperforms unimodal results, missing data heavily impacts predictions and thus effective design choices such as tokenization granularity, and intra-missing handling is essential for reliable prediction.

</details>

### 169. [Target-ESS Tempered Policy Optimization (TETPO): Smooth Variance Control via Bridge Importance Sampling](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14440v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14440

**作者：** Shayan Mohajer Hamidi、Kayhan Behdin、Wenhui Zhu、Aida Rahmattalabi、Jincheng Cao、Jelena Markovic-Voronov、Alborz Geramifard

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14440v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14440v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 TETPO：在异步 off-policy 的 LLM 后训练中把重要性权重 ρ 替换为 ρ^α，按每个 prompt 组用一维二分搜索选取满足目标 ESS 比例 κ 的最大 α，从而只对权重退化严重的组加强校正，并在数学推理基准上验证其优于基线。

**相关性简评：** 其「按实际权重集中程度自适应调节校正强度、避免少数轨迹主导更新」的思路，可能可供核查 LVR 轨迹训练中贡献分配与监督权重的设计，但论文本身不涉及视觉或 latent 推理，联系偏间接。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Target-ESS Tempered Policy Optimization (TETPO): Smooth Variance Control via Bridge Importance Sampling

**abstract/A1：** Asynchronous reinforcement-learning post-training of large language models is computationally efficient but inherently off-policy: the learner updates on rollouts generated by a stale policy, while correcting this mismatch requires importance weights that can be extremely heavy-tailed. A small number of trajectories may then dominate an update, collapsing the effective sample size (ESS) and increasing the variance and instability of the resulting gradient estimates. Existing stabilizers apply fixed interventions regardless of the realized severity of weight concentration, either discarding selected samples or reweighting them without adapting the correction strength. We introduce \\emph{Target--ESS Tempered Policy Optimization} (TETPO), which replaces each importance weight $ρ$ by $ρ^α$ for a data-adaptive exponent $α\\in\[0,1\]$: $α=1$ preserves the original importance weights, whereas $α=0$ assigns uniform coefficients. For each prompt group, TETPO selects the largest $α$ whose tempered weights satisfy a target ESS fraction $κ$, applying little tempering to healthy groups and stronger tempering when weight degeneracy is severe. At the population level, the tempered coefficients are exact importance weights for a geometric bridge between the sampler and learner policies. The exponent is efficiently found by one-dimensional bisection, while the resulting weights satisfy deterministic bounds on normalized-weight dispersion and weighted-gradient norm that are independent of policy drift, together with a fixed-$α$ bound on bridge-target discrepancy. Power tempering also introduces no explicit zero-weight mask. On mathematical-reasoning benchmarks under high staleness, TETPO outperforms strong on- and off-policy baselines.

</details>

### 170. [KV4-RL: Unlocking Faster Asynchronous Rollouts for RLVR with INT4 KV Cache Quantization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14448v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14448

**作者：** Sihwan Park、Sung-Yub Kim、Doohyuk Jang、Eunho Yang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14448v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14448v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文刻画 RLVR 异步 rollout 中的 KV 负载集中现象，提出 KV4-RL：对 KV cache 做免校准 INT4 量化，并对 attention sink 与近期上下文的少量位置保留 INT8，以在缓解采样偏差的同时取得约 1.8 倍 rollout 加速。

**相关性简评：** 「保护 attention sink 与近期位置的 KV 精度」这一选择性缓存策略，可供核查 latent 推理中缓存状态退化、缓存/注意力结构如何影响内部状态保真，以及 rollout 与训练采样不一致对轨迹监督的干扰。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** KV4-RL: Unlocking Faster Asynchronous Rollouts for RLVR with INT4 KV Cache Quantization

**abstract/A1：** Asynchronous rollout improves the efficiency of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) by reducing under-utilization during long-tail generation. Sustained concurrency also concentrates context processing into fewer decode steps, increasing the KV workload per step. We characterize this \\emph{KV concentration} and find that KV cache quantization delivers substantially greater acceleration than weight-only and weight-activation quantization in our matched-workload comparisons. However, INT4 KV rollout can degrade learning even with token-level truncated importance sampling (TIS). We propose \\emph{KV4-RL}, which combines calibration-free INT4 KV quantization with selective INT8 protection of attention sinks and recent context. Protecting a bounded number of positions reduces sampler mismatch while retaining most of the speedup from INT4. Across 400 iterations of Qwen3-8B-Base GRPO training, KV4-RL achieves $1.80\\times$ cumulative rollout speedup and $1.27\\times$ cumulative full-iteration speedup over BF16 rollout, reaching $1.97\\times$ rollout speedup over the final 50 iterations. Under a common BF16 evaluator, its final six-benchmark mean accuracy is within 0.5 percentage points of BF16-rollout training for both Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen3-8B-Base.

**comment/C1：** 32 pages, 15 figures, 6 tables

</details>

### 171. [RES-MR: Risk-Aware Reasoning for Explainable and Safe Medication Recommendation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14474v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14474

**作者：** Cong Wang、Jin Li、Shoujin Wang、Yishuo Li、Huilin Gu、Wenpeng Lu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.IR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14474v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14474v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 RES-MR 两阶段框架：先用图检索得到的患者知识合成推理轨迹做蒸馏，再用解耦药物因子构建患者特异参考原型，通过奖励塑形与裁剪实现风险感知的安全用药推荐。

**相关性简评：** 其「推理轨迹蒸馏 + 带奖励裁剪的策略优化」或可为 LVR 的轨迹监督、冲突目标下的状态约束与贡献分配提供训练侧线索，尤其可核查参考原型式边界校准能否迁移为 latent 状态的安全约束。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RES-MR: Risk-Aware Reasoning for Explainable and Safe Medication Recommendation

**abstract/A1：** Medication recommendations seek to deliver personalized drug combinations based on patients' clinical information, where ensuring transparent decision-making and personalized safety are of paramount importance. However, existing approaches predominantly operate as \`\`black boxes'', offering limited interpretability and hindering clinician trust. Furthermore, they typically rely on fixed, patient-agnostic safety constraints, neglecting the heterogeneity of risk tolerance across individuals, which poses significant risks to vulnerable populations. To address these gaps, we propose \\textbf{RES-MR}, a novel Risk-aware Reasoning framework for Explainable and Safe Medication Recommendation using LLMs. RES-MR follows a two-stage training paradigm: (1) an explainable clinical reasoning distillation stage to elicit diagnostic capabilities by fine-tuning on synthesized reasoning trajectories, grounded in patient-specific knowledge from graph retrieval; and (2) a risk-aware policy optimization stage to dynamically balance therapeutic efficacy with personalized safety. This stage employs disentangled drug factors to construct patient-specific reference prototypes that capture desired therapeutic drug features and risk features to avoid. These prototypes enable risk boundary calibration and guide the model toward safe recommendations via reward shaping and clipping. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that RES-MR significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in terms of accuracy, safety, and explainability. Our code and data are available at: https://github.com/wangcong2001/RES-MR.

**comment/C1：** 12 pages

</details>

**相关性简评：** 其 token 级内容/风格解耦与「先分解再分类」的适配器设计，或可作为核查 LVR 中「任务必要视觉内容与干扰因素能否在内部状态中分离」「答案是否真正使用 latent 内容」的迁移线索，但跨模态有效性需人工进一步核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DEFT: Disentanglement-Enhanced Fine-Tuning for EEG Foundation Models

**abstract/A1：** EEG foundation models (EFMs) have improved EEG representation learning by transferring knowledge from large-scale multi-subject pretraining to downstream tasks. However, their pretrained embeddings often retain substantial subject-related variation, placing an additional burden on the downstream classifier, especially in cross-subject settings. To address this issue, we propose Disentangled EFM Fine-Tuning (DEFT), a plug-and-play adapter for EFM fine-tuning. DEFT encourages branch disentanglement of pretrained tokens into task-oriented content and subject-consistent style, then performs downstream prediction from the content branch. It instantiates this factorize-before-classify design with recursive Gaussian refinement, temporal-variance regularization, subject-aware contrastive learning, and reconstruction. Experiments across multiple EEG datasets and four EFM backbones show that DEFT improves matched fine-tuning baselines. Further ablations and analyses support the intended content/style branch organization.

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出 DSR-Net 用于 3D 人体姿态估计：用动态骨骼关系模块学习超出预定义骨架连接的自适应关节间依赖，再以分层关系感知融合策略耦合结构与时序表示，并用轻量残差重校准模块稳定结构特征。

**相关性简评：** 其「动态关系建模 + 结构/时序分层融合」的方式可能为 LVR 中实体关系如何在内部状态里被动态维护与更新提供可核查的线索，但领域较远，迁移价值需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DSR-Net: Learning Dynamic Skeletal Relations for 3D Human Pose Estimation

**abstract/A1：** 3D human pose estimation requires accurate modeling of motion-dependent skeletal structures and inter-joint dependencies. Existing methods typically rely on fixed skeletal topologies in Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs) or implicitly capture joint relations through attention mechanisms, limiting their adaptability to diverse motion patterns. To address this issue,we proposeDSR-Net, a dynamic structural representation learning framework for 3D human pose estimation. Specifically, a Dynamic Skeletal Relation (DSR) module is introduced to learn adaptive inter-joint dependencies beyond predefined skeletal connections. Based on the learned relations, a hierarchical relation-aware fusion strategy is developed to facilitate effective interaction between structural and temporal representations. In addition, a lightweight Residual Skeletal Recalibration Module (RSRM) is designed to enhance the stability of structure-aware features with minimal computational overhead. Extensive experiments on Human3.6M and MPI-INF-3DHP demonstrate that DSR-Net achieves MPJPEs of 37.9 mm and 14.9 mm, respectively, consistently improving over strong baselines. The results validate the effectiveness of dynamic skeletal relation modeling for robust 3D human pose estimation.

**内容简述：** 论文提出 TartanMatch，用轻量模态适配和真实/合成数据混合，把 RGB 预训练的对应模型扩展为覆盖 RGB、事件、热成像、深度、投影 LiDAR 共 25 个有序模态对的统一稠密对应模型，并在零样本真实基准上大幅降低 EPE。

**相关性简评：** 其「轻量模态适配 + 多模态对联合训练带来正向迁移」的机制，可能为 LVR 中跨模态视觉细节的保留与共享 latent 空间的信息坍缩问题提供可核查的适配与训练线索；但论文本身不涉及推理、证据使用或 latent 状态生成，联系较弱。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TartanMatch: Towards Universal Dense Correspondence Across Modalities

**abstract/A1：** Robotic platforms combine multi-modal sensors to operate across diverse conditions, but most dense correspondence methods are limited to RGB-RGB or a small set of modality pairs. Training a model for each modality pair scales poorly with the number of sensors and forgoes potential positive transfer across modality pairs. We introduce TartanMatch, a unified model for dense correspondence across all 25 ordered pairs among RGB, event, thermal, depth, and projected LiDAR. TartanMatch adapts an RGB-pretrained correspondence model to all modality pairs within one shared network using lightweight modality adaptation and a mixture of real and synthetic data. On zero-shot real-world benchmarks, TartanMatch reduces Endpoint Error (EPE) over the strongest baselines by 61.9% for cross-modal matching and 49.6% for same-modal matching. We further show that joint training across all modality pairs improves average matching accuracy over pair-specific training, especially on challenging cross-modal pairs. These results demonstrate that a single model achieves broad multi-modal coverage and state-of-the-art matching accuracy.

### 175. [Compositional Concepts Erasing: Disentangling Object-Style via Domain Manifold Unlearning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14514v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Domain Manifold Unlearning（DMU），用从扩散模型中间特征中提取并经 EMA 更新的特征代理表示目标物体方向，从而在抹除「物体-风格」组合概念时只移除特定域成分、保留其他语义，缓解批量与顺序遗忘中的灾难性遗忘。

**相关性简评：** 其「由中间特征构造概念方向、只选择性抹除某个子空间而保留其余语义」的解耦与状态编辑思路，可能为 LVR 中分离和操控 latent 状态里的视觉证据与风格／先验成分提供方法线索，可供核查；但论文本身面向图像生成的遗忘任务，不直接研究多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Compositional Concepts Erasing: Disentangling Object-Style via Domain Manifold Unlearning

**abstract/A1：** Diffusion models pose significant risks regarding the generation of illicit content and copyright violations. This has catalyzed the development of machine unlearning to erase harmful concepts or copyrighted styles from a model's generative repertoire without compromising its general performance. However, previous unlearning approaches on diffusion models have largely focused on either object-level or style-level removal and failed to address the challenge of object-style combination unlearning. At the same time, multiple unlearning requests often lead to catastrophic forgetting. To address these challenges, we propose Domain Manifold Unlearning (DMU), which uses an EMA-updated feature proxy extracted from intermediate diffusion features to represent the retained target-object direction. As a lightweight estimating representation of an object, DMU enables selective unlearning of domain-specific components in a specific object while preserving other semantic representations, thereby significantly enhancing robustness in multiple combination unlearning scenarios. Extensive experiments show that DMU significantly mitigates catastrophic forgetting, outperforming state-of-the-art methods of batch unlearning and sequential unlearning.

**comment/C1：** 14 pages

</details>

### 176. [We Have Been Interpreting Diffusion Transformer Backbone Behaviors Wrong](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14517v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14517

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文重新解读 DiT 主干深度上激活性能呈倒 U 曲线的成因：预测目标（ε、u、x0）才是核心，语义信号只是副产物，且预测目标的选择可预测地改变曲线形状，并据此预测 REPA 的近似最优插入位置。

**相关性简评：** 虽属图像扩散生成，但其「中间层激活只是预测目标副产物」及训练目标决定表示层次分布的结论，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态取自哪一层、辅助对齐监督应加在何处、以及内部状态内容归因提供可核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** We Have Been Interpreting Diffusion Transformer Backbone Behaviors Wrong

**abstract/A1：** During a network forward call, diffusion backbones naturally produce many intermediate activations. If we evaluate each activation against an identical downstream benchmarking protocol, we can plot an inverted-U-shaped curve as the depth profile: the activation's performance goes up first and then down as we go into deeper layers. This is common knowledge in the diffusion model community, which inspires many applications including the widely-adopted REPA. However, the common interpretation of this depth profile may be inaccurate and incomplete: (i) The cause of this curve has long been treated as signal granularity changing from coarse to fine, but there has been little evidence in DiT backbones. (ii) The community has been mainly studying this phenomenon in a static way, without investigating how it changes across different training setups. In this work, we show a different mechanism picture for the profile, where the prediction target (e.g., $ε$, $u$, $x\_0$) sits at the center. The semantically meaningful signal is only an intermediate by-product for predicting the target, while the prediction target is the real goal for the backbone. Furthermore, the choice of prediction targets as part of the training setup can predictably affect the curve's shape. With this updated interpretation, many applications of this depth profile can be better grounded and predicted. As an example, we show how to predict the near-optimal placement of REPA based on the prediction target of the training setup. The code is at https://github.com/Darkbblue/dit-compare.

</details>

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出 Q-NeuS，一个查询自适应的神经元干预框架：先用主体线索构建候选神经元空间，再用轻量 Query-Adaptive Gate 为每个输入生成逐神经元的调制系数，并以 Neu-GRPO 依据多种干预配置的相对表现训练该门控，基座 LLM 全程冻结。

**相关性简评：** 属纯文本推理期干预，但「按输入动态决定改哪些内部单元、改多少」的门控设计，以及用多配置相对表现做贡献分配的 Neu-GRPO，可供核查其是否可迁移为 LVR 中的自适应 latent 状态调制与干预监督线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Query-Adaptive Neuron Steering for LLMs

**abstract/A1：** Effectively eliciting the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) at inference time remains an important challenge. Existing studies address this challenge through context engineering, which shapes user queries, or fixed steering, which directly intervenes in model computation. However, predefined contexts and fixed intervention strategies may not adequately accommodate the diverse knowledge and reasoning requirements of individual queries. This raises a natural question: Can internal steering in LLMs be made query-adaptive? In this work, we investigate whether query-induced internal activations can guide adaptive steering in LLMs. Our pilot studies reveal subject- and layer-dependent neuron activation patterns and show that amplifying subject-relevant neurons can improve model performance. Based on these findings, we propose Q-NeuS, a query-adaptive neuron steering framework that dynamically determines which neurons to modulate and by how much for each input. Specifically, Q-NeuS constructs a compact subject-guided candidate neuron space and employs a lightweight Query-Adaptive Gate to generate neuron-wise modulation coefficients. To learn effective intervention strategies, we introduce Neu-GRPO, which adapts group-relative optimization to train the Query-Adaptive Gate using the relative performance of multiple neuron intervention configurations. The base LLM remains frozen throughout training and inference, and no task or subject labels are required at inference time. Extensive experiments across multiple LLMs and benchmarks demonstrate that Q-NeuS consistently improves model performance and exhibits broad applicability across model scales and strong cross-benchmark transferability.

</details>
