### 178. [InfraWorld: Motion-Aware World Modeling for Roadside 4D Occupancy Forecasting](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14544v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14544

**作者：** Songkai Wang、Xiaokai Bai、Lei Yang、Hui-liang Shen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14544v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14544v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 InfraWorld，把路侧 4D 占据预测表述为选择性状态演化：用稠密 BEV 状态承载全局场景、用持续 motion query 表示局部运动，并借助运动引导的查询初始化、长短时融合与查询注入，在 rollout 中迭代更新两类互补状态。

**相关性简评：** 其「稠密全局状态＋持续查询」的混合潜在状态与逐帧选择性注入更新方式，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态如何时序更新、如何只在局部区域扰动状态提供可供核查的方法线索，但领域相距较远，需读原文确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** InfraWorld: Motion-Aware World Modeling for Roadside 4D Occupancy Forecasting

**abstract/A1：** Roadside 4D occupancy forecasting predicts future semantic occupancy in a fixed infrastructure coordinate system. Roadside scenes are globally structured yet locally evolving, requiring comprehensive scene-level context while precisely modeling sparse localized motion. However, existing forecasting paradigms struggle to tackle both requirements. To address this limitation, we propose InfraWorld, a world model formulating roadside occupancy forecasting as selective state evolution. InfraWorld maintains a dense BEV state for the complete scene and persistent motion queries for moving regions, assigning complementary states to global context and local dynamics. Specifically, we propose Dynamic Query Initiation (DQI) to initialize queries in regions supported by motion in the observed history. During rollout, the dense state is updated through Long--Short Temporal Fusion (LST), which combines short-term adjacent-frame continuity with long-term motion trends to preserve stable context while capturing scene evolution. Motion-Aware Query Injection (MAQI) then refines the queries and injects confidence-weighted query information into corresponding BEV tokens, enabling targeted dynamic updates without perturbing global context. Together, InfraWorld concentrates predictive capacity on evolving traffic regions. Extensive experiments on the InfraOcc and Occ3D--nus datasets demonstrate that InfraWorld achieves state-of-the-art performance for roadside 4D occupancy forecasting while retaining its effectiveness under ego-centric settings. Code will be released.

</details>

### 179. [Adversarial Gradient Forcing for Robust Few-Step Autoregressive Video Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14553v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14553

**作者：** Chenxi Xia、Yixuan Xu、Shan Liu、Jiapeng Wang、Maohua Li、Hanlin Tang、Kan Liu、Tao Lan、Weiyi Lu、Xinggao Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14553v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14553v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究少步自回归视频生成中的误差累积问题，指出模型对自身生成历史的扰动高度敏感，称之为「局部历史鲁棒性缺口」，并提出 Adversarial Gradient Forcing：用未来块预测的分布匹配梯度筛选对自生成历史的对抗扰动，再在原始与扰动历史上联合训练生成器，从而在仅需 5 秒 rollout 的训练下提升长时生成鲁棒性。

**相关性简评：** 该工作针对自回归 rollout 中历史误差被放大的「鲁棒性缺口」，其扰动筛选与原始/扰动历史联合训练的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理轨迹的漂移抑制与轨迹级监督提供可核查线索；但研究对象是视频生成而非视觉推理，需人工判断能否迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Adversarial Gradient Forcing for Robust Few-Step Autoregressive Video Generation

**abstract/A1：** Autoregressive video generation models generate videos sequentially, with each new block conditioned on previously generated blocks. By training on the model's own rollouts, Self Forcing and its follow-up methods substantially mitigate exposure bias caused by the mismatch between training- and inference-time history distributions. However, these models still suffer from error accumulation during long-horizon generation. We identify a key underlying limitation: the model remains highly sensitive to errors in its generated history, allowing small deviations to be amplified through subsequent generations. We refer to this underexplored problem as the local history robustness gap. To address this gap, we introduce Adversarial Gradient Forcing (AGF), a framework designed to improve the robustness of few-step autoregressive video models to perturbations and accumulated errors in their own generated histories. AGF uses distribution matching gradients from future block predictions to select adversarial perturbations of self-generated histories. It then jointly trains the generator on the original and perturbed histories to improve the robustness of future generation. Extensive experiments show that AGF achieves the highest VBench Total score on 60-second video generation and the best visual quality on four-minute video generation. Notably, AGF achieves such long-horizon robustness while requiring only 5-second rollouts for training.

**comment/C1：** Project page: https://wuli-art.github.io/Adversarial-Gradient-Forcing/ ; Code: https://github.com/wuli-art/Adversarial-Gradient-Forcing

</details>

### 180. [FrameFold: Response-Guided KV Cache Consolidation for Autoregressive Long Video Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14568v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14568

**作者：** Muyu Liu、Mingming Liu、Hong Gu、Yuyao Zhang、Qin Lu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14568v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14568v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出免训练的 KV 缓存合并方法 FrameFold：以相邻历史条目的时序冗余为基础，比较同一批近期历史查询在合并前后检索到的内容，闭式拟合 value 合并系数并选取响应失真最小的合并方案，在长视频自回归生成中保持一致性。

**相关性简评：** 论文属视频生成，不直接研究视觉推理，但其「按注意力响应失真选择合并、并保留完整空间网格」的缓存整合准则，可能为 LVR 中缓存与注意力结构如何影响 latent 内容保留、以及历史状态如何压缩提供可核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FrameFold: Response-Guided KV Cache Consolidation for Autoregressive Long Video Generation

**abstract/A1：** In autoregressive video generation, retaining all historical key-value (KV) states increases memory usage and per-step attention costs as videos grow longer. A fixed cache budget bounds these costs but raises the challenge of preserving historical content that supports consistent, high-quality generation. Existing methods control cache size through history selection or consolidation, yet deciding what to retain and how to limit the loss of useful content remains a shared challenge. Our analysis shows that spatial queries depend on different historical content and that higher current attention coverage does not necessarily yield better long-video quality. We introduce FrameFold, a training-free KV cache consolidation method that compares the content retrieved by the same recent historical queries before and after merging to guide both representative construction and merge selection. Exploiting temporal redundancy between adjacent historical entries, FrameFold merges their KV states into shared representatives while retaining complete spatial grids. It fits value-merging coefficients in closed form by matching conditional attention responses, then selects the merge with the lowest remaining response distortion. Under matched KV cache budgets, experiments on Self Forcing and Causal Forcing at 30 and 60 seconds and on LongLive at 120 seconds demonstrate improved consistency and visual quality. Continuous eight-minute Self Forcing rollouts further show less quality degradation than the baselines.

**comment/C1：** 26 pages, 14 figures

</details>

### 181. [PsyMemBehav: Psychology-Informed and Memory-Grounded Two-Level Identity-to-Action Reasoning for Social-Media Behavior Simulation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14570v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14570

**作者：** Wenji Zhang、Xilong Cheng、Yunxiao Qin、Mai Tu、Tongye Zhu、Yuhao Zhou、JingBo Ji、Yuting Tan、Duoyin Li、Hongjiang Xiao、Yuan Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.SI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14570v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14570v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 PsyMemBehav，用心理学画像与检索到的记忆做两级 identity-to-action 推理来模拟真实用户的社交媒体行为，并基于 5.57M 条真实行为构建 PsyMemBehav-bench，以 reverse-CoT 和轨迹级 DPO 训练。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接视觉或多模态联系，但其对完整推理—动作轨迹的监督方式（reverse-CoT、rubric-guided DPO）与外部记忆接地，可能可供核查 LVR 中轨迹训练与贡献分配问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PsyMemBehav: Psychology-Informed and Memory-Grounded Two-Level Identity-to-Action Reasoning for Social-Media Behavior Simulation

**abstract/A1：** Large language models (LLMs) support social simulation, but faithfully reproducing real users requires grounding both structured platform decisions and language in sparse, noisy behavioral evidence. We introduce PsyMemBehav, which maps psychology-informed profiles and retrieved memories to target-first platform behavior through two-level identity-to-action reasoning. To support this approach with comprehensive behavioral traces, we construct a dataset PsyMemBehav-bench from 5.57M observed behaviors of 5,862 real users (approximately 950 per user) across Reddit, Bluesky, and Twitter. Each recorded engagement is modeled as target selection followed by Comment, Like, or Repost and optional response generation. PsyMemBehav combines 41-dimensional user descriptors, top-5 BM25 memories, reverse-CoT supervision, and rubric-guided DPO over complete reasoning-action trajectories. Experiments show that PsyMemBehav 27B ranks first in 11 of 12 reported individual-level metrics, improving average response quality over GPT-5.4 from 54.28 to 59.68 (9.95% relative), and obtains the lowest group-level MAE (0.081) and MSE (0.009) among simulated systems. These results support evidence-grounded user modeling for observed-thread continuation; the benchmark remains conditional on recorded engagement and does not model no-action decisions.

**comment/C1：** 20 pages, 7 figures, including appendices

</details>

### 182. [Reward-Aligned Distillation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14572v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14572

**作者：** Yilan Chen、Zian Su、Manish Prajapat、Dingmin Wang、Rein Houthooft、Rui Song、Vijay Lingam

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14572v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14572v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Reward-Aligned Distillation（RAD），一个双层框架：通过临时优化步的元梯度预测每个 token 蒸馏信号对学生更新后奖励的影响，据此加权、抑制甚至反转其梯度贡献，并在数学与代码基准上验证。

**相关性简评：** 属纯文本 on-policy 蒸馏、不涉及视觉状态，但其按奖励贡献为单个 token 监督打分的元梯度机制，可能为 LVR 中 latent 步骤与视觉证据的贡献分配和筛选提供可核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Reward-Aligned Distillation

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but remains computationally expensive and sample inefficient. On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense token-level supervision from a stronger teacher, yet standard OPD distills every token regardless of whether the teacher's preference actually improves task reward. Existing token-selection methods rely on proxies such as uncertainty or teacher--student divergence, which need not identify reward-improving supervision. We introduce Reward-Aligned Distillation (RAD), a bilevel framework that weights distillation signals based on their predicted effect on the student's post-update reward. RAD differentiates through a temporary optimizer step to score each token's supervision, then updates the token weights by projected ascent from the initial token weights. The resulting weights can strengthen, suppress, or reverse individual distillation-gradient contributions. At a matched training-response budget, RAD improves mean accuracy on six competition-math benchmarks over the strongest baselines by 6.5 percentage points for Qwen3-1.7B (non-thinking) and 2.5 points for Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507. RAD-Simple, a simplified variant, achieves comparable math accuracy at the same training-response budget. On LiveCodeBench-v6, RAD reaches 54.69\\% and 58.67\\% pass@1 with Qwen3-1.7B (non-thinking) and OLMo3-7B-Instruct, respectively, exceeding the strongest baselines by 8.7 and 6.4 points. These results support reward-guided weighting of teacher supervision across model families and tasks.

</details>

### 183. [CB-Agent: Concept-Based In-Context Learning for Sequential Action Selection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14574v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14574

**作者：** Qingyue Zhang、Huaze Tang、Minyu Zhang、Yuxiang Yan、Wenbo Ding、Shao-Lun Huang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14574v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14574v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 CB-Agent，把 concept-based ICL 扩展到交互智能体的序列动作选择：从专家轨迹中抽取情境-动作决策，用最大似然拟合一个概念向量，再与冻结语言模型特征和先验结合，对候选动作打分并在 ReAct 交互中直接选动作，在 TextWorld、ALFWorld、ScienceWorld 上评测。

**相关性简评：** 其「把演示压缩成一个可训练 latent 概念向量、并由它直接监督动作选择」的做法，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态如何训练、以及答案是否真正使用 latent 内容；但该工作面向纯文本智能体，无视觉状态，迁移线索需人工确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CB-Agent: Concept-Based In-Context Learning for Sequential Action Selection

**abstract/A1：** In-context learning (ICL) allows large language models to use demonstrations without updating their parameters. For interactive agents, demonstrations are trajectories of reasoning, actions, and observations that illustrate how to complete a task. Reusing demonstrations in new situations is challenging: directly inputting full trajectories consumes limited prompt space and constrains the overall effectiveness, while natural-language summaries require the agent to translate general guidance into specific action choices. Therefore, we study whether expert action choices can directly supervise a reusable scoring rule. We propose CB-Agent, which extends concept-based ICL to sequential action selection. We extract environment-action decisions from expert trajectories and fit a concept vector by maximum likelihood to model the conditional distribution over candidate actions given the context. This model combines the concept with frozen language-model features and priors. During ReAct interaction, the agent uses this distribution to select environment actions without including demonstrations in the action-scoring context. Across TextWorld, ALFWorld, and ScienceWorld, CB-Agent achieves the highest cross-benchmark average among the evaluated methods at all three tested model sizes and ranks first on TextWorld and ScienceWorld at each size. ALFWorld experiments support the learned concept's contribution beyond prior-only scoring and show further gains when combined with Reflexion. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CB-Agent-DFF9/.

</details>

### 184. [Iterate on an LLM, Serve on an SLM](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14576v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14576

**作者：** Keegan Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.MA

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14576v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14576v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出「先在前沿 LLM 的 prompt 空间用实时流量反馈迭代出目标行为，再把真实生产决策记录蒸馏到 SLM」的两阶段流程，并在家庭护理排班的逐对 yes/no 安全决策代理上验证（LoRA 微调 Qwen3-8B 达 0.913 一致率，延迟与成本更低）。

**相关性简评：** 论文用真实推理记录（而非合成模仿数据）做 SFT 蒸馏并进行教师自一致性与人工盲评比较，可供核查 LVR 中推理轨迹的训练监督来源与贡献分配问题；但工作本身为纯文本企业代理应用，未涉及视觉状态或 latent 推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Iterate on an LLM, Serve on an SLM

**abstract/A1：** As frontier LLMs gain more capabilities, the cost to run them also goes up. At the same time, small language models (SLMs) also gain more capabilities but have largely been able to keep their cost stable, offering 5-40 times cheaper inference for the narrow, repetitive subtasks that agents decompose work into. However, the standing limiting factor is getting the correct behavior out of a small model in a fast, efficient, and economical way. Unfortunately, in most cases, zero-shot small models fail narrow production tasks. Furthermore, retraining one every time the behavior changes is too slow to iterate on. We propose doing both in sequence. First, develop the desired behavior in prompt space, on a frontier model, with immediate feedback from live traffic. Then, once the behavior converges, distill the recorded production behavior (not synthetic imitations of it) into an SLM through supervised fine-tuning (SFT). We show a proper use case of this method through a scheduling agent for home-care agencies that fans out a single yes/no safety decision per caregiver-shift pair on GPT-5.4-nano. A LoRA-tuned Qwen3-8B trained on 11.6k recorded production decisions reaches 0.913 agreement, while the teacher (GPT-5.4-nano), re-run on its own recorded prompts, agrees with itself only 72.7% of the time, pointing to the fact that the SLM may also be more consistent. Furthermore, when the two disagreed, a blinded professional scheduler sided with the student 48-29. Finally, we find that the SLM has approximately 2.5 times lower median latency and is a fraction of the cost. We believe this lifecycle of quick building, live feedback, and cheap inference is a blueprint for others building similar systems.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 2nd Workshop on Agentic AI Benchmarks and Applications for Enterprise Tasks (AABA4ET)

</details>

### 185. [Attribute-Centric Vision-Language Alignment for Fine-Grained Gait Understanding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14589v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14589

**作者：** Saihui Hou、Chenye Wang、Wenpeng Lang、Qiannan Guo、Zhengxiang Lan、Chao Fan、Shiqi Yu、Yongzhen Huang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14589v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14589v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文构建了大规模步态属性识别基准 RA-GAR（1001 受试者、约 24 万条行走序列、15 类静动态属性），并提出 Gait-VL：用属性专属可学习 query 跨空间与帧聚合 RGB 特征，与由 LLM 扩写的文本类原型匹配，并将属性预训练视觉编码器迁移到身份步态识别流程。

**相关性简评：** 其「属性 query 跨帧聚合视觉证据并与文本原型匹配」的表示与匹配方式，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、任务必要信息保留与状态压缩提供可核查线索；但任务属步态识别，未涉及 latent 推理状态生成，迁移性需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Attribute-Centric Vision-Language Alignment for Fine-Grained Gait Understanding

**abstract/A1：** Walking sequences reveal human-interpretable attributes related to body structure, posture, and motion. Gait attribute recognition provides a concrete route to fine-grained gait understanding by predicting these attributes. However, existing benchmarks provide limited fine-grained annotations, while classifier-based gait attribute recognition methods typically represent candidate classes through learned output weights rather than directly matching visual evidence with textual class representations. To address the annotation gap, we present RA-GAR, a large-scale, richly annotated multimodal benchmark for gait attribute recognition, containing 1,001 subjects, 242,729 walking sequences, and annotations for 15 static and motion gait attributes. We further propose Gait-VL, an attribute-centric vision-language alignment framework that recognizes gait attributes by matching attribute-specific multi-frame visual evidence with textual class prototypes. On the visual side, attribute-specific learnable queries aggregate RGB features across spatial locations and frames into per-attribute visual embeddings. On the language side, diverse descriptions expanded by a large language model are combined with context about relevant body regions to construct textual class prototypes. Beyond attribute recognition, we evaluate the transferability of the attribute-pretrained visual encoder by using it to replace generic upstream large vision models in identityoriented gait recognition pipelines; attribute pre-training uses no identity classification or metric-learning objectives. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art attribute recognition performance on RA-GAR and consistent improvements in downstream identity recognition across multiple pipelines and benchmarks, supporting the effectiveness and transferability of attribute-centric gait representation learning.

</details>

### 186. [Bidirectional Adaptive Transformers for Multimodal Anomaly Detection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14598v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14598

**作者：** Yuxin Jiang、Yunkang Cao、Weiming Shen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14598v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14598v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Bidirectional Adaptive Transformers（BAT）用于 RGB 图像与 3D 点云的多模态异常检测：用双向特征对齐模块的互预测机制建立跨模态潜在语义对应，并用轻量 image/point cloud adapter 微调冻结的预训练编码器，在 MVTec 3D-AD 与 Eyecandies 上报告了优于现有方法的检测性能。

**相关性简评：** 其「互预测式跨模态对齐」与「adapter 缓解冻结编码器信息损失」可作方法线索，供核查 latent 状态中视觉细节保留与多模态对齐训练目标的参考；但任务本身是工业异常检测，不涉及推理期状态生成、证据获取或 VLM 推理，迁移尚属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Bidirectional Adaptive Transformers for Multimodal Anomaly Detection

**abstract/A1：** The effective integration of features derived from RGB images and 3D point clouds presents a substantial challenge in the field of multimodal anomaly detection (MAD). Existing MAD methods typically rely on static fusion paradigms built upon frozen pre-trained encoders. While these frameworks facilitate spatial alignment, they lack the mechanism to establish latent semantic correspondence, thereby inducing cross-modal interference that degrades anomaly discriminability. To mitigate these limitations, this study proposes a Bidirectional Adaptive Transformers (BAT) framework, which constructs comprehensive and semantically aligned multimodal representations by leveraging complementary attributes across modalities. The BAT framework introduces a Bidirectional Feature Alignment (BFA) module, which employs a mutual predictive mechanism to bridge the gap between 2D textural patterns and 3D geometric structures. This bidirectional interaction explicitly enhances the textural granularity of point cloud descriptors while augmenting the spatial contextual awareness of RGB features. To ensure that the latent representations possess sufficient informational density for alignment, BAT incorporates a parameter-efficient adaptation architecture. By utilizing lightweight image and point cloud adapters, the framework facilitates specialized fine-tuning of pre-trained models, mitigating the information loss inherent in frozen encoders. Extensive experiments conducted on MVTec 3D-AD and Eyecandies confirm that BAT achieves state-of-the-art anomaly detection performance, significantly outperforming existing MAD methods.

</details>

### 187. [Decoupling Knowledge Forgetting and Refusal Learning in MLLM Unlearning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14605v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14605

**作者：** Haodong Chen、Shengtao Wen、Dong Liang、Lingbing Guo、Xiang Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.IR、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14605v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14605v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文研究多模态大模型遗忘，指出「是否停止输出」这一表层指标会掩盖两类失败：知识抑制引发虚构、拒绝训练只改行为未抹除知识；为此提出 Forget-Aware Self-Distillation，把行为与知识拆成两个通道，从自身模型蒸馏拒绝行为（并掩蔽目标 token 以免重新教会），同时直接抑制 ground-truth 答案片段。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接关系，但「行为通道／知识通道」解耦监督、在 teacher 分布中掩蔽目标 token 的做法，可能为 latent 推理中的监督信号设计、答案信息是否经 latent 泄漏的核查提供线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Decoupling Knowledge Forgetting and Refusal Learning in MLLM Unlearning

**abstract/A1：** Current evaluations of multimodal unlearning typically focus on whether a model stops outputting target information. This surface-level criterion, however, masks two critical failure modes. First, knowledge suppression techniques often induce confabulation, leading the model to hallucinate facts about the unlearned subject. Second, refusal training merely alters observable behavior without erasing the underlying knowledge; such models might decline open queries but still identify correct answers under multiple-choice probing. To overcome these limitations, we propose Forget-Aware Self-Distillation (FASD). This method is designed to achieve honest ignorance, a state where the model genuinely loses the target knowledge and learns to acknowledge its absence. FASD separates these goals into two complementary channels. The behavior channel distills appropriate refusals from an ignorance-prompted copy of the model itself. Crucially, target tokens are masked from the teacher distribution to avoid accidentally reteaching the forgotten concepts. Simultaneously, the knowledge channel directly suppresses ground-truth answer spans independently of the model's generated responses. Experiments demonstrate that FASD successfully unlearns target knowledge, prevents information leakage in open-ended tasks, and preserves performance on retained data. The resulting model not only forgets the specified information but accurately recognizes the boundaries of its own knowledge. Code and data will be released upon publication.

</details>

### 188. [EarthAlign: Learning Language-Aligned Representations of Earth System Data](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14624v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14624

**作者：** Fadillah Adamsyah Maani、Numan Saeed、Jiaqi Ma、Dat Tien Nguyen、Youssef Wehbe、Duncan Watson-Parris、Salman Khan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14624v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14624v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文构建了覆盖 2000–2024 年、与 ERA5 63 变量对齐的 EarthAlign 多源事件与常态天气数据集，并提出双编码器框架 MeteoLIP，学习气象数据与语言的对齐表示，在跨模态检索、天气状态分类和物理变量估计三个下游任务上评估。

**相关性简评：** 其 MetTok 用地理与时间条件查询把变量级 patch embedding 聚合为紧凑气象 token 序列，可作为核查线索：这类条件化压缩是否保留任务必要信息，可能对 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与紧凑 token 的信息坍缩问题有方法借鉴。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** EarthAlign: Learning Language-Aligned Representations of Earth System Data

**abstract/A1：** Interpreting Earth system conditions is central to understanding environmental risks and informing decisions across weather- and climate-sensitive sectors. Existing multimodal weather systems primarily target task-specific prediction, generation, or question answering, while general-purpose alignment between Earth system data and language remains underexplored due to the limited availability of diverse language supervision grounded in meteorological conditions. To fill this gap, we introduce EarthAlign, a large-scale dataset with broad geographic coverage spanning 2000-2024 that combines 10 expert-curated natural event and disaster data sources with climatology-derived normal-weather samples. Each sample includes temporal and geospatial information and four grounded caption styles aligned with 63-variable ERA5 meteorological data. Building on EarthAlign, we introduce MeteoLIP, a dual-encoder framework for learning aligned meteorology-language representations. MeteoLIP incorporates MetTok, which uses a geolocation- and time-conditioned query to aggregate variable-specific patch embeddings into a compact sequence of meteorology tokens. To comprehensively assess Earth system multimodal representations, we introduce three downstream tasks: cross-modal retrieval, weather-condition classification, and physical variable estimation. Our experiments show that MeteoLIP improves upon the corresponding CLIP and SigLIP baselines across these tasks. Further analyses highlight the importance of meteorological input, temporal and geospatial conditioning, and multi-style supervision for meteorology-language alignment. Thus, EarthAlign and MeteoLIP provide a foundation for learning and evaluating language-aligned representations of Earth system data. Our code, dataset, and weights are publicly available at https://github.com/mbzuai-oryx/EarthAlign.

</details>

### 189. [PEARL: Process-Experience Aware Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14636v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14636

**作者：** Jie Yang、Mianqiu Huang、Yiwei Zhao、Bo Wang、Yang Liu、Yuxin Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14636v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14636v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** PEARL 提出无需额外 critic 的多轮 agent 强化学习框架：对同一历史的两条不同结局轨迹定位首次分歧，构建局部分支的决策特征并在成功/失败记忆库中聚类，识别反复出现的局部决策模式，从而有选择地强化低回报决策的负优势，在 AppWorld、ALFWorld 上取得提升。

**相关性简评：** 该工作属纯文本多轮 agent 的训练期信用分配，未涉及视觉或多模态内部状态；其「首次分歧定位＋模式记忆聚类」的局部贡献分配机制，可能为 LVR 轨迹训练中的中间步骤监督与贡献分配提供可核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PEARL: Process-Experience Aware Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Agents

**abstract/A1：** Terminal rewards make multi-turn agents trainable without step-level annotations, but group-relative advantages provide little guidance about which intermediate decisions to adjust. Failed trajectories also contain reasonable actions, while unfavorable decision patterns can recur as training proceeds. We introduce PEARL (Process-Experience Aware Reinforcement Learning), which improves local credit assignment without an additional critic. Given two continuations from the same history with different outcomes, PEARL locates their first divergence and builds a feature representation of each branch's local decision. It clusters these decision features in recent failure and success memories to identify recurring local patterns. Using this pattern memory, PEARL selectively strengthens negative advantages at lower-reward decisions, while leaving positive advantages and the base policy optimizer unchanged. On AppWorld, PEARL improves over ARPO on Normal and Challenge tasks at both 4B and 8B scales. On ALFWorld, it achieves 97.9% mean success at 4B, 2.7 points above the strongest baseline, while remaining competitive at 8B. Ablations of shaping location, success-bank filtering, and memory window support the value of selective, recurring-pattern-based updates.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14644

**作者：** Yaoxiang Wang、Kai Zhang、Ruobing Xie、Lanrui Wang、Guoliang Zhao、Junhui Li、Jinsong Su

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14644v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14644v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究 MoE 的专家形状设计：LatentMoE 把专家计算移入低维空间，使输入维度与中间宽度成为显式选择；作者证明局部 Jacobian 秩受二者共同上界约束，实验显示近方形专家最优，并用逐层内禀维度（ID）指导跨深度的专家数量与形状分配。

**相关性简评：** 用内禀维度指导逐层容量分配、以 Jacobian 秩刻画表示维度上界，可能为 LVR 中按层分配 latent 工作区宽度或计算预算、以及诊断表示维度坍缩提供可核查的方法线索；但该「latent」指低维专家空间，与 latent 推理无关，需人工判断迁移可行性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Shaping Latent Mixture-of-Experts: From Expert Geometry to Layerwise Capacity Allocation

**abstract/A1：** Fine-grained mixture-of-experts (MoE) models commonly increase expert count by narrowing each expert, treating expert shape as a by-product of routing granularity. LatentMoE moves expert computation into a lower-dimensional space, exposing the input dimension and intermediate width of each expert as explicit design choices. We show that an expert's local Jacobian rank is jointly bounded by these two dimensions, and that balancing them maximizes the rank ceiling at fixed per-expert parameters. Controlled shape sweeps across model scales and routing granularities consistently favor near-square experts. We further use layerwise intrinsic dimension (ID) to guide capacity allocation across depth, co-varying the number and shape of experts while keeping per-layer parameter count, activated FLOPs, and communication volume constant. Compared with layer-homogeneous baselines, our ID-guided allocation achieves lower validation loss and stronger downstream performance. These results establish expert shape and layerwise allocation as practical design axes for MoEs.

</details>

### 191. [Prospective Forcing: Learning to Look Ahead for Autoregressive Long Video Diffusion](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14654v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14654

**作者：** Yifan Shen、Yewei Xia、Gongxu Luo、Peiyuan Zhu、Boyang Sun、Zhenhao Chen、Guangyi Liu、Guangyi Chen、Kun Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14654v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14654v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Prospective Forcing，在滚动窗口自回归视频生成器上挂接多个按时间偏移区分的轻量预测头，用不同未来偏移的 chunk 共同监督共享历史表示，推理时还用可学习验证器采纳未来预测以跳过骨干执行，否则回退到标准自回归生成。

**相关性简评：** 属视频生成，不直接研究多模态推理；但「多偏移监督迫使历史状态保留长程可用信息」与「验证器接受/拒绝候选并回退」可能为 LVR 中预测工作区的长度泛化、latent 状态信息保留及 STOP 与计算成本权衡提供可核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Prospective Forcing: Learning to Look Ahead for Autoregressive Long Video Diffusion

**abstract/A1：** Autoregressive video generators synthesize long videos through chunk-wise rollouts, yet they are typically trained to predict only the immediate future. This limited prediction horizon makes it challenging to maintain video quality over extended rollouts. To address this problem, we introduce Prospective Forcing, a multi-head prediction framework that injects long-range predictive signals into autoregressive video representations. Built on a rolling-window generator, Prospective Forcing attaches lightweight, offset-specific heads that share the same conditioning information and independently predict chunks at different future temporal offsets. By extending supervision beyond the next chunk, these heads encourage the shared history representation to retain information useful for longer-horizon prediction, supporting temporally consistent generation. At inference time, we accelerate sampling by using accepted future-chunk predictions to skip full-window backbone executions. We equip the head with learnable embeddings to generate multiple candidates for the next chunk, and a learned verifier either selects a candidate or rejects all and falls back to standard autoregressive generation.

</details>

### 192. [Ascent Conditions for Length-Normalized Single-Rollout Policy Updates](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14670v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14670

**作者：** Levin David Schwab

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14670v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14670v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在有限轨迹模型下研究将每条轨迹分数贡献除以实际长度后的策略更新方向，为三结果 softmax 策略推导出精确上升阈值，并给出长度归一化导致期望更新反而降低任务成功率、局部符号反转的二元奖励例子，另提出无偏的三阶 U 统计量估计一阶回报变化。

**相关性简评：** 其「长度归一化会改变策略更新方向」的结论，可供核查在长链推理（含 latent 或文本轨迹）上做长度归一化训练时，贡献分配与信用分配是否出现类似偏差。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Ascent Conditions for Length-Normalized Single-Rollout Policy Updates

**abstract/A1：** Dividing each trajectory's score contribution by its realized length can change the direction of a reward-centered policy update. In a finite trajectory model, we derive an exact ascent threshold for a three-outcome softmax policy and exhibit a binary-reward example in which the expected Euclidean update decreases task success. Natural-gradient ascent holds for fully controllable outcome distributions with deterministic binary labels, but can fail under a one-parameter restriction. A third-order U-statistic estimates the first-order return change without bias from independent current-policy trajectories, one per request. In the example, a same-sample plug-in estimator instead has the opposite sign in expectation for batch sizes two through forty-nine. Exact policy-grid enumeration confirms the local sign reversal. In a branching process, length-normalized learning initially loses return, then recovers and exceeds the unnormalized comparator. The analysis concerns the expected update field at the current policy.

**comment/C1：** 16 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables; code and data included as ancillary files

</details>

### 193. [Competition Domains Matter: Selective Head Globalization for Training-Free Sparse Attention in Video Diffusion Transformers](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14672v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14672

**作者：** Tiantian Liu、Meng Wan、Zhiqiang Liang、Jue Wang、Ningming Nie、Yangang Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14672v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14672v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出免训练稀疏注意力框架 EG-Sparse，按注意力头熵值把低熵头路由到跨头分组竞争池、高熵头保留逐行局部选择，仅用稀疏流程已有分数；在视频扩散 Transformer 上以诊断实验和四种配置表明该竞争域自适应可提升视频质量并降低注意力密度与去噪延迟。

**相关性简评：** 其「竞争域」设定与按头熵值差异化路由 token 选择的机制，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选范围和注意力结构对 latent 相似度的影响提供可核查线索，但该工作面向视频扩散生成效率，与多模态推理状态的关联需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Competition Domains Matter: Selective Head Globalization for Training-Free Sparse Attention in Video Diffusion Transformers

**abstract/A1：** Training-free sparse attention is a practical route to efficient video diffusion transformer inference, yet existing methods typically fix the competition domain at each query row for every attention head. Prior work primarily addresses how to estimate token-level importance within this fixed domain; whether the domain itself should adapt to head heterogeneity remains under-specified. We introduce EG-Sparse, a training-free framework that routes low-entropy heads to a grouped cross-head pool while retaining per-row local selection for high-entropy heads, using only scores already materialized by the sparse pipeline. A controlled diagnostic fixes the ranking score and varies only the competition rule: grouped cross-head selection reduces low-entropy-head reconstruction error by 9.8%, whereas forcing high-entropy heads into an all-head global pool increases it by 7.9%. Across four configurations, EG-Sparse achieves higher video quality while reducing attention density and GPU denoising latency compared with strong training-free sparse-attention baselines. Mechanism ablations further show that selective domain adaptation outperforms uniform, random, and fixed domain-assignment policies. These results support competition-domain adaptation as a distinct design axis within centroid-guided training-free sparse attention.

</details>

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CAST-ASD: Causal Attention over Speakers and Time for Online Active Speaker Detection

**abstract/A1：** We present CAST-ASD (Causal Attention over Speakers and Time), a causal joint model for active speaker detection (ASD). Recent ASD models improve performance by jointly processing all faces in a scene, but operate offline, with the full clip available before any frame is labelled. Low-latency causal detectors instead process each face independently. CAST-ASD combines joint face reasoning with fully causal inference. It applies scene-level attention across faces within the current frame and causal temporal attention over each face's history, enabling information sharing across speakers with zero lookahead. Its parameter count does not grow with the number of faces. On MSDWild, where most negative face-frames contain a visible competing speaker, CAST-ASD reduces competing-speaker false alarms by 32% relative to the causal per-face detector it extends, with larger gains as scene occupancy increases. It outperforms all causal baselines on both validation splits while using only one-tenth the inter-speaker parameters of a three-block fixed-roster convolution. Code and models are available at https://github.com/prathamg007/CAST-ASD.

**内容简述：** 面向印度手语识别，提出融合运动学条件自适应 GCN 与距离感知 Elastic Transformer 的混合框架，用熵驱动 SVD 采样挑选关键帧，并新建 120 类原生数据集，报告 89.8% 准确率。

**相关性简评：** 熵驱动关键帧采样与针对不规则时间间隔的连续双位置编码，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、稀疏帧下的位置与缓存表示提供可供核查的方法线索，但论文本身不涉及 latent 推理或 VLM 推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A Hybrid Kinematic GCN and Elastic Transformer for Efficient Indian Sign Language Recognition

**abstract/A1：** Sign Language Recognition (SLR) presents complex challenges due to variable signing speeds and spatial intricacies. Specifically, Indian Sign Language (ISL) requires precise modeling of its inherently bimanual nature and is bottlenecked by the scarcity of large-vocabulary benchmarks and the inability of standard models to handle irregular signing velocities. To address this, a structurally-aware hybrid framework for efficient, gloss ISL recognition is proposed. To minimize computational redundancy, an entropy-driven SVD sampler that dynamically extracts informative keyframes is used. Because this subsampling creates irregular physical time gaps, the proposed architecture employs a Continuous Dual Positional Encoding paired with a distance-aware Elastic Transformer to preserve natural signing rhythm. Spatially, a Kinematically-Conditioned Adaptive GCN explicitly models bimanual geometry using unified bone-joint features. To validate our framework, a 120-class, 9,453-video native ISL dataset is created. Augmented by Physical Node Dropout and ArcFace optimization to mitigate subject-specific memorization, our framework achieves a competitive 89.8% accuracy, establishing a strong baseline for complex sign language modeling.

</details>

**内容简述：** 论文把原理演化型科学智能体的修订过程重构为「证据准入」问题，提出 TRIAGE-PIEVO：异常驱动的搜索用于立即引导搜索方向，而只有经独立验证的证据才被允许改写持久原则，被矛盾的原则则被撤回。

**相关性简评：** 其分阶段验证门控与「准入—撤回」机制，可能为 LVR 中筛选进入推理状态的视觉证据、抑制噪声观察引发错误状态更新提供方法线索，可供核查其验证信号是否独立于被检验的假设。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Triage-PiEvo: Evidence Admission for Principle-Evolving Scientific Agents

**abstract/A1：** Large language model (LLM)-based AI Scientists advance scientific discovery, yet they suffer from inefficiencies due to noisy observations. Existing principle-evolving agents act on every anomaly, leaving its source unresolved: a new mechanism or an evaluation artifact, so invalid revisions bias evolution. To address this, we formulate revision as evidence admission: anomalies steer search immediately, but only independently verified evidence may rewrite persistent principles, and contradicted principles are retracted. We realize this in TRIAGE-PIEVO , which pairs an anomaly-responsive search portfolio with a staged verification gate that alone controls what enters principle state. Across four scientific tasks with three backbones, TRIAGE-PIEVO (1) attains the highest average solution quality with +7.5%~11.8% over the strongest baseline per backbone, matching the strongest baseline's full-budget quality with one-third of the evaluation budget on Qwen3-235B; and additional stress tests and cross-harness deployment demonstrate that (2) in constructed stress tests, it admits none of the corrupted, hidden-source, or exploit evidence that ungated variants admit, while missing no planted mechanism, and (3) plugged unchanged into three external research harnesses, it cuts false evidence admissions by over 60% and raises verified scores by 31%~43%.

</details>

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Demiurge，一条基于动态 4D 点云记忆缓存的自回归视频重渲染流水线，结合外观扩散模型、记忆一致深度补全、双流 warping 与几何感知精修，实现跨相机轨迹一致的 4D 世界生成。

**相关性简评：** 其「记忆缓存 + 几何一致更新」可看作跨步骤累积状态的更新与漂移抑制机制，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据的长期保存、状态更新一致性提供借鉴线索；但论文面向视频与世界模型生成，与 VLM 推理主线关联间接，需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Demiurge: Forging Navigable 4D Worlds via Autoregressive Video Rerendering

**abstract/A1：** Recent advances in video diffusion enable novel-view video synthesis from a single input video, supporting world modeling, embodied intelligence, and robotic simulation. However, existing methods process camera trajectories independently, lacking the cross-trajectory consistency needed for coherent, navigable 4D worlds. We introduce Demiurge, an autoregressive video rerendering pipeline built on a dynamic 4D point-cloud memory cache. It promotes cross-trajectory consistency through four components: (1) an appearance video diffusion model that synthesizes photorealistic novel-view videos conditioned on the 4D memory; (2) a memory-consistent video depth completion model that aligns known-region depths with cached geometry and completes missing regions, mitigating scale ambiguity and discontinuities during memory updates; (3) memory-aware dual-stream warping that provides high-fidelity visual guidance and occlusion cues for novel-view synthesis; and (4) geometry-aware video refinement that enhances perceptual quality. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance and three key capabilities: coherent spatiotemporal lattice construction over dense multi-view trajectories; large-parallax video rerendering under challenging camera motions, including 180-degree rotations with no input-view overlap; and geometry-faithful outputs that can be directly optimized into high-quality 3D Gaussian Splatting representations with minimal artifacts. Project page: https://hanxinzhu-lab.github.io/demiurge\_project\_page/.

</details>

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究如何在 transformer PDE 代理模型中显式表示外生场（如介质密度、障碍几何），提出 Patchwise Adaptive Normalization（PAdaNorm），将外生场切块并与状态 token 对齐做归一化调制，在三个 PDE 数据集上评估长程自回归精度、硬物理约束维持与推理开销。

**相关性简评：** 其「切块与 token 化对齐的调制」及静态条件下缓存 conditioning embedding 的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据如何注入内部状态、以及深度/缓存对 latent 表示的影响提供可供核查的机制线索，但属远域迁移推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** One-Way Coupling via Patchwise Adaptive Normalization in Transformer Surrogates

**abstract/A1：** Many physical systems exhibit one-way coupling: exogenous fields such as medium density or obstacle geometry influence the dynamics without being affected by them. We investigate how explicitly representing these fields can improve the accuracy and computational efficiency of transformer-based PDE surrogates. Building on spatially adaptive normalization, we introduce Patchwise Adaptive Normalization (PAdaNorm), which partitions exogenous fields into patches aligned with the state tokenization. We evaluate PAdaNorm on datasets from three different domains, using a Walrus-inspired transformer architecture. Across the three PDE families, PAdaNorm is on par with or up to 16% better than parameter-matched baselines in mean long-horizon variance-scaled RMSE on 60-step autoregressive rollouts. We also find that PAdaNorm better maintains hard physical constraints over long rollouts, such as preventing flow into impenetrable solid regions in porous media. When the conditioning is static, PAdaNorm caches the conditioning embeddings once and reuses them across the entire rollout, reducing inference FLOPs per step by up to 36% compared with parameter-matched baselines. An ablation over eight conditioning variants shows that modulating a single attention axis (temporal or spatial) suffices and that a lightweight shared MLP across blocks remains competitive with per-block projections.

</details>

### 199. [Accelerating Cross-Model LLM Inference via Attention Map Reuse](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14688v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14688

**作者：** Zhan Jin、Yuze Luo、Bin Cui、Xupeng Miao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14688v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14688v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 MapFlow：在异构 LLM 服务中不复用 KV 状态，而是复用跨模型更可迁移的 attention map，通过部分重算、轻量线性变换、块级稀疏压缩与融合检索核降低预填充延迟并保持生成质量。

**相关性简评：** 其把 attention map 视为可跨模型复用的状态、并以块级稀疏与检索选取保留部分，可能为 LVR 中注意力结构对 latent 相似度的影响以及视觉证据筛选提供线索，但该文为纯文本推理效率工作，与多模态推理机制的联系需人工核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Accelerating Cross-Model LLM Inference via Attention Map Reuse

**abstract/A1：** LLM-augmented data workflows often involve multiple heterogeneous models operating over substantial shared context, such as schemas, tool specifications, interaction history, and intermediate results. Although prefix caching can reduce prefilling overhead, existing approaches are largely limited to reuse within the same model because KV states are tightly coupled to model-specific architectures. We present MapFlow, a system for efficient heterogeneous LLM serving via cross-model attention map reuse. Instead of reusing KV states, MapFlow reuses attention maps, which capture token dependency patterns and are more transferable across models. To enable efficient and accurate reuse, we combine partial recomputation with lightweight linear translation across layers and heads. To make attention reuse practical for long contexts, we further introduce block-level sparse compression and a fused retrieval kernel. Experiments show that MapFlow reduces prefilling latency and improves end-to-end serving efficiency while preserving generation quality across heterogeneous model pairs and multi-turn routing workloads. These results suggest that attention maps provide an effective reusable state for heterogeneous LLM serving, especially in prefix-heavy data workflows. Our code is available: https://github.com/PKU-DAIR/MapFlow.

</details>

**内容简述：** 论文研究在 5.01B 文本到视频扩散 transformer 上引入显式点对应监督时的张力，提出置信度加权的轨迹与可见性头、零初始化残差反馈和非对称 PCGrad，并报告 1000 步多种子消融与 24 提示评测的轨迹误差和 VBench 表现。

**相关性简评：** 其非对称 PCGrad 只在共享 LoRA 参数上剔除与主目标是冲突的辅助梯度分量，可能为 LVR 中辅助视觉监督与主推理目标的贡献分配及梯度冲突缓解提供训练期线索，可供核查是否可迁移到 latent 状态训练。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AcrossVAM2.0: Conflict-Aware Point Supervision for Parameter-Efficient Video Diffusion Adaptation

**abstract/A1：** Explicit point correspondence is attractive for adapting video generators: it describes how visible surfaces move, but can overwrite the appearance prior learned by a large pretrained model. We study this tension in a 5.01B-parameter text-to-video diffusion transformer. ACROSSVAM2.0 combines a confidence-weighted track-and-visibility head, zero-initialized residual feedback, and asymmetric PCGrad that removes only the auxiliary component opposing the primary flow-matching gradient on shared LoRA parameters. The design preserves the generator exactly at initialization and protects its primary update during adaptation. In a four-way ablation trained for 1,000 steps with three independent seeds, the full method lowers KLT forward-backward cycle error in all three seeds relative to a matched flow-only continuation (mean seed-level difference -0.00711, SD 0.00505), while robust sharpness remains positive in all three. An expanded 24-prompt evaluation (216 videos) yields 9.7% lower aggregate CoTracker3 cycle error than the matched control and near-matched performance on six VBench dimensions; however, the seed-level tracking effect is heterogeneous and I3D-FVD regresses from 0.1824 to 0.2022. These results support a bounded claim: conflict-aware adaptation improves correspondence consistency without broad perceptual degradation, but does not uniformly improve video quality. We release equations, pseudocode, matched outputs, source tables, and artifact provenance.

**comment/C1：** ICLR conference

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14710v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14710v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** DeKoR 针对 GNN 与 LLM 知识空间不匹配且融合代价高的问题，将 LLM 知识分解为局部与全局两个互补视图，以 LLM 作离线教师蒸馏到轻量专家，并用自适应路由器为每个节点学习对各专家的依赖比例。

**相关性简评：** 其「离线教师蒸馏 + 按节点自适应路由」的机制可供核查是否迁移到 LVR 中对视觉 latent 与参数知识的选择性使用，但本文面向文本属性图学习，与多模态推理主线无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DeKoR: Decomposed Knowledge Routing for Efficient GNN--LLM Fusion

**abstract/A1：** Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong potential for text-attributed graph learning by leveraging rich pre-trained knowledge and language understanding capabilities. Combining LLMs with Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) offers a promising paradigm for expanding the modeling capabilities of graph learning. However, LLMs and GNNs follow distinct learning paradigms, leading to a pronounced mismatch between their knowledge spaces. Such discrepancies make effective knowledge fusion nontrivial. Moreover, existing methods often incur substantial additional computation for only limited performance gains. To address these challenges, we propose DeKoR, an efficient framework for GNN and LLM knowledge fusion. To enable efficient knowledge transfer, DeKoR decomposes LLM knowledge into complementary local and global views and uses the LLM as an offline teacher to distill them into lightweight experts. To enable selective knowledge fusion, an adaptive router learns how much each node should rely on each expert. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that DeKoR outperforms existing baselines on both node and subgraph classification, achieving superior effectiveness and efficiency.

**comment/C1：** 19 pages

</details>

**内容简述：** 提出 SEGA 框架用于测试时发现（TTD）：用 LLM 为已知类生成属性描述，训练出属性锚定的视觉-语义空间，并在测试时以相似/相异已知类锚点做关系语义 grounding，生成候选概念后在语义空间中重排，再用置信度引导语义稳定，使匿名聚类变为可解释概念。

**相关性简评：** 其「关系锚点+LLM 候选概念生成+语义空间重排+置信度稳定」可能为 LVR 的 latent 假设生成、视觉证据筛选与停止决策提供方法线索，但该工作针对开集类别发现而非多模态推理，迁移性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Relational Semantic Grounding for Test-Time Discovery

**abstract/A1：** Test-Time Discovery (TTD) aims to recognize known classes and detect novel ones from a continuous unlabeled test stream after deployment. Existing TTD methods mainly rely on visual clustering or prototype comparison, and can only assign anonymous labels to discovered classes, leaving them difficult to interpret in open-world applications. In this paper, we propose SEGA, a Semantic Grounding with Attributes framework for TTD. SEGA leverages large language models to generate attribute-rich descriptions for known classes and constructs an attribute-anchored visual-semantic space during training. At test time, we introduce Relational Semantic Grounding (RSG), which grounds unknown samples with similar and dissimilar known-class anchors, prompts the LLM to generate candidate concepts, and reranks them in the learned semantic space. The selected concept is further used for confidence-guided test-time semantic stabilization. By coupling attribute-level semantic alignment with relational concept grounding, SEGA transforms anonymous test-time clusters into interpretable semantic concepts. Experiments show that SEGA improves TTD baselines with the promise of semantic grounding for open-world.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 MHWA 多时间尺度层级 world-action 模型，用跨步高层上下文通道降低全局上下文更新频率以抑制自回归 rollout 的漂移累积，并借 context-aware routing 依全局上下文与当前观测动态重配底层专家；在 14 个 Atari 游戏离线数据上以 77M 参数取得 0.884 的 IQM HNS。

**相关性简评：** 其多时间尺度 latent 状态更新频率与按上下文路由的 gating，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的更新节奏、误差累积与长度泛化提供可核查的设计线索，但论文面向离线 RL 世界模型，与视觉推理的具体联系仍待确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MHWA: Multi-timescale Hierarchical World-Action Model

**abstract/A1：** Autoregressive world models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for sample efficient decision making, yet their open loop rollouts often exhibit increasing drift that leads to error accumulation even within a relatively small planning horizon. Hierarchical temporal abstraction is a natural candidate to mitigate such drift by reducing the effective prediction horizon; however, existing hierarchical designs can introduce added structural and conceptual complexity, sometimes making them difficult to control and limiting gains over flat baselines. To this end, we introduce MHWA (Multi-timescale Hierarchical World-Action model), which employs a strided high level context channel to reduce global context update frequency, effectively curbing the propagation of compounding drift. Crucially, via context aware routing, the gating network dynamically reconfigures a low level mixture of experts by using both global context and current observations, thereby enabling flexible high-low coordination, helping alleviate interference commonly observed in static hierarchies. Empirically, using RLiable's seed-by-game aggregation, MHWA (77M parameters) achieves an IQM human normalized score (HNS) of 0.884 across three training seeds on a 14-game Atari subset using 10% subsampled offline data, outperforming a matched JOWA-70M baseline (0.529) and achieving numerically comparable performance to JOWA-150M while using nearly half the parameters and 70.88% fewer training FLOPs per sequence.

**内容简述：** 提出 VitaBench，一个面向语言智能体长期记忆生命周期的基准，用重复记忆审查与全时域反事实评估，量化记忆应保持精确、压缩、整合还是删除的表示决策，并给出生命周期 headroom 等诊断指标与一个延迟生命周期策略。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** VitaBench: Memory Lifecycles Beyond Retrieval

**abstract/A1：** Long-term memory benchmarks for language agents primarily evaluate whether information from earlier interactions can be retrieved and used when relevant. Persistent memory systems face an additional problem before future use is known: deciding whether a memory should remain exact, be compressed, consolidated, or deleted. Existing benchmarks capture long-range retrieval, temporal reasoning, evidence reuse, and incremental interaction, but do not directly evaluate these earlier representation decisions. We formalize memory lifecycle evaluation and introduce VitaBench, a benchmark that makes lifecycle decisions measurable through repeated memory reviews and full-horizon counterfactual evaluation. VitaBench contains a controlled Diagnostic tier that isolates future-use patterns and a Naturalistic tier that composes them into generated customer-service-style interaction streams. We characterize lifecycle decision structure with three diagnostics: lifecycle headroom, measuring the advantage of adaptive choices over the best fixed strategy; horizon reversal, measuring when short-horizon decisions change under delayed consequences; and optimal-action diversity, measuring whether different memory states favor different lifecycle operations. Across both tiers, VitaBench exhibits substantial lifecycle structure: lifecycle headroom is 1.364 in Diagnostic and 1.405 in Naturalistic, and 60.2% and 56.5% of states, respectively, change their preferred action between short and full horizons. A learned delayed lifecycle policy further improves over the best fixed strategy on VitaBench-Naturalistic, reaching 101.5 versus 83.4 joint utility. These results show that retrieving past information and deciding how it should persist are distinct evaluation problems, and that lifecycle management requires evaluation of the delayed consequences of representation decisions.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Continual Learning in the Era of Foundation Models and Embodied Agents (CL4FMAgents)

</details>

### 205. [Align-VAE: Aligning Attention and Geometry in VecSet VAEs for 3D Reconstruction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14734v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14734

**作者：** Huaizhi Qu、Mingxin Yang、Xintong Han、Fangneng Zhan、Chunchao Guo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14734v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14734v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文考察 VecSet VAE 中 latent token 是否真正与几何对齐，诊断出注意力汇聚式 token、注意力响应的空间周期性重复、编解码查询法线信息不一致、SDF 与法线关系缺乏监督四类问题，并用共享可学习 decoder token 工作区、距离偏置交叉注意力、无编码器查询和 Poisson 式正则加以修正，在 ABO 上将 Chamfer 距离降低 26.6%。

**相关性简评：** 其关于 latent 与几何对齐的诊断（注意力汇聚、检索偏置、共享工作区）可能为 LVR 中 latent 内容保真、注意力结构与视觉证据筛选提供可核查的方法线索，但属 3D 重建任务，迁移性需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Align-VAE: Aligning Attention and Geometry in VecSet VAEs for 3D Reconstruction

**abstract/A1：** Set-based variational autoencoders (VecSet VAEs) represent 3D shapes as compact sets of latent tokens. Although each token originates from a query at a sampled surface location, whether these latents truly align with geometry remains unclear. We investigate this alignment and identify four issues: (i) attention-sink-like tokens that attract queries from across the shape; (ii) spatially periodic repetitions in decoder attention responses; (iii) mismatched normal information in encoder and decoder query features; and (iv) missing supervision of the intrinsic relation between signed distance fields and surface normals. To address these issues, we introduce Align-VAE with four corresponding modifications: (i) a shared bank of learnable decoder tokens provides a workspace for global computation; (ii) distance-biased cross-attention guides retrieval toward nearby predicted spatial anchors; (iii) normal-free encoder queries align the two stages' access to normal information while retaining normals in the encoder keys and values; and (iv) a screened Poisson-inspired regularizer supervises surface values and normal-direction derivatives. These changes align latent retrieval and field prediction with geometry without enlarging the per-shape code. On the ABO dataset, Align-VAE reduces Chamfer distance by 26.6% compared to the standard VecSet VAE.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出工具增强策略智能体 TASA：依据优化轨迹为每一步规划策略，把 OPRO 式的候选生成过程拆解为可追踪的策略选择，并用 LLM 构造问题专用工具，由策略引导的自适应工具规划器利用轨迹信息更新解，在统一候选评估预算下验证解质量与可追踪性。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本组合优化工作，但其把轨迹摘要当可追踪状态、以策略选择驱动自适应工具调用的做法，可能与 LVR 中推理状态更新、动态计算分配与停止决策相关，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Think in Strategies, Act with Tools: Traceable Agentic Optimization for Combinatorial Problems

**abstract/A1：** Optimization by PROmpting (OPRO) directly leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate candidate solutions through natural-language prompting. However, OPRO's optimization process is difficult to track, which prevents LLMs from capturing useful information accumulated over previous iterations, thereby limiting solution quality. To address this limitation, we propose a Tool-Augmented Strategic Agent (TASA) which summarizes and exploits trajectory to improve solution quality. Specifically, TASA plans the strategy for each step based on the optimization trajectory, which decomposes the optimization process into traceable strategy selections. Moreover, we leverage LLM to construct problem-specific tools and introduce a strategy-guided adaptive tool planner, which efficiently utilizes the information of trajectory to update solutions. We establish local convergence under persistent exploration and evaluate the complete framework under a shared candidate-evaluation budget. The results support its solution quality and the traceability of strategy-guided search.

</details>

### 207. [PTGPO: Prefix Tree Group Policy Optimization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14737v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14737

**作者：** Ruolin Chen、Yang Li、Jihang Wang、Zhuoya Zhao、Yuchen Liu、Jiaming Xu、Qian Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14737v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14737v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 PTGPO：一种无需 critic 的组策略优化方法，在 anchor-state 组内对轨迹后缀构建前缀树，以每个树边父子经验回报均值之差作为信用，为长程交互任务提供细粒度学习信号，并在 ALFWorld、WebShop、Sokoban 上超过 RL 基线。

**相关性简评：** 其「边级条件回报差分」为 LVR 中隐式中间推理步骤的贡献分配与轨迹监督提供了可供核查的方法线索，但实验限于纯文本交互 agent，是否可迁移到视觉 latent 状态与多模态推理步骤尚需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PTGPO: Prefix Tree Group Policy Optimization

**abstract/A1：** Training language agents on long-horizon interactive tasks is challenging because sparse terminal rewards provide weak credit signals for intermediate actions. Existing group-based methods either assign a shared trajectory-level advantage or estimate step-level advantages from state groups, which may conflate the current action with subsequent decisions. We propose Prefix Tree Group Policy Optimization (PTGPO), a critic-free method that constructs prefix trees over trajectory suffixes within anchor-state groups. PTGPO assigns each tree edge a credit given by the difference between its child and parent empirical mean returns, capturing the conditional return change revealed by each additional action. These prefix-tree credits provide fine-grained learning signals without requiring a critic or additional rollouts. Experiments on interactive benchmarks ALFWorld, WebShop and Sokoban show that PTGPO consistently improves over RL baselines, demonstrating its effectiveness.

</details>

### 208. [Equal-information evaluation of credit assignment in modular financial reinforcement learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14750v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14750

**作者：** Gennadiy Chistiakov、Yury Yanovich

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14750v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14750v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对模块化金融强化学习中信用分配难以评估的问题，提出结合等信息重构对照、固定效用比较与预设下游守护条件的评估框架，并在更新分配、监督目标表示与组合风险控制三项受控研究中诊断出冗余归因信号等三类评估失败。

**相关性简评：** 其「等信息重构对照＋固定效用比较」的评估方法可能可供核查：用于判断被归因的信号（如 latent 状态）是否真正带来决策相关信息，对应 LVR 中贡献分配与「答案是否使用 latent 内容」的评估问题，但金融域差异较大、迁移仅为推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Equal-information evaluation of credit assignment in modular financial reinforcement learning

**abstract/A1：** Credit assignment in modular financial reinforcement learning is difficult to evaluate because an attributed signal may improve a component loss without adding decision-relevant information or improving economic outcomes. We propose an evaluation framework combining equal-information reconstruction controls, fixed-utility comparisons and prespecified downstream guardrails. The framework is instantiated in an attribution-guided modular trading architecture and tested in three controlled studies covering update allocation, supervision-target representation and portfolio risk control. We find that residual-based allocation is exactly reproduced by an ordinary loss-budget control under the disclosed interface; direct shortfall supervision improves component prediction but fails decoded-outcome preservation; and component-wise critic supervision worsens risk-condition certainty equivalent and drawdown relative to scalar supervision under fixed utility. These results identify three distinct evaluation failures: redundant attribution signals, representation-induced prediction trade-offs, and misalignment between component supervision and downstream risk outcomes. A preserved historical engineering case further shows why module-level learning claims require run-level provenance. The contribution is a reusable methodology for evaluating credit assignment in expert systems operating under partial observability, delayed feedback and economic risk constraints.

</details>

### 209. [CrossMean: Model Merging by Pairing Merged and Expert Activations](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14762v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14762

**作者：** Moshe Eliasof

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14762v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14762v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文将闭式模型合并形式化为线性系统，指出现有方法两侧使用同一矩阵，提出 CrossMean 用配对「已合并模型激活」与「专家激活」的双线性统计替换其中一侧，并由此导出无标签准则来预测哪些任务集合能从这一改动中获得更大提升。

**相关性简评：** 其逐层配对合并/专家激活统计的思路，可能为考察 latent 推理状态在多层传递中与原模型表示的一致性或缓存失配提供可供核查的方法线索，但该工作面向参数空间合并，与 VLM 推理无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CrossMean: Model Merging by Pairing Merged and Expert Activations

**abstract/A1：** Model merging combines fine-tuned experts into one network without retraining, and closed-form methods compute each merged layer from statistics of its input activations. However, these statistics are measured on a single expert, while in the merged model, each layer receives activations from the merged layers that precede it. Recent work re-measures these statistics in the merged model but still forms them from a single network. We formulate closed-form methods as a linear system and show that they use the same matrix on both sides. We then introduce CrossMean, which replaces this matrix on one side with a bilinear statistic that pairs merged and expert activations. From the same statistics, we also derive a label-free criterion that indicates the task sets in which accounting for the merged activations improves the merge more. Empirically, task sets with a lower criterion value show a larger improvement. On the eight-task benchmark of each vision backbone that we tested and on BERT encoders, CrossMean improves on merging with statistics measured on the experts, and with all linear layers merged, it also improves on re-measuring these statistics in the merged model. These results suggest that merging benefits from pairing merged and expert activations.

</details>

### 210. [CUSE: Fine-Grained Multimodal Unlearning with Counterfactual Guidance and On-Policy Self-Distillation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14763v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14763

**作者：** Chenlu Ding、Jiancan Wu、Yanchen Luo、Tianyu Zhang、Yancheng Yuan、Xiang Wang、Xiangnan He

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14763v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14763v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 CUSE，一个面向多模态大模型的反事实引导「在线自蒸馏」遗忘框架：先移除目标相关证据构造反事实输入，用 token 概率变化定位需更强遗忘的 token，再由冻结原模型在遗忘／保留特权上下文下做 token 级蒸馏，在 MLLMU-Bench 上同时改善遗忘与保留。

**相关性简评：** 其「移除视觉证据看 token 概率变化」的做法是一种细粒度因果归因信号，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据贡献分配、证据筛选与 token 级监督提供可核查的线索，但论文目标是遗忘而非推理状态，关联需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CUSE: Fine-Grained Multimodal Unlearning with Counterfactual Guidance and On-Policy Self-Distillation

**abstract/A1：** Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can reproduce sensitive, copyrighted, or unsafe information from their training data. Effective unlearning must remove target information while preserving non-target content, even within the same response. Existing methods typically apply uniform forgetting objectives to complete responses and rely on fixed, off-policy supervision, resulting in coarse token control and misalignment with the model's current behavior. We propose CUSE, a Counterfactual-guided Unlearning framework via on-policy Self-distillation for multimodal large language models. It first constructs counterfactual inputs by removing target-related evidence and uses the resulting changes in token probabilities to identify which tokens require stronger forgetting. It then distills token-level forgetting and retention targets on responses sampled from the current policy, with a frozen copy of the original model serving as the teacher model augmented with the corresponding forgetting- and retention-oriented privileged contexts. This design jointly determines what to forget and what to preserve. On MLLMU-Bench, CUSE reduces forget-set ROUGE-L by 33.6% while achieving 1.2% higher retain-set ROUGE-L than the strongest baseline.

</details>

### 211. [ProgAgent: Learning Tool Orchestration through Programmatic Training](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14774v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14774

**作者：** Hao Li、Keqing He、Longtao Zheng、Junlong Li、Weihao Zeng、Qian Liu、Yuzhen Huang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14774v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14774v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** ProgAgent 提出一套完整的 Programmatic Tool Calling（PTC）训练方案，包括可验证长时程任务合成流水线、轻量运行时和两阶段训练配方，让模型用可执行代码调用工具并把中间结果存入运行时变量而非上下文，在四个基准上取得高于同规模基线的通过率。

**相关性简评：** 其核心线索是把工具中间结果外化到运行时变量而非不断累积的上下文，以缓解 context rot，这与 LVR 关心的推理状态应否写入显式上下文、状态压缩与信息保真之间的权衡可能相通，可供核查其训练方式能否迁移到多模态推理状态的组织与监督。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ProgAgent: Learning Tool Orchestration through Programmatic Training

**abstract/A1：** Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly expected to orchestrate diverse tools over long-horizon tasks. Existing agents typically use Direct Tool Calling (DTC), where the model invokes tools sequentially, and tool responses accumulate in the model context, which can lead to context rot and orchestration breakdown. In contrast, Programmatic Tool Calling (PTC) invokes tools through executable code and stores intermediate results in runtime variables rather than appending them to the context. Prior work has explored PTC mainly as an inference-time optimization, but its benefits for agentic training remain unclear, and suitable verifiable training tasks are scarce. In this work, we introduce ProgAgent, a full PTC training stack, comprising a pipeline for synthesizing verifiable long-horizon tasks, a lightweight PTC runtime, and a two-stage training recipe. Using only 215 tasks instantiated at four environment scales, ProgAgent yields higher pass rates than the evaluated baselines of comparable size across four benchmarks. On LOCA-bench, ProgAgent-14B achieves a 30.7% pass rate at a 64k-token environment state, where these baselines score zero. Cross-harness experiments show that PTC-trained models outperform DTC-trained models under both evaluation interfaces, suggesting that the benefits of PTC training extend beyond the interface.

### 212. [LYNX: Analytical Program Synthesis via Grounding and Closed-Loop Refinement](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14777v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14777

**作者：** Ruichen Xia、Xiao Han、Dingyu Yang、Luwei Yang、Sai Wu、Dongxiang Zhang、Binhui Yao、Gang Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.DB

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14777v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14777v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** LYNX 是一个多智能体框架，把 LLM 数据分析（NL-to-SQL）建模为受 schema 与领域知识约束的分析问题，用规划—生成—验证—修正的闭环工作流、SSD-SAA 以及 delta 引导的迭代修订提升执行正确性，并在 BIRD-SQL Mini-Dev 与 Spider 2.0-Lite 上报告准确率与 token 效率。

**相关性简评：** 其「验证—修正」闭环、失败诊断与 stage-aware 资源分配可能为 LVR 的迭代状态修复、验证驱动的停止决策与动态算力分配提供可核查线索，但该任务为纯文本 SQL 合成，不含视觉表示，迁移需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LYNX: Analytical Program Synthesis via Grounding and Closed-Loop Refinement

**abstract/A1：** LLM-powered data analytics aims to translate natural language instructions into executable analytical programs over underlying data. However, existing approaches, whether treating LLMs as intent-to-code translators or as standalone analytical engines, often fail to reliably align domain semantics with complex schemas and heterogeneous metadata, resulting in brittle execution and semantically inconsistent analytical outputs in real-world workloads. We present LYNX, a multi-agent framework that formulates LLM-driven analytics as a schema- and knowledge-constrained analysis problem rather than a single-pass generation task. LYNX organizes analytical synthesis into a closed-loop workflow of planning, generation, verification, and refinement through three role-specialized agents that collaboratively enforce schema grounding, semantic consistency, and execution correctness. To address domain ambiguity and schema misalignment, LYNX integrates Semantic-Structural Distillation and Stage-Aware Allocation (SSD-SAA). A delta-guided iterative revision continuously diagnoses and repairs semantic and execution-level failures, substantially improving synthesis robustness. We evaluate LYNX on two NL-to-SQL benchmarks, BIRD-SQL Mini-Dev and the more challenging Spider 2.0-Lite. Experimental results demonstrate strong performance and efficiency, achieving 10.66% to 59.54% execution accuracy across lightweight and commercial models, while reducing token consumption by 70.53% compared with the prior most efficient method. Our framework displays high generalization over different backbones, from open-source, lightweight models to the latest commercial models. Additional case studies on quantitative finance analytics and complex multi-relational SQL workloads further demonstrate the framework's robustness, scalability, and practical applicability in real-world analytical scenarios.

</details>

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14802v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14802v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 YOUDrive：把多位教师的行为蒸馏为 task vector，形成规划器表示空间中的风格方向，推理时无需重训即可缩放与组合，并以 flow-matching 解码器生成多模态可行轨迹，同时给出风格对齐指标 SAS。

**相关性简评：** 「在表示空间中学习可缩放、可组合的方向」这一做法可能为 latent 推理状态的可控组合与叠加提供可核查线索，但论文属端到端驾驶任务，与 VLM 推理状态生成无直接关联，迁移性需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** YOUDrive: Driving Style as a Composable Direction for End-to-End Autonomous Driving

**abstract/A1：** End-to-end driving policies can achieve strong task performance while offering limited control over their driving style. Driving style describes how a vehicle accelerates, brakes, and maintains distance. Policies trained without explicit preference conditioning lack a direct mechanism for adjusting these behaviors at inference. We propose YOUDrive, a vision--language--action planner for continuous and composable driving-style control. Each teacher's behavior is distilled into a task vector, a learned parameter update that induces a style direction in the planner's representation. These directions can be scaled and combined at inference without retraining the backbone. Conditioned on these directions, a flow-matching decoder models a multimodal trajectory distribution and generates kinematically feasible motion alternatives. We introduce the Style Alignment Score (SAS) to describe human-referenced kinematic behavior after safety and task gating. On NAVSIM navtest, a single coefficient monotonically controls assertiveness across six teacher-derived personas, while PDMS remains above 0.90 across the tested individual and blended configurations, reaching 0.954. Further analyses reveal systematic policy-specific kinematics after controlling for scene context, whereas the evaluated discrete style labels provide limited additional explanatory power. Code, checkpoints, and the metric will be released.

### 214. [\[Re\] Boosting the Visual Interpretability of CLIP via Adversarial Fine-Tuning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14832v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14832

**作者：** Anton Nuzhdin、Andrei Gruzitski、Balázs Egyed、Aleksandr Raudvee

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文复现 ICLR 2025 的对抗微调（AFT）工作，核验其在提升 CLIP 图像编码器显著图质量、概念对齐、分布外迁移性以及零样本精度折衷方面的主张，并提出 Energy Pointing Game 损失，显式监督梯度显著图与目标物体的空间对齐。

**相关性简评：** 其显式监督显著图与目标物体空间对齐的训练目标，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与内部状态里视觉细节定位的监督设计提供可核查线索，但该工作面向编码器解释性，而非推理期 latent 状态生成。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** \[Re\] Boosting the Visual Interpretability of CLIP via Adversarial Fine-Tuning

**abstract/A1：** This paper presents a reproducibility study of \`\`Boosting the Visual Interpretability of CLIP via Adversarial Fine-Tuning'', published at ICLR 2025, which proposes an unsupervised adversarial fine-tuning (AFT) method with norm regularisation to enhance the visual interpretability of CLIP's image encoder. We attempt to reproduce the key claims regarding improved saliency map quality, increased concept alignment, transferability to out-of-distribution datasets, and the trade-off with zero-shot accuracy. Beyond reproduction, we propose a saliency-guided regularisation extension that introduces an Energy Pointing Game loss, directly supervising the spatial alignment of Simple Gradient saliency maps with target objects. We evaluate our extension across a range of saliency-loss weights and show that explicit saliency supervision \\rev{substantially} improves localisation metrics at a modest cost: the reduction in zero-shot accuracy and adversarial robustness is small at the lowest saliency-loss weight ($w\_s=0.2$) and moderate at the strongest setting ($w\_s=0.6$). We restructure the codebase for configurable, systematic experimentation.

</details>

### 215. [Getting Space Right: Agentic Rewards for Image Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14852v1>)
