摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对空间文生图强化学习中奖励不可靠、rollout 缺少由易到难进阶的问题，提出课程引导的 RL 框架：用带空间感知工具链的 agentic 奖励模型 SpatialCritic 做验证，并以能力图组织掌握度驱动的 rollout 与补救。

**相关性简评：** 其专用视觉工具、反事实偏好数据构造以及工具选择与证据整合对齐，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选和验证式监督设计提供方法线索；但对象是图像生成奖励而非推理状态，可迁移性待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Getting Space Right: Agentic Rewards for Image Generation

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement learning (RL) is promising for spatial text-to-image generation, but existing work largely focuses on policy optimization, assuming accurate rewards and effective online rollouts. We observe in-domain gains with out-of-domain degradation, exposing two limitations: unreliable spatial rewards in open-world settings and rollouts lacking basic-to-complex progression. We propose a curriculum-guided RL framework. First, we introduce SpatialCritic, an agentic reward model equipped with a spatial perception harness that combines reusable verification guidance with specialized vision tools. We then construct spatial preference datasets through targeted counterfactual perturbations and perform agent-harness alignment to improve tool selection and evidence integration efficiently. Second, curriculum learning organizes shared foundational capabilities and their compositional dependencies in a capability graph for mastery-guided rollouts, periodic review, and targeted remediation. On SpaRW-Eval, SpatialCritic achieves 95.1% verification accuracy, outperforming 320B GLM-5.3-Flash with a 40x smaller 8B backbone and raising average baseline scores from 78.4 to 83.9 on SD3.5-Medium and 83.2 to 86.5 on BAGEL. Project page: https://xiaofeng-tan.github.io/projects/spatialcritic/

**comment/C1：** 15 pages, 7 figures

</details>

### 216. [World2TS: Real-World Event Context for Time-Series Forecasting](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14861v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14861

**作者：** Zhiding Liu、Jiqian Yang、Mingyue Cheng、Zhi Li、Enhong Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14861v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14861v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 World2TS 框架与数据集：用 agent 驱动的语义推理、网络检索与人工复核流程，为时间序列发现并核验真实世界事件，共构建 31 个数据集与 5.6 万余条事件—序列链接，并实验验证外部事件上下文对预测的增益。

**相关性简评：** 其「发现候选事件—证据核实—在明确时间与语义范围内链接到受影响序列」的证据筛选流程，可供核查是否迁移到 LVR 的视觉证据筛选与证据归属环节；但与多模态 latent 推理的距离较远，迁移价值属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** World2TS: Real-World Event Context for Time-Series Forecasting

**abstract/A1：** Time-series forecasting plays a vital role in a wide range of real-world applications. Recent approaches have achieved strong performance by modeling temporal correlations and cross-channel dependencies, yet most forecasting benchmarks still represent time series primarily as numerical histories. In practice, time series are observations of complex real-world processes, and their trajectories may reflect events, interventions, disruptions, and changes in measurement or reporting that cannot always be inferred from past values alone. A central barrier to studying context-aware forecasting is therefore the lack of large-scale datasets that align real-world events with the individual series they affect. We present World2TS, a scalable construction framework and large-scale dataset for time-series forecasting with real-world event context. We first develop world2ts-core, a reusable tool that combines agent-led semantic reasoning and Web search, command-line execution and validation, and human review within a feedback-driven discovery workflow. Given heterogeneous time series with semantic descriptions, the workflow discovers candidate events, consolidates retrieved evidence into verified events, and links them to relevant series under explicit temporal and semantic scopes. Using this framework, we construct world2ts-data, which contains 31 datasets across six domains, comprising 4,179 series, 97.1 million observations, 1,159 events, and 56,846 event-series links. We further conduct extensive data analyses and controlled comparative experiments to characterize the dataset and demonstrate the utility of the collected context for improving forecasting accuracy. World2TS provides a reusable data foundation for developing and evaluating context-aware forecasting models and agents. The project homepage is available at https://world2ts.github.io/.

</details>

### 217. [WeatherBridge: Forecast-Aware Multi-Source Input Adaptation for Pretrained Weather Forecasting Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14863v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14863

**作者：** Mutian Xi、Xinyu Su、Xiaohui Zhong、Hao Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14863v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14863v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** WeatherBridge 研究在冻结预训练天气预报模型的前提下，用源条件适配器把异构业务 NWP 初始场映射到 ERA5 参考状态：以 Swin-UNet 预测结构化残差修正并在多尺度注入源嵌入，训练目标结合纬度加权重建与 One-step Rollout Alignment，使适配后的初始状态兼顾保真度与下游预报兼容性，并在 GFS/HRES/CMA 初始场和 FuXi、FengWu 上验证。

**相关性简评：** 「冻结主干 + 输入适配器 + 可微下游 rollout 对齐」的训练范式可能为 LVR 提供线索：在不更新推理模型时用下游目标驱动视觉侧适配，以缓解输入分布错配与信息坍缩，其可迁移性尚需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** WeatherBridge: Forecast-Aware Multi-Source Input Adaptation for Pretrained Weather Forecasting Models

**abstract/A1：** Data-driven weather forecasting models are commonly trained on ERA5, yet operational deployment must use timely initial states from physics-based numerical weather prediction (NWP) systems whose distributions differ substantially from ERA5. Direct initialization with these states can degrade autoregressive forecasts, motivating input adaptation that keeps the pretrained forecasting model unchanged. Here, we introduce WeatherBridge, a unified, source-conditioned adapter that maps heterogeneous operational NWP initial states to ERA5 reference states without updating the pretrained forecasting model. WeatherBridge predicts the structured residual corrections with a Swin-UNet and injects source embeddings across multiple spatial scales, allowing the model to capture shared atmospheric structure and source-specific discrepancies. Its training objective combines latitude-weighted ERA5 reconstruction with One-step Rollout Alignment (ORA), which backpropagates one-step forecast error through a frozen FuXi model to optimize the adapted states for both initial state fidelity and downstream forecast compatibility. We evaluate WeatherBridge using daily GFS, HRES, and CMA initializations from 1 January to 22 November 2025 across six variables and lead times up to 240 hours. Relative to raw source initialization of FuXi, WeatherBridge reduces the mean RMSE of FuXi over the 6- 240-hour rollout for 17 of 18 source-variable combinations, with a median reduction of 10.2% and a maximum reduction of 46.3%. The adapter trained with frozen FuXi also improves FengWu forecasts on GFS inputs without retraining either the adapter or FengWu. These results demonstrate that forecast-aware input adaptation can improve forecasts from heterogeneous operational NWP inputs and transfer across pretrained ERA5-based forecasting models.

</details>

### 218. [Beyond Outcome Feedback: Trajectory-Quality-Guided Experience-based Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14877v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14877

**作者：** Bingjie Zhang、Yibo Yang、Qiantong Liu、Benshuo Fu、Yi Chang、Dandan Guo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14877v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14877v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 TQG-Exp 框架，用轨迹质量损失（TQL）把任务完成度与执行过程质量结合为超越最终结果的学习信号，并以「有/无检索经验」的成对 rollout 差异估计被检索经验的贡献、更新其效用，再用效用与语义相关性共同指导检索，在 ALFWorld、WebShop、ScienceWorld 上验证。

**相关性简评：** 虽属纯文本 agent 经验学习、无视觉状态，但其用成对 rollout 的质量差做轨迹级贡献分配与效用更新的思路，可能可供核查 latent 轨迹训练中的监督信号与贡献分配问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Outcome Feedback: Trajectory-Quality-Guided Experience-based Learning

**abstract/A1：** Experience-based learning enables large language model (LLM) agents to improve over time by reusing knowledge from past executions. However, existing methods typically rely on final task outcomes as feedback for experience learning, overlooking the execution process and limiting their ability to evaluate and optimize experience based on trajectory quality. To address this limitation, we propose TQG-Exp, a trajectory-quality-guided experience-based learning framework that introduces process feedback. Specifically, we introduce Trajectory Quality Loss (TQL), which jointly considers task completion and process quality to provide a learning signal beyond final task outcomes. Based on this signal, we employ paired rollouts with and without retrieved experience to guide experience optimization. Representative trajectories are selected based on their outcomes and trajectory quality to extract task-level and task-type-level experiences. Meanwhile, differences in trajectory quality between the paired groups are used to estimate the contribution of retrieved experience and update its utility. The learned utility is then combined with semantic relevance to guide subsequent experience retrieval. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld with two backbone LLMs show that TQG-Exp outperforms existing experience-based methods, improving Avg.@3 over the strongest baseline by 4.50 and 8.55 percentage points on DeepSeek-V4-Flash and Qwen3.5-Flash, respectively.

</details>

### 219. [Bridging Risk Approximation Gaps in Model Predictive Task Sampling via In-Context Modeling](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14913v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14913

**作者：** Jiarong Wen、Qi Tao、Kaiyu Zhang、Yun Qu、Lizhou Cai、Heming Zou、Yuhang Jiang、Qi Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14913v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14913v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该工作形式化 model predictive task sampling 中风险预测模型的两个失效模式（优化历史稀疏、风险近似滞后一步），将风险预测重构为 in-context 序列建模，并加入一步前瞻与时间加权滑动窗口，在 Meta-RL、域随机化和 LLM 提示课程后训练中提升样本效率。

**相关性简评：** 以「历史轨迹 + in-context 序列建模 + 前瞻」预测任务难度与收益的方法线索，可能可供核查地迁移到 latent 推理轨迹的贡献分配、训练任务筛选或推理价值的预测，但原文不涉及视觉或多模态推理，联系较间接。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Bridging Risk Approximation Gaps in Model Predictive Task Sampling via In-Context Modeling

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement learning (RL) is essential for adaptive decision-making, e.g., robust Meta-RL and domain randomization (DR), and efficient post-training of large language models (LLMs), where tasks are commonly structured as Markov decision processes or prompts. A central bottleneck in all these settings is the cost of agent-environment interactions required for task selection and policy optimization. Model predictive task sampling (MPTS) has emerged as a promising approach to improve sample efficiency by querying informative tasks via a risk predictive model (RPM) trained on optimization history. However, existing RPMs suffer from two failure modes: (i) sparse optimization histories, which limit RPMs' generalization across the task space, and (ii) a one-step lag in risk approximation, which causes biased difficulty estimation as the policy evolves. This work formalizes these failure modes, derives lagged-risk decompositions that expose the resulting temporal bias, and recasts risk prediction as an in-context sequence modeling problem. The developed RPM integrates a one-step look-ahead mechanism with a temporal-weighted sliding window to mitigate data non-stationarity and scarcity, without requiring additional rollouts. Empirically, our approach yields more reliable difficulty estimates and consistent performance gains across robust Meta-RL, DR, and prompt curriculum RL post-training of LLMs.

</details>

### 220. [Representation Drift in Continual Learning: LoRA versus N-gram Memory](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14921v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14921

**作者：** Hao Wu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14921v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14921v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在一个带原生 N-gram 记忆的 48 层 MoE 模型上，用七个任务的链式训练比较三种持续更新方式（只更新 N-gram 表、共享 LoRA、每任务 LoRA 后合并），在每个层级与任务边界采集固定上下文表示，量化漂移并分析其与遗忘、logit margin 变化的关系。

**相关性简评：** 其「逐层、固定上下文、以不同更新机制对比」的内部表示漂移度量思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态在生成或更新后保留了多少任务必要信息；但研究对象为纯文本持续学习，与视觉多模态推理无直接关联，属于方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Representation Drift in Continual Learning: LoRA versus N-gram Memory

**abstract/A1：** A language model that keeps learning online must not slowly erode its own base capabilities. We ask which part of a modern LLM should absorb continual updates, by measuring how each choice changes the model's internal representations. On a 48-layer mixture-of-experts model with a native pretrained N-gram memory, we train a seven-task chain under three update mechanisms with identical data and budgets: updating only the N-gram memory table, continually training one shared LoRA adapter, and training a fresh LoRA per task that is merged into the backbone. We capture fixed-context representations at every layer and task boundary. Updating only the N-gram memory changes the base model's representations of general math and code inputs by 26%/15% (relative RMS), against 64%/35% for merged and 97%/39% for shared LoRA. This drift does not grow with the number of tasks: it reaches 25% after the first task and stays there for all seven, while both LoRA variants keep accumulating. Its generic behaviour is essentially unchanged (no code problem lost, math NLL -0.01), and every change is confined to inspectable, reversible table rows. The cost appears elsewhere: N-gram memory acquires new tasks more weakly and its stored tasks interfere with one another, losing as much old-task NLL as shared LoRA. We show that this forgetting is governed by drift on the learned tasks' own inputs, measured from the checkpoint at which each was learned, not by generic drift (Spearman rho=0.85; rho=0.71 on Llama-3-8B), and we derive the exact relations behind it: with a frozen head, every pairwise logit margin changes by the projection of drift onto a head-difference direction. These results support a design principle for long-running online learning: write new knowledge only into the memory table and keep the backbone fixed; the remaining problem, interference between stored tasks, then lies inside the memory.

**comment/C1：** 28 pages, 7 figures

</details>

### 221. [Compositional Average Velocity Modeling for Efficient Diffusion Offline Reinforcement Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14941v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14941

**作者：** Thanh Nguyen、Abu Hanif Muhammad Syarubany、Hwanhee Kim、Chang D. Yoo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、eess.SY

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14941v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14941v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 InsQL：把扩散策略的多步去噪换成平均速度建模与组合式 flow-matching，实现单步动作生成，并与行为正则 actor-critic 统一训练，还用价值引导的候选筛选提升性能，在离线 RL 基准与机器人任务上降低训练和推理开销。

**相关性简评：** 其「平均速度」单步生成与价值引导候选筛选，可能为 diffusion 式 latent 推理状态的低成本生成及候选验证／停止决策提供方法线索，可供核查；但本文面向离线 RL 动作生成，跨域迁移属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Compositional Average Velocity Modeling for Efficient Diffusion Offline Reinforcement Learning

**abstract/A1：** Diffusion-based policies have recently emerged as a powerful paradigm for offline reinforcement learning, but their reliance on multi-step denoising introduces substantial computational overhead and requires backpropagation through time during training, limiting scalability and practical deployment. In this work, we propose \\textbf{Instant Flow Q-Learning (InsQL)}, a single-step generative policy learning framework that retains the expressive capacity of diffusion models while eliminating iterative sampling and BPTT. InsQL builds on the flow-matching perspective of diffusion policies, but replaces marginal velocity parameterization with \\emph{average-velocity} modeling and introduces a principled compositional mechanism, yielding a theoretically grounded objective that learns average velocity consistently across scales. This formulation provides a direct noise-to-action mapping and enables single-step action generation. InsQL further unifies compositional average-velocity modeling with behavior-regularized actor--critic optimization in a single framework, requiring only a single policy network and avoiding distillation, multi-stage procedures, and Jacobian computations during training. At inference time, actions are generated in a single forward pass and can be refined via value-guided candidate selection to improve performance. Extensive experiments on standard offline RL benchmarks and real-world robotic manipulation tasks show that InsQL matches or surpasses state-of-the-art diffusion-based methods while substantially reducing both training and inference time. Overall, these results establish compositional average-velocity modeling as an efficient and scalable alternative to multi-step generative policies for offline RL.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, IROS 2026

</details>

### 222. [DSM-Free UAV Visual Localization via Latent-Depth Variable Projection and Structure-Adaptive Coupling](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14945v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14945

**作者：** Yibin Ye、Xichao Teng、Shuo Chen、Xiaokai Song、Yuli Sun、Qifeng Yu、Zhang Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14945v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14945v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究无 DSM 的无人机视觉定位：提出 LDVP，把透视视线上的未知尺度当作隐深度并解析消去，使非线性估计退化为仅含旋转的闭式问题；再用 SAC 依据单目深度推断的相对场景结构，在 LDVP 与 Planar-PnP 之间自适应切换。

**相关性简评：** 这里的「latent depth」是几何优化中被解析消去的中间变量，与 LVR 的内部隐状态并非同一概念；但其变量投影式消元、可观测性分析以及按场景结构选择求解路径的做法，可能为 latent 状态的解析处理与动态计算/路径选择提供可核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DSM-Free UAV Visual Localization via Latent-Depth Variable Projection and Structure-Adaptive Coupling

**abstract/A1：** Visual localization enables unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) to maintain absolute positioning in GNSS-denied environments. A common approach matches UAV images with geo-tagged orthographic maps and estimates camera pose using Perspective-n-Point (PnP) with elevations from Digital Surface Models (DSMs). However, accurate and up-to-date DSMs are often unavailable in practice. Orthographic-perspective geometry (OPG) enables DSM-free localization in scenes with varying elevations, yet existing methods typically estimate pose indirectly through intermediate matrix estimation and decomposition. To address this limitation, we propose Latent-Depth Variable Projection (LDVP), which treats the unknown scales along perspective viewing rays as latent depths. By analytically eliminating these depths and solving for the horizontal camera center in closed form given the rotation, LDVP reduces nonlinear estimation to a rotation-only problem, enabling direct recovery of metric horizontal position without assuming a planar scene. To improve localization robustness across different scene structures, we further introduce Structure-Adaptive Coupling (SAC), which uses relative scene structure inferred from monocular depth estimation to select LDVP when the matched points are not dominated by a single plane, and Planar-PnP otherwise. Our local observability analysis reveals how scene elevation variation affects the geometric constraints of OPG, providing a basis for this adaptive strategy. Extensive experiments show that LDVP consistently outperforms existing OPG-based DSM-free methods, while SAC further improves robustness across diverse scenes and substantially narrows the gap to DSM-based localization. Code will be released at https://github.com/UAV-AVL/LDVP-SAC.

**comment/C1：** 15 pages, 8 figures

### 223. [Exact Phase-Type Point Processes for Certified Measurement and Prediction of Event Streams](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14948v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14948

**作者：** Sayak Dutta

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、q-fin.ST、q-fin.TR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14948v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14948v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文用 phase-type（Erlang 链）状态空间统一事件流的测量与预测：构造参数线性、对数似然凹且带 Fenchel 对偶间隙证书的多尺度 Hawkes 过程，并提出神经点过程 EPT-X，在线性 Hawkes 主干上加入历史相关的 Erlang 更新混合通道，状态满足仿射递推、可用并行扫描训练。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉推理无直接关联，但其显式 phase-type 隐状态、mixture-of-Erlang 通道的仿射递推与并行扫描，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的并行更新与多 latent 假设混合提供方法线索，其对偶间隙证书也可供核查「latent 内容是否真被使用」的验证思路。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Exact Phase-Type Point Processes for Certified Measurement and Prediction of Event Streams

**abstract/A1：** Temporal point processes are used both to measure market mechanisms, for example how fast prices absorb news and how much of the reaction is the market responding to itself, and to predict the next event. We show that one algebraic object, the phase-type (Erlang-chain) state space, serves both purposes with exact likelihoods. For measurement, we build a multiscale phase-type Hawkes process whose parameters all enter linearly. Its log-likelihood is concave, and we compute the global maximum together with a Fenchel duality-gap certificate. A Markov embedding gives the response to an exogenous shock, echoes included, in closed form, and this response is stable if and only if the spectral radius of the branching matrix is below one. Applied to six markets around 670 scheduled macroeconomic releases (2022-2026) with a built-in placebo test, the model shows that the direct reaction to CPI, payrolls, PPI and the FOMC statement is absorbed in about a second, while the market's own echoes stretch half of the response to 16-137 s. For prediction, we introduce EPT-X, a neural point process that adds a history-dependent mixture-of-Erlang renewal channel to a linear Hawkes backbone. Its intensity and compensator remain in closed form, its states follow an affine recursion that trains with a parallel scan, and it can start from the certified fit of the measurement model. EPT-X has the best test likelihood on all five LOBSTER order-book streams and on Retweet and Taobao, and is level with the best published model on StackOverflow. We also find that the EasyTPP implementation of IntensityFree clamps short inter-event times before scoring, and that the gaps of the EasyTPP Amazon data are uniform on two fixed intervals.

**comment/C1：** 27 pages, 5 figures, 11 tables. Code: https://github.com/itz-sayak/infodiff

</details>

### 224. [MCPDisCo: Seesaw-Mitigated Tuning for MCP-Native Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14956v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14956

**作者：** Kounianhua Du、Jianxing Liu、Shuai Shao、Ke Li、Xing Sun、Weinan Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14956v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14956v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 MCPDisCo，一个面向 MCP 原生智能体的生态级强化学习框架：用 Thought-MDP 显式建模内部推理与路由、执行、终止，并在 70 个 MCP 服务器、527 个工具的真实长程交互上训练；针对「推理—工具跷跷板」干扰，组合 token 掩码奖励归因与双向梯度手术。

**相关性简评：** 其「推理—工具」目标干扰、token 掩码奖励归因与显式终止建模，可能为 LVR 的贡献分配、监督设计与 THINK/STOP 取舍提供方法线索；但工作面向纯文本工具智能体，无视觉输入与 latent 状态，可迁移性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MCPDisCo: Seesaw-Mitigated Tuning for MCP-Native Agents

**abstract/A1：** The Model Context Protocol provides a shared interaction substrate for the agentic web, allowing heterogeneous services to expose capabilities through a standardized interface. Learning to use this ecosystem entails a hierarchy of capabilities: tool-format skills, server-level transfer, and cross-server composition. We present MCPDisCo, an ecosystem-scale reinforcement learning framework for MCP-native agents. Using a Thought-Markov Decision Process (Thought-MDP), the framework explicitly represents internal reasoning alongside routing, execution, and termination and trains on real-server, long-horizon interactions spanning 70 MCP servers and 527 tools across six domains. We study the reasoning--tool seesaw, a joint-learning failure mode in which improvement in one objective can accompany deterioration in the other. To mitigate potential interference, MCPDisCo combines token-masked reward attribution with bidirectional gradient surgery: the former separates direct supervision for reasoning and action spans, while the latter removes conflicting components from both objective gradients in shared parameters. MCPDisCo achieves higher success with fewer chain-of-thought tokens. On the out-of-distribution MCP-Atlas and the GAIA benchmark, MCPDisCo maintains monotone gains, confirming that the learned behavior generalizes beyond the training server distribution and broader agentic tasks. Model weight and implementation are available.

</details>

### 225. [FleetPilot: Fine-Grained Steering Empowers Real-World LLM Personalization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14970v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14970

**作者：** Kounianhua Du、Jianxing Liu、Kangning Zhang、Wenxiang Jiao、Yuan Lu、Jiarui Jin、Jianghao Lin、Weiwen Liu、Yong Yu、Weinan Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14970v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14970v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** FleetPilot 提出细粒度、按样本定制的 steering 框架：从用户数据动态生成干扰向量并注入前向传播，借助 match contrast、hook attention 与 MLP 激活的 steering 组件及 query-conditioned 聚合实现个性化，在短到长文本生成与 web function calling 上验证有效性，且无需训练周期。

**相关性简评：** 其「按样本动态生成激活干预向量、hook 多层激活并按 query 条件聚合」的做法，可能与 LVR 中推理期注入与组合 latent 状态、免训练地调控内部表示的方式相通，可供核查；但论文面向用户个性化而非多模态视觉推理，与视觉证据保留和推理决策无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FleetPilot: Fine-Grained Steering Empowers Real-World LLM Personalization

**abstract/A1：** With the rapid evolution of large language models (LLMs), there is an increasing demand for effective personalization techniques that can adapt model behavior to individual user preferences. Personalized LLMs must infer a user's query-dependent preferences from limited, heterogeneous, and evolving interaction histories. Existing approaches rely primarily on in-context personalization, parametric adaptation, or personalized reward modeling, but respectively incur recurring costs in context management, model optimization and deployment, or multi-candidate generation and scoring. These limitations become particularly restrictive when user observations are sparse and the preference evidence relevant to each query varies across contexts and over time. To address these challenges, we propose \\modelname, a fine-grained and instance-tailored steering framework that dynamically generates sample-level interference vectors from user data and injects them into the model's forward pass for personalized adaptation. Our approach introduces: match contrast that produces user-relevant signals, fine-grained steering component that captures nuanced signals by hooking activations from attention and MLP layers, and query-conditioned aggregation module that synthesizes these signals into contextually relevant enhancements. Extensive experiments across diverse scenarios, including short-to-long text generation, and web function calling, validate the effectiveness and compatibility of \\modelname. Results show that our method consistently brings significant performance gains, and show extreme superiority in fast-shifting and data-sparse environments. Additionally, \\modelname rids us of training cycles and incurs light overhead of storage or inference latency. These make \\modelname a strong and real-world deployable method. Implementation is available \\footnote{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/FleetPilot}.

</details>

### 226. [HodgePhaseNet: Discrete Hodge Decomposition of Semantic Flows in Transformer Attention](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14971v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14971

**作者：** Kiyotaka Kasubuchi、Kazuo Fukiya

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14971v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14971v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 HodgePhaseNet，把 Transformer 注意力中的成对语义关系建模为有限单纯复形上的反对称 1-上链，Hodge 分解为梯度、旋度与调和三分量，并给出显式投影算子、稀疏实现和改造后的注意力接口。

**相关性简评：** 把关系场拆成一致方向、局部循环与未闭合全局循环的分解思路，可能为分析 VLM 内部 latent 对实体关系的编码是否完整、区分「矛盾」与「缺失信息」提供线索；其注意力偏置接口与因果信息边界构造可供核查能否用于视觉证据筛选与推理状态的组织。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** HodgePhaseNet: Discrete Hodge Decomposition of Semantic Flows in Transformer Attention

**abstract/A1：** WavePhaseNet introduced frequency-resolved semantic representations, QuantumPhaseNet introduced gauge-covariant phase connections, and ModularPhaseNet made a finite cyclic phase channel and its cycle holonomy computable in an ordinary Transformer. These constructions are complementary, yet they do not by themselves separate an observed collection of pairwise relations into a globally consistent direction, circulation around local compositions, and circulation that persists around a larger unfilled cycle. HodgePhaseNet addresses this separation by representing semantic transitions as an antisymmetric real-valued 1-cochain on a finite oriented simplicial complex. With vertex-edge incidence matrix $B\_1$ and edge-face incidence matrix $B\_2$, every such field has a unique orthogonal decomposition $Ω= B\_1^TΦ+ B\_2Ψ+ H$, where $B\_1H=0$ and $B\_2^TH=0$. The three component fields are unique even when their potentials are not. We give explicit projectors, a sparse implementation, integrability and gauge results, a verified numerical example, and a redesigned attention interface. The attention bias is defined on allowed ordered query-key pairs, remains consistent under arbitrary choices of edge orientation, and preserves a decoder's causal information boundary by constructing its complex from the visible prefix. Gauge invariance of the attention output is conditional on using invariant or appropriately compensated features. A simple difference of vertex embeddings has no coexact or harmonic component; a genuine relation encoder is therefore indispensable. Local circulation is not automatically contradiction, and harmonic flow is not automatically missing knowledge. These interpretations and any reduction in factual error require controlled empirical evaluation. This paper presents a mathematical and architectural proposal, not external natural-language performance results.

</details>

### 227. [Characterizing the Separability Gap in Prior-Data Fitted Networks](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14989v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14989

**作者：** Julius Kobialka、Manuel Hülskamp、Thomas Nagler、David Rügamer

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14989v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14989v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文指出常见 PFN（prior-data fitted networks）任务先验并不可分，推导其预训练目标实际面向同时使用标注上下文与查询特征的 task posterior，刻画它与仅用上下文后验之差，并分析该差异对特征归因、贝叶斯优化和半监督 SemiTabICL 的影响。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉多模态主线无直接联系，但其关于「预测是否依赖查询侧特征、以及上下文后验能否替代」的刻画可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态是否真正使用任务必要证据而非捷径先验，其显式利用无标签观测的预训练目标也可能类比视觉旁路与额外证据的监督设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Characterizing the Separability Gap in Prior-Data Fitted Networks

**abstract/A1：** Prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) are transformers pretrained on simulated datasets to approximate Bayesian posterior predictive distributions. Standard PFN theory assumes a separable task prior, under which the feature distribution and the mechanism generating labels from features are independent. We show that common PFN priors are non-separable, even in simple settings. Consequently, standard pretraining targets a predictive distribution based on a task posterior updated using both the labeled context and the query features. We characterize its difference from the predictive based on the context posterior alone and show that this difference vanishes under posterior concentration. Under misspecification (i.e., when the true joint distribution lies outside the prior's support), however, prior non-separability can favor better feature fit at the expense of conditional label fit. We illustrate the consequences for feature attribution, Bayesian optimization, and martingale checks of Bayesian behavior. The same dependence also enables PFNs to learn from additional unlabeled observations. We demonstrate this with SemiTabICL, a PFN explicitly pretrained to use these observations, which improves accuracy over a matched supervised baseline. Our findings highlight the need for explicit rules on unlabeled data use in PFN evaluation and establish the dependence between feature and label distributions as a consequential prior design choice.

</details>

### 228. [Retraining-Free Depth Pruning of Vision Transformers: A Cross Domain Study of Layer Redundancy](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15005v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15005

**作者：** Alessandro Viespoli、Loris Nanni

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15005v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15005v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文将基于相似度的冗余分析扩展到视觉 Transformer：用层输入与输出的余弦相似度衡量各层变换的影响，在 DINOv2、SwinV2 等模型上做免重训练的深度剪枝，并给出自动选择剪枝配置的流程，报告精度与效率的折中。

**相关性简评：** 其逐层 latent 相似度度量正是「相似度受深度与层位置影响」的具体线索，可供核查哪些层的内部状态变化最小、视觉必要信息集中在何处；但该工作目标为分类模型的压缩效率，与推理期状态生成无直接关系，迁移需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Retraining-Free Depth Pruning of Vision Transformers: A Cross Domain Study of Layer Redundancy

**abstract/A1：** Transformer architectures have achieved strong results in natural language processing and computer vision, but their deployment is limited by high computational, memory and storage costs, motivating research into model compression techniques, such as pruning, while preserving performance. Prior work has shown substantial redundancy in large language models (LLMs), and redundancy in vision transformers has also been investigated, but it remains less systematically analyzed than in LLMs. In this work, we extend similarity-based redundancy analysis to vision models by measuring cosine similarity between layer inputs and outputs to identify transformations with minimal impact. We study redundancy patterns across several transformer architectures and find that deep vision transformers such as DINOv2 and SwinV2, like language models, exhibit significant redundancy. We then evaluate how this redundancy can be exploited to improve efficiency, analyzing the trade-off between inference speed and performance degradation under different pruning strategies. Our results show that moderate pruning can yield substantial acceleration with limited impact on accuracy, and that 20% of the DINOv2 blocks can be removed without any retraining, for a 1.24x throughput gain and a 20% lower energy per image at a relative accuracy loss below 1% on ImageNet-1K. We further propose a model selection pipeline that automatically identifies the best pruned configuration for a given dataset, reducing FLOPs by 13% to 27% on average across architectures with an average accuracy change between -0.3 and +1.0 points.

</details>

### 229. [What Really Works for Universal Multimodal Embeddings? A Controlled Study of Contrastive Training Strategies](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15035v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15035

**作者：** Duo Li、Haojun Pan、Zuhao Yang、Xintong Wang、Chengfu Huo、Shijian Lu、Liang Ding

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15035v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15035v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在统一基准下系统评估多模态嵌入的对比训练策略（负样本选择、批构造、梯度调制），并用 MLLM-as-a-Judge 诊断框架拆解 MMEB 上的 top-1 检索错误，发现多数策略仅带来边际收益甚至倒退，归纳出梯度失真、分布幻觉与三者协同训练三点结论。

**相关性简评：** 该文的阴性诊断（正负相似度分布拉得更开并不等于下游更好、高相似负样本加权损害泛化）可能可供核查 LVR 中以 latent 相似度作为表示质量代理指标的做法；其难负样本挖掘与假负样本缓解的协同训练思路，或可迁移到对 latent 推理状态的监督与表示坍缩分析。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** What Really Works for Universal Multimodal Embeddings? A Controlled Study of Contrastive Training Strategies

**abstract/A1：** Contrastive learning has become the standard paradigm for multimodal representation learning, aligning semantically matched pairs while separating mismatched ones in a shared embedding space. Although various contrastive training strategies have been proposed across negative selection, batch construction, and gradient modulation, their actual effectiveness under controlled, reproducible conditions remains poorly understood. This motivates a fundamental question: Do sophisticated contrastive strategies consistently bring meaningful downstream gains in multimodal embedding learning? To address this, we systematically evaluate representative strategies under a unified benchmarking framework on MMEB. Surprisingly, direct evaluations reveal that most existing strategies offer marginal gains over a standard aligned baseline, with several even degrading overall performance. To uncover the underlying failure modes, we introduce an MLLM-as-a-Judge diagnostic framework that dissects top-1 retrieval behaviors into labeled positives, false negatives (unlabeled valid matches), and hard/easy negative errors. Our systematic analysis yields three key insights: (1) Gradient distortion: Upweighting gradients from high-similarity negatives consistently hurts downstream generalization; (2) Distribution illusion: Wider separation between positive and negative similarity distributions does not necessarily translate to better retrieval performance; and (3) Synergistic training: While false-negative mitigation or hard-batch construction yields limited gains in isolation, integrating hard-negative mining, false-negative mitigation, and hard-batch construction achieves optimal performance, delivering an average improvement of 6.0% on MMEB with Qwen2-VL-2B. Overall, our findings demystify popular contrastive strategies and provide actionable recipes for training universal multimodal embedding models.

**comment/C1：** 16 pages, 3 figures

</details>

### 230. [The Optimal Decoder is Tilted Temperature](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15058v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15058

**作者：** Nikolaos Papagiannis、Ananth Grama、Wojciech Szpankowski

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15058v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15058v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把 LLM 解码建模为带熵下界和交叉熵上界的 pass@k 最大化，推导出闭式「tilted temperature」采样规则，并给出在线（J-EOS）与离线（CTD）两种 verifier potential 估计方式，在代码生成基准上评估。

**相关性简评：** 其按「最终通过概率」倾斜采样分布、用二元反馈在线估计 verifier potential 的做法，可能迁移到 LVR 中 latent 轨迹的加权采样、证据筛选与随样本数增长的计算预算分配，可供人工核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The Optimal Decoder is Tilted Temperature

**abstract/A1：** Larger sample budgets benefit from higher sampling temperatures in LLMs, but what temperature tuning optimizes and why it works remain poorly understood. We seek to answer these questions: we pose decoding as pass@$k$ maximization subject to two constraints that encode critical decoding failure modes: an entropy floor preventing diversity collapse, and a cross-entropy ceiling preventing implausibility. We prove that this maximization takes the form of a single closed-form conditional sampling rule, the \\emph{tilted temperature} $q^\\star \\propto \\bigl(p e^{ηV}\\bigr)^{1/T}$. Here, the tilt comes from a verifier potential $V$ that quantifies how likely a partial generation is to eventually pass. Ordinary temperature sampling, verifier-greedy decoding, and reward-tilted policies represent special cases. We further show that, under a natural rule for scaling the diversity budget with sample size $k$, the resulting optimal temperature increases with $k$, turning empirical choice into a theorem. The optimum still needs the unknown verifier potential, which we estimate using two design approaches. In the online setting, our J-EOS algorithm jointly tracks the two constraint multipliers and learns the verifier potential from binary pass/ fail feedback alone. In the offline setting, we show that when the model is calibrated, its log-probability tracks correctness up to an affine map. Under this condition, the tilt collapses into the exponent and the optimum reduces to ordinary temperature sampling. Calibrated Temperature Decoding (CTD) then fits one scalar offline and samples with zero additional inference-time overhead relative to temperature sampling. Building on these decision rules, we design a practical decoding algorithm for code generation and evaluate it alongside CTD on benchmarks including HumanEval and MBPP, showing improvements over standard and adaptive decoding baselines.

</details>

<a id="paper-231"></a>

### 231. [Swarm Telepathy: Prefill-Free KV-Cache Transfer Across Families](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15095v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15095

**作者：** Abdulrahman Alabdulkareem、Irene Tenison、Yang Zhang、Yada Zhu、Boris Katz、Dan Gutfreund

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15095v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15095v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**内容简述：** 提出 SwaT，用跨模型家族的 KV-cache 传输替代文本通信，使接收方无需重新 prefill 即可获得发送方的上下文状态，并演示由 VLM 发送方向纯文本 LLM 迁移视觉能力。

**相关性简评：** 以 KV 状态而非离散 token 作为 agent 间信息通道，与 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的传递、视觉信息能否保留在内部表示并绕过文本旁路的问题相关，可供核查；但该工作面向通信带宽与速度，未研究视觉推理机制本身。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Swarm Telepathy: Prefill-Free KV-Cache Transfer Across Families

**abstract/A1：** LLM multi-agent systems split work across agents that communicate through text. An agent summarizes its findings, another agent receives the text. This constrains communication to discrete tokens and costs redundant compute, limiting bandwidth and capabilities of multi-agent systems. Recent works demonstrate KV-cache transfer between LLMs but they either require the LLMs to be within the same family or cannot function across context, thus requiring the receiver to prefill text. We present SwaT (Swarm Telepathy), the first cross-family KV-cache transfer method that allows prefill-free communication in multi-family multi-agent systems. In an agent-to-agent communication setting, combining SwaT with recent advances in KV-cache compaction beats text-to-text communication in both accuracy and speed, with a mean of $40\\%$ higher accuracy and a mean of $4\\times$ faster wall-clock time. Experiments show SwaT achieves high performance on 17 benchmarks across 12 LLMs and 6 families. Additionally, given a sender Vision-Language Model (VLM), SwaT is able to transfer the vision capabilities to a text-only receiver LLM exceeding text-to-text communication despite SwaT being trained on text-only data. SwaT keeps both sender and receiver models frozen without fine-tuning and only requires $&lt;50M$ tokens and $&lt;1$ GPU-day to train.

</details>

### 232. [TIDE: Trajectory-Informed Skill Distillation for Efficient Text-to-Video Prompt Optimization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15098v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15098

**作者：** Chengxing Zhou、Yuliang Huang、Jingwei Song

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15098v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15098v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 TIDE，把昂贵的迭代式提示优化搜索蒸馏成一组按语义维度划分、以源条件激活的规则模块，形成可冻结复用的提示改写 Skill，单次 LLM 调用即产出正负提示并只做一次 T2V 生成，无需测试时视觉搜索或主干微调。

**相关性简评：** 将「生成—评估」搜索轨迹蒸馏为冻结可复用策略、从而免除测试时搜索的思路，可能为 LVR 中的轨迹监督与推理成本/停止决策提供可供核查的方法线索，但其任务域为 T2V 提示优化，与视觉推理主线无直接关联。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TIDE: Trajectory-Informed Skill Distillation for Efficient Text-to-Video Prompt Optimization

**abstract/A1：** Text-to-video (T2V) models are highly sensitive to prompt specificity, while iterative prompt optimization typically improves generation quality only through repeated video generation and vision-language model evaluation at inference time. We propose TIDE, a framework that distills this costly search process into an interpretable and reusable prompt-rewriting Skill. TIDE formulates prompt rewriting as a set of source-conditioned rule modules, each targeting a distinct semantic dimension. Once distilled, the frozen Skill activates the relevant rules and generates both positive and negative prompts in a single LLM call, followed by only one T2V generation, without test-time visual search or backbone fine-tuning. Evolved using only 100 prompts over 14 hours, TIDE achieves prompt-optimization performance comparable to computationally expensive search-based methods. Moreover, when transferred to previously unseen video-generation models, TIDE outperforms existing approaches specifically designed or trained for those models. Code is available at https://github.com/xiningin/TIDE\_T2V.

</details>

### 233. [Drive3R: Block-wise Streaming Geometric Foundation Models for Autonomous Driving](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15112v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15112

**作者：** Tianyi Yang、Haojun Yang、Jipeng Xiao、Xuesong Chen、Shaoshuai Shi、Li Jiang、Zhipeng Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15112v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15112v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Drive3R，一种面向自动驾驶长时程序列的分块流式几何基础模型：用 block-wise causal attention 缓解全双向注意力的显存与复杂度瓶颈，并以置信度感知的重新锚定（检测不可靠流式状态、重置 KV cache、SE(3) 对齐拼接）抑制长距离漂移，在 nuScenes、KITTI、Waymo 上报告 SOTA。

**相关性简评：** 任务本身是驾驶场景 3D 重建，与 VLM 推理无直接关联，但其流式状态维护中的置信度判定、KV cache 重置与分块因果注意力，可能为 LVR 的 latent 状态漂移、缓存/注意力结构对表示的影响以及何时重初始化推理状态提供方法线索，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Drive3R: Block-wise Streaming Geometric Foundation Models for Autonomous Driving

**abstract/A1：** High-fidelity closed-loop simulation for autonomous driving increasingly relies on dense multi-view 3D reconstruction. While recent feed-forward geometric foundation models have revolutionized per-scene optimization, applying them to continuous, long-horizon driving sequences is computationally intractable due to GPU memory limits and the quadratic complexity of global attention. Existing scaling strategies are fundamentally limited, as causal streaming suffers from compounding scale drift and trajectory deviation, while rigid "chunk-then-align" heuristics fragment global context and produce trajectory discontinuities. To address these limitations, we introduce Drive3R, a block-wise streaming geometric foundation model. Its block-wise causal attention resolves the scalability bottleneck of fully bidirectional attention while avoiding the loss of local future context in purely causal streaming. Its confidence-aware re-anchoring further mitigates long-range drift by detecting unreliable streaming states, re-initializing the KV cache, and stitching refreshed segments through SE(3) alignment. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Drive3R establishes a new state-of-the-art on nuScenes, KITTI, and Waymo. Specifically, on nuScenes, it improves over the recent DVGT-2 baseline from 0.1806 to 0.1081 in AbsRel, from 0.6750 to 0.5344 in point-cloud Accuracy, and from 1.5812 to 0.9092 in ATE.

**comment/C1：** 11 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Project page: https://silence-ai423.github.io/Drive3R/

</details>

### 234. [When Dynamic Scaling Fails: A Scale-State Feedback Governs Recurrent-State Quantization in Linear-Attention and SSM LLMs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15139v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15139

**作者：** Yuhang Jiang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15139v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15139v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究线性注意力与 SSM 大模型中定长循环状态的量化：量化尺度与其所依赖状态之间形成反馈，使每步量化误差在递推中累积，长程解码后即使 INT4 也毁掉召回；作者用固定尺度、逐层比特分配等对照，将数值不稳定与功能退化区分为两类可分离的失败。

**相关性简评：** 该文的「状态每步被重写、误差在递推内累积、须报告位宽被认证的解码视野」等线索，可能可供核查 LVR latent 状态更新的精度与长程稳定性及长度泛化评估方式，但论文不涉及视觉或多模态推理，联系需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When Dynamic Scaling Fails: A Scale-State Feedback Governs Recurrent-State Quantization in Linear-Attention and SSM LLMs

**abstract/A1：** Linear-attention and state-space LLMs carry long context in a fixed-size recurrent state, and quantizing that state is the natural way to cut its cost during long decode. Unlike a weight tensor, the state is rewritten at every step, so a quantizer applied at each step sits inside the recurrence and its errors compound. INT4 that leaves synthetic recall perfectly intact at the start destroys it a thousand steps later. The mechanism is a feedback between the quantizer scale and the state it is derived from. Yoking that scale to a full-precision reference removes the resulting norm explosion entirely, yet recovers only 1.8 of the 5.4 nats lost, so numerical instability and functional degradation are separable failures. The remainder is a resolution problem that locating outliers does not solve, since every outlier-aware scheme here loses to plain persistent scaling. Allocating bits across layers does help, but under article-disjoint splits a learned allocation collapses onto the trivial rule of protecting the first few layers. Run out to 32K, group-wise INT4 is worth no more than discarding the state. Contain the scale rather than locate outliers, and report the decode horizon at which a bit-width was certified.

**comment/C1：** 14 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables. NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Long-Context Foundation Models (non-archival). Extended version: adds a cross-architecture containment comparison on Mamba-2 and corrects two claims in the workshop version. Code and project page: https://avalon-s.github.io/dynamic-scaling-fails/

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15146

**作者：** Dan Saunders、Benjamin Ren、Catherine He

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL、cs.NE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15146v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15146v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 首次对 SpikeGPT 族脉冲语言模型做 Chinchilla 式 IsoFLOP 缩放研究，拟合计算最优的参数量—数据配比，并把损失差距拆为不随算力变化的骨干成本与逐步收敛的脉冲化成本。

**相关性简评：** 其用 IsoFLOP 扫描与损失分解量化「额外计算／稀疏化」代价的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理步数带来的算力—精度权衡与成本归因提供可核查的方法模板，但本身不涉及视觉或多模态状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Compute-Optimal Scaling Laws for Spiking Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Spiking neural networks target energy-efficient language modeling through sparse, binary activations, but the efficiency-accuracy tradeoff of spiking language models is uncharacterized at scale. We present the first Chinchilla-style IsoFLOP scaling study of a spiking language model, sweeping SpikeGPT-family models (RWKV backbone) from width 384 to 1536 across compute budgets from $3\\times10^{17}$ to $10^{19}$ FLOPs on FineWeb-EDU. We report two findings. First, the compute-optimal frontier is $N\_{opt} \\propto C^{0.56}$, close to the 0.50 that Hoffmann et al. report for dense Transformers, so spiking does not change how parameters and data should be traded off under a compute budget. Second, against non-spiking RWKV and Transformer baselines trained the same way, the loss gap splits into a backbone cost of about 0.16 nats that does not change with compute and a spiking cost that falls from 0.34 to about 0.23 nats and then levels off. These results give the first compute-optimal recipe for spiking language models and quantify the accuracy cost of their sparsity.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to AXIOM: Foundations of Efficient Deep Learning (NeurIPS 2026 workshop). 4 pages + appendix, 4 figures, 5 tables

</details>

### 236. [Harmony Harness: Multi-Objective Self-Evolution of Agent Harnesses](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15150v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15150

**作者：** Weichen Yu、Lesly Miculicich、Bhavana Dalvi Mishra、Jiefeng Chen、Shuo Li、Matt Fredrikson、Tomas Pfister、Long T. Le

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15150v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15150v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Harmony Harness，把 LLM agent 的 harness 演化建模为多目标优化问题，用基于分解的进化搜索覆盖 Pareto 前沿，并以因子化算子分别优化通用机制与基准特定适配，在推理时动态组合。

**相关性简评：** 其多目标权衡搜索与「通用机制／环境特定适配」的因子化设计，可供核查是否能迁移到 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的收益—成本折中及可迁移推理机制与任务特定视觉适配的分离；但原文针对文本 agent harness 而非 latent 视觉状态，联系仍属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Harmony Harness: Multi-Objective Self-Evolution of Agent Harnesses

**abstract/A1：** Recent work on self-evolving LLM agents treats the agent harness as an optimization target that can be iteratively improved through execution feedback. Existing approaches, however, largely optimize a single objective and evolve the harness as a monolithic artifact, limiting their ability to handle competing goals and to separate transferable design from environment-specific adaptation. We introduce Harmony Harness, a framework for multi-objective, compositional harness evolution. Harmony Harness formulates harness evolution as a multi-objective optimization problem and uses decomposition-based evolutionary search to maintain solutions across different regions of the Pareto frontier, avoiding reliance on a hand-designed structural diversity metric for repository-scale harnesses. In parallel, we introduce factorized evolution operators that separately refine general-purpose harness mechanisms and benchmark-specific adaptations, together with a dynamic composition workflow that integrates them at inference time. Across SecRepoBench and BaxBench, Harmony Harness consistently outperforms strong harness-evolution baselines, with gains exceeding 10% on both benchmarks. Our results show that explicitly modeling both objective trade-offs and harness structure yields substantially stronger and more transferable agent evolution than existing single-objective, monolithic approaches.

</details>

### 237. [Beyond Adjacent Layers: Graph-Guided Layer Fusion for Compressing Large Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15159v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15159

**作者：** Muhammad Usama、Yeoreum Jung

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15159v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15159v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文研究 LLM 深度压缩：对六个架构家族共 13 个模型计算全对 CKA 相似度矩阵，发现非相邻层的高相似冗余显著多于相邻层，据此提出用谱社区检测聚类功能等价层、保留代表层并加 LoRA 恢复的 FCM 方法。

**相关性简评：** 其「全对表示相似度矩阵 + 按层聚类」的分析流程，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据在跨深度层间的相似度与冗余分布，但原文仅面向文本压缩，与推理期 latent 状态生成无直接联系，属需人工核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Adjacent Layers: Graph-Guided Layer Fusion for Compressing Large Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Existing depth-compression methods for large language models (LLMs) score layers individually or group only adjacent or contiguous layers, implicitly assuming that functional redundancy is local. We test this assumption by computing full pairwise Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) similarity matrices for thirteen LLMs from six architecture families (1.6B-14B parameters). Non-adjacent layers have 3.6-15.9x more high-similarity pairs than adjacent ones, a structure that prior similarity-based layer merging has not systematically exploited. We propose Fusion via Community Mining (FCM), which builds the full L x L similarity graph, uses spectral community detection to find clusters of functionally equivalent layers, keeps the highest-Block-Influence layer in each cluster, and applies LoRA recovery; a pre-specified rule computed only on calibration data chooses between cosine and CKA similarity. At 2x compression, FCM lowers mean perplexity below ShortGPT on twelve of thirteen models, significantly on ten (Welch's t-test with Holm-Bonferroni correction; up to 50% on Qwen3-4B), with Mistral-7B the only loss (+13.4%). Against FlattenGPT, SWM, and DeltaLLM under matched calibration and recovery, FCM gives the best perplexity on ten of thirteen models (mean rank 1.15), and it also outperforms MKA on three anchor models. FCM matches or exceeds ShortGPT on 15 of 20 zero-shot reasoning cells and also improves MMLU, LAMBADA, HumanEval pass@1, and free-form generation quality. The 2x-compressed Qwen2.5-7B has 46% fewer parameters, 42% lower peak VRAM, and 84% higher decode throughput on a single A100. Spectral grouping outperforms Fisher contiguous segmentation by 41% and uniform partitioning by 51%, and FCM's advantage grows beyond a 2x crossover up to 3x and persists at the 14B scale. Code: https://github.com/Usama1002/fcm-layer-fusion

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Code: https://github.com/Usama1002/fcm-layer-fusion

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15177

**作者：** Michael Cardei、Anjun Hu、Chenrui Ma、Francesco Pinto、Chawin Sitawarin、Chulin Xie、Ferdinando Fioretto

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15177v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15177v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 CoDA，在扩散语言模型的去噪过程中逐步把 token 分布投影到任务相关的策略合规集合上，以持续满足安全约束并抵御 prompt injection，并在静态与自适应攻击下评估攻击成功率、任务效用与推理开销。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉推理无直接关联，但其「逐步投影约束去噪」的迭代生成机制，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的受限更新、视觉证据筛选或停止决策提供可供核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Only What You've Signed up For: Secure Workflows with Constrained Diffusion Agents

**abstract/A1：** As agentic AI systems take on increasingly complex and consequential tasks, securing them against prompt injection becomes critical. Existing defenses often rely on detecting or reasoning about injected malicious instructions and can therefore remain vulnerable to adaptive attacks that optimize the injection itself. Diffusion language models (dLLMs), an emerging framework for language generation, offer a new opportunity for security enforcement: by iteratively refining their sequence wide predictions, they enable broader-scope constraint enforcement throughout generation. This paper introduces Policy-Constrained Diffusion Agents (CoDA), a framework that enforces task dependent security policies directly within the denoising process of diffusion language models. At each denoising step, CoDA projects token distributions onto a policy-compliant set, maintaining constraint satisfaction throughout generation. We evaluate CoDA across state-of-the-art diffusion language model families under both static and adaptive prompt-injection attacks. Results demonstrate substantial reductions in attack success rate with competitive task utility and practical inference overhead.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15207

**作者：** Lass Najmuldeen、Seyedhamidreza Mousavi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.CR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15207v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15207v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文系统考察基于深度的动态推理（从中间层早退生成输出）对 LLM 越狱鲁棒性的影响，报告浅层出口更鲁棒、更深出口的对抗后缀更易优化至更低攻击损失、对抗后缀对不同深度的效用影响一致等三点观察。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本、非视觉工作，但其按出口深度分析中间层状态的可靠性差异与攻击损失变化，可能为 LVR 中动态计算、停止深度选择与中间层 latent 状态可用性的关系提供核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Exploring Jailbreak Vulnerability Across Depth-Based Dynamic Inference in Large Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Large Language Models (LLMs) have been shown to be computationally expensive and vulnerable to jailbreak attacks, in which adversarial prompts bypass safety alignment and induce harmful responses. To address this inefficiency, a range of techniques have been proposed to enable efficient LLM inference. Depth-based dynamic inference has demonstrated promising results by enabling outputs to be generated from intermediate layers. It offers the flexibility to adjust model behavior based on the available resource budget. However, how this flexibility affects the robustness of LLMs against jailbreak attacks remains unexplored. In this paper, we address this gap via a comprehensive investigation into the impact of depth-based dynamic inference on the robustness of LLMs against jailbreak attacks. Specifically, we make the following key observations: 1) Shallow exits are consistently more robust to jailbreak attacks than deeper ones; 2) Exit depth affects how easily the adversarial suffix can be optimized, with deeper exits reaching lower attack loss; and 3) Adversarial suffixes affect utility uniformly across exit depths. These insights can help design dynamic inference methodologies that are more robust to jailbreak attacks. Code is available at https://github.com/LassNajmuldeen/balcony-jailbreaking

**comment/C1：** Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundations of Language Model Security (FLMSec). 10 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** HarnessNet: Feedback-driven Hierarchical Joint Harness Evolution for Multi-agent Systems

**abstract/A1：** AI agents can evolve by using environment feedback to revise their harnesses, the software managing model inputs, tool use, memory, and execution, while keeping foundation models frozen. Existing studies focus on single agents, leaving joint harness evolution in multi-agent systems (MAS) underexplored. A single global optimizer faces growing context and workload as the system scales, while access restrictions may prevent sharing agent internals or system-wide feedback. We propose HarnessNet, a framework for hierarchical harness evolution in MAS. Its basic unit, Agentron, comprises an evolvable forward harness, a foundation model, and a local optimizer that can observe and modify only that harness. Agentrons form a layered graph through which environment feedback propagates backward, with upstream optimizers receiving node-specific feedback from the downstream layer. This decomposes joint harness evolution into smaller, coordinated tasks with separate contexts, reducing individual optimizers' context and workload while keeping access local. Optimizers need not access all agent trajectories or raw environment feedback. Experiments on AgentBench with multiple foundation models demonstrate the feasibility of training HarnessNet. Compared with a single global optimizer, HarnessNet achieves comparable performance gains while respecting local privacy and requiring fewer tokens and less time per optimizer call. A migration study shows that the evolved harnesses remain jointly effective after replacing the foundation models, suggesting transferability across models.

**comment/C1：** A novel method for multi-agent system harness joint evolution

</details>

**作者：** Chuang Tong、Ling Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15225v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15225v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 AdaSub-ZO：一种仅需前向计算的 LLM 零阶微调框架，用有限差分反馈迭代学习逐层低秩投影矩阵（替代固定随机子空间），并引入子空间动量平滑噪声梯度估计，在自然语言理解任务上降低方差、加快收敛。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本参数优化工作，但其「从反馈中学习低秩子空间以对齐任务相关方向」与「跨演化基的动量平滑」可能为 LVR 中 latent 工作区的低维参数化与状态更新提供方法线索，是否适用于推理期视觉状态表示尚待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Zeroth-Order Fine-Tuning of LLMs in Learnable Low-Rank Subspaces

**abstract/A1：** Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization enables memory-efficient fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs). However, ZO optimization suffers from high variance in high-dimensional parameter spaces. While recent methods restrict perturbations to random low-rank subspaces, these subspaces often misalign with task-specific descent directions. We propose AdaSub-ZO, a novel forward-only fine-tuning framework in learnable low-rank subspaces. Instead of relying on fixed random matrices, AdaSub-ZO iteratively learns layer-wise projection matrices directly from finite-difference feedback to track task-aware descent directions. Furthermore, AdaSub-ZO incorporates a subspace momentum acceleration mechanism to smooth noisy gradient estimates across evolving subspace bases. Extensive experiments on natural language understanding tasks demonstrate that AdaSub-ZO outperforms existing ZO baselines, substantially reducing gradient estimation variance and accelerating convergence.

**comment/C1：** 7 pages, 4 figures

</details>

### 242. [MoMaTune: Model, Match, Then Tune Language Models for Numerical Records](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15235v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15235

**作者：** Weimin Lyu、Jingfen Zhang、Lingdao Sha、Peng sun、Xiaowei Chen、Vincent Gao、Rui Song

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15235v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15235v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 MoMaTune 两阶段后训练策略：先在无标签序列化记录上做密集下一词预测（Model）并可加同记录多视图表示对齐（Match），再做下游目标监督微调（Tune），以弥补数值记录中值内敏感性与跨字段依赖的监督缺口，并在八个公开数据集上评测。

**相关性简评：** 其「Match」同一示例不同局部视图的表示一致性目标，以及对非答案内容施加密集辅助监督的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 表示的多视图一致性与答案之外内容的监督分配提供可核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MoMaTune: Model, Match, Then Tune Language Models for Numerical Records

**abstract/A1：** Despite remarkable progress in language understanding and generation, decoder language models continue to exhibit striking failures on numerical data. Numerical examples are typically serialized as text by concatenating feature names with their values (e.g., fat:3.4), while conventional task adaptation applies loss only to the downstream prediction target. This leaves two structures weakly supervised: within-value sensitivity, where digit position determines numerical magnitude, because token cross-entropy contains no explicit numerical metric; and across-field structure, where measurements in the same record are statistically dependent, because target-only tuning provides no direct loss on the measurements or their dependencies. We introduce MoMaTune (Model, Match, then Tune), a two-stage post-training strategy organized around these supervision gaps. Stage 1 applies Model, ordinary next-token prediction densely over label-free serialized records, and optionally adds Match, a same-record consistency objective that aligns representations of different partial views of the same example. Stage 2 applies Tune, supervised fine-tuning for downstream target prediction. We evaluate MoMaTune on 169,285 records from eight public datasets, with 339 of 340 input fields numerical. At 1.5B parameters, Model raises the eight-dataset masked-value imputation aggregate from 0.106 to 0.401, while the three-dataset correct-context gain rises from 0.058 to 0.167. On diagnostics, Model also increases sensitivity to numerically consequential digit changes, while Match improves robustness to informative partial views. Adding Tune yields higher target-supervised embedding aggregates for each tested Stage-1 parent, and the two-stage recipes obtain higher aggregate scores than Tune alone. The same pattern is observed at 4B, 9.6B, and 27B parameters when model embeddings are used for downstream prediction.

</details>

### 243. [EvolvAttack: Backdooring self Evolving VLM Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15244v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15244

**作者：** Chuan Zou、Yang Xiang、Zexin Li、Xiaonan Luo、Simin Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15244v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15244v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出「自演化后门」这一新攻击面，用记忆感知的后门训练把视觉触发器与 agent 不断演化的记忆状态耦合，使恶意载荷在初始阶段休眠、随记忆演化逐步激活；在多个 VLM 主干与记忆演化方式下，演化前攻击成功率仅 0.5%，百余次交互后超过 95%。

**相关性简评：** 其「视觉触发器需与特定记忆状态共现才生效」的设定暗示 agent 行为由内部记忆状态决定，或可作为探测 latent 状态是否真正承载并影响视觉证据的线索，也可供核查静态干净记忆扫描失效对 LVR 评价方式的启示。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** EvolvAttack: Backdooring self Evolving VLM Agents

**abstract/A1：** Self-evolving mechanisms let vision-language model (VLM) agents continually adapt through evolving memory, but they also allow malicious behavior to emerge only after deployment. We introduce a new attack surface, the self-evolving backdoor, whose payload stays dormant in the initial agent and is progressively activated as the agent evolves. Unlike conventional backdoors, which can be exposed by testing triggered inputs on a static model, our attack requires both a visual trigger and a sufficiently evolved memory state; static scanning with clean memory thus yields near-zero attack success and may deem the agent benign. We realize this through memory-aware backdoor training, which couples trigger activation with the agent's evolving memory while preserving benign behavior unless the trigger co-occurs with payload-related memory. Across three VLM backbones, four agent pipelines, and recency-, semantic-, and reward-based memory evolution, the attack preserves normal functionality and stays nearly inactive before evolution (0.5% attack success rate), yet exceeds 95% attack success within 100 interactions, revealing a stealthy threat unique to self-evolving agents.

**comment/C1：** 21 pages, 7 figures, 9 tables

</details>

### 244. [ObsSpec: Accelerating Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Observation Speculation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15246v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15246

**作者：** Kyle Montgomery、Wang Zhang、Chenguang Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15246v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15246v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ObsSpec：在 agentic RL 中用小世界模型在环境执行工具调用时提前预测工具输出，使策略提前开始下一轮生成，并仅保留与实际观测完全一致的推测结果，配合协同训练保持世界模型同步更新，从而降低 rollout 延迟。

**相关性简评：** 其「提前预测下一步观测—精确匹配校验—只接受一致结果」与协同更新的设计，可能为 LVR 中如何生成并验证下一步推理状态或证据预测提供可核查的方法线索；但对象是文本工具输出，与视觉推理的联系尚需人工确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ObsSpec: Accelerating Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Observation Speculation

**abstract/A1：** Tool-using agents alternate between model generation and tool execution, waiting for each tool call to complete before starting the next generation. This sequential execution is costly during agentic reinforcement learning (RL), which requires large batches of multi-turn rollouts. We introduce ObsSpec, an observation speculation pipeline for agentic RL that uses a small world model to predict tool outputs while the environment executes, allowing the policy to begin its next generation early. ObsSpec retains speculative work only when the predicted and actual observations match exactly, making rollout collection lossless, while co-training keeps the world model up to date as the policy learns. On terminal-use tasks, predictions from a 0.6B world model exactly match actual observations in 66.4% of attempts and arrive roughly 16 times faster. Using these predictions, ObsSpec reduces agent latency by 9.3% and 14.2% for 8B and 32B policies. Across controlled experiments, we characterize the regimes in which ObsSpec reduces agent latency under shared policy resources. Finally, because ObsSpec overlaps policy generation with tool execution, it is architecturally compatible with existing techniques for accelerating RL. Code is available at https://github.com/kylemontgomery1/verl-recipe/tree/obsspec/obsspec.

</details>

### 245. [Correlation-Aware Reconstruction for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15250v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15250

**作者：** Md. Johir Raihan、Zahra Zamanzadeh Darban、Yueyang Liu、Flora D. Salim、Levin Kuhlmann、Mahsa Salehi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15250v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15250v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 CARMA，一种双隐空间的重建式 VAE：一个隐空间建模时序动态，另一个被显式监督以重建窗口内通道间的两两 Pearson 相关，两者在解码器中融合，并以重建误差检测异常；在 TSB-AD-M（17 数据集、180 序列）上对比 29 个基线方法。

**相关性简评：** 时序异常检测与 LVR 主线较远，但其把关系性信息从时序动态中拆到独立隐空间、用显式监督目标训练该支路、并通过消融核查各支路贡献的做法，可能为 LVR 中分离视觉关系与推理状态、验证 latent 内容是否被真正使用提供方法线索，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Correlation-Aware Reconstruction for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection

**abstract/A1：** Reconstruction-based detectors for multivariate time series anomaly detection typically learn a single entangled representation of normal behavior and flag anomalies based on reconstruction error. However, real-world anomalies are not only isolated spikes in a single channel but also disruptions in the relationships between channels, where each sensor individually appears normal, but their joint behavior deviates from the norm. Because these models compress both temporal evolution and inter-channel structure into this single space, they lack an explicit mechanism to isolate such inter-channel dependencies from normal temporal dependencies, leading to lower detection rates for cross-channel anomalies. We propose CARMA (Correlation-Aware Reconstruction for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection), which is a reconstruction-based variational autoencoder with two complementary latent spaces: a temporal latent that captures sequential dynamics, and a correlation latent that is trained to reconstruct the window's pairwise Pearson correlations. Both representations are fused in the signal decoder, and anomalies are detected from the reconstruction error. We evaluate CARMA on the TSB-AD-M benchmark suite (17 datasets, 180 series) against 29 baseline methods, and show that it significantly outperforms all of them across multiple threshold-free and range-aware metrics, achieving a VUS-PR of 0.4929. Ablations show that removing the correlation branch degrades performance, that adding a second latent without supervision recovers only part of the gain, and that supervising the correlation latent with an explicit correlation target accounts for the rest and produces a sharper error response at anomalies.

</details>

### 246. [LeHami: Symplectic Latent Dynamics for World Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15267v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15267

**作者：** Romina Yalovetzky、Randall Balestriero、Yann LeCun

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15267v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15267v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 LeHami，用动作条件下的 Hamiltonian 流替换 JEPA 世界模型的普通自回归预测器，在结构化 latent 状态 (q, p) 上以保辛 leapfrog 积分，从而在任意参数与动作下保持相空间体积、排除 latent 收缩与状态合并，并在视觉摆环境中改善长程速度预测。

**相关性简评：** 其「latent 状态在长 rollout 中收缩/不同状态合并」的失效分析与 LVR 中 latent 信息坍缩、多步状态更新的稳定性问题直接对应，保辛结构作为替代表示正则化的推理期约束可供核查；但对象是低维动力学世界模型而非 VLM 推理，迁移性需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LeHami: Symplectic Latent Dynamics for World Models

**abstract/A1：** Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) learn world models directly in latent space, but unconstrained autoregressive predictors may contract the latent distribution over long rollouts. We introduce Symplectic Hamiltonian JEPA (LeHami), which replaces the standard predictor with an action-conditioned Hamiltonian flow over a structured latent state (q, p) integrated using an exactly symplectic leapfrog step. This construction preserves phase-space volume at every rollout step and rules out uniform contraction, asymptotically stable fixed points, and merging of distinct latent states, independently of the learned parameters or action sequence. We obtain the momentum-like component from temporal derivatives of the learned position-like representation, providing an explicit second-order state for prediction and control. On conservative and actuated visual pendulum environments, LeHami substantially improves long-horizon velocity prediction over an unconstrained JEPA world model and empirically maintains constant latent volume where the baseline contracts. The learned flow also supports accurate integration at unseen sub-frame step sizes and numerical time reversal. These results show how geometric structure can provide inference-time guarantees that are complementary to representation regularization in latent world models.

</details>

### 247. [GeoBridge: Evolving Transferable Decoder Topologies for Geometric Vision](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15280v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15280

**作者：** Rui Wang、Haoyu Zhang、Ran Cheng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15280v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15280v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** GeoBridge 提出一种进化式神经架构搜索框架，把解码器中阶段内部的变换组织方式（残差、串行、并行组合）作为可搜索对象，并用功能树编码、阶段感知交叉变异及免训练的梯度敏感度对齐代理来筛选候选拓扑，最终在深度估计和高斯重建等几何视觉系统中实例化验证其可迁移性。

**相关性简评：** 其把「变换的组合拓扑」当作可迁移设计对象、并以免训练代理快速评估候选的做法，或可迁移到 latent 推理中状态更新模块的组合结构与低成本筛选，但面向几何视觉解码器、是否适用于自回归或循环式推理状态仍需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GeoBridge: Evolving Transferable Decoder Topologies for Geometric Vision

**abstract/A1：** Depth estimation and Gaussian reconstruction share a need for multi-scale feature processing, yet use different prediction interfaces and training objectives. Whether a decoder's internal computation can be optimized once and reused across these systems remains a structural design question. Search over primitive configurations alone leaves the organization of transformations fixed. To address this gap, we propose GeoBridge, an evolutionary framework for transferable decoder topologies. First, GeoBridge makes stage-internal topology searchable through residual, sequential, and parallel composition of configurable primitives. Shape-preserving composition retains the stage interfaces of a fixed multi-scale scaffold. Second, a functional-tree encoding supports stage-aware crossover and hierarchical mutation, while a gradient sensitivity-alignment proxy evaluates candidates without training. Multi-objective evolution balances this proxy with computation and parameter cost. Third, selected topologies are instantiated and trained in target systems with task-specific prediction interfaces. A single source search takes approximately 12 GPU hours. GeoBridgeNet-A3 achieves the best depth accuracy among four adapted decoder baselines under a common encoder and training protocol on NYU Depth V2 and KITTI. The same topology reaches 27.11 dB PSNR in Gaussian novel-view synthesis on RealEstate10K, and its refined representations support open-vocabulary segmentation on LERF. These results support decoder topology as a reusable design object across the evaluated geometric vision systems. Code and pretrained weights are available at https://github.com/EMI-Group/GeoBridge-NAS.

</details>

### 248. [Imperfect Verifiers, Exact Targets: Inference-Time Scaling for Continuous Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15281v1>)

**作者：** Kijung Jeon、Molei Tao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.CO、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15281v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15281v1>)
