摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 CS-VGB：对连续状态生成模型在推理期通过反复去噪/重噪与中间状态回溯进行引导采样，并证明在验证器不完美时清洁检查点的稳态分布仍等于目标的 reward-tilted 分布、收敛随检查点数线性增长；在扩散模型和一步后验映射上以图像生成与多机器人规划验证。

**相关性简评：** 其「不完美中间验证器下的回溯式搜索与收敛保证」可能可供核查 LVR 中 LOOK/验证信号可信度、停止决策与计算预算增长下的收益，但对象是连续生成采样而非 VLM latent 推理状态，迁移性需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Imperfect Verifiers, Exact Targets: Inference-Time Scaling for Continuous Generation

**abstract/A1：** Verifier-guided inference-time scaling uses additional computation to score intermediate states and steer generation toward better outputs. However, imperfect intermediate verifiers can distort sampling, and repeated refinement alone does not ensure recovery of the desired reward-tilted distribution. We introduce Continuous-State Verifier-Guided Backtracking (CS-VGB), an inference-time scaling method for sampling from reward-tilted distributions with continuous generative models through repeated denoising and renoising. With correctly paired denoising and renoising transitions, the stationary distribution of CS-VGB at the clean checkpoint equals the desired reward-tilted target, even when intermediate verifiers are inaccurate. Under stated regularity conditions, CS-VGB converges exponentially to the target despite verifier error, and the expected number of updates needed to reach a clean sample grows only linearly with the number of checkpoints. In analytically tractable settings, we empirically demonstrate that CS-VGB recovers the desired reward-tilted distribution despite verifier error, whereas the compared verifier-based sampling methods fail to recover the target under the same verifier errors. We also instantiate the framework with diffusion models and one-step stochastic posterior maps. Across prompt-guided ImageNet generation, facial-attribute generation on CelebA, and multi-robot planning, recurrent CS-VGB search improves reward and task success as inference budgets grow, with image-generation rewards continuing beyond the observed plateaus of denoising-only baselines.

**comment/C1：** 74 pages

</details>

### 249. [CHEAR: Confusion-Hierarchy Evidence-Aware Reasoning for Cost-Efficient Human Activity Recognition](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15298v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15298

**作者：** Xiangqing Lu、Tao Zhu、Mingxing Nie、Liming Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15298v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15298v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 CHEAR：用跨被试检索错误构建并验证活动混淆层级与活动对判别知识，把候选比较顺序和知识的组织部分移到离线；推理时 LLM 按层级逐步保留候选，仅对剩余活动访问局部判别知识。在八个穿戴传感器数据集上报告了跨被试/跨数据集识别精度、候选缩减率与 token 消耗的下降。

**相关性简评：** 虽属传感活动识别而非视觉推理，但「混淆层级驱动的候选渐进剪枝 + 按需调用判别证据」与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、动态计算及何时获取证据的决策可能相通，可供核查其离线组织与在线保留策略能否迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CHEAR: Confusion-Hierarchy Evidence-Aware Reasoning for Cost-Efficient Human Activity Recognition

**abstract/A1：** Large language models (LLMs) offer a new approach to wearable-sensor-based human activity recognition. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) further introduces similar motion examples and discriminative sensor knowledge, enabling decisions grounded in observations relevant to the current query. More evidence, however, does not necessarily mean better-organized evidence. When online prompts and LLM agents primarily orchestrate inference, decisions about which activities to compare and when to invoke discriminative knowledge remain concentrated at inference time. As the activity vocabulary grows, the model must repeatedly process more candidates and associated knowledge, whereas pruning candidates too early risks excluding the true activity. We propose confusion-hierarchy evidence-aware reasoning (CHEAR), which moves part of this knowledge organization offline. CHEAR constructs and validates an activity hierarchy from recurrent cross-subject retrieval errors and builds corresponding activity-pair knowledge. At inference time, the hierarchy orders candidate comparisons; the LLM retains candidates progressively, and local discriminative knowledge is accessed only for the remaining activities. Across eight datasets, CHEAR achieves 86.79\\% mean cross-subject accuracy, a 75.91\\% candidate reduction rate, and 96.44\\% true-activity retention. Per-sample token use is 85.15\\% lower on average than in a variant without the hierarchical structure. Mean accuracy across eight cross-dataset transfer directions is 88.81\\%. These results show that organizing candidates and discriminative knowledge around observed activity confusions reduces online LLM input while maintaining recognition performance.

</details>

**作者：** Yifeng Mao、Yuze Feng、Yutong Shen、Liyang Gao、Zhixiang He

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.LO、cs.NE

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** FENAS 提出一种拓扑无关的少数样本（few-shot）架构性能预测框架，其核心 CAST 流水线通过 copula 对齐与协同变换把多个异构零成本代理（ZCP）映射为紧凑特征流形，使轻量元学习器在极少标注下给出可靠排序，并用它加速 NAS 搜索。

**相关性简评：** 「融合多个异构廉价信号 + 少样本监督得到排序」的 CAST 思路，可能为 LVR 中多 latent 假设或视觉证据的筛选与聚合提供可借鉴线索；copula 对齐与协同变换能否迁移到 latent 相似度打分值得核查，但原文验证的是 NAS 场景，迁移属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FENAS: A Few-Shot Meta-Ensembling Framework for Efficient Neural Architecture Search with Synergized Zero-Cost Proxies

**abstract/A1：** Efficient neural architecture search (NAS) requires accurate performance estimation under limited evaluation budgets. Existing zero-cost proxies (ZCPs) provide fast training-free signals, but each proxy usually captures only a partial property of an architecture, leading to unstable rankings across datasets and search spaces. In contrast, GNN-based predictors can improve accuracy, but often depend on labeled architectures, graph encoders, and costly representation learning, which makes them less suitable for extreme few-shot settings. We propose FENAS, a topology-agnostic few-shot prediction framework that turns complementary initialization priors into robust ranking signals. Its core component, CAST, is a feature pipeline that combines copula alignment and synergy transformation. CAST maps heterogeneous ZCPs into a compact feature manifold, enabling lightweight meta-learners to produce reliable rankings from scarce supervision. On NAS-Bench-201, with only 0.5% labeled samples, FENAS achieves a Kendall's Tau ($τ$) of 0.70, outperforming representative topology-based few-shot predictors in this low-label regime. In closed-domain search, FENAS evaluates the NAS-Bench-201 space in approximately 1138 seconds and achieves competitive test accuracy. By providing a fast, reliable, and structurally simple evaluation mechanism, FENAS supports the design of automated neural architectures under limited evaluation budgets.

**comment/C1：** 15 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at ICONIP 2026

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CR、stat.ML

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该白皮书提出 Machine Deception Detector：读取语言模型每一层的激活，仅用回答标签学习哪些 token 携带欺骗证据，并校准告警阈值使假阳性率低于预设水平；再用检测器集成衡量分数不确定性，仅在成员一致时告警，计划在 Liars' Bench 的五个未见任务和多个 Qwen3 模型上评估，并观察欺骗特征出现在哪些层及随模型规模的变化。

**相关性简评：** 其逐层读取内部激活、定位证据 token、报告特征所在层与集成置信度校准的做法，可能为 LVR 中「任务必要信息保留在哪些层/位置」以及置信度与停止决策提供可核查的方法线索；但研究对象是纯文本欺骗检测，与视觉或多模态推理无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Accuracy and Uncertainty in Machine Deception Detection (Research White Paper)

**abstract/A1：** A deception detector is only as useful as the trust its alarms deserve. Like a polygraph, detectors that read a language model's internal activations can catch deceptive responses that look honest. Yet current detectors depend on which layers they read, weaken on broader tests, and do not state how certain their alarms are. This white paper proposes the Machine Deception Detector, which targets both detection accuracy and the uncertainty of detector scores. The detector reads every layer of the language model, learns which tokens carry evidence of deception using only response labels, and calibrates its alarm threshold so that its false--positive rate stays below a prescribed level. An ensemble of such detectors measures the uncertainty of each score and raises an alarm only when its members agree, with a confidence level that sets how certain each alarm must be. The proposed evaluation trains on instructed honest and deceptive statements, tests on five unseen deceptive tasks of Liars' Bench read by six Qwen3 models from 0.6B to 32B parameters, and is designed to also show which layers carry the deception feature and how this changes with model size.

**comment/C1：** 18 pages, 2 figures

</details>

### 252. [SuperAI: Merging Capabilities Across Heterogeneous Foundation Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15322v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15322

**作者：** Jingtong Dou、Chuancheng Shi、Wenhua Wu、Wei Bao、Fei Shen、Zhiyong Wang、Tat-Seng Chua

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15322v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15322v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出跨架构多模型融合框架 SuperAI：用共享锚样本从源模型与宿主模型提取任务相关表示，以 PCA 构造同维低维功能子空间，再用正交 Procrustes 对齐两套坐标系，并训练轻量残差 MLP 在任务输出与源模型增量联合监督下学习输入相关的残差增量并注入宿主模型，在三个宿主模型、15 个能力域上验证融合效果。

**相关性简评：** 论文本身不涉及视觉或多模态推理，但其「低维任务相关子空间提取—正交对齐—残差增量注入宿主模型」的做法，可能为 LVR 关心的任务必要信息是否保留在内部状态、以及外部证据特征如何注入宿主 latent 状态提供可供核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SuperAI: Merging Capabilities Across Heterogeneous Foundation Models

**abstract/A1：** Enabling the reuse and composition of knowledge and capabilities distributed across foundation models is an important step toward building scalable artificial intelligence (AI) systems. However, architectural differences and incompatible representations make it difficult to transfer and integrate these capabilities through a unified cross-model interface. To address this challenge, we propose SuperAI, a cross-architecture multi-model fusion framework that integrates complementary capabilities from multiple source models into a host model through orthogonal alignment of low-dimensional task-relevant representations. Specifically, we first extract task-relevant representations from the source models and the host model using shared anchor samples, and apply principal component analysis (PCA) to construct low-dimensional functional subspaces with the same dimensionality. Next, we use orthogonal Procrustes mappings to align the source and host coordinate systems, establishing cross-model correspondences while preserving the internal geometry of each source subspace. Finally, we train a lightweight residual multilayer perceptron (MLP) with joint supervision on task outputs and source-model increments, learning input-dependent residual increments that are injected into the host model for multi-model capability fusion. Experiments on three host models across 15 capability domains show that SuperAI achieves higher average domain scores than the evaluated cross-architecture fusion methods and better preserves general capabilities as the number of source models increases. Ablation studies further support the effectiveness of orthogonal alignment, nonlinear residual mapping, and joint supervision.

</details>

### 253. [TempoKV: Predictive KV Cache Quantization for Autoregressive Video Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15324v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 TempoKV，一个免训练的预测式 KV cache 量化框架：观察到自回归视频生成中 key 可由时间历史高度预测、value 主要依赖当前 key 且只需短历史，于是按二者不同依赖分别预测并仅以低精度存储残差，预测器用少量 BF16 样本线性回归离线校准后固定，在多个视频扩散模型上取得更高压缩比与质量。

**相关性简评：** 其「按状态依赖结构预测内部状态、只存残差」的缓存压缩视角，可能可供核查借鉴于 LVR 中 latent/注意力状态的压缩、缓存与信息保留问题，但原文面向视频生成，与多模态推理状态生成的联系仍需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TempoKV: Predictive KV Cache Quantization for Autoregressive Video Generation

**abstract/A1：** Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models enable streaming generation of long videos but suffer from significant memory overhead due to the rapidly growing KV cache. Existing KV cache quantization methods are primarily designed for LLMs and transfer poorly to video models, where activations exhibit different statistics and strong spatiotemporal redundancy. We observe that the video KV cache is largely predictable over time, with a clear asymmetry. Keys are highly predictable from their temporal history, while values depend primarily on the current key and need a short history of preceding values. Based on these observations, we propose \\textbf{\\method}, a training-free predictive KV cache quantization framework for AR video generation. \\method predicts keys and values according to their distinct dependencies and stores only the residuals at low precision. Both predictors are lightweight, calibrated once offline by linear regression on a small set of BF16 samples, and remain fixed across prompts and generation runs. Experiments on Self-Forcing, Causal Forcing, and LongCat-Video-13B show that \\method consistently achieves higher generation quality than existing KV cache quantization methods at comparable or higher compression ratios, reaching up to $6.71\\times$ KV cache compression with the best overall quality--efficiency tradeoff. Our code will be released on GitHub.

</details>

### 254. [ZOIF: Zeroth-Order Influence Function Estimation for LLM Data Selection Using Only Forward Passes](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15336v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15336

**作者：** Lisong He、Yunxuan Jiang、Haishan Ye、Xiangyu Chang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15336v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15336v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ZOIF，一种只用前向传播的零阶影响函数估计框架：先用零阶估计近似平均代理梯度，再把逆 Hessian 向量积改写为辅助零阶优化，最后沿参数更新方向做前向有限差分得到逐样本影响分数，用于 LLM 数据选择并显著降低峰值显存。

**相关性简评：** 论文本身不涉及多模态或 latent 推理，但其无反向传播、低显存的影响估计思路，可能与 LVR 关心的「轨迹训练、贡献分配与监督」问题相关，可供核查其能否迁移到推理轨迹或视觉证据样本的贡献评估。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ZOIF: Zeroth-Order Influence Function Estimation for LLM Data Selection Using Only Forward Passes

**abstract/A1：** Influence functions enable principled data selection for large language models (e.g., identifying influential training samples for model editing, debugging, or efficient fine-tuning). However, scaling IFs to LLMs is hindered by the intractability of billion-scale Hessian matrices and the prohibitive memory overhead of backpropagation (BP). While many classical IF approximations reduce Hessian complexity, they still rely on BP for gradient computation, requiring massive storage for intermediate activations that impedes practical data selection at scale. To address this, we propose ZOIF, a zeroth-order framework for influence estimation that operates entirely via forward passes, enabling memory-efficient data selection under resource constraints. ZOIF decomposes influence estimation into three BP-free stages: (1) approximating the average proxy gradient via zeroth-order estimation; (2) reformulating and solving the inverse Hessian-vector product as an auxiliary zeroth-order optimization to bypass explicit inversion; and (3) deriving per-sample influence scores via a forward finite difference along the previously computed parameter update direction. Experiments show that ZOIF selects data subsets with downstream utility competitive with, and in some cases exceeding, the evaluated baselines, yet at substantially lower peak memory cost and with comparable overall computation time.

</details>

### 255. [Across Viewpoints and Time: Trajectory-Generalizable Physical Attacks on World Models and Video Understanding Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15343v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15343

**作者：** Song Xia、Meiwen Ding、Chenqi Kong、Wenhan Yang、Xudong Jiang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15343v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15343v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究单一物理对抗纹理能否在视角与时间轨迹变化的真实场景中持续欺骗世界模型与视频理解模型，提出轨迹感知的对齐与细化攻击 TARA，并构建几何接地的跟踪评测流程与实拍复现数据。

**相关性简评：** 其「轨迹感知对比对齐」把来自不同视频—轨迹实例的表征拉向共享对抗区域，这一跨异质轨迹的表征对齐与监督线索，可能可供核查 LVR 中不同推理轨迹或长度下 latent 状态的对齐与训练监督设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Across Viewpoints and Time: Trajectory-Generalizable Physical Attacks on World Models and Video Understanding Models

**abstract/A1：** World models and video understanding models are increasingly deployed in dynamic visual environments, yet their robustness to physical adversarial threats remains largely underexplored. We study whether a single physical adversarial texture can mislead the victim model across different real-world scenarios where observing viewpoints vary along uncontrolled object--camera trajectories. We identify that heterogeneous video semantics and trajectories induce poorly aligned gradients for optimizing the adversarial texture. To address that, we propose the Trajectory-aware adversarial Alignment and Refinement Attack (TARA), which incorporates trajectory-aware optimization to capture the evolving geometric variations of a printed texture under real-world scenarios. To improve cross-instance optimization compatibility, TARA incorporates trajectory-aware contrastive alignment to encourage attacked representations from diverse video--trajectory instances to approach a shared adversarial region and then performs trajectory-aware task refinement to translate the aligned representation into task-level prediction errors. For reproducible evaluation, we develop a geometry-grounded tracking pipeline that provides physically plausible adversarial regions with temporally consistent trajectories on EPIC-KITCHENS-100 and Something-Something V2. We further collect real-world print-and-recapture videos to validate attack effectiveness under physical deployment conditions. Together, the annotated benchmarks and real-world captured data form a reproducible testbed for future evaluation. Notably, our results reveal that a single printable adversarial texture can persistently disrupt world models and video understanding models under physical conditions, highlighting the fundamental security challenge.

**comment/C1：** Project page: https://xiasong0501.github.io/TARA/

</details>

### 256. [TRACE: Temporal Risk Assessment and Concept Editing for Safer Language Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15365v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15365

**作者：** Ankur Garg、Xuemin Yu、Hassan Sajjad、Samira Ebrahimi Kahou

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** TRACE 在语言模型生成过程中做风险检测与干预：学习一个激活模式码本，把每个 token 激活最近邻映射为潜在概念，用 GRU 综合激活与概念特征预测整句有害性和单调累积的流式风险，并将有害概念的激活沿邻近良性方向选择性编辑，同时留下可供事后审计的检测与编辑记录。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本安全生成工作，但「token 激活→码本概念分配→循环网络追踪状态→对潜在方向选择性编辑并审计」的线索，可能可供核查 LVR 中内部概念是否真正被使用、以及如何干预与追溯潜在状态，需判断其向视觉多模态推理迁移的可行性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TRACE: Temporal Risk Assessment and Concept Editing for Safer Language Generation

**abstract/A1：** Large language models (LLMs) can produce harmful content while generating a response. A useful safeguard should not only detect this risk during generation but also intervene while leaving safe responses largely unchanged and provide an auditable record of the internal patterns supporting its decisions. We propose TRACE (Temporal Risk Assessment and Concept Editing), a framework that tracks harmful-response risk during generation, selectively edits token activations, and leaves an auditable trace of its detection and steering decisions. TRACE learns a codebook of recurring activation patterns, with each codebook vector representing a latent concept. At inference time, it assigns each token activation to the nearest codebook vector to obtain the corresponding concept. A gated recurrent unit (GRU) processes the activations and their assigned concept features to predict completed-response harmfulness and a monotone cumulative streaming risk. During steering, activations assigned to harmful concepts are steered along directions defined by nearby benign targets. An external LLM labels the learned concepts post hoc, making detection sequences and harmful-to-benign edit records interpretable. Experiments across three generators and the WildGuard and S-Eval benchmarks show that TRACE improves streaming F1 over Kelp in five of six comparisons while remaining competitive on completed-response detection. TRACE's selective steering reduces Harmbench attack success with little change in refusal on originally safe responses. The post-hoc audit reveals recurring semantic structure in the learned concepts and distinct traces associated with harmful detection, safe generation, and activation edits.

</details>

### 257. [Fewer Bits, More Tries: Recovering Capability Under Memory Constraints](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15372v1>)

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究在内存受限下放弃大模型，改为用小模型或压缩模型并行多次采样，并用公开或模型自生成的测试做验证式重试选择，在四个代码生成基准上比较精度与内存、时延、能耗的权衡。

**相关性简评：** 其「verified retry」以测试验证在多个候选中择优，并对测试时计算与模型容量、压缩率、能耗做量化权衡，可能为 LVR 中候选 latent 状态的筛选验证与 THINK/STOP 的收益成本核算提供线索，但该工作无视觉或多模态内容，迁移可行性有待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Fewer Bits, More Tries: Recovering Capability Under Memory Constraints

**abstract/A1：** Large language models are generally more capable than smaller ones, but their memory requirements can make local deployment difficult. We ask whether part of this capability gap can instead be recovered by running a smaller or more compressed model multiple times and selecting among its outputs using public or model-generated tests. Single-user local inference can leave hardware underutilized, allowing parallel candidate generation to trade additional test-time computation for accuracy at modest latency cost. Across four code-generation benchmarks, verified retry recovers substantial accuracy lost to model size or compression. A 7B Qwen model with eight parallel attempts essentially matches a 32B model on MBPP+ and exceeds it on the other three benchmarks, while using about $4\\times$ less model memory, running up to $6\\times$ faster, and using less energy, as measured on Nvidia GPU. We observe similar tradeoff across model sizes, compression levels and hardware choices, although exact benefit depends on the hardware profile and problem setting. These results show that model capacity can be traded for verified test-time computation when correct solutions remain reachable within a modest retry budget.

</details>

**内容简述：** 论文用 Weighted Stochastic Block Model 替换随机连接以构造具生物模块性的 Echo State Network 储层，并引入 InputDSA 分离结构先验对内在递归动力学与外部输入的影响，发现结构多样性不必然带来行为多样性、且成功网络在环境约束下动力学趋于收敛。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Analyzing the Dynamics of WSBM-based Echo State Networks using InputDSA

**abstract/A1：** Bridging the structural gap between biological brains and artificial neural networks presents a pathway to altered computational dynamics. This paper introduces a Reservoir Computing framework that replaces random networks with biologically realistic modularity by applying the Weighted Stochastic Block Model (WSBM) to Echo State Networks (ESNs). This topological parameterization constructs reservoirs reflecting latent functional sub-circuits. Furthermore, the integration of Input Dynamical Similarity Analysis (InputDSA) provides a mechanism to isolate and compare how structural priors modulate intrinsic recurrent dynamics versus external inputs. By evaluating these architectures, we establish that structural diversity does not necessarily predicts behavioral diversity across the selected network subset. Furthermore, our demixed analysis confirms Anna Karenina principle of dynamics, demonstrating that environmental constraints enforce dynamical convergence in successful agents, while failing networks degenerate into idiosyncratic trajectories.

**comment/C1：** 9 pages excluding refs and appendices, 9 figures

</details>

### 259. [E8 Lattice Key Quantization for Low-Bit KV-Cache Compression](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15384v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15384

**作者：** Sasho Nedelkoski、Alexander Acker、Soeren Becker、Dominik Scheinert、Odej Kao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15384v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15384v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文用基于 E8 格点的向量量化对 LLM 的 KV 缓存 key 做低位宽量化，配合表驱动非对称打分避免显式反量化，在 2-bit key/2-bit value 下接近基线长上下文困惑度并保持解码吞吐。

**相关性简评：** 其「利用相邻维度相关性、以结构化 VQ 提升每字节 SQNR」的思路，可能为压缩 latent 推理状态或视觉证据缓存时抑制信息坍缩提供可核查的方法线索；但原文只针对文本 KV 缓存，与 VLM 推理状态的适配性尚需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** E8 Lattice Key Quantization for Low-Bit KV-Cache Compression

**abstract/A1：** Compressing the key-value (KV) cache is essential for serving long-context large language models (LLMs) under memory constraints. While current scalar quantization methods achieve significant compression, they typically face a quality-fidelity trade-off, either suffering from performance instability at 2-bit precision or necessitating 3-bit keys to maintain model quality. In this work, we demonstrate that a uniform low-bit k2v2 configuration (2-bit keys and 2-bit values) can preserve near-baseline quality by using vector quantization (VQ) based on the $E\_8$ lattice for KV keys. We show that structured VQ exploits correlations across adjacent dimensions to achieve signal-to-quantization-noise ratios (SQNR) higher than those of independent scalar quantization at the same key payload rate. To ensure practical utility, we adapt a table-based asymmetric scoring algorithm that avoids explicit codebook dequantization during attention computation and preserves decode-throughput parity with scalar baselines. Across five LLM families, our $E\_8$ k2v2 approach yields \\textasciitilde$6\\times$ KV compression, roughly 20\\% smaller than scalar k3v2 (3-bit keys and 2-bit values), while retaining near-baseline long-context perplexity. In our full-suite perplexity evaluation, $E\_8$ improves over scalar k3v2 in 80\\% of model--dataset--context settings. These results indicate that $E\_8$ lattice VQ improves quality per byte while keeping throughput at parity, suggesting that structured key quantization is a useful primitive for KV-compression stacks. Overall, our work provides a low-overhead primitive for expanding the quality-memory frontier in long-context LLM inference.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15394

**作者：** Shengkun Tang、Dan Alistarh、Zhiqiang Shen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 WUSPruner，把结构化剪枝的基选择形式化为局部线性重构问题，证明在正定二阶矩下由激活与权重统计联合构造的 WUS 变换可在所有可逆基变换中最小化剪枝重构损失并使两个二阶矩同时对对角化，据此在 Llama、Qwen 8B–72B 上实现分块剪枝。

**相关性简评：** 其二阶矩基选择与「删除误差按独立谱分量分解」的视角，或可供核查 latent 推理状态表示基与坐标信息含量的关系，但论文本身不涉及视觉或多模态推理，联系属推测性借鉴。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** WUSPruner: Second-Moment-Optimal Transforms for Structured Pruning

**abstract/A1：** Structured pruning is typically formulated as identifying which model dimensions to remove, often within the model's original representation. However, the effect of coordinate deletion fundamentally depends on the basis in which pruning is performed. This raises a more fundamental question: how should the basis be chosen specifically for coordinate deletion? We introduce WUSPruner, a transform-based framework for structured pruning of large language models. We formulate basis selection as a local linear reconstruction problem that directly minimizes the reconstruction loss induced by pruning. Inspired by the second-moment transformation in WUSH, we consider a WUS transform constructed jointly from activation and weight statistics. We show that under positive-definite second moments, WUS transform minimizes the local reconstruction loss over all invertible changes of basis. In the resulting basis, the activation and weight second moments are simultaneously diagonalized and balanced, causing the deletion error to decompose into independent spectral contributions and yielding a principled criterion for coordinate selection. Guided by this result, we develop a scalable pruning method based on blockwise WUS transformations and compact input projections. Experiments on Llama and Qwen models from 8B to 72B parameters show consistent improvements over structured pruning baselines across language modeling, knowledge, commonsense reasoning, mathematics, and code generation benchmarks, while also delivering practical reductions in inference latency and memory usage.

</details>

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 GA-SVD：用 on-policy 知识蒸馏梯度构造与生成行为对齐的白化变换（GAWW），并用进化搜索在给定全局压缩比下做逐层 rank 分配，以提升 LLM 低秩压缩在生成任务上的保真度。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本压缩工作，但与主线无直接关系；其「在全局预算约束下按层分配 rank」的进化搜索与生成对齐的梯度加权，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 容量/计算预算的分配与监督信号设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GA-SVD: Generation-aware Singular Value Decomposition for LLM Compression

**abstract/A1：** Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong generalization across a broad range of reasoning and generation tasks, but their large parameter counts impose substantial memory and computation costs, hindering deployment in practical resource-constrained settings. One-shot low-rank compression is a promising solution since it reduces model size and inference cost effectively. However, existing SVD-based methods primarily target multiple-choice benchmarks and often fail to preserve performance on generation tasks. Moreover, their rank allocation strategies are typically heuristic. We propose GA-SVD, a generation-aware low-rank compression framework for LLMs. First, we introduce Generation-Aware Weight Whitening (GAWW), which leverages gradients from on-policy knowledge distillation to construct whitening transformations aligned with generative behavior. Second, we develop an evolutionary global rank allocation method that searches for effective layer-wise rank allocation under a given global compression ratio. Across extensive experiments on Mistral-7B, Qwen3 series, and Llama-3.3 models, evaluated on both multiple-choice and generative benchmarks, GA-SVD consistently outperforms existing SVD-based baselines and achieves state-of-the-art (SoTA) results. We further demonstrate scalability by applying our method to models with up to 70B parameters.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15401

**作者：** Xin Liu、Yutong Jiang、Jian Su、Ziheng Wang、Chuang Wang、Haoran Li、Dongbin Zhao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.RO

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文认为让 VLM 回归精确奖励与其能力不匹配，转而把 VLM 当作成功检测器：提出 VLMeg，先用当前 episode 与生成成功轨迹的相似度做「值得判定」门控，再从中挑出混淆度最低的关键观测交给 VLM 评估，作为情节奖励，并配合探索激励提高触发频率，在 MetaWorld 与真实环境中验证从零训练 RL。

**相关性简评：** 关键观测的相似度门控与低混淆筛选是一条具体的视觉证据筛选线索，或可对照 LVR 中「何时调用视觉证据、选取哪个观测（LOOK/STOP 决策）」的问题；但研究主线是具身 RL 奖励设计，与 latent 推理状态的关联需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Harnessing VLM in Embodied RL: From Reward Regressor to Success Detector via Exploration-Augmented Key-Observation Gating

**abstract/A1：** VLMs provide promising solutions to embodied reward design. Most current methods that train VLMs as reward regressors not only require extensive annotations but are also primarily designed for finetuning pretrained policies, and perform less well in the more challenging from-scratch RL setting. This issue stems from a fundamental mismatch: regressing precise rewards is misaligned with what VLMs naturally excel at. We posit that it is more aligned with VLMs' inherent multi-modal VQA capabilities for the models to function as success detectors, and propose VLM success reward via Exploration-Augmented Key-Observation Gating (VLMeg) to well harness VLM for embodied reward design. As the core of VLMeg, the proposed exploration-augmented key-observation gating first determines whether the current RL episode is judgment-worthy based on its similarity to a generated success trajectory. Then, the key observation with the lowest confusion from the judgment-worthy episode will be selected for VLM evaluation as episodic reward. This gating mechanism not only avoids redundant calls but also enables higher detection accuracy of VLM. Considering the sparsity of judgment-worthy episodes, the advanced exploration incentives based on the generated trajectory are introduced, enabling more efficient exploration toward judgment-worthy trajectories for more VLM reward triggers and thus gaining higher RL efficiency. Extensive experiments in MetaWorld demonstrate VLMeg achieves state-of-the-art from-scratch RL, outperforming advanced VLM-based baselines on 12 challenging reward-free tasks. Furthermore, VLMeg also enables effective RL without any ground-truth reward in 3 challenging real-world experiments. Code will be open after acceptance at https://github.com/Raina915/VLMeg.

</details>

### 263. [SpecFit: Not All Draft Tokens Cost the Same in Offloaded MoE Inference](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15417v1>)

**作者：** Hongliang Cao、Xiuyu Li、Siqi Wang、Ziming Wang、Jingmin Zhu、Hailong Yang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对 MoE 模型专家权重卸载后投机解码的 H2D 传输开销，提出 SpecFit：用 draft 路径概率估计可提交 token 数、用子树激活专家的并集预测周期时间，搜索使预测吞吐最大的祖先封闭子树，并在每层草稿后据此决定何时停止草稿。

**相关性简评：** 其按成本模型筛选候选子树、并在每轮判断是否继续的机制，可能与 LVR 的动态计算分配与停止决策（STOP）可供核查；但该文属 MoE 推理系统优化，不涉及视觉推理或 latent 状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SpecFit: Not All Draft Tokens Cost the Same in Offloaded MoE Inference

**abstract/A1：** Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models activate only a few experts per token, but when their expert weights are offloaded to host memory, host-to-device (H2D) expert transfers enter the critical path of decoding. Speculative decoding verifies several draft tokens in one forward pass, yet in an MoE model each verified token activates its own experts, so a larger draft tree transfers more experts. Because of this H2D cost, speculative decoding commits several tokens per verification cycle yet is sometimes even slower than autoregressive decoding. Based on this observation, we propose SpecFit, which chooses the verified draft subtree to maximize predicted throughput rather than acceptance length. SpecFit estimates the expected number of committed tokens from draft path probabilities and predicts cycle time from the node count and the per-layer union of the experts the subtree activates; this union is a monotone submodular coverage function, so each node pays only for the experts it adds. An exact search over ancestor-closed subtrees returns the subtree with the highest predicted throughput; run after each draft level, the same search also decides when to stop drafting, and the unmodified target verifies the result. On CNN/DailyMail summarization and a GSM8K subset with Qwen3-30B-A3B, SpecFit decodes 21.6% and 7.0% faster than EAGLE-3 with the same expert cache and 1.97x and 1.72x as fast as vanilla EAGLE-3. Code is available at https://github.com/Chlience/SpecFit.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 PLATO，在基于上下文的离线元强化学习中将推断出的任务 latent 沿远离训练中心的方向扰动以合成反事实任务，用解码器集成在扰动 latent 上做短程 rollout 并按集成不一致度加悲观权重更新策略，并给出 out-of-support 泛化误差界，在八个 MuJoCo 连续控制任务上验证。

**相关性简评：** 其「扰动 latent 制造分布外状态＋用集成不一致度加权伪轨迹」的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态在分布外场景下的轨迹训练与不确定性监督提供可核查的方法线索；但该工作属元强化学习任务表示领域，与 VLM 推理的实际可迁移性需进一步确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Pessimistic Latent Task-aware Optimization for Robust Offline Meta-Reinforcement Learning

**abstract/A1：** Context-based offline meta-reinforcement learning (COMRL) has advanced almost entirely through better task representations, which separate task identity from artifacts of the behavior policy so that the latent reflects the task alone. The implicit expectation has been that a clean representation will transfer to out-of-support (parameter-extrapolation) tasks. On such a task, however, the encoder produces a latent outside the training support, where the policy has never been trained. We address this gap with Pessimistic Latent Task-aware Optimization (PLATO), which exposes the policy to off-support latents during training. PLATO assumes a mild manifold hypothesis: task latents lie on a low-dimensional manifold, and out-of-support tasks lie farther from the training centroid. It exploits this geometry by perturbing inferred latents outward from the centroid to synthesize counterfactual tasks. A learned decoder ensemble then rolls out short trajectories at each perturbed latent, and the policy is updated on the imagined transitions under a pessimism weight that down-weights steps on which the ensemble disagrees. We prove that the perturbation leaves the training support by a controllable margin and that the out-of-support generalization gap is bounded by the same perturbation reach, and we give explicit conditions, verified empirically, under which the epistemic disagreement at the perturbed latent stays bounded away from zero. On eight MuJoCo continuous-control benchmarks, PLATO consistently improves out-of-support returns over strong COMRL baselines while remaining competitive on in-distribution tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/deephoony/plato.

</details>

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 PASP，为每条输入构造文本、语音、视觉（字形）三种感知视图，并用攻防自博弈训练：攻击方借助防守方反馈生成保留意图的伪装表达，防守方以意图不变性奖励学习识别被伪装的有害意图，在中文有害内容基准上大幅降低自适应攻击成功率。

**相关性简评：** 与主线无直接关系，但可核查的方法线索是：把 token 空间中丢失的字形/视觉线索显式放入表征视图，并用自博弈加意图不变性奖励迫使判断跨表面形式保持一致，这或可迁移为 latent 推理状态保留视觉细节、抵抗改写扰动的训练监督思路。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Hidden in Plain Sight: Advancing Harmful Content Understanding via Perception-Aware Adversarial Self-Play

**abstract/A1：** Despite significant advances in language understanding, Large Language Models (LLMs) can still miss meaning hidden in plain sight, failing to identify harmful intent in expressions readily understood by humans. Malicious users exploit this gap by strategically disguising harmful content to evade automated moderation, posing a serious threat to online platform safety. The vulnerability reflects a fundamental cognitive asymmetry between human readers, who integrate contextual, phonetic, and visual cues to decipher the intent behind deliberate obfuscation, and text-based LLMs, which rely primarily on token sequences and have limited exposure to evolving evasions. To bridge this asymmetry, we propose PASP (Perception-Aware Adversarial Self-Play), which combines multi-perceptual views with adversarial self-play to improve understanding of harmful intent as evasions evolve. Specifically, PASP constructs textual, phonetic, and visual views of each input, preserving its original context while exposing pronunciation and glyph cues obscured in token space. During adversarial self-play, an attacker uses defender feedback to generate intent-preserving evasions, while the defender is trained using an intent-invariance reward to understand harmful intent across changing surface forms. Extensive experiments show that PASP reduces adaptive attack success rates by up to 73.71% and 74.49% on ChineseHarm-Bench and EvoHarmBench, respectively, preserves model capabilities with minimal degradation, and effectively interprets real-world evasive expressions in e-commerce.

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文为鲁棒在线 MDP 规划提出首个确定性 anytime 保证：在采样搜索树上确定性地界定未采样轨迹的贡献，得到投影值与真实鲁棒值的上下界，并据此构建 CAR-MCTS，用界引导探索、剪枝可证次优分支并在最优根动作被认证后终止。

**相关性简评：** 其「界引导搜索、可证明次优剪枝、认证后终止」的搜索与验证机制，可能为 LVR 中动态计算分配与 STOP 决策提供可核查的方法线索，但论文本身不涉及视觉或多模态推理，需人工判断迁移可行性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Scalable Robust MCTS with Anytime Deterministic Optimality Guarantees

**abstract/A1：** MDP planners often rely on nominal transition models that may differ from the true dynamics. Robust MDP planning accounts for this uncertainty through a set of admissible models, but doing so with limited online computation is challenging: the search tree grows exponentially with the horizon and each robust backup requires an additional optimization. Existing online robust methods remain limited in scale and offer at most probabilistic guarantees. We introduce, to the best of our knowledge, the first deterministic anytime guarantees for robust online MDP planning. We restrict computation to the sampled search tree while deterministically bounding the contribution of unsampled trajectories. For any fixed policy, we derive lower and upper bounds on the gap between its projected and true robust values under rectangular and non-rectangular uncertainty sets. Under rectangular uncertainty, we propagate these bounds through the robust Bellman operator to bound the optimal robust value. These bounds are computable from the current sampled tree, hold at every node, tighten as the sampled support expands, and converge to the robust values as full support is recovered. We develop CAR-MCTS, a bound-guided MCTS planner that uses these deterministic bounds to guide exploration, prune provably suboptimal branches, and terminate once the optimal root action is certified. The fixed-policy bounds also yield an anytime policy-evaluation mechanism that certifies the robust value of any policy, independent of how it was obtained. Experiments verify the deterministic bounds, their tightening under support expansion, substantial branch pruning, root-action certification, and convergence to the optimal robust policy. To our knowledge, this is the first scalable robust MCTS framework with anytime deterministic guarantees for both online planning and policy evaluation, without enumerating the full state space.

**comment/C1：** 33 pages, including appendix

</details>

### 267. [MemeLogos: Knowledge-Driven Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning for Harmful Meme Detection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15463v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 MemeLogos：把有害梗图中反复出现的危害模式与推理结构抽象为可复用知识单元，组织成星形知识图谱，并用结构化知识检索加受认知机制启发的多阶段显式推理来提升检测性能与可解释性。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线不直接相关，但其「检索结构化外部知识 + 多阶段显式推理」的框架可能为 latent 推理中的证据获取（LOOK 类）与推理轨迹监督提供借鉴线索，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MemeLogos: Knowledge-Driven Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning for Harmful Meme Detection

**abstract/A1：** With the rapid proliferation of social media, harmful memes have become a growing threat to online ecosystems. Their harmfulness is often implicitly conveyed through complex interactions among visual, textual, and contextual cues, making accurate detection challenging. Recent studies have introduced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and external knowledge into harmful meme detection. However, existing methods mainly retrieve similar instances or auxiliary information, limiting their ability to capture reusable harmfulness knowledge and underlying reasoning mechanisms, and thus constraining both detection performance and interpretability. To address these challenges, we propose MemeLogos, a knowledge-driven retrieval-augmented reasoning framework for harmful meme detection. MemeLogos abstracts recurring harmfulness patterns and reasoning structures from diverse harmful cases into reusable knowledge units and organizes them into a dedicated star-shaped knowledge graph. By combining structured knowledge retrieval with an explicit multi-stage reasoning process inspired by cognitive mechanisms, MemeLogos leverages retrieved knowledge to guide harmfulness reasoning, improving both detection reliability and interpretability. Extensive experiments show that MemeLogos consistently outperforms existing harmful meme detection methods while generating more coherent and interpretable reasoning, demonstrating the effectiveness of structured harmfulness knowledge for multimodal content understanding.

</details>

### 268. [Semantic Saliency from Multi-Modal Large Language Model Scene Understanding Maps](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15467v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15467

**作者：** Ziqi Wen、Shravan Murlidaran、Jonathan Skaza、William Wang、Miguel P. Eckstein

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15467v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15467v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 AUTO-SUM：自动分割并移除场景中的单个物体，用 MLLM 分别描述原图与修改后图像，再以文本嵌入度量两段描述的语义相似度，从而量化各物体对场景理解的贡献，并在人类场景理解图与自由观看/描述任务的注视数据上验证其预测能力。

**相关性简评：** 其「移除物体—描述差异」的反事实归因流程，可能为 LVR 中判断哪些视觉细节被保留、如何筛选关键视觉证据或做贡献分配提供可核查的测量线索；但论文目标是预测人类显著性与注视，与推理状态生成无直接关联。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Semantic Saliency from Multi-Modal Large Language Model Scene Understanding Maps

**abstract/A1：** Image-computable low-level image saliency has shaped perceptual psychology and computer science, but is limited by its inability to capture human high-level cognitive factors that influence attention and eye movements. Here, we propose a new fully automated method to compute semantic saliency by quantifying each object's contribution to scene comprehension without fitting any parameters to human data: the Automated Scene Understanding Map (AUTO-SUM). AUTO-SUM automatically segments and removes individual objects from a scene, uses multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to describe the original and modified scenes, and measures the semantic similarity between these descriptions using text embeddings. We show that AUTO-SUM can predict which object is most important in a human-measured scene understanding map (H-SUM) estimated using human scene descriptions. We also show that AUTO-SUM can predict the object most fixated by human observers during free viewing and scene description tasks better than a low-level saliency model (GBVS, Itti-Koch), a saliency model trained based on human meaning ratings (Meaning Map), and comparable to DeepGaze, which is trained on human fixation data. We contend that AUTO-SUM can be used as a semantic saliency model that complements lower-level saliency models. Code are available at https://github.com/starsky77/AUTO-SUM-Source-Code .

</details>

### 269. [SkillFusion: Towards Reliable Multi-Skill Composition for LLM Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15481v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15481

**作者：** Enhao Huang、Xinye Zhao、Yiming Li、Bingrun Yang、Nanjun Zhou、Chunshu Xia、Hongwei Yao、Zhan Qin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15481v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15481v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SkillFusion，一个离线编译器：把多个独立编写的 LLM 智能体技能之间的冲突显式化为带类型与作用域的约束，用类型-作用域门控筛候选交互、选择性回退补漏、分类器判定交互类型、对抗验证器复核不确定判断，再以条件路由、优先级、抽象与去重生成可复用的合并技能，在多个智能体基准上评估成功率。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接关系（纯文本智能体、技能合并），但其冲突门控、选择性回退与对抗验证器复核不确定判断的机制，可能可供核查多 latent 假设的筛选与仲裁、以及 THINK/LOOK/STOP 中是否继续推理或复核证据的决策设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SkillFusion: Towards Reliable Multi-Skill Composition for LLM Agents

**abstract/A1：** Independently authored skills can impose incompatible requirements, competing preferences, and redundant instructions when jointly loaded by an LLM agent. We propose SkillFusion, an offline compiler that reconciles these interactions into a reusable merged skill. Its central idea is to make composition decisions explicit through typed, scoped constraints linked to their source directives. A type-scope gate selects candidate interactions, while selective fallback revisits pairs potentially missed by structural pruning. A classifier identifies interaction types, and an adversarial verifier re-examines uncertain judgments. The resolver applies conditional routing or explicit priorities to hard conflicts, verified abstraction to soft conflicts, and deduplication to redundant instructions. Source-linked checks guide synthesis and compression, and metadata synthesis supports discovery of the merged skill. The resulting artifact retains associated scripts and resources and can be reused across tasks and executor models. SkillFusion achieves the highest mean Success among evaluated non-oracle methods on all three agent benchmarks and on both transfer benchmarks across three executor models. At the largest tested instruction configurations, it achieves over 2.5 times the Success of unresolved multi-skill loading, highlighting the growing value of reconciliation as composition becomes more demanding. The code will be open-sourced after the review process concludes.

**comment/C1：** 29 pages, 10 figures, 15 tables

</details>

### 270. [Large Decision Models: Repurposing Large Language Models as Single-Pass Decision Makers](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15501v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15501

**作者：** Ziyi Chen、Yan Zhang、Jianhui Wei、Jianing Yin、Daoan Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15501v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15501v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Large Decision Models，通过 Diverse Decision Supervision 与基于冻结教师的自问推理蒸馏，把语言模型改造成一次 prefill 前向即对运行期指定标签输出显式概率的决策器，并在 DecisionVista 上配合置信度路由评测精度与延迟。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本、无视觉，但「单次前向直接读出决策概率分布」与「按置信度路由以决定是否继续推演」可能为 LVR 中答案是否取自内部状态、以及按不确定性分配计算与停止决策提供可核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Large Decision Models: Repurposing Large Language Models as Single-Pass Decision Makers

**abstract/A1：** Large language models make decisions through parallel prefill and sequential decoding. Although effective, this approach incurs decoding costs and does not explicitly expose decision probabilities. Existing task-specific classifiers require per-task training and offer limited generalization to unseen decision schemas. We propose Large Decision Models (LDMs), repurposing language models to return explicit probabilities over labels specified at run time using one prefill forward pass. We first adapt models to this interface through Diverse Decision Supervision (DDS), covering varied domains, rules and labels. To further narrow the performance gap to a reasoning model, Self-Posed Reasoning Distillation (SPRD) adds tasks generated by a frozen teacher, filters them for answer consistency, and trains on label distributions obtained from repeated teacher reasoning. We evaluate on DecisionVista, pairing new-schema tests with held-out human-labelled sources. Across three base models, the recipe improves accuracy over a step-matched baseline by 1.8 and 1.5 percentage points, respectively, achieving a 182-fold speedup in latency over reasoning rollout on Gemma-4-31B. Reasoning remains stronger on the new-schema test, motivating a confidence router for uncertain decisions. On development sets, routing recovers a median 92% of reasoning's accuracy advantage while generating 27-58% of its tokens. Code is available at https://github.com/JianhuiWei7/LDM.

</details>

### 271. [SARATHI: Decoupled Data-Free Probing and Adaptive Reconstruction for Structured LLM Pruning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15514v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15514

**作者：** Sankar Behera、Dhruv Singh、Satyadev Ahlawat、Yamuna Prasad

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15514v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15514v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 SARATHI，将结构化剪枝的神经元选择与权重重建解耦：用无需校准数据的 NMF 残差子空间探针按权重内在几何打分，再用局部校准的 Adaptive OBS 在 O(d²) 峰值内存下重建权重，并加入偏置漂移补偿以缓解高稀疏下的困惑度崩溃。

**相关性简评：** 其无数据的子空间重要性评分与 OBS 式的逐层贡献分配，可能为 LVR 中判别内部 latent 状态哪些子空间承载视觉信息、以及特征对答案的贡献分配提供可核查的分析工具；但论文本身面向纯文本 LLM 压缩，与 VLM 推理无直接关联。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SARATHI: Decoupled Data-Free Probing and Adaptive Reconstruction for Structured LLM Pruning

**abstract/A1：** Structured pruning reduces the inference cost of large language models (LLMs) by permanently removing neurons and weight rows, yielding dense, hardware-agnostic speedup. Existing post-training methods couple neuron selection and weight reconstruction through a shared calibration dataset, introducing domain bias and out-of-memory failures at high sparsity. We propose SARATHI, a framework that decouples these two stages. A data-free \\emph{NMF Residual Subspace Probe} scores neurons using intrinsic weight geometry, without accessing any calibration data, and carries a formal connection to Robust PCA. \\emph{Adaptive OBS} then reconstructs the pruned weights with a localized calibration batch, operating in $\\mathcal{O}(d^2)$ peak memory per layer and eliminating the global memory bottleneck of coupled methods. A \\emph{Bias Shift Compensation} step corrects systematic activation drift in post-LayerNorm architectures that would otherwise cause perplexity collapse at high sparsity. Experiments across six models from two architecture families (gated and non-gated FFN) at 15--40\\% sparsity show that SARATHI achieves competitive perplexity and matches or exceeds existing structured pruning baselines on zero-shot accuracy.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Main Conference

</details>

### 272. [Semantically Steerable Image Tokenization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15515v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15515

**作者：** Danilo de Goede、Mohammad Mahdi Derakhshani、Yuki M. Asano、Cees G. M. Snoek

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15515v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15515v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 GIST 自适应图像 tokenizer，用像素级误差与语义误差（在冻结 DINOv3 特征空间中度量）联合控制 token 分配，使压缩可按语义保真度需求调节；语义目标置零时可放宽像素目标以保留图像所描绘的内容。

**相关性简评：** 语义误差驱动的可变 token 分配与「压缩中优先保留哪些视觉内容」直接相关，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选、视觉信息坍缩与内部状态保真度分析提供线索；但该文面向图像压缩而非推理，迁移可行性需人工核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Semantically Steerable Image Tokenization

**abstract/A1：** Adaptive image tokenizers compress an image into a variable number of tokens matched to its complexity, and recent work makes this allocation controllable: conditioned on a target reconstruction error, the tokenizer itself decides how many tokens an image needs. However, the fidelity measure guiding this allocation shapes which aspects of the image are preserved under compression. The pixel-wise error used in prior work is blind to the spatial structure that carries an image's meaning, and under heavy compression such tokenizers are prone to abruptly discarding tokens that encode essential content. We introduce GIST (Guided Image Semantic Tokenizer), an adaptive tokenizer that can be steered toward a requested semantic fidelity. Its token allocation is jointly controlled by pixel-level and semantic target errors, with semantic error measured in the feature space of a frozen DINOv3 encoder. This joint control enables semantic protection: with the semantic target fixed at zero, the reconstruction target can be relaxed to discard pixel detail while preserving what the image depicts. In a controlled comparison on ImageNet-100, GIST outperforms its pixel-controlled counterpart KARL at every token count, with up to $30\\%$ lower LPIPS and $37\\%$ lower DreamSim. On average, lowering its semantic target reduces LPIPS $2\\times$ faster per token than lowering the reconstruction target, and up to $5\\times$ in the low-token regime. Semantic fidelity is thus an effective control signal for adaptive tokenization: it lets a tokenizer see, and so preserve, what an image depicts.

</details>

### 273. [Truncation Samplers Are Nested: Comparing Decoding Rules Is a Measurement Problem](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15570v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15570

**作者：** Rasul Khanbayov、Hasan Kurban

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15570v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15570v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文观察到常见截断采样规则每一步都保留概率排序词表的前缀、因而彼此嵌套，据此给出每步闭式距离与耦合、序列级分离证书，并得到一个无偏配对估计器，把与 prompt 级配对的比较方差降低 1.2–3.8 倍。

**相关性简评：** 论文不涉及视觉或 latent 状态，与主线无直接关联；但其耦合构造与配对估计/方差缩减线索可能可供核查，用于比较不同推理配置或 latent 推理变体时的评测成本与显著性判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Truncation Samplers Are Nested: Comparing Decoding Rules Is a Measurement Problem

**abstract/A1：** Settling one comparison between two truncation samplers has cost six thousand A100-hours, and nothing says in advance how far apart two samplers can be. We observe that almost every deployed truncation rule keeps a prefix of the probability-sorted vocabulary, so any two such rules are nested at every decoding step. Nesting yields a closed-form per-step distance and a coupling under which both samplers emit identical text until they first disagree. Accumulated over a generation, this gives a separation certificate that bounds the difference between two samplers on any bounded outcome, is computable from logs a comparison already produces, and equals their sequence-level total variation distance exactly when neither rule ever overtakes the other. Two consequences follow without measurement: exactness is fragile, and certifying a small difference requires the two retained masses to agree to very high precision at every step. On six open-weight models over four math and science benchmarks, the certificate for every hyperparameter grid we tested is at least 0.998, so a bound alone rarely settles a comparison, although two members of one family can be far closer. What remains useful is the coupling, which gives an unbiased paired estimator that cuts variance $1.2$-$3.8\\times$ against prompt-level pairing. Read against benchmark sizes at the default pair's variance and our point estimate of its between-prompt component, resolving a one-point difference needs 8 to 32 samples per prompt on GSM8K, MATH-500 and GPQA-Diamond and about 210 on AIME 2025; at that component's upper confidence bound GPQA-Diamond needs more than 32 and AIME 2025 cannot be resolved at any sample count. Choosing a truncation sampler is a measurement problem at least as much as a design one. The code is available at https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/truncation-samplers.

</details>

### 274. [Self-Representation Alignment in Diffusion Models for Video Background Music Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15575v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15575

**作者：** Jincheng Zhang、György Fazekas、Charalampos Saitis

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15575v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15575v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 U-SRA：在扩散 U-Net 训练中用对齐损失，把高噪声条件下较早层的较弱内部表示对齐到低噪声条件下较后层的较优表示，以改善表示质量，并将其用于视频背景音乐生成，配合交叉注意力同步音乐与视频片段。

**相关性简评：** 其以训练期对齐损失约束并改善内部表示（跨层、跨噪声条件）的机制，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的监督方式与贡献分配提供可核查的方法线索；但任务本身为跨模态音乐生成，与 VLM 推理的关联需进一步确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Self-Representation Alignment in Diffusion Models for Video Background Music Generation

**abstract/A1：** Diffusion models have been widely used for various generative tasks. However, recent studies have demonstrated that the internal representations learned in the diffusion models' denoising process are insufficiently meaningful, which can hinder the generation performance. To address this, we propose a novel diffusion U-Net architecture enhanced by explicitly aligning the weaker representation from the earlier layer conditioned on higher noise with the better representation from the later layer conditioned on lower noise during training, which we use for the challenging multimodal task of video background music generation. Our diffusion U-Net Self-Representation Alignment (U-SRA) employs an alignment loss to effectively guide our diffusion model to learn good internal representations, thereby enabling it to produce higher-quality symbolic music conditioned on video features. We employ a cross-attention mechanism to synchronize music with video segments. Experiments on a benchmark video-music dataset demonstrate that the proposed U-SRA approach for video background music generation surpasses the state-of-the-art across key evaluation metrics, including video-music alignment and overall music quality.

</details>

### 275. [The Gradient That Top-k Distillation Never Computes](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15589v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15589

**作者：** Rasul Khanbayov、Hasan Kurban

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15589v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15589v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文分析 top-k 蒸馏中「重归一化」的梯度后果：证明截断目标只依赖保留 token 间的 log-odds，沿控制尾部质量的方向梯度恒为零，全词表梯度等于截断梯度加尾部质量加权残差，并在七个开源教师上观察到 k=d+1 起才能精确恢复教师分布、学生尾部质量会漂移。

**相关性简评：** 其关于截断蒸馏丢失尾部监督、梯度可分解为截断项与残差的分析，可能为 LVR 训练中监督信号如何作用于 latent 状态、信息坍缩与贡献分配提供可核查线索，但论文本身不涉及视觉或多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The Gradient That Top-k Distillation Never Computes

**abstract/A1：** Many deployed distillation pipelines show the student a truncated view of the teacher: keep the top-k probabilities, renormalize, and minimize a divergence on what remains. Renormalization is assumed to account for the missing mass. We prove that it removes the visibility of tail mass, not the freedom to move it. The renormalized objective depends only on log-odds among the retained tokens, so at each position its gradient along the directions that control tail mass is exactly zero; on a real teacher that component measures $2$-$3\\times10^{-15}$ of the gradient. The full-vocabulary gradient equals the truncated gradient plus a residual weighted by the tail masses, and training acts only on the first term. Without the cross-entropy term, a top-k student's tail mass drifts away from the teacher's while a full-vocabulary control moves slightly toward it; with it, the gap shrinks about fourfold but persists. On seven open-weight teachers, the retained set determines the teacher's distribution only from $k=d+1$ ($d$ the hidden dimension): recovery is exact from there on all seven, and commonly cached sizes sit below it. In our off-policy runs the practical effect is real but smaller than the choice of teacher-student pair. Renormalization is a normalization, not a safeguard. The code is available at https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/top-k-distillation.

</details>

### 276. [1Step-WAM: Your World Action Model but Faster using 1-Step Action Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15625v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15625

**作者：** Rundong Su、Pengtao Chen、Haohan Geng、Sha Zhang、Zhihang Yuan、Yicheng Rong、Chong Yu、Hao Huang、Tao Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15625v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15625v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对 World Action Model 中多步动作去噪与「先视觉预填充、后动作预测」串行执行造成的部署瓶颈，发现去噪轨迹近似直线，于是用轻量校准器修正首步速度并结合带宽约束解码，将多步去噪压缩为单次前向，使动作生成能与视觉预填充并行。

**相关性简评：** 其「多步迭代 latent 精炼近似直线可一步外推」与「生成与视觉编码并行」这两条线索，可能为 LVR 中压缩循环式 latent 推理步数、以及让 THINK 与 LOOK 并行重叠提供可核查的方法借鉴，但该工作面向机器人动作生成，非视觉推理任务。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** 1Step-WAM: Your World Action Model but Faster using 1-Step Action Generation

**abstract/A1：** World Action Models (WAMs) unify visual world modeling and action generation, yet their real-world deployment is heavily bottlenecked by iterative action denoising and the sequential execution of visual prefilling and action prediction. We demonstrate that the action-denoising trajectories in WAMs are approximately straight, rendering the first-step velocity a strong estimate of the final action direction. Building on this observation, we introduce 1Step-WAM, a framework that transforms multi-step action denoising into one single forward. Specifically, we employ a lightweight calibrator to directly correct the first step velocity, and use bandwidth-constrained action decoding to further reduce errors in the calibrated one-step actions. Compressing action generation into a single step enables it to execute in parallel with visual prefilling, completely breaking the sequential bottleneck of the traditional imagination-then-action paradigm. Evaluations on RoboTwin and LIBERO show that 1Step-WAM largely preserves multi-step task success with only about 13.4M trainable parameters, while achieving inference speedups of $7.44\\times$, $5.98\\times$, and $24.84\\times$ for FastWAM, ImageWAM and Kairos, respectively. Furthermore, real-world robotic deployments using the FastWAM backbone confirm a consistent 7.44$\\times$ speedup while maintaining close success rate to the multi-step baseline. Code is avaliable at https://github.com/changdong1687/1Step-WAM.

</details>

### 277. [MERIT: Scaling KG Foundation Models with Relation Transformers](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15638v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15638

**作者：** Cosimo Gregucci、Daniel Hernandez、Antonio Vergari、Steffen Staab

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15638v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15638v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出 MERIT，用 transformer 关系编码器替代知识图谱基础模型中的图消息传递与随机游走集成，让关系名之间全注意力交互、把 motif 作为软先验，在 56 个基准上以更低推理成本匹配零样本链接预测性能。

**相关性简评：** 其「以全注意力加软结构先验取代显式图消息传递」的做法，可能为 LVR 中实体关系表示与推理状态更新、以及结构信息的软注入提供可核查的方法线索；但研究对象是 KG 链接预测，与视觉或多模态推理并无直接关联。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MERIT: Scaling KG Foundation Models with Relation Transformers

**abstract/A1：** Knowledge graph (KG) foundation models (KGFMs) predict links on unseen graphs zero-shot. KGFMs have been pioneered by ULTRA which builds a relation graph from co-occurrences that match motif templates, and passes messages over it to obtain relation representations. More recent KGFMs such as MOTIF and TRIX increase the size of this relation graph, and FLOCK replaces message-passing with probabilistic random-walk ensembles. However, larger relation graphs mean more messages, and more walks mean more sequences to encode, so they improve performance at higher training and inference cost. This cost hinders their use in more complex reasoning tasks, such as complex query answering. To reverse this trend, we design MERIT, the first KGFM with a transformer relation encoder: every relation name attends to every other, and the motifs enter as a soft prior rather than as edges. Over 56 benchmarks, MERIT matches the zero-shot MRR of SoTA KGFMs while being 6x faster than TRIX and over 100x faster than FLOCK at inference. Fine-tuned for complex query answering like UltraQuery, MERITQuery improves over it at matched cost.

</details>

### 278. [Context-Aware Precision Scheduling for Small Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15640v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15640

**作者：** Mukund Athmaram、Manoj Rao、Liang Ma

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15640v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15640v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文为端侧小模型提出上下文感知的混合精度调度：用不同精度与上下文长度下的实测校准延迟模型，结合张量敏感度，在延迟或精度预算下选择权重与 KV cache 精度，并在运行时按预先生成的调度执行、保留会话 KV cache。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉推理主线无直接关联，但其以实测执行成本而非比特数建模预算、以及 KV cache 占用挤压权重计算时间进而改变配置的思路，可能为 LVR 中动态计算（如 THINK/LOOK/STOP）的成本与预算分配提供可核查的借鉴线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Context-Aware Precision Scheduling for Small Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Small language models (SLMs) used as on-device agents must balance accuracy and latency as their context grows. Mixed precision helps manage this tradeoff by assigning different precisions to weight tensors according to their size and sensitivity. However, these choices depend on the operating conditions, so a configuration selected for a short context may no longer provide the best tradeoff at a longer one. We calibrate a timing model from measurements at different precisions and context lengths, and combine it with tensor sensitivities to choose configurations under a latency or accuracy budget. We argue that fewer bits do not always mean faster execution, so our predictor estimates latency from calibrated execution costs rather than weight bytes alone. Under a latency budget, reading the larger key-value (KV) cache leaves less time for weight operations, leading the allocator to select lower precisions. This gives a schedule of tensor changes that can be prepared before execution. Our runtime follows the schedule while retaining the session's KV cache. We evaluate executed schedules on a laptop GPU, including a longer-context schedule with three weight formats and a tool-use benchmark measuring full response time and correctness. Under an accuracy budget, measured error from a quantized KV cache determines the budget left for weights. The allocator can raise or lower weight precision as this estimate changes. These experiments show where context-aware precision helps and where accuracy recovery remains limited.

</details>

### 279. [Recall What Is Missing: Composing Evidence from Long-Term Agent Memory](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15642v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15642

**作者：** Qi Feng、Jicong Fan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15642v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15642v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把长期记忆的读取视为「查询条件下的证据组合」问题，提出免训练的 MemPursuit：以稀疏凸查询重构残差作为当前已选记忆缺失内容的表示代理，只复用检索阶段的查询与候选 embedding 逐层组合互补证据，在固定预算下提升 LoCoMo 等基准准确率并大幅降低重排序延迟。

**相关性简评：** 其按「集合已选内容之外还补充了什么」估值、并用残差表示「缺失什么」的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据的互补筛选与「证据是否充分/何时停止」判断提供免训练线索，但需核查该文本记忆代理能否迁移到多模态内部状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Recall What Is Missing: Composing Evidence from Long-Term Agent Memory

**abstract/A1：** Under a limited context budget, a long-term agent must recall not merely memories that are individually relevant, but evidence that is collectively sufficient for the current query. Conventional memory access retrieves, scores, and truncates memories, often spending multiple context slots on redundant facts while leaving complementary evidence behind. We cast the read phase of long-term memory as query-conditioned evidence composition: each memory is valued by what it adds beyond the evidence already selected. We instantiate this operation with MemPursuit, a training-free mechanism that uses the residual of a sparse convex query reconstruction as a representation-space proxy for what the current memory set is missing. By reusing the query and candidate embeddings already available from retrieval, MemPursuit progressively composes nested evidence contexts without invoking a language model or cross-encoder to score each query--memory pair. The effectiveness of our method is verified on 3 popular benchmarks in comparison to strong baselines. In fixed-budget LoCoMo experiments, MemPursuit improves end-to-end accuracy by 7.2 percentage points at Top-10 and 5.5 percentage points at Top-20, with consistent gains across multiple memory frameworks, while achieving a 32.9$\\times$ speedup in median reranking latency over fully batched BGE-v2-m3. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/FengQi-HITSZ/MemPursuit.

</details>

### 280. [Sparse All-Layer Connector for Domain Generalised Semantic Segmentation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15660v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15660

**作者：** Ruoyu Guo、Xin Kun Lin、Maurice Pagnucco、Yang Song

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15660v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15660v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对域泛化语义分割中多基础模型融合过度依赖「深度对齐」的假设，提出稀疏全层连接器 SALC：让每层自适应地从前一模型的多个更浅层中稀疏选取信息，并用候选丢弃正则增强稀疏性与选择多样性。

**相关性简评：** 其跨深度、稀疏自适应的层间信息路由思路，可能为 LVR 中跨层 latent 状态的聚合位置选择、避免密集聚合带来的信息坍缩提供方法线索，但其面向的是分割特征融合而非推理状态，实际可迁移性仍待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Sparse All-Layer Connector for Domain Generalised Semantic Segmentation

**abstract/A1：** Domain generalised semantic segmentation (DGSS) has recently benefited from combining multiple foundation models, such as vision-language and vision foundation models, to leverage their diverse representations for generalisation. Existing multi-model approaches share a common design choice: cross-model fusion is restricted to depth-aligned layers, implicitly assuming that mutually beneficial information resides at the same depth across models. However, foundation models pretrained under different objectives may develop distinct representation hierarchies, making the optimality of depth-aligned fusion questionable. Moreover, we observe that the foundation models exhibit different depth-wise domain sensitivity. Motivated by these observations, we propose a Sparse All-Layer Connector (SALC) that enables each layer to access information from preceding layers of another model. As the number of accessible layers grows with depth, dense aggregation may hurt generalisation. SALC therefore learns to adaptively select a sparse subset of informative layers. We further introduce a candidate dropout regularisation that strengthens sparsity and encourages SALC to explore diverse layers, leading to more robust selection. Across four foundation model combinations and three DGSS evaluation settings, the proposed design demonstrates stronger generalisation than conventional depth-aligned fusion. The code is available at https://github.com/RuoyuGuo/SALC.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. The final version will be updated soon

</details>

### 281. [ProtoPur: Prototype-Purity Pseudo-Labeling for Weakly Supervised Instance Learning in Pathology](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15669v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15669

**作者：** Chen Shu、Chengyang Zhang、Boyu Fu、Ting Yin、Wenchuan Zhang、Jie Chen、Yuhao Yi、Hong Bu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15669v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15669v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ProtoPur，在病理全切片弱监督学习中用冻结基础模型特征构建原型区域、估计类别均衡的局部纯度，为高纯度区域分配伪标签以提供实例级监督，并给出伪标签噪声的风险分解分析。

**相关性简评：** 其「原型纯度优先、覆盖度次之」的局部类特异证据筛选，以及把伪标签风险拆为选择性不匹配与覆盖残差的思路，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选与 latent 监督噪声评估提供可核查线索；但该文未涉及推理期 latent 状态生成，联系属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ProtoPur: Prototype-Purity Pseudo-Labeling for Weakly Supervised Instance Learning in Pathology

**abstract/A1：** Weak bag-level labels are widely available in computational pathology, whereas reliable instance-level annotations for whole-slide images remain expensive and ambiguous. Weakly supervised multiple instance learning (MIL) achieves strong bag-level classification, but instance-level supervision from attention scores, model predictions, negative bags, or spatial refinement may fail to identify class-specific local evidence. We propose ProtoPur, a prototype-purity pseudo-labeling method for weakly supervised instance-level learning in pathology whole-slide images. ProtoPur estimates class-balanced local purity over prototype regions constructed from frozen foundation-model features, and assigns pseudo-labels to high-purity regions strongly associated with a target class. This purity-first design separates class-specific evidence from negative or shared morphology, with coverage used only to ensure sufficient pseudo-label assignment. We provide a PAC-style analysis showing that the risk of an instance classifier trained with ProtoPur pseudo-labels can be decomposed into a standard uniform-convergence term and a ProtoPur-specific pseudo-label noise term, comprising selected-region mismatch and a coverage residual. Experiments on three public whole-slide image datasets with two pathology foundation encoders show that ProtoPur consistently improves instance-level performance across multiple MIL backbones while maintaining competitive bag-level performance. Pseudo-label quality comparisons on two public datasets further demonstrate that prototype-purity selection provides stronger instance supervision. These results suggest that the foundation-model features contain exploitable instance-level supervision signals, and ProtoPur is a way to reveal and use these signals from weak bag labels without requiring dense instance annotations.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to IEEE BIBM 2026

</details>

### 282. [Knowledge Interaction in Hypernetwork-based Continual Learning: Conflict and Composition](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15677v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15677

**作者：** Jiaqi Zheng、Yi Hu、Yadong Mu、Muhan Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15677v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15677v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在基于超网络的持续学习框架中研究基础模型、适配器更新与输入上下文三种知识来源的交互：在知识冲突下模型偏向跟随上下文且更依赖知识出现位置，多跳推理中三者难以可靠组合，并发现上下文与适配器知识沿正交于干净隐状态的方向扰动表示，由此导出可控制知识来源的引导向量。

**相关性简评：** 其表示几何与引导向量「控制模型遵循哪个知识来源」的技术，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据与语言先验的取舍、以及答案是否真正使用 latent 内容；多跳组合失效的分析也或可迁移到视觉证据与 latent 状态的组合与信息坍缩问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Knowledge Interaction in Hypernetwork-based Continual Learning: Conflict and Composition

**abstract/A1：** Continual learning aims to adapt pretrained large language models (LLMs) to evolving data while preserving their pretrained capabilities. A central challenge is catastrophic forgetting: adaptation to new data can impair performance on previously learned knowledge. Since continual learning commonly changes model parameters, the model's predictions may draw on knowledge from the base model, the parameter update, and the input context. Understanding how these sources interact is essential: conflicts reveal whether new knowledge can override outdated knowledge, while multi-hop reasoning tests whether new knowledge can be composed with existing knowledge to support generalization. We study these interactions in a hypernetwork-based adaptation framework, where a shared network generates adapters from context, allowing a frozen base model to adapt without task-specific updates. We find that, under knowledge conflict, models preferentially follow the context, and their choices depend more on where knowledge is presented than on its content. We also show that context and adapter knowledge perturb the base model's representations along directions orthogonal to its clean hidden states, enabling us to derive steering vectors that control which source the model follows. In multi-hop reasoning, we find that models fail to reliably compose knowledge across the three sources, with the key breakdown arising from the interaction of the hypernetwork with both the base model and the context. Code and reproduction materials: https://github.com/missswiftie/Knowledge-Interaction-in-CL

**comment/C1：** 23 pages

</details>
