### 283. [TabMosaic: Unified In-Context Diffusion for Tabular Generative Tasks](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15699v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15699

**作者：** Jayoung Kim、Sanghyun Hong、Noseong Park

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15699v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15699v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 TabMosaic，把合成、补全、条件生成等表格任务统一表述为「给定未见表格中已观测单元、建模任意目标单元集合的联合条件分布」，用对所有目标单元联合去噪的 in-context diffusion 实现，无需表级训练，并在 48 个真实表格上与 20 个基线比较。

**相关性简评：** 其「对目标集合联合去噪而非逐单元生成」的目标设计、以及用预训练目标界定后验预测分布的分析，可能为 LVR 中并行 latent 状态生成与训练期监督/贡献分配提供可借鉴线索，但领域为表格数据，迁移可行性可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TabMosaic: Unified In-Context Diffusion for Tabular Generative Tasks

**abstract/A1：** Generative modeling for tabular data has advanced to the point where models can synthesize realistic records, recover missing values, and generate samples conditioned on class labels or observed attributes. Despite recent advances, existing approaches either require table-specific training or restrict in-context learning to single-cell prediction. In this work, we formulate these tabular generative tasks as a single problem: modeling the joint conditional distribution of an arbitrary set of target cells given the observed cells of an unseen table. To this end, we turn to diffusion, whose denoising objective is defined jointly over all target cells rather than one cell at a time. Under the pretraining distribution, this objective is minimized by the posterior predictive distribution over the target set. Building on this, we propose TabMosaic, a unified in-context diffusion model for generating mixed-type target cells in unseen, potentially incomplete tables without table-specific training. We further show that its pretraining objective bounds the conditional negative log-likelihood and the divergence from the posterior predictive for arbitrary target sets, extending the Bayesian account of in-context learning from a single-value prediction to joint multi-cell generation. Across 48 real-world tables, TabMosaic ranks first on all evaluated generative tasks against 20 baseline approaches

</details>

**内容简述：** 论文提出 RespFocus，用多实例学习从周期级弱标签中学习可检查的时间声学证据并将其融入呼吸音四分类，同时构建多中心儿科呼吸音数据集 PedResp2026，并报告了证据诊断与匹配时间干预实验。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RespFocus: Learning Temporal Evidence for Weakly Supervised Respiratory Sound Classification

**abstract/A1：** Respiratory auscultation provides a low-cost means of assessing pulmonary function, yet transient crackles and sustained wheezes can be difficult to recognize in noisy clinical recordings. Conventional deep learning classifiers often operate as black boxes, offering limited insight into the temporal acoustic evidence supporting their predictions. We present RespFocus, a weakly supervised framework that uses multiple instance learning (MIL) to learn inspectable temporal evidence from cycle-level labels and integrate it into classification. We also introduce PedResp2026, a multicenter pediatric respiratory sound cohort collected in routine clinical environments with adjudicated cycle-level annotations. In classification experiments, RespFocus achieves four-class Scores of 69.55\\% on public ICBHI 2017 and 72.91\\% on PedResp2026. Evidence diagnostics and matched temporal interventions support the functional contribution of the learned evidence to model predictions. Together, these findings highlight RespFocus's potential as a tool for automated respiratory sound diagnosis.

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 无直接多模态关联，但「直接泛化 vs 组合泛化」的区分与可识别性论证，可供核查 latent 推理状态的信息保留与泛化评价方式时借鉴。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Generalizable Model Editing Could Be More Than Direct Generalization

**abstract/A1：** A central desideratum in model editing is generalization to complex tasks, which prior work formalizes under a direct generalization paradigm: treating and evaluating LLM behavior as an input-output mapping and expecting a factual update to alter outputs on reasoning tasks. Yet despite substantial empirical effort, the field consensus remains that such generalization is highly challenging and elusive. However, when we deploy the latest models in an in-the-wild chatbot-user setting, we surprisingly find that even classical editing methods exhibit remarkably fluent generalization behavior. This motivates us to revisit the obstacles to generalization and the limitations of the prevailing paradigm. We find that direct generalization is fundamentally constrained both theoretically and practically: theoretically, it suffers from an identifiability issue; and practically, existing approaches attempting to circumvent this are further hindered by the ambiguity of their constructed biases and by vulnerability to being overridden by other factors such as optimization dynamics. We instead identify compositional generalization, empowered by the increasingly strong reasoning and composition abilities of modern LLMs, as a theoretically grounded and empirically validated alternative. We validate this phenomenon across multiple models and editing methods, showing that such generalization behavior is widespread. Overall, we argue that generalizable model editing could be more than direct generalization, and call for a paradigm shift toward more generalizable and practically deployable knowledge update techniques.

</details>

### 286. [SpecForge: Recursive Self-Improvement for Coding Agents via Behavioral Specifications](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15708v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15708

**作者：** Yutong Cheng、Haifeng Chen、Peng Gao、Wei Cheng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.SE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15708v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15708v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 SpecForge，把自然语言「行为规范」当作可迭代改进的外部状态：agent 依规范生成代码、用执行验证的测试评估、再依失败结果重写规范，并以多前沿树搜索缓解实体相互依赖带来的「打地鼠」式回退，在 DevEval+ 上提升多款骨干模型的解题率。

**相关性简评：** 其「生成—执行验证—改写中间状态」的递归循环、Pareto 状态保留与按失败子集多样化扩展，可能为 latent 推理轨迹的搜索、互补状态保留与停机/收敛判据提供可供核查的线索；但本文针对代码 agent 的外部文本规范，不涉及视觉或多模态内部状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SpecForge: Recursive Self-Improvement for Coding Agents via Behavioral Specifications

**abstract/A1：** Coding agents based on frozen language models can improve their performance by refining the external context they rely on, without updating model weights. We study recursive self-improvement through behavioral specifications: natural-language code documentation that describes the behavior of program entities and guides agents in generating correct code. We formulate a self-improvement loop in which an agent generates code from its current specifications, evaluates it with execution-verified tests, and refines the specifications based on observed failures. The improved specifications then guide subsequent generation, progressively improving the agent's understanding of the codebase. However, recursive refinement is challenging because program entities are interdependent. Improving the specification of one entity can inadvertently degrade the correctness of others, a phenomenon we call output coupling. This creates a whack-a-mole effect in which local improvements cause regressions elsewhere, preventing consistent progress. We introduce SpecForge, a multi-frontier tree search framework that addresses this challenge with three mechanisms: (i) Pareto-guided state selection preserves complementary specification states and prevents premature commitment; (ii) dependency-constrained entity selection prioritizes callee-before-caller refinement; and (iii) error-diversified expansion explores multiple refinements using different subsets of test failures. On DevEval+, SpecForge achieves the best performance across five backbone models, including a 94.9% solve rate with Claude-4.5-Sonnet and a 5.7-percentage-point average improvement over the strongest baseline. The improved specifications also make the agent better at tasks outside the loop: they transfer to cross-language translation and to new-feature implementation, where they outperform the benchmark-provided requirement documents.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (Main Track)

</details>

### 287. [Preserving Updates in Low-Bit Recurrent State Quantization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15709v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15709

**作者：** Haotian Li、Liran Dong、Kaicheng Xiao、Guoliang Xing

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15709v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15709v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究循环/线性注意力模型低比特状态量化时误差跨步累积的问题，指出微小更新在舍入中丢失、且更新方向比单步误差更重要，据此提出训练无关的 Low-Rank Bypass 与 Bounded Directional Rounding。

**相关性简评：** 其「低秩旁路缓冲小更新」与「更新方向优先」可类比 LVR 中 latent 状态的信息保留、信息坍缩与视觉旁路机制，可供核查；但该工作面向序列模型效率而非多模态推理，迁移价值需自行验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Preserving Updates in Low-Bit Recurrent State Quantization

**abstract/A1：** Linear attention and recurrent models compress past tokens into a fixed-size state that is updated at every step. However, storing these states in high precision incurs substantial memory and bandwidth costs at large batch sizes, motivating low-bit state quantization. Unlike weights and key--value caches, a recurrent state is requantized after every update, so its quantization errors accumulate across steps. Our analysis shows that these errors are highly coherent across steps, so reducing per-step errors alone is insufficient. This coherence arises mainly from small updates that are lost in rounding. To preserve these updates, we intervene both before and at rounding. Before rounding, we propose Low-Rank Bypass (LRB), which accumulates small updates in a compact low-rank buffer and periodically merges its sufficiently large elements into the state. At rounding, we observe that a state element can even move opposite to its update, and such reversals prove particularly harmful. Therefore, we propose Bounded Directional Rounding (BDR), which rounds reversed elements toward their updates without additional storage. Although BDR enlarges the rounding error, it improves the model, suggesting that the direction of an update matters more than its rounding error at a single step. Across Gated DeltaNet, GLA, Mamba2, and RetNet, our training-free method substantially outperforms INT4, while reducing state memory by up to 5.3$\\times$ and speeding up decoding by up to 1.9$\\times$ relative to FP32 states.

</details>

### 288. [MedHarnessBench: A Unified Benchmark for Healthcare Agent Evaluation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15714v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15714

**作者：** Rui Tang、Hongqiu Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15714v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15714v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Medical Harness Protocol 与 MedHarnessBench，用 342 个可执行医疗任务、七个流程维度（如证据对齐、闭环验证、审计性）和 16000+ 次受控执行，分离 agent 模型与运行时 harness 对成败的贡献。

**相关性简评：** 其「流程维度 + 归一化干预轨迹（可用/激活/交付/采纳/传播）」提供一种可核查的评估设计线索：或可迁移用于度量 latent 支持是否被真正采纳并影响后续推理，以及 THINK/LOOK/STOP 收益归因，属跨域方法借鉴而非主线研究。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MedHarnessBench: A Unified Benchmark for Healthcare Agent Evaluation

**abstract/A1：** Healthcare agents must transform longitudinal clinical evidence into reliable actions through heterogeneous tools and stateful workflows, conditions under which model-centric systems may lose context, misuse tools, fail to verify consequential transitions, or cross authorization boundaries. Existing medical-agent benchmarks primarily emphasize terminal task outcomes, making it difficult to determine whether execution failures arise from the agent model, the runtime harness, or their interaction. We present the Medical Harness Protocol, an outcome-preserving framework that independently evaluates seven healthcare-specific process dimensions: Care Action Fulfillment, Clinical Resource Competence, Patient-Evidence Alignment, Clinical Workflow Continuity, Clinical Auditability, Closed-Loop Verification, and Clinical Conduct Boundaries. A normalized intervention trace further tracks whether runtime support is available, activated, delivered, adopted by the agent, and propagated into subsequent behavior. We instantiate the protocol as MedHarnessBench, comprising 342 executable tasks across FHIR/EHR operations, healthcare-administration interfaces, and multimodal clinical tools. Across more than 16,000 controlled task executions, MedHarness yields broad improvements in terminal task success, intermediate subtask completion, and healthcare-specific process quality. We further evaluate MedHarness against multiple general-purpose harnesses and use controlled single-fault perturbations to verify the sensitivity and discrimination of the seven-dimensional evaluation. These results demonstrate that healthcare-specific runtime support can substantially improve both task completion and execution quality, while revealing failures that terminal outcomes alone cannot capture. Code and resources are available at https://github.com/Tomry1114/Awesome-Agent-Harness-for-Healthcare.

</details>

### 289. [To Cache or Not to Cache: Understanding and Mitigating Safety Incompatibility in Cross-Model KV Cache Reuse](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15721v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15721

**作者：** Zhiwei Lin、Jiahao Liu、Yan Liu、Chengpeng Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CR、cs.SE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15721v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15721v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文系统评估接收模型复用发送模型 KV cache 时对安全行为的偏离（safety incompatibility），发现偏差方向与幅度取决于模型对和复用配置，且 value 复用比 key 复用偏差更大；并提出 VReparo，离线学习逐层、逐 KV head 的仿射映射，将复用的 sender value 张量与 receiver 原生状态对齐。

**相关性简评：** 其 value 与 key 复用差异及轻量仿射对齐线索，可能对应 LVR 关注的缓存与注意力结构如何影响内部 latent 内容、以及跨状态对齐的问题，可供核查；但属文本安全场景，与视觉推理主线距离较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** To Cache or Not to Cache: Understanding and Mitigating Safety Incompatibility in Cross-Model KV Cache Reuse

**abstract/A1：** Cross-model KV cache sharing reduces prefill computation by allowing a receiver model to reuse prefix KV states generated by a related sender model. Existing methods optimize such reuse for latency and generation quality, but its safety implications remain unclear. In this work, we systematically evaluate this issue across diverse sender-receiver pairs and reuse configurations. We refer to deviations from the receiver's native safety behavior as safety incompatibility. Our study shows that both the direction and magnitude of safety incompatibility depend on the model pair and reuse configuration, with value reuse causing substantially larger deviations than key reuse across all evaluated pairs. Furthermore, we propose VReparo, a technique that learns per-layer and per-KV-head affine maps offline to align reused sender value tensors with their receiver-native counterparts before decoding. Across two model pairs under full KV reuse and the state-of-the-art selective reuse setting, VReparo reduces the average HarmBench attack success rate (ASR) from 57.28% to 39.21% and the average StrongREJECT score from 0.4215 to 0.2163 upon our benchmarks, while retaining an average Time to First Token (TTFT) reduction of 85.62%.

**comment/C1：** 17 pages, 2 figures. Code: https://github.com/Snakinya/VReparo

</details>

### 290. [A Dependency-Aware Multi-GPU Training Framework for Temporal Graph Neural Networks](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15730v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15730

**作者：** Yang Zhao、Yue Dai、Liang Qiao、Buxin Tu、Bo Liu、Sen Zhang、Yi Zhang、Xiaoyu Hao、Jun Shi、Junshi Chen、Hong An

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.DC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15730v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15730v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 DepBloom 多 GPU 时序图神经网络训练框架：基于依赖在时间和图拓扑上的局部性、批内缺失短程依赖可廉价恢复、部分记忆更新非即时必需这三点观察，设计时序有界空间划分、批内记忆修正与关键路径优化，在保持精度的同时显著加速训练。

**相关性简评：** 其核心是把节点状态向量（memory）更新的依赖做局部性分析与延迟调度，这对 latent 推理中推理状态的更新顺序、并行/循环生成与「何时必须更新」的决策可能提供方法线索，值得核查其依赖建模与关键路径判据能否迁移到 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的成本权衡上。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A Dependency-Aware Multi-GPU Training Framework for Temporal Graph Neural Networks

**abstract/A1：** Temporal graph neural networks (TGNNs) achieve superior performance in many dynamic graph learning tasks. These models use node state vectors (i.e., memories) to capture and record graph changes (i.e., events), and then exploit these memories to assist prediction. However, this memory-centric design makes multi-GPU training challenging because predictions for later events often depend on memory updates from earlier events. To maintain model quality, existing multi-GPU TGNN training schemes strictly preserve all event dependencies, which limits parallelism and causes expensive cross-GPU memory synchronization. In this work, we observe that many of these dependencies can be handled more flexibly without harming training quality. Specifically, (a) dependencies in TGNN training have high locality in both time and graph topology, (b) the short-range dependencies missed within a large batch can often be recovered cheaply, and (c) many memory updates are not immediately needed. Based on these observations, we propose DepBloom to accelerate multi-GPU TGNN training with three techniques: (1) temporally bounded spatial partitioning to reduce unnecessary cross-GPU synchronization and improve parallelism; (2) intra-batch memory refinement to recover missing short-range temporal dependencies inside enlarged batches; and (3) critical-path optimization to prioritize urgent memory updates while deferring non-critical work during multi-GPU pipeline execution. Experimental results across representative models and diverse datasets show that DepBloom achieves an average speedup of 2.84$\\times$ and up to 5.16$\\times$ over state-of-the-art methods, while maintaining comparable or better model accuracy.

</details>

**内容简述：** 论文面向自动驾驶的多模态 3D 占用预测，用脉冲神经网络构建对传感器缺失更鲁棒的感知系统，提出 Spiking Mixture-of-Experts（专用 RGB、LiDAR 与融合通路）与 Sensor Availability Learning（分阶段课程加显式路由监督）。

**相关性简评：** 其「专家分工 + 有界残差保留原始多模态特征」与路由监督课程，或可供核查：专家化处理时如何避免视觉细节在内部状态中坍缩，以及视觉证据缺失时表示保持与训练监督的设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SpikeOcc: Towards Resilient Multimodal 3D Occupancy Perception via Spiking Experts

**abstract/A1：** Multimodal 3D occupancy prediction underpins safe autonomous driving through comprehensive scene understanding. However, existing methods have largely pursued higher accuracy through sophisticated fusion, leaving resilience to missing sensors underexplored. In this paper, we investigate spiking neural networks (SNNs) as a means of building more resilient multimodal perception. Still, the discrete nature of spiking neurons makes optimization challenging. To overcome this difficulty, SpikeOcc is introduced with two complementary components, a Spiking Mixture-of-Experts (SMoE) and Sensor Availability Learning (SAL). Specifically, SMoE organizes RGB, LiDAR, and joint fusion into specialized pathways, enabling full-width unimodal representations while retaining the original multimodal features via a bounded residual. Beyond sensor dropout, SAL employs a staged curriculum with explicit routing supervision, progressively improving robustness under severe sensing conditions. Remarkably, SAL also yields notable gains for conventional models, highlighting its broader potential for resilient multimodal learning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SpikeOcc maintains competitive full-sensor accuracy while markedly raising the performance floor under sensor outages. SpikeOcc illustrates the promise of neuromorphic computing, pointing toward more reliable and energy-efficient autonomous driving.

</details>

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Google Earth AI Geospatial Reasoning Agent: Capabilities and a Systematic Evaluation

**abstract/A1：** Google Earth AI is a family of geospatial AI models, together with an agent that orchestrates them. We present this agent, Google Earth AI's Geospatial Reasoning agent (GRA), a Gemini-powered research system that combines geospatial data sources, foundation models, and tools to answer questions about our planet. GRA organizes these into modular domain skills and pairs them with upfront geospatial planning to decompose complex queries into multi-stage workflows. Evaluating such systems is hard: real-world problems admit multiple valid workflows, require data discovery across large catalogs, and rely on evolving ground truth. We introduce two benchmarks and release their development splits. GeoExpertQueries poses complex analytical problems grounded in practitioner use cases and refined by geospatial experts; each is paired with a consensus golden workflow from three independent experts and scored by a human-validated, tool-agnostic autorater. GeoKTools consists of templated queries with deterministic reference solvers that systematically vary the number of required tool types. We also use two external benchmarks, CBGB and UnivEARTH; the latter we find to be saturated. To isolate the contribution of GRA's tools and its agentic orchestration, we compare four configurations, each with Gemini 3.1 Pro and 3.8 Flash: a standalone LLM, the LLM with basic tools, the LLM with GRA's skills and tools but without its upfront planning and execution guidance, and GRA itself. With at most basic tools, an advanced model recovers much of the answer on templated queries but satisfies only a small fraction of the expert workflows on open-ended problems; GRA performs well on both. The largest step comes from GRA's skills and tools; on open-ended problems, its planning and execution guidance add a further gain with Gemini 3.8 Flash, letting Flash match or exceed Pro at lower cost.

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 SlotAVS，用双模态 slot attention 从音频时序初始化离散物体槽，并在视觉 token 上施加严格的槽间竞争绑定，配合匈牙利匹配与置信度感知掩码融合，在 AVSBench 上完成多声源音视频目标分割（S4 88.6%、MS3 71.7% mIoU）。

**相关性简评：** 其离散槽位竞争绑定与匈牙利匹配可能为 LVR 中实体级内部状态的组织、视觉证据筛选与贡献分配提供方法线索，但该工作是像素级感知分割而非多模态推理，需核查槽表示能否迁移到 latent 推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SlotAVS: Object-Centric Audio-Visual Segmentation via Bi-Modal Slot Attention

**abstract/A1：** Audio-Visual Segmentation (AVS) requires predicting pixel-wise masks of sounding objects by grounding acoustic signals in visual space. In multi-source scenes, concurrent sound sources often remain entangled within shared visual representations, leading to merged masks or unstable specialization when using standard alignment-focused transformer architectures. To address this, we present SlotAVS, an object-centric framework driven by competitive bi-modal slot attention. While robust foundation models provide rich semantic priors, SlotAVS shifts the paradigm from global cross-modal fusion to explicit competitive binding. By initializing discrete object slots from temporal audio sequences and enforcing strict slot-wise competition over spatial visual tokens, our method structurally mitigates the blending of distinct acoustic entities. Further, to stabilize instance-level learning, we introduce a Hungarian matching strategy that optimally aligns slots with ground-truth objects using spatial and boundary overlap. Coupled with a numerically stable, confidence-aware mask fusion mechanism, SlotAVS robustly aggregates multi-source predictions. Extensive experiments on the AVSBench dataset demonstrate the efficacy of our approach, achieving 88.6% mIoU on the Single-Source (S4) split and 71.7% mIoU on the Multi-Source (MS3) split. These results show that explicit competitive binding is critical for complex audio-visual scene understanding and effectively leveraging foundation-model priors without relying solely on their capacity.

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15778v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15778v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究用冻结 LLM 判官作 GRPO 奖励时的判官 hacking：训练 rollout 准确率上升多为采样锐化而非留出贪心准确率提升，hacking 深度与判官 AUC 相关，起始快慢无法仅由 policy 与判官的能力差解释。

**相关性简评：** 不涉及视觉，但其对判官奖励失效与训练收益真伪的检验，可能为 LVR 中用模型判官监督 latent 推理轨迹的训练设计与评价提供线索，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Who Sets the Pace of Judge Hacking? Judge Capability versus the Policy-Judge Gap

**abstract/A1：** When a policy is trained with GRPO against a frozen, reference-free LLM judge, the judge accepts more of its answers, but in a post-hoc analysis we detect no gain in held-out greedy accuracy: in all 12 (policy, judge) cells, the seed-mean gain never exceeded 0.04. A gold-reward control with the same recipe raised the 1.5B policy's greedy accuracy by +0.054 \[0.013, 0.096\], so for this policy the flat accuracy is specific to the judge reward; for the 0.5B policy, gold reward also gave no detectable gain. In the four rising cells we checked, the early rise in training-rollout accuracy is mostly sampling sharpening, as it is under gold reward. We then ask whether the policy-judge gap or the judge sets how far and how fast RL exploits the judge's false positives. We train 0.5B and 1.5B Qwen2.5 policies against four judges at least as large (Qwen2.5-1.5B/3B/7B, Llama-3.2-3B) and the 1.5B policy against one smaller judge (Qwen3-0.6B). The depth of judge hacking (the plateau) tracks the judge: it correlates with judge AUC (Spearman -0.69 \[-0.94, -0.14\] over 12 cells), and within a family the larger judge is fooled less deeply. For the pace (onset), two pre-specified pairs contradict the gap account (the larger-gap cell was fooled 3.5x sooner at the pre-specified threshold). With 12 cells we cannot formally separate judge AUC from the gap for either endpoint. The smaller judge was not fooled sooner than a judge as large as the policy, though it also differs in family and template. In a blind test on three held-out judges, a hash-locked step-0 predictor did not beat step-0 AUC, but three cells cannot separate them. At 7-8B, judges from three families plateaued at 0.37, 0.67 and 0.85.

**comment/C1：** 20 pages, 6 figures. Code, per-step logs and the read answer samples: https://github.com/haosenwang1018/judge-hacking-pace

</details>

### 295. [Data-Centric Recursive Self-Improvement for Navigation via Policy-Synchronized Language-Action Dual Bootstrapping](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15782v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15782

**作者：** Songze Li、Haoming Gu、Ziyang Gong、Zhitong Wang、Gengze Zhou、Zun Wang、Yuhan Zhu、Tianxiang Jiang、Juanzi Li、Qi Wu、Weinan Zhang、Yu Qiao、Wenwei Zhang、Yi Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15782v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15782v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 RSI-Nav：在视觉语言导航中用一个共享模型同时做「指令跟随」与「指令生成」，按小分片处理无标注轨迹，用当前策略生成指令并执行评估目标达成与路径效率，保留合格样本后立即更新模型，从而缓解生成监督滞后于策略演化的问题。

**相关性简评：** 虽然研究的是导航任务而非 latent 视觉推理，但其「策略同步的分片式自生成监督 + 依任务结果筛选样本」可能为 LVR 的轨迹训练、监督与贡献分配提供可核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Data-Centric Recursive Self-Improvement for Navigation via Policy-Synchronized Language-Action Dual Bootstrapping

**abstract/A1：** Vision-language navigation requires agents to follow natural-language instructions to reach target locations, making high-quality language supervision essential. Since human annotation is costly, prior work has explored scalable data synthesis methods. However, existing methods typically either use separate models for navigation and instruction generation or couple the two tasks through task-specific components; most also annotate the full trajectory corpus with a fixed model before updating, which can cause generated supervision to lag behind the evolving policy. Therefore, we introduce RSI-Nav, a data-centric recursive self-improvement framework for navigation via policy-synchronized language-action dual bootstrapping, which unifies vision-language-to-action instruction following and vision-action-to-language instruction generation within a shared model. Specifically, after supervised fine-tuning establishes fundamental capabilities, RSI-Nav progressively processes unlabeled trajectories in small shards. The current model generates instructions for these trajectories, executes them to evaluate goal completion and path efficiency, retains qualified samples, and immediately updates itself before processing the next shard. This shard-wise update keeps newly generated supervision aligned with the evolving policy. We also incorporate spatial understanding data, since stronger spatial reasoning benefits navigation. Extensive experiments show that RSI-Nav reaches 68.6% SR on R2R-CE and 72.4% SR on RxR-CE, while providing stronger instruction-generation utility and modestly improved spatial understanding after recursive evolution.

</details>

### 296. [Agent Sociodrama: Social-Dynamics-Guided Persona Recasting for LLM Agent Teams](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15788v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15788

**作者：** Yirui Qi、Xiaoming Zhang、Jaehong Yoon

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.MA

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15788v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15788v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Agent Sociodrama，用统一外部 LLM 裁判每轮更新 LLM 智能体的情绪状态与有向非对称关系，并以社会理论模式和人类判断评估其社会动态；随后提出 TPR，从交互记录与轨迹中诊断群体失效、重铸 agent persona 后重跑任务。

**相关性简评：** 其「每轮由外部裁判更新状态」与「按交互轨迹诊断失效再修改初始配置重跑」的循环更新与轨迹级修复机制，可能为 LVR 的 latent 状态更新、轨迹诊断与监督提供可核查的方法线索；但该工作不涉及视觉或多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Agent Sociodrama: Social-Dynamics-Guided Persona Recasting for LLM Agent Teams

**abstract/A1：** Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed as teams, yet they fail in characteristically social ways: information holders stay silent, dominant speakers anchor groups on wrong answers, and norm violations go unsanctioned. We present Agent Sociodrama, a framework for modeling and validating evolving social dynamics in LLM agent teams. Under fixed personas, agents' emotional states and directed, asymmetric relationships are updated every round by a unified external LLM judge and shape their subsequent interactions. Across six LLM backbones and five social scenarios, we assess social fidelity through classical social-theory patterns and agreement with human judgments. The resulting trajectories exhibit structured social patterns and model-specific differences. We then introduce Trajectory-Guided Persona Recasting (TPR), which diagnoses group-dynamic failures from interaction transcripts and social trajectories and recasts agent personas before rerunning the task. Across four collaborative benchmarks, TPR improves performance from both heterogeneous and randomly initialized agent persona compositions, yielding up to 83.3%p of accuracy improvement over the initial casting. On representative distributed-information cooperation and mixed-motive bargaining tasks, we outperform SOTOPIA and AgentVerse in three of four comparisons, by up to 37.5%p in Pareto rate. These results show that validated social trajectories provide actionable signals for repairing LLM agent teams.

**comment/C1：** Project Page: https://lululu896.github.io/Agent-Sociodrama

</details>

### 297. [Passing Tests, Missing Semantics: Evidence of Interpretive Lock-In in Plan-Based DataFrame Code Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15797v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15797

**作者：** Jingjing、Liu、Dishu Yang、Hongbo Qin、Hansong Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.SE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15797v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15797v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在 30 个基于 TPC-DS 的 DataFrame 任务上比较一次性生成、测试引导修订与计划审查引导修订，发现测试通过率从 22/30 升至 30/30，但无一解匹配参考输出，并将这种错误解释跨计划、实现与测试持续存在的现象称为「解释锁定」。

**相关性简评：** 其「自生成测试通过≠语义正确」及评估器对照、非判别性测试的诊断线索，可能可供核查 LVR 中验证信号是否具判别力、视觉证据筛选与停止决策的收益判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Passing Tests, Missing Semantics: Evidence of Interpretive Lock-In in Plan-Based DataFrame Code Generation

**abstract/A1：** Planning and revision are intended to bring generated code closer to the task specification. Yet a mistaken interpretation can persist across the plan, implementation, and tests - a pattern we call interpretive lock-in. We investigate this risk on 30 DataFrame tasks derived from TPC Benchmark DS, comparing Frozen One-Pass, Test-Guided Revision, and PlanAudit-Guided Revision. Test-pass counts rose from 22/30 to 29/30 and 30/30, yet no generated solution matched its stored reference output. Evaluator controls returned the expected outcome in 57/57 cases. Same-engine SQL re-execution reproduced 28/30 references; all 77 test-passing runs on these tasks still failed reference agreement. PlanAudit-Guided Revision improved code scores on 3/30 tasks and test coverage on 11/30, but the median paired change was zero for both measures. Failure analysis revealed tests that omitted requirements, adopted candidate-defined schemas, used nondiscriminating fixtures, or repeated the implementation's incorrect logic. Fresh generation on ten targeted tasks produced 0/30 reference matches and 25/25 false passes among test-passing runs. These findings are diagnostic rather than causal: the pipelines differ in feedback, grounding, call budgets, and editing permissions, and the study uses one model and one primary generation per eligible task. Because pre-adjudication human labels were not retained, inter-rater agreement cannot be reconstructed and the mechanism analyses remain exploratory. Overall, increasingly successful self-generated tests did not establish semantic correctness, even after excluding unreproduced references.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at the International Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering Researches (ICECER 2026)

</details>

### 298. [Engram Injection: A Study of Temporal Validity in Parametric Language-Model Memory](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15882v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15882

**作者：** Sam Siavoshian、Omar Ramadan、Amir K. Saeed、Benjamin A. Johnson、Benjamin M. Rodriguez

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15882v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15882v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究语言模型能否仅凭问题与当前时间在参数中学会事实的时效变更：用 LoRA 适配器存事实、FiLM 注入时钟，并与带日期全历史提示、检索四条记录对比；结果显示适配器方法在训练未见的七天时点上版本选择全错，而提示与检索几乎全对，据此区分「学到事实」与「学会何时使用」。

**相关性简评：** 其核心诊断（去掉提示或检索后，参数状态是否真被用于输出）与 LVR 中信息坍缩、视觉旁路及 latent 贡献分配的核查思路相通，「可删除记忆单元」与训练审计也可能供借鉴；但该工作为纯文本设定，迁移到多模态推理状态尚需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Engram Injection: A Study of Temporal Validity in Parametric Language-Model Memory

**abstract/A1：** A stored fact may stop being valid when a user changes a preference or an event replaces an earlier one. We study whether a language model can learn these changes in its parameters and answer correctly from only a question and the current time. Engram Injection stores facts in LoRA adapters and supplies the clock through FiLM conditioning on a frozen Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct model. We compare it with additive clock conditioning, prompting with the full dated history, and retrieving four dated records. We train six matched adapters across three seeds after fixing a sampler that could admit test-age examples into training. The training audit reports no such examples among 127,760 evaluated training inputs. On 62 pairs of questions asked before and after an update, at an elapsed age of seven days excluded from training, both adapter methods answer zero pairs correctly under the primary blinded assistant review with order code 1 held fixed. Full-history prompting answers 59/62 pairs correctly, and retrieval answers 62/62. Separate experiments show that adapters can store facts and that removable memory units can support local deletion. Combining fact selection with time-based version selection remains unsuccessful. These results separate learning a fact from learning when to use it.

**comment/C1：** 18 pages, 4 figures

</details>

### 299. [RetryBench: Separating Retry Permission from Recovery Outcomes in GPT Tool Use](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15884v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15884

**作者：** You Liu、Yue Liu、Quanchao Lu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15884v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15884v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出 RetryBench，通过多组受控实验把「超时工具调用后重试是否被可见契约允许」与「重试是否真正带来恢复」分开测量，发现多个 GPT 端点会在缺乏契约支持时仍发起重试，且成功恢复并不等于能可靠拒绝无支持重试。

**相关性简评：** 其把「获得许可」与「实际结果」解耦的对照设计、接口变体声明与多重比较校正，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 步骤是被真正使用还是仅被允许出现；原文不涉及视觉或多模态内部状态，迁移性有待判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RetryBench: Separating Retry Permission from Recovery Outcomes in GPT Tool Use

**abstract/A1：** False retry permission (FRP) occurs when an agent retries a timed-out tool call without support from the visible contract. RetryBench separates this error from realized recovery. Successful protected recovery does not imply reliable rejection of unsupported retries. In a 720-response key control, valid keys usually enabled safe progress, but offered changed keys elicited unsupported retries in Sol (1/80), Terra (55/80), and Luna (60/80). A later 240-response control removed the candidate and required models to supply a key. Luna still made 8/80 unsupported dispatches; Sol and Terra made none in 80 responses each. Accepting a displayed bad key therefore cannot explain all observed errors, although changed output requirements and conditions preclude a pure display-effect comparison. Removing the weak-contract label increased retries in Sol and Terra's coded-action conditions in a six-endpoint study. A separate 1,536-response canonical-action block also found a positive Terra contrast (115/128 versus 124/128 retries), concentrated in two task/order conditions; the other five contrasts remained unresolved after multiplicity correction. An explicit-contract cue control elicited deferral in all 762 returned responses, leaving recovery unresolved. These results support reporting permission and recovery together across declared interface variants. The evidence covers four purposive tasks, fixed GPT endpoints, and one recovery decision; it identifies neither internal mechanisms nor episode-level safety.

</details>

### 300. [Variance-Optimal State Resampling for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15888v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15888

**作者：** Yibo Wang、Yuanxin Liu、Zhaoran Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15888v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15888v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该工作研究可验证奖励强化学习中的 rollout 预算浪费问题，将其重构为「固定预算下哪种状态采样分布能最小化策略梯度估计方差」，得到闭式 Neyman 分配 μ∝d(s)σ(s)，并据此提出 GRPO 的即插即用改动 VSR（前缀回放缓冲与零成本方差代理），在数学推理与长程 agentic 任务上优于 GRPO/GiGPO。

**相关性简评：** 论文不涉及视觉或多模态 latent 推理，但「按估计方差分配状态采样预算」的思路可能可供核查 LVR 中动态计算分配、是否继续 LOOK/THINK 的停止决策，以及轨迹训练里的贡献分配问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Variance-Optimal State Resampling for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards spends much of its rollout budget on states that yield no learning signal. We recast this as a question about the sampling distribution itself: under a fixed rollout budget, which distribution over states minimizes the variance of the policy-gradient estimator? The answer admits a closed-form Neyman allocation, $μ\_{\\mathrm{var}}^π(s) \\propto d^π(s)\\,σ\_π(s)$, which connects naturally to GRPO's group-relative advantage and induces an emergent reverse curriculum as the policy improves, with no externally imposed schedule. Building on this principle, we propose VSR (Variance-driven State Resampling), a plug-in modification to GRPO using a prefix replay buffer and a zero-cost variance proxy. On mathematical reasoning benchmarks and long-horizon agentic tasks (Sokoban, BabyAI), VSR outperforms GRPO and GiGPO on most benchmarks with fewer generated tokens per update.

</details>

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning Multimodal Sensor Fusion with JEPA Representations for Breathing Activity and Pose Recognition

**abstract/A1：** Predictive video representations do not by themselves specify how a multimodal system should handle missing sensors. We transfer frozen V-JEPA2 features to a set of heterogeneous sensors comprised by RGB video, depth video, and radar time series. A shared fusion model uses modality queries, fixed sensor slots, and explicit availability to classify breathing activity and pose from all seven non-empty sensor subsets. The contribution is a controlled evaluation of subset supervision, pooling capacity, and representation transfer on 39 OMuSense-23 subjects with five subject-group folds and three seeds. With matched downstream parameter counts, the final model reaches recording-level activity macro-F1 of $75.23%\\pm0.60$ averaged across seven subsets. Supervising all subsets in each batch improves the matched query-pooling control by 1.923 percentage points (conditional 95% subject-bootstrap interval \[0.647, 3.209\]), while query pooling shows no clear advantage over matched mean pooling under balanced supervision. Radar probes support transfer beyond pooled wavelet pixels, 64-token inference approximately preserves mean activity performance, and the tested Consensus-JEPA loss adds no measured benefit against its exact control.

### 302. [Make Every Expansion Count: Learning to Search Efficiently in LLM Code Repair](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15894v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15894

**作者：** Elad Sharony、Ido Greenberg、Jialin Song、Shie Mannor、Gal Chechik、Eli Meirom

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.SE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15894v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15894v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 CodeTriage：一个 0.6B 参数的学习型策略，在生成并测试修订代码之前，读取测试输出、失败诊断与候选编辑，预测经由该编辑修复所需的修复步数分布，据此跨程序对待处理编辑排序，从而减少修订次数与 token；并发布 1220 万条程序版本的修复树语料。

**相关性简评：** 其「先预测剩余步数分布再排序候选」的做法，可能为 LVR 中候选 latent 假设的筛选、动态计算分配与停止/验证决策提供方法线索，可供核查该打分能否迁移为推理期的价值估计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Make Every Expansion Count: Learning to Search Efficiently in LLM Code Repair

**abstract/A1：** Large language model (LLM) code-repair systems fix faulty programs by repeatedly generating and testing revisions. Each revision is costly, making the choice of which repair to pursue important for efficiency. Existing search policies rely on test pass rates and search statistics, ignoring the details of test failures and proposed edits. We introduce CodeTriage, a learned policy that prioritizes edits before their revised programs are generated and tested. Its 0.6B-parameter model reads the test output, failure diagnosis, and proposed edit, then predicts a distribution over the number of repair steps needed to reach a fix through that edit. These predictions prioritize all pending edits across programs before generating and testing the revised code. On held-out repair tasks, CodeTriage finds fixes with 21% fewer program revisions and 12% fewer output tokens than the strongest baseline on each metric. Without retraining, it achieves the highest average success across search budgets for each of 11 unseen repair LLMs. Ablations show that both the failure context and edit text, as well as comparisons across programs, improve search. We also release a corpus of 12.2 million program versions from four LLMs, organized into repair trees with proposed edits and test results.

</details>

### 303. [Fast and Accurate: Improving Personalized LLM Performance by Semantic Concentration Inspired Workload Split between RAG and Fine-Tuning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15921v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15921

**作者：** Xingke Yang、Sicong Li、Lingfeng Yao、Rui Chen、Changqing Luo、Xin Fu、Miao Pan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15921v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15921v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 PUR，按用户历史数据的「语义集中度」划分工作负载：语义集中的「核心」信息用于 PEFT 离线参数微调，分散信息交给 RAG；在线时核心查询直接由参数化模型生成，仅边缘查询触发检索，在高精度同时降低 14.4%–46.6% 推理延迟。

**相关性简评：** 其按语义集中度在参数化记忆与外部检索之间路由的做法，可能为 LVR 中「何时依赖内部 latent 状态、何时重新获取视觉证据」的 THINK/LOOK 决策提供方法线索，但跨域可迁移性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Fast and Accurate: Improving Personalized LLM Performance by Semantic Concentration Inspired Workload Split between RAG and Fine-Tuning

**abstract/A1：** With ever increasing personalized large language model (LLM) services, the next question to answer is how to improve the quality of services/users' experiences, which is indicated by personalized LLM generation accuracy/quality and inference latency. Although state-of-the-art designs, e.g., parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) or Full PEFT+RAG, can help, they largely ignore the heterogeneous semantic concentrations of users' historical data and cannot fully unleash the potential of personal data for personalized LLM performance enhancement. In this paper, we propose PEFT Union RAG (PUR), a novel \`\`fast and accurate'' approach that exploits the semantic concentration of users' personal historical data to split workload between PEFT and RAG, aiming to improve personalized LLM performance in terms of better generation accuracy/quality and lower inference latency. Briefly, PUR partitions user's personal historical data and assigns semantic concentrated \`\`core'' information to PEFT for offline parametric fine-tuning, while retaining dispersed information for RAG. During the online LLM inference, PUR directly generates responses for \`\`core'' queries covered by the PEFT region and invokes RAG only for sporadic \`\`peripheral'' queries. Experimental results show that, by appropriately splitting workload between PEFT and RAG, PUR consistently achieves the best generation accuracy/quality for various users across multiple tasks, while reducing inference latency by 14.4%--46.6% compared with the best performed method.

</details>

### 304. [Frequency-Step Cache: Separating Synchronization and Repair for Efficient Autoregressive Video Diffusion](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15922v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15922

**作者：** Kerry Xu、Param Misra、Zachary Stenglein、Athri Karunamurthy、Fanjiang Ye、Yuke Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15922v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15922v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Frequency-Step Cache，在自回归视频扩散中把缓存的两类决策解耦：用密集到稀疏的锚点决定何时做全量同步计算，再用基于频域漂移和 token age 的 latent 风险信号决定锚点之间做整步复用、选择性 token 重算还是完全修复，从而改善速度-质量折中。

**相关性简评：** 其「何时同步全量计算、间隔内补多少修复」的两段式调度与基于 latent 漂移/陈旧度的风险度量，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的刷新时机与缓存陈旧修复提供可核查的方法线索；但该工作属视频生成，与推理期状态使用和停止决策的对应关系需人工确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Frequency-Step Cache: Separating Synchronization and Repair for Efficient Autoregressive Video Diffusion

**abstract/A1：** Autoregressive (AR) video generation enables long-horizon synthesis but requires repeated forward passes through large diffusion transformers. Training-free caching reduces this cost by reusing intermediate computation, yet existing controllers often couple two decisions: when to synchronize the cache exactly and how much computation to repair between synchronizations. We introduce Frequency-Step Cache (FSC), which separates these roles. FSC schedules exact full-computation anchors on a dense-to-sparse trajectory, while a lightweight latent-space risk based on frequency-resolved drift and token age controls inter-anchor repair through whole-step replay, selective token recomputation, or full repair. On SkyReels-V2, whole-step reuse provides most of the acceleration, while selective token computation is most effective as fidelity repair. A controlled ablation shows that using one reactive signal for both synchronization and repair reduces fidelity at matched latency, with the same separation advantage observed on FramePack and Matrix-Game. Across multiple autoregressive video backbones, FSC improves speed-quality trade-offs. On SkyReels-V2, FSC-Speed reaches 2.36x speedup versus MotionCache's 2.275x while improving SSIM by 0.019 and PSNR by 0.5 dB. At MotionCache-matched speed, FSC-Quality improves SSIM by 0.031 and PSNR by 1.0 dB and lowers LPIPS by 0.024. Without retuning, FSC-Quality transfers to SkyReels-V2 14B at 2.12x speedup versus 1.79x for MotionCache.

**comment/C1：** 30 pages, 11 figures, 18 tables

</details>

### 305. [When Trackers Fail: VLM-Guided Verification and Recovery for Robust Video Object Segmentation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15929v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15929

**作者：** Valay Bundele、Susmit Agrawal、Mehran Hosseinzadeh、The Nam Nguyen、Hendrik P. A. Lensch

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15929v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15929v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Dual-Agent 框架：由视觉语言验证 agent 基于时空上下文判断跟踪器是否仍锁定目标，检出失败后由纠错 agent 结合时序上下文恢复目标，纠错模块在真实 SAM3 失败样本加身份切换与干扰扰动上训练，在 LVOS-v2、SecVOS 及多个 VOT 基准上验证并可免训练迁移到 SAM2.1、SeC、Cutie。

**相关性简评：** 其中用 VLM 显式判断「当前传播是否已失效」并触发重新获取证据，可能为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的停止与再观察决策、以及失败样本监督设计提供可供核查的线索；但研究对象是视频跟踪的纠错恢复，验证信号能否迁移到 latent 推理状态仍待确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When Trackers Fail: VLM-Guided Verification and Recovery for Robust Video Object Segmentation

**abstract/A1：** Recent trackers built on foundation models such as the Segment Anything Model (SAM) achieve strong performance by propagating object masks through memory. However, this strength is also a key source of failure: under occlusion, reappearance, or distractors, an incorrect prediction can enter the tracking loop and be propagated over time, resulting in persistent identity drift. Existing approaches seek to prevent such failures through improved memory and temporal modeling, but once a failure occurs, the tracker has no explicit mechanism to recognize or correct it. We address this gap with Dual-Agent, a failure-aware tracking framework that complements propagation with explicit verification and recovery. We address this gap with Dual-Agent, a failure-aware tracking framework that complements propagation with explicit verification and recovery. A vision-language verification agent first reasons over spatio-temporal context to determine whether the tracker is still following the target. When a failure is detected, a correction agent uses temporal context to recover the target before tracking continues. The correction agent is trained on real SAM3 failures, augmented with targeted identity-switch and distractor perturbations that expose it to challenging ambiguities during recovery. On LVOS-v2 and SecVOS, Dual-Agent improves SAM3 by 1.2 and 2.7 $J\\&amp;F$, respectively. Importantly, the proposed framework transfers without retraining to SAM2.1, SeC, and Cutie, as well as to long-term video object tracking benchmarks including LaSOT-ext, TNL2K, and VOT-LT2022. Our results show that explicitly reasoning about when tracking fails and how to recover provides a complementary path to robust tracking beyond improving propagation alone. Project page: valaybundele.github.io/Dual-Agent.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 306. [DiffNash: Finding Nash Equilibrium in High-Dimensional Continuous Action Spaces with Diffusion Policies](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15932v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15932

**作者：** Haichuan Wang、Anagha Satish、Jiale Zheng、Saisneha Ghatti、Lingkai Kong、Kai Wang、Milind Tambe

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.GT、cs.MA

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15932v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15932v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 DiffNash，用扩散策略在高维连续动作空间中求解 Nash 均衡：推导重加权 score matching 目标，使扩散策略无需来自更新后目标分布的样本即可训练，并用当前与历史策略 ELBO 之差的无偏估计作为重要性权重代理，结合 OMD 与 FP 及 replay buffer，在森林保护与连续 Colonel Blotto 博弈上降低 Nash gap。

**相关性简评：** 迭代求解中目标策略分布持续漂移、无法直接采样的问题，与 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的分布训练、轨迹监督和贡献分配有一定结构相似性；其「无似然的重加权/重要性权重估计」可能为 latent 状态训练中的分布偏移校正提供可核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DiffNash: Finding Nash Equilibrium in High-Dimensional Continuous Action Spaces with Diffusion Policies

**abstract/A1：** Computing equilibria in high-dimensional continuous games requires learning and representing rich, multi-modal strategy distributions, something conventional neural policies struggle to achieve. Diffusion models offer a natural solution, but standard diffusion training requires direct samples from a fixed target distribution, which are generally unavailable under iterative game-solving updates. We propose a diffusion-based framework for equilibrium computation that enables diffusion-based variants of Online Mirror Descent (OMD) and Fictitious Play (FP). Our approach derives a reweighted score-matching objective that trains diffusion policies without requiring direct samples from each updated policy. Our main method, DiffNash, combines the fast convergence of OMD with the sample efficiency of FP by reusing past actions through a replay buffer. To correct the resulting distribution shift from sample reuse, we derive an unbiased estimator of the difference between current and past policies' Evidence Lower Bounds, whose exponential provides a tractable proxy for the corresponding importance weight without evaluating diffusion likelihoods. We evaluate our approach on forest protection games and continuous Colonel Blotto games, reducing the Nash gap over the strongest baseline by 35.6% and 24.7%, respectively, with minimal hyperparameter tuning.

**comment/C1：** 41 pages, 11 figures

</details>

### 307. [Error-Based Bidirectional Predictive Coding Enables Deep, 4-Bit Predictive Coding Networks](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15933v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15933

**作者：** Garrett Kinman、Zeljko Zilic

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15933v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15933v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究如何把预测编码网络（PCN）的特性带入深层与 4-bit 量化场景：结合双向 PC（bPC）与基于误差的重参数化（ePC），并加入误差梯度全局范数裁剪，缓解基于状态的 PC 随深度指数衰减、低精度下更严重的失败，使至少八层网络在 W4A4E4 量化感知训练下稳定训练并保留分类与类条件生成能力。

**相关性简评：** PCN 的迭代能量最小化推断、逐层误差信号与低精度状态表示，可能与 LVR 中 latent 状态的循环更新、深度方向信息保真及状态量化线索相关；不过该工作面向硬件加速与图像分类/生成，与视觉语言推理无直接联系，迁移属推测，需核查其误差优化是否真能维持跨层有效信号。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Error-Based Bidirectional Predictive Coding Enables Deep, 4-Bit Predictive Coding Networks

**abstract/A1：** Predictive coding networks (PCNs) promise properties not offered by backpropagation-trained networks: learning from purely local information, a single network that both discriminates and generates, and flexible inference by energy minimization. However, their iterative inference is expensive, making hardware acceleration desirable, and a useful, efficient accelerator needs both depth and aggressive quantization. Canonical state-based PC delivers neither: its inference signal decays exponentially with depth, so deep models fail to train, and low precision makes it worse. We show that pairing two recent methods carries the full PCN property set into the deep, 4-bit regime: bidirectional PC (bPC), which unifies discrimination and generation, and the error-based reparameterization (ePC), which optimizes prediction errors rather than states during inference. Error optimization delivers the output signal to every layer in a single backward pass, removing the signal decay; one additional element, global-norm clipping of the error gradients, stabilizes the error dynamics at depth. The resulting ePC+bPC model trains stably up to at least eight layers and retains its full-precision accuracy and clean class-conditional generation under W4A4E4 quantization-aware training, across FP4 and three posit formats. On six-layer networks, where state-based bPC collapses to chance, ePC+bPC classifies more than 50 accuracy points above it after one epoch of training, with class-conditional generations 5-9x better in RMSE. 4-bit quantization is nearly free: full-precision and 4-bit accuracies differ by at most ~5 points, and by under two in the best-performing formats. We characterize the two failure modes the method overcomes, bounded signal decay in state-based PC and error divergence in unregularized error optimization, and discuss implications for a 4-bit-native PCN accelerator.

</details>

### 308. [Probabilistic Forecasting of Wildfire Size Using Conditional Flow Matching](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15983v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15983

**作者：** Isaac Lee、Bryan Shaddy、Assad Oberai

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15983v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15983v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文用条件 flow matching 对野火面积的时间演化做概率预测：以当前与上一步火场规模、区域平均气象、地形与燃料信息为条件，预测 3 小时面积变化，并对 24 小时多步递归预报给出不确定性量化。

**相关性简评：** flow matching 式的连续时间生成、递归多步状态推进及不确定性量化，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的生成与逐步更新提供方法线索，其敏感性分析思路也可供核查 latent 表示是否保留任务必要信息；但属跨领域应用，迁移性待验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Probabilistic Forecasting of Wildfire Size Using Conditional Flow Matching

**abstract/A1：** In this work we present a probabilistic model for predicting the temporal evolution of wildfire size using conditional generative algorithms, namely flow matching. Rather than predicting spatially resolved fire progression, the proposed model forecasts a time series of fire acreage, substantially reducing computational cost and enabling efficient integration with downstream applications such as early warning systems and risk assessment tools. Given estimates of the fire size at the current and previous forecasting steps, alongside spatially averaged weather conditions, terrain characteristics, and fuel composition, the model predicts the change in fire area over a 3-hour interval. Training data are drawn from 140 coupled atmosphere-wildfire simulations generated using WRF-SFIRE, paired with weather data from the North American Mesoscale (NAM) model. Sensitivity analysis demonstrates that the model captures physically-consistent responses to variations in wind speed, temperature, and relative humidity. Model performance is evaluated against reference solutions from WRF-SFIRE. For single-step predictions, the model achieves a symmetric mean absolute percentage error (sMAPE) of 0.39 relative to the reference WRF-SFIRE solutions. Recursive multi-step predictions over 24 hours are performed for 12 held-out test cases, where the flow matching model achieves a final fire area sMAPE of 0.39 while further providing meaningful quantification of forecast uncertainty.

**comment/C1：** 18 pages, 7 figures, 1 table. Code and data: https://github.com/isaaclee2/Wildfire\_Size\_Flow\_Matching

</details>

### 309. [Representational Difference Distillation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15997v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15997

**作者：** Abdulkarim Mugisha、Divin Irakiza

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15997v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15997v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Representational Difference Distillation（RDD）：用两个非对称亲和矩阵刻画师生表示空间中的相反方向错配，从而决定对齐哪些样本对、以多大力度纠正每个错配样本，在 CIFAR-100 的 resnet32x4→resnet8x4 上验证，并比较课程式与采样式变体。

**相关性简评：** 其「先诊断表示结构性分歧、再据此加权监督信号」的思路可能可供核查：迁移到 LVR 时或可用于定位学生 latent 推理状态与教师状态不一致的样本或关系并集中训练信号，但原论文限于图像分类蒸馏，关联属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Representational Difference Distillation

**abstract/A1：** Knowledge distillation transfers representational knowledge from a large teacher network to a compact student. Existing relational and contrastive distillation methods treat all samples uniformly, spending equal gradient on well-matched and poorly-matched regions of the representation space alike. We propose Representational Difference Distillation (RDD), which diagnoses where teacher and student representations structurally disagree and concentrates the distillation signal on those regions. RDD uses two asymmetric affinity matrices that capture opposing directions of misalignment: one identifies samples the student incorrectly considers similar, the other identifies teacher relationships the student has yet to learn. These affinities determine which sample pairs the distillation loss aligns and how strongly it corrects each misaligned sample. On CIFAR-100 with resnet32x4 to resnet8x4, RDD reaches 75.58% test accuracy in our runs, on par with CRD (75.45%) and above KD and RKD. We additionally explore curriculum-based and sampling-based variants, finding that weighting the loss is more effective than filtering the data.

**comment/C1：** 9 pages, 7 figures, 1 table

</details>

### 310. [Autoregressive Decoding as a Martingale: Characterizing the Stochastic Dynamics of LLM Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16041v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16041

**作者：** Xiahui Zhu、Zhenyi Qi、Wanwei Liu、Haoang Chi、Yang Tan、Xinyu Sun、Ji Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16041v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16041v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把自回归解码的每步预测误差定义为采样 token 指示与模型条件预测分布之差，证明累积误差过程对解码滤波构成鞅，并导出可预测二次变差的闭式表达 Σ\_t(1−p(y\_t\|y\_&lt;t))，在 Llama-3.x 与 Qwen2.5 上做了白盒验证。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本解码的鞅与二次变差刻画可能作为一种逐步骤不确定度累积的量具，可供核查 LVR 中基于不确定性的停止决策或 latent 推理轨迹波动分析；与视觉推理本身无直接关联。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Autoregressive Decoding as a Martingale: Characterizing the Stochastic Dynamics of LLM Generation

**abstract/A1：** Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success across a wide range of language tasks. At their core, autoregressive LLMs are conditional probability models that learn to approximate the next-token distribution given the preceding context. Despite this probabilistic nature, the stochastic dynamics of autoregressive decoding have rarely been investigated from a rigorous probabilistic perspective. In this work, we define the per-step prediction error as the difference between the sampled token indicator and the model's conditional predictive distribution, and prove that the cumulative error process is a martingale with respect to the decoding filtration, implying that its conditional first-order moment is identically zero. Beyond this first-order property, we derive a closed-form expression for the second-order behavior of the martingale sequence: its predictable quadratic variation reduces to $\\sum\_t\\left(1-p(y\_t\\mid y\_{&lt;t})\\right)$, computable from realized token probabilities alone. This identity establishes a direct theoretical connection between sequence fluctuations and predictive uncertainty during autoregressive decoding. White-box experiments on Llama-3.x and Qwen2.5 families (1B to 72B parameters) verify that the empirically measured second-order moments closely match the theoretical predictions derived from our martingale analysis. These results provide a probabilistic framework for analyzing autoregressive LLM decoding, reveal intrinsic probabilistic fingerprints of different language models, and establish a rigorous mathematical foundation for LLM-generated text detection and uncertainty quantification.

</details>

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PIGEONS: Incremental Long-Video Captioning with Persistent Identity Gallery and Evolving Overarching Narrative Summary

**abstract/A1：** Detailed video captioning has become an essential semantic interface for multi-modal understanding and generation. While existing methods mainly target short videos, extending them to long videos remains challenging, primarily due to limited context windows of current video understanding models. A naive solution is to adopt segment-wise captioning followed by concatenation, yet this paradigm often suffers from inconsistent subject references and fragmented long-range narratives. To mitigate these issues, we introduce PIGEONS, an incremental long-video captioning model built upon a Persistent Identity Gallery and an Evolving Overarching Narrative Summary. Before caption generation, PIGEONS scans the entire video to construct an identity gallery that captures key subjects along with their visual references, thereby providing a stable referential anchor. The model then performs clip-by-clip captioning conditioned on the persistent gallery and an evolving overarching narrative summary, which compactly maintains and updates essential long-range contextual information after each captioning step. To enable these capabilities, we develop a three-stage training strategy that integrates supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PIGEONS markedly improves long-video captioning performance, achieving superior accuracy, completeness, and subject referential consistency over existing methods, while maintaining competitive performance on short-video captioning.

</details>

**内容简述：** 论文研究如何为 LLM 多智能体系统训练运行时审计器，从执行前缀预测最终成败；提出 Dream2Discern，在审计器自身预测损失引导下扰动其表示算子，生成「hard latent variants」作为隐式增广，使有限轨迹语料持续产出难例，无需额外采集或验证结果。

**相关性简评：** 以其预测损失为目标扰动内部表示、迭代再生难例的机制，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的监督与难例构造提供借鉴；但论文针对多智能体失败预测而非视觉推理，且其「latent」指审计器内部表示而非生成式推理状态，迁移性可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Dream2Discern: Learning from Hard Latent Variants for Runtime Failure Prediction in Multi-Agent Systems

**abstract/A1：** Reliable deployment of LLM-based multi-agent systems calls for runtime auditors that predict terminal outcomes from observed execution prefixes. These auditors typically learn from a limited corpus of trajectories with verified outcomes. Expanding this corpus requires costly execution and verification, yet broader failure coverage alone provides no explicit criterion for identifying prefixes that the current auditor finds difficult to classify. To this end, we propose Dream2Discern, a runtime auditor trained through implicit augmentation guided by its own prediction loss. During Dream, we select perturbations of the auditor's representation operators to increase prediction loss on recorded prefixes, yielding hard latent variants. During Discern, the auditor learns to predict execution outcomes from these variants using the original labels. The variants are regenerated as the auditor learns, turning a limited corpus into a renewable source of hard examples and requiring no additional trajectory collection or outcome verification. Extensive evaluations on AFTraj-2K and StepShield show that Dream2Discern outperforms competitive failure auditors and achieves over 90% trajectory-level weighted accuracy on both benchmarks while balancing prediction accuracy and timeliness. Project page: https://zbox1005.github.io/dream2discern-project/

**comment/C1：** 27 pages, 6 figures

</details>

### 313. [Regime-Aware Router Learning for Multi-Domain Medical Image Generation with Diffusion Experts](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16082v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16082

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16082v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16082v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究在固定 diffusion expert 池上如何学习组合专家的路由器：比较仅用服务器图像与分量标签的 Server-Only 策略，以及借助去噪损失蒸馏路由目标、并用代理门控后续精修的 Anchor-Delta，在异构四域医学图像生成上评估路由与生成效果。

**相关性简评：** 其按输入与时间步分配专家、并以专家去噪损失作为性能证据来蒸馏路由目标的做法，可能与 LVR 中 latent 状态更新的贡献分配、无真值标签下的监督信号来源有可供核查的迁移线索；但属图像生成路由场景，联系需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Regime-Aware Router Learning for Multi-Domain Medical Image Generation with Diffusion Experts

**abstract/A1：** Heterogeneous medical image data motivate domain-specialized diffusion experts, but expert specialization alone does not determine how their predictions should be combined during sampling. Learning a global router is particularly challenging when the server has limited, potentially unrepresentative images. We study two router-learning strategies for a fixed expert pool. Server-Only learns input- and timestep-dependent expert assignments from server images with component labels. Anchor-Delta (AD) uses the same images and frozen experts to obtain additional evidence from denoising losses. It distills targets that combine this evidence with the current router's assignments, while a proxy gate controls a subsequent refinement step. Component labels describe data origin; expert losses measure empirical prediction performance. We evaluate these distinct signals through routing analyses and paired medical image generation. An AD-trained router improves generation metrics over Server-Only in a heterogeneous four-domain setting, and a separate server-data study shows gains in held-out routing over a corrected-routing comparator. Additional paired evaluations show that the effect of inference-time evidence mixing varies across benchmarks. These findings establish server-data availability and expert performance as distinct considerations in learning routers for multi-domain diffusion models.

### 314. [SelectTTRL: Representation-Guided Data Selection for Efficient Test-Time Reinforcement Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16104v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16104

**作者：** Yi Li、Linan Yue、Weibo Gao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16104v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16104v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究在不访问真值答案的情况下，能否用模型内部响应表示与「正确性方向」的余弦相似度（COS）预先判断测试题的可解性，并据此只对选定分位的题目执行 test-time RL，从而在保持或提升性能的同时减少测试时采样与更新开销。

**相关性简评：** 用内部表示预测问题可解性并据此分配测试时计算，可能与 LVR 关注的动态计算、停止决策及「预测工作区」线索相关，但其为纯文本 LLM 设定，迁移到多模态 latent 推理与视觉证据保持尚需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SelectTTRL: Representation-Guided Data Selection for Efficient Test-Time Reinforcement Learning

**abstract/A1：** Test-Time Reinforcement Learning (TTRL) enables large language models to adapt directly on unlabeled test problems by constructing pseudo-labels from multiple sampled responses. However, existing TTRL methods typically apply the same expensive sampling and optimization procedure to all test problems, despite substantial differences in their training utility. In this paper, we study whether such problems can be identified before costly test-time training, without access to ground-truth answers. We uncover a stable relationship between internal response representations and problem-level empirical accuracy. Specifically, we define COS as the cosine similarity between a model's response representation and a correctness-related direction constructed from an independent question-answering dataset. COS consistently correlates with problem solvability across different models, datasets, and experimental settings, and we further provide a theoretical analysis explaining this relationship. Building on this finding, we propose SelectTTRL, a representation-guided data selection method that ranks test problems using COS and applies TTRL only to a selected percentile interval. SelectTTRL leaves the standard TTRL pipeline unchanged for the selected problems, while avoiding unnecessary multi-response sampling and reinforcement learning updates on the remaining ones. Experiments across multiple reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that SelectTTRL substantially reduces test-time computation while maintaining or improving the performance of standard TTRL. Code is available at https://github.com/heyiliyi/SelectTTRL-public.

**comment/C1：** 22 pages, 1 figure

</details>

### 315. [Beyond Policy Rollouts: Embedding-Space Directional Exploration with Anchored Noise for LLM RLVR](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16105v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16105

**作者：** Daijiao Liu、Huiyi Wang、Lina Yao、Dong Gong

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16105v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16105v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 EDEN：在 rollout 源头做锚定噪声干预，把每组的少量标准 rollout 替换为在 prompt 后追加一个扰动 embedding 位置所生成的轨迹，并以降权优势加入 GRPO 更新，提升 LLM 数学推理 RLVR 的探索多样性与解覆盖。

**相关性简评：** 属纯文本 RLVR 探索增强，与视觉 latent 推理无直接关联；但其在输入表示层注入锚定噪声、刻意拉开组内条件差异以扩大学习信号的做法，可能为 latent 推理状态的多样性探索与优势分配提供可供核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Policy Rollouts: Embedding-Space Directional Exploration with Anchored Noise for LLM RLVR

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) typically uses small rollout groups per prompt, where repeated sampling from the same policy can yield highly similar trajectories, reducing within-group reward variation and weakening group-relative advantage signals. Existing remedies such as higher sampling temperature, entropy bonuses, asymmetric clipping, and larger rollout budgets broaden sampling or modify policy updates but leave rollout conditioning unchanged. In this paper, we propose EDEN (Embedding-space Directional Exploration via anchored Noise), which intervenes at the rollout source through anchored input perturbations. EDEN explores beyond the policy's own rollouts. Within the same rollout budget, it replaces a small fraction of standard rollouts in each group with rollouts that the same policy generates from the prompt plus a single appended, perturbed embedding position, rather than from the prompt alone. Gaussian noise drives variation, while a shared anchor provides a common conditioning direction within each prompt group. Selected perturbed rollouts contribute to GRPO updates with downweighted advantages, and the model architecture, discrete decoding, and test-time inference remain unchanged. Across model scales and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, EDEN outperforms GRPO and the exploration controls evaluated in the same pipeline, with the largest gains in sampled solution coverage. Analyses show that more prompt groups provide non-zero group-relative learning signals and that noise and anchoring play complementary roles. Intervening at the rollout source is thus an effective lever for exploration in RLVR.

</details>

### 316. [Silence and Noise: Resolving Suppression and Overvaluation in Multimodal Entity Alignment](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16106v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16106

**作者：** Xizhe Zhang、Jingfeng Zhang、Meng-Fen Chiang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16106v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16106v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究多模态实体对齐中模态缺失与跨图谱拓扑不对称的耦合失效，提出 ALMEA 框架：以跨模态补全合成缺失模态细节，用 latent 语义校准对齐跨图联合嵌入，并在稀疏监督下用受控迭代选择获取伪标签对。

**相关性简评：** 其「细节缺失导致模糊表征被高估」与「稠密结构上下文压制弱模态信号」的表述，可能对应 LVR 中视觉旁路、latent 信息坍缩与模态贡献分配问题，latent 校准与伪标签筛选机制可供核查借鉴。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Silence and Noise: Resolving Suppression and Overvaluation in Multimodal Entity Alignment

**abstract/A1：** Multimodal entity alignment (MMEA) is fundamental to integrating heterogeneous knowledge graphs (KGs), yet existing paradigms remain critically vulnerable to incomplete modalities and cross-graph structural asymmetries. This paper exposes a fundamental oversight in current MMEA research: treating feature missingness and topological discrepancies as isolated preprocessing or denoising challenges, which overlooks their destructive coupling during multimodal fusion. We systematically formulate and evaluate two newly identified failure modes: 1) Detail Missing (DM)-induced overvaluation, where the absence of local modality details causes models to overemphasize uninformative, blurred representations; and 2) Context Imbalance (CI)-induced suppression, where topological discrepancies across KGs allow dense structural contexts to overwhelm weaker but highly discriminative modal signals, triggering high-level semantic drift. To break this cycle of degradation, we introduce ALMEA, a generative and calibration framework that establishes a bidirectional feedback loop between low-level feature reconstruction and high-level latent space alignment. Specifically, Cross-Modality Imputation (CMI) synthesizes missing modality details to mitigate overvaluation, while Latent Semantic Calibration (LSC) aligns cross-graph joint embeddings to suppress topology-driven semantic drift. Under sparse supervision, we develop Controlled Iterative Selection (CIS) to adaptively acquire representative and diverse pseudo-labeled pairs, optimizing latent calibration under constrained budgets. Extensive evaluations on standard benchmarks demonstrate that ALMEA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. At a 20% supervision rate, ALMEA yields substantial absolute improvements of up to 5.20% in MRR and 6.40% in Hits@1, maintaining robust gains across higher supervision thresholds.

**comment/C1：** 26 pages, including appendices. Code: https://github.com/RTX4090123/ALMEA

</details>

### 317. [Imitation Holds a Key to Evolution: Localized Repair and Verified Skill Acquisition for Adaptive Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16125v1>)

**内容简述：** 论文把「被动模仿」形式化为一个循环：定位被违反的契约、提取局部目标、提出效果匹配的技能、测试小补丁，并在全任务验证后保留证据；作者以确定性符号控制器实例化该循环，在十个模拟工具环境中分析其修复查询复杂度并做对照实验。

**相关性简评：** 「定位需修复的局部经验、小规模试探后经验证再保留」这一机制可能与 LVR 的轨迹训练贡献分配、视觉证据筛选及停止/验证决策有关，可供核查；但该工作为符号化工具环境，无视觉或多模态状态，联系属方法层面的推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Imitation Holds a Key to Evolution: Localized Repair and Verified Skill Acquisition for Adaptive Agents

**abstract/A1：** An agent can retain successful trajectories without learning which part of an experience should repair a new discrepancy. We formulate passive imitation (PI) as an architectural loop that localizes a violated contract, extracts a local goal, proposes an effect-matched skill, tests a small patch, and retains evidence after full-task verification. We instantiate this loop as a deterministic symbolic controller and analyze its finite repair-query complexity under explicit identifiability and noninterference assumptions. Across ten simulated tool worlds, PI solves all 600 cold held-out composition tasks with three allowed small trials, compared with 6.17% for a whole-trajectory control, while an equally expressive compositional repair control matches PI. On an unseen tool revision, PI achieves 70.0% success versus 24.0% without small trials and 79.0% with self-trial enumeration; an exploratory 24-task adaptation stream subsequently raises first-submission success to 100%, supporting a limited correction-and-retention mechanism rather than a unique incentive advantage or general intelligence. The CPU-only implementation, integrity checks, and reproducible results are available at https://github.com/FriendOfYishan/PI.

</details>
