### 318. [PID-Gated Continual Prompt Adaptation Under Noisy Feedback](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16129v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16129

**作者：** Zhentao Xu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16129v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16129v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对非平稳环境下 LLM 智能体的提示适配调度问题，提出受 PID 控制启发的轻量门控，依据当前误差、历史证据积累与编辑后回滚来决定噪声反馈是否触发持久指令更新，并在多类漂移任务、模型规模与噪声水平上与简单基线及 TextGrad、GEPA 比较其性能与编辑调用成本的 Pareto 权衡。

**相关性简评：** PID 门控「响应当前误差、累积证据、回滚恶化」的接受/拒绝调度机制，可能可供核查为 LVR 中迭代推理状态何时提交更新、何时停止以及编辑/计算预算分配提供线索，但原文作用于提示层面而非 latent 状态，迁移性待确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PID-Gated Continual Prompt Adaptation Under Noisy Feedback

**abstract/A1：** Deploying LLM agents in non-stationary environments requires continually revising their instructions as the task drifts, yet rewriting after every reported mistake can turn noisy feedback into persistent errors. This raises an often-overlooked scheduling question in prompt adaptation: when should feedback trigger a lasting instruction update, and at what editor-call cost? Taking inspiration from proportional-integral-derivative (PID) control, we introduce a family of lightweight gates that react to the current error, accumulate evidence over time, and roll back deterioration after an edit. We benchmark these gates against both simple baselines and advanced prompt optimizers (TextGrad and GEPA), over a diverse suite of drifting tasks, LLM parameter sizes, feedback-noise levels, and random seeds. PID-gated continual prompt adaptation yields a more favorable Pareto trade-off between task performance (high accuracy, low error) and editor-call budget than the baselines considered, pointing to control-theoretic scheduling as a simple, general tool for robust prompt adaptation under unreliable feedback.

</details>

### 319. [Large Language Model Assisted Transportation Planning through a Differentiable User Equilibrium Layer](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16140v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16140

**作者：** Eunseung Lee、Gyeongjun Kim、Keemin Sohn

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16140v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16140v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该研究搭建了一个 LLM 智能体 + MCP 接口 + 开源交通规划引擎的可交互规划框架，并通过对 Beckmann 交通分配问题 KKT 条件直接求导构造可微用户均衡层，用出行时间函数标定与预算约束下的网络设计两个任务做示范。

**相关性简评：** 其可微均衡层本质上是对隐式不动点方程求导以获得梯度，可能为 latent 迭代推理状态的训练、梯度回传与贡献分配提供方法线索，但论文面向交通规划应用，与 LVR 状态生成的实际关联需人工核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Large Language Model Assisted Transportation Planning through a Differentiable User Equilibrium Layer

**abstract/A1：** Transportation planning has traditionally required substantial expertise in network modeling, traffic assignment, and optimization. As a result, strategic analyses such as network design, capacity expansion, and model calibration remain inaccessible to non-expert decision makers. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) provide an opportunity to bridge this gap by enabling natural-language interaction with complex transportation planning tools. However, existing LLM-based systems primarily serve as interfaces to simulation software and lack the ability to efficiently search, evaluate, and optimize transportation solutions. This study proposes an integrated human-AI transportation planning framework that combines a large language model, a model context protocol (MCP) interface, an open-source transportation planning engine (AequilibraE), and a differentiable user equilibrium (UE) assignment layer. The framework allows non-expert users to execute network analyses and improve solutions for optimization. A differentiable UE layer is developed by directly differentiating the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) conditions of the Beckmann traffic assignment problem. The proposed framework is demonstrated through two representative planning tasks: calibration of travel time functions from observed traffic counts and network design under budget constraints. The examples illustrate how differentiable transportation models and LLM agents can jointly democratize transportation planning and substantially reduce barriers between domain expertise and transportation decision making.

</details>

### 320. [BARTER: Compact Dynamic Sparse Training with Standard Dense Kernels](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16147v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16147

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 BARTER，一种结构化动态稀疏训练框架：保持训练张量物理紧凑以使用标准稠密核，仅依据普通反向传播中活跃单元的统计量，在各自固定全局预算下剪枝与克隆注意力头和前馈通道，并在拓扑更新时重设张量尺寸与优化器状态，从而在视觉 Transformer 分类任务上以更低训练成本保持精度。

**相关性简评：** 其「固定全局预算下按层动态重分配容量」与紧凑张量训练机制，可能为 LVR 中动态计算分配与 latent 状态容量/训练成本控制提供可供核查的效率线索，但与视觉推理主线无直接关联，需人工判断可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** BARTER: Compact Dynamic Sparse Training with Standard Dense Kernels

**abstract/A1：** Dynamic sparse training (DST) aims to reduce training costs while maintaining accuracy. Existing DST methods mask out parameters but keep matrix dimensions unchanged. Training speedups therefore depend on specialized support, such as sparse kernels. We introduce BARTER, a structured DST framework that reduces training cost using standard dense kernels by keeping training tensors physically compact while dynamically reallocating capacity across layers. Unlike existing works that require computing gradients for all parameters, BARTER instead uses statistics collected only from active units during ordinary backpropagation to prune and clone attention heads and feed-forward channels under separate fixed global budgets. At each topology update, it resizes the affected parameter tensors and remaps their optimizer states, so subsequent training steps operate directly on the compact model. Training and fine-tuning experiments with Transformer-based vision models on two image classification benchmarks at densities from $0.1$ to $0.7$ show competitive Top-1 accuracy relative to full-tensor DST baselines. On an NVIDIA L40, BARTER achieves speedups of up to $6.29\\times$ in measured training segments and reduces peak allocated GPU memory by up to $81.3\\%$ relative to these implementations. An iPhone 13 Pro Max training benchmark additionally shows a $2.78\\times$ speedup over the full-tensor DST baseline.

</details>

### 321. [Label-Centric Knowledge Retrieval for Zero-Shot Text Classification](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16182v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16182

**作者：** Daoping Wu、Dong Wang、Siyu Liu、Chen Liang、Jian Geng、Ziqi Li、Shuguang Xiong、Ying Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16182v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16182v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 SLKR 框架做零样本文本分类：离线用旗舰 LLM 为标签空间生成定义、检索关键词与易混标签对的边界规则，在线以语义加词法混合检索挑出候选标签和输入相关的少量边界规则，再由轻量 LLM 单次调用完成分类。

**相关性简评：** 其「离线构建可复用知识、在线按输入检索并限量挑选相关规则以压缩上下文」的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与上下文/计算成本权衡提供可核查的检索式线索，但不涉及多模态推理或 latent 状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Label-Centric Knowledge Retrieval for Zero-Shot Text Classification

**abstract/A1：** Flagship large language models (LLMs) offer rich general knowledge and strong reasoning capabilities, but their high inference cost and latency limit their use for large-scale data labeling. We study zero-shot text classification with semantically meaningful labels and task descriptions, without task-specific labeled examples or classifier feedback. We propose \\textbf{SLKR} (Semantic Label Knowledge Retrieval), a label-centric retrieval-augmented generation framework that separates offline knowledge construction from lightweight online inference. Offline, a flagship LLM independently generates label definitions, retrieval keywords, and boundary rules for potentially confusable label pairs, forming a reusable label-knowledge store. Because this construction operates over the label space rather than the input corpus, its one-time flagship cost can be amortized across large-scale inference. Online, hybrid semantic and lexical retrieval first identifies the top-$K$ candidate labels and then selects up to $M$ input-relevant boundary rules connecting candidate-label pairs. A lightweight LLM performs the final classification in a single call using the retrieved definitions and rules. Across three public benchmarks and a real-world multilingual book-classification dataset, SLKR achieves the best results on all four datasets with Qwen3.5-4B and on three of four with Ministral-3-3B, while using compact input contexts and no task-specific labeled examples. Boundary ablations further show that retrieving a small set of input-relevant rules preserves performance close to using all boundaries with substantially less context, supporting efficient reuse of flagship-generated label knowledge for lightweight classification.

</details>

### 322. [VGGA: Geometry-Grounded Autoencoder for Video Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16204v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16204

**作者：** Chaofan Gan、Yian Zhao、Shijie Li、Tieyuan Chen、Zicheng Zhao、Mehrtash Harandi、Weiyao Lin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16204v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16204v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 VGGA，一种几何感知的视频自编码器：在重建过程中沿结构深度、运动对应与投影变换三个维度加入几何约束，由共享时空上采样解码器联合优化几何学习与 RGB 重建，使视频 latent 空间捕获场景的 3D 结构与运动，并在多个视频生成基准上降低 gFVD。

**相关性简评：** 该文用几何约束直接塑造 latent 表示结构，可能为 LVR 中「内部状态是否保留几何与任务必要信息」提供表示层的方法线索，可供核查这类辅助监督目标能否迁移到推理期 latent 的构造。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** VGGA: Geometry-Grounded Autoencoder for Video Generation

**abstract/A1：** Autoencoders are the core component of latent video generative models, compressing high-dimensional videos into compact latent spaces for downstream generation. However, existing video autoencoders are primarily optimized for pixel-level reconstruction, providing limited supervision for learning structured latent representations. We argue that videos should not be treated merely as signals to be reconstructed, but rather as 2D projections of dynamic 3D worlds that exhibit explicit and well-structured geometric properties. Building on this insight, we propose \\textbf{V}ideo \\textbf{G}eometry \\textbf{G}rounded \\textbf{A}utoencoder (\\textbf{VGGA}), a geometry-aware video autoencoder that explicitly incorporates geometric constraints into the reconstruction process. Specifically, VGGA grounds the learned representations along three complementary geometric dimensions: \\emph{Structural Depth}, \\emph{Motion Correspondence}, and \\emph{Projective Warping}. These objectives are unified within a Video Geometry Decoder, which employs a shared spatio-temporal upsampling trunk to jointly optimize geometric learning and RGB reconstruction. Through these geometry-grounded objectives, VGGA encourages the latent representations to capture the underlying 3D structure and motion of dynamic scenes. VGGA consistently improves video generation across both geometry-centric and human-motion domains, reducing gFVD by 28.1\\% on RealEstate10K and 37.7\\% on Taichi-HD. Notably, these substantial generation improvements are achieved while maintaining comparable reconstruction quality, demonstrating that geometry-grounded representation learning yields a more effective latent space for video generation.

</details>

### 323. [MP-MNCA: Morphology-Prior Masked Neighbor Cross-Attention for Efficient Spatial Domain Identification](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16212v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16212

**作者：** Sidharthan Sivacoumar Chitra、Sanjeev Manivannan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.LG、q-bio.TO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16212v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16212v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 MP-MNCA，一种以组织学形态为连续注意力先验、在空间邻居间选择性路由分子信息的掩码邻居交叉注意力框架，用于空间转录组的空间域识别，并在 12 个 DLPFC 切片上以收敛轨迹与聚类指标同基线比较。

**相关性简评：** 用相似度先验做连续注意力偏置、按需路由邻居信息并以掩码邻居对比目标监督，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、注意力结构对 latent 表示的影响及状态更新监督提供可核查线索，但属空间组学远域，迁移可行性待确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MP-MNCA: Morphology-Prior Masked Neighbor Cross-Attention for Efficient Spatial Domain Identification

**abstract/A1：** Spatial transcriptomics jointly captures molecular state, tissue morphology, and spatial organization, yet spatial-domain methods are typically compared only at late training checkpoints, obscuring differences in convergence efficiency. We introduce MP-MNCA, a morphology-prior masked neighbor cross-attention framework that preserves the full 3,000 dimensional highly-variable-gene representation while selectively routing molecular information across spatial neighbors, with histological similarity incorporated as a continuous attention prior under a self-supervised masked neighbor-contrastive objective. Across 12 heterogeneous human dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DLPFC) sections, MP-MNCA is evaluated against established spatial-domain baselines using both convergence trajectories and epoch-wise spatial-domain visualizations. Our results show that MP-MNCA (i) reaches coherent spatial-domain structure in substantially fewer training epochs, as reflected quantitatively by convergence curves and qualitatively by progressive spatial grids, and (ii) maintains strong clustering quality, achieving a mean peak refined ARI of 0.546 versus 0.549 for the strongest baseline (STAIG), while attaining the highest mean refined NMI of 0.657 versus 0.640. Moreover, MP-MNCA outperforms STAIG on 7 of 12 sections in ARI and 11 of 12 in NMI, demonstrating faster convergence without sacrificing spatial-domain quality.

**comment/C1：** Both authors contributed equally to this work

</details>

### 324. [Look Back to Move Forward: Learning to Revisit for Agentic Compositional Image Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16224v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16224

**作者：** Zixu Wang、Xiaoran Zhao、Yahui Liu、Feng-ao Wang、Junhao Xiao、You Shu、Bing Liu、Yiting Liu、Songlei Jian、Zhiliang Tian、Dongsheng Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16224v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16224v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 GenRevisit，把 agentic 组合图像生成的动作选择扩展为「续接状态＋动作」的联合选择，让智能体从历史图像候选中挑选一个继续编辑，并以 SFT 加 agentic RL 训练；同时提出 NACA，按各动作对减少剩余目标的贡献重新分配优势，缓解 GRPO 的轨迹级粗粒度信用分配。

**相关性简评：** 其「从历史候选中选续接点」与非单调回退思路，可能为 LVR 的状态回退/停止决策提供线索；逐步 credit assignment 按贡献重分配优势的做法，可供核查是否可迁移到 latent 轨迹训练的贡献分配与监督。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Look Back to Move Forward: Learning to Revisit for Agentic Compositional Image Generation

**abstract/A1：** Text-to-image models have made remarkable progress in visual fidelity and instruction following, yet complex compositional generation remains challenging. Existing agentic approaches address this limitation through iterative generation and editing, adapting their actions based on interaction history. However, they typically fix the continuation state (i.e., the image from which refinement proceeds) to the latest image. Since iterative editing is not necessarily monotonic, the agent may continue refining from the latest image even when it has already degraded. In this work, we introduce GenRevisit, an agentic framework that extends action selection to joint continuation-state and action selection. The agent can not only use interaction history to adjust editing instructions but also select an image candidate to edit, jointly deciding where to continue from and how to refine. We train GenRevisit with SFT followed by agentic reinforcement learning. To address the coarse credit assignment of final outcome reward in GRPO, which assigns the same trajectory-level advantage to all actions, we further propose Normalized Action Credit Assignment (NACA) to redistribute positive advantage according to each action's contribution to reducing the remaining objective. On GenEval2, GenRevisit achieves GM scores of 84.3 and 74.4 with Qwen-Image-2512 and Z-Image-Turbo, surpassing the strongest baselines using the same generators by 12.7 and 10.9 points respectively. GenRevisit achieves state-of-the-art performance on GenEval, GenEval++, and GenEval2 among baselines.

</details>

### 325. [Learning to GUIDE the Group: Self-Learning LLM Facilitation Across Multi-Party Tasks](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16231v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16231

**作者：** Ziyi Liu、Tzu-Sheng Kuo、Jiale Liu、Deqing Fu、Nithum Thain、Crystal Qian

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16231v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16231v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 GUIDE 框架，收集 N=432 场由任务专用专家 LLM 引导的多方人机对话，让 LLM 从对话中归纳可执行的策略手册并用与人类标注对齐的 LLM 裁判反馈迭代精炼，得到一个跨任务的通用引导者，并在离线胜率与实时在线实验中检验其表现和交互成本。

**相关性简评：** 其「从交互轨迹中归纳策略、由 LLM 裁判迭代精炼」的自学习监督机制，可能为 LVR 的轨迹训练信号与贡献分配提供可核查的方法线索；其实时干预与回合/词数缩减指标或与动态计算和停止决策相关，但论文本身不涉及视觉或 latent 状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning to GUIDE the Group: Self-Learning LLM Facilitation Across Multi-Party Tasks

**abstract/A1：** As large language models are increasingly adopted as multi-party communication facilitators, there is a growing demand for agents capable of balancing diverse group dynamics across contexts. However, existing LLM facilitators are often fine-tuned for task-specific objectives; generalized LLM-based facilitation methods that can adapt to different types of tasks and diverse group dynamics are underdeveloped. To address this gap, we present GUIDE (Generalized Unified Intervention for Dynamic Exchanges, a framework for developing generalized LLM-based facilitators across different multi-party contexts. GUIDE evaluates facilitation across both objective task outcomes and subjective metrics, including psychological safety and perceived friction. Within this framework, we study whether LLMs can self-learn generalized facilitation strategy offline to real-time interventions. We first collect multi-party human interactions guided by task-specific expert LLM facilitators (N=432 conversations). We then employ a self-learning method in which an LLM induces an actionable strategic playbook from conversations and iteratively refines it using feedback from an LLM judge aligned with human annotators (N=20), developing a single generalized facilitator that outperforms the three task-specific expert facilitators on held-out conversations 61.4% win rate. Finally, we evaluate these improvements empirically; in a real-time online empirical study, the self-learned generalized facilitator preserves facilitator performance and group productivity, improves speaking comfort and reduces interpersonal friction, while using 24.7% fewer turns and 29.0% fewer words than the expert prompts. These findings provide empirical evidence that LLMs can learn generalizable, task-agnostic social facilitation from task-specific human interactions, on-par with hand-crafted task-specific prompts across diverse group settings.

</details>

### 326. [Seg2Click: Learning Pixel-Level Action Masks for GUI Visual Grounding](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16234v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16234

**作者：** Jingchao Wang、Dingjiang Huang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16234v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16234v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文把 GUI visual grounding 重构为「可执行区域」预测：在仅有 bounding-box 监督下预测可点击区域掩码，再用确定性规则由掩码推出最终点击坐标，从而摆脱单点监督的歧义与视觉 token 网格的分辨率限制，并在多个 backbone 与 ScreenSpot 系列基准上验证。

**相关性简评：** 文中指出 patch 级 grounding 的空间判断被视觉 token 足迹（跨目标、邻近控件与背景）所绑定，这与 LVR 关心的视觉证据粒度、内部状态是否保留几何与任务必要信息存在可核查的联系，其掩码式区域监督或可作为证据筛选与表示粒度的借鉴线索，但属推测，需读原文确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Seg2Click: Learning Pixel-Level Action Masks for GUI Visual Grounding

**abstract/A1：** Visual grounding is a central challenge for GUI agents, requiring an instruction to be mapped to a target within a crowded screenshot. Coordinate generation with single-point supervision reduces a spatially extended target to one position, despite the presence of many valid click locations. Region-based patch scoring alleviates this ambiguity, but its spatial decisions remain tied to visual-token footprints that may span the target, neighboring controls, and background. To address these limitations, we propose Seg2Click, which reformulates GUI grounding as executable-region prediction: identifying where a click can validly execute the given instruction. Using bounding-box supervision, Seg2Click predicts an executable-region mask and computes the final click point through a deterministic rule. This formulation captures the spatial extent of valid click locations and enables finer localization beyond the visual-token grid, making it well suited to small, densely arranged controls without requiring a verifier or zoom-in pass. Experiments across five backbone configurations from two model families demonstrate the effectiveness of Seg2Click. Seg2Click-9B achieves 92.06\\%, 94.10\\%, and 55.22\\% on ScreenSpot, ScreenSpot-v2, and ScreenSpot-Pro, respectively, while matched-backbone comparisons show improvements over both coordinate generation and patch-based grounding. Code will be available at https://github.com/jcwang0602/Seg2Click.

**comment/C1：** 19 pages

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 MFlowHOI：用接触感知的多部件 RVQVAE 将身体、手、物体与接触信号编入结构化 latent 空间，再由 ST-DiT 在一次 MeanFlow 评估中直接生成完整的人–物交互轨迹。

**相关性简评：** 其多部件结构化 latent 加共享解码器的设计，可供核查 LVR 中「表示是否保留任务必要信息、避免信息坍缩」，而一步 MeanFlow 替代迭代扩散，可能为 parallel 式 latent 推理状态的生成与更新成本权衡提供线索；但属动作生成领域，迁移性需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MFlowHOI: Whole-Body Human-Object Interaction Generation via Part-Aware MeanFlow

**abstract/A1：** Whole-body human-object interaction (HOI) generation requires coordinating body and finger motion, object trajectories, and time-varying contacts. Existing methods typically rely on iterative diffusion or test-time optimization, resulting in high inference costs. Direct one-step generation is highly desired in downstream applications due to efficient inference. However, it is challenging because these HOI components differ substantially in structure and scale. We present MFlowHOI, an efficient one-step framework for whole-body HOI generation. A Contact-Aware Multipart RVQVAE organizes body, hand, object, and contact signals into a structured latent space, with a shared decoder preserving their global coordination. An ST-DiT then models temporal and cross-part dependencies in this space and generates a complete interaction in a single MeanFlow evaluation. Predicted object-local contact correspondences further enable geometric refinement and interaction-preserving transfer to photorealistic 3D Gaussian avatars with different body proportions. Experiments demonstrate that MFlowHOI outperforms existing base generators in motion quality and text alignment while substantially reducing inference time.

**comment/C1：** 9 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables

</details>

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** EgoWholeView: Camera-Only Head-Mounted Capture of Body and Bimanual Hand Motion for Embodied Demonstrations

**abstract/A1：** Head-mounted body and bimanual motion capture supports self-avatars, teleoperation, and embodied demonstrations. However, a single egocentric camera is vulnerable to a limited field of view, scale ambiguity, and hand-object occlusion. We present EgoWholeView, a wearable capture system of six synchronized wide-angle RGB cameras with a role-specialized pipeline. The outward views localize the rig in a world frame, while an overlapping downward pair independently predicts SMPL-X body and MANO hand parameters. Both predictors are adapted to egocentric fisheye data. To combine the two, reliability cues measured from the predictions themselves weight the fusion of body and hand joint rotations, while shape is aggregated across views and frames. The pair's baseline fixes metric scale, and triangulation recovers root translation. Relative to monocular prediction, fusion reduces PA-MPJPE by 3.7% for the body and 11.2% for the hands, and temporal refinement lowers angular-acceleration magnitude by 32.2% and 31.0%, respectively. On our six-camera recording, the pipeline produces body and hand states in a shared world frame using benchmark-fitted gates without retuning, and temporal refinement lowers hand acceleration magnitude by 41.08%. Using only RGB cameras and no third-person view, EgoWholeView offers a low-cost, portable route to egocentric interaction data.

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Error Correction in Trained TTT Layers

**abstract/A1：** Test-time-training (TTT) layers update fast-weight memory while processing an input sequence. A gradient-based update, however, does not by itself establish how the memory revises an existing association. We study the structure and empirical role of prediction-derived updates in released TTT implementations. For dot-product objectives, we characterize the absence of a prediction-error residual and establish conditions under which inner-loop ascent and descent are equivalent after reparameterization. For the LayerNorm-based squared-error objective used by TTT-Linear and TTT-MLP, we derive the inner gradient and identify a prediction-derived component that cancels at the released initialization in the zero-epsilon limit. We then measure the full normalized prediction's contribution on three trained checkpoints. Removing this contribution while retaining the LayerNorm Jacobian gives a mean gradient norm ratio of 0.25 to 0.32 across the models. On 100,303 tokens from War and Peace, the same intervention with local per-token norm matching raises perplexity by 2.8-2.9% on TTT-Linear-760M and 1.3B, whereas freezing all fast-weight updates raises it by factors of 4.2-4.5. Separate synthetic tests illustrate the dependence of plain delta-rule overwriting on step size. The results distinguish a prediction-derived update from its behavioral value and show why implementation analysis and live interventions are both needed to assess test-time memory.

**comment/C1：** 13 pages, 3 figures. Code and saved results included as ancillary material and at https://github.com/aliceyh7/ttt-error-correction

</details>

### 330. [A Survey of Flow Matching in Reinforcement Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16275v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16275

**作者：** Nabuat Zaman Nahim、Fairoz Nower Khan、Peizhong Ju

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16275v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16275v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 这是一篇 Flow Matching 用于强化学习的综述，按「建模的目标分布」（动作策略、价值批评器、转移动态）与「RL 信号整合机制」（能量加权回归、flow-based 策略梯度、GRPO 等）两条轴梳理文献，并与 Gaussian、diffusion 基线作对比、列出开放问题。

**相关性简评：** 论文本身面向连续控制策略学习，不含视觉或多模态推理；但其用速度场与 ODE 确定性传输生成样本、并强调推理延迟更低的机制，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的生成与更新（如替代 diffusion 式解码）提供效率与训练监督线索，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A Survey of Flow Matching in Reinforcement Learning

**abstract/A1：** Flow Matching (FM) has recently emerged as a principled and efficient generative modeling framework for reinforcement learning (RL), enabling expressive, multimodal policy parameterizations via deterministic probability transport. Compared to diffusion-based policies that rely on stochastic denoising chains, FM uses sampling based on ordinary differential equations (ODEs), with learned velocity fields, which can substantially reduce inference latency and simplify the incorporation of RL objectives. As research in flow-based RL rapidly accelerates across offline continuous control, online fine-tuning, and foundation model alignment, the literature has become highly fragmented. In this survey, we provide a comprehensive taxonomy of flow-matching approaches in reinforcement learning. We organize the literature along two axes: the target distribution being modeled (e.g., action policies, value critics, transition dynamics) and the mechanism of RL signal integration (e.g., energy-weighted regression, flow-based policy gradients, and group relative policy optimization). Furthermore, we survey emerging frontiers such as discrete and non-Euclidean action spaces, provide a systematic comparative analysis against Gaussian and diffusion baselines, and outline critical open problems. Ultimately, this survey serves as a foundational roadmap for the next generation of generative reinforcement learning and alignment.

**comment/C1：** 52 pages. Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 2026. Survey Certification. Reviewed on OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=P6e5IC4gPe

</details>

### 331. [REVEAL: Reverse Engineering Agentic Latents from Frontier-Model Traces](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16288v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16288

**作者：** Yuetian Du、Meng Wang、Yucheng Wang、Zhangzhe Chen、Wei Wang、Boyu Yang、Weiqi Zhai、Bing Zhao、Ming Kong、Zhan Zhou、Jie Liu、Qiang Zhu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16288v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16288v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** REVEAL 提出从前沿模型的文本智能体轨迹中「反向工程」出 agentic latents（锚定状态与反馈—响应循环的动态画像），用成功/失败 rollout 的响应转移对比得到目标模型专属的 steering 方向，在冻结智能体每次响应前施加，无需训练；在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 与带工具的 HLE 上报告优于未修改智能体。

**相关性简评：** 该工作处理的是纯文本智能体而非视觉/多模态推理，但其由轨迹对比提取 latent 状态画像并在推理期注入 steering 方向的训练无关做法，可能为 LVR 的 latent 状态提取、轨迹监督与贡献分配提供方法线索，可供核查是否迁移到多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** REVEAL: Reverse Engineering Agentic Latents from Frontier-Model Traces

**abstract/A1：** Frontier LLM agents perform complex interactive tasks, but their inference costs motivate transferring their experience to smaller open-source agents. Distillation and latent communication typically require target-model training or access to source-model internals. We study how textual frontier-model trajectories can provide reusable local controls for a frozen agent. Inspired by protocol reverse engineering, we introduce $\\textit{Agentic Latents}$, comprising anchored states and dynamic profiles of feedback--response cycles elicited by replay in the target model. Our training-free framework, $\\textbf{REVEAL}$ ($\\textbf{REV}$erse $\\textbf{E}$ngineering $\\textbf{A}$gentic $\\textbf{L}$atents), uses these profiles and trajectory outcomes to match and select local events from successful and failed rollouts of the same task and source model. Their response-transition contrasts yield a target-specific steering direction, applied before each response. Within-benchmark evaluations on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and Humanity's Last Exam with tools report higher accuracy than unmodified agents across three targets. Representation analyses and behavioral case studies support reusing frontier-model experience as local activation control.

</details>

### 332. [Fast Quantized Johnson$-$Lindenstrauss Transforms](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16289v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16289

**作者：** Angelos Korakitis、Vasileios Nakos

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.DS

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16289v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16289v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究用随机 Hadamard 变换的组合替代 Quantized Johnson-Lindenstrauss 中的稠密高斯投影，提出两种构造：一是在第二阶段使用高斯对角并加入高斯抖动以平滑量化器，二是插入随机置换以正则化高斯测量的协方差结构，并给出嵌入维度与 O(d log d) 运行时间保证。

**相关性简评：** QJL 以 1-bit 非对称量化压缩 KV cache 并近似保持注意力所需内积，其结构化投影与量化误差可能影响缓存中 latent 表示的保真度及注意力结构，可供核查压缩对内部状态信息保留程度的影响。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Fast Quantized Johnson$-$Lindenstrauss Transforms

**abstract/A1：** Quantization has emerged as one of the primary techniques for reducing the memory footprint of large language models during inference. A prominent example is Quantized Johnson$-$Lindenstrauss (QJL), which compresses KV caches using 1-bit asymmetric quantization while approximately preserving the inner products required by the attention mechanism. Recent theoretical and practical work aims at replacing the dense Gaussian projections used by the aforementioned transforms with more structured embeddings $-$ such as compositions of randomized Hadamard transforms $-$ while retaining the same embedding dimension. In this paper, we introduce two constructions based on a composition of randomized Hadamard transforms, albeit with a Gaussian rather than Rademacher diagonal in the second stage. The first adds Gaussian dithering to smooth the quantizer, while the second inserts a random permutation to regularize the covariance structure of the resulting Gaussian measurements. We prove embedding-dimension and running-time guarantees analogous to those of Fast JL in the non-quantized setting. The first construction achieves $m=O(\\varepsilon^{-2}\\log^2(d/δ))$, while the second achieves $m=O(\\varepsilon^{-2}\\log(d/δ))$ under a restriction on $m$. Both constructions can be applied in $O(d\\log d)$ time.

</details>

### 333. [FON: A Draft-Revise Dual-Organ Language Model without Sequence-Level Quadratic Attention](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16301v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16301

**作者：** Helong Hu、Hongdan Pan、Shuiqing Hu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16301v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16301v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 FON，把同一权重栈分化为「起草器官」（可学习多抽头延迟 + 内容自适应递归，因果、O(S) 训练、O(1) 解码状态）与「修订器官」（通过多尺度 ripple 核与弱门控重处理已写前缀、不产生输出），在 30M/70M 规模上报告 WikiText-103 困惑度、长度外推与域内 infilling 的收益与代价。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本生成架构，与视觉推理无直接关系；但其「生成通道 vs 非生成式修订通道」的双器官划分、可学习延迟递归与弱门控回读前缀，可能为 LVR 的 latent 状态更新与验证/修正通路设计提供借鉴线索，可供核查其 O(1) 状态与递归机制能否迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FON: A Draft-Revise Dual-Organ Language Model without Sequence-Level Quadratic Attention

**abstract/A1：** Self-attention assigns two functions to one mechanism-where to read and how to mix-at the price of O(L^2) training, an O(T) decode state, and position signals bound to the training length. Existing attention-free alternatives all optimize the single function of generation. We propose FON (Fusion-Organ Network), which differentiates one weight stack into a drafting organ (multi-tap learnable delays + content-adaptive recursion; causal, O(S) training, O(1) decode state, no sequence-level quadratic attention) and a revision organ that re-processes the written prefix through multi-scale ripple kernels injected via weak gates, never generating. At 30M parameters, iso-parameter and iso-token budget, FON reaches perplexity 131.03 on WikiText-103, beating Transformer (197.73) and Mamba2 (152.53); the advantage persists under all depth-aligned baselines and at the 70M tier (-20.8%). At 8x length extrapolation FON degrades by ~8-9% without positional-encoding engineering, between ALiBi and RoPE. The revision channel provides a structural pathway for in-domain infilling that causal architectures lack in principle (+19% over on-demand coupling), at a perplexity cost indistinguishable within measurement precision. We report all costs and boundaries: impaired long-range retrieval, synthetic-task disadvantages, weaker out-of-domain code infilling than a same-recipe Transformer, and a 6.5-12.3x wall-clock gap.

**comment/C1：** 24 pages, 14 figures, 9 tables

</details>

### 334. [RAR: Rate-Adaptive Rollout for Time-Consistent Interactive World Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16302v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16302

**作者：** Yaoyang Liu、Dongyu Yan、Yihua Du、Shengju Qian、Zeke Xie、Xin Wang、Ying-Cong Chen、Long Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16302v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16302v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对视频交互式世界模型中「时间率耦合」问题（运行时生成速率与训练时时间率不一致、且单一速率在时间粒度与物理跨度间存在取舍），提出 RAR 框架：以 Stride-RoPE 将不同采样率下的 latent 帧对齐到统一物理时间坐标，配合多 stride 视频采样，实现可控多速率 rollout、在线速率切换与未见速率泛化。

**相关性简评：** 其「统一时间坐标下对齐多速率 latent 帧＋多 stride 联合训练」可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的位置／深度编码、动态计算调度与长度（跨度）泛化提供可核查的方法线索，但原文面向视频世界模型，未涉及推理任务或答案对 latent 的使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RAR: Rate-Adaptive Rollout for Time-Consistent Interactive World Models

**abstract/A1：** Video-based interactive world models aim to enable real-time, user-controllable environments. Yet most existing systems are trained and rolled out at a fixed temporal rate, limiting both runtime-rate adaptation and physical-horizon coverage -- a limitation we term temporal-rate coupling. Specifically, when runtime generation throughput differs from the learned temporal rate, the generated world evolves unintentionally more slowly or quickly. Moreover, using a single temporal rate imposes an inherent trade-off between temporal granularity and physical horizon: higher rates capture finer motion but cover a shorter duration under a fixed context window. To address both limitations, we introduce Rate-Adaptive Rollout (RAR), a framework that enables interactive world models to roll out at controllable temporal rates. At its core, Stride-RoPE aligns latent frames sampled at different rates on a shared physical-time coordinate, enabling consistent multi-rate rollout, unseen-rate generalization, and online rate switching without discarding history. Meanwhile, RAR uses multi-stride video sampling to enable joint learning of fine-grained dynamics and long-horizon evolution. Across action- and camera-controlled environments, RAR achieves temporally consistent multi-rate rollout and online rate switching while preserving high-rate generation quality and extending physical horizons under matched training budgets. RAR also transfers to pretrained world models while preserving perceptual quality.

**comment/C1：** Project page: https://hkust-longgroup.github.io/RAR

</details>

### 335. [HyWe: Unifying Search and Operation for Real-World Hybrid Web Tasks](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16319v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16319

**作者：** Zijian Cai、Haowei Liu、Kailai Chen、Lin Peng、Cong Wan、Ziqi Zhang、Chunfeng Yuan、Bing Li、Weiming Hu、Haiyang Xu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16319v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16319v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 HyWe：在同一模型与轨迹内用两种模式（搜索式与操作式）统一网页信息获取与页面交互，靠显式切换和共享历史衔接子目标；并用自动流水线 HyWeCollector 合成混合轨迹训练 35B 网页智能体，同时发布 HyWeBench 评测基准。

**相关性简评：** 其「显式模式切换 + 共享历史跨子目标累积证据」的决策与轨迹合成流程，可能提供训练数据构造与状态/证据在模式间复用的线索，可供核查是否类比 THINK/LOOK/STOP 式的能力选择与证据筛选，但论文本身未涉及 latent 推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** HyWe: Unifying Search and Operation for Real-World Hybrid Web Tasks

**abstract/A1：** Real-world hybrid web tasks need both information gathering and page interaction, yet search-based and operation-based agents are developed and evaluated separately. To bridge this gap, we introduce HyWe, a framework that unifies both capabilities within one model and trajectory. Its two modes use dedicated prompts and tool sets to sustain sub-goal execution; explicit switching selects the needed capability, and shared history lets each mode build on the other's findings. To provide demonstrations of these behaviors, we develop HyWeCollector, a fully automatic pipeline that uses task prototypes, four switching patterns, and multi-agent synthesis to produce verified hybrid trajectories. We train HyWe-35B on these demonstrations to unify efficient information gathering and browser interaction in a single 35B web agent. To evaluate hybrid task completion, we introduce HyWeBench: 100 human-written tasks on websites distinct from training, with human-written sub-goal checklists and an outcome-based evaluation pipeline. Hybrid training enables HyWe-35B to achieve 47.0% success on this benchmark, improving on the untrained base model by 19.0 percentage points and outperforming existing search-based and operation-based agents. Even before training, the same base model solves 28.0% of tasks with HyWe, versus 11.0% with all tools under one prompt. Beyond hybrid tasks, HyWe-35B achieves 59.0% and 88.3% success on Online-Mind2Web and WebVoyager, outperforming existing open-source baselines and cutting action cost per successful task by 48.3% and 51.9% compared with Fara-7B.

### 336. [BAT3R: Robust Online 3D Reconstruction with Bayesian Adaptive State Updates](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16330v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16330

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16330v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16330v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对流式在线3D重建中长期序列误差累积问题，提出免训练的贝叶斯自适应框架 BAT3R：用状态创新门控将状态演化锚定到几何初始化以抑制表示漂移，并以 Kalman 滤波式递归推断，结合信息论增益与 cross-attention 空间相关性对历史状态与新观测做非对称融合。

**相关性简评：** 其「门控锚定 + 可靠性加权状态融合」的递归状态更新机制，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的何时更新、视觉证据筛选与长序列漂移抑制提供可核查的方法线索，但需跨域验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** BAT3R: Robust Online 3D Reconstruction with Bayesian Adaptive State Updates

**abstract/A1：** Feed-forward transformer models have driven remarkable progress in 3D vision,yet their quadratic complexity renders them impractical for long video sequences. Streaming 3D reconstruction addresses this bottleneck by processing frames sequen?tially with constant memory. However, existing recurrent architectures inevitably suffer from progressive degradation over long sequences, as they fail to account for the intrinsic reliability of observations and the accumulated confidence of the historical state, leading to severe error accumulation. To address these issues, we introduce BAT3R, a training-free Bayesian adaptation framework comprising two synergistic modules: State Innovation Gating (SIG) and Bayesian-guided Adaptive State Updating (BASU). SIG acts as a distributional regularizer that anchors state evolution to its geometric initialization, effectively arresting representational drift during long-term inference. Building on this, BASU reformulates state update as a recursive Bayesian inference process within a Kalman filtering framework. By jointly modeling the temporal reliability of observations via information-theoretic gain and spatial relevance via cross-attention maps, BASU achieves an asymmetric spatio-temporal state fusion: well-consolidated historical regions are protected from redundant updates, while genuinely novel scene content is aggressively incor?porated. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks (7-Scenes, TUM, ScanNet, KITTI, etc.) demonstrate that BAT3R consistently outperforms state-of-the-art online 3D reconstruction methods, with the most significant gains observed on long sequences and complex scenes.

</details>

### 337. [WorldRoPE: Probabilistic World-Centric Rotary Embedding for Multi-View Attention](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16337v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16337

**作者：** Mijeong Kim、Kyujin Lim、Bohyung Han

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16337v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16337v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 WorldRoPE：一种面向多视图注意力的概率化世界坐标旋转位置编码。它把每个 patch token 反投影为共享世界坐标系中的一组体素高斯基元，用以表达多种深度假设、深度不确定性及 patch 视锥的空间延展，并将旋转算子在该分布上闭式积分，按混合权重与协方差衰减调制注意力，使注意力对不确定的关键位置更不敏感；当支撑退化为点时还原为确定性 RoPE。

**相关性简评：** 用「多假设 + 不确定性协方差」刻画视觉证据在世界坐标中的 latent 表示并按不确定性加权注意力，可能为 LVR 中如何保留几何/任务必要信息、按证据可靠性筛选视觉旁路提供可核查的方法线索，但该文面向新视角合成与三维重建，未涉及推理期 latent 状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** WorldRoPE: Probabilistic World-Centric Rotary Embedding for Multi-View Attention

**abstract/A1：** Rotary Positional Embedding (RoPE) is widely used to encode relative positions in Transformers. In multi-view settings, however, patch coordinates are defined independently in each image: the same 3D point can therefore have different coordinates across views, making them insufficient for establishing cross-view correspondences. We introduce WorldRoPE, a probabilistic world-centric RoPE for multi-view attention. At each layer, WorldRoPE back-projects each patch token into a set of volumetric Gaussian primitives in a shared world frame. These primitives represent multiple plausible 3D supports for a token, jointly capturing alternative depth hypotheses, depth uncertainty, and the finite spatial extent of its patch frustum. When a key token's support is projected into a query view, it induces a distribution over where that key may appear in the query image. WorldRoPE integrates the rotary operator over this distribution in closed form, combining rotations at the projected primitive centers according to their mixture weights with covariance-dependent attenuation. This makes attention less sensitive to uncertain key locations in the query view, without rasterizing or warping token features. The formulation reduces to deterministic RoPE when the support collapses to a point. Across layers, the predicted geometry guides cross-view attention, while the updated features refine the geometry used at the next layer. Experiments on novel view synthesis, depth estimation, and 3D geometry reconstruction demonstrate the effectiveness of WorldRoPE for multi-view Transformers.

**comment/C1：** Project page: https://cv.snu.ac.kr/research/WorldRoPE

</details>

### 338. [Efficient Multi-Agent Reasoning via Confidence-Guided Adaptive Debate](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16343v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16343

**作者：** Seungdong Yoa、Ye Seul Sim、Suhee Yoon、Sanghyu Yoon、Dongmin Kim、Soonyoung Lee、Bumsoo Kim、Junhyun Lee

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16343v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16343v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 LASE：一种以 leader 为中心的多智能体辩论框架，仅依据置信度在「非中性」情形下选择性地启动交互，并用非对称的 leader-supporter 结构实现有向信息流动与信号放大，其余情况退回简单聚合，从而以接近单智能体的 token 成本取得多智能体级推理表现。

**相关性简评：** 其「何时启动交互」的置信度判据与 LVR 中动态计算、THINK/STOP 决策有方法上的可类比线索，非对称信息流也可能供核查证据筛选与编排；但该工作面向纯文本多智能体辩论，不涉及视觉状态或 latent 推理，联系属推测性迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Efficient Multi-Agent Reasoning via Confidence-Guided Adaptive Debate

**abstract/A1：** Multi-agent debate has shown promise for improving the reasoning of large language models, yet recent theory suggests its benefits are highly regime-dependent. While interaction can amplify informative signals under corrective conditions, symmetric debate dynamics are neutral in expectation, often making majority voting preferable. We reconcile these views by arguing that debate is effective only when invoked at the right time and with appropriate structure. Based on this insight, we propose LASE: Leader-Adaptive Structured Engagement, a leader-centric multi-agent debate framework that selectively engages interaction only in non-neutral regimes. LASE introduces an asymmetric leader-supporter architecture that enables directed information flow and selective signal amplification, while defaulting to simple aggregation otherwise. Experiments across diverse reasoning benchmarks show that LASE achieves multi-agent-level performance with near single-agent token cost, substantially improving efficiency over static debate and voting baselines.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at ICML 2026

</details>

### 339. [Rescuing Points Trapped Inside Incorrect Decision Regions: A target for Evaluating and Improving Forward-Forward Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16347v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16347

**作者：** Alireza Rahmansetayesh、Amirhossein Yousefiramandi、Maxwell Spiridonov、Sumit Raut、Kent Ziti、Pierre Baldi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16347v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16347v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文指出以线性探针准确率评估 Forward-Forward 等层局部学习会高估其贡献——未训练卷积网络的探针已远超随机水平；为此提出以 Boundary Proximity Index（按类质心归一化的多类间隔）逐样本分析七个 Forward-Forward 变体，考察哪些点被训练真正「救回」。

**相关性简评：** 其「超越准确率、按间隔与质心参照逐样本诊断内部表示增益」的分析范式，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态是否保留任务必要信息、以及性能提升是否真来自训练而非探针或先验。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Rescuing Points Trapped Inside Incorrect Decision Regions: A target for Evaluating and Improving Forward-Forward Learning

**abstract/A1：** Forward-Forward learning replaces end-to-end backpropagation with local, layer-wise training objectives. Its variants are evaluated primarily by classification accuracy, often measured with linear probes trained on their representations. We show that this evaluation can over-credit the learning method: a linear probe on the representations of an untrained convolutional neural network already reaches accuracy well above chance. Moreover, a single accuracy value does not reveal which datapoints become correctly classified after training and which remain misclassified. To examine what learning contributes beyond the random, untrained baseline, we present an analysis methodology built on the Boundary Proximity Index (BPI), a multiclass margin normalized by a class-centroid reference. We apply our analysis to seven Forward-Forward variants and related layer-local methods and find that initially misclassified points near the probe's decision boundary generally have higher rescue rates than those farther inside incorrect decision regions. Rescue rates vary substantially across methods, with some correcting a substantial fraction of these deeply embedded points. Together, these analyses offer a way to evaluate representation learning beyond accuracy and identify the rescue of points far inside incorrect decision regions as a target for improving local learning methods.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 LoongSage：面向 LLM 智能体任务的全异步 RL 训练框架，核心约 14K 行，包含统一白盒/黑盒智能体的 AgentFlow 执行范式、约束轨迹陈旧的滑动窗口策略、拓扑感知的 TransferMesh 权重同步，以及支持多教师 on-policy 蒸馏的 Teacher Manager，并在四次完整训练中验证奖励与硬件利用率。

**相关性简评：** 论文不涉及视觉细节保留或 latent 状态生成，但其轨迹级监督、陈旧度约束与多教师蒸馏的工程做法，可能可供核查 LVR 轨迹训练、贡献分配与教师监督的可靠性，属较间接的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A Production-Grade, High-Efficiency Agentic RL Framework for Frontier LLMs with Validated Recipes

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a critical phase in the post-training pipeline of large language models (LLMs). As the frontier of LLM capabilities shifts from static reasoning to agentic tasks--characterized by external tool invocation, multi-turn interactions, and long-horizon decision-making--existing mainstream RL frameworks have grown increasingly unwieldy, raising the overhead of adoption, usage, and debugging. To address these challenges, we present LoongSage, an agent-native, fully asynchronous RL framework with a lightweight core of roughly 14K lines of code. Built upon Megatron for distributed training and SGLang for high-throughput inference, LoongSage centralizes orchestration within a single controller process and encapsulates all GPU-resident components as Ray actors. It introduces AgentFlow, a unified execution paradigm that orchestrates both white-box and black-box agents. For asynchronous execution, it integrates sliding-window strategies that bound trajectory staleness, and employs TransferMesh, a topology-aware synchronization mechanism that routes weights after each step over the fastest transport available to each receiver. Beyond agentic RL, LoongSage incorporates a memory-efficient Teacher Manager that decouples the scaling of teacher models from GPU memory constraints, natively supporting Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation. Extensive evaluations across four complete training runs, spanning complex reinforcement learning and multi-teacher distillation, demonstrate that task rewards improve steadily while the train-inference gap is kept under continuous control, and the fully asynchronous pipeline removes synchronous idle bubbles, sustaining hardware utilization.

</details>

### 341. [From Sound to Sense: An Anatomy of Semantic Supervision for Speech-Driven Visual Grounding in Remote Sensing Imagery](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16364v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16364

**作者：** Zhongyu Pang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16364v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16364v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 SemEcho，将冻结的 Whisper 语音通路接入 VLTVG 定位宿主并共享解码器，用线性语义探针解剖特征模仿蒸馏、词级 CTC 监督、两阶段 ASR 预训练三种语义注入通道，并对比直接音频对齐与 ASR 级联，同时发布 Audio-DIOR-R 等音频版遥感定位数据。

**相关性简评：** 同宿主文本上界与线性语义探针的诊断设计，可能可供核查 LVR 中语义或视觉信息是否真正进入内部状态并影响输出，但任务是语音驱动的遥感定位，与 latent 推理状态生成无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** From Sound to Sense: An Anatomy of Semantic Supervision for Speech-Driven Visual Grounding in Remote Sensing Imagery

**abstract/A1：** Speech-driven visual grounding in remote sensing (RSVG) removes the typing bottleneck of text-based interaction and is intended to preserve prosodic intent, enabling hands-free target acquisition in time-critical missions. The direct-audio paradigm, mapping raw speech straight to a bounding box and bypassing automatic speech recognition (ASR), was recently adopted by RSTalker, but what such grounders actually learn about language remains unmeasured. SemEcho grafts a frozen Whisper speech pathway onto a VLTVG grounding host so that speech and text share one decoder, making the paired text, free by construction since speech corpora in this task are synthesized from DIOR-RSVG expressions, a training-time teacher and a fair, same-host text upper bound. On this instrument we dissect three semantic injection channels (feature-mimicry distillation, word-level CTC supervision, and two-stage ASR pretraining) with linear semantic probes, and release Audio-DIOR-R (80,973 training clips; 10 timbres x K=3; Qwen3-TTS synthesis with online sox noise lambda in \[0, 0.4\]) and Audio-DIOR-Comp, a re-split holding out 17 attribute-category combinations under a 2x2 acoustic-semantic protocol. Our anatomy yields four findings. (i) Whether direct alignment beats a domain-trained ASR cascade is decided by recognizer quality: against a weak in-domain cascade (CTC 0.53) direct wins by 9.0 Acc@0.5 points with transcription errors concentrated on spatial-relation words, but a strong in-domain cascade (CTC 0.029) reaches the text upper bound (80.8 vs. 81.0) and beats even the strongest direct model by 8.8 points; the anti-ASR premise holds only against weak recognizers.

</details>

### 342. [LoopQuant: Accurate and Efficient Post-Training Quantization for Looped Transformers](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16368v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16368

**作者：** Zhixiong Zhao、Zukang Xu、Xing Hu、Lifeng Liu、Guangyu Sun、Dawei Yang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16368v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16368v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 LoopQuant，一个面向循环复用共享模块的 LoopLM 的低比特训练后量化框架，通过跨循环表示规范化、按循环的精度分配与任务空间校准来缓解递归误差传播。

**相关性简评：** 原文对跨循环激活动态、逐循环敏感度与递归误差传播的刻画，可能为 LVR 中循环式 latent 状态更新、表示稳定性及不同深度贡献分配提供方法线索；但研究对象是纯文本量化的部署效率，与视觉多模态推理无直接关联，需核查其分析是否可迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LoopQuant: Accurate and Efficient Post-Training Quantization for Looped Transformers

**abstract/A1：** Looped Language Models (LoopLMs) improve parameter efficiency by recursively reusing shared Transformer modules, yet their repeated computation over evolving recurrent states poses new challenges for low-bit deployment. Existing post-training quantization (PTQ) methods, largely designed for feed-forward Transformers, fail to account for cross-loop activation dynamics, heterogeneous loop sensitivity, and recursive error propagation, leading to substantial performance degradation at low precision. To address these challenges, we propose LoopQuant, a loop-aware PTQ framework for accurate and efficient low-bit quantization of LoopLMs. LoopQuant is built on three core components: 1) Cross-Loop Distribution Canonicalization (CLDC) learns a shared quantization-friendly representation across recurrent states while preserving parameter sharing; 2) Interaction-Aware Loop-wise Precision Allocation (ILPA) allocates activation precision under a fixed bit budget by modeling task-level loop sensitivity and cross-loop interactions; and 3) Loop-Conditioned Task Calibration (LCTC) further aligns quantized inference with the low-bit recursive trajectory through lightweight task-space calibration. Extensive experiments across LoopLM architectures demonstrate that LoopQuant consistently outperforms existing low-bit PTQ methods. On Ouro-2.6B, LoopQuant under W4A4 surpasses all W4A8 baselines in performance, while reducing model memory by 65.3% with only 3.4% additional storage overhead over naive INT4 and achieving a 1.7 times decoding speedup over BF16. These results demonstrate a strong balance among accuracy, compression, and inference efficiency, providing a practical and deployment-friendly solution for low-bit LoopLM inference. The code is available at \[https://github.com/Kishon-zzx/LoopQuant\].

</details>

**内容简述：** 论文提出递归环境缩放 RES，在不改变任务目标与完成条件的前提下改写 benchmark 环境的信息访问、资源关系与执行依赖，用执行级检查筛选候选并跨轮继承，从而生成更难的配对环境用于 agent 评测与轨迹收集。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接关联，但其用环境变异控制信息可及性与依赖关系、并据此生成难度阶梯与训练轨迹的做法，可能可供核查 VLM 推理训练中轨迹监督与难度／长度泛化数据构造的线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Recursive Environment Scaling for General Long-Horizon Agents

**abstract/A1：** We study environment scaling as a way to increase agent-benchmark difficulty while holding core task objectives fixed. Our framework, Recursive Environment Scaling (RES), transforms existing benchmark environments while preserving their objectives and completion requirements. A proposer changes information access, resource relations, and execution dependencies; execution-grounded checks validate the resulting candidate, and accepted changes are inherited across rounds. This produces related environments for paired evaluation and training-trajectory collection. Experiments on 294 initial tasks from three benchmarks show lower task success for all six evaluation models, with decreases of 57.14--77.14 percentage points on Claw-Eval-Live. With equal trajectory counts and identical optimization settings, fine-tuning on RES trajectories outperforms original-trajectory SFT in all nine model--benchmark comparisons by 7.00--14.61 percentage points. Ablations identify recursive inheritance and dependency composition as important contributors to increased difficulty. Together, these results support environment scaling for both agent evaluation and training.

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16415

**作者：** Zhimeng Jiang、Yuening Li、Ruixiao Sun、Yuanzhen Lin、Kun Jin、Chuan He、Liang Liu

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 CDS：在工业短视频排序系统中把同一个特征交互块重复迭代、参数跨迭代共享，使「链长」（迭代次数）成为不增加参数的新扩展维度，并用链内残差连接稳定优化；在生产系统上比较压缩与质量扩展两种 regime 的离线在线效果、训练吞吐与延迟构成。

**相关性简评：** 参数共享的循环迭代、以迭代次数作为额外建模容量、以及残差稳定深层循环的做法，可能为 LVR 中 loop 式 latent 状态更新的深度/长度扩展与训练稳定性提供可核查线索，但其任务与视觉或多模态推理无直接关系，深度收益是否源于参数复用之外也需另行核实。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Chain Dimension Scaling: Communication-Efficient Loop-Style Scaling for Industrial Short-Video Ranking

**abstract/A1：** Industrial recommendation rankers keep scaling in width and depth to billions of parameters, but this increasingly incurs costs in parameter growth, distributed communication overhead, and training inefficiency. We introduce \\underline{C}hain \\underline{D}imension \\underline{S}caling (CDS), a scaling strategy orthogonal to width and depth. CDS repeatedly applies a single feature-interaction block with parameters shared across iterations, so the number of iterations (the chain length) becomes a new scaling dimension that adds no parameters. A lightweight intra-chain residual connection stabilizes optimization and improves quality. CDS enables two regimes. In the \\emph{compression regime}, shallow blocks with a longer chain match deeper baselines with fewer parameters and faster training; in the \\emph{quality-scaling regime}, increasing chain length under a fixed parameter budget yields consistent offline and online gains, suggesting the chain dimension adds modeling capacity beyond parameter reuse. We evaluate CDS in a large-scale multi-task short-video ranking system in production. In the compression regime, CDS stays within $0.03\\%$ of baseline offline quality while reducing trainable parameters by 26.6\\% and improving training throughput by 6.4\\%, with neutral-to-positive online participation. In the quality-scaling regime, quality improves monotonically with chain length. Wall-clock analysis shows the efficiency gain comes mainly not from reduced FLOPs but from lower cross-device synchronization overhead and reduced optimizer update cost. These results position parameter-shared iterative computation as a practical, communication-efficient scaling axis for industrial ranking systems.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 IW-CFM：用冻结的条件与无条件 flow 模型给出的密度比对条件 flow matching 样本重新加权，使梯度与在 ω-powered 条件分布上的 flow matching 一致，并在合成分布与 ImageNet 上验证其比 matched-guidance CFG 更贴近该目标分布，另附 CLIP 排序分析。

**相关性简评：** 其用重要性权重把训练目标显式对齐到指定分布、并做自归一化与轻量校正器近似的做法，可能可供核查用于 latent 推理轨迹的加权监督与贡献分配，但论文本身属图像生成，与 LVR 主线无直接关联。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning $ω$-Powered Conditional Distributions with Importance-Weighted Flow Matching

**abstract/A1：** Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) with guidance scale $γ$ is commonly motivated by the $ω$-powered conditional distribution obtained by setting $ω=γ$, but CFG does not, in general, sample from this distribution exactly. We study whether the powered target can instead be learned explicitly. We introduce Importance-Weighted Conditional Flow Matching (IW-CFM), which reweights conditional flow-matching examples using density ratios obtained from frozen conditional and unconditional flow models. With exact normalized weights, the resulting objective has the same gradient as flow matching on the powered target; in practice, we use self-normalized estimation and a regularized empirical approximation for high-dimensional data. On synthetic distributions, IW-CFM recovers analytical powered targets for which numerically matched CFG, $γ=ω$, exhibits a visible mismatch. On ImageNet, an amortized lightweight corrector achieves better alignment than fixed- and matched-guidance CFG with the corresponding weighted and filtered reference distributions. We additionally present an exploratory CLIP analysis of powered-density rankings on real ImageNet data. Aggregate shifts across selected prompt-specific contrasts coexist with heterogeneous classwise responses, including nonmonotonic trajectories. These results provide a practical route for studying and approximating model-defined powered conditional distributions.

**comment/C1：** Code available at https://bitbucket.org/dmmlgeneva/iw-cfm

</details>

**相关性简评：** 其「同动作、异上下文、标签翻转」的对比设计可供核查，用于检验 VLM/LVR 决策是否真依赖任务必要上下文而非输入捷径；文中检索环境信号改善授权判断的做法或可类比视觉证据的获取与使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AuthGateBench: Benchmarking LLMs as Authorization Gate

**abstract/A1：** Automated approval systems let coding agents execute high-risk actions with minimal human oversight by delegating the authorization decision to a classifier, typically a large language model (LLM). Such systems, adopted in tools like Claude Code and Codex, remain vulnerable to failure modes such as scope escalation, where the agent takes actions exceeding what the user authorized. Existing benchmarks focus mainly on malicious requests, evaluating refusal under an implicit policy. We introduce AuthGateBench, the first policy-guided benchmark for authorization gating under benign requests. We implement a novel pipeline where an LLM generates contrast pairs with identical action and trajectory but differing request, flipping the label between block and allow. This allows us to assess whether models reason over context rather than the action alone. We further examine whether auxiliary environment signals can help models make better decisions. The resulting benchmark comprises 1,400 instances spanning five failure modes drawn from real-world Claude Code incidents. Evaluations show accuracy degrades unevenly across failure modes as models over-rely on internal safety alignment, and models still block most actions even when explicitly authorized, revealing unstable rather than deterministic decisions; retrospectively retrieved environment signals, however, substantially improve authorization accuracy.

</details>

### 347. [ARMED: Adaptive Retrieval-Augmented Medication Recommendation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16440v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16440

**作者：** Kyungkeon Chung、Se Un Park、Hyejin Lee、Junyoung Park

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.IR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16440v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16440v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ARMED 自适应临床检索增强框架：先观察首轮检索结果，按检索充分性与当前就诊相关性决定是否补充多查询检索，并用相关性门控只激活临床相关的同患者病史，将证据组织为结构化查询级证据，在 MIMIC-IV 上评估用药推荐质量。

**相关性简评：** 其「按检索充分性决定是否继续扩展检索」与「相关性门控筛选证据」可作为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与 THINK/LOOK/STOP 停止决策的可核查方法线索，但属纯文本临床应用，迁移性需读者自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ARMED: Adaptive Retrieval-Augmented Medication Recommendation

**abstract/A1：** Medication recommendation requires jointly considering diagnoses, comorbidities, longitudinal patient history, and treatment interactions. Although recent retrieval-augmented generation approaches using language models have shown promise for clinical recommendation, most existing systems rely on fixed retrieval pipelines that cannot adapt to diverse clinical retrieval scenarios and may introduce noisy or irrelevant evidence. We propose ARMED, an adaptive clinical RAG framework that dynamically expands retrieval according to retrieval sufficiency and current-admission relevance. ARMED first observes the initial retrieval outcome and selectively performs supplementary or fallback multi-query retrieval when additional evidence is needed. The framework also incorporates a relevance gate that activates only clinically relevant same-patient history and organizes retrieved evidence into structured query-level clinical evidence. Experiments on MIMIC-IV demonstrate that ARMED consistently outperforms previous static retrieval baselines and improves overall medication recommendation quality. By combining locally runnable small language models with adaptive retrieval, ARMED supports medication recommendation without relying on external language model APIs or task-specific fine-tuning.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at ICTAI 2026

</details>

### 348. [RAP-WAM: Learning World-Action Models through Predictive Rehearsal and Action Perturbations](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16443v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16443

**作者：** Yuanpeng He、Ceyao Zhang、Fangjing Li、Kefei Zhu、Lijian Li、Yueheng Li、Tianjia He、Wenpin Jiao、Zhi Jin、Yaodong Yang、Yuanpei Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16443v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16443v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 RAP-WAM，将预测性排练（在模型生成输入上训练但保留真实目标）与动作扰动结合，用未来监督查询和耦合动作投影学习策略，并把动作引起的视频预测响应、预测误差与排练先验合成时空信用分配，以此分配视觉监督强度，在 RoboDojo 与真机任务上评估。

**相关性简评：** 其按动作响应而非仅预测误差分配视觉监督的时空信用分配思路，可能为 LVR 中哪些内部视觉状态值得监督、视觉证据如何筛选提供方法线索；文中「响应 top20 与误差 top20 大量不重合」的观察也提示监督信号可超出预测误差，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RAP-WAM: Learning World-Action Models through Predictive Rehearsal and Action Perturbations

**abstract/A1：** Recent world action models draw on video generation priors to jointly predict future observations and robot actions. Adapting these priors to control requires determining how future predictions should guide policy learning. RAP-WAM combines predictive Rehearsal and Action Perturbations (RAP) with future-supervised queries and Coupled Action Projection for policy learning. Predictive rehearsal trains on model-generated inputs while retaining recorded targets, and accumulates recurring errors into a spatial prior. We perturb actions and measure changes in video predictions. Action-response-based spatiotemporal credit assignment combines these responses, prediction error, and the rehearsal prior to allocate visual supervision; spatially aggregating the responses determines supervision intensity across future action steps. No separate scoring network or deployment-time probe is required. The base learns from a video-pretrained backbone without intermediate pretraining on external embodied data. We evaluate the fixed base and its agent-refined, task-conditioned system. On 42 RoboDojo tasks, their average success rates are 12.85% and 15.62%, with Scores of 17.86 and 20.59. Across 15 real-robot tasks, the complete system achieves 89.00% task-macro-average success, exceeding the strongest of five baselines by 37.67 percentage points. Across 315 fixed-output simulation windows, 45.21% of response-top20 positions fall outside error-top20, revealing information beyond prediction error.

</details>

### 349. [Tikhonov-Stabilized Bezier Representation Forecasting for Training-free Diffusion Acceleration](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16448v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16448

**作者：** Lei Zhu、Mujie Lin、Ruochong Zheng、Guangyi Wang、Hao Li、Peng Jin、Chang Liu、Jie Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16448v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16448v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 BeziCast：一种免训练的扩散加速框架，用低阶 Bezier 轨迹预测去噪器输出端的中间表示，控制点经 Tikhonov 稳定拟合估计，并引入凸包式护栏把高风险外推软拉向保守估计，在图像与视频扩散模型上取得数倍加速。

**相关性简评：** 其「对中间隐状态做容量受控的平滑轨迹拟合外推，并设护栏识别高风险预测」可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的预测、更新幅度与停止判断提供可核查的方法线索，但原论文面向图像/视频生成加速，与多模态推理的联系需人工核实。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Tikhonov-Stabilized Bezier Representation Forecasting for Training-free Diffusion Acceleration

**abstract/A1：** Diffusion models, particularly Diffusion Transformers, achieve strong image and video generation quality but remain expensive at inference time due to repeated denoiser evaluations. Feature caching offers a deployment-friendly acceleration strategy by reusing or predicting intermediate representations without retraining the generator or modifying the sampler. However, existing cache-then-forecast methods often rely on Taylor-style finite-difference extrapolation, which can become unstable over longer cache intervals, and typically predict local module outputs whose errors may accumulate through subsequent denoiser blocks. We propose \\textbf{BeziCast}, a training-free diffusion acceleration framework that forecasts output-proximal denoising representations using low-order B'ezier trajectories. BeziCast estimates B'ezier control points via Tikhonov-stabilized fitting, providing a smooth, capacity-controlled temporal parameterization that avoids explicit high-order derivative estimation and decouples trajectory capacity from cache-query density. To moderate aggressive extrapolation, we further derive equivalent forecasting weights and introduce a convex-hull-inspired guardrail that detects high-risk predictions and softly pulls them toward a conservative simplex-projected estimate. Extensive evaluations across advanced image and video diffusion models demonstrate the effectiveness of BeziCast. In particular, BeziCast accelerates FLUX.1 by up to (4.79\\times) and HunyuanVideo by up to (4.11\\times), while preserving substantially better generation quality than competing acceleration baselines.

**comment/C1：** 6 figures, 5 tables

</details>

### 350. [StructZO: Structured Zeroth-Order Optimization for Memory-Efficient LLM Fine-Tuning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16451v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16451

**作者：** Xuanlin Yang、Jia Li、Zhouchen Lin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16451v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16451v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 StructZO，一种结构化零阶优化框架：在激活诱导的低维子空间内做大规模查询估计，对子空间更新做谱控制后再映射回原参数，从而在省去反向传播激活与优化器状态内存的同时提升 LLM 微调效果。

**相关性简评：** 其「激活诱导信息子空间＋谱控制」的用法或可供核查：类似手段可用于识别内部状态中与任务相关的少数方向、度量 latent 表示的低秩结构与投影损失，但它面向纯文本微调效率，与视觉推理状态生成无直接关系，迁移属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** StructZO: Structured Zeroth-Order Optimization for Memory-Efficient LLM Fine-Tuning

**abstract/A1：** Fine-tuning large language models at scale is increasingly limited by the memory cost of backpropagation. Zeroth-Order (ZO) optimizers reduce this burden by relying only on forward function evaluations, but they still exhibit a substantial performance gap to first-order (FO) optimizers such as Adam. We argue that this gap does not arise solely from the absence of explicit gradients: FO fine-tuning also benefits from informative low-rank optimization geometry, large-scale signal aggregation, and well-conditioned update directions. Motivated by this, we introduce StructZO, a structured Zeroth-Order optimization framework for memory-efficient LLM fine-tuning. StructZO performs large-query ZO estimation within an activation-induced informative subspace and applies spectral control to the resulting reduced-space update before mapping it back to the original parameters. This lets ZO aggregate useful directional signals in a compact, geometry-aware space while avoiding the activation and optimizer-state memory costs of backpropagation. We show theoretically that, when the induced subspace captures concentrated optimization-relevant directions, StructZO reduces the effective ZO estimation dimension from $mn$ to $mr$, with the remaining projection error governed by the spectral tail of the activation Gram matrix. Empirically, across OPT-series and Llama3.1-8B on diverse downstreamtasks, StructZO improves over the strongest existing ZO baselines by up to $8.7%$ relative on average and up to $26.9%$ relative on individual tasks, while remaining within $1.5%$ of FO-Adam on average. These results suggest that structured and spectrally controlled ZO updates can substantially narrow the gap between ZO and FO optimization.

**comment/C1：** 20 pages

</details>

### 351. [Not Every Cue Is Evidence: Cue Supportability for Forensic Distillation in Face Forgery Detection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16452v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16452

**作者：** Binjia Zhou、Dawei Luo、Shuai Chen、Feng Xu、Haoyuan Li、Jia wen Seow、Jiachi Wang、Jie Lei、Zunlei Feng、Yijun Bei

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16452v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16452v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对人脸伪造检测中「答案正确但证据错误」的失败，提出双重可支持性审计：蒸馏前要求候选线索既能由剩余特权上下文预测、又与当前图像的高归因视觉区域因果绑定，仅满足两者才给予显著蒸馏权重。

**相关性简评：** 其「线索必须与图像高归因区域绑定、否则不应作为监督信号」的思路，可能与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、特权监督下的贡献分配问题相通，可供核查；但任务为单图检测，与 latent 状态生成和推理期使用距离较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Not Every Cue Is Evidence: Cue Supportability for Forensic Distillation in Face Forgery Detection

**abstract/A1：** Explainable face forgery detection requires not only correct judgments but also forensic evidence supported by the input image. However, training cues are typically derived from the forgery generation pipeline. Since images available to the model are of limited quality and resolution, it is difficult to observe the fine-grained traces these cues refer to. Training methods that further supply such cues as privileged supervision exacerbate the problem, as the student is taught to articulate evidence it cannot perceive. The student consequently resorts to templated or over-generalized expressions, giving rise to the correct-answer, wrong-evidence (CAWE) failure. We propose a dual supportability audit that filters privileged cues before distillation. Each candidate cue must be predictable from the remaining privileged context and causally tied to high-attribution visual regions in the current image. Only cues satisfying both conditions receive substantial distillation weight, preventing unsupported details from leaking into the student. Experiments across eight benchmarks show that our method maintains or improves detection accuracy while significantly raising explanation faithfulness compared to existing paradigms.

</details>

### 352. [GHOST: Geometry-Constrained Hybrid Diffusion for Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16455v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16455

**作者：** Changqun Feng、Wangxiandi Yin、Xin Hu、Ruiting Dai、Feiyang Yang、Jielei Wang、Tao He

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.MM

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16455v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16455v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** GHOST 面向开放词汇 3D 场景图生成，提出几何约束的混合扩散框架，联合建模连续节点几何与离散边谓词，按「几何→约束→谓词」去噪，并用语言驱动的约束归纳把谓词嵌入映射为可微几何约束以引导布局细化与谓词重加权。

**相关性简评：** 其连续-离散状态的联合去噪、以及把语言先验转成几何约束的机制，可能为 LVR 中结构化 latent 状态的更新方式、以及用几何证据校正「语言相似度≠空间关系」的偏差提供可核查线索，但与图像 VLM 推理主线仍有距离。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GHOST: Geometry-Constrained Hybrid Diffusion for Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph Generation

**abstract/A1：** 3D scene graph generation requires understanding both object semantics and metric spatial relations. However, existing open-vocabulary methods often struggle with spatial predicates because language similarity reflects semantic co-occurrence rather than explicit geometry. We propose GHOST, a Geometry-constrained Hybrid diffusion framework for Open-vocabulary 3D Scene graph generaTion. GHOST jointly models continuous node geometry and discrete edge predicates, following a geometry-to-constraint-to-predicate denoising process to ensure geometrically consistent relation prediction. It introduces language-grounded constraint induction, which maps predicate embeddings to differentiable geometric constraints that guide both layout refinement and predicate reweighting. A Geometry-Topology Collaborative Denoiser further couples node and edge reasoning through noise-adaptive interaction and orientation-aware modeling. Experiments on 3DSSG demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in both closed-set and open-vocabulary settings, including over 17-point gains over RelationField on spatial predicates.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages. Accepted at ACM MM 2026 (34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia)

</details>
