### 353. [XAI-Guided Fourier Domain Generalisation for Pure-Simulation Sim-to-Real Deep Reinforcement Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16478v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16478

**作者：** Wei Yao、Chuyao Wang、Ziwei Wang、Nabil Aouf

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16478v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16478v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 XFD：从模拟观测中提取 XAI 归因图，将其转成策略条件下的傅里叶域扰动，在纯模拟内构造增强鲁棒的视觉域，并配合鲁棒策略优化，以提升自动驾驶策略的 sim-to-real 零样本迁移表现。

**相关性简评：** 其「用归因图区分任务关键视觉证据与外观敏感成分」的思路，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选与贡献归因监督提供线索；归因一致性分析可供核查视觉信息是否真正被策略使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** XAI-Guided Fourier Domain Generalisation for Pure-Simulation Sim-to-Real Deep Reinforcement Learning

**abstract/A1：** Deep reinforcement learning has shown strong potential for vision-based autonomous driving, but policies trained in simulation often suffer severe performance degradation when deployed in the real world. Existing sim-to-real methods commonly address this gap through image-transfer-based domain adaptation or policy-agnostic domain randomisation. However, the former requires laborious acquisition of target-domain data and is often limited to the deployment domain, whereas the latter introduces unguided perturbations that may not reflect the underlying sim-to-real discrepancy, leading to suboptimal transfer performance. To overcome these limitations, we propose XFD, an explainable artificial intelligence (XAI)-guided Fourier domain generalisation framework for pure-simulation sim-to-real reinforcement learning. The proposed framework extracts explainability attribution maps from simulated observations, and converts these attributions into policy-conditioned Fourier-domain interventions. By perturbing appearance-sensitive spectral components while preserving task-defining spatial structures, XFD constructs robustness-enhancing visual domains entirely within simulation. Subsequently, the proposed robust policy optimisation guides the policy towards attending to task-critical features while suppressing sensitivity to irrelevant visual information. Extensive experiments in simulation and zero-shot real-world deployment demonstrate that XFD consistently improves traveled distance and reward over standard policy and randomly domain-randomised baseline, especially on unseen maps with cluttered backgrounds. Attribution-based analysis further proves that the proposed policy preserves more consistent task-relevant visual evidence across simulation and real-world observations.

</details>

### 354. [MiMaAlign: Hierarchical Micro-Macro Alignment for Physically Plausible Video Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16482v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16482

**作者：** Yansong Liu、Litong Gong、Weijie Li、Tiezheng Ge、Ming Zeng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16482v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16482v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 面向 T2V 扩散模型的物理合理性生成，提出 MiMaAlign 分层 micro-macro 对齐框架：用 Neural ODE 学习连续运动表示、用指令提示的 VLM 提供事件常识，并以仅训练期的辅助目标把两类教师监督分别对齐到浅层与深层生成器特征。

**相关性简评：** 其「按抽象深度分层对齐互补教师表示」的训练监督方式，可能为 LVR 中视觉细节与高层语义在不同层级的保留、以及对内部状态施加辅助监督提供可核查的方法线索，但该文面向视频生成，与 latent 推理状态无直接关系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MiMaAlign: Hierarchical Micro-Macro Alignment for Physically Plausible Video Generation

**abstract/A1：** Text-to-video (T2V) diffusion models have made remarkable progress in generating high-fidelity visuals, yet their outputs still often exhibit physically implausible phenomena, including discontinuous dynamics and implausible event interactions. Existing representation alignment methods mainly transfer generic video features or short-range motion cues, treating physical plausibility as a single-level representation problem. To address this issue, we propose MiMaAlign, a hierarchical micro-macro alignment framework that transfers complementary dynamics-oriented and event-oriented knowledge into different abstraction depths of a pretrained video diffusion model. Specifically, micro-level continuous dynamics alignment imposes constraints by aligning diffusion features with a continuous-time motion representation learned by a Neural Ordinary Differential Equation (Neural ODE), while macro-level event-commonsense alignment provides representations of object interactions and event semantics through an instruction-prompted vision-language model (VLM). With training-only auxiliary objectives, we align the complementary supervision from the two teachers with shallower and deeper generator features, respectively, enabling the generator to internalize the corresponding physical priors. Empirical evaluations show that, on CogVideoX-2B, MiMaAlign achieves a relative improvement of up to 21.0% in the Physical Commonsense (PC) score on the VideoPhy benchmark over the baseline, and also delivers substantial gains on the highly challenging VideoPhy2 benchmark, while maintaining general video quality on VBench and being supported by blind user comparisons.

**comment/C1：** 20 pages, 14 figures

</details>

### 355. [SLEM: Spectrum-Aware Latent Expert Merging](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16484v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16484

**作者：** Dohyeon Kim、Bedionita Soro、Bruno Andreis、Sung Ju Hwang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16484v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16484v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对 MoE 专家合并在参数空间直接凸插值缺乏函数意义、且依赖校准数据估计相似度的问题，提出 SLEM：用 VAE 构建专家权重的结构化隐表示，在隐空间按相似度分组并做几何感知插值，再解码回合并后的专家权重。

**相关性简评：** 该工作研究的是权重隐空间中的相似度度量与几何插值，与 LVR 关注的 latent 相似度受内容、深度、位置等因素影响、以及 latent 状态如何比较与融合的问题可能形成方法线索，可供核查其隐相似度定义是否可迁移到推理状态分析。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SLEM: Spectrum-Aware Latent Expert Merging

**abstract/A1：** Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale model capacity efficiently by activating only a small subset of experts for each input, while still requiring all parameters to be stored in memory, resulting in substantial memory overhead. Expert merging techniques have recently emerged as a promising compression paradigm that reduces this overhead by consolidating multiple experts into a smaller set. However, existing approaches have two key limitations: (i) direct convex interpolation in parameter space is not generally guaranteed to yield meaningful interpolation of expert functions; and (ii) estimating expert similarity or merging coefficients often relies on calibration data, introducing dependence on the calibration distribution. To address these limitations, we propose Spectrum-Aware Latent Expert Merging (SLEM), a calibration-free expert merging framework that occurs in a structured latent representation of expert weights using a VAE. SLEM groups experts within and across layers based on latent similarities and derives merging coefficients from expert weight spectra. It then performs geometry-aware latent interpolation and decodes the resulting representations into merged expert weights. Compared with existing expert merging methods, SLEM achieves comparable or better performance on general knowledge benchmarks and higher average performance on generation benchmarks involving mathematical reasoning and code generation.

**comment/C1：** 21 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables

</details>

### 356. [Growing and Transferring Pathways for LLM Reinforcement Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16489v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16489

**作者：** Haolin Tian、Yikang Li、Tonghan Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16489v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16489v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** GrowRL 提出一种 LLM 强化学习训练方法：冻结预训练主干，在每层新增因果注意力分支和前馈分支，用零初始化输出投影保持初始策略不变，RL 只更新这些新增路径，并在五个主干上验证数学推理与分布外表现及跨模型迁移。

**相关性简评：** 「冻结主干＋独立可迁移计算路径」的组织方式，可能为 LVR 中推理状态更新模块的挂载、RL 贡献分配与轨迹/适配器迁移提供方法线索；但该工作面向纯文本推理，未涉及视觉证据或 latent 生成，需人工核查其线索是否适用于多模态场景。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Growing and Transferring Pathways for LLM Reinforcement Learning

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement learning (RL) can substantially improve the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but an effective training run requires considerable resources. Reusing the computation acquired through RL across models would extend the value of that training. We propose GrowRL, an RL method that organizes learned updates into compact computational pathways through structural growth. GrowRL freezes the pretrained backbone and adds an independent causal attention branch and a feed-forward network branch at each Transformer layer. Zero-initialized output projections preserve the pretrained policy at initialization, and RL updates only the added pathways. The learned pathways remain explicit after training, allowing transfer to structurally compatible target models and subsequent adaptation with the target backbone frozen. The architecture also supports sequential transfer of additional pathways. By keeping the learned attention and feed-forward computation separate from the pretrained weights, GrowRL provides an explicit structure for preserving and reusing the outcome of an RL run. Experiments across five backbones show competitive mathematical reasoning and out-of-distribution performance with a small number of trainable parameters. Learned pathways provide immediate gains across all three transfer directions, with performance after only 10 target-side updates already close to that after 100 updates in every case. These results support computational pathways as parameter-efficient and reusable units of reinforcement learning adaptation.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16491

**作者：** Xin Xu、Ke Cheng、Hao Wang、Yangru Huang、Yanghao Xiao、Zhichao Chen、Zhisheng Zhong、Xun Liu、Yi Li、Qian Li、Haibin Lv、Jun Zhang、Jie Jiang、Zhouchen Lin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16491v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16491v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Speculative Recursive Self-Improvement（SpecRSI）：在有限预算下先推测式草拟可执行的继任 agent 再做完整验证，并用验证感知树搜索（VATS）在继续编辑与待完成检验之间分配预算、用组验证优化（GVO）训练改进器，在科学任务与编码验证对比中超过 Janus、MetaRSI-v1 与 HGM。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉/多模态推理无直接关联，但其「按预测的已验证回报分配计算」「先草拟后验证」的做法，可能为 LVR 中的动态计算分配、证据获取与停止决策提供可核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Drafting Agents, Not Just Tokens: Speculative Recursive Self-Improvement for Agentic Systems

**abstract/A1：** Improving an agent through successive revisions requires balancing exploration and evaluation under a limited budget. A narrow search can miss useful sequences of edits, while fully evaluating every intermediate version can exhaust the budget before those sequences yield a verified improvement. We introduce Speculative Recursive Self-Improvement (SpecRSI), which drafts executable successor agents before their predecessors are fully evaluated, while requiring complete verification before adoption. Verification-Aware Tree Search (VATS) allocates the budget between further edits and outstanding checks using the predicted verified return of a continuation. Group Verification Optimization (GVO) learns the improver from completed searches while keeping the real evaluator fixed. In the main scientific comparison, terminal gains exceed Janus by 33.3%--40.0%. Additional evaluations show that SpecRSI outperforms Janus in all 50 scientific backbone--task pairs and exceeds MetaRSI-v1 by 1.85%--2.38% in macro-average system score across twenty backbones. Coding-validation success reaches 69.4% versus HGM's 64.3% at a 20.8% lower target-cost index.

**comment/C1：** 47 pages; code available at https://github.com/SpecRSI-GPR/SpecRSI

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** KARAMEL 面向文化遗产领域的多模态实体链接，把视觉-语言编码器与异构图神经网络融合，引入社会历史与结构化上下文知识来消解模糊指代，并发布 WikiMuSA 基准数据集。

**相关性简评：** 其「VLM 编码器＋异构图」在关系结构上做上下文推理、以外部结构化知识缓解证据不充分，可供核查 LVR 中实体关系保留与视觉证据筛选的表示方式；但论文未涉及 latent 状态的生成、更新或答案对 latent 的使用，联系属方法层面推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** KARAMEL: Knowledge-Aware Ranking for Multimodal Entity Linking in the Arts via Heterogeneous Graphs

**abstract/A1：** Discovering and disambiguating entities from multimodal and heterogeneous data is a key challenge in discovery science, where relevant knowledge is often implicit and distributed across modalities. We present KARAMEL, a framework for multimodal entity linking (MEL) - the task of aligning visual and textual mentions to entities in a knowledge base - in the cultural heritage domain. Unlike prior vision-language models that primarily rely on surface-level multimodal alignment, our approach incorporates sociohistorical and contextual knowledge through a knowledge-aware architecture that fuses a vision-language encoder with a heterogeneous graph neural network. This design enables contextual reasoning over complex relational structures and supports robust entity disambiguation under ambiguous or underspecified evidence. To benchmark multimodal discovery in this setting, we introduce WikiMuSA (Wikidata-based Multimodal Semantic data for Art), a new dataset that links artworks to Wikidata entities via images, textual descriptions, and structured contextual knowledge. Experimental results show that KARAMEL surpasses strong baselines, particularly on implicit or abstract mentions, while ablation studies highlight the critical role of domain-specific, structured context in learning expressive representations. While instantiated in the cultural heritage domain, KARAMEL addresses a general knowledge discovery problem and applies to other scientific settings involving multimodal observations and heterogeneous background knowledge. Both the dataset and source code are made publicly available.

**comment/C1：** 19 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables, journal: Machine Learning

</details>

### 359. [EAU: Environment-Agent-User Co-evolution for Training User-Centric Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16523

**作者：** Min Cai、Dan Zhang、Gao Xing、Libin Ma、Zhaohui Xu、Xi Ye

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.LG

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 EAU 元智能体框架，在训练中监测轨迹、工具调用、奖励与统计量，诊断失败与无信息交互，并自动修改用户模拟器、环境、奖励设计和 RL 配置且热替换到当前训练，实现环境-智能体-用户协同演化，在三个交互式 agent 基准上优于基线。

**相关性简评：** 其「诊断失败交互、识别不可靠验证器并动态调整监督与奖励」的机制，可能为 LVR 中轨迹训练、贡献分配与视觉证据验证器的可靠性问题提供可供核查的方法线索，但需确认能否迁移到多模态 latent 推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** EAU: Environment-Agent-User Co-evolution for Training User-Centric Agents

**abstract/A1：** Training LLM agents to interact with users over multiple turns is challenging because the learning signal depends not only on the agent, but also on the user simulator and environment, which jointly shape the agent's experience. Simulated users can be stochastic or inconsistent, while environments may contain unreliable tools, incomplete state coverage, and incorrect verifiers. Prior work mainly addresses the resulting instability through reward shaping or denser supervision, while treating these components as fixed. We instead introduce EAU, a meta-agent framework for environment--agent--user co-evolution. During training, EAU monitors trajectories, tool traces, rewards, and training statistics; diagnoses failures and uninformative interactions; and proposes targeted modifications to the user simulator, environment, reward design, and RL configuration. Validated changes are hot-swapped into the ongoing run, allowing the training setup to evolve together with the policy. These adaptations also persist across runs, so later training can build on previously discovered improvements rather than restarting from a fixed setup. We enable this process through an editable symbolic representation of user and environment dynamics, while the agent remains a neural LLM optimized with RL. Across three interactive-agent benchmarks and two backbone models, EAU consistently outperforms prior RL methods, improving the overall score over the strongest baseline by 14.7--15.0% and increasing successful task completion on ColBench by up to 36.7%, showing that co-evolving the training system with the policy can substantially improve multi-turn RL.

</details>

### 360. [Overtaught, Underlearned: Learner-Centered Distillation from Multi-Agent Discussion](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16543v1>)

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16543v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16543v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文指出多智能体讨论的全图蒸馏中教师示范与学生实际所学不匹配，表现为同一解在学生表征中重复的「过度教学」和训练后仍不会的「学习不足」，并提出 FAR：训练前把同一讨论状态下的多个解折叠为代表课程，训练后依据学生自身尝试定位漏题、针对表征不足的聚类补写课程，在两类学生、四个推理任务上优于全图蒸馏。

**相关性简评：** 其按学生内部表征折叠重复监督、再据漏题定位补课的做法，与 LVR 轨迹训练中的信息冗余、贡献分配与监督组织问题可能相通，可供核查；但材料仅涉及纯文本讨论蒸馏，无视觉或多模态状态生成线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Overtaught, Underlearned: Learner-Centered Distillation from Multi-Agent Discussion

**abstract/A1：** Multi-agent discussion produces reasoning collaboratively, while deployment still relies on a smaller student that must answer alone. Full-graph distillation transfers such discussions by treating each correct solution as a separate training target, but what teachers provide need not match what the student learns. This mismatch appears in two ways: several correct solutions may amount to the same lesson in the student's representation (over-teaching), while some training questions remain missed after learning (under-learning). We quantify both with rates that are high on discussion graphs. To address them, we introduce FAR (Fold--Attempt--Revisit), a learner-centered distillation procedure that organizes supervision around the student's own state. Before training, FAR folds solutions within each discussion state into representative lessons. After training, the student's own attempts identify missed questions, while poorly represented clusters indicate where folding may have lost useful variation; FAR then writes targeted lessons from retained discussion contexts. Across two students and four reasoning tasks, FAR outperforms full-graph distillation with far fewer training targets and lower under-learning. Further analyses examine the behavior of FAR and the sources of its gains. Overall, the results show that organizing discussion supervision around the student can make distillation both more effective and more efficient.

**comment/C1：** 28 pages

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 AlignCache，一个面向视频扩散模型加速的闭环特征缓存框架，用分阶段阈值路由、基于反事实误差的在线阈值校准和动量式草稿合成，来改进去噪过程中复用中间特征的调度决策。

**相关性简评：** 其「启发式差异度量与真实质量错位、预算估计未与真实误差核对」的诊断，以及对复用/重算决策做闭环校准的思路，可能为 LVR 中动态计算分配、停止决策与 latent 相似度判据的可靠性问题提供可核查线索；但属视频生成加速场景，需人工判断迁移价值。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Heuristics are Not Enough: Calibrated and Corrected Caching for Video Diffusion Acceleration

**abstract/A1：** Feature caching has become a mainstream training-free strategy for accelerating video diffusion models by reusing intermediate outputs across denoising steps. However, existing adaptive methods rely on heuristic difference measures misaligned with actual generation quality, employ a single global threshold that ignores heterogeneous phase dynamics, and never validate their budget estimates against true approximation error, allowing systematic bias to propagate uncorrected. We propose \\textbf{AlignCache}, a closed-loop caching framework that directly aligns scheduling decisions with their true influence on the final generated video through three tightly coupled components: (1) phase-adaptive budget routing that partitions the denoising trajectory into structurally distinct phases, each governed by an independent threshold and a staleness-aware guard; (2) closed-loop threshold calibration that exploits counterfactual error measurement at the classifier-free guided output level to adjust decision boundaries online via an EMA feedback loop; and (3) momentum-augmented draft synthesis combining direction-magnitude gated residual extrapolation with anchor-guided unconditional correction. By transforming scheduling from a static risk accumulator into a feedback-driven, self-correcting controller, AlignCache consistently achieves superior acceleration-quality trade-offs across state-of-the-art video generation models. Our code is available at https://github.com/jiangjyjy/AlignCache.

</details>

**abstract/A1：** Basic probabilistic models form the basis of modern deep learning largely by defining the final activation layer of a network and allowing the networks outputs to be interpreted through a probabilistic lens. By increasing the complexity of these final activation layers to include features such as spatial regularisation, allow for these models to improve in performance without requiring significantly more data. The challenge however is to ensure that these more complex probabilistic graphical models adapt well to being used in tandem with deep learning, that is, ensuring they converge and have meaningful derivatives. The goal of this paper is to show two algorithms with provable convergence properties to allow this type of regularisation for image and signal classification models. Through both rigorous mathematical analysis and in silico experiments, we can show the differing performance between these solution types.

**title/T1：** Dense Endoluminal Mapping and Localisation from Monocular Bronchoscopy

**abstract/A1：** Bronchoscopy inserts a camera through the airways to diagnose endoluminal disease. Locating the camera along the airway usually requires additional equipment, such as an electromagnetic tracker and a preoperative CT scan. In this paper, we investigate the use of the monocular camera stream to localise the bronchoscope without requiring additional sensing. We introduce a monocular SLAM system that localises the tip of a bronchoscope and reconstructs the airway surface around it from RGB video alone. A Depth Anything 3 backbone, fine-tuned on over a million photorealistic airway renderings, returns metric per-pixel depth and is the system's only source of scale. DINOv3 features routed through a custom cross-attention matcher supply sub-pixel correspondences on mucosa where classical descriptors fail. Both enter a factor graph alongside a dense constraint from projective iterative closest point (ICP) registration against the system's own running reconstruction, so surface evidence stabilises the directions the visual factors leave weakly observable. On six airways rendered from patient CT scans, the system reaches 26.1 mm mean absolute trajectory error and 77.5% mean surface F-score. Its mean surface accuracy exceeds that of five recent monocular SLAM and feed-forward baselines. MASt3R-SLAM, which fits a free scale to the ground truth, has a lower mean trajectory error (22.0 mm). ORB-SLAM3 completes only two of the six airways, whereas our system completes all six and also reconstructs two ex vivo specimens.

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该工作研究物理约束残差惩罚与数据分布保真度之间的冲突，指出残差正则化会使扩散模型偏好低残差敏感度的可行状态，甚至迁移到数据支撑之外的区域，并提出在干净训练样本处用残差 Jacobian 加权并归一化的 data-anchored penalty 来消除这种激励。

**相关性简评：** 其正则项导致状态向低敏感区域漂移（avoidance/leakage）的分析与「把辅助惩罚锚定在数据样本处以避免状态偏离」的做法，可能可供核查 LVR 训练中辅助监督是否同样把 latent 状态推离视觉证据，属于方法线索而非直接主线。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Characterizing and Mitigating Distributional Bias in Physics-Informed Generative Models

**abstract/A1：** Physics-informed generative models augment a data-fitting objective with residual penalties that encourage physical constraints to hold in generated samples. However, improving constraint satisfaction need not improve fidelity to the data distribution. We study this conflict in residual-regularized diffusion models and identify two possible consequences. First, the same prediction error can incur different residual costs near different feasible states, preferring states with lower residual sensitivity (avoidance). Second, this preference can extend to feasible states outside the data support, where the residual also vanishes (leakage). Motivated by this analysis, we propose a data-anchored penalty that weights prediction errors by the residual Jacobian at the clean training sample and normalizes the resulting magnitude. This removes the incentive to relocate to less sensitive states without changing the model architecture or sampling procedure. Experiments on a controlled synthetic system, three PDE systems, and molecular transition-state generation with flow matching demonstrate the benefits of anchoring. Code is available at https://github.com/TanjaBien/anchored\_diffusion.

</details>

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 double-rollout 强化学习：对每条采样轨迹截断推理过程并从该前缀采样多个续写，以续写奖励均值替换原奖励，得到更稳健的推理质量估计，缓解结果奖励噪声带来的信用分配问题，在数学与代码任务上提升准确率与 token 效率。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本 reasoning RL 的奖励估计与信用分配方法，其「截断前缀＋多续写采样」的监督构造可能为 LVR 中 latent 轨迹训练、贡献分配与停止决策的评估提供可核查线索，但尚无视觉或 latent 状态实验。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Double-Rollout Reinforcement Learning with Sampling-based Reward Estimation

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) implemented with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has driven substantial progress in training reasoning language models. However, verifiable outcome rewards provide an imperfect measure of reasoning quality: a correct final answer may not be supported by the reasoning trace, whereas an incorrect rollout may contain a nearly correct reasoning trajectory. We present empirical evidence for this mismatch and hypothesize that the resulting reward noise contributes to instability in reinforcement learning for both reasoning accuracy and token efficiency. To address this credit assignment challenge, this paper proposes double-rollout reinforcement learning. For each sampled rollout, we truncate its reasoning trace, sample multiple continuations from the truncated prefix, and replace the original reward with the mean continuation reward, yielding a more robust estimate of reasoning quality. This double-rollout algorithm incurs only a moderate increase in compute cost and yet reaches substantially higher accuracies across math and coding tasks and across Qwen and Nemotron models than baseline algorithms with fewer RL steps. For example, using only DAPO data it trains Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B to reach 95.4% on AIME 2026, versus 91.5% by GRPO and substantially above state of the art for this model size, within 30 RL steps. When combined with length-based rewards, the same algorithm further improves the accuracy-efficiency Pareto frontier over existing efficiency optimizations. These findings suggest that the double-rollout reward estimation is an effective and cost-efficient way to improve both the accuracy and token efficiency of reasoning RL.

</details>

### 366. [DEFlow: Deep Equilibrium Flow Maximum-Entropy Reinforcement Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16597v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16597

**作者：** Ruslan Ageev、Huaze Tang、Runqing Miao、Jiarong Li、Wenbo Ding

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16597v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16597v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** DEFlow 提出深度平衡流策略，用隐式 Euler 积分替代显式采样，把中间动作联合求解为平衡系统，并以隐式微分配合离散变量替换公式得到最终动作密度，从而在 soft actor-critic 中无需对求解器迭代反传即可离策略训练，在多目标对接等连续控制任务上取得约 10% 的平均相对提升。

**相关性简评：** 其将迭代中间状态作为平衡系统联合求解、并用隐式微分绕开对求解迭代的反传，可能与 loop／迭代式 latent 推理的状态更新与训练监督（固定点求解、免 BPTT 式梯度）存在方法借鉴关系，但属连续控制领域，迁移可行性需人工核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DEFlow: Deep Equilibrium Flow Maximum-Entropy Reinforcement Learning

**abstract/A1：** Expressive flow policies can represent multiple high-value actions, but sampling them with few integration steps while retaining tractable action densities remains challenging. We introduce DEFlow, a deep equilibrium flow policy that replaces explicit Euler sampling with implicit Euler integration and solves all intermediate actions jointly as an equilibrium system. We combine implicit differentiation with a discrete change-of-variables formula for the final-action density, enabling off-policy training within soft actor-critic without backpropagating through solver iterations. DEFlow achieves an average relative improvement of approximately 10% in mean successful coverage over the strongest baseline across four Multi-Goal docking variants. It also achieves the highest mean time-averaged return on four of five manipulation tasks, while remaining broadly competitive across five MuJoCo tasks. These results support implicit flow policies for tasks requiring both diversity and precision, at the cost of additional nonlinear and linear solves. Primary

</details>

### 367. [DR-APO: Decoupled-Representation Advantage-Guided Policy Optimization from Continuous Control to Embodied Navigation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16618v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16618

**作者：** Runhua Zhang、Yingjie Niu、Chao Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.RO

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 DR-APO，把策略改进与策略表示解耦：以优势引导的目标改进配合表示兼容的直接动作拟合，为高斯、扩散与流匹配策略提供统一优化接口，并在 MuJoCo-v5 任务和具身导航后训练中验证效果。

**相关性简评：** 文中「优势引导目标改进 + 与生成过程解耦的直接拟合」可能为 latent 推理轨迹的监督信号构造与信用分配提供借鉴线索，但其评测在连续控制与导航策略上，与 VLM 推理的联系尚需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DR-APO: Decoupled-Representation Advantage-Guided Policy Optimization from Continuous Control to Embodied Navigation

**abstract/A1：** Policy representations in reinforcement learning have expanded beyond Gaussian policies to diffusion and flow-matching based generative policies. However, existing RL methods remain representation-specific, lacking a unified optimization interface for emerging generative policies. In particular, extending likelihood-based objectives to multi-step generative policies couples optimization to their internal generation process, where accumulated likelihood ratios can weaken the update signal. Meanwhile, generative-policy-specific methods often rely on multi-candidate generation and critic-based selection, improving overall return while providing limited improvement to the policy itself. We introduce DR-APO (Decoupled-Representation Advantage-Guided Policy Optimization), which decouples policy improvement from policy representation through advantage-guided target improvement and representation-compatible direct action fitting, providing a shared optimization principle for Gaussian, diffusion, and flow policies. Across five MuJoCo-v5 tasks, DR-APO remains competitive with SAC for Gaussian policies and achieves the best aggregate policy-only performance for both diffusion and flow-matching policies. NavDP post-training improves the Success Rate (SR) from 70.33% to 89.55% in simulation and from 25% to 65% in real-world navigation. These results demonstrate a unified policy-improvement principle across Gaussian, diffusion, and flow policies, from continuous-control learning to embodied-policy post-training.

**comment/C1：** 9 pages, 4 figures,

**内容简述：** 论文面向 FPGA 布线后时序收敛，提出两层框架 LATCH，把 LLM 编排与确定性的 FPGA 实现评估分离，比较专家配方、直接 EDA 操作与 LLM 自建流程三种代理控制粒度，并在固定动作层级后比较序列推理、分支探索与知识库引导探索等多轮组织方式。

**相关性简评：** 其可控性—收益权衡与「序列推理 vs 分支探索 vs 知识库引导」的多轮组织结论，可能为 LVR 迭代推理中的状态更新、搜索式验证与停止决策提供组织线索，可供核查是否迁移；领域为 EDA，与视觉多模态推理无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LATCH: LLM-Assisted Timing Closure Harness for Post-Route FPGA Optimisation

**abstract/A1：** Post-route FPGA timing closure remains expert-dependent and computationally expensive. We present LATCH (LLM-Assisted Timing Closure Harness), a two-layer framework that separates large language model (LLM) orchestration from deterministic FPGA implementation and evaluation. Across sixteen designs and seven LLMs, a single-iteration study compares three agent control granularities - expert-written recipes, direct EDA operations and LLM-constructed procedures - to ask how much control an agent needs per attempt. Functional-pass rates are 98.2%, 71.4% and 17.9%, respectively; yet direct operations give slightly larger 3.4% median Fmax gains when passing, versus 3.2% for recipes. This exposes a trade-off between execution reliability and timing improvement. Informed by this trade-off, a multi-iteration study fixes the action tier at expert recipes to ask how repeated attempts are best organised, comparing a fitted deterministic heuristic with sequential LLM reasoning, branching exploration and knowledge base-guided exploration within 12 checkpoints per run. Branching raises mean maximum-frequency improvement from 10.5% (sequential) to 16.0%, and the knowledge base to 20.3%, improving 15 of 16 designs. Characterisation across 2,421 recipe attempts profiled their gain and validation rates, showing hard-block re-placement gives the largest cumulative mean gain at 41.4MHz.

### 369. [AeroChem: Closed-loop Physics-Informed State Space Modeling for Long-term Chemically-Reactive Air Quality Forecasting--Extended Version](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16630v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16630

**作者：** Kien Le Trung、Tung Kieu、Dinh Duc Nha Nguyen、Cuong Do、Bin Yang、Phi Long Nguyen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16630v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16630v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 AeroChem，一个闭环物理信息状态空间框架：用 UDE 过程分支提供物理先验，Mamba 虚拟观测分支产生概率性虚拟观测，再通过神经卡尔曼融合在各预测步校正 latent 物理状态并回馈模拟器，同时发布 HanoiAir 数据集。

**相关性简评：** 其「每步校正 latent 状态并把后验回馈」的闭环状态更新与卡尔曼式融合，可能为 LVR 中推理状态的迭代修正与误差漂移控制提供方法线索，值得核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AeroChem: Closed-loop Physics-Informed State Space Modeling for Long-term Chemically-Reactive Air Quality Forecasting--Extended Version

**abstract/A1：** Accurate long-term air quality forecasting is challenging due to long-range transport, meteorological variability, and nonlinear chemical reactions underlying secondary pollutant formation. Purely data-driven models often suffer from long-horizon drift and lack physical consistency, while existing physics-informed approaches commonly follow open-loop designs that fuse neural and physical components only at the output level. We propose AeroChem, a closed-loop physics-informed state space framework for chemically reactive air quality forecasting. AeroChem adopts a two-branch co-correction design: a UDE-based process branch provides a structured but imperfect physical prior, while a Mamba-based virtual measurement branch captures long-range temporal context and produces probabilistic virtual observations. Neural Kalman Fusion couples the two branches by correcting the latent physical state at each forecasting step and feeding the posterior state back into the simulator, reducing long-horizon drift. We further introduce HanoiAir, a real-world dataset integrating pollutant concentrations, meteorology, and emission inventories. Experiments on HanoiAir and a public benchmark show that AeroChem improves long-horizon stability and sudden-change forecasting.

**comment/C1：** 25 pages. An extended version of "AeroChem: Closed-loop Physics-Informed State Space Modeling for Long-term Chemically-Reactive Air Quality Forecasting--Extended Version" accepted at NeurIPS 2026

</details>

**title/T1：** REEL: Learning to Retrieve, Evaluate, and Evolve Visual Memory for Any Long-Horizon Multi-Shot Video Generation

**abstract/A1：** Memory-based long-video generation aims to combine user control with long-range visual consistency. We organize this process into three functional components: a planner, an adapter, and a generator. Representative multi-shot systems couple memory to generator-specific interfaces or use predefined agent workflows, rather than independently training a memory policy for cross-shot objectives. We introduce REEL, a general-purpose visual-memory planner. Through a unified tool interface, REEL learns to retrieve references, create missing visual evidence, and update persistent memory. Backend-specific adapters translate its evidence plans into supported conditioning inputs, allowing the same policy to guide different black-box video generators. To train REEL, we construct two high-quality datasets, REEL-SFT-4k and REEL-RL-1k, covering diverse interaction patterns and prompt types. Training proceeds in three stages: supervised fine-tuning, single-shot Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), and multi-shot GRPO. Multi-shot GRPO carries policy-generated memory across consecutive shots, so later outcomes guide earlier reference selection and memory updates. REEL-Bench tests identity preservation and intended state changes under text-only requests and timed reference-image uploads. On JoyAI-Echo~1.5 and MiniMax-H3, REEL improves cross-shot consistency on ST-Bench by 15.1\\% and 20.7\\%, and Core-100 on our proposed REEL-Bench by 2.41 and 8.32 points, respectively, over the no-memory baseline.

**内容简述：** 提出 ACED：在数学题的测试阶段把自然语言自洽答案当作默认参照，把可执行程序输出当作辅助证据而非等价投票，通过将各来源答案计数平滑为支持度、加权对数池化，并在校准后的相对证据边际被超过时才覆盖默认答案，同一规则兼顾候选选择与仅可执行答案的接纳。

**相关性简评：** 其「保留证据来源、异质证据通道加权汇聚、校准边际足够大才覆盖默认答案」的机制，可能可供核查 LVR 中多种 latent 假设与视觉证据的筛选、覆盖与停止决策；但该工作限于文本数学推理，不涉及视觉内部状态，迁移线索尚待验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ACED: Reference-Anchored Aggregation of Natural-Language and Executable Evidence for Mathematical Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Natural-language self-consistency and executable programs provide complementary test-time evidence for mathematical reasoning, yet either channel may support the same semantic error. Thus we propose ACED, a reference-anchored framework that treats the self-consistency answer as the default and executable outputs as supporting evidence rather than interchangeable votes. ACED converts source-specific answer counts into smoothed supports, combines them through a weighted logarithmic pool, and overrides the reference only when a calibrated relative-evidence margin is exceeded. The same rule supports both candidate selection and admission of executable-only answers. Across five math word-problem benchmarks, ACED matches or outperforms the corresponding baselines. On GSM8K, ACED-CANDIDATE recovers 89.7% of the attainable candidate-set gain with only three damaging overrides, while ACED-ALL reaches 86.9% accuracy versus 82.6% for direct Program-of-Thought aggregation. These results show that preserving evidence provenance enables more reliable integration of natural-language and executable reasoning.

### 372. [Does a Hosted Decision Model Respect Irrelevant Alternatives? A Pre-Registered Test of Option-Set Dependence in Jev](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16655v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16655

**作者：** Dushyant Rajput、Nirdesh Chauhan、Siddharth Kosaraju

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16655v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16655v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 以预注册实验在托管决策模型 jev-1.13.0 上做近 30 万次调用，检验其按选项输出的概率是否满足无关选项独立性（IIA）：加入既非正确答案也非最强竞争者的选项仍会系统性推动金标签与最强错误标签之间的对数几率，且偏移随选项数对数增长。

**相关性简评：** 其对「逐一独立打分 vs 联合读选项集」的对比与选项集依赖度量，可供核查 LVR 中把 latent 读出的概率当作选项属性、并据此做验证或置信停止这一假设是否成立。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Does a Hosted Decision Model Respect Irrelevant Alternatives? A Pre-Registered Test of Option-Set Dependence in Jev

**abstract/A1：** Decision APIs that return a probability for each option are routinely used as if those probabilities were properties of the options themselves. That reading is valid only if the model satisfies independence of irrelevant alternatives (IIA): adding an option that is neither the right answer nor its strongest rival should leave the odds between those two unchanged. We test this in a pre-registered study of jev-1.13.0, a hosted decision model, using 299,463 calls on intent classification (BANKING77, CLINC150) and topic classification (AG News). Every added option moves the log-odds between the gold label and the strongest wrong label: the root-mean-square systematic shift is 0.20-0.52 nats, 1.2 to 3 times the run-to-run variation, even when the added option takes at most 0.1% of the probability mass. The shifts are directional. An option similar to the wrong answer draws probability from it (+0.10 nats toward the gold label). A paraphrase of the wrong answer produces an intermediate pattern: the gold label's probability is almost conserved, but the paraphrase receives only about a third of the wrong answer's share rather than the half that strict substitution implies. The distortion grows steadily with the logarithm of the number of options, reaching about 1 nat at 255 options, and off-domain padding pushes the odds against the gold label. In contrast, questions packed into one call do not interact (bias &lt; 0.001). Scoring each option with an independent yes/no question removes the option-set dependence but picks the right answer 8.7 points less often. Jev sits between two local baselines, an option-independent scorer and a prompt readout. Its probabilities are best read as relative to the option list they were computed over.

</details>

### 373. [Compression Through Time: An Interplay of Separability, Stationarity and Capacity](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16660v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16660

**作者：** Nikolaus Kopp、Franz Pernkopf、Bernhard Geiger

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16660v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16660v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在离散化 LSTM 上直接估计信息量，考察压缩在时间轴末端增强的现象，并用类别可分性、时间平稳性与网络容量三个机制加以解释和验证。

**相关性简评：** 其「有限嵌入空间直接估计信息量 + 观察压缩随计算步变化」的分析手段，可能可供核查 LVR latent 状态中的信息坍缩与后续计算可用信息，但纯序列、无视觉证据，迁移可行性待验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Compression Through Time: An Interplay of Separability, Stationarity and Capacity

**abstract/A1：** Information-theoretic and geometric compression have been widely studied as possible explanations for generalization. Yet their temporal dynamics in recurrent networks remain largely unexplored. Using discretized LSTMs, whose finite embedding space enables direct estimates of information quantities, we observe pronounced compression across the final timesteps of many datasets. We explain this effect through three competing mechanisms: (i) class separability permits stronger compression at the final timestep; (ii) shared recurrent dynamics propagate this pressure across timesteps with similar activation states, making its extent depend on temporal stationarity; and (iii) limited representational capacity opposes prolonged compression because it restricts information available for subsequent computation. We systematically test these mechanisms through controlled synthetic interventions and real-world sequence tasks. Our results identify class separability, temporal stationarity, and network capacity as key determinants of temporal compression, and suggest that compression acts as a regularizer-potentially beneficial when excess capacity is available, but harmful to generalization when it consumes memory needed for the task.

</details>

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SOAR 两阶段框架用于持续 LoRA 学习：先把 A 矩阵约束到 Stiefel 流形以缩小坐标错位，再用正交 Procrustes 过程对齐 B 矩阵，并辅以按秩保留的合并策略，以在不增加内存的情况下缓解多任务下的表示对齐不足。

**相关性简评：** 其正交子空间对齐与「directional agreement」逐秩合并，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的对齐、融合与贡献分配提供可核查的方法线索，但原文属持续微调场景，与推理期状态生成的距离需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Making LoRA Identifiable: Orthogonal Alignment for Continual Learning

**abstract/A1：** There is growing interest in applying Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) to Continual Learning, as it enables faster training, mitigates catastrophic forgetting, and facilitates better adaptation to new tasks. Prior approaches have explored a range of strategies, including extending new LoRA branches for each incoming task, training under orthogonal loss objectives across all task-specific LoRA modules, and employing gating mechanisms to integrate new and existing LoRA modules. However, these methods incur memory costs that grow linearly with the number of tasks, limiting their scalability. More recent approaches investigate training a single LoRA by leveraging asymmetries in its parameterization; however, they often suffer from insufficient representational alignment across the LoRA parameter space. To address these limitations, we propose Stiefel Optimization and Aligned Rotation (SOAR), a two-stage framework for continual LoRA learning. First, we constrain the A matrix to lie on the Stiefel manifold, thereby reducing coordinate misalignment to the space of orthogonal rotation matrices. Second, we introduce an Orthogonal Procrustes alignment procedure for the B matrix to estimate the optimal rotation, coupled with a per-rank retention merging strategy that quantifies directional agreement between representations of new and previously learned tasks. We conduct extensive experiments across multiple models and benchmarks, demonstrating that SOAR achieves strong continual learning performance without incurring additional memory overhead.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 375. [3D-VITAL: Visibility-aware Identity Training from Artificial Liftings of 3D Reconstruction model for Cross-View Object Re-Identification](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16692v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16692

**作者：** William Grolleau、Astrid Sabourin、Guillaume Lapouge、Catherine Achard

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16692v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16692v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文面向单视角航拍-地面跨视角物体重识别，用单视图3D网格重建将源图像提升为带纹理网格并渲染新视角作为训练数据，提出逐像素可见性图，并以 CVCF 过滤几何错误的网格、以 VAAS 引导注意力聚焦可靠区域。

**相关性简评：** 可见性图作为渲染副产品区分「源视角可见」与「模型须幻觉」的区域，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、幻觉内容抑制与注意力监督提供方法线索，但任务本身是 ReID，其向多模态推理内部状态的迁移价值尚待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** 3D-VITAL: Visibility-aware Identity Training from Artificial Liftings of 3D Reconstruction model for Cross-View Object Re-Identification

**abstract/A1：** We address the Cross-View Object Re-Identification (ReID) task, aiming to match identities across drastically different viewpoints. We focus on Single-View Aerial-Ground ReID (SV AG-ReID), where models train on one viewpoint and must generalize to another at inference. To bridge this viewpoint gap, related work employs generative models to synthesize novel views from source images as additional training data. We leverage recent advances in large-scale single-view 3D mesh reconstruction to lift source images into textured meshes and to render them from new viewpoints. However, this pipeline produces unreliable data in two distinct ways. First, the reconstruction may fail and produce geometrically incorrect meshes, resulting in severe corruption in rendered novel views. Second, even when the geometry is correct, the rendered novel views contain hallucinated textures in regions not visible in the source image. The reconstructed mesh carries a per-pixel partition between regions visible from the source view and regions that the reconstruction model had to hallucinate, available as a deterministic byproduct of rendering. We introduce this per-pixel visibility map and exploit it in a two-stage design. Cross-View Consistency Filtering (CVCF) discards geometrically incorrect meshes by ensuring multi-view consistency between source and novel views over visible patches. Visibility-Aware Attention Supervision (VAAS) leverages the visibility map to guide the model's attention toward reliable regions of the rendered view during training. Combined, these two components enable our method, 3D-VITAL, to better leverage the synthetic signal from single-view 3D mesh reconstruction. 3D-VITAL sets a new state-of-the-art on three SV AG-ReID benchmarks. Code and data will be released at https://github.com/TurtleSmoke/3D-VITAL.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (poster)

</details>

### 376. [Attention-Graph Curvature for the Verification of Mathematical Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16709v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16709

**作者：** Kanghyeon Kim、Johannes F. Lutzeyer、Yanzhu Guo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16709v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16709v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该工作在纯文本数学推理上检验注意力图的有向 Forman 曲率是否携带推理步骤正确性信息：在 ProcessBench 上为四种逐步骤验证器分别加入曲率特征，四者平均表现均提升，其中以全部 token 为输入的 ReProbe 提升最大，但前向耗时平均增加约 18%。

**相关性简评：** 提供「以注意力图局部几何作为步骤正确性信号」的轻量验证线索，可能可供核查其迁移到 latent 推理轨迹的错误检测与停止决策，并对应注意力结构对 latent 状态影响的兴趣点；但该文限于文本数学推理、未涉及视觉或多模态，适用性需人工核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Attention-Graph Curvature for the Verification of Mathematical Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Language models have recently solved open Erdős problems and achieved gold-medal level performance on International Mathematical Olympiad problems. But their solutions, written in natural language, cannot yet be verified by proof assistants. An erroneous reasoning step can invalidate every step that comes after, so it is advantageous to detect errors early. Several methods have been proposed to detect erroneous reasoning quickly based on the features of the forward pass of the language model that performs reasoning. In this work, we study whether the directed Forman curvature of that model's attention graph, a local quantity computed at an edge from the attention weights around it, carries information about a step's correctness. To do so, we evaluate four per-step verifiers on ProcessBench with and without the curvature appended to their input. Appending curvature values improves the overall mean performance of all four verifiers. ReProbe, the verifier that takes every token of a step as input, shows the largest improvement. Adding the curvature increases the time of the language model's forward pass by 18% on average.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at the 6th Workshop on Mathematical Reasoning and AI (MATH-AI), NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 377. [Trace-to-Architecture: Capability Bottleneck Diagnosis for Harness Revision](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16725v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16725

**作者：** Wenfeng Wang、Jianrui Shi、Mingang Guo、Jiayuan Ma、Yuqi Lu、Jiajun Sun、Guojiang Zhao、Jing Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16725v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16725v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Trace-to-Architecture（T2A）框架：用成功与失败任务的执行轨迹作为证据诊断 agent 的失败，修正 harness 组件，并迭代验证目标任务提升、已有成功任务不退化以及修改确实被触发，在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、AppWorld 上超过基线。

**相关性简评：** 其「执行证据定位失败→修改机制→验证改动实际触发」的闭环，可能为 LVR 中判断视觉或 latent 证据是否真正参与答案、以及贡献归因与监督设计提供可迁移线索，但仅属方法借鉴，尚需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Trace-to-Architecture: Capability Bottleneck Diagnosis for Harness Revision

**abstract/A1：** Improving an LLM agent requires knowing what to change when it fails. Similar failures can require different fixes, and resolving one problem can expose another. We introduce Trace-to-Architecture (T2A), a framework that uses execution trajectories to determine what to change in an agent's harness and when those changes apply. A development agent diagnoses failures using execution evidence from successful and failed tasks, revises the corresponding harness components, and then checks whether target tasks improve, selected successful tasks remain successful, and the edits are actually triggered. New execution evidence guides subsequent diagnosis and revision. Across ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and AppWorld, T2A achieves the highest aggregate score for all three evaluated task agents, exceeding their respective strongest baselines by 6.2--30.3 points. We also integrate T2A's diagnosis and validation procedures into Meta-Harness, improving the resulting harnesses' mean ScienceWorld score by 21.6 points from the same starting harness.

</details>

### 378. [Image Tokenizers Should Be Trained Between Images](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16759v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16759

**作者：** Ole Beißwenger、Jan-Niklas Dihlmann、Hendrik Lensch

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16759v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16759v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 InterpTok：微调 MAETok 的解码器，使其能把两张图像码的混合解码为自然图像，用判别器判断混合结果是否自然、并用混合比例损失约束信息保留，从而提升插值质量与匹配生成器的 FID。

**相关性简评：** 该工作对 latent 码空间中「训练样本之间」区域做显式监督，并以比例损失防止坍缩，可能为 LVR 中处理不在训练分布的 latent 推理状态、维持其内容保真与监督方式提供可核查的方法线索；本身属图像生成，与多模态推理主线关联间接。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Image Tokenizers Should Be Trained Between Images

**abstract/A1：** Latent diffusion models generate images as codes of an image tokenizer, whose decoder turns them into the pixel image. Recent tokenizers improve how well these codes reconstruct an image and how easily a generator learns them. Yet a generator does not reproduce the codes of training images, and when a generated code lands outside what the decoder expects, the decoded image contains imperfections. Current methods make the decoder more robust to generated codes by adding noise during training. However, generated codes lie between the training codes and resemble their mixture more than one of them plus noise. To improve generated images, decoders should therefore be trained on codes in the space between training samples. We propose InterpTok, which fine-tunes MAETok to decode mixtures of image codes into natural images. Since no target image exists between two training samples, a discriminator judges whether each decoded mixture looks as natural as its two sources. A mixing ratio loss requires the decoded mixture to keep the mixing ratio of the two codes. Together, they prevent collapse to a trivial solution and yield a sharp and natural composition of both images. InterpTok keeps MAETok's reconstruction quality and improves interpolation quality more than threefold, the best of all tokenizers in a recent benchmark. Beyond interpolation, InterpTok improves the generation FID of a matched diffusion transformer from 11.61 to 8.48 without guidance, and even reaches 8.11 at an eighth of the sampling steps, where the generator on MAETok's codes worsens. The generator trained on our tokenizer also reaches the final result of the one trained on MAETok at half the training steps. Our findings show that the space between image codes can and should be explicitly supervised rather than ignored.

**comment/C1：** Project page: https://graphics.cs.uni-tuebingen.de/papers/interptok/

</details>

### 379. [Separating Prompt Harmfulness from Interaction Safety via Partial Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16761v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16761

**作者：** Ram Vikas Mishra、Shashank Aggarwal、Jahnavi Kumar、Amit Awekar

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.IR、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16761v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16761v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文区分「提示词有害性」与「交互安全性」，用 Llama、Gemma、Qwen 等七个开源模型构建 4 万余条提示-响应对，并训练分类器仅凭部分已生成响应预测响应级危害，从而支持边生成边判断、必要时提前停止。

**相关性简评：** 其「观察部分输出即做停止决策」的思路与 LVR 中基于部分推理状态判断是否继续、何时终止的问题可能相通，可供核查前缀信号能否迁移到 latent 状态的 early-stop 与验证机制。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Separating Prompt Harmfulness from Interaction Safety via Partial Generation

**abstract/A1：** LLM-based information systems need safety guardrails. Most guardrails classify the prompt alone. If the prompt looks harmful, the system rejects it before any answer is generated. This is costly. Many rejected prompts would have received a safe response. Users lose help they should have received from the information system. This cost grows as conversational and generative search becomes common. Prompt-level labels treat harm as a property of the query. But harm depends on what the model actually writes. Existing input-output guards do look at responses. But they judge a finished response, so the decision comes after full generation. However, we observe that safety of model interaction with the input prompt can be inferred early with only partial output. So the system can start generating, watch the partial response, and stop only if it turns harmful. We test this idea in three steps. First, we build a dataset of 41,944 prompt-response pairs with seven open weights LLMs from three families: Llama, Gemma, and Qwen. Second, we show that prompt harmfulness and interaction safety differ. Prompt labels and response labels agree on only 50.46\\% of items (Cohen's $κ$ = 0.06). Of the prompts that make any model respond harmfully, only 3.5\\% do so for all seven LLMs. Third, we show that partial responses carry most of the signal. Fine-tuned classifiers predict response-level harm well (best AUPRC 0.885, F1 0.807). About one third of the response tokens recover almost full-response AUPRC.

</details>

### 380. [Towards Complementary Keypoint Detection via Mixture of Detectors](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16762v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16762

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16762v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16762v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Mixture of Detectors（MoD），先把异构关键点检测器蒸馏进单一模型，再用轻量 router 按图像块、以关键点预算为条件选择最合适的检测器，并用下游匹配质量驱动的奖励训练路由，在 MegaDepth、ScanNet、HPatches 上验证。

**相关性简评：** 其「按局部区域、预算条件化选择检测器 + 任务驱动奖励」的机制，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、LOOK 位置决策与算力预算下动态计算分配提供可核查的方法线索，但该文本身不涉及多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Towards Complementary Keypoint Detection via Mixture of Detectors

**abstract/A1：** Keypoint detection plays a central role in geometric vision pipelines. Existing detectors exhibit complementary strengths across different scene structures and keypoint budgets, and reliance on a single detector often results in suboptimal keypoint distributions. Motivated by this observation, we propose \\textbf{Mixture of Detectors (MoD)} for dense matching pipelines, a unified framework for complementary keypoint detection through the adaptive composition of heterogeneous detectors. MoD first distills heterogeneous detectors into a unified model, allowing diverse detection maps to be predicted efficiently within a single forward pass. Detector selection is subsequently formulated as a patch-wise, budget-conditioned decision process, in which a lightweight router assigns the most suitable detector to each local region. To avoid heuristic supervision, the router is trained with task-driven rewards derived from downstream matching quality, jointly capturing both keypoint quantity and precision. Extensive experiments on MegaDepth, ScanNet, and HPatches demonstrate that MoD consistently outperforms strong baselines across a wide range of keypoint budgets, demonstrating its effectiveness in improving keypoint distribution and downstream geometric performance.

**comment/C1：** NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 381. [Relational Learning as World Modeling](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16763v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16763

**作者：** Zheyu Zhang、Gjergji Kasneci

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16763v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16763v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 TabWM，把每个关系型运行系统视为一个「世界」，用少量已观测执行轨迹作上下文、在不更新参数的情况下预测新动作引发的稀疏结构化编辑（需匹配操作、关系位置与取值），并配以可执行关系世界生成器 WorldRel 做预训练；预测出的编辑可递归展开以想象候选未来并比较动作。

**相关性简评：** 其「以执行轨迹为上下文预测状态编辑、再递归想象与搜索验证」属于可核查的状态更新与搜索线索，可能为 LVR 的 latent 状态更新、轨迹条件训练和候选验证提供参照，但领域为关系数据库、与视觉证据筛选无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Relational Learning as World Modeling

**abstract/A1：** Relational learning typically predicts from a database state, but decision making asks a different question: how will that state change under an action? In operational systems, the answer depends on system-specific dynamics that may not be visible in the database itself. We view each such system as a relational "world" and ask whether a model can infer how it behaves from observed executions. We introduce TabWM (Tabular World Model) and WorldRel, a generator of executable relational worlds for pretraining. Given executions from an unseen world, TabWM uses them as context to predict the sparse structured edits caused by a new action without parameter updates. Across 512 held-out worlds, complete-edit F1 rises from 0.016 with no observed executions to 0.685 with 64, where a correct edit must match its operation, relational location, and value. Because these predictions are explicit relational edits, they can be applied recursively to imagine candidate futures and compare actions before they are taken. Broader search over these predicted futures improves the realized return of selected action sequences. Together, these results suggest that relational dynamics can be learned in context, broadening relational learning from modeling system state to modeling how that state changes under action.

</details>

### 382. [TPPO: Tracking-Value PPO For Language Model Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16794v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16794

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16794v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16794v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 TPPO：利用相邻前缀价值在 log-odds 空间满足贝叶斯加性分解，把 critic 改为按位置标量输出累加的值 logits，并仅用终端结果监督学习重构价值，在多个 Qwen 模型与数学、倒计时、科学编程任务上提升推理分数与分布外泛化。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本 RL 工作，不涉及视觉状态或 latent 生成，但其「沿轨迹追踪值演化」与按位置加性参数化、终端监督可能为 LVR 的贡献分配、latent 状态逐步更新与信用监督提供可核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TPPO: Tracking-Value PPO For Language Model Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) is widely used in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards for language-model reasoning. While \\emph{value evolution along trajectory} characterizes relative token-level credit, yet standard critics often fail to track it under sparse terminal rewards. To model this evolution, we analyze the relation between successive prefix values and show that they admit a Bayesian decomposition with additive updates in log-odds space. We use this additive structure to construct Tracking-Value PPO (\\method), a cumulative value parameterization that sums position-wise scalar outputs into value logits. These outputs are learned through terminal-outcome supervision on the reconstructed values. \\method improves aggregate mathematical reasoning scores over PPO by 7.0 and 8.4 points on Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen3-8B-Base, respectively, while improving out-of-distribution generalization. Gains extend to Qwen3-4B, Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B, Qwen3.5-9B and to countdown, and scientific coding tasks. Further analysis shows more accurate tracking of value evolution and more reliable advantage estimates. Our code is publicly available in https://github.com/LINs-lab/TPPO.

</details>

### 383. [Growing to See: Efficient Pretraining of Self-Supervised Vision Transformers](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16817v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16817

**作者：** Amir Mohammad Karimi Mamaghan、Ferdinand Kapl、Andrea Dittadi、Karl Henrik Johansson、Kaitlin Maile、Johannes von Oswald、Stefan Bauer

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16817v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16817v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文系统研究渐进式深度增长（先训练浅层网络、再逐步插入层）在 MAE 与 DINOv3 两类自监督视觉 Transformer 预训练中的作用，报告下游性能提升、训练 FLOPs 降低 13.9–24.8%，并分析中间层表示与内部注意力模式（全局/局部注意力的交替与推进）的变化。

**相关性简评：** 属纯视觉自监督预训练，未涉及多模态推理或 latent 生成；但其「逐步增深改变中间表示与内部注意力结构」的观察，可供核查分层递进式计算、深度增长是否影响推理状态组织与训练成本分配的线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Growing to See: Efficient Pretraining of Self-Supervised Vision Transformers

**abstract/A1：** Progressive depth growth builds large networks by starting with shallow models and inserting layers during training. Recent advances in large language models have renewed interest in this longstanding approach, demonstrating benefits for training efficiency and reasoning alongside changes in internal computations. However, how growing affects representation quality and computational patterns in self-supervised vision transformers remains unclear. In this work, we systematically investigate progressive depth growth in two popular self-supervised families, namely masked autoencoders (MAE) and DINOv3, and analyze how growing affects downstream performance, intermediate representations, and internal computations. Across global and dense tasks, we show that growing improves downstream performance while reducing training FLOPs by 13.9--24.8%, with ImageNet linear-probe accuracy gains of up to 3.36 percentage points. Growing also improves downstream performance at intermediate layers and reshapes internal computational patterns, introducing recurring alternations between global and localized attention in MAE and earlier local-to-global attention progression in self-distilled DINOv3. Together, these findings establish progressive depth growth as an effective and efficient pretraining strategy for improving downstream performance across global and dense visual tasks with less computation, and advance our understanding of how growing shapes visual computation.

</details>

### 384. [DTA-GT: Direction- and Topology-Aware Graph Transformer for Neural Network Representation Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16822v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16822

**作者：** Yuxiang Zeng、Kun Xie、Yang Wang、Jigang Wen、Xiaocan Li、Guangxing Zhang、Gaogang Xie、Jiannong Cao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.NE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16822v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16822v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 DTA-GT，一个方向与拓扑感知的图 Transformer，通过在节点初始化、谱编码、成对交互和特征更新各阶段保持有向一致性，把神经网络架构（有向 DAG）编码为表示以预测精度或延迟，在 NAS-Bench-101/201 的有限预算设定下优于序列、GNN、Transformer 及混合预测器。

**相关性简评：** 其「全编码器方向一致性」设计（方向感知初始化、Magnetic Laplacian 谱编码、方向对偶结构注意力、方向敏感 MoE-FFN）可能为在 latent 状态中保留有向关系与拓扑结构提供可核查的注意力结构线索，但与视觉多模态推理无直接关联，需较多核查其可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DTA-GT: Direction- and Topology-Aware Graph Transformer for Neural Network Representation Learning

**abstract/A1：** Architecture attribute predictors reduce the cost of neural architecture search by estimating accuracy or latency from a small set of evaluated candidates. The key difficulty is that neural architectures are operation-labeled DAGs: edge direction defines computational flow, but existing predictors often treat direction as a local structural cue. We propose DTA-GT, a Direction- and Topology-Aware Graph Transformer based on encoder-wide directional consistency, which preserves directed computational semantics across node initialization, global spectral encoding, pairwise interaction, and feature update. DTA-GT realizes this principle with direction- and topology-aware node initialization, Magnetic Laplacian spectral encoding, direction-dual structural attention, and a Direction-Sensitive MoE-FFN. Across accuracy and latency prediction on NAS-Bench-101 and NAS-Bench-201, DTA-GT consistently outperforms representative sequence-, GNN-, Transformer-, and hybrid predictors under limited-budget settings. Ablations and Magnetic spectral controls show that the improvements come from coordinated direction-aware stages and edge-orientation-sensitive spectral information, while mechanistic diagnostics confirm that the modules exhibit the intended directional behavior. These results support encoder-wide directional consistency as an effective design principle for architecture DAG representation.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 36 pages, 6 figures

</details>

### 385. [The Bell Boundary of Shared Representations](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16828v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16828

**作者：** Yang Wu、Hanyu Zhao、Yazhou Zhang、Yuexian Hou

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16828v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16828v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 借用 Bell 定理研究多任务共享表示何时不足以同时支持多个任务，提出受控多任务模型 NCnet，发现随表示容量出现 \|S\| 越过并回归 CHSH 界的系统性转变（Bell Boundary）。

**相关性简评：** 其 CHSH 型可测量诊断或可迁移用于核查 LVR 内部 latent 状态是否因容量受限而丢失任务必要信息，与表示瓶颈、信息坍缩线索相关，但如何映射到视觉推理状态仍需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The Bell Boundary of Shared Representations

**abstract/A1：** When does a shared representation become insufficient for jointly supporting multiple tasks? This question lies at the heart of multi-task learning models. Although task interference in shared representations has been widely observed, its onset, measurable form, and capacity boundary remain poorly understood. In this paper, we revisit this problem through the lens of Bell's theorem. We show that if four binary task outcomes can be jointly represented by a common shared representation, their correlations must satisfy the classical CHSH bound $\|S\|\\leq2$. We introduce NCnet, a controlled multi-task model for studying how representational capacity affects task compatibility. Experiments reveal a clear capacity-dependent transition. Once nontrivial task fitting emerges, constrained capacity can yield $\|S\|&gt;2$. As capacity further increases, these exceedances progressively disappear and $S$ returns to the bounded region. This systematic pattern provides evidence that limited representational capacity is an important source of the observed incompatibility. We observe similar transitions across CNNs, PLMs, and LLMs, suggesting that the phenomenon extends beyond the controlled NCnet setting. We refer to this capacity-dependent transition as the Bell Boundary, providing a measurable diagnostic for representation bottlenecks, task incompatibility, and capacity allocation in multi-task models.

</details>

### 386. [Davinci-Tool: Scaling Agentic Tool-Use Supervision with Verifiable Executable Environments](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16867v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16867

**作者：** Xiaoyang Yuan、Ji Zhao、Xingyu Hu、Wenhan Wang、Yutao Hu、Qiaosheng Zhang、Pengfei Liu、Yu Qiao、Yi Bin、Wenqi Shao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16867v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16867v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Davinci-Tool（30B 工具使用模型）与 Davinci-ToolData 数据集，通过「执行落地任务合成」与「可执行环境合成」两条管线，构造带可恢复状态、执行轨迹、结果与验证器的监督数据，先做 SFT，再复用环境状态与验证器构造结果导向偏好做 DPO，在多个多轮工具调用基准上大幅提升。

**相关性简评：** 属纯文本 agent 工具调用训练工作，与视觉 latent 推理无直接关系；但其「可执行验证器＋状态化任务＋结果导向偏好」的监督构造方式，可能为 LVR 的训练期监督与贡献分配提供可核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Davinci-Tool: Scaling Agentic Tool-Use Supervision with Verifiable Executable Environments

**abstract/A1：** Reliable agentic tool use requires training data that pair diverse multi-step workflows with executable evidence that the requested outcomes were achieved. Scaling either trajectory coverage or verification alone is insufficient as new environments introduce distinct states, rules, and dependencies that must also be reflected in the success criteria. To address this challenge, we introduce Davinci-Tool, a 30B tool-use model, and Davinci-ToolData, an execution-grounded dataset designed to scale environment coverage and outcome verification together. Davinci-ToolData preserves restorable states, execution traces, outcomes, and verifiers as a unified substrate for supervision. Two complementary pipelines populate this substrate: Execution-Grounded Task Synthesis (EGTS) derives verified demonstrations from independently authored systems, and Executable Environment Synthesis (EES) synthesizes auditable environments, state-grounded tasks, and executable verifiers across single and coordinated domains. These pipelines yield 30,395 verified trajectories spanning 2,260 invoked tool names. We first train on these demonstrations with supervised fine-tuning, then reuse EES states and verifiers to compare alternative actions and construct outcome-grounded preferences for Direct Preference Optimization. Davinci-Tool improves Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct from 52.4 to 88.2 on $τ^2$-bench, from 30.4 to 62.8 on BFCL v4 multi-turn, and from 16.9 to 56.2 on MCP-Atlas, outperforming Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct on all three benchmarks with only 1/16 of its total parameters. Code is available at https://github.com/MassLab-SII/Davinci-Tool.

**comment/C1：** 27 pages, 4 figures, 13 tables. Code: https://github.com/MassLab-SII/Davinci-Tool

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16878v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16878v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究 EHR 基础模型预训练中训练序列的组成方式——患者轨迹如何拼接成 token 窗口、是否允许跨患者注意力——并提出可控制各轨迹贡献程度的组合方法与全局流基线对比，在 MIMIC-IV 等任务上取得提升。

**相关性简评：** 序列组合方式与跨边界注意力是否泄漏，可能为 LVR 中推理轨迹训练数据的组织、状态监督与贡献分配提供可核查线索；但该工作属 EHR 领域，能否迁移到 VLM 推理训练仍需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Sequence Composition in EHR Foundation Model Pretraining

**abstract/A1：** Autoregressive electronic health record (EHR) foundation models predict the next event token in patient trajectories: sequences of structured medical events. A typical pretraining strategy is to concatenate all trajectories into a global stream and sample token windows from it. This gives patients with longer sequences more training exposure and allows tokens to attend across patient boundaries. We argue that these choices create a misalignment between pretraining and downstream clinical tasks. To explore this, we investigate how the composition of pretraining sequences affects clinical prediction performance. Using the global-stream approach as a baseline, we propose alternative sequence composition methods that control how patient trajectories contribute to pretraining sequences. Across four MIMIC-IV v2.2 tasks, our best method improves macro AUROC, AUPRC, F1, and balanced accuracy, with relative gains of 9.3% in F1 and 2.7% in AUPRC under a fixed training recipe. We find that these gains generalize across four additional evaluation settings, including the INSPIRE and eICU-CRD datasets, with improvements in macro AUROC, AUPRC, and F1 score. Our results show that simply changing how EHR data are presented to the model during pretraining can improve downstream performance, without changing the model or collecting additional data.

**comment/C1：** 26 pages, 11 figures, 10 tables

</details>

### 388. [EviStress: Evidence Stress Learning for Generalizable Face Forgery Detection with Textual Explanations](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16879v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16879

**作者：** Jiuyao Jing、Xuanyu Yi、Yu Zheng、Chunlei Peng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16879v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16879v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 EviStress 两阶段框架做可泛化人脸伪造检测并附文本解释：第一阶段用 ETPP 从全局、关系与语义线索估计 patch 级决策依赖并对其施加相关扰动，配合 DVP 约束扰动前后表示残差以保留判别信息；第二阶段把适配后的 CLIP 作为 LLaVA 视觉塔做参数高效指令微调。

**相关性简评：** 其 patch 级「决策依赖」估计与定向扰动，可能为诊断视觉证据筛选与信息坍缩提供可核查线索，但任务是人脸伪造检测而非推理，能否迁移到 VLM 推理状态仍需核实。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** EviStress: Evidence Stress Learning for Generalizable Face Forgery Detection with Textual Explanations

**abstract/A1：** The rapid spread of face forgeries on the Web challenges the credibility of visual content. In practical Web environments, manipulated media originate from evolving generation pipelines and undergo diverse processing during dissemination, making reliable authenticity assessment under unseen manipulations and visual changes a critical challenge. We observe that a standard LoRA-adapted CLIP detector exhibits uneven patch-level decision dependence, concen trating a disproportionate share of class-specific relevance on a small fraction of visual patches. To improve robustness to variations in such highly dependent evidence, we propose EviStress, a two-stage framework for generalizable face forgery detection with textual explanations. In the first stage, Evidence-Targeted Patch Perturbation (ETPP) estimates patch dependence from global, relational, and semantic cues and assigns positively correlated perturbation probabilities, explicitly stress-testing highly dependent visual evidence during training. We further introduce Discriminative Variation Preservation (DVP), which constrains the residual between clean and perturbed representations to retain authenticity discriminative information. In the second stage, Intrinsic Evidence Instruction Tuning (IEIT) transfers the adapted CLIP encoder into LLaVA as its vision tower and performs parameter-efficient multimodal instruction tuning, enabling authenticity prediction and textual explanation directly from the learned forgery-sensitive representation without an external detector. Experiments demonstrate improved cross-dataset and cross-method generalization and corruption robustness, with the multimodal model providing authenticity predictions and human-readable explanations.

</details>

### 389. [Mining Cross-Modal Perception Gaps in Autonomous Driving: When Camera and LiDAR Disagree](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16906v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16906

**作者：** Hongsen Cao、Mona Jaber、Shanxin Yuan、Ahmed Sayed

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16906v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16906v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文在 nuScenes、KITTI、Waymo 上按「哪些模态检测到」给每个真值目标打标，构建约 0.4M 目标数据库，并用按距离分区条件化的 Shapley 归因（SSFA）分析相机与 LiDAR 的感知差异，最后把归纳出的模态可靠性图通过轻量注意力层注入四种预训练融合检测器。

**相关性简评：** 其按空间分层做 Shapley 贡献归因、并把模态可靠性作为可审计量注入注意力层的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与跨模态／跨层贡献分配提供可供核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Mining Cross-Modal Perception Gaps in Autonomous Driving: When Camera and LiDAR Disagree

**abstract/A1：** Multi-modal fusion for 3D object detection assumes that cameras and LiDAR are broadly complementary. In practice, how much each modality is trusted at a given location is decided by learned weights that are neither characterized nor auditable. We label every ground-truth object by which modalities detected it, then mine the resulting 0.4M-object database across nuScenes, KITTI, and Waymo. Because the patterns shift with distance from the ego vehicle, we read the mined model through Spatially Stratified Feature Attribution (SSFA), which conditions Shapley attribution on distance zones and exposes structure that global attribution averages away. Three assumptions built into the current fusion design do not hold. The modality-preference boundary tracks the object itself: a traffic cone is nearly six times as likely as a truck to be seen by the camera alone (16.8% vs. 2.9%), regardless of range. Camera-only detections peak at 10-30 m, inside the band usually ceded to LiDAR, and fall away on either side. The drivers of failure are not additive either: the distance - density interaction alone outweighs the entire main effect of viewing direction. We further find that modality dominance is directionally non-stationary, with objects behind the vehicle being markedly more LiDAR-dominant than those in front. We compile the mined structure into a Modality Reliability Map and inject it into four pretrained fusion detectors through a lightweight attention layer. This improves performance by up to 1.3 mean Average Precision (mAP) while fine-tuning under 4% of their parameters in 2-3 GPU-hours. Our work lifts reliability out of the weights and treats it as a quantity that can be examined before deployment. That is what a safety measure for multi-modal perception must rest on.

</details>

### 390. [ConDenseDrive: Knowledge-Dense, Token-Sparse Visual Encoder for End-to-End Autonomous Driving](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16908v1>)

**作者：** Shengzhen Li、Yongkang Li、Hao Gao、Chenxi Wu、Yajing Sun、Lu Hou、Wenyu Liu、Xinggang Wang
