**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 ConDenseDrive，一个面向端到端自动驾驶的视觉编码器：先从三个视觉基础模型蒸馏视觉、语义与几何知识，再用 register token 承载多帧时空上下文，最后通过 register 引导的 token 压缩减少冗余 patch 计算，在 NAVSIM 与 HUGSIM 上评测规划性能与加速比。

**相关性简评：** 其 register token 汇聚时空上下文、并据此压缩 patch token 的设计，与 LVR 中「哪些视觉细节需留在内部状态、压缩是否导致信息坍缩」的问题结构相近，可供核查 token 稀疏化后任务必要信息的保留情况与成本收益，但属远领域线索，需人工判断可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ConDenseDrive: Knowledge-Dense, Token-Sparse Visual Encoder for End-to-End Autonomous Driving

**abstract/A1：** End-to-end driving requires rich spatiotemporal representations to support scene understanding and trajectory planning under strict latency constraints. However, most systems initialize their visual encoders from generic image pretraining and densely process all patch tokens for each camera view and input frame, limiting both representation quality and inference efficiency. To address these challenges, we present ConDenseDrive, a knowledge-dense and token-sparse visual encoder for end-to-end autonomous driving. Our three-stage framework first makes the encoder knowledge-dense by distilling complementary visual, semantic, and geometric knowledge from three vision foundation models. It then adapts the distilled encoder to multi-frame end-to-end driving and integrates spatiotemporal context into register tokens for planning. Finally, it makes the encoder token-sparse by applying register-guided token compression, reducing redundant patch computation and yielding a 2.0$\\times$ speedup while improving planning performance. ConDenseDrive achieves 94.5 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 and 90.8 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2, and reaches 37.4 HD-Score in zero-shot evaluation on HUGSIM. Extensive experiments and qualitative analyses demonstrate that visual encoder design provides an effective route to reliable and efficient end-to-end driving.

**comment/C1：** 17 pages, 8 figures

</details>

### 391. [UniMetric: Universal Metric Scale Recovery for Visual Geometry Foundation Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16945v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16945

**作者：** Lei Yang、Yuner Zhang、Ziyang Liu、Ziying Song、Kai WU、Yiyang Gao、Jiangtao Su、Yiming Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16945v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16945v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出免训练的 UniMetric：用 VLM 提取熟悉物体的高度先验，与重建几何沿支撑面法线对齐为尺度区间，再以凸目标做序列级全局尺度恢复，并发布 MetricBench 在九个几何基础模型上评测。

**相关性简评：** 将 VLM 语义先验转成区间约束、再全局协调多个局部几何观测的做法，或可供核查 LVR 中多假设 latent 的证据筛选与尺度一致性校准；论文本身不涉及 latent 推理状态的生成与使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** UniMetric: Universal Metric Scale Recovery for Visual Geometry Foundation Models

**abstract/A1：** Recent advances in multimodal foundation models, exemplified by GPT-6 Astra, raise the prospect of general-purpose embodied reasoning and planning. Using Internet videos for embodied pretraining calls for reliable physical-scale annotations. Yet visual geometry foundation models often recover scene structure and camera motion without reliable metric scale. We show that uncertain size priors of familiar objects can jointly constrain a reconstruction's shared scale. Building on this insight, we present UniMetric, a universal and training-free metric scale recovery framework for geometry foundation models, without additional sensors or task-specific metric supervision. Specifically, Metric Prior Acquisition elicits object height intervals from a vision-language model. Semantic-Geometric Alignment measures reconstructed object heights along the estimated support-surface normal in each frame and converts the priors into scale intervals. Global Scale Recovery reconciles these intervals through a convex objective, yielding a jointly feasible scale when they overlap and a unique compromise otherwise. The estimated sequence-level scale is applied uniformly to reconstructed points and camera translations. Controlled experiments with real VLM priors show that combining observations improves scale accuracy with exact relative object heights. To evaluate metric accuracy on GFM reconstructions without ground-truth scale alignment, we introduce MetricBench, covering twelve embodied, driving, and roadside subsets with sensor-derived ground truth. Across nine geometry foundation models, UniMetric reduces mean depth Abs Rel, reconstruction Chamfer distance, and trajectory error by 54.2%, 83.8%, and 65.6%, respectively, improving every model on all three tasks at the suite level. We release the UniMetric code and MetricBench data.

**comment/C1：** 39 pages. Technical report. Code: https://github.com/yanglei18/UniMetric ; Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/yanglei18/MetricBench

### 392. [DDVR-Net: Degradation-Aware Decoupling and Visibility-Guided Restoration for Historical Document Recognition](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16956v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16956

**作者：** Jiu Sha、Yu Weng、Mengxiao Zhu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16956v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16956v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 DDVR-Net 历史文献识别框架：在特征层面解耦字形结构与环境退化，预测字符局部可见度以估计其可靠性，并用可见度门控选择性激活上下文解码器修复退化字符；同时构建藏、蒙、维三种文字的低资源多语言基准。

**相关性简评：** 其「局部可见度预测 + 门控上下文解码」线索可能与 LVR 中视觉证据可靠性筛选、何时依赖语言先验或停止视觉采样的决策问题相关，可供核查；但研究对象是文档 OCR 而非 VLM 推理，迁移性需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DDVR-Net: Degradation-Aware Decoupling and Visibility-Guided Restoration for Historical Document Recognition

**abstract/A1：** Historical document analysis is crucial for cultural heritage preservation and low-resource language digitization. However, real historical documents often suffer from severe degradation, such as ink erosion and structural damage, causing mixed-visibility character sequences. Conventional OCR systems struggle in such evidence-limited scenarios, while contextual language models may over-correct visually clear characters. To address these challenges, we propose DDVR-Net, a degradation-aware decoupling and visibility-guided restoration framework for historical document recognition. DDVR-Net decouples intrinsic glyph structures from physical corruption at the feature level and predicts local visibility to estimate character reliability. A contextual decoder is selectively activated through a visibility-guided gate, restoring degraded characters while preserving clear visual recognition. Furthermore, we construct a low-resource multilingual benchmark covering Tibetan, Mongolian, and Uyghur scripts with 187000 document pairs, combining large-scale synthetic data and progressive training with real-world annotations to reduce the synthetic-to-real gap. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DDVR-Net consistently outperforms existing methods across three languages and diverse reading orders, providing an effective framework and benchmark for low-resource historical document recognition. Code and Benchmark: https://github.com/Shajiu/DDVR-Net

**comment/C1：** 18 pages. Accepted to the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM MM 2026)

</details>

### 393. [Learning to Design SR Solvers: Harness Optimization for Symbolic Regression](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16966v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16966

**作者：** Qian Li、Yuxiao Hu、Qihao Duan、Jinyue Yan、Yuntian Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16966v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16966v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 HarnessSR：把符号回归（SR）agent 的提示与工作流本身当作优化对象，先用方程发现反馈优化角色提示，再联合搜索提示分配与工作流，并依据残差模式、候选方程结构与搜索结果反思精炼角色指令，在 LLM-SRBench 上取得明显提升。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉/多模态主线无直接关系，但「把 agent 脚手架（提示与工作流）作为优化目标、用搜索过程中的数值反馈迭代精炼」这一方法线索，可能可供核查——用于 LVR 中推理 scaffold 的设计与监督信号/贡献分配，属推测性借鉴。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning to Design SR Solvers: Harness Optimization for Symbolic Regression

**abstract/A1：** Symbolic regression (SR) seeks explicit equations that explain observed data, and recent methods increasingly employ large language models (LLMs) and agents for equation discovery. However, these systems typically rely on manually designed workflows and prompts. We argue that the SR agent harness should itself be an optimization target: its design shapes search priors and how numerical feedback guides subsequent equation refinement. We therefore propose HarnessSR, a framework for jointly optimizing prompts and workflows to construct reusable SR agents. During both harness optimization and agent execution, HarnessSR supports either PySR or an LLM-based equation generator through tool-specific interfaces, allowing the framework to optimize search guidance for different equation-discovery mechanisms. HarnessSR first optimizes role prompts through equation-discovery feedback in basic workflows, then jointly searches prompt assignments and workflows with brief adaptation to align the two. Finally, it refines role instructions through reflection on residual patterns, candidate equation structures, and search outcomes, improving how these signals guide subsequent equation search. On LSR-Synth in LLM-SRBench, HarnessSR achieves a mean ID $\\mathrm{Acc}\_{0.01}$ of 61.33% across three backbones, a 45.0% relative improvement over the next-best baseline.

</details>

### 394. [MADDIE: Multi-Agent Drug Discovery Engine](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16975v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16975

**作者：** Ye Liu、Reza Averly、Avery Meyer、Frazier N. Baker、Ruoxi Gao、Daniel Adu-Ampratwum、Xia Ning

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16975v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16975v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** MADDIE 是一个多智能体药物发现引擎，由中央 Orchestrator 与四个专职 worker（HitIdentifier、LeadOptimizer、Synthesizer、Evaluator）组成，可动态组合成灵活工作流；在 50 个蛋白靶标上生成满足关键性质要求的分子及合成路线，优于现有 agent 系统与生成模型。

**相关性简评：** 其 Orchestrator 的按目标改编策略、动态编排与 Evaluator 独立验证，可能为 LVR 中的验证机制、停止决策与计算分配提供方法线索；但工作为纯文本、领域应用，无 latent 状态，线索需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MADDIE: Multi-Agent Drug Discovery Engine

**abstract/A1：** Drug discovery remains a resource-intensive and time-consuming process, involving billions of dollars and a decade of development to advance a drug to market. While many in silico tools have accelerated this process, operating them still demands substantial time, effort, and expertise from medicinal chemists. Autonomous systems built on Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as a promising solution, yet current designs limit their performance. Existing single-agent systems scale poorly to long-horizon, multi-step, and realistic tasks, whereas multi-agent systems typically execute predefined workflows that cannot capture the iterative, non-linear nature of a real drug discovery campaign. Here, we present MADDIE, a multi-agent drug discovery engine. It comprises a central agent, Orchestrator, and four specialized worker agents: HitIdentifier, LeadOptimizer, Synthesizer, and Evaluator, each representing a critical step in a drug discovery campaign. Under Orchestrator's orchestration and coordination, these worker agents are composed into flexible workflows, enabling MADDIE to adapt its strategy and navigate the drug discovery pipeline end-to-end. Across 50 protein targets, MADDIE produces molecules satisfying key property requirements and their synthesis routes, outperforming existing agentic systems, generative models, and general-purpose LLMs by a wide margin. Our analysis reveals how these agents collaborate and that MADDIE can employ different strategies across targets to achieve the campaign's goal, while still being efficient in time and tokens. Together, they demonstrate MADDIE as a low-cost, effective, and efficient autonomous engine for accelerating drug discovery. Code and dataset is available via https://github.com/ninglab/MADDIE.

</details>

### 395. [From Suboptimal to Optimal: One-Step Latent Flow Policies for Offline Reinforcement Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16984v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16984

**作者：** Shenghua Lu、Zixuan Yang、Rongxu Zhao、Bohao Qu、Jifeng Hu、Hechang Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16984v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16984v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 MF2B，把离线 RL 重构为高层潜决策空间中的生成式决策块优化：用编码器将轨迹块映射为潜决策表示，学习共享条件平均速度场，构造由高斯源指向行为决策区域、由次优决策指向高价值区域的两条流映射，一步 ODE 即可完成精修，并用分层块级优势引导流向。

**相关性简评：** 与 VLM 推理无直接关联，但其「从当前状态到更优状态」的一步潜空间流映射、共享速度场与块级压缩，可能为 latent 推理状态的一步更新与长度、计算成本压缩提供可供核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** From Suboptimal to Optimal: One-Step Latent Flow Policies for Offline Reinforcement Learning

**abstract/A1：** Offline reinforcement learning aims to learn effective policies from fixed datasets without environment interaction. Although generative models such as diffusion and flow matching enhance policy expressiveness, they typically start from uninformative Gaussian noise and generate actions through multi-step iteration, leading to high computational costs and failing to effectively leverage suboptimal trajectories in datasets. We propose MeanFlow2Better (MF2B), which reformulates offline RL as generative decision chunk optimization from current performance status to better performance status in a high-level latent decision space. MF2B maps trajectory chunks to high-level latent decision representations through an encoder, placing generation starting points within a structured decision space sculpted by behavioral data. The model learns a shared conditional mean velocity field in this space, constructing two flow mappings: from Gaussian-Induced Decision Sources toward positive behavioral decision regions, and from suboptimal decisions toward high-value decision regions. Both flow mappings complete decision refinement through one-step ODE integration over the unit time interval $Δt=1$, requiring neither multi-step iterative sampling nor backpropagation through time. Furthermore, we propose hierarchical chunk-level advantage to guide the flow direction toward high-return regions, where the high-level decisions cover multiple low-level actions, leading to sequence length compression from $T$ to $K \\approx T/H$ and significantly lower computational overhead. On the D4RL Gym-MuJoCo benchmark, MF2B achieves an average score of 90.91, matching or surpassing strong baselines.

</details>

### 396. [Self-Supervised Learning of Semantically Consistent Visual Features via a Simple 3D Prior](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16988v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16988

**作者：** Sebastian Day、Oisin Mac Aodha

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16988v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16988v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出一种自监督视觉特征学习方法：用简单的类别级 3D 先验替代实例级分析合成，通过对比学习和数据集级分布匹配学习类别粗形状与外观，并辅以几何损失，使特征全局与局部统计接近真实图像，从而缓解对称或重复部件导致的左右歧义。

**相关性简评：** 该方法用分布匹配与几何损失约束视觉特征的统计与几何一致性，可能为 LVR 中视觉表征的细节与几何信息保留、对称歧义消解提供可核查的正则化线索，但不涉及推理期状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Self-Supervised Learning of Semantically Consistent Visual Features via a Simple 3D Prior

**abstract/A1：** Visual features extracted from vision models like DINOv2 or Stable Diffusion enable high quality semantic correspondence between images. However, such features exhibit documented limitations that hinder accurate correspondence estimation such as the inability to disambiguate the left from right for categories exhibiting symmetries or repeated parts. Previous attempts to improve these features rely on using supervised data such as annotated keypoint pairs or camera pose information, or make restrictive topological assumptions, such as modelling the object of interest as a 3D sphere. We introduce a new self-supervised approach that allows us to learn features for topologically complex object categories using a simple prior. Instead of relying on an expensive instance-level analysis by synthesis pipeline, our approach makes use of contrastive learning and distribution matching at the global dataset-level to learn the coarse shape and appearance of a category. Combined with additional geometric losses, this enables us to replicate the global and local statistics of visual features which match those that are extracted from real images. Quantitative results are presented across several challenging object categories, demonstrating the effectiveness of our approach.

</details>

### 397. [Glasseek: A Transparent Recipe for Training and Trustworthy Evaluation of DeepSearch Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16998v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16998

**作者：** Cong Pang、Jiaqi Su、Chengrui Wu、Kuihao Yan、Tianrui Zhang、Zixuan Qiu、Chao Lin、Zixiu Lin、Zixuan Chen、Zelin Xiao、Tiankuo Yao、Jiawei Hong、Zixuan Chen、Dan Xu、Lewei Lu、Wenjie Wang、Xin Lou

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16998v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16998v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** Glasseek 提出一套全透明的深度搜索智能体开发框架，公开数据、模型权重、训练配方与代码，包含可验证的轨迹构建流程、Compaction-Managed GSPO 训练方法，以及对开放网络检索中测试集泄漏的系统审计与模块化防泄漏评测插件。

**相关性简评：** 该文属纯文本检索智能体，与 LVR 无直接关系；但 CM-GSPO 在上下文压缩边界上只优化执行子轨迹、屏蔽摘要段，可能为 latent 推理状态的训练—推理不一致与贡献分配提供可供核查的线索，防泄漏评测思路亦可能类比视觉旁路与证据真实使用的检验。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Glasseek: A Transparent Recipe for Training and Trustworthy Evaluation of DeepSearch Agents

**abstract/A1：** Deep search enables language agents to solve complex information-seeking tasks through iterative web exploration. However, developing robust open-source agents remains challenging for three reasons. First, opaque trajectory-construction pipelines make training data difficult to audit and reproduce. Second, context compression can create a substantial mismatch between training and inference. Third, agents may retrieve benchmark content from the open web during evaluation, contaminating the results and overstating their performance. To overcome these bottlenecks, we introduce Glasseek, a fully transparent deep search framework spanning the complete development lifecycle, releasing all data, model weights, training recipes, and code. Specifically, for data construction, we establish a verifiable trajectory curation pipeline that systematically generates high-quality exploration paths. For training, we propose Compaction-Managed GSPO (CM-GSPO), which uses the same policy for search and summarization while optimizing only execution sub-trajectories, enabling end-to-end search-policy training across context-compaction boundaries. For evaluation, we conduct the first systematic audit of test-set leakage in open-web agents and release a modular anti-leakage plugin that seamlessly integrates into existing evaluation harnesses. Under this rigorous evaluation protocol, our 9B agent outperforms frontier proprietary agents across almost all deep research benchmarks spanning diverse task types, and achieves the best overall performance among recent open-weight agents, setting a new state of the art at the 9B scale.

</details>

### 398. [MaskSense: Confronting the Visual Exploration Trap in Masked Image Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17009v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17009

**作者：** Yawen Shao、Jie Xiao、Kai Zhu、Yu Liu、Hongchen Luo、Xueyang Fu、Yang Cao、Wei Zhai、Zheng-Jun Zha

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17009v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17009v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文指出掩码图像生成模型用于强化学习时存在「视觉探索陷阱」，即基于置信度的采样会为了贪婪解析低不确定性背景而牺牲主体多样性，导致探索空间提前坍缩；为此提出 MaskSense，用语义锚定路由采样保留高熵主体 token 的探索，并用全局熵转变锚定策略把梯度集中到最关键的若干解码步，在文本到图像基准上大幅提升。

**相关性简评：** 其「用熵识别关键解码步并集中更新」以及掩码解码中的探索—坍缩机制，可能为 LVR 的动态计算分配、latent 步贡献分配与 THINK/LOOK/STOP 取舍提供可核查的方法线索；但该工作属图像生成场景，迁移是否成立需人工验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MaskSense: Confronting the Visual Exploration Trap in Masked Image Generation

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement learning (RL) has shown strong potential for aligning generative models with human intent, but adapting RL to masked generative models (MGMs) remains largely underexplored. Existing approaches that directly adapt Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to MGMs leave a foundational conflict unaddressed: MGMs' exploitative decoding nature is inherently at odds with the exploratory diversity that GRPO presupposes. In this work, we reveal a structural decoding bias termed the visual exploration trap: confidence-based sampling trades the exploration of diverse subject realizations for the greedy resolution of low-uncertainty background regions, causing premature collapse of the generative exploration space and starving GRPO of the rollout diversity it depends on. To this end, we propose MaskSense, a novel RL framework for MGMs that confronts the visual exploration trap at both the sampling and optimization stages. Specifically, we introduce a semantic anchored routing sampling mechanism that leverages semantic priors to preserve high-entropy subject token exploration while amplifying intra-group reward variance through exploratory-exploitative routing to yield more discriminative advantage estimates. Furthermore, we design a global entropy transition anchoring strategy to identify the most consequential decoding steps and concentrate gradient updates on them. Extensive experiments on multiple text-to-image benchmarks demonstrate that MaskSense substantially improves upon the base model, with GenEval accuracy improving from 54% to 86% and HPS from 28.89 to 36.39, achieving state-of-the-art performance.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Project Page: https://yawen-shao.github.io/MaskSense/

</details>

### 399. [Gradient Routing Localizes and Removes Unintended Behaviors in RL](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17062v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17062

**作者：** Jake Ward、Shawn Hu、Aria Wong、Nathan Hu、Bryce Woodworth、Alexander Matt Turner、Alex Cloud

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17062v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17062v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 GRAFT，将监控器标记样本上的梯度更新约束到一组新增的「牺牲」参数，以避免模型学会隐藏奖励黑客行为，并可通过消融这些参数削弱或消除非预期行为；在 135M–8B 的 RL 环境及蒸馏 Qwen3-32B 上验证。

**相关性简评：** 其「按样本路由梯度 + 参数消融定位行为」的做法，可能为 LVR 中轨迹训练的贡献分配、监督信号隔离以及用消融检验 latent 状态因果作用提供训练侧线索，但论文不涉及视觉输入或 latent 推理，迁移性待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Gradient Routing Localizes and Removes Unintended Behaviors in RL

**abstract/A1：** We propose a mitigation to reward hacking in reinforcement learning. Our setup involves a misspecified reward function that gives rise to unintended behavior, and a monitor used to detect unintended behavior. As with frontier AI systems, the monitor makes systematic errors. Consequently, using the monitor for data filtering or to apply a reward penalty fails to prevent the model from learning unintended behavior ("reward hacking"). To address this problem, we introduce GRAFT: Gradient Routing Adapter Fine Tuning. Rather than penalizing or filtering flagged samples during training, GRAFT constrains gradient updates on those samples to a sacrificial set of new parameters. This has two benefits: First, because the monitor is not part of the reward function, the model does not learn to hide misbehavior. Second, ablating the sacrificial parameters reduces or entirely stops the unintended behavior while maintaining improved performance on target tasks. We demonstrate these benefits in RL environments where reward penalties cause models to learn to reward hack in undetected ways, training models ranging from 135M to 8B parameters. Additionally, we show a similar effect at a larger scale by distilling frontier LLM trajectories containing reward hacking into Qwen3-32B, without teaching that model to reward hack. Overall, our work suggests GRAFT may be a promising approach for leveraging imperfect monitors during post-training in settings where true performance is difficult to evaluate.

</details>

### 400. [TILE: Bridging LLMs and Table Foundation Models for Tabular Learning with Strings](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17065v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17065

**作者：** Félix Lefebvre、David Holzmüller、Gioia Blayer、Myung Jun Kim、Marine Le Morvan、Gaël Varoquaux

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17065v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17065v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** TILE 研究如何为含字符串列的异构表格构造 LLM 表示，提出行序列化、取中间层、按列池化以及让数值与类别特征绕过 LLM 的旁路设计，再与表格基础模型结合，在 100 个数据集与 STRABLE 上取得领先。

**相关性简评：** 其「中间层而非末层抽取」与「旁路特征」两条接口经验，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的取层选择、池化方式及视觉旁路/模态捷径提供可核查的对照线索，但论文本身面向表格预测，未涉及视觉推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TILE: Bridging LLMs and Table Foundation Models for Tabular Learning with Strings

**abstract/A1：** Real-world tables are often heterogeneous, combining numerical features with free-form string columns. Table foundation models (TFMs) excel on numerical tables but require strings to be encoded numerically, while large language models (LLMs) hold semantic knowledge but are not designed for tabular predictions. Most existing bridges use LLMs as plug-in encoders for cell strings, yet how to extract representations effectively for tabular learning remains underexplored. We show that the interface between LLMs and tables matter as much as the LLM itself. Applied cell-wise, larger LLMs do not give better features. With our interface, the same LLMs improve steadily with size. TILE (Table-Interfaced LLM Embeddings) combines four ingredients: row serialization to provide cross-column context, intermediate-layer extraction to avoid layers specialized for next-token prediction, columnar pooling to remove mean pooling's length bias, and by-pass features to route numbers and categories past the LLM. Paired with TFMs, TILE sets a new state of the art for tables with strings. Across 100 datasets, it beats the strongest baseline on 89% of splits, with gains across 7 LLMs and 10 tabular learners, and ranks first on the 108-dataset STRABLE benchmark.

</details>

### 401. [PerturbBridge: Direct Phenotypic Supervision for Cellular Perturbation Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17066v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17066

**作者：** Yucheng Yang、Xiaoxiao Sun、Huangqingbo Sun、Elaine Sui、Emma Lundberg、Serena Yeung-Levy

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17066v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17066v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出随机 data-to-data bridge 生成模型 PerturbBridge，训练时经冻结图像编码器回传可微生物响应损失，直接监督生成图像的扰动表型，并在三个显微图像基准上以更少采样步数取得更好的表型保真度与图像质量。

**相关性简评：** 属细胞图像生成、非 LVR 主线，但其「冻结编码器 + 可微任务损失直接监督生成内部状态」的训练设计，可能为 LVR 中如何用下游任务损失监督 latent 推理状态、缓解信息坍缩与贡献分配提供可核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PerturbBridge: Direct Phenotypic Supervision for Cellular Perturbation Generation

**abstract/A1：** Virtual cell models should capture phenotypes induced by specific perturbations. However, image-based models are typically trained and evaluated to match real-image distributions, which alone does not explicitly prioritize perturbation-specific biological responses. Recent approaches add biological signals through reinforcement-learning post-training or inference-time steering, raising a central question: where should biological response information enter the generative pipeline? We introduce PerturbBridge, a stochastic data-to-data bridge model that directly supervises perturbation-specific phenotypes in predicted perturbed images during training. PerturbBridge jointly optimizes bridge regression and differentiable biological response losses, with biological gradients passing through a frozen image encoder. We further introduce perturbation-response evaluations based on downstream classification and retrieval. Across three microscopy benchmarks for perturbation profiling and subcellular imaging, PerturbBridge surpasses CellFlux in biological fidelity, image quality, and sampling efficiency. On BBBC021, mechanism-of-action classification improves by 5.66 and 7.5 percentage points with morphological and learned visual features, respectively. On JUMP and AllenCell, retrieval Hit@10 and Hit@1 improve by 1.77 and 7.15 percentage points, respectively. On BBBC021 and JUMP, PerturbBridge achieves lower FID with 80% fewer model evaluations than CellFlux. Overall, these results show that directly supervising perturbation responses during training improves phenotypic fidelity while enabling efficient cellular image generation. Code is available at https://github.com/yyc1215lll-creator/PerturbBridge.

**comment/C1：** 25 pages, including appendix

</details>

### 402. [Scaling Unified Multimodal Models to Long-Horizon Interleaved Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17080v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17080

**作者：** Ziqiao Peng、Yutao Cui、Wang Lin、Zhong-Yu Li、Qingwen Gu、Tianhui Song、Chengyou Jia、Guozhen Zhang、Xuerui Qiu、Qixun Wang、Miles Yang、Zhao Zhong、Yonglong Tian、Hongyan Liu、Jun He

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17080v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17080v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究如何把统一多模态模型的交错文本-图像生成扩展到长时程自回归轨迹，提出包含持久视觉参考、选择性检索场景相关历史状态与少步自 rollout 的视觉记忆框架，并构建 LongMIG-Bench 评测长时程多图生成。

**相关性简评：** 其「选择性检索历史视觉状态」与「自 rollout 适应不完美历史」的做法，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选、轨迹训练与上下文累积导致的信息坍缩提供可核查线索，但该工作侧重图像生成一致性而非推理状态，迁移性需阅读正文确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Scaling Unified Multimodal Models to Long-Horizon Interleaved Generation

**abstract/A1：** Unified multimodal models (UMMs) provide an interface for interleaved text-image generation, where generated visual states can directly inform subsequent reasoning and synthesis. However, existing systems are still primarily demonstrated on short trajectories or simplified visual content. We develop a large UMM natively trained on interleaved multimodal data, with strong capabilities in image synthesis, text rendering, complex composition, and multimodal planning, and study how to extend these native capabilities to substantially longer autoregressive trajectories. The main challenge is that generated images continuously accumulate in context: irrelevant or imperfect visual states interfere with future synthesis, while previously established characters and scenes must still be recovered after long intervals. We introduce a visual-memory framework that maintains persistent visual references, selectively retrieves scene-relevant historical states while preserving the complete semantic history, and uses few-step self-rollout to adapt the model to imperfect generated histories. We further introduce LongMIG-Bench for evaluating long-horizon text-to-multi-image and image-to-multi-image generation. Our model achieves high-fidelity long-horizon interleaved generation with strong character and scene consistency, demonstrating how visual memory can scale native interleaved generation to substantially longer trajectories.

**comment/C1：** 29 pages, 11 figures

</details>

### 403. [SFT Leaves a Reproducible Signature in Activation Geometry: Calibrating Post-Training Interpretability Against Run-to-Run Noise](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17093v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17093

**作者：** Xupeng Chen、Chenqian Le、Jiayi Cheng、Runhao Li、Michael Yue

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17093v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17093v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文在 Qwen3-1.7B 的稀疏共激活图上测量 base→SFT 的位移，用多次 LoRA-SFT 重跑之间的差异作为噪声带做校准，认为 SFT 留下可复现的结构位移，而 DPO/GRPO 的读数未形成一致结论；再用预注册的因果扫描检验被位移的来源是否真正承担作用，并主动把结论限定为「经校准的结构位移」而非机制改变。

**相关性简评：** 「以重跑噪声校准内部表示层面的发现」与「用因果扫描判断被位移成分是否 load-bearing」两条做法，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态或视觉证据的因果贡献、贡献分配与解释稳健性；但研究对象是纯文本模型的后训练分析，不含视觉或多模态推理，属方法线索而非主线工作。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SFT Leaves a Reproducible Signature in Activation Geometry: Calibrating Post-Training Interpretability Against Run-to-Run Noise

**abstract/A1：** A model diff credits post-training with whatever separates a base checkpoint from one post-trained descendant, presuming a rerun would land close by. On the sparse co-activation graph of Qwen3-1.7B it does not: two LoRA-SFT reruns sit over half as far apart as either sits from the base. We score each base-to-post contrast against the run-to-run band of its own recipe, and show that $k$ runs certify no better than $p=1/(k+1)$ under run exchangeability, however large the effect, so the band $z$-score is a descriptive scale. SFT leaves a large, reproducible signature: base $\\to$ SFT displaces the graph by 17.8 pairwise-distance SDs beyond the mean distance between four independent LoRA-SFT runs, and the pre-registered estimator replicates on Llama-3.1-8B with Llama-Scope. At 29 steps each, four SFT and four DPO runs occupy disjoint displacement ranges, a gap $5.0\\times$ and $5.6\\times$ the spreads of the two arms, without any band. All bands use graphs built on one GPU architecture. Three other readings stop short of a verdict: DPO band counts (3/4, 1/4, 3/4 contrasts outside at 12, 29, 60 steps) show no consistent dose ordering while its displacement stays flat; light GRPO is a secondary non-detection, not an absence, and we run no equivalence test; and the graph concentration read as an RL signature is already in the zero-RL base. A pre-registered causal sweep at three edge budgets on 4,816 held-out prompts found the displaced sources load-bearing ($12\\times$ a matched random control in mean, $3.5\\times$ in median at 10,000 edges), but their stage-specificity interaction reversed at two budgets and the third failed its faithfulness gate, so we claim calibrated structural displacement, not a changed mechanism. Scope: one backbone, one SFT recipe and general-text probe states for the full protocol.

</details>

### 404. [Towards Universal Calibration for In-Context Classification](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17096v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17096

**作者：** Awik Dhar、Sunita Sarawagi、Arpit Agarwal

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17096v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17096v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 CALIBFORMER，一个基于 transformer 的通用 ICL 校准器：用上下文示例上的模型预测来预测测试输入的置信度；在三个模型、十个任务上训练后可泛化到未见任务与四个 LLM，在 Gemini 上把校准误差降低逾 50%。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本 ICL 校准，与视觉 latent 推理无直接关系；但其「读取上下文示例的预测结果、免微调地估计置信度」的思路，可能为 LVR 中答案可信度评估与停止（STOP）决策提供可核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Towards Universal Calibration for In-Context Classification

**abstract/A1：** In-Context Learning (ICL) has received a lot of interest recently due to its ability to improve classification accuracy for new tasks without having to fine-tune the model over these tasks. However, the impact of ICL on calibration has been far less studied. Recent work has shown that ICL can have a negative impact on calibration due to biased selection of in-context examples. The existing methods for improving ICL calibration require additional task and model-specific training, detracting from the no-fine-tuning convenience of ICL. In this work, we introduce CALIBFORMER, a universal ICL calibrator for classification tasks, that generalizes to new models and tasks without further fine-tuning on these tasks. Specifically, we design a transformer-based calibrator which uses the model predictions on in-context examples to predict a confidence score for the test input. We show that the calibrator trained on three models and ten tasks, is able to generalize/calibrate ICL predictions on several new tasks and four LLMs unseen during training. Even for frontier models like Gemini, CALIBFORMER is able to obtain over 50% reduction in calibration error.

**comment/C1：** 30 pages, 11 figures, 19 tables, AACL-IJCNLP Findings accepted

</details>

### 405. [Masked Attention Pooling Is Invariant to Padding and Permutation: A Formal Proof in Lean](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17132v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17132

**作者：** Yusuf Khaled Sadek、Enes Yilmaz

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17132v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17132v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 用 Lean 4 与 mathlib 形式化定义带守卫归一化器的掩码注意力池化，证明其在行置换和追加任意掩码行下不变、掩码位置取值无关、全掩码输出为零，并经 jax-lean 证书流程把定理连接到 JAX kernel 导出的 Jaxpr 实数语义（仅限理想实数算术）。

**相关性简评：** 其「掩码行不影响池化结果、掩码处取值无关」的严格结论，可能与 LVR 中视觉 token 掩码、剪枝或填充是否改变注意力池化与 latent 状态这一证据筛选问题相关，可供核查；但对象是 MIL 池化的理想实数算术，未涉及多模态推理，联系偏间接。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Masked Attention Pooling Is Invariant to Padding and Permutation: A Formal Proof in Lean

**abstract/A1：** Attention-based multiple instance learning (MIL) pools a variable-size bag of instance embeddings into one vector. In batched training, bags are padded to a common length, and the pooled output is expected not to depend on how much padding was added or on the order in which instances are stored. This expectation holds only if padded rows are removed from both the numerator and the softmax normalizer. Common implementation idioms meet it only under side conditions. Zeroing padded features alone does not work. Masking logits with $-\\infty$ fails on empty bags and on nonfinite padding. Masking with a large negative constant is exact only after floating-point underflow. We define masked attention pooling with a guarded normalizer and prove in Lean 4 with mathlib that it is invariant under any bijective reindexing of rows and under appending any finite number of masked rows with arbitrary real features and logits. We also prove that values at masked positions are irrelevant and that an all-masked bag maps to zero. The theorems hold for arbitrary finite index types and feature dimensions. Using the jax-lean certificate pipeline, we connect these theorems to the Jaxpr traced from the JAX kernel itself. Lean checks translation certificates for two concrete shapes, identifies the generated functions with the generic specification, and transfers both invariances to the imported Jaxpr's real-arithmetic semantics. All audited theorems depend only on Lean's three standard axioms. The results concern ideal real arithmetic. Floating-point execution, XLA, and the JAX tracer and importer remain outside the proof.

**comment/C1：** 9 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Code: https://github.com/y2x0/masked-attention-lean

</details>

### 406. [MARS: Systematic Multi-Level Acceleration for World Action Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17141v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17141

**作者：** Zengyuan Zuo、Yongchang Zhang、Guangyu Zhao、Tianze Zhang、Biao Wu、Meng Fang、Yiwu Zhong

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17141v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17141v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文剖析世界动作模型（WAM）联合预测未来世界状态与机器人动作时的推理开销，提出免训练、即插即用的 MARS 框架：选择性删除低影响注意力计算、按运动粒度自适应加速扩散去噪，并对跨查询复用的预测视觉表征做在线校验，在 LIBERO、RoboCasa 与真机上取得最高约 4 倍加速且成功率接近原策略。

**相关性简评：** 其「推测复用未来视觉表征＋在线校验」与低影响计算/去噪步的自适应裁剪，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态缓存复用的安全性与动态计算分配提供可供核查的方法线索，但研究对象是机器人动作策略而非 VLM 推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MARS: Systematic Multi-Level Acceleration for World Action Models

**abstract/A1：** World Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising alternative for embodied intelligence by jointly predicting future world states and robot actions. However, their heavy visual encoding and iterative generative inference incur substantial latency, limiting their applicability to high-frequency closed-loop control. Existing training-free acceleration methods typically optimize a single stage, yielding limited speedups or degraded control under aggressive reuse. In this work, we systematically profile the inference overhead of WAMs and observe abundant redundancy across Transformer computation, diffusion denoising, and consecutive policy queries. However, the safe removal of such redundancy depends strongly on its impact on action prediction and control sensitivity. Based on these observations, we introduce \\textbf{MARS}, a training-free and plug-and-play framework for multi-level WAM acceleration. MARS selectively removes low-impact attention computation, adaptively accelerates diffusion inference according to motion granularity, and speculatively reuses predicted future visual representations across consecutive queries with online verification. Together, these complementary mechanisms provide remarkable acceleration while limiting approximation error. Extensive experiments across LIBERO, LIBERO-PRO, and RoboCasa show that MARS achieves up to $4.00\\times$, $3.94\\times$, and $2.10\\times$ end-to-end speedups, respectively, while maintaining task success rate close to the original policy. Moreover, MARS generalizes across different model backbones and across simulation and real-robot experiments, substantially improving the efficiency--performance trade-off of WAM inference. Our code is available at https://github.com/PKU-VaLuE-Lab/MARS.

</details>

### 407. [FunDM: Cheap &amp; Label-Free Decision Models from Frozen Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17175v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17175

**作者：** Ujjawal K. Panchal

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17175v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17175v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 FunDM：在冻结语言模型上只取约三分之二的 transformer 层并接入一个轻量决策头，用 KL 散度对齐完整模型的选项概率分布，无需正确答案标签训练，用于候选答案打分与 agent 运行筛选。

**相关性简评：** 从冻结骨干的中间层状态训练无标签决策头来预测答案或动作概率，可能为 LVR 中基于 latent 状态的停止、验证或价值估计头及其训练监督提供可核查线索，但该工作为纯文本、未涉及视觉推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FunDM: Cheap &amp; Label-Free Decision Models from Frozen Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Decision models such as Jev score candidate answers or actions. A small decision head trained label-free can recover about 99% of a frozen language model's multiple-choice accuracy while using only two-thirds of its transformer layers. It learns the full model's answer probabilities with KL divergence, without correct-answer labels for training. One backbone pass reads the question and all options together; the head returns probabilities for every option. We call this model FunDM (Fun Decision Model). Using 24 of Qwen3-8B's 36 layers and skipping the LM head, its +1T variant reaches 75.0% mean accuracy over eight benchmarks, versus 75.7% for the full model. On MMLU-Pro, both heads achieve 1.56 to 1.57 times batched vLLM throughput with about one-third lower peak GPU allocator memory. Both heads score higher than released Contrastive Language Models (CLM), fine-tuned CLM, and CLM-shaped heads trained from scratch on the eight multiple-choice benchmarks and coding-agent selection. Separately trained agent heads learn judge probabilities without pass/fail labels and select passing runs for 74.4 to 74.6 of 100 held-out tasks on average, versus 74 for the full-model judge and 52.0 for a CLM-shaped action-trained head. Code is available at: https://github.com/Ujjawal-K-Panchal/FunDM

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17190

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、physics.geo-ph

**内容简述：** 提出 CartoVec：用 Overture 开放地图数据在多个空间尺度上预测土地覆盖、土地利用、交通、地点与连通性目标，训练一个无需图像输入和下游标签的坐标编码器，并在冻结嵌入上评估美国东北部的 Census、Airbnb 价格与犯罪率预测，推理时不需要地图检索。

**相关性简评：** 其「多尺度结构化目标做无下游标签监督」与「冻结表示＋空间分块交叉验证」的协议，可能可供核查能否迁移到 VLM 内部视觉状态的多尺度空间/关系信息保留与 latent 质量评估上。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CartoVec: General-Purpose Location Embeddings from Open Map Data

**abstract/A1：** Geographic coordinates are common inputs in applied machine learning, but latitude and longitude describe position rather than the surrounding environment. Image-grounded location encoders learn this context from satellite or ground-level imagery; structured open map data offers another source of supervision whose utility for continuous coordinate encoders remains less explored. We introduce CartoVec, a coordinate encoder trained to predict Overture-derived land cover, land use, transportation, place and connectivity targets at multiple spatial scales, without image inputs or downstream-task labels. We evaluate frozen embeddings on Census outcomes, Airbnb prices and Philadelphia crime in the US Northeast using spatial block cross-validation. CartoVec has the highest mean performance on most Census outcomes and the highest average across the full suite, with several comparisons close across folds. The findings support open map data as a practical source of reusable location representations with a coordinate-to-vector interface that requires no map lookup at inference. The open-weight model is available at https://huggingface.co/gursoyfurkan/CartoVec.

### 409. [Multics: Generative Multi-Player World Model with Hierarchical Communication](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17201v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17201

**作者：** Kaiyi Huang、Wangbo Yu、Yukun Huang、Jiwen Yu、Kunhao Liu、Donglin Yang、Wenbo Hu、Ying Shan、Xihui Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17201v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17201v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Multics，一个多玩家交互视频世界模型生成框架：用玩家—分组—全局的三层层次化通信（引入 group token 作为中间表示）替代全连接通信，并基于相机轨迹做预算受限的动态分组。

**相关性简评：** 其 group token 聚合、跨组共享参数以适配可变实体数、以及按预算动态分组的机制，可能为 LVR 中多实体 latent 状态的层次化聚合、通信路由与动态计算分配提供方法线索，可供核查；但该工作属视频世界模型领域，与 VLM 推理的联系尚需确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Multics: Generative Multi-Player World Model with Hierarchical Communication

**abstract/A1：** Multi-player interactive world models aim to simulate shared environments from multiple players' perspectives, but achieving robust generation while scaling to more players remains challenging. Existing approaches that rely on fully-connected communication (e.g., Solaris) incur quadratic attention costs as the number of players grows, while centralized approaches (e.g., $γ$-World) suffer from interference between unrelated events in a shared global representation. To address these challenges, we present Multics, a multi-player video generation framework with hierarchical communication that structures information exchange across player, group, and global levels. This hierarchy introduces group tokens into self-attention as intermediate group-level representations that aggregate locally relevant player information. These tokens connect to global tokens for cross-group communication, while the hierarchical topology limits direct mixing between unrelated local events. Group-token parameters are shared across group slots, allowing the same communication module to accommodate varying numbers of players without introducing new group-specific parameters. We further propose budget-constrained dynamic grouping based on recent camera trajectories, which adaptively groups relevant players while limiting unnecessary communication. Experiments demonstrate that Multics achieves state-of-the-art performance in 4- and 6-player settings, with improved cross-player consistency, player-specific action and camera controllability, and interference robustness. Moreover, Multics generalizes from 4-player training to 6-, 8-, and 10-player inference without retraining, while reducing self-attention computation compared with fully-connected communication.

**comment/C1：** Project page: https://karine-huang.github.io/Multics/

</details>

### 410. [Releasing the Inner Jev: A Simple Recipe for Open Decision Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17205v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17205

**作者：** Jonathan Geuter、Andrew Cheng、David Alvarez-Melis

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17205v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17205v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文指出开源指令模型无需训练即可在单次前向中从末位 token 对应的选项字母 logits 读出答案，接近 Jev 这类「System One」决策模型，并用 LoRA 加由语言模型头切片初始化的决策头微调进一步提升，同时发布 2,352 题的 OpenDecisions 验证集。

**相关性简评：** 其「跳过文本生成、直接从末位 token 的 logits 或决策头读出答案」以及选项概率校准评价的做法，可能为 LVR 中从 latent 状态解码答案、评估候选置信度提供可核查线索；但论文纯文本、无视觉输入与 latent 推理，与主线联系较间接。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Releasing the Inner Jev: A Simple Recipe for Open Decision Models

**abstract/A1：** LLM-based decision-making systems, also called System One models, have recently gained popularity, most notably through Jev (Almeida, 2026). Given a typed input state, a question, and a set of options, they return a probability for each option in a single forward pass, without text generation. We show that existing open instruction-tuned language models can achieve comparable performance \\textit{without any additional training}, by reading out answers from letters (A, B, C, etc.) in the model's output logits at the last token position. Furthermore, we show how a simple supervised fine-tuning recipe can improve their performance further. We evaluate four open instruction-tuned language models: Gemma 4 31B, Gemma 4 12B, Qwen3.6-27B, and Qwen3.5-4B. We fine-tune each using LoRA and a decision head initialized from a slice of the language model head. Furthermore, we introduce OpenDecisions, a novel 2,352-question validation dataset designed to reflect the task composition of JevBench (JevBench main- tainers, 2026) and which computes a Capability score based on accuracy and calibration metrics. Without fine-tuning, Gemma 4 31B scores 79.6 on OpenDecisions, compared to Jev's 80.1. After undergoing our fine-tuning recipe, it scores 84.4 on OpenDecisions and 81.5 on JevBench v1.7, outperforming Jev by 4.3 and 4.4 Capability points respectively and setting a new state-of-the-art on OpenDecisions. On a suite of public decision datasets, our models achieve accuracy comparable to Jev, with lower calibration error. Our results show that open language models already possess System One capabilities, and with simple fine-tuning they outperform Jev on a wide range of decision tasks. We release our models, serving code, and OpenDecisions.

**comment/C1：** 23 pages, 5 figures

</details>

### 411. [CodeLift: Your Test Suite Is Secretly a Dense SWE Curriculum](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17224v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17224

**作者：** Junjielong Xu、Huachao Zhu、Alyssa Wu、Zhichao Hu、Pinjia He

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.SE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17224v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17224v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 CodeLift：指出测试通过率并不等于补丁质量，于是按「杀死相同补丁 / 通过相同测试」对测试与补丁分组，对少数补丁组能通过的测试组加权，把测试套件变成自适应课程；同时用同一打分规则给仓库快照打分，为中间动作分配信用，在 SWE 基准上提升 pass@1/2/4/8。

**相关性简评：** 其「按区分度对监督信号重加权」与「对中间状态/动作分配贡献」的思路，可能为 LVR 的轨迹训练、贡献分配及视觉证据筛选提供可核查的方法线索，但该工作面向代码智能体，与多模态推理无直接关联。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CodeLift: Your Test Suite Is Secretly a Dense SWE Curriculum

**abstract/A1：** The pass-all-test binary reward has become a standard recipe for training software engineering agents, but its sparsity eliminates difference of partially correct patches. The test pass-rate is a natural alternative. However, we find that it is not a reliable indicator of patch quality. A functionality being tested can be covered by either one challenging test or one hundred trivial tests, where the majority might be already satisfied pass-to-pass tests. We introduce CodeLift, a reinforcement learning method that dynamically calibrates pass-rate rewards, turning the test suite into an adaptive curriculum. At each iteration, CodeLift groups tests that kill the same patches and patches that pass the same tests, then gives more weight to test groups that fewer patch groups pass. This reduces the impact of majority simple tests and focuses more on what is still challenging. Within each rollout, CodeLift applies the same scoring rule to repository snapshots, assigning credit to useful actions even when later ones introduce regressions. Experiments on SWE benchmarks show that CodeLift consistently improves pass@1/2/4/8 over binary and pass-rate baselines. Analyses show that CodeLift provides dense, stable learning signals and unlocks the inherent curriculum in the test suite.

</details>

### 412. [Beyond Sparse Captions: Aligning Slide-Level Text and Patch-Level Vision in Pathology](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17233v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17233

**作者：** Daniel Shao、Dongmin Bang、Luca L. Weishaupt、Sophia J. Wagner、Nic G. Reitsam、Ming Y. Lu、Long P. Le、Richard J. Chen、Faisal Mahmood

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17233v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17233v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 LIMIT：冻结预训练视觉编码器、只微调文本编码器，让病理报告嵌入作为 cross-attention query 对 patch 特征包做注意力聚合，得到报告条件化的 slide 表示并以 InfoNCE 对齐，据此构建 CONCH-Z，在 22 项病理任务上取得零样本 SOTA。

**相关性简评：** 报告查询对 patch 特征包的 cross-attention 聚合与弱监督对齐，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、把 patch 级细节压缩进 latent 状态提供可核查的方法线索；冻结视觉塔也便于考察视觉旁路与信息坍缩，但论文本身不涉及推理过程。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Sparse Captions: Aligning Slide-Level Text and Patch-Level Vision in Pathology

**abstract/A1：** Contrastive vision-language (VL) pretraining in computational pathology has generally relied on curated image-caption datasets sourced from social media, educational videos, and research publications. These corpora are sparse relative to the diversity of tissue morphology and difficult to scale further, as pathologists do not routinely produce descriptive captions in clinical practice. We propose to instead leverage slide-level pathology reports which can be generated during routine diagnostic workflows in a scalable manner. A key challenge in this weakly-supervised setting is that pathology reports describe macroscopic, diagnostic findings while patch-level visual features describe microscopic findings. We introduce Locked Image Multiple Instance PreTraining (LIMIT), which addresses this gap by freezing a pretrained vision encoder and fine-tuning only the text encoder: report embeddings serve as cross-attention queries over bags of patch features, producing report-conditioned slide representations optimized via InfoNCE. Using LIMIT, we establish CONCH-Z, which aligns the text encoder of CONCH v1.5 to 335k clinical reports. Evaluated across 22 tasks spanning patch-level classification, tumor detection, and slide-level subtyping, CONCH-Z establishes state-of-the-art zero-shot performance over VL encoders trained on curated caption datasets, while simultaneously closing the gap with slide-level foundation models trained with substantially more parameters and compute. The code and model is available at https://github.com/mahmoodlab/LIMIT.

**comment/C1：** Neurips 2026 Spotlight

</details>

### 413. [IsoVRBench: Video Reward Modeling Without Human Feedback](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17234v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17234

**作者：** Shuyue Stella Li、Jacqueline He、Jiahui Chen、Sreya Dutta Roy、Yulia Tsvetkov、Luke Zettlemoyer、Marjan Ghazvininejad、Xiaochuang Han

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17234v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17234v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 构建 IsoVRBench：用只改变单一属性的受控干预自动生成 8,000 对视频偏好对，诊断视频奖励模型能否区分具体视觉属性，并据此训练奖励模型 IsoVRM 与生成器 IsoWan。

**相关性简评：** 其「单属性受控干预 + 自动生成偏好监督」的思路可能可供核查，用于诊断 LVR 内部状态是否保留特定视觉属性（如时序、运动），或作为免人工标注的属性判别训练信号；但论文对象是视频生成的奖励模型，与 VLM 推理期状态生成无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** IsoVRBench: Video Reward Modeling Without Human Feedback

**abstract/A1：** Video reward models are trained and evaluated on human preferences between videos that often differ simultaneously on properties such as prompt alignment, visual fidelity, motion, and generator identity. As a result, aggregate accuracy does not reveal which video properties a reward model can reliably distinguish. We construct preference pairs by controlled interventions that change one property of a generated video while holding the rest fixed. The resulting pairs, by construction, provide preferences for how the videos differ along a specific dimension, without requiring any human annotation. We propose IsoVRBench, a video generation reward modeling benchmark of 8,000 such pairs across eight interventions, and show that state-of-the-art models separate broad quality differences between generators but miss important features such as temporal order. The best reward model reaches only 60.8% on reordered frames against 100% for humans, and rankings on existing benchmarks do not predict this failure. Using the synthetic isolated intervation pairs as training data leads to 1) IsoVRM, a reward model outperforming its counterpart trained with a larger human labeled preference dataset by 3.8 points on VBench-2.0, 2) IsoWan, the video generator post-trained with IsoVRM, outperforming its human-data counterpart in human preferences, and 3) gains that stack when combined with human data. Because intervention pairs are automatically generated rather than collected, the benchmark and training data can be easily extended as generators evolve.

**comment/C1：** 20 pages, 18 tables, 6 figures

</details>

### 414. [MIRRA: Fast, High-Fidelity Molecular Generation with Chemistry-Informed Discrete Flow Matching](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17244v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17244

**作者：** Ge Sun、Juan J. de Pablo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、physics.chem-ph、physics.comp-ph

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17244v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17244v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 MIRRA，一种基于化学砌块的离散流匹配分子生成器：用化学特征在相关身份间共享信息并做上下文身份校正，采样时先决定哪些位置需要刷新再计算其概率，从而在全词表可用下实现更快、更准的生成。

**相关性简评：** 其「先决定更新位置、再计算概率」的稀疏刷新式离散状态迭代更新，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的选择性更新与动态计算成本控制提供方法线索，是否可迁移到推理期状态生成可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MIRRA: Fast, High-Fidelity Molecular Generation with Chemistry-Informed Discrete Flow Matching

**abstract/A1：** Fast, high-fidelity molecular generation requires accurate chemical choices and efficient sampling. Chemical building blocks reduce graph size, but make each node a choice among tens of thousands of related identities. We introduce MIRRA (Molecular Identity Representation, Refresh and Assembly), a discrete flow-matching generator that learns from chemical knowledge and evaluates identity probabilities only when needed, while keeping every identity in its vocabulary available. Chemical features share information across related blocks, and learned identity corrections distinguish them in molecular context. By deciding which positions will refresh before computing their probabilities, the sampler avoids unused predictions while preserving each sampling transition. Against the strongest baselines in each task, MIRRA reduces chemical and graph distribution errors on ZINC250k by 29-31% and 53-60%, respectively, with generation up to 8.6 times faster. Property targeting yields an estimated 7.8-20.8 times more distinct novel hits per second. On a held-out polymer test set, MIRRA achieves 100% periodic validity with known chain topology, versus 57.0% for a polymer variational autoencoder. These results demonstrate fast, high-fidelity generation with the full chemical vocabulary available throughout sampling.

</details>

### 415. [LLM-to-Flow Distillation: Teaching Natural Language Goals to Scientific Generators](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17246v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17246

**作者：** Riccardo De Santi、Federico Di Gennaro、Angelo Gnazzo、Sophia Tang、Pranam Chatterjee、Fanny Yang、İsmail İlkan Ceylan、Michael M. Bronstein、Andreas Krause

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17246v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17246v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 LLM-to-Flow Distillation：以冻结 LLM 作为自适应教师，为流/扩散式科学生成器构造感知其当前能力的中间子目标课程，并用 LLM 对采样候选的评判生成偏好、经 DPO 迭代蒸馏，在无显式代理奖励下对齐自然语言发现目标，于抗菌肽与小分子设计上验证。

**相关性简评：** 「LLM 评判候选样本→偏好蒸馏→稠密学习信号」与逐步子目标课程，可能为 latent 推理中的监督信号构造、贡献分配及低概率区域适配提供可核查线索；但任务属科学生成对齐，与 VLM 推理的联系需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LLM-to-Flow Distillation: Teaching Natural Language Goals to Scientific Generators

**abstract/A1：** Generative discovery in science requires coupling high-level scientific reasoning with the ability to generate samples respecting the structure of a design space. Yet these capabilities remain largely separated: foundation LLMs encode broad chemical and biological knowledge, while domain-specific flow- and diffusion-based generators capture the priors needed to produce valid sequences and geometries. We study how to align such scientific generators to high-level natural-language discovery goals without requiring an explicit proxy reward, which is often unavailable or poorly captured by learned predictors in experimental sciences. We introduce LLM-to-Flow Distillation (LFD), where a frozen LLM acts as an adaptive teacher for a domain-specific generator. Given a goal such as 'generate peptides with promising anticancer activity', the teacher constructs a curriculum of intermediate sub-goals aware of the flow's current capabilities, and progressively directs them toward the original discovery goal. At each round, the LLM judges sampled candidates under the current objective. These judgments induce preferences that are iteratively distilled into the generator through DPO. This procedure provides dense learning signals even when the initial model places negligible probability on designs satisfying the final goal, enabling adaptation toward poorly covered, out-of-distribution regions. Experiments on therapeutic peptides and small-molecule structure design demonstrate that LFD enables a new form of generative control: aligning arbitrary domain-specific scientific generators to scientific discovery tasks expressed via high-level natural-language goals.

</details>

### 416. [Does a Governed Confidence Score Know When a Text-to-SQL Answer Is Right? An Exploratory Study on BIRD and a Pre-registered Confirmation on Spider](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17256v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17256

**作者：** Raghu Venkat、Tricha Anjali

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17256v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17256v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 本文审计一套生产级 Text-to-SQL 系统的置信度评分设计，在 BIRD dev 上诊断其区分正误能力弱、扣留过多正确答案，并在预注册的 Spider dev 上验证「以样本一致性为分数、以确定性检查作否决与上限」的改法可显著提升 AUROC 并降低正确答案扣留率。

**相关性简评：** 其用样本一致性构成置信度、并以检查项作否决/上限来决定是否扣留答案（STOP 决策），以及「最小值合成会丢失排序信号、额外检查总以无资格覆盖率为代价」的结论，可能为 LVR 中停止准则与置信度组合方式的设计提供可核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Does a Governed Confidence Score Know When a Text-to-SQL Answer Is Right? An Exploratory Study on BIRD and a Pre-registered Confirmation on Spider

**abstract/A1：** Conversational analytics lets people ask questions of records spread across many systems and get answers in plain language; it is useful only if each answer can be trusted and explained. A production system of this kind attaches a confidence score to every answer it writes over a database and uses it to show the answer, show it with a warning, or withhold it. The score's weights, caps and thresholds were set by design. This paper audits that design. On the 1,534 questions of BIRD dev, answered by GPT-5.1 with a benchmark-adapted production prompt and five samples per question, the designed score separates right from wrong answers weakly (AUROC 0.624, 95% CI 0.595-0.652) and withholds 35.7% of correct answers. Nearly all of its ranking signal comes from agreement among the samples, and most of it is lost where agreement is combined by a minimum with a checklist that drops to zero on any unsupported claim, including claims in commentary. We froze a rule in which agreement with the shown answer is the score and deterministic checks act as vetoes and caps, and pre-registered a test on Spider dev before any Spider answer existed. The primary hypothesis held: AUROC rose from 0.566 to 0.725 (paired difference +0.159, 95% CI +0.097 to +0.221), and correct answers withheld fell from 49.0% to 8.8% with PASS accuracy 95.7%. Under one matching policy the choice of agreement statistic matters little; the gain comes from how agreement enters the score. Whether added checks help depends on how correctness is defined, while they always cost unqualified coverage. A pre-registered empty-result check did not meet its effect-size criterion on Spider. Correctness here means the core answer; labels are model-judged, and a blinded two-person audit, not yet complete, will be reported in a revised version.

**comment/C1：** 23 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables. Code, frozen scorer, pre-registration and data: https://github.com/numberz-ai/numberz-ies-tdd-h-calibration

</details>

### 417. [Reasoning for Propaganda Detection via Label-Guided CoT Optimisation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17271v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17271

**作者：** Zeba Afroz、Harsh Vardhan、Md. Shad Akhtar

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17271v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17271v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ReCoT，一个 reasoning-conditioned 的 propaganda 检测框架，用群体级优化与 performance-guided resampling 在无解释标注条件下获得定义性线索，并在 INDI-PROPspan、PTC 上报告了相对基线与 SFT 上界的 F1\_LCS 表现。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本 CoT 工作，但「按性能对推理链池重采样与迭代更新、无需额外监督」的思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中推理轨迹筛选与监督信号分配的问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Reasoning for Propaganda Detection via Label-Guided CoT Optimisation

**abstract/A1：** Propaganda detection systems usually operate as black boxes, lacking explanations. To address this, we hypothesise that persuasive techniques contain definitional characteristics with respect to their social-political setting. We introduce ReCoT, a reasoning-conditioned detection framework that captures definitional cues of persuasive techniques via population-level refinement and performance-guided resampling, without requiring additional explanation annotations. On INDI-PROPspan, ReCoT achieves a macro F1\_LCS of 0.364, surpassing baselines and reaching 88% of the SFT upper bound on Avg F1\_LCS. Similarly, on PTC, ReCoT reaches 85% of the SFT upper bound on Avg F1\_LCS, closing much of this gap while remaining interpretable. Importantly, the analysis of the reasoning pool's convergence and update pattern for ReCoT shows effective refinement of reasoning CoTs.

</details>

### 418. [Which Geometry on Which Layer? Measured Sign-Spectral Assignment in Mixed-Optimizer Training](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17285v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17285

**作者：** Hiroki Naganuma、Laura Gomezjurado、Mahdi Ghaznavi、Ganesh Talluri、Atsushi Nitanda、Seng Pei Liew、Ryuichiro Hataya、Ioannis Mitliagkas

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17285v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17285v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Which Geometry on Which Layer? Measured Sign-Spectral Assignment in Mixed-Optimizer Training

**abstract/A1：** Modern neural-network training uses mixed recipes, assigning AdamW-like or sign-based updates to embedding and output layers and spectral updates to hidden matrices. These assignments are usually fixed by layer type, without a clear criterion for selecting the appropriate geometry. We turn sign-versus-spectral assignment into a measurable, layerwise decision problem. For ideal memoryless steps, we derive a finite-batch ratio of conservative descent-lemma lower bounds for spectral and sign updates. Its closed form separates signal efficiency from a geometry-dependent global curvature factor. In the positive-signal regime, the same smoothness assumption gives two-sided bounds that determine which step has the larger conditional expected decrease when the ratio crosses explicit noise-dependent thresholds. We then derive a local directional quadratic score from gradient alignments and Hessian-vector products and use it in Generalized-Scion (G-Scion) to control layerwise routing. In a controlled input-rank experiment, including directional curvature matches the measured same-iterate ordering in all seven aggregate settings, whereas the curvature-free proxy selects the opposite geometry. On 31M GPT-2, the output score routes the output layer from spectral warmup to sign, and G-Scion improves validation loss over fixed Scion in memoryless and matched-momentum comparisons. ViT-B/16 results further show that a spectral edge assignment can outperform fixed Scion outside language modelling. These results suggest that optimizer geometry need not be hard-coded by layer type and are a first step toward understanding how it should be assigned.

**comment/C1：** 35 pages, including appendices

</details>

### 419. [The Agent Knew: Internal States Forecast Unauthorized Actions and Stop Them, and the Lies That Follow](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17301v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17301

**作者：** Arya Fayyazi、Mehdi Kamal、Massoud Pedram

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17301v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17301v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在 CAPE-Bench、tau^2-bench 等智能体基准上研究语言模型智能体的越权行动及其事后虚假汇报，发现残差流上的线性读出可在行动前预测违规、在汇报前预测谎言，并用该预测门控每个候选动作以降低违规，成本远低于 CoT 监控，且在提示注入基准上保持良性效用。

**相关性简评：** 其「用内部状态线性读出提前预测并门控后续输出」的思路，可能为 LVR 中核查 latent 状态是否保留任务必要信息、以及以探针作因果干预或停止依据提供方法线索；但原文为纯文本智能体安全场景，向多模态推理的迁移属推测，需人工核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The Agent Knew: Internal States Forecast Unauthorized Actions and Stop Them, and the Lies That Follow

**abstract/A1：** Language-model agents sometimes act beyond their authorization and then misreport what they did. On CAPE-Bench, matched agent tasks in which one fact decides whether an action is authorized, frontier open-weight agents do both, and one behavior marks the lie: retroactive permission laundering, acting and then asking permission as if the action were pending, precedes a false report in 70% of 1081 fresh informed violations, against 8% otherwise (preregistered odds ratio 7.0); frontier agents on tau^2-bench instead fabricate the authorization before violating. A linear readout of the agent's residual stream forecasts the violation before the action (AUROC 0.94) and the false report before the report, and beats chain-of-thought monitors when the agent is pressured to hide its reasoning. Gating every proposed action on this forecast cuts violations over whole episodes in four model families, and sending repeated flags to an approver keeps authorized work (Gemma-4: violations 0.70 -&gt; 0.09, completion 1.00; a model approver that escalates unclear cases keeps this gain with a person seeing 25% of asks), at about 10-8 of the agent's compute and 109 times less than a chain-of-thought monitor. On AgentDojo, an external prompt-injection benchmark, the same readout calibrated on 29 tasks, with the steering unchanged, cuts attack success on unseen tasks in two families (Gemma-4 11.7% -&gt; 5.7%, gpt-oss 28.5% -&gt; 17.5%) while keeping benign utility (Gemma-4 0.637 vs 0.637; gpt-oss 0.667 vs 0.681). Preventing the violation is also the most reliable way to prevent the lie (misreported violations 0.10 -&gt; 0.01 pooled over three families, preregistered), whereas lie-specific fixes after a violation are weak. All tests are preregistered and hash-locked; code, data and the full record, including tests that did not pass, are at https://github.com/AryaFayyazi/Honesty.

</details>

### 420. [SSM-Attack: Learning Where to Perturb for Black-Box Face Privacy](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17323v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17323

**作者：** Tunahan Parlayıcı、Erchan Aptoula、Yücel Saygın

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.CR、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17323v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17323v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** SSM-Attack 是一个基于选择性状态空间模型（SSM）的黑盒人脸隐私保护框架：不做生成式合成，而是用一次线性时间前向直接预测扰动预算在面部空间上的分配图，标出承载身份证据的位置，再由一个轻量投影细化确定具体取值。

**相关性简评：** 其核心方法是用 SSM 单次前向预测「哪里值得投入预算」的空间重要性分配图，并强调小容量网络即可完成定位，这可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、LOOK 区域选择与计算预算分配提供可核查的方法线索；但原任务是对抗攻击与图像保真度优化，与内部推理状态的关系需人工判断，迁移性属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SSM-Attack: Learning Where to Perturb for Black-Box Face Privacy

**abstract/A1：** Face recognition systems are deployed widely enough that a photograph shared online can be matched without its subject's consent. Generator-based protection methods rely on heavy pretrained backbones, multi-stage inference or visible semantic edits. We introduce SSM-Attack, a black-box face privacy framework built on Selective State Space Models. Rather than synthesizing the perturbation, the state-space model predicts in one linear-time pass a spatial allocation of the perturbation budget, marking which facial locations carry identity evidence; a short projected refinement then sets the values within this per-pixel budget. Against published benchmark results, SSM-Attack attains the highest average black-box attack success rate on all three evaluation sets: 87.10 percent on CelebA-HQ, 86.90 on LADN and 81.15 on FFHQ, the last from a network that never saw that dataset. The allocation network holds 5.73 million parameters, or 16.13 million with the frozen networks used by its quality terms. Under the same cap of 0.10 on the maximum per-pixel change, allocation improves structural similarity by 0.044, peak signal-to-noise ratio by 1.62 decibels and Frechet Inception Distance by 11.2 points over a uniform map while spending 37 percent of its capacity. Strong facial privacy protection therefore does not require a large generative prior; it requires knowing where to spend a small one.

**comment/C1：** 25 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Preprint submitted to Pattern Recognition

</details>

### 421. [COMPASS: Membership Inference Attack Against Vision Large Language Models via Adaptive Noise Calibration](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17332v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17332

**作者：** Damien Lo、Hong Kyu Lee、Ruixuan Liu、Li Xiong

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17332v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17332v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文系统刻画 VLLM 在不同强度高斯图像扰动下的成员/非成员响应分歧，发现最优扰动幅度与成员信号方向随模型-数据集而变，并提出自适应校准扰动强度与分数方向的灰盒成员推断方法 COMPASS（基于 Renyi 归一化 KL 与 max-k 聚合）。

**相关性简评：** 把图像扰动引起的响应与图像-logit 分歧当作探针，与 LVR 中「答案是否真正依赖视觉证据」「latent 是否保留视觉细节」的诊断思路可能有方法上的相通；其「低噪声区间分离更强、分数方向会反转、不宜固定扰动强度」的结论，可供核查扰动式视觉旁路或视觉贡献度量实验的强度设定与方向假设。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** COMPASS: Membership Inference Attack Against Vision Large Language Models via Adaptive Noise Calibration

**abstract/A1：** Vision large language models (VLLMs) are deployed in privacy-sensitive domains, raising training-data exposure concerns. Existing gray-box membership inference attacks (MIAs) commonly rely on entropy statistics or generated descriptions, requiring costly generation with limited membership separation. Perturbation-based methods instead measure response changes but focus on large perturbations, leaving VLLM membership behavior under smaller perturbations poorly understood. We systematically characterize VLLM membership behavior under controlled Gaussian perturbations across noise levels at fine resolution. We find that optimal perturbation magnitude and membership-signal direction vary across model-dataset pairs. In many settings, a previously unstudied low-noise regime yields stronger separation than large perturbations, with members exhibiting lower divergence than non-members, reversing the conventional score direction. Other settings retain the conventional direction, demonstrating that neither a fixed perturbation magnitude nor a predetermined score orientation is universally reliable. We propose COMPASS, an adaptive gray-box MIA that calibrates both the perturbation magnitude and membership-score direction using a loosely distribution-matched, known non-member reference set. We instantiate COMPASS using Renyi-normalized KL divergence and Renyi divergence, with max-k aggregation over the most informative image-logit positions. Across LLaVA v1.5-7B, MiniGPT-4, and HuluMed-32B, spanning pretraining, instruction-tuning, and medical-image datasets, COMPASS outperforms baselines. On general-domain data, COMPASS achieves AUCs up to 0.88. On the distribution-matched medical evaluation, it reaches 0.64 AUC, while the strongest baseline remains at chance level. These results establish full-range adaptive perturbation analysis as an effective approach to VLLM membership inference.

</details>

### 422. [When Goals Leak Across Relationships: How Cached Goal Representations Shape Cross-Client Decisions](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17365v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17365

**作者：** Saloni Gupta、Sébastien Krier、Glenn Matlin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17365v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17365v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文在双客户市场场景中测试 OLMo-3-7B-Instruct，发现共享对话记忆会让一个客户的目标影响另一客户的决策；随后用线性探针在 KV cache 中定位客户目标的所有权表示，并通过定向消融验证其因果作用。

**相关性简评：** 其「探针定位表示 + 按层与注意力头定向消融」的因果归因思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 视觉证据是否真被答案使用、贡献如何分配，以及缓存与注意力结构对 latent 状态的影响；但研究对象是文本 agent 的目标状态，迁移到视觉推理仍需验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When Goals Leak Across Relationships: How Cached Goal Representations Shape Cross-Client Decisions

**abstract/A1：** As LLM agents take on more autonomous roles, they may interact with multiple clients and counterparties whose goals and incentives conflict. If an agent maintains shared inference state across these interactions, information associated with one relationship may influence decisions made for another. We test OLMo-3-7B-Instruct in a controlled two-client environment with 20 market scenarios, where each client is assigned an opposing objective. With shared conversational memory, the model deviates from the current client's objective in 22% of eligible decisions. We then investigate how these goals are represented in the KV cache. Linear probes show that client-goal ownership becomes highly recoverable in middle layers and is concentrated in particular attention heads. We use these results to identify where to intervene in the cache and test whether these representations affect the model's decisions. Ablating the competitor's cached goal representations at these locations shifts the model toward the current client. The effect is larger for heads identified by probing than for randomly selected heads, and larger when ablating goal tokens than matched non-goal tokens from the same client. Our results show that client-specific goal representations persist in the KV cache and can causally influence decisions made for other clients, highlighting the importance of relationship-specific state isolation in persistent LLM agents.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshops on Interpreting Agent Behavior (IAB) and Agents in the Wild (AIWild)

</details>
