### 423. [What Makes a Latent Space Shared? Direct and Recoverable Compatibility in Motion VAEs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17376v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17376

**作者：** Iago Brito、Walcy Rios、Lucas Fernandes、Kaiki de Oliveira、Arlindo Galvão Filho

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17376v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17376v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在 HumanML3D 的多 schema 运动 VAE 中检验「共享 latent 空间」假设，发现共享骨干、维度或先验并不保证隐坐标可直接互换：原始 Recall@1 仅 5.9–17.7%，但线性校准后对应关系几乎可完全恢复。

**相关性简评：** 其对「可恢复对应」与「直接兼容」的区分，以及线性校准、循环一致性、少量配对片段微调等探针与干预手段，可能为 LVR 中判断 latent 状态是否被下游直接使用、跨模态隐表示对齐的评价提供可核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** What Makes a Latent Space Shared? Direct and Recoverable Compatibility in Motion VAEs

**abstract/A1：** A shared latent space is often assumed to make representations from different schemas directly interchangeable, yet sharing parameters, dimensionality, or a prior does not determine how corresponding instances are expressed in latent coordinates. We show that this assumption conflates recoverable correspondence, direct compatibility, and decoder reuse. In a controlled multi-schema motion VAE on HumanML3D, even identical inputs yield only $5.9$--$17.7\\%$ raw Recall@1 and $0.221$--$0.484$ paired-token cosine, despite correspondence being almost perfectly recoverable after linear calibration. Cycle consistency strengthens recoverability but still leaves direct retrieval and token agreement near zero. In contrast, only $64$ paired clips raise raw Recall@1 to $88.4$--$90.3\\%$ and token cosine to approximately $0.82$, making most post-hoc alignment unnecessary, although crossed decoding remains substantially worse than native reconstruction. We further find that reducing measured marginal discrepancy does not imply schema invariance. These results show that a shared backbone or prior does not ensure directly compatible latent coordinates, while limited paired correspondence can substantially improve direct compatibility in the tested setting.

</details>

### 424. [EPOCH: Coverage-Aware Evolution with Experiential Preference Optimization for LLM-based Automated Heuristic Design](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17379v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17379

**作者：** Oguzhan Gungordu、Ayse Tursucular、Siheng Xiong、Faramarz Fekri

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17379v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17379v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 EPOCH，把「实例覆盖」作为 LLM 自动启发式设计中的进化搜索目标，并用经验偏好优化加反思自蒸馏微调生成器，使自然语言反思从 prompt 内化到模型权重。

**相关性简评：** 其「让反思反馈进入权重而非停留在提示中」的训练监督与偏好对构造思路，可能为 LVR 的轨迹训练、贡献分配和 latent 收益内化提供可核查的方法线索，但本身不研究多模态推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** EPOCH: Coverage-Aware Evolution with Experiential Preference Optimization for LLM-based Automated Heuristic Design

**abstract/A1：** LLM-based automated heuristic design (AHD) discovers heuristics for combinatorial optimization problems (COPs), where an LLM generates candidates in an evolutionary search. Existing frameworks freeze the generator or fine-tune it on a scalar fitness signal hiding which instances each heuristic covers. Reflection-based frameworks improve heuristics with natural-language feedback, but it stays in the prompt and never reaches the generator's weights. We propose EPOCH, which makes instance coverage the objective of the evolutionary search and fine-tunes the generator to internalize reflection. Parent selection, operator allocation, and stagnation recovery all optimize how well the heuristics jointly cover the training instances, so the search returns a complementary heuristic ensemble. The generator learns from its own search by experiential preference optimization. A teacher LLM returns a natural-language insight on the generated heuristics, and the generator produces new heuristics with this insight. These improvements join the preference pairs for direct preference optimization (DPO). Since DPO only teaches the generator to rank these improvements, a reflective self-distillation (RSD) term makes it more likely to generate them on its own, and the gains accumulate over the long horizon of the search. Across COPs and open-source LLM backbones, EPOCH's heuristic ensembles outperform inference-only and fine-tuned baselines and generalize across problem scales.

</details>

### 425. [Measure Neural Mappings](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17384v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17384

**作者：** Ricardo Baptista、Edoardo Calvello、Bohan Chen、Andrew Stuart、Urbain Vaes

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17384v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17384v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文定义 measure neural mappings（MNMs），把自注意力/交叉注意力与 Set Transformer 刻画为概率测度上的算子，在非紧支撑律与尾部可积假设下证明随系综或粒子数 N 增长的 Wasserstein/欧氏误差收敛界（含 N^{-1/2} 项），并在 d=1…10 的七个算子上验证粒子数依赖。

**相关性简评：** 把注意力视为测度到向量的聚合映射并给出系综一致性与 N^{-1/2} 收敛估计，可能为分析 LVR 中随证据/序列长度增长的 latent 状态聚合、注意力结构与长度泛化提供理论工具，但原文不含视觉推理任务，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Measure Neural Mappings

**abstract/A1：** We introduce and define measure neural mappings (MNMs), which combine measure-dependent neural transport with ensemble consistency for learning operators on probability measures. Ensemble consistency requires outputs from growing ensembles sampled from an input law to converge to the specified population output in probability. We establish quantitative continuum limits for attention on noncompact laws under strong sub-Gaussian and tail-integrability assumptions. These laws accommodate unbounded state spaces in scientific machine learning, including Bayesian inference and uncertainty quantification. For fixed self-attention transformers, the expected output Wasserstein error is bounded by the empirical input Wasserstein error plus an additional $N^{-1/2}$ attention term. These self-attention transformers are MNMs under the stated assumptions: pre-norm architectures follow from compact stability after normalization, while post-norm architectures are covered under the stated tail conditions. We prove corresponding cross-attention estimates and extend the results to multihead attention and grouped transformer evaluation, with convergence as the group size grows. For Set Transformers viewed as measure-to-vector mappings, we obtain an $N^{-1/2}$ bound on the expected Euclidean output error under the stated assumptions. Experiments on seven operators in dimensions $d=1,2,3,5,10$ support the predicted particle-count dependence, using one-dimensional Wasserstein computations and Sinkhorn approximations in higher dimensions. The observed Wasserstein and sliced Wasserstein decay rates are close to their respective theoretical sampling benchmarks.

**comment/C1：** 65 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17426

**作者：** Li-Ching Chen、Andrés Franco Valiente、Yuta Ishiyama、Zachary R. Chalmers、William Chen、Kelsey Natsuhara、Taema Brinjikji、Madhumita Sushil、Travis Zack、Julian C. Hong

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17426v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17426v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 把结肠癌一线治疗规划建模为部分可观测下的交互式 RL 问题，从真实病历构造患者特异、过程感知的奖励，要求智能体先从结构化患者表示中顺序采集信息再给出治疗建议，并用 GRPO/GDPO 优化 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct。

**相关性简评：** 其「先顺序获取信息、再承诺决策」的交互式 RL 与过程感知奖励，可能为 LVR 中证据获取、停止决策与轨迹级监督提供可核查的方法线索，但需确认该奖励设计能否迁移到视觉 latent 推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Reinforcement Learning In Partially Verifiable Environments for Colon Cancer Treatment Planning

**abstract/A1：** Clinical decision-making is a sequential process of information collection, clinical inference, and forecasting under partial observability, often without a uniquely correct treatment decision. Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong medical question-answering capabilities but extending these advances to clinical reasoning remains challenging because many clinical tasks are only partially verifiable. Recent clinical reinforcement learning (RL) work has therefore largely focused on diagnostic endpoints, where correctness can be more directly verified. Oncology treatment decision making is a particularly challenging instance of this problem that extends beyond medical question-answering in which multiple decision trajectories can be clinically defensible for the same partially observed patient state. We formulate oncology treatment planning as an interactive RL problem under partial observability and construct patient-specific, process-aware rewards from decision processes observed in real world clinical records. The agent must learn to sequentially acquire information from a structured patient representation before committing to a first-line treatment recommendation, and is evaluated on information gathering, treatment selection, and reasoning alignment. Using GRPO and GDPO to optimize Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct within this environment, RL substantially improves the base policy beyond frontier model capabilities. The GDPO-trained policy increases Mean@3 scalar clinical reward by $79.60\\%$ over base Llama and exceeds GPT-5.2 by $18.82\\%$ under the same interactive environment, while reducing query count during training. Overall, our results show that patient-specific, partially verifiable rewards can provide an effective learning signal for interactive clinical RL when both the patient state and the underlying clinical decision process are only partially observed.

</details>

### 427. [World-T3: Test-Time Training as Persistent Memory for Real-Time Video World Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17434v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17434

**作者：** Junyi Wu、Zekun Li、Chenhongyi Yang、Chen Guo、Lingchen Yang、Yongan Zhang、Xinyi Zhang、Hongbing Hu、Bartek Rymkowski、Srinath Sridhar、Yan Yan、Xijie Huang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.MM

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17434v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17434v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** World-T3 是相机可控的视频世界模型，用测试时训练的快速权重把过往视觉观测在线写入模型参数，并按相机位姿读出来维持长时程一致性，再以双教师分布匹配蒸馏实现少步实时生成。

**相关性简评：** 其递归最小二乘的在线参数化记忆更新与按 key 读出视觉特征的机制，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的长期保持、更新规则与按需读取提供可核查的方法线索；但论文面向视频生成，未涉及推理决策。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** World-T3: Test-Time Training as Persistent Memory for Real-Time Video World Models

**abstract/A1：** Recent advances in video world models have enabled plausible interactive environments, yet long-horizon generation places a fundamental demand on visual memory: the previously observed world must remain consistent as the model continues to generate. Existing autoregressive approaches often implicitly rely on the generative model itself to retain such information, leading to spatial memory decay beyond the active context. We introduce World-T3, a camera-controlled video world model with a test-time training memory that consolidates past observations into dedicated model parameters. To robustly update this memory, we propose a recursive least-squares rule that incrementally absorbs novel visual features via online pose-keyed memory updates. Our TTT memory reads out previously observed scene features from the fast-weight state by camera pose, enabling consistent generation with constant storage and per-step computation regardless of rollout length. To facilitate real-time interactive generation with this robust memory, we further distill the autoregressive model into a few-step generator via dual-teacher distribution matching. On a long-horizon revisit benchmark, World-T3 raises revisit PSNR from 13.52 to 18.31 dB and reduces absolute rotation error from 3.344 to 1.075 relative to the strongest baseline on both metrics, while sustaining 20.6 FPS at 1280 x 704 on a single NVIDIA B200 GPU.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 SchemaWeaver：在移动端 LLM 工具调用的解码阶段做 schema 引导的并行解码，使每次解码产出多个 token 以降低时延，无需训练或改动 LLM，在多种移动 SoC 与 LLM 上报告最高约 3.9 倍加速。

**相关性简评：** 其「按结构 schema 约束、一次并行生成多 token 并缩短串行解码步数」的调度思路，可能为 LVR 中并行 latent 状态生成与结构约束解码的可核查线索；但该工作面向移动端工具调用延迟，未涉及视觉细节保留、推理状态更新或答案对 latent 内容的使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SchemaWeaver: Accelerating On-Device Mobile Agentic AI via Schema-Guided Parallel LLM Decoding

**abstract/A1：** Large language models (LLMs) on mobile devices can act as agents that call external software tools to complete complex tasks, but the major challenge of supporting on-device mobile agentic AI with LLMs is the long latency of LLM tool calling on mobile devices. In particular, the decode phase is the main contributor of such long latency, but is hard to speed up on mobile processors as it is bound by memory bandwidth rather than compute power. To address this limitation, in this paper we present SchemaWeaver, a new on-device mobile agentic AI technique that enforces schema-guided parallel decoding in the decode phase of LLM tool calling, to reduce its latency by producing multiple tokens in each decode pass. SchemaWeaver can be generically applied to the LLM inference engine on mobile devices without involving any training efforts or changes on LLMs, and our experiment results on major mobile SoCs and LLM families show that SchemaWeaver can reduce the LLM tool calling latency by up to 3.9 times, compared to the competitive baselines.

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17448v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17448v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把历史表格的结构恢复当作问题，用动态规划按「有多少列的和等于末行」把卷宗切成区块，再以门控将每列判为精确对账、标记为可靠但页码算术有误、或拒绝采信，并用求和检验理论刻画其无法察觉的错误与最优区块行数。

**相关性简评：** 其「三态验证门控 + 按可靠性选择验证区块粒度」的做法，可能为 LVR 中 LOOK/STOP 的视觉证据筛选、是否拒绝作答以及验证成本与缺陷率的权衡提供可供核查的方法线索，但论文本身并非 latent 推理研究。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TableVision: Recovering Verified Structure from Historical Tables

**abstract/A1：** Gaps, skips, and mistakes are the normal state of a historical register: rows go missing, tables cross page breaks, columns slip under wrong names, and column sums disagree with the corresponding row entries. Readers read digits correctly but lose the table structure. On seven clean panels of election returns, the best open-source reader reproduces 99.0\\% of the digits but files only 83.7\\% of the figures in the correct cells and gets 11 of 30 columns correct. TableVision treats table structure recovery as the problem. On three degraded 1888 pages, Amazon Textract files only 1 of 1494 figures correctly; TableVision correctly files 99.2\\%, and all 51 columns its exact-total check releases are correct. A dynamic program cuts a volume into blocks by how many columns sum to their last line; witnesses read the cells; the gate classifies each column as exactly reconciling, flagged as faithful to a page whose arithmetic is wrong, or withheld. A theory of the sum check says which errors it cannot see and why its optimal block is about $θ^{-1/2}$ rows at defect rate $θ$. On 2201 columns of Wisconsin electoral data, the gate accepts 2042, flags 118, and withholds 41; failure rises with column length $R$ as $1-(1-θ)^R$ at 1.1 defects per 1000 cells in general elections; official returns confirm 933 of 934 testable accepted sums and all 35 testable flagged totals; and the deployment added 491\\,359 gated precinct rows to a 9.3-million-row dataset. One implication is that the design of the verification block is critical.

</details>

### 430. [REA: From Correct LLM Judgments to Safe Decision Delivery](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17473v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17473

**作者：** Jingxiang Meng、Aofan Liu、Yaoshuai Ma、Fangxin Liu、Yongbiao Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17473v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17473v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 REA 框架，把 LLM 安全守护模型的判断沿「解析—回退—应用动作」链路追踪，实验表明正确判断常出现在格式不合规的输出中，匹配解析器并规范格式可把误放行的有害请求比例大幅降低。

**相关性简评：** 其把「判断正确」与「下游能否提取使用」分离评测的思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态已含正确信息、但答案未使用或无法解码的类似现象，也可借鉴其解析匹配与前缀约束等做法。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** REA: From Correct LLM Judgments to Safe Decision Delivery

**abstract/A1：** Generative safety guards must classify requests correctly and return outputs that applications can parse. Reasoning guards can improve classification accuracy while producing outputs that applications cannot parse. When applications cannot extract a correct prediction, fallback handling can allow harmful requests or block safe ones. We introduce Resolve--Express--Act (REA), a framework that traces judgments through parsing and fallback to application actions. Experiments on classifiers and safety guards show that correct predictions can appear in incorrectly formatted outputs. Parsing the safety verdict preserves the reasoning guard's accuracy advantage, while stricter explanation requirements reject additional correct predictions. Accepting formatting variations recovers most rejected correct predictions. Held-out tests confirm that output requirements and generation limits affect whether correct predictions can be parsed. In our fail-open replay, matching the parser to the output and fixing formatting reduced the fraction of harmful requests allowed despite correct guard judgments from 95.5% to 0%. A fixed-output comparison shows that model-based extraction can preserve guard verdicts, but is not automatically reliable; deterministic normalization already repairs the observed native-format failures. Fallback replay shows that the same correct prediction can lead to different safety actions depending on the parser and fallback policy, including allowing requests the guard correctly identifies as harmful.

</details>

### 431. [Foundation Models for Event Prediction Across Heterogeneous Event Logs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17503v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17503

**作者：** Fabian Spaeh、Sean Jaffe、Shandian Zhe、Bin Shen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17503v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17503v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Foundation Event Predictor（FEP）：一种 in-context 注意力架构，把「下一事件预测」表述为可并行化的非参数推断，在 696 个异构事件日志上预训练，并在 50 个未见数据集上作零参数适配的跨系统泛化评估。

**相关性简评：** 其把上下文转移的「相关性加权聚合」实现为 cross-attention，并用置换鲁棒嵌入解耦事件 ID 与持久语义，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态的检索式更新、视觉证据筛选、以及内容与位置/缓存解耦等线索；但领域为事件日志序列预测，迁移属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Foundation Models for Event Prediction Across Heterogeneous Event Logs

**abstract/A1：** Event logs are ubiquitous across real-world domains, including business processes, manufacturing workflows, healthcare, and many other operational systems. Yet event logs can differ substantially in their event semantics, label spaces, interaction patterns, and temporal scales, making it difficult to build a single foundation model that generalizes directly to previously unseen systems. We address this challenge with the Foundation Event Predictor (FEP), a simple and scalable in-context architecture that performs next-event prediction through learned, event-level nonparametric inference. Causal self-attention encodes context and target histories into key and query representations, respectively, while the observed next context events are encoded as values. Cross-attention then performs learned, relevance-weighted aggregation of next-event outcomes over all context transitions, allowing the entire nonparametric prediction procedure to be expressed as standard attention operations and efficiently parallelized with modern kernels such as FlashAttention. To promote cross-system generalization, we introduce permutation-robust embedding learning and random fixed embeddings to decouple event IDs from persistent semantics, together with empirical quantile transforms and robust normalization to handle diverse temporal scales. We pretrain FEP on 696 real-world event datasets spanning heterogeneous event systems and evaluate it on 50 held-out datasets unseen during pretraining. Across these datasets, FEP generalizes effectively to new event systems without parameter adaptation, frequently approaching the performance of strong models trained separately on each target dataset while substantially outperforming existing foundation-model baselines, particularly on challenging prediction tasks.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17552

**作者：** Ruchang Yao、Shi Guo、Junhao Zhuang、Mingde Yao、Xin Cai、Jiahao Zhan、Bin Fu、Xinyuan Chen、Yu Qiao、Tianfan Xue

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** FlashVSR+ 面向视频超分，提出以局部性为主的混合注意力加稀疏全局交互来降低 DiT 推理开销，并用奖励加权的教师 rollout 做分布匹配蒸馏，实现一步生成与偏好对齐。

**相关性简评：** 该工作属低层视觉任务，但其「多步教师轨迹蒸馏为一步生成器」与奖励加权分布匹配的监督方式，可能为 latent 推理状态的轨迹训练、贡献分配和一步状态更新提供借鉴线索，值得核查；混合注意力对局部与全局信息的取舍也与内部状态保留视觉细节的问题相关，但均属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FlashVSR+: Efficient Video Super-Resolution via Hybrid Attention and Reward-Yield Distribution Matching

**abstract/A1：** Recent video super-resolution (VSR) models achieve efficient one-step generation through diffusion distillation. However, high-resolution inference remains costly, and distilled models are difficult to align with human preferences. These challenges call for improvements in both model architecture and training strategy. We present \\textbf{FlashVSR+} to address both limitations. On the architecture side, we introduce hybrid attention based on the strong locality observed in pretrained VSR models, while retaining sparse global interaction for long-range consistency. It achieves up to $2\\times$ DiT speedup and 45\\% lower peak memory, enabling spatially untiled 4K VSR on a single 24GB RTX 4090. On the training side, we propose Reward-Yield Distribution Matching Distillation (Ry-DMD) for preference-aligned one-step generation. Ry-DMD uses reward-weighted teacher rollouts to incorporate black-box rewards into distribution matching, without backpropagating through the reward model. We further show that Ry-DMD generalizes beyond VSR to T2I generation. Together, FlashVSR+ delivers stronger restoration quality and substantially improves high-resolution efficiency, with consistent gains in user preference. We release our code, models, and training data at \\href{https://www.flashvsr.tech}{\\textcolor{FlashBlue}{\\textbf{www.flashvsr.tech}}}.

</details>

### 433. [RAN-JEPA: An Action-Conditioned World Model for Energy-efficient Mobile Network Control](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17584v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17584

**作者：** Binghan Wu、Kai Zeng、Kai Yang、Ya-Qin Zhang、Joseph Sifakis、Ye Ouyang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17584v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17584v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 RAN-JEPA，一个动作条件世界模型：先用纯观测的运营商数据学习预测性 latent 表示并适配目标域，再在固定编码器下用少量 sleep/wake 控制轨迹学习动作条件 latent 动力学，用于移动网络节能控制。

**相关性简评：** 其「先学预测表示、再冻结编码器学 latent 动力学」的分阶段训练可供核查 LVR 中状态更新与监督信号的分离设计，尤其冻结编码器是否导致任务必要信息坍缩。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RAN-JEPA: An Action-Conditioned World Model for Energy-efficient Mobile Network Control

**abstract/A1：** Operational mobile networks are rich in observations but poor in interventions: they continuously generate large volumes of passive telemetry, while controlled action--response trajectories remain comparatively scarce and costly to collect. This observation--intervention asymmetry is a central obstacle to building practical world models for RAN control. We address this problem with RAN-JEPA, an action-conditioned world model that separates representation learning from intervention learning. The model first learns a predictive latent representation from observation-only network data, adapts that representation to the target deployment domain, and then learns action-conditioned latent dynamics from controlled sleep/wake trajectories while keeping the encoder fixed. We evaluate RAN-JEPA using public operator performance data for pretraining and a real-equipment four-cell 5G testbed for domain adaptation, post-training, and control. Across four future 15-minute intervals, RAN-JEPA achieves lower action-conditioned prediction error than a GPT-2 world-model baseline and a mechanistic rule, while remaining close to a strong persistence reference. What-if evaluation further shows that the model produces distinct and coherent future trajectories under matched SLEEP and KEEP plans. In closed-loop control, RAN-JEPA consistently supports higher sleep ratios than the two baselines at comparable congestion cost. These results show that observation-first, action-conditioned learning can turn abundant passive telemetry and limited intervention data into a practical predictive model for energy-aware RAN control.

</details>

### 434. [Revisiting the 16x Pretraining Compute Gap between Diffusion and Autoregressive Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17590v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17590

**作者：** Guanghan Wang、Bing He、Zhan Shi、Benoit Dumoulin、Hanqing Lu、Volodymyr Kuleshov

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17590v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17590v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文重新检验「diffusion LM 预训练算力约为 AR LM 的 16 倍」这一结论，指出原评估使用 ELBO 与整序列 decoder-only 设定已偏离当前实践，改用模型自身解码顺序下的精确似然、block diffusion 训练与 encoder-decoder 结构，并对 block size 做扫描，在约 1700 个模型上重拟合 scaling law，将算力倍数降至 12.8x–3.0x 区间。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉推理主线不直接相关，但其 block diffusion 训练、解码顺序似然与 block size／解码深度的算力-质量权衡，可能为 LVR 中 diffusion 式并行状态生成的分块粒度与深度选择提供可核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Revisiting the 16x Pretraining Compute Gap between Diffusion and Autoregressive Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Diffusion language models (DLMs) have attracted wide attention for their fast, parallel decoding, but they are believed to be far less efficient to train than autoregressive language models (ARMs): a widely cited study reports that a DLM needs roughly 16x the training compute of an ARM to match its likelihood, a figure that has made pretraining DLMs from scratch look prohibitive at scale. We find that the methodology behind this figure has fallen out of step with current DLM practice: it scores the model with its evidence lower bound (ELBO) and trains a full-sequence, decoder-only model. We therefore revisit the scaling laws of DLMs, adopting the exact likelihood under the model's own decoding order, block diffusion training, an encoder-decoder architecture, and a sweep over the block sizes used in practice. Under this new protocol, we study across ten model variants, about 1,700 models in total, and find that pretraining DLMs is far cheaper than previously thought. Concretely, scoring with the exact likelihood reduces the compute multiple to 12.8x; block diffusion training and an encoder-decoder architecture further reduce it to 7.8x at block size 32, and smaller block sizes narrow it to 4.6x at block size 8 and 3.0x at block size 4. We complement these scaling analyses with an empirical rule for the optimal decoder depth of encoder-decoder block diffusion, a held-out compute budget beyond the fitting range at which the gap between variants persists, and downstream benchmark results where likelihood improvements carry over to accuracy. Overall, the 16x figure substantially overstates the pretraining cost gap between DLMs and ARMs, and pretraining DLMs from scratch is far more viable than previously assumed.

**comment/C1：** project page: https://guanghanwang.com/dlm-scaling

</details>

**内容简述：** 提出 MorphContrast，一种形态学感知的对比式多示例学习框架，以组织形态标签作为结构监督，从结直肠癌全切片图像预测五年生存，并在多个队列上评估。

**相关性简评：** 该工作不涉及 latent 推理或多模态生成，但其以多样性正则抑制表征坍缩、按形态匹配构造硬负样本并施加 patch 级对比监督的做法，可能为 LVR 中的信息坍缩与监督信号设计提供可核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Morphology-aware deep learning predicts colorectal cancer survival from whole-slide images

**abstract/A1：** Background: Five-year survival prediction from hematoxylin-and-eosin whole-slide images could support risk stratification, but the task is weakly supervised, and the tissue morphologies carrying prognostic information remain incompletely characterized. Methods: We conducted a retrospective secondary analysis using TCGA-COAD/READ (n=562) for morphology-specific analysis, Alliance/ CALGB 89803 (n=424) for model development, and SurGen (n=218) for external evaluation. We propose MorphContrast, a morphology-aware contrastive multiple-instance learning framework that uses tissue labels as structural supervision for five-year survival prediction. MorphContrast combines gated-attention pooling with three auxiliary objectives: patch-level morphology labels define within-patient contrasts, outcome concordance or discordance defines cross-patient contrasts within matched morphologies, and diversity regularization discourages representational collapse. Morphology-matched patches from patients with discordant outcomes serve as hard negatives, encouraging prognostic discrimination within comparable histologic contexts. Results: Morphology-specific models show weak but distributed prognostic discrimination: adipose tissue achieves an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.622, stroma achieves 0.604, and both perform comparably to tumor epithelium (0.601-0.605). On Alliance/CALGB 89803, the single model achieves an AUC of 0.642, while the post hoc ensemble reaches a pooled out-of-fold AUC of 0.70 and a risk-group hazard ratio of 3.79 (95% confidence interval: 2.55-5.63). On the external SurGen colon cancer cohort (n=218), the single model and ensemble achieve AUCs of 0.669 and 0.678, respectively. Conclusions: These findings support tissue morphology as structural supervision for outcome-aware representation learning in colorectal cancer prognosis.

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出免训练方法 UCoE：让可执行验证器程序与 agent 的 harness 状态共同演化，用「响应对比对」合成候选验证器并按最弱对比族上的判别力（driving capacity）挑选，用于诊断弱点、单次修复、决定采纳哪个响应以及是否将修复写入状态，模型参数固定，在开放式基准上提升偏好率。

**相关性简评：** 「用对比对挑选验证器、并据验证结果决定是否更新状态」的机制，可能为 latent 推理的候选状态验证、视觉证据筛选与状态提交门控提供可核查线索；但论文面向纯文本 agent 自改进，无视觉与 latent 成分，迁移性需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Verifier-Harness Co-Evolution for Training-Free Self-Improvement on Open-Ended Tasks

**abstract/A1：** Training-free self-improvement lets an agent use feedback to revise the response it is about to return and to update the harness state that shapes how it handles later tasks. On open-ended tasks that feedback rarely comes from reference answers or executable tests, so the agent has to rely on a model-based verifier. When the verifier is wrong, the current response can get worse, and misleading experience can persist across the task stream. A verifier that never changes also grows stale as the agent's responses improve and task demands shift. We introduce Unified Co-Evolution (UCoE), a training-free method that evolves an executable verifier program together with the agent's harness state while all model parameters stay fixed. UCoE synthesizes candidate verifier programs and tests them on response contrasts, pairs of responses that differ in one declared property and have a known preferred side. It selects the candidate whose discrimination on its weakest contrast family is highest, a quantity we call driving capacity. The selected verifier diagnoses one weakness in each draft, guides a single repair, decides which response is served, and determines whether the accepted repair may enter the harness state. As tasks complete, their diagnostics seed new candidate verifiers, which must beat the current verifier on the same contrasts before adoption. Across six open-ended benchmarks, UCoE averages 59.00% preference against matched direct generation with Qwen3-8B and 57.19% with Qwen3.8-27B, margins of 9.00 and 7.19 percentage points. On three verifiable benchmarks, the same method raises the mean from 36.06% for direct generation to 38.48%. Code is available at https://github.com/tianyi0216/Unified-Co-Evolution.

**comment/C1：** 47 pages, 5 figures

</details>

### 437. [OpenDepth: Repurposing Image Editing Priors for Robust Open-World Monocular Depth Estimation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17610v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17610

**作者：** Mengke Zhang、Tianyi Yang、Xinzhuo Li、Anlong Ming

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17610v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17610v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 OpenDepth，把开放世界单目深度估计视为跨多种风格图像的一致几何推断，借助 I2I 编辑先验，通过 DiT 浅层特征对齐与联合 RGB 潜变量重建解耦风格干扰，在标准与极端天气基准上刷新零样本深度估计结果。

**相关性简评：** 其「将几何相同但风格不同的输入映射到统一 latent 空间」与辅助 RGB 潜变量重建监督，可能为 LVR 中视觉扰动下的潜状态稳定与几何/任务必要信息保留提供可核查的方法线索，但该工作本身不做推理轨迹或答案使用分析。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** OpenDepth: Repurposing Image Editing Priors for Robust Open-World Monocular Depth Estimation

**abstract/A1：** Recently, the integration of generative priors has revolutionized Monocular Depth Estimation (MDE), achieving state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance with remarkably high data efficiency. However, although methods based on Text-to-Image (T2I) models excel in general scenes, their efficacy degrades sharply when confronted with open-world environmental perturbations, such as illumination variations and adverse weather. Since T2I priors are optimized for semantic synthesis rather than preserving pixel-level structure, they struggle to decouple geometry from appearance under severe visual shifts, easily triggering structural hallucinations. Therefore, our core insight is to model open-world depth estimation as consistent geometric inference across multi-style images, fully leveraging the powerful structure-preserving editing priors of Image-to-Image (I2I) models. Based on this, we propose OpenDepth, a robust open-world MDE framework that introduces "Intra-Domain Awareness" -- the capability to map diverse stylistic inputs sharing identical geometry into a unified latent space. To achieve this, we first align shallow features within the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) to anchor degraded observations to unified geometric representations. Additionally, we introduce a joint RGB latent reconstruction task, requiring the model to recover clean RGB information from degraded inputs. This multi-stage strategy effectively decouples environmental style interference, compelling the model to focus strictly on underlying geometric recovery. Extensive evaluations show that OpenDepth sets new SOTA records for robust zero-shot depth estimation across standard and extreme weather benchmarks, demonstrating exceptional structural integrity and adaptability.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at ACM Multimedia 2026. 18 pages, 9 figures, including supplementary material

</details>

### 438. [MAS-Gate: Unlocking Multi-Agent System Lifecycle via Node-Centric Quantification](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17613v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17613

**作者：** Hehai Lin、Zixuan Wang、Ming Yan、Peidong Wang、Shilei Cao、Minzhi Li、Bosheng Ding、Juepeng Zheng、Chengwei Qin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.MA

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17613v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17613v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文将 LLM 多智能体系统的开发与运行刻画为设计时编排、运行时干预、事后归因三阶段生命周期，提出节点中心的统一量化 MAS-Gate（结合节点内效用与节点间强度），并用于训练编排器稠密奖励、运行时前缀编辑与事后错误定位。

**相关性简评：** 多智能体场景下的节点贡献量化、基于执行前缀的干预与风险节点排序，可能为 latent 推理中的轨迹贡献分配、中间状态干预和证据筛选提供可核查的方法线索，但对象是文本智能体 DAG 而非视觉 latent 状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MAS-Gate: Unlocking Multi-Agent System Lifecycle via Node-Centric Quantification

**abstract/A1：** Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) can solve complex problems beyond the reach of a single agent by decomposing tasks and coordinating complementary capabilities. Despite extensive research on MAS, existing work largely focuses on specific aspects or individual phases of their development and operation, resulting in fragmented perspectives with objectives and signals that are difficult to reconcile across these different settings. To bridge these disconnected perspectives, we conceptualize MAS development and operation as a three-phase lifecycle spanning design-time orchestration before execution, runtime intervention during execution, and post-hoc attribution after execution, and introduce MAS-Gate, a unified node-centric quantification applicable across these phases. Modeling each execution as a directed acyclic graph, MAS-Gate combines within-node utility, which estimates a node's contribution through changes in reference-answer likelihood, with inter-node strength, which approximates semantic uptake and potential downstream reach. We adapt this shared quantification to three objectives: providing a structure-aware dense reward for Orchestrator training, training an Editor to act on execution prefixes using paired rewards from completed edited and unedited trajectories, and supplying risk-ranked nodes as auxiliary evidence for LLM-based post-hoc attribution. Experiments spanning interaction environments, knowledge-intensive multi-hop question answering, general reasoning, and post-hoc attribution demonstrate that MAS-Gate improves workflow construction, targeted runtime editing, and LLM-assisted error localization over corresponding phase-specific baselines. Together, these results establish MAS-Gate as a unified structural interface for improving MAS generation, dynamic editing, and error attribution throughout the lifecycle.

</details>

### 439. [RELAY: Selective Self-Distillation with Adaptive Hand-off for Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17623v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17623

**作者：** Kunwang Zheng、Xinyu Sun、Yu Cao、Shuocheng Li、Lei Cheng、Ying Liu、Qilong Zhang、Jinlong Chen、Hua Yang、Qianglong Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17623v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17623v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 RELAY：在 rubric-based RL 中先用冻结教师对「正 advantage 与低分零 advantage」的 rollout 做选择性自蒸馏并叠加 GRPO，再通过平台期检测器在训练中撤除教师，转入纯 GRPO 阶段，并在多个模型—领域组合上验证。

**相关性简评：** 其「按 advantage 选择性蒸馏 + 依据损失平台期动态停止外部监督」的监督调度，可能为 latent 推理训练的贡献分配与监督何时撤除提供可核查线索，但该工作本身是纯文本 RL 训练，与视觉状态生成无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RELAY: Selective Self-Distillation with Adaptive Hand-off for Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning

**abstract/A1：** Rubric-based reinforcement learning grades a response against many written criteria but collapses them into one reward, which discards the detail the rubric carries and gives no GRPO reward gradient when a group's responses tie. A frozen teacher that reads the rubric as privileged context provides token-level supervision, but we observe an early plateau in the gains over GRPO. RELAY uses advantages and rewards to select positive-advantage and low-scoring zero-advantage rollouts, and monitors the distillation loss to decide when to retire the teacher. Stage 1 combines selective distillation from a frozen teacher with GRPO; a plateau detector then removes the teacher, and Stage 2 continues with GRPO alone. Calibrated on one model-domain pair and reused unchanged in three others, the plateau detector fires between steps 122 and 171. RELAY scores highest in-domain among the compared methods in all four settings, ahead of GRPO on RaR-Medicine by 4.62 points with Qwen3-1.7B and 6.02 with Qwen3-4B. On Qwen3-1.7B/Medicine, removing the teacher from a shared checkpoint outperforms keeping, weakening or refreshing it. Distilling selected rollouts covering about half the response tokens also outperforms distilling all rollouts at a matched average coefficient.

**comment/C1：** 17 pages, 8 figures, 13 tables

</details>

### 440. [4LC: 4D Latent Cache for Efficient Conditioning in Dynamic World Modeling](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17625v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17625

**作者：** Jianhui Zhang、Zuyao Lin、Pengxin Xu、Jingdong Wang、Xingyu Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17625v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17625v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 4LC，一个 4D latent 缓存：把多个视觉编码器（VAE、DINO、V-JEPA、VGGT）的表征绑定到共享的几何与运动，并提供可按指定时间与视角读取的时空接口，直接复用静态与动态内容的视觉表征作为生成条件，避免逐请求 RGB 渲染与重编码；在此基础上构建 4LC-Video，以同一模型支持相机控制、时序控制、新视角合成、场景重访与长时生成。

**相关性简评：** 其「多编码器 latent 缓存 + 按时间/视角索引读取」的机制，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的缓存与复用、内容/位置索引对相似度的影响提供可核查线索，但该工作面向视频生成，非推理，是否真有借鉴价值需读原文确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** 4LC: 4D Latent Cache for Efficient Conditioning in Dynamic World Modeling

**abstract/A1：** For video generation in dynamic world modeling, observed static and dynamic content should be efficiently reused to provide conditions for repeated generation at different times and viewpoints. We introduce 4LC, a 4D latent cache with composite visual representations and a flexible spatiotemporal access interface. As a latent cache, 4LC directly reuses visual representations of static and dynamic content to provide generation conditions, avoiding per-request RGB rendering and re-encoding. As a composite cache, 4LC binds visual representations from multiple visual encoders (e.g., VAE, DINO, V-JEPA, VGGT) to shared geometry and motion, allowing the composite representations to describe the dynamic world with rich information. Besides, we design a flexible spatiotemporal interface, which directly reads the cache at independently specified times and viewpoints and combines readouts across observations, providing a common conditioning format for diverse downstream tasks. Building on 4LC, we develop 4LC-Video to address multiple video generation tasks through different configurations of source observations, spatiotemporal requests, and historical reuse, including camera control, temporal control, novel-view synthesis, scene revisits, and long-term generation. Our experiments show more efficient condition acquisition, effective spatiotemporal controllability, and scene consistency across tasks using a single 4LC-Video model without task-specific fine-tuning.

**comment/C1：** Project page: https://zgca-hmi-lab.github.io/4LC

</details>

### 441. [Calibrated Disambiguation for Partial Multi-label Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17635v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17635

**作者：** Zhuoming Li、Yuheng Jia、Mi Yu、Zicong Miao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CV

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对部分多标签学习中的过标注噪声，提出 PML-CD：把基于课程学习的最优加权函数形式化为对模型预测置信度的校准，并用一个以正样本置信度直方图为输入的校准器在训练中生成课程权重，辅以原型对齐正则。

**相关性简评：** 其「由置信度分布学习自适应权重」的校准思路，可能为 LVR 中潜在步骤的加权、监督贡献分配或基于置信度的停止/核验提供可核查的方法线索，但原文任务为噪声标签去歧义，与视觉推理状态无直接关系，需人工判断迁移价值。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Calibrated Disambiguation for Partial Multi-label Learning

**abstract/A1：** Partial multi-label learning (PML) aims to train a classifier on datasets whose instances are over-annotated with not only relevant labels but also irrelevant labels, which is common when datasets are collected from crowd-sourcing platform. Existing works primarily approach it from a curriculum learning perspective, leveraging the memorization effect to disambiguate noisy labels and produce robust predictions. However, these methods are based on non-adaptive weighting functions and lack theoretical guidance for optimal weighting. To overcome these issues, a calibrated disambiguation model named PML-CD is proposed. We first formulate the optimal weighting function for curriculum-based disambiguation, which is equivalent to the calibration of the model's predicted confidences, thus providing guidance for curriculum designing. To obtain the optimal weighting function from PML dataset during the training, a transferable calibrator is designed, which takes the histogram of positive samples' confidences as input, and outputs the optimal curriculum weighting for training. Prototype alignment regularization is also proposed to promote the model's performance. Experiments conducted on Pascal VOC, MS-COCO, NUS-WIDE and CUB have verified that our method outperforms existing state-of-the-art PML methods.

**comment/C1：** The paper is accepted by AAAI 2025

</details>

### 442. [The Tokens Strike Back: Safety-Aware Denoising with Directional Embedding-based Revision](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17636v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17636

**作者：** Amman Yusuf、Jiwoo Shin、Ruizhi Deng、Heitor Rodrigues Guimarães、Nikita Dvornik、Mijung Park

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17636v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17636v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 SADDER：在文本扩散模型推理时，按 token 位置从嵌入（激活）空间提取安全引导信号，并用该信号对 SAD 式更新规则加权修正 token，同时从理论上推导出使修改后去噪器保持精确的逐位置目标分布，并在 MDLM/USDM 的不安全续写与越狱设置上验证安全性与质量的权衡。

**相关性简评：** 其「嵌入空间逐位置引导信号 + 门控式状态更新 + 目标分布校正以保持去噪一致」可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的定向修改、视觉证据筛选门控与更新后的一致性约束提供可供核查的方法线索；但该工作面向文本扩散安全引导，与视觉/多模态推理无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The Tokens Strike Back: Safety-Aware Denoising with Directional Embedding-based Revision

**abstract/A1：** The Safety-Aware Denoiser (SAD) is a recent, training-free, safety-guidance framework for text diffusion models. During inference, SAD steers text samples toward safe regions of the token probability space. In this paper, we propose $\\mathit{SADDER}$ (Safety-Aware Denoising with Directional Embedding-based Revision), which improves the safety and quality trade-offs of SAD by exploiting a safety-guidance signal in the embedding (or activation) space for each token position, then updating the token positions using the SAD update rule multiplied by the guidance signal. This multiplication acts as a gating mechanism: tokens with a high unsafe signal are more likely to be modified during inference following the SAD update rule. However, such an update does not automatically preserve the conditional mean, i.e., the denoiser of a fixed target distribution. We therefore theoretically derive new position-wise target distributions for which the modified denoiser is exact. Furthermore, we derive conditions under which the position-wise target distributions match a global target distribution. We test our $\\mathit{SADDER}$ method on popular Masked Diffusion Language Models (MDLMs) and Uniform-State Diffusion Models (USDMs) across unsafe continuation and jailbreak settings, and show that $\\mathit{SADDER}$ achieves a better balance between safety, generation quality, and inference cost than existing methods.

**comment/C1：** 43 pages, 4 figures

</details>

**内容简述：** 提出 FrameLite，一个基于 Qwen3.5-0.8B 的紧凑美学裁剪模型：先用空间与构图训练建立定位与取景偏好，再以质量引导在线监督（QOS）从当前策略生成的候选中挑出最高质量完整答案，并用相对 greedy 答案的正负质量差（GRO）继续优化，推理时直接输出一个坐标答案，无需搜索或外部打分器。

**相关性简评：** 可核查的方法线索是：在策略自身生成的候选答案中筛选高质量答案作在线监督，并以相对于 greedy 答案的质量差做偏好式更新，可能为 LVR 的轨迹训练、答案质量筛选与贡献分配提供借鉴；但论文未涉及 latent 状态或视觉推理过程，联系较弱。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FrameLite: Decision-Oriented Aesthetic Cropping with a Compact Vision-Language Model

**abstract/A1：** Aesthetic image cropping improves composition by balancing subjects, context, and image boundaries. Large vision-language models bring semantic knowledge to this task, but their scale limits lightweight photography assistance. We propose FrameLite, a compact cropping model built on Qwen3.5-0.8B. Our approach is motivated by the observation that a small model can generate better crops than its first answer suggests. We develop three-stage training to turn this potential into stronger direct predictions. Spatial and composition training establishes localization and framing preferences. Quality-Guided Online Supervision (QOS) then learns the highest-quality complete answers among the current policy's generated candidates. Greedy-Referenced Optimization (GRO) further refines the policy using positive and negative quality differences relative to its current greedy answer. Both online stages use annotation-derived feedback, while inference returns one coordinate answer without search or an external scorer. Experiments show that FrameLite outperforms the compared large-VLM croppers across public benchmarks with a substantially smaller backbone. Controlled studies confirm that selecting high-quality training answers improves the final model beyond online sampling alone. We will release our code and model weights at https://github.com/JianzeLi-114/FrameLite .

</details>

### 444. [Beyond Bias Scores: Answerability Confounds in Activation Steering with Gradient-Constrained Direction Design (GCD)](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17641v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17641

**作者：** Weitong Li、Donglin Song、Junkai Lin、Xi Xuan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文指出 BBQ 的模糊项分数把「可回答性」与有符号偏好混在一起，在 11 个类别、28824 条数据、5 个模型上验证对比式激活引导主要改变的是可回答性通道；进而提出带一阶 unknown-logit 约束的 GCD 方向构造，使答案率畸变降低 14 倍、偏好改变扩大 4 倍。

**相关性简评：** 该文的激活引导方向构造、方向近正交与分数通道分解，以及弃答行为分析，可能为 LVR 中 latent 内容的因果贡献分配与 STOP 决策提供可核查的线索，但原文为纯文本设定、未涉及视觉推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Bias Scores: Answerability Confounds in Activation Steering with Gradient-Constrained Direction Design (GCD)

**abstract/A1：** Bias scores in language-model evaluations often conflate what a model prefers with whether it answers at all. We identify this confound in \\textsc{BBQ}, whose ambiguous score factorizes into answerability and signed preference. Across 11 categories, 28,}824 items, and five models, contrastive steering lowers the signed ambiguous score in 11/11 categories but lowers the signed disambiguated preference score in only 8/11. Across 99 configurations, the answerability channel exceeds half of the observed score change in 17\\% and accounts for the entire change in 11%. In a six-category disambiguated evaluation, 20.8\\% of 1,500 items flip to the unknown option, where abstention is incorrect; \\textsc{StereoSet} shows no analogous answer-rate shift. The effect reflects selection and near-orthogonality between the contrastive and preference-gradient directions. We introduce Gradient-Constrained Direction Design (\\textsc{GCD}), an option-gradient construction with a first-order unknown-logit constraint. Under a matched Qwen-7B protocol, GCD reduces answer-rate distortion 14-fold and yields a 4-fold larger preference change, while ablations show similar gains for alternative and unconstrained option-gradient directions; nulling the unknown gradient alone is not responsible for the gain. We recommend reporting answerability alongside published scores.

</details>

### 445. [When Should Enterprise Policy Decisions Be Learned, and When Should They Be Reasoned?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17643v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17643

**作者：** Hyojung Han、Ryangkyung Kang、Youngeun Kim、Seung-Hun Jeon

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17643v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17643v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在固定的 27B 韩语企业模型上做析因比较：决策输出为生成 JSON 还是单个约束 token，以及是否允许先推理；用 2800 条分布内样本和 300 条由隐藏可执行策略标注的密封基准衡量动作准确率与翻转稳定性，并检验边界定向监督与中英文重渲染的效应。

**相关性简评：** 其「推理 vs 可学习的直接决策」对比、边界定向监督对推理的部分替代（交互约 -4.9）以及推理增益约 +17.3 的测量框架，可能为 LVR 中推理期计算何时必要、监督能否替代推理、贡献分配与效果评价提供可核查的方法线索；但与视觉多模态无直接关系，需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When Should Enterprise Policy Decisions Be Learned, and When Should They Be Reasoned?

**abstract/A1：** An enterprise agent that answers under a written policy must choose an action before it says anything: answer, ask for a missing fact, ask for confirmation, call one or several tools, escalate, or refuse. Holding one 27B Korean enterprise model fixed, we vary whether the decision is a generated JSON object or a single constrained token, and whether the model may reason first. On 2800 in-distribution items we did not detect an accuracy difference between the two deployed paths (93.46% vs 94.14%), while they differ about tenfold in restart stability (3.00% of actions flip vs 0.29%); they also differ in reasoning, so this is an operational comparison. On a sealed benchmark of 300 items whose labels come from a hidden executable policy, reasoning is worth +17.3 points \[+12.3, +23.0\] on exact action. With reasoning off, the format difference was 0.0 points \[-4.3, +4.0\], a failure to detect an advantage for either interface, not equivalence; with reasoning on it is unresolved. Against a token-matched random control, boundary-targeted supervision moves the two covered boundaries by +17.5 and +20.0 points and leaves a held-out boundary unchanged. In a 3-seed training x reasoning factorial, the sealed-rendering interaction is -4.9 \[-8.1, -1.7\], consistent with partial substitution. All supervision was Korean. On independently rendered English versions, the model is 0.82 points lower \[-2.68, +0.93\] with reasoning on, the same order as re-rendering in Korean; the reasoning-off gain from targeted supervision is not stable in either language, so we do not claim transfer. The original text stays private as the confirmatory set. An open-model re-rendering made after these results reproduced the reasoning effect and the English verdict; the interaction kept its sign but did not replicate under item-clustered intervals. We release the model and that re-rendering with gold labels.

**comment/C1：** 43 pages, 17 tables, 9 figures

</details>

### 446. [DeltaTTG: Training Multi-Turn Agents with a Token-to-Go Progress Meter](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17666v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17666

**作者：** Xuyan Ye、Xiyan Fu、Shengda Fan、Jiawei Cui、Yankai Lin、Wei Lu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17666v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17666v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 DeltaTTG：用冻结的共享 progress meter 预测「Token-to-Go」（完成任务前还需生成的 token 数）作为可观测的进度代理，从而在多轮智能体的 RLVR 训练中把终局奖励的优势重分配到各步，不改变奖励本身，并在 ALFWorld、PaperSearchQA、BFCLv3 上取得平均分提升。

**相关性简评：** 其「由轨迹学习进度信号并重分配步骤优势」的监督与贡献分配思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 轨迹训练、逐步信用分配和停止/继续决策提供可核查的方法线索，但原文面向纯文本多轮 agent、不含视觉与 latent 状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DeltaTTG: Training Multi-Turn Agents with a Token-to-Go Progress Meter

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) for multi-turn agents relies on sparse terminal rewards that say little about individual steps. Within-group step comparisons depend on reliable state matching and sufficiently diverse sampled outcomes, while direct step scoring may require costly external evaluators, human annotations, or task-specific heuristics. We introduce DeltaTTG to learn a reusable progress signal through a shared progress meter, using low-cost supervision from diverse policies' recorded trajectories without task-specific progress rules. Its supervision target, Token-to-Go (TTG), the number of tokens remaining to be generated until task completion, serves as an observable proxy for remaining completion effort. During actor training, changes in the frozen meter's estimates redistribute outcome-derived advantages across steps without altering the reward, preserving each trajectory's advantage sign and token-average scale. On ALFWorld, PaperSearchQA, and BFCLv3, DeltaTTG improves the average score over GRPO by 5.7 and 7.2 points with Qwen3-4B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, respectively, outperforms all compared RL baselines on average, and keeps actor-training GPU-hours close to GRPO. Further experiments show improved sample efficiency and out-of-domain performance, and support the meter's ability to distinguish step quality and guide test-time action selection across actor sizes. The code is available at https://github.com/Xuyan923r/DeltaTTG.

</details>

### 447. [SWORD: Scene-Grounded Wasserstein Object-Relation Distance for 3D Scene Graph Prediction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17692v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17692

**作者：** U-Chae Jun、Jaeeun Ko、Yoonhyuk Choi、Jiwoo Kang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17692v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17692v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 SWORD，利用固定节点索引与边槽位的对齐设定，从训练标注构建物体与关系的地面距离度量，并将其提升为节点及零增强边边缘分布上的 Wasserstein 距离，作为 3D 场景图预测的语义图距离监督，替代仅靠精确标签的分类损失。

**相关性简评：** 其「在无需图匹配的前提下比较对齐结构化表示分布」的 Wasserstein 距离构造，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态或轨迹的相似度度量与训练监督提供可核查的方法线索，但原文面向 3D 场景图标签预测，与视觉推理状态生成无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SWORD: Scene-Grounded Wasserstein Object-Relation Distance for 3D Scene Graph Prediction

**abstract/A1：** 3D scene graph prediction is commonly optimized with object-node and relation-edge classification losses. These objectives encourage exact object and relation label recovery, but they do not directly optimize semantic proximity to the ground-truth scene graph: two wrong graphs can receive comparable penalties even when one is much closer in object roles and relation contexts. A direct graph-distance loss is difficult in general, since graph matching and graph edit distance require correspondence search and edit-cost design. Our key observation is that prior supervised 3D scene graph prediction protocols are conducted on fixed object-node indices and supervised edge slots. This can turn a scene graph comparison into a well-defined aligned graph-distance problem. To this end, we propose SWORD, a Scene-Grounded Wasserstein Object-Relation Distance that builds block-normalized object and relation ground distance metrics from training scene graph annotations through a deterministic base-to-context order, without external semantic priors. SWORD lifts these metrics to Wasserstein distances over aligned node and null-augmented edge marginals, providing semantic graph-distance supervision beyond exact-label penalties while preserving the ground-truth graph as the unique zero-distance solution in aligned marginal probability space. We prove that SWORD is a strict metric on aligned marginal probabilistic scene graphs, preserves scene-graph-grounded substitution ordering, controls additive graph-grounded semantic observables, and yields a surrogate upper-bounding decoded semantic error.

</details>

### 448. [A Node Embedding Framework for Model-Centric Conformance Checking in Process Mining](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17702v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17702

**作者：** Mostafa Abbasi、Homayoun Najjaran

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17702v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17702v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出以模型为中心的过程挖掘一致性评估框架：用 PetriNetGraph 把 Petri 网转为图，结合节点嵌入与 Procrustes 对齐实现跨图可比，并以参数化余弦距离给出统一有界指标，附带活动级偏差定位与熵正则的全局偏差聚合，在九个公开事件日志上验证其对噪声更稳健。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉/多模态推理无直接关系，但其中用 Procrustes 对齐把不同图的嵌入映射到可比空间、再用参数化余弦距离和熵正则聚合比较结构，可能可供核查于跨层或跨模型的 latent 推理状态相似度度量。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A Node Embedding Framework for Model-Centric Conformance Checking in Process Mining

**abstract/A1：** Evaluating the quality of process models discovered from event logs is a fundamental challenge in process mining. Traditional evaluation relies on conformance metrics such as fitness and precision, which are highly sensitive to noise and deviations in event logs and therefore often fail to give a consistent assessment of discovery algorithms. We introduce a model-centric evaluation framework that combines node embeddings with Procrustes alignment to enable cross-graph comparability, since embeddings derived from different graphs reside in distinct vector spaces. The proposed PetriNetGraph method transforms Petri net process models into graph representations compatible with embedding algorithms. Comparing the node embeddings of ground-truth and discovered models through a parameterized cosine distance yields a unified and bounded metric for evaluating process discovery across datasets and methods. We evaluate the framework under static and context-aware scenarios to examine how prior knowledge of activity existence influences the assessment of structural similarity. The framework also integrates a compliance checking mechanism that localizes deviations at the activity level and an entropy-regularized node distance aggregation function that quantifies global deviations across the model. Experiments on nine publicly available event logs show that the approach provides a reliable embedding-based conformance indicator that reflects the behavior of fitness and precision. Experiments on synthetic logs with controlled noise levels confirm that it is substantially more robust to log deviations than traditional conformance metrics, PetriNet2Vec, and its dynamic-window and Procrustes-aligned variants, while remaining sensitive to process model degradation. All implementation details and datasets are publicly available.

**comment/C1：** 34 pages, 13 figures, 8 tables. Code: https://github.com/mstabc/cc\_node2vec

</details>

### 449. [Focus on What You Need: Global-to-Local Dynamic Attention for Multimodal Sarcasm Detection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17707v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17707

**作者：** Dehao Wu、Xingjie Zhuang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17707v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17707v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 GLDA 框架，先做全局多模态融合捕捉图文粗粒度不一致，再用局部门控跨模态注意力动态过滤冗余视觉与文本特征，并用多分支目标联合优化单模态与多模态表示，用于多模态讽刺检测。

**相关性简评：** 其门控跨模态注意力对无关视觉对象的动态筛选与精化，可能与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、冗余视觉导致的信息坍缩问题相关，可供核查；但论文面向任务判别，不涉及 latent 推理状态的生成与使用。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Focus on What You Need: Global-to-Local Dynamic Attention for Multimodal Sarcasm Detection

**abstract/A1：** Multimodal sarcasm detection has attracted increasing attention due to the widespread use of images and text on social media platforms. Existing studies generally treat the semantic or emotional inconsistency between images and text as a key cue for identifying sarcastic expressions. However, images in real-world scenarios often contain multiple visual objects, many of which are irrelevant to sarcasm-related semantics. Such redundant visual information may introduce noise during cross-modal interaction, distracting models from focusing on critical sarcasm cues and potentially leading to inaccurate predictions. To address this issue, we propose GLDA (Global-to-Local Dynamic Attention), a multimodal sarcasm detection framework that models cross-modal interactions from a global-to-local perspective. Specifically, GLDA first employs a global multimodal fusion module to capture high-level semantic interactions between visual and textual modalities, enabling the model to identify coarse-grained cross-modal inconsistencies. To further reduce the influence of irrelevant objects, GLDA introduces a local gated cross-modal attention mechanism that dynamically filters redundant visual and textual features and refines multimodal representations at a finer granularity. In addition, a multi-branch learning objective is designed to jointly optimize unimodal and multimodal representations. Experimental results demonstrate that GLDA effectively improves sarcasm detection performance and achieves competitive results compared with existing approaches. The code will be available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/GLDA-DBE6.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 8 figures

</details>

### 450. [Confine to the Task, Anchor the Rest: Concept-Guided Retention Regularizer for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17713v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17713

**作者：** Ibna Kowsar、Ivan Medri、Fanyu Meng、Xin Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17713v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17713v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Concept-Guided Retention（CGR），一个即插即用的 PEFT 正则化器：借助冻结的稀疏自编码器读取概念，用权重通道把更新软约束到任务概念子空间，并用激活通道把选定的通用概念锚定到原模型，在 CLIP 视觉面板与 Llama-3.1-8B 指令微调上验证保留效果。

**相关性简评：** 其「激活通道 + SAE 概念子空间」约束线索可能可供核查：在训练 latent 推理状态时，是否可用类似概念级正则抑制任务必要视觉信息在微调中的坍缩或流失，但该文关注的是通用知识保留而非推理状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Confine to the Task, Anchor the Rest: Concept-Guided Retention Regularizer for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning

**abstract/A1：** Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) has been widely used, yet the adapted model suffers catastrophic forgetting of pre-trained knowledge. While most existing work hardens the adapter by constraining where the weight update may lie, we note that constraining this weight channel does not constrain the activation channel. In this paper, we propose Concept-Guided Retention (CGR), a plug-and-play regularizer that constrains both for any PEFT base. CGR reads a frozen sparse autoencoder (SAE) and treats two disjoint concept sets differently. It softly confines the update to the task-concept subspace (via weight channel), and anchors a selected set of general-purpose concepts to the frozen model (via activation channel). We also provide anchor value bounds based on weight updates to understand how they interact, and show that both terms are necessary. On a CLIP vision panel, CGR significantly improves retention at comparable accuracy for every base, and the same pattern holds for world-knowledge retention under Llama-3.1-8B instruction tuning. Because the protected directions are named SAE concepts, CGR remains inspectable and controllable.

</details>

### 451. [MissPath-FM: Flow Matching with Structured Priors for Partially Observed Time Series](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17715v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17715

**作者：** Genpei Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17715v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17715v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 MissPath-FM，一种面向部分观测时间序列的 flow matching 框架：用插值先验与高斯过程后验等结构化源先验，配合按观测/缺失区域非对称分配传输的缺失感知路径，在 48 个设定中胜出 45 个。

**相关性简评：** 其「源先验靠近已观测信号、把速度场集中到真正不确定条目」的做法，可供核查 latent 推理状态如何锚定视觉证据并把计算投向不确定区域；flow matching 这一并行生成路径也可能与 AR/parallel/diffusion 的推理状态生成方式对照，但迁移尚属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MissPath-FM: Flow Matching with Structured Priors for Partially Observed Time Series

**abstract/A1：** Flow matching has emerged as a powerful alternative to diffusion models for generative modeling, but standard conditional flow matching is fundamentally misaligned with partially observed time series: starting from an uninformed Gaussian source forces the model to transport even already-observed entries from noise to the target, wasting capacity on trivially known regions. We propose MissPath-FM, a partial-observation-aware flow matching framework that redesigns the source prior and probability path for incomplete time series. MissPath-FM employs structured source priors (interpolation priors and Gaussian process posterior priors) to initialize the flow close to the observed signal, paired with a missingness-aware smooth path that allocates transport asymmetrically between observed and missing regions. We evaluate systematically across four datasets, four missingness mechanisms (MCAR, block, MNAR, irregular), two missing ratios, and three sequence lengths (T in {24, 48, 96}), totaling 48 settings against eight baselines. MissPath-FM wins 29 of 32 settings at T=48 and 45 of 48 overall (93.8%). Our ablations reveal a regime-dependent design hierarchy in which no single component suffices: under random missingness the source prior yields a large initial gain, but under structured block missingness it can fail entirely and the learned flow becomes indispensable; the missingness-aware path contributes a further 12%-26% across all regimes. Mechanistically, structured priors shorten observed-region transport by up to 15x, concentrating the velocity field on genuinely uncertain entries. Project page: https://zgp110.github.io/misspath-fm/

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 24 pages. Project page: https://zgp110.github.io/misspath-fm/ Code: https://github.com/zgp110/misspath-fm

</details>

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ECG-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Targeted Electrocardiogram Waveform Evolution

**abstract/A1：** Electrocardiogram (ECG) models need supervision that targets evolving weaknesses and remains faithful to waveform evidence. We introduce ECG-RSI, a recursive self-improvement framework combining verified waveform synthesis with feedback-guided intervention search. Signal remeasurement verifies waveform edits; construction errors guide generator repair, while learner errors motivate interventions compared on a separate selection set. Across seven benchmarks, three rounds raise Qwen3.5-35B-A3B's mean question-answering accuracy from 34.57% to 56.04% and mean classification F1 from 24.27 to 34.03. Across the retained trajectory, the preferred supervision shifts from direct reinforcement to confusion-focused contrasts. Continued feedback correction yields diminishing external gains. These results motivate separating error diagnosis from intervention selection and checking whether gains on the feedback set transfer to independent benchmarks.

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TSRL: Trigger-based Supervised Reinforcement Learning for Continual Agent Training

**abstract/A1：** Large language model (LLM) agents excel at complex, multi-step tasks but suffer from catastrophic forgetting during continual learning--acquiring new skills often degrades previously mastered capabilities. Existing post-training paradigms face a fundamental trade-off: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) is sample-efficient but prone to severe forgetting, while Reinforcement Learning (RL) preserves prior capabilities but converges slowly without expert guidance. To bridge this gap, we introduce Trigger-based Supervised Reinforcement Learning (TSRL), a framework that integrates the strengths of both paradigms through an adaptive, state-dependent expert supervision mechanism. TSRL employs RL as the optimization backbone, activating SFT selectively on "hard states" where the policy fails. Theoretically, we show that restricting supervision to failure states derives an upper bound on the cumulative parameter updates, thereby reducing forgetting compared to full SFT. Empirically, TSRL achieves consistent gains across three agent benchmarks (ALFWorld, WebShop, and Deep Search) at both 7B and 32B scales. In continual learning scenarios, our method retains up to 9.6 points more capability on prior tasks than SFT-&gt;RL baselines, while matching or exceeding target-task performance.

</details>

### 454. [CoCA: Criterion-Aware Credit Assignment for Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17733v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17733

**作者：** Guangcheng Zhu、Yingfan Ma、Xing Zheng、Haobo Wang、Shenzhi Yang、Kai Tang、Zhengqing Zang、Bowen Song、Weiqiang Wang、Gang Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对 rubric-based RL 中标准方法把准则级反馈压成标量奖励、对所有 token 均匀分配优势的问题，提出 CoCA：把特权 rubric 信息当作相关性线索，用组内相对结果推导准则级 credit，并按准则引起的分布偏移把 credit 分配到 token 上，在医学与科学基准上平均提升 4.2%。

**相关性简评：** 属于纯文本 RL 的细粒度信用分配，与 LVR 中「答案是否真正使用 latent 内容、贡献分配与监督信号落点」的问题形式相近，其按准则相关性把 credit 摊到 token 的做法可供核查是否能迁移为 latent 步或视觉证据的贡献归因；但无视觉或多模态推理设定，联系为推测性线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CoCA: Criterion-Aware Credit Assignment for Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning

**abstract/A1：** Rubric-based reinforcement learning (RL) evaluates responses against explicit criteria to construct rewards, offering a viable way to train large language models on open-ended tasks. However, standard methods compress criterion-level feedback into scalar rewards and assign uniform token advantages, leaving structured rubric supervision underutilized. Recent work seeks finer-grained guidance by treating rubrics as privileged information to derive self-distillation targets, but the resulting learning signal is not grounded in criterion outcomes and can lead to reward degradation. This motivates us to reframe the problem as criterion-aware credit assignment, where privileged rubric information serves as a relevance cue for credit allocation rather than a source of imitation targets. Accordingly, we propose CoCA, which derives criterion-level credits from group-relative outcomes and allocates them across tokens based on criterion-induced distribution shifts, yielding both outcome-grounded and fine-grained learning signals. Empirically, CoCA achieves an average gain of +4.2% over standard rubric-based RL across medicine and science benchmarks, demonstrating more effective learning on open-ended tasks.

</details>

### 455. [Explore with Memory, Learn without It: In-Context Exploration and Self-Distillation for LLM Reasoning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17734v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17734

**作者：** Yutong Chen、Zhichao Xu、Rui Liu、Kunpeng Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17734v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17734v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 LEAF：在每次 rollout 前向上下文注入动态、问题级记忆（最近一次回答、奖励及其他验证器反馈），并在每次验证后更新记忆，同时用自蒸馏把策略更新与 rollout 解耦，以加速 RLVR 的探索与学习效率。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本 RLVR 工作，不涉及视觉状态，但其「把历史回答与验证反馈作为记忆注入并逐步更新」以及自蒸馏的轨迹训练监督方式，可能为 LVR 中的状态更新、轨迹训练与贡献分配提供可核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Explore with Memory, Learn without It: In-Context Exploration and Self-Distillation for LLM Reasoning

**abstract/A1：** Exploration bounds learning efficiency in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). Current methods explore mostly through independent sampling, without fully using the information gathered along the way, such as known wrong answers and environment feedback. We propose LEAF, which injects a dynamic, problem-specific memory into the context before every rollout. The memory contains the most recent response, its reward, and other environment feedback. It is updated after every verifier call. We decouple policy updates from rollouts and update the policy through self-distillation. On four benchmarks and two open models, LEAF accelerates exploration by about 4x compared with a random sampling baseline. On unseen test sets, it improves accuracy over the strongest baseline by 1.59 and 1.83 percentage points on the two models, while using less compute than any RL baseline. These results highlight the potential of LEAF in improving both exploration and learning efficiency. Code is available at: https://github.com/on1262/LEAF

**comment/C1：** preprint

</details>

### 456. [Train for Many, Update with One: Improving Multi-Sample Reasoning via Fenchel-Bregman Posterior Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17735v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17735

**作者：** Sungjun Lim、Adrian Robert Minut、Nico Carlsen Daheim、Mohammad Emtiyaz Khan、Kyungwoo Song、Thomas Möllenhoff

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17735v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17735v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文将多采样推理（Pass@K 覆盖）重新表述为有限 K 后验学习：在求解器参数上训练一个分布以降低 K 个候选全部失败的概率，并提出只需一次后验采样的 Fenchel-Bregman 方法，实例化为 FBI，在递归与自回归推理任务上提升候选覆盖并减少训练时间。

**相关性简评：** 研究问题属纯文本多候选覆盖的训练目标，不在视觉 latent 主线上，但其「多轨迹覆盖 + 单次采样更新 + 指数滑动权重」的训练监督机制，可能可供核查于 LVR 多轨迹 latent 训练中的贡献分配与采样成本问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Train for Many, Update with One: Improving Multi-Sample Reasoning via Fenchel-Bregman Posterior Learning

**abstract/A1：** Multi-sample reasoning measures candidate coverage, the probability that at least one of $K$ candidates is correct. However, minimizing the average loss of individual attempts does not directly optimize candidate coverage. We therefore formulate finite-$K$ posterior learning, which trains a distribution over solver parameters to reduce the probability that all $K$ independently generated candidates fail. To optimize this objective efficiently, we propose a Fenchel-Bregman (FB) approach that requires only one posterior draw per update, rather than the $K$ used by direct Monte Carlo optimization. FB first uses an exact Fenchel reformulation to separate problem-specific weights from the posterior update, enabling one-draw posterior updates. It then applies a closed-form Bregman update to track these weights through an exponential running average of observed failures, reusing the same draw. We instantiate FB with IVON, a variational optimizer for Gaussian posteriors over solver parameters, yielding Fenchel-Bregman IVON (FBI). Across diverse recursive and autoregressive reasoning tasks, FBI improves candidate coverage. In a matched comparison, it achieves comparable Pass@10 using 12.3% of the direct Monte Carlo baseline's measured training time per update.

</details>

### 457. [Coupled Harness--Model Evolution for Scientific Equation Discovery](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17740v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17740

**作者：** Pengze Li、Jiaquan Zhang、Encheng Su、Yunbo Long、Zihang Zeng、Xinping Liu、Han Zhang、Junchi Yu、Shixiang Tang、Aoran Wang、Xi Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17740v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17740v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出耦合演化框架，让可执行工具库与模型工具使用策略从同一可验证的拟合误差信号中共同改进：智能体通过诊断自身失败来新增工具、修正选择规则，再用冻结工具库收集的成功轨迹微调约 3B 的小模型，并在多个方程发现基准上评测。

**相关性简评：** 其「冻结工具库采集成功轨迹再微调策略」的监督方式，以及工具能力与策略各自贡献的消融设计，可能为 LVR 中的轨迹训练、贡献分配与监督信号设计提供可核查线索；但材料未涉及视觉表示或潜空间状态，联系需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Coupled Harness--Model Evolution for Scientific Equation Discovery

**abstract/A1：** Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to discover scientific equations from experimental data. Such a discovery system has two parts that must work together: a library of executable computational tools and the model's tool-use policy. The tools supply the solving capability, from diagnosing structure in the data to fitting candidate equations; the policy plans and orchestrates their use. Yet existing systems adapt only one part, keeping either the toolset or the model fixed, which leaves the corresponding failures uncorrectable. We develop a coupled evolution framework that improves both parts from the same verifiable fit-error signal. In the tool-evolution phase, an agent grows an executable tool library from a small set of generic numerical operations by diagnosing its own failures: it authors a new tool when a capability is missing and revises its selection rules when the right tool went unused. In the policy-evolution phase, a small open model (roughly 3B active parameters) is fine-tuned on successful tool-use trajectories collected with the frozen library, on training formulas screened to be disjoint from all evaluation benchmarks. Ablations show the two phases are complementary: with no tool library at all the same model solves almost nothing, the tools account for most of the gain, and trajectory training adds a further gain that is largest on the most difficult problems. The full system solves 79.1/71.3\\% of LSR-Synth problems at fit tolerances $10^{-2}$/$10^{-3}$, reaches 63.8\\% pooled accuracy on the distributionally different SRSD-Feynman panel, and obtains a normalized CP3-28 aggregate of $-7.27$. These results suggest a broader recipe for scientific agents: let the model and its instruments improve each other under verifiable feedback.

</details>
