### 458. [Posterior-Averaged Bellman Flow Matching for Distributional Critics](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17788v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17788

**作者：** Zeqiao Li、Yijing Wang、Haoyu Wang、Zheng Li、Zhiqiang Zuo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17788v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17788v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出 PA-BFM：把 flow critic 训练的中间桥态视为与多个 Bellman 终点兼容，对 latent anchor 做闭式后验推断并回归后验均值速度，以降低分布式 critic 的 TD 目标方差。

**相关性简评：** 其「潜在锚点后验 + 后验均值速度」这一处理多终点歧义的监督构造，可能迁移到 LVR 中同一 latent 状态对应多条有效推理轨迹或答案时的训练目标设计，可供人工核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Posterior-Averaged Bellman Flow Matching for Distributional Critics

**abstract/A1：** Distributional critics model the full return distribution, providing richer signals for exploration and risk-sensitive control. Recent work has shown that flow-based critics can model these distributions flexibly and provide effective supervision across flow time for temporal-difference learning. However, unlike standard flow matching with fixed data endpoints, a flow critic is trained on Bellman targets recursively generated by a learned target critic under the current policy. Existing objectives therefore either use noisy single-endpoint supervision or rely on the learned flow itself for additional guidance. Our key observation is that an intermediate bridge state may be compatible with several Bellman endpoints, so its velocity should average their directions under the corresponding posterior. We propose Posterior-Averaged Bellman Flow Matching (PA-BFM), which samples an endpoint pool, infers the closed-form posterior over the latent anchor, and regresses to the posterior-mean velocity. Uniform anchor selection makes this target an exact finite-pool Rao--Blackwellization of the single-endpoint target: for every \\(K\\), it preserves the population target, cannot increase conditional variance, and its conditional variance scales as \\(O(K^{-1})\\). The endpoint pool supports conservative updates, while the twin return flows provide critic-disagreement and unsupported-mass diagnostics. Controlled studies show that PA-BFM reduces fixed-query target mean-squared error by \\(79.7\\%\\) and target-induced gradient variance by up to \\(98.0\\%\\), while improving return-distribution fidelity. Across 50 OGBench tasks and four offline-to-online scenarios, PA-BFM achieves higher aggregate performance than Value Flows.

</details>

### 459. [Benchmarking and Training Reward Models for Cross-Source Evidence Grounding in Search Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17827v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17827

**作者：** Haochen Zhao、Minsheng Hao、Zheng Li、Yifan Li、Zikang Liu、Bowen Qin、Yuhao Cheng、Chuang Fan、Haosheng Zou、Jeff Chen、Sujian Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17827v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17827v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 CSEG 评估框架与 CSEG-Bench，用覆盖完整搜索轨迹的六层决策树刻画跨来源证据溯源、归因与冲突消解，并训练奖励模型 CSEG-RM 为答案策略提供分层监督。

**相关性简评：** 其分层奖励建模与轨迹级证据归因、冲突裁决监督，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与「答案是否真正使用 latent/证据」的信用分配提供可核查的监督信号设计线索；但对象为文本检索代理，向多模态 latent 推理的迁移仍需核实。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Benchmarking and Training Reward Models for Cross-Source Evidence Grounding in Search Agents

**abstract/A1：** Existing approaches to training and evaluating search agents focus heavily on final-answer quality, largely neglecting how generated answers map back to retrieved evidence. Recent methods track citations to enforce grounding, but citation support alone does not establish source independence or whether an answer appropriately handles conflicting evidence. We argue that credibility in open-web retrieval depends on principled cross-source evidence grounding that accounts for source independence and systematically attributes and adjudicates conflicting evidence, while hierarchical judgments of these grounding decisions provide a unified signal for training and evaluation. To this end, we propose an evaluation framework, Cross-Source Evidence Grounding (CSEG), that employs a fine-grained, six-layer decision tree over the complete search trajectory. We introduce CSEG-Bench and trainable reward models to provide targeted supervision following this framework. Our approach helps eliminating the severe data skew of natural trajectories by providing targeted coverage over complex, deep-layer decision paths, such as cross-source conflict resolution and nuanced attribution, that standard rollouts fail to capture. Specifically, (1) we define the hierarchy at label, node, and path levels; (2) we construct 1,160 verified trajectories over nine canonical paths by rewriting answers on real retrieved document pools, with independent frontier judges reproducing the entire gold path and human experts deciding inclusion; (3) we train CSEG-RM, which reaches 83.9% exact accuracy on our benchmark while lying on the performance-token efficiency Pareto frontier. Experiments that use this reward alone to supervise a frozen-retrieval answer policy raise the independently judged mean label from 2.83 to 4.19, and show that learning the hierarchy generalizes across layers at a fraction of frontier-judge cost.

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 QK-Edit，一种免训练的图像与视频编辑框架：针对 MM-DiT 中图像与文本 token 拼接自注意力的特性，通过查询-键层面的注意力操作在推理时分离并调整关键注意力成分，以平衡提示保真与结构一致，并在 FLUX、HunyuanVideo 上验证。

**相关性简评：** 其推理期特征替换与 query-key 注意力干预，可能为 LVR 中注意力结构如何影响视觉证据在内部状态中的保留与使用提供可供核查的操纵与诊断线索，但研究对象是扩散生成式编辑，与多模态推理的距离较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** QK-Edit: Revisiting Attention-based Injection in MM-DiT for Image and Video Editing

**abstract/A1：** Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MM-DiTs) have recently emerged as a powerful framework for unified text-vision synthesis, surpassing traditional U-Net architectures in generative tasks. One key innovation lies in its Multimodal Self-Attention (MM-SA) interaction, where image and text tokens are concatenated and processed via self-attention. However, this mechanism poses significant challenges for editing, rendering conventional U-Net-based attention manipulation methods ineffective. To address this limitation, we propose QK-Edit, a training-free framework that exploits the unique attention dynamics of MM-DiTs for precise text-guided image and video editing. By introducing a novel query-key manipulation strategy, our method isolates and adjusts critical attention components to achieve an optimal balance between prompt fidelity and structural consistency. This enables seamless edits across various tasks, including object addition, object removal, object replacement, changing background, changing material, changing color, and style transformation. Notably, it can be easily implemented with feature replacement in inference. QK-Edit demonstrates superior editing performance on state-of-the-art models, such as FLUX and HunyuanVideo, effectively bridging the gap between generative power and editable flexibility in MM-DiTs, and paving the way for scalable multimodal content creation.

</details>

### 461. [GeoNIRS: Geometry-Aware Pretraining for Heterogeneous fNIRS Representation Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17845v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17845

**作者：** Zongsheng Li、Shengyuan Zhu、Zimo Zhang、Hanyao Li、Shengming Wang、Quanying Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17845v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17845v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** GeoNIRS 面向 fNIRS 异构通道配置的联合预训练，用光源—探测器位置作为共享空间参考，将变长通道集合压缩为定长 latent，并以 HbO/HbR 双向跨重构加连续时间掩码进行自监督预训练，在八个下游任务上高于多类基线。

**相关性简评：** 其「用物理几何作共享参考、把变长输入压成定长 latent，并用掩码跨信号重构提供监督」的做法，可能为 LVR 中变长视觉证据到定长 latent 工作区的压缩与训练监督方式提供可供核查的线索，但跨模态迁移性未知。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GeoNIRS: Geometry-Aware Pretraining for Heterogeneous fNIRS Representation Learning

**abstract/A1：** Functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) provides portable and spatially localized measurements of cortical hemodynamics, but differences in channel count, probe layout, signal distribution, and task type hinder joint pretraining across datasets. We introduce GeoNIRS, a geometry-aware framework that uses source-detector locations as a shared spatial reference across heterogeneous probe layouts. GeoNIRS compresses variable-size channel sets into a fixed-size latent representation and employs bidirectional HbO/HbR cross-reconstruction with contiguous temporal masking. GeoNIRS-base is pretrained on eight heterogeneous datasets, while GeoNIRS-large scales to 22 datasets. Neither downstream data nor labels are used during pretraining, enabling evaluation under a strict cross-task setting. To our knowledge, GeoNIRS is the first fNIRS framework to explicitly model physical channel geometry during joint pretraining across heterogeneous channel configurations, and the first to provide complete source code and downloadable pretrained checkpoints. We evaluate GeoNIRS on eight held-out tasks spanning clinical and auditory assessment, pain and affective processing, semantic decoding, and motor function. GeoNIRS achieves the highest task-averaged balanced accuracy among the evaluated conventional machine-learning, fNIRS-specific, general time-series, and fNIRS pretraining baselines. Compared with random initialization, pretraining improves average balanced accuracy by 4.12 percentage points under linear probing and 3.30 points under full fine-tuning, with larger benefits when labels are scarce. GeoNIRS also remains robust to missing input channels. Geometry perturbations and pretraining ablations further show that both channel geometry and cross-chromophore reconstruction contribute to the learned representations.

**comment/C1：** 30 pages, 5 figures, and 21 tables. Code and pretrained checkpoints are available at https://github.com/GeoNIRS/GeoNIRS

</details>

### 462. [Socratic Skill Learning: Interleaving Teaching and Practice for Transferable Agent Skills](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17860v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17860

**作者：** Letian Zhu、Han Li、Yifan Yao、Xinping Lei、Xinyu Che、Jiahao Wang、Dianyi Wang、Yucheng Fu、Jiakai Wang、Zhiqi Bai、Wenbo Su、Jiaheng Liu

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Socratic Skill Learning，让专家「教学」与学生「实践」交替进行，学生始终是唯一的环境操作者与 Skill 作者，并构建含 35 个任务族、408 个可执行用例的 SkillTransferBench；Issue-Guided 变体通过跟踪未解决问题减少 61.7% 的指导 token。

**相关性简评：** 其交错式教学/实践监督、按未解决问题选择性复习以控制成本的做法，可能为 LVR 轨迹训练中的监督分配与「STOP」式预算决策提供线索；但全文是纯文本 agent 技能获取，无视觉内部状态或推理期表示生成，需人工核查迁移价值。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Socratic Skill Learning: Interleaving Teaching and Practice for Transferable Agent Skills

**abstract/A1：** Agent Skills improve LLM agents by making task knowledge reusable across sessions. Learning transferable Skills requires evidence about a procedure and its conditions of use, which a successful task attempt can leave untested. We introduce Socratic Skill Learning (SSL), which interleaves expert teaching with Student practice. An Educator guides investigation while the Student remains the sole environment operator and Skill author, able to question, test, and adapt advice. To test reuse beyond the learning task, we construct SkillTransferBench, with 35 task families and 408 executable cases, pairing public variation specifications with held-out evaluation in fresh solver sessions. On the main 22-family, 155-case cohort, Fixed-Window SSL reaches 0.801 utility, versus 0.723 without a Skill, 0.761 for adapted Trace2Skill (trajectory distillation), and 0.751 for adapted SKILL-KD (contrastive distillation). Across three model pairs on shared families, interleaved guidance outperforms expert authoring and post-hoc teaching. Process analysis links guidance to Student writing and package revision; a case study shows the Student testing and refining a proposed procedure for later reuse. As demand for new lessons falls, the cost of fixed-window review grows. Issue-Guided SSL tracks unresolved questions across Skill revisions to select and focus review, reaching 0.805 utility with 61.7% fewer Educator tokens and 16.9% fewer total acquisition tokens than Fixed-Window SSL on the main cohort.

**comment/C1：** 25 pages. Code and benchmark: https://github.com/NJU-LINK/Socratic-Skill-Learning

</details>

### 463. [Searching for What Matters: Open-Ended Discovery of Multiple Hypotheses with Agentic Data Exploration](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17874v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17874

**作者：** Sanchit Kabra、Nurendra Choudhary、Jiangshu Du、Eddie Huang、Danai Koutra、Chandan K Reddy

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17874v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17874v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出「开放式多假设发现」任务及基于结构因果模型的基准（351 个植入假设、15 个任务、53–65 个变量），并提出把数据集当作交互环境的 HypAgent，迭代提出候选方向、筛选精炼假设并移除已被解释的信号，F1 约 0.49 优于最强基线 0.35。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接关联，但其迭代证据获取与「移除已解释信号以重定向搜索」的残差分离机制可供核查，可能类比 latent 推理中的证据筛选、贡献分配与停止决策。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Searching for What Matters: Open-Ended Discovery of Multiple Hypotheses with Agentic Data Exploration

**abstract/A1：** Discovering what drives an outcome from data is central to science and often requires deciding what is worth investigating before a specific hypothesis is known. Yet most existing hypothesis generation settings substantially narrow this search by providing a research question, target relationship, or curated context. We introduce open-ended multiple hypothesis discovery, where a system receives only a large tabular dataset and an outcome and must discover multiple data-supported hypotheses without knowing in advance the relevant variables, functional forms, conditions, or number of underlying mechanisms. To study this problem, we introduce a benchmark built from structural causal models grounded in real-world data schemas, containing 351 planted hypotheses across 15 tasks and five domains, with 53--65 variables and 1M--10M rows per task. The causal model is hidden from the discovery method and retained only by the evaluator, allowing proposed hypotheses to be tested through interventions and separating observational discovery from causal validation. We further propose HypAgent, which treats the dataset as an interactive environment and performs iterative search by proposing candidate directions, triaging and refining promising hypotheses, and removing explained signal so that each accepted discovery redirects subsequent search. HypAgent achieves 0.47 precision, 0.51 recall, and 0.49 F1, compared with 0.35 F1 for the strongest baseline. Our analysis shows that many failures occur after a relevant variable has already been surfaced, suggesting that correctly characterizing a mechanism's functional form and conditions, rather than merely identifying relevant variables, remains a key challenge in open-ended discovery.

</details>

### 464. [Diagnose-to-Generate: Eliminating Structural Distortions in Flow Models via Patch-Level Grounded Alignment](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17882v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17882

**作者：** Yifan Li、Lishuai Gao、Tong Zhang、Qilong Huang、Chen Zhao、Zhuoliang Kang、Jie Hu、Yujie Zhong、Fenghe Tang、S Kevin Zhou、Xiaoming Wei

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17882v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17882v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Diagnose-to-Generate 框架：构建区域标注数据集并训练诊断模型 ARGUS 预测异常类别与边界框，再将其转成 patch 级置信加权奖励，配合 Patch-level Flow-GRPO 与 TPSS（前期用确定性 ODE 轨迹、后期才注入随机性）抑制流式图像生成的局部结构畸变。

**相关性简评：** 其「区域诊断→patch 级信用分配」与轨迹保持采样对 rollout 空间漂移的约束，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态贡献分配与探索稳定性提供可核查的方法线索，但对象是图像生成对齐，与 VLM 推理无直接关系，故仅作方法借鉴。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Diagnose-to-Generate: Eliminating Structural Distortions in Flow Models via Patch-Level Grounded Alignment

**abstract/A1：** Flow-based image generators achieve strong semantic synthesis but still produce localized structural distortions, such as malformed hands and limbs. Existing post-training methods typically optimize global scalar rewards, which provide weak spatial credit assignment and may alter well-formed regions while correcting local defects. We present \\textit{Diagnose-to-Generate (D2G)}, a grounded alignment framework that separates visual diagnosis from generative optimization. We construct \\textbf{Achilles-600K}, a region-annotated dataset for structural anomalies, and train \\textbf{ARGUS} through supervised cold-start and Region-Aware Group Relative Policy Optimization to predict anomaly categories and bounding boxes. These diagnoses are converted into confidence-weighted spatial rewards for our \\textbf{Patch-level Flow-GRPO}. We further identify that global stochastic exploration can shift semantic regions across group rollouts, making patch-wise relative advantages spatially inconsistent. Our \\textbf{Trajectory-Preserving Stochastic Sampling (TPSS)} anchors early denoising with deterministic ODE trajectories and introduces stochasticity only at later steps, thereby limiting intra-group spatial drift while retaining local exploration. Experiments on FLUX.1-dev and SD3.5 show improved structural fidelity with preserved FID and CLIP scores. Consistent gains under HumanRefiner, zero-shot GPT-4.1, and blinded human evaluation further demonstrate that the improvements extend beyond the training reward model.

</details>

### 465. [Training LLMs for Multi-Agent Collaboration with Verifiable Information Rewards](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17893v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17893

**作者：** Keru Chen、Sen Lin、Yingbin Liang、Nathaniel D. Bastian、Shaofeng Zou

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17893v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17893v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 CoSIR：用贝叶斯评估器以团队 surprisal 的下降衡量共享信息与请求信息的价值，作为可验证奖励，并用自博弈后训练多个 LLM，测试其向七个未见自然语言协作任务的迁移。

**相关性简评：** 其「surprisal 下降即信息价值」的奖励设计以及「是否真正使用队友信息」的辅助监督，可能为 LVR 中证据 token 的贡献分配、LOOK 的证据价值评估与视觉旁路诊断提供可核查线索；但本文无视觉输入与 latent 状态，属方法借鉴而非直接竞争。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Training LLMs for Multi-Agent Collaboration with Verifiable Information Rewards

**abstract/A1：** Effective collaboration among large language model (LLM) agents in multi-agent systems requires sharing relevant evidence, requesting missing information, and incorporating teammates' contributions into decisions. Training these behaviors is challenging because final task outcomes provide limited feedback on the value of individual messages. We introduce CoSIR (Collaboration via Surprisal-based Information Rewards), a post-training approach that uses a simple, verifiable environment to teach collaboration behaviors that generalize to more complex, unseen tasks. We propose a Bayesian evaluator that scores shared information by its reduction in team surprisal, defined as the sum of the negative log probabilities assigned to the correct option given each agent's available evidence. Requests are scored by the potential reduction in the same quantity if the requested information were truthfully provided. Separate rewards encourage agents to use the received information in their private choices and calculations. We post-train Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, and Gemma-3-4B-it through self-play and evaluate transfer to seven unseen natural-language collaboration tasks. CoSIR achieves the highest aggregate score, while its performance in general tasks remains competitive. Behavioral analyses show increased disclosure of private evidence and fewer judged failures to use teammates' input.

**comment/C1：** 23 pages

</details>

### 466. [DriveWLA: Unifying Future Dynamics and Scene Semantics through World-Language-Action Modeling for Autonomous Driving](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17903v1>)

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.RO

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 DriveWLA，一个基于 Mixture-of-Transformers 的世界-语言-动作统一模型：由世界专家做未来场景预测、语言专家做语义理解、动作专家生成轨迹，并用跨专家注意力与 Flow-GRPO 强化学习后训练加以整合。

**相关性简评：** 其「跨专家注意力控制信息流」与「世界专家产出的未来动态表示供动作专家消费」的结构，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据如何进入并留存于推理状态、避免视觉旁路与信息坍缩提供可核查线索，但原文属驾驶应用，迁移性需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DriveWLA: Unifying Future Dynamics and Scene Semantics through World-Language-Action Modeling for Autonomous Driving

**abstract/A1：** Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and world models have demonstrated strong capabilities in semantic understanding and future scene evolution for autonomous driving. However, effectively integrating both capabilities for trajectory generation remains challenging. In this work, we propose DriveWLA, a unified World-Language-Action model based on Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) that jointly models semantic understanding, future scene dynamics, and trajectory generation. DriveWLA consists of three experts: a World Expert for future prediction, a Language Expert for semantic understanding, and an Action Expert for trajectory generation. We further introduce Cross-Expert Attention, which enables controlled information flow across experts while aligning semantic and dynamic representations. To improve trajectory generation beyond imitation learning, we apply Flow-GRPO reinforcement learning post-training to refine the Action Expert. Extensive experiments show that DriveWLA achieves superior performance in both open-loop and closed-loop evaluation. DriveWLA achieves 92.3 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 and 90.1 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2, demonstrating strong performance among VLM-based and world-model-based planners. Without specific fine-tuning, DriveWLA further demonstrates strong zero-shot generalization to HUGSIM, nuScenes, and Bench2Drive. These results validate the effectiveness of our unified World-Language-Action modeling, establishing DriveWLA as a generalizable framework for autonomous driving.

**comment/C1：** 17 pages, 4 figures

</details>

### 467. [Stable-Plastic Subspace Construction for Differentially Private Continual LoRA](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17904v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17904

**作者：** Jin Liu、Ning Xi、Yinbin Miao、Junkang Liu、Ke Cheng、Jianfeng Ma

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17904v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17904v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究差分隐私约束下持续 LoRA 微调中的稳定性-可塑性矛盾，提出 DP-SPA：用历史私有更新构造 stable 子空间、在其余正交补内以预训练权重构造 plastic 子空间，固定两组基只私有优化 LoRA 因子，并按历史与当前更新能量对 stable 方向系数重标定。

**相关性简评：** 其围绕正交子空间划分、固定基与消除双线性噪声的构造，可能为 LVR 中「保留既有视觉证据」与「更新推理状态」之间的表示分离与干扰抑制提供可核查的方法线索，尚需阅读原文确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Stable-Plastic Subspace Construction for Differentially Private Continual LoRA

**abstract/A1：** Continual learning (CL) adapts pretrained models to a sequence of tasks while retaining knowledge acquired from earlier tasks. When task data are sensitive, differential privacy (DP) provides record-level protection, but maintaining both adaptation and retention under privacy constraints remains challenging. We study this problem in continual low-rank adaptation (LoRA) and observe that: 1) private training increases forgetting primarily during subsequent adaptation rather than initial task acquisition; 2) jointly perturbing both LoRA factors introduces a non-negligible bilinear noise interaction; and 3) DP aggravates the stability-plasticity dilemma, hindering both knowledge retention and adaptation to new tasks. Based on these observations, we propose DP-SPA, which constructs a stable subspace from previously privatized updates and a plastic subspace from pretrained weights within its orthogonal complement. The method fixes these bases and privately optimizes only the LoRA factor, eliminating the bilinear noise interaction within each step. Before merging each task update, it rescales stable-direction coefficients using historical and current update energies. We establish a privacy guarantee and show that recalibration does not increase historical overlap and tightens a conditional upper bound on old-task loss increase. Experiments across five datasets, eight settings, and multiple privacy budgets show that DP-SPA improves average accuracy and reduces forgetting compared with the evaluated baselines.

</details>

### 468. [NBCLT: Parameter-Agnostic Norm-Ball Clipped Local Training](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17913v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17913

**作者：** Linxuan Pan、Shucheng Yang、Junchi Yang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17913v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17913v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 NBCLT，一个统一用于联邦学习与去中心化学习的本地训练框架：把「预测—校正」式本地更新与灵活的 norm-ball 欧氏投影结合，实现无需问题相关超参的更新裁剪，并给出通信与随机梯度复杂度界。

**相关性简评：** 其中的 norm-ball 投影约束与「预测—校正」更新规则，可能为 latent/循环推理中多次迭代的状态更新漂移控制与几何约束提供可核查的借鉴线索，但原文面向分布式优化，是否可迁移到推理期 latent 状态演化尚需核对。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** NBCLT: Parameter-Agnostic Norm-Ball Clipped Local Training

**abstract/A1：** Distributed learning with multiple local steps reduces communication but aggravates drift, and its practical performance often depends on carefully tuned hyperparameters under heterogeneous data and communication constraints. At the same time, recent Muon-type optimizers suggest that constraining updates within suitable norm balls provides a simple way to encode geometric priors into optimization. In this work, we propose NBCLT (Norm-Ball Clipped Local Training), a unified local-training framework for both federated learning (FL) and decentralized learning (DL). NBCLT combines a predict-and-correct local update rule with Euclidean projections onto flexible norm balls, thereby performing norm-ball clipping under flexible update geometries while retaining a simple implementation. In FL, its problem-parameter-free regime achieves $\\mathcal{O}(ε^{-2})$ communication complexity and $\\mathcal{O}(ε^{-4})$ total stochastic-gradient complexity without assuming bounded heterogeneity, when the per-round local-computation budget is scaled appropriately with the horizon. In DL, NBCLT is compatible with both static and time-varying mixing and preserves these accuracy exponents under the analogous computation scaling, up to fixed network constants and an additive initialization cost.

</details>

### 469. [Stein Variational Distributional Reinforcement Learning: Score-Guided Particles for Multivariate Return Distributions](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17925v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17925

**作者：** Manuel Haußmann、Melih Kandemir

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17925v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17925v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SVDRL：用 Stein 粒子表示多变量回报分布，沿学习到的 score 场输运粒子，以自举去噪 score matching 加一致性损失训练，并用反向扩散采样器回答低于粒子分辨率的尾部风险查询。

**相关性简评：** 属 RL 分布建模，与视觉推理主线无直接关系；其粒子沿学习 score 场的迭代输运与跨 Bellman 递归的一致性损失，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的迭代生成与轨迹级监督提供可核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Stein Variational Distributional Reinforcement Learning: Score-Guided Particles for Multivariate Return Distributions

**abstract/A1：** Decisions that weigh several reward signals against each other require the joint distribution of the return vector. Categorical critics scale exponentially in the reward dimension, and quantiles have no canonical multivariate analogue. Multivariate distributional critics therefore represent each return distribution by M equal-weight particles trained with a discrepancy loss. Beyond their atoms, the particles provide no sampler and cannot resolve events rarer than 1/M. We propose Stein variational distributional RL (SVDRL). Its critic outputs Stein particles, which Stein variational gradient descent transports along a learned score field of the distributional Bellman target. We learn this field by bootstrapped denoising score matching across noise levels and tie it across the Bellman recursion by a consistency loss, which we prove is a non-expansive temporal-difference scheme in score space. The same field certifies the particles. Its reverse-diffusion sampler satisfies a supremal Wasserstein policy-evaluation bound that holds for bounded, possibly multimodal returns. The Stein particles inherit this bound up to a gap that we measure without ground truth, and the sampler answers tail-risk queries below the particle resolution at any sample size. Empirically, SVDRL is more accurate on rare events than particle critics with the same number of particles, and on par on MuJoCo continuous control.

**comment/C1：** preprint

</details>

### 470. [CineMem: Attention-Aligned Fine-grained Memory Retrieval for Multi-Shot Long Video Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17926v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17926

**作者：** Xiaoxue Wu、Xinyu Gao、Fang Yu、Yu Qiao、Xinyuan Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17926v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17926v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** CineMem 面向自回归多镜头长视频生成，提出注意力对齐的细粒度记忆检索框架：用在线聚类 KV cache 组织全部历史 token，并以查询级检索机制在固定预算下近似全记忆访问，另提出 VLM 辅助的跨镜头一致性指标。

**相关性简评：** 其「注意力模式驱动的在线聚类 KV cache」与「查询级、固定预算检索」可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的记忆组织、视觉证据按需检索以及缓存与注意力结构对状态检索的影响提供可供核查的方法线索；但任务属视频生成，与 VLM 推理的直接关联仍需核实。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CineMem: Attention-Aligned Fine-grained Memory Retrieval for Multi-Shot Long Video Generation

**abstract/A1：** Autoregressive video generation relies on memory retrieval to model long-range dependencies. This capability becomes particularly critical for multi-shot generation, where models must reconcile substantial visual changes across shot transitions with persistent semantic continuity. Existing methods tend to perform memory retrieval at the frame level and share the same historical context across all query tokens, overlooking the heterogeneous information needs and leading to redundant retrieval and inefficient use of historical memory. To bridge this gap, we introduce CineMem, an attention-aligned fine-grained memory retrieval framework that combines online memory organization with query-adaptive retrieval for autoregressive multi-shot video generation. Specifically, guided by intrinsic memory-access patterns revealed through attention analysis, we propose an online-clustered KV cache as a memory organization strategy over all historical tokens, enabling semantic-aware memory grouping and more precise retrieval. In addition, we introduce a query-level retrieval mechanism that provides broader access to historical information under a fixed retrieval budget, thereby improving long-term memory utilization. Together, these designs enable the multi-shot video generator to preserve long-range consistency across shot transitions, particularly in revisitation scenarios, while approximating full-memory access under a constrained memory budget. To facilitate evaluation, we further introduce a suite of task-specific, VLM-assisted metrics for faithful inter-shot consistency assessment. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework.

**comment/C1：** Project Page: https://uknowsth.github.io/CineMem/

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17933

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17933v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17933v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文构建糖尿病视网膜病变的「筛查—病灶分割—分级」级联系统，用异构稀疏专家 U-Net 分割多种病灶、以门控交叉注意力让病灶掩码查询图像并分离可分级性与严重度，并做端到端评估与阶段错误归因。

**相关性简评：** 其掩码消融与「门控开启后分级仍忽略掩码」的负结果，以及把错误回溯到具体阶段的做法，可能为核查 LVR 中视觉旁路、证据是否被答案实际使用与贡献分配提供可借鉴的诊断线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** HierarchiRetina: A Diabetic Retinopathy Screening and Grading Cascade with Heterogeneous Mixture-of-Experts Lesion Segmentation

**abstract/A1：** Clinical screening for diabetic retinopathy proceeds in stages, yet most automated systems grade fundus images with a single black-box network. Three gaps remain: (i) lesions differ widely in size and contrast, but segmenters typically apply the same blocks to all; (ii) ungradable images are usually excluded or treated as an extra class, and lesion-aware graders seldom test whether lesions drive the grade; (iii) staged systems often report each stage only on the images reaching it, leaving propagated errors unmeasured. HierarchiRetina, a screening, segmentation and grading cascade with inspectable stage outputs, addresses each gap. First, HSMoE-AUNet is a U-Net whose skip, bottleneck and decoder blocks are sparse mixtures of heterogeneous experts, with lesion-matched types, counts and losses; SwinHRUNetPP, a dual-encoder vessel segmenter, uses a field-of-view-restricted loss. Second, LG-DRG separates gradability from ordinal severity and lets lesion masks query the image through gated cross-attention. Third, an end-to-end evaluation counts screening misses as errors and traces each error to its stage. Pooled Dice ranged from 0.184 (microaneurysms) to 0.579 (exudates); vessel Dice was 0.731. On 58,689 held-out images from six datasets, end-to-end quadratic weighted kappa was 0.804, with referral sensitivity 0.832 at specificity 0.947, and the screening gate caused 66% of errors. In ablations, the grade ignored the masks, even with the cross-attention gate started open. On all 4,105 official DDR test images, six-class accuracy was 85.6%, above the best published six-class result we found (83.8%). Staged screening systems should be evaluated end-to-end, with stage attribution and mask ablation, before clinical deployment.

**comment/C1：** 8 pages, 8 figures, 8 tables. Submitted to the IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics. Code, trained weights and per-image predictions: https://github.com/asifuddin01/HierarchiRetina

</details>

<a id="paper-472"></a>

### 472. [PUGS: Physics-Guided Uncertainty Modeling for Underwater Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17936v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17936

**作者：** Tingjun Li、Yuxi Wang、Guoqiang Zhong、Zhaoxiang Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17936v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17936v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文面向水下动态场景重建，提出 PUGS：把每个 3D Gaussian 的运动参数化为带期望形变与物理不确定性的概率分布，用局部重参数化采样多条轨迹进行随机形变优化，再通过不确定性随机退火与双路径自洽蒸馏，把随机探索收敛为确定性重建。实验在水下动态数据集与物理感知基准上报告了渲染质量与时序一致性提升。

**相关性简评：** 虽属 3D 重建、不在 LVR 主线上，但其「以分布刻画内部状态 + 重参数化采样轨迹 + 退火把随机探索转为确定性状态 + 双路径自洽蒸馏监督」的组合，可能为 latent 推理状态的采样式生成、训练期随机性与推理期确定化的过渡、以及 latent 轨迹的自洽监督提供可核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PUGS: Physics-Guided Uncertainty Modeling for Underwater Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting

**abstract/A1：** Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) provides an efficient framework for dynamic scene reconstruction. Most existing approaches model scene dynamics with deterministic deformation fields, assuming each Gaussian follows a distinct geometric trajectory over time. This assumption breaks down underwater, where light scattering, refraction, marine snow and low visibility create substantial physical ambiguity in captured images. We present PUGS, a physics-guided uncertainty model for underwater dynamic 3DGS. PUGS learns inherent uncertainty induced by underwater image formation and leverages it as a physical signal for dynamic scene modeling. Rather than estimating a single deterministic displacement, it parameterizes each Gaussian's motion as a probability distribution with expected deformation and physical uncertainty. We adopt stochastic deformation optimization to sample Gaussian trajectories via local reparameterization, exploring multiple physically plausible solutions during training. We further propose uncertainty stochastic annealing and a dual-path self-consistency distillation objective, converting stochastic exploration to deterministic reconstruction while preserving temporal coherence. Extensive experiments on underwater dynamic datasets and physics-aware benchmarks demonstrate superior rendering quality, temporal consistency and reconstruction robustness. Our method achieves 1.16 dB PSNR gain over the strongest baseline on UVEB and 3.99 dB on DRUVA.

</details>

### 473. [HaloBlock: Faster and Better Decoding for Diffusion Large Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17948v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17948

**作者：** Zhaohui Zheng、Chenhang He、Jinrui Zhang、Ming-Ming Cheng、Lei Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17948v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17948v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 HaloBlock：以双向累积熵刻画扩散 LLM 块式解码的难度，并据此在每个块两侧自适应分配 halo 区域，缓解边界上下文不连续，在 LLaDA、Dream 等模型上同时提升准确率与推理效率。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本扩散 LLM 解码工作，但其「按 token 难度自适应分配计算/上下文」与块边界状态连续性处理，可能为 LVR 中并行或扩散式 latent 状态生成、动态计算分配及跨块 latent 上下文传播提供可核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** HaloBlock: Faster and Better Decoding for Diffusion Large Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have attracted increasing research attention due to their bidirectional attention and arbitrary order decoding. However, there are two issues in dLLMs inference: the decoding difficulty is dominated by the tokens on the right side of the block, and the block-wise decoding inherently suffers from boundary contextual discontinuity. To tackle these limitations, we propose HaloBlock, a difficulty-aware adaptive halo mechanism for dLLM inference. We first leverage bidirectional cumulative entropy to characterize block decoding difficulty. Then, based on the bidirectional decoding difficulty, we adaptively allocate bidirectional halo regions on both sides of each block to mitigate boundary contextual discontinuity. The difficulty-aware design of HaloBlock smooths cross-block context propagation and lowers decoding difficulty for hard tokens, yielding better generation quality and faster convergence. Evaluated on LLaDA-8B-Instruct, Dream-7B-Instruct and LLaDA-1.5 across mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks, HaloBlock demonstrates consistent accuracy improvements and higher inference efficiency. Source codes are publicly available at https://github.com/PolyU-VCLab/HaloBlock.

</details>

### 474. [BELT : BEhavior-Aligned Low-Rank KV Cache Compression with Learned Top-k Rank Allocation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17966v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17966

**作者：** Yaoyang Liu、Shuwei Shen、Jincheng Tang、Jinguang Liu、Jinbao Xue、Hailong Yang、Ke Zhang、Yinjun Wu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17966v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17966v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** BELT 提出低秩 KV cache 压缩框架：以注意力分布而非原始 key 或 pre-softmax logits 为优化目标，得到有闭式解的二次代理目标，并用可学习全局 rank 分配器在训练时软选择、部署时硬选择，以满足指定的组件预算。

**相关性简评：** 与研究兴趣中「缓存、注意力结构对内部状态的影响」有间接联系：其注意力分布对齐的低秩近似与按预算分配 rank 的做法，或可供核查多模态 latent 状态压缩时是否丢失细粒度视觉证据；但论文本身限于纯文本长上下文效率，未涉及视觉或多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** BELT : BEhavior-Aligned Low-Rank KV Cache Compression with Learned Top-k Rank Allocation

**abstract/A1：** Long-context inference makes the key-value (KV) cache a major memory bottleneck for large language models. We propose BELT, a low-rank KV cache compression framework. Its key-side objective targets attention distributions rather than raw keys or pre-softmax logits, yielding a quadratic surrogate with a closed-form low-rank solution. A learned global rank allocator uses differentiable soft selection during training and hard selection at deployment to meet a user-specified component budget. Experiments demonstrate improved model quality under aggressive compression and increased decoding throughput at comparable accuracy. Evaluated across three LLMs and multiple benchmarks, BELT achieves up to 70% low-rank KV cache compression while outperforming the strongest baseline by up to 23.3 points on LongBench, and up to 17.8x overall KV cache reduction when combined with quantization. With Triton-based GPU kernels and a quantized cache, BELT delivers up to 2.7x speedup for the attention module and 3.3x end-to-end decoding throughput.

</details>

### 475. [Neural Dimensional Analysis: Foundations of Dimensionless and Scale-Consistent Computation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17969v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17969

**作者：** Bum Jun Kim、Makoto Kawano、Yusuke Iwasawa、Yutaka Matsuo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.NE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17969v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17969v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Neural Dimensional Analysis 框架，用类似物理量纲的「神经单位」刻画张量如何缩放、哪些量可相加，并据此给出诊断尺度失配的 Unit Violation Index、单位一致的多损失目标，以及采用归一化坐标与正交化残差相加的 Gauge-Canonical Transformer；在 51M–1B 语言模型上验证训练稳定性与量化鲁棒性。

**相关性简评：** 该工作本身不涉及多模态推理，但其关于残差流尺度一致性、归一化坐标与量纲式诊断的线索，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态范数漂移、latent 相似度比较是否被尺度主导，以及循环/多步状态更新如何保持尺度一致。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Neural Dimensional Analysis: Foundations of Dimensionless and Scale-Consistent Computation

**abstract/A1：** Modern Transformers rely on many scale-control mechanisms, including normalization, residual scaling, attention temperatures, loss weighting, and adaptive updates. To explain how these mechanisms maintain scale consistency, we introduce Neural Dimensional Analysis (NDA), a unified framework based on dimensional consistency. We define neural units that specify how tensors rescale and which quantities can be added, just as physical units do in physics. Our rules match residual units, nondimensionalize attention and gate inputs, combine losses across units, and convert gradient units into parameter units. We implement NDA through dimensionless Unit Violation Indices (UVI) for diagnosing scale mismatches within Transformers, a unit-consistent multi-loss objective, and the Gauge-Canonical Transformer (GCT) with normalized coordinates and orthogonalized residual additions. In language-model experiments spanning 51M to 1B parameters, GCT remains stable during training across a broad sixteenfold learning-rate range, outperforming Pre-LN, LLaMA-style, and QK-Norm in 124M validation loss at tuned learning rates. GCT's normalized residual stream also shows improved robustness to quantization. At 1B parameters, calibrated per-tensor int8 quantization increases GCT's validation loss by only 0.009 nats, compared with up to 5.51 nats for the baselines. Vision and physics-informed neural network experiments further confirm NDA's benefits beyond language modeling. These results establish dimensional consistency as a neural network design principle.

**comment/C1：** 56 pages, 9 figures

</details>

### 476. [Exact power indices for plurality-voting ensembles](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17980v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17980

**作者：** Ilie Sarpe、Theofanis Georgakopoulos、Aristides Gionis

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.DS、cs.GT

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17980v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17980v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文用合作博弈论为多数投票集成（含随机打破平局）构造新博弈，研究 Banzhaf 与 Shapley 权力指数，提出 ENPOWER 使二分类可线性时间、多分类可低次多项式时间精确计算，并用于集成裁剪与 VLM 的 prompt 集成。

**相关性简评：** 其 Shapley/Banzhaf 的精确、可扩展计算线索，可能可供核查 LVR 中多组件或推理步骤的贡献分配与诊断问题，但原论文归因对象是分类器投票而非内部推理状态，迁移性需自行验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Exact power indices for plurality-voting ensembles

**abstract/A1：** Plurality-voting ensembles aggregate the predictions of multiple base classifiers and output the most voted class, with ties typically broken at random. Despite the simple aggregation rule, attributing the impact of each base classifier to the ensemble's predictions is far from straightforward. That is, a single base classifier's impact depends on how it interacts with the votes of all other classifiers in the ensemble, for example, in resolving ties, and not only on its own predictions. We address the attribution problem using established tools from cooperative game theory, studying the Banzhaf and Shapley power indices for new games modeling plurality voting and random tie-breaking, for binary and multiclass classification settings. Computing power indices is, in general, intractable. Surprisingly, our methods, collectively named ENPOWER, enable the exact computation of Banzhaf and Shapley values in linear time for the binary classification setting and in low-degree polynomial time for the multiclass setting. The algorithms in ENPOWER rely on new combinatorial formulations of the Banzhaf and Shapley indices, yielding closed-form solutions for the binary case and ordinary generating function representations for the multiclass case. We validate empirically the methods in ENPOWER demonstrating their high applicability, providing attribution values not captured by existing methods. We apply the attribution of ENPOWER to: ensemble pruning and prompt-based ensembling of vision-language models.

**comment/C1：** Extended version of a work accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 59 pages, 9 figures, 11 tables

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17991

**作者：** Wenshuo Zhang、Xiangyue Zhang、Junlin Li、Wenjie Tian、Yubo Zheng、Hongli Xu、Jingyu Ru、Xinde Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17991v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17991v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** PolUR 提出结合偏振与 RGB 的多模态语言驱动框架，通过结构化语义指令识别水下退化的类型与严重程度，并以退化感知语义特征引导图像复原，同时构建 MixPolar 基准评测退化感知与复原。

**相关性简评：** 其将语言模型的退化语义特征作为引导信号调制复原表征，可供核查 LM 隐表示如何注入并影响视觉表征（与 latent 内容是否被真正使用、信息坍缩等问题相关），但论文本身不涉及推理期 latent 状态生成与停止决策。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PolUR: Polarization Aware Multimodal Degradation Perception for Underwater Image Restoration

**abstract/A1：** Recovering high-quality images from degraded underwater observations is crucial for underwater exploration. Polarization observations show promise as an effective source of complementary physical cues for recovering target radiance under clear-water conditions. However, existing methods have yet to jointly model raw intensity information and polarization cues to enable image restoration driven by an understanding of mixed degradations (color casts, haze, and low light). To overcome these limitations, we propose PolUR, a unified multimodal language-driven framework that jointly uses polarization and RGB information to identify degradation types and severity levels through structured semantic instructions and enhances joint restoration representations under the guidance of degradation-aware semantic features to improve restoration robustness under mixed degradations. We further construct a new benchmark named MixPolar, which contains underwater images exhibiting real-world degradations and their corresponding degradation descriptions. MixPolar supports systematic evaluation of degradation perception, image restoration, and performance on downstream tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PolUR effectively integrates polarization and RGB information, achieving competitive performance in degradation perception and image restoration, while also demonstrating generalization capability and utility for downstream tasks.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages,10 figures

</details>

### 478. [Correcting or Continuing? What On-Policy Distillation Learns from Student Errors](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18011v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18011

**作者：** Shuo Yang、Zheyu Zhang、Mahito Sugiyama、Gjergji Kasneci

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18011v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18011v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在统一数学竞赛协议下评估 Qwen-3 与 Phi-4 上的五种 on-policy distillation 机制，发现当训练只集中在学生当前做不对的难题上时，准确率不升反降（8 组配置全部下降），而训练不集中于失败集时提升约 4.6 个百分点，说明效果取决于监督是否由正确的学生前缀主导。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本训练监督工作，与 LVR 关注的轨迹训练、贡献分配和监督来源有潜在联系：其失败样本主导的 on-policy 监督会强化既有错误这一现象，可供核查 latent 推理轨迹训练中如何筛选正/负样本与分配监督信号。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Correcting or Continuing? What On-Policy Distillation Learns from Student Errors

**abstract/A1：** On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own rollouts under a frozen teacher, mitigating the distribution mismatch of off-policy supervision. While prior work has primarily trained on problems a student can largely solve, we ask whether OPD can improve a student when training is restricted to problems it currently fails. We evaluate five representative OPD mechanisms with Qwen-3 and Phi-4 models under a unified competition-mathematics protocol. We find that OPD does not improve accuracy on this hard subset, with most mechanisms instead degrading performance despite continued decreases in training KL divergence. All eight configurations show a decline, and the two-sided sign test gives p=0.0078. In contrast, the same pipeline improves accuracy by 4.6 percentage points when training is not concentrated on failures, showing that the failure is conditional on the training regime rather than systematic. These findings suggest that OPD is effective when supervision is dominated by correct student prefixes, but can reinforce existing errors when training is concentrated on problems the student currently fails.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages

</details>

### 479. [Dynamic Interpolation for Training-Time Prediction Reshaping in Low-Light Image Enhancement](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18018v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18018

**作者：** Peirui Zhu、Shijie Hao、Jingxi Liao、Richang Hong、Meng Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18018v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18018v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文从训练动力学角度重新审视有监督低光图像增强，指出亮度相关误差收敛过早、残差噪声与结构伪影后期优化不足，提出无需额外参数、仅训练期生效的动态插值模块 DITM：将模型预测与按真值平均亮度重标定得到的图像插值，削弱全局亮度差异的主导地位，使局部残差误差在后期反传中更受重视，推理时完全移除。

**相关性简评：** 其「训练期重塑预测以改变不同误差项在反传中主导性」的做法，可能为 latent 轨迹训练中答案损失与视觉监督的贡献分配、分阶段监督权重设计提供可核查线索，虽属像素级增强任务，但机制本身与推理状态无直接关系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Dynamic Interpolation for Training-Time Prediction Reshaping in Low-Light Image Enhancement

**abstract/A1：** Low-light image enhancement (LLIE) is an important image/video processing problem for reliable visual systems under poor illumination, yet it remains challenging due to the strong coupling among insufficient illumination, noise amplification, and structural degradation. Existing methods typically rely on sophisticated network architectures or engineered objective functions. While effective, the former increases model complexity and deployment burden, whereas the latter relies on empirically tuned loss weights. We revisit supervised LLIE from a training-dynamics perspective and observe that brightness-related errors tend to converge early, while residual noise and structural artifacts often remain insufficiently optimized in later stages. To address this issue, we propose a Dynamic Interpolation Training-only Module (DITM), which introduces no additional learnable parameters and adaptively reshapes the model prediction for supervised feed-forward LLIE training. Specifically, DITM employs brightness-aware interpolation, in which the model prediction is combined with a mean brightness-aligned image constructed by rescaling the model prediction according to the mean brightness of the ground-truth image. By reducing the relative dominance of global brightness discrepancy, DITM makes residual local errors more influential during backpropagation after global luminance has largely stabilized, thereby facilitating artifact suppression and fine-detail restoration in later training stages. DITM is used only during training and is fully removed at inference, introducing no additional inference cost. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets and CNN-, Transformer-, and Mamba-based LLIE backbones show that DITM consistently improves fidelity and perceptual quality while preserving the inference-time architecture and introducing no additional inference-time computation.

**comment/C1：** 18 pages, 9 figures. Published in IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Video Technology (Early Access)

</details>

### 480. [FRACTION: Fraud Explanation Generation via Agentic Graph Context Navigation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18023v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18023

**作者：** Cecelia Soh、Jun Hu、Yuan Li、Cheng Chen、Hui Liu、Yanjia Zhu、Hao He、Bryan Hooi、Bingsheng He

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18023v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18023v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对图欺诈解释生成，提出 FRACTION：为语言模型配备可逐步披露邻居记录的图工具，用评测细则引导的轨迹蒸馏训练 agent，并提出涵盖忠实性、图依据等五维的解释质量评分准则。

**相关性简评：** 其「按需逐步披露证据」的工具调用与 rubric 引导的轨迹蒸馏，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选、LOOK/STOP 决策及轨迹监督提供借鉴；但对象是图结构而非视觉状态，需核查其状态更新与停止机制是否可迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FRACTION: Fraud Explanation Generation via Agentic Graph Context Navigation

**abstract/A1：** Graph fraud explanation generation emerges as an important task, which requires jointly leveraging graph structure and content information to produce human-readable explanations for a given risk label. An intuitive approach is to adapt existing graph-enhanced large language models (LLMs), which inject graph structure into LLMs via graph-conditioned instruction tuning or structure-aware embeddings. However, existing methods face two key challenges in graph fraud explanation generation: a lack of evaluation protocols tailored to explanation quality, and a mismatch between the granularity of graph information they provide and what explanation generation requires. In this paper, we propose FRaud Explanation Generation via Agentic Graph Context NavigaTION (FRACTION), a framework for graph fraud explanation generation. To evaluate explanation quality, we introduce a task-specific rubric that assesses faithfulness, graph grounding, helpfulness, consistency, and conciseness, and validate it against human judgments. To focus on fine-grained details of relevant neighbors without reading the entire neighborhood, we equip a language model with graph tools that progressively disclose neighbor records. To train our graph agent, we propose a rubric-guided trajectory distillation strategy through which the agent learns both tool-use behavior and structured explanation generation. Experimental results on three fraud datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art baselines under a human-aligned rubric.

</details>

### 481. [ChampionKV: Head-Wise Adaptive Budget Allocation for KV Cache Compression](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18026v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18026

**作者：** Yuechuan Chen、Yanda Guo、Xiaoxi Liu、Weilin Ruan、Huanbo Xu、Ruyi Wang、Wei Zhu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18026v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18026v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ChampionKV：面向长上下文 KV cache 压缩的输入自适应 head 级预算分配器，用 observation-window 注意力聚合峰值作为注意力集中度的经验代理，偏向分散的 head 多分预算，并加入异常 head 掩码与预算下限；可挂载 SnapKV、PyramidKV，在 LongBench 与 RULER 上评测。

**相关性简评：** 其「按 attention 集中度做 head 级预算分配 + 下限/掩码鲁棒机制」可能为 LVR 中按 head 或层动态分配 latent 计算、筛选保留视觉证据提供方法线索，但能否迁移到多模态推理状态尚需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ChampionKV: Head-Wise Adaptive Budget Allocation for KV Cache Compression

**abstract/A1：** Some observation-window-based KV cache compressors use prompt attention to identify important tokens but allocate uniform or predefined budgets across heads, overlooking input-dependent differences in budget demand. We propose ChampionKV, an input-adaptive head-wise budget allocator for long-context KV cache compression. It uses the maximum aggregated observation-window attention score as a lightweight empirical proxy for attention concentration, assigning larger budgets to heads with dispersed attention and smaller budgets to concentrated heads. An abnormal-head mask and a floor-budget mechanism improve robustness under weak attention responses. ChampionKV plugs into compressors such as SnapKV and PyramidKV without changing their token-selection procedures. On LongBench and RULER, both Champion variants consistently improve over their SnapKV and PyramidKV base compressors; the improvements are largest and statistically significant on Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, especially under tight budgets, whereas results on the tested 7B/8B models remain competitive but mixed. ChampionKV does not uniformly outperform Ada-KV, whose global cross-head Top-K selection retains an advantage in several settings. Controlled analysis further shows improved retained attention mass over the corresponding base compressors at negligible overhead.

</details>

### 482. [FlowSim: Rendering-Free Closed-Loop Simulation for Evaluating End-to-End Driving Systems](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18030v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18030

**作者：** Hanfeng Wu、Alvaro Marcos-Ramiro、Michael Schmidt、Christoph Stiller

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18030v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18030v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 FlowSim，一种免渲染的闭环仿真方案：由前一帧隐表示与目标帧符号场景条件直接预测下一帧内部 latent，再交由冻结的下游模块处理，从而省去图像渲染与感知重编码；在 nuScenes 与 NavSim 上验证其行为一致性与运行速度。

**相关性简评：** 其「直接预测 latent 状态驱动冻结下游模块」的做法，可能为 LVR 中隐状态跨步更新与 rollout 保真度的评估、以及绕过视觉重建后下游是否仍能使用隐内容提供方法线索，可供核查其跨帧关联与可变视界预测是否保留任务必要信息。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FlowSim: Rendering-Free Closed-Loop Simulation for Evaluating End-to-End Driving Systems

**abstract/A1：** Closed-loop evaluation of end-to-end (E2E) driving systems typically relies on generating sensor observations and re-processing them through the perception encoder, introducing substantial computational cost and a sim2real gap between simulated and real sensor observations. In this paper, we ask a more fundamental question: is image-space simulation necessary for closed-loop evaluation of E2E driving systems? We propose FlowSim, a rendering-free simulation paradigm that predicts the internal latent representation directly from a previous latent and target-frame symbolic scene conditions. The predicted latent is then processed by the original frozen downstream modules, eliminating image rendering and perception re-encoding. Explicit cross-frame agent association improves latent transition prediction and rollout stability, while variable-horizon simulation enables long-horizon prediction from a common real anchor without accumulating intermediate rollout errors. Experiments on nuScenes and NavSim demonstrate that FlowSim preserves downstream behavior competitively with, and often exceeds image-space simulation in source-to-reference agreement across variable simulation horizons and both dense and sparse latent representations. By predicting the latent directly, both instantiations of FlowSim simulate each step in 0.04--0.06s, substantially faster than the image-space simulation methods they are compared against. These results establish FlowSim as an efficient and practical alternative to conventional image-space simulation methods.

</details>

### 483. [COMPASS: Contextual Moment Prior Alignment for Generalizable AIGI Detection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18034v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18034

**作者：** Zhan Yang、Tiancheng Shen、Weijie Lyu、Shuo Chen、Bernard Ghanem、Yibo Yang、Ming-Hsuan Yang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18034v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18034v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 COMPASS，一种数据感知的子空间适配框架：用小型无标注语义代理集估计目标激活统计，将激活协方差纳入预训练权重分解，冻结目标相关的语义子空间作为稳定参考，再由残差适配器学习伪造相关变化，以提升 AIGI 与 deepfake 检测的跨域泛化。

**相关性简评：** 其依据激活协方差区分「需保留的语义子空间」与「可适配残差」的分解思路，可能为 LVR 中适配模型时保留视觉证据、抑制内部表示信息坍缩提供可核查的方法线索；但任务本身是图像取证检测，与 VLM 推理状态无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** COMPASS: Contextual Moment Prior Alignment for Generalizable AIGI Detection

**abstract/A1：** Generalizable AI-generated image (AIGI) and deepfake detection remain challenging due to the asymmetry phenomenon, where adaptation to limited training distributions can degrade the transferable representations of Vision Foundation Models (VFMs). Recent subspace adaptation methods mitigate this issue by freezing high-magnitude principal components while adapting the residual subspace. However, such magnitude-based decomposition is data-agnostic and does not explicitly account for target-relevant semantics, potentially leading to semantic misalignment. We propose COMPASS (COntextual Moment Prior Alignment for Subspace Separation), a data-aware subspace adaptation framework that uses a small unlabeled Semantic Proxy Set to estimate target activation statistics. COMPASS incorporates activation covariance into the decomposition of pre-trained weights, preserving target-relevant representations as a stable semantic reference while the residual adapter learns forgery-related variations. The proxy calibration requires no gradient-based optimization. Extensive experiments demonstrate strong generalization across cross-dataset, cross-method, joint cross-dataset-method, and open-world cross-generator evaluations, achieving state-of-the-art performance on both Deepfake and AIGI detection benchmarks.

</details>

### 484. [Scaling Vision Transformers Without Training: Prune-and-Merge Token Compression](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18039v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18039

**作者：** Vatsal、Soumil Malhotra、Priyanshu Chahal、Sanjeev Kumar

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出免训练的 Prune-and-Merge ViT 框架，用类别注意力剪枝结合相似度合并压缩视觉 token，并引入 RAD 与 PFR 两个指标衡量模型在图像变换下的精度退化与预测一致性。

**相关性简评：** 其注意力引导剪枝与相似度合并直接涉及「保留哪些视觉证据」，可能与 LVR 的视觉证据筛选及内部状态是否留存必要细节相关；RAD/PFR 或可供核查用于评估 latent 状态在输入扰动下的稳定性，但原文并未涉及多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Scaling Vision Transformers Without Training: Prune-and-Merge Token Compression

**abstract/A1：** Vision Transformers achieve strong performance but incur high computational costs from quadratic token interactions. Training-free token reduction methods improve efficiency, but their robustness remains underexplored. We propose Prune-and Merge ViT, a training-free framework for off-the-shelf models. It combines class attention-based pruning with similarity-based merging to reduce redundancy while preserving semantic information. To evaluate robustness we introduce two metrics. Relative Accuracy Drop (RAD) measures relative accuracy degradation under transformations, and Prediction Flip Rate (PFR) quantifies prediction consistency. On pretrained ViT and DeiT, Prune-and-Merge reduces computation competitively while maintaining robustness and better accuracy than existing token reduction methods. Our analysis suggests that hybrid token reduction does not introduce hallucination-like behavior and preserves prediction stability for common image transformations.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at the GlobalSouthAI Workshop at NeurIPS 2026; 12 pages

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把成员推断测试（MINT）用于 LoRA 微调后的 LLM，用中间层激活与参数相关信号训练分类器来判断样本是否参与过训练，在 Qwen、Phi-4、DeepSeek-V3、LLaMA 3.2-3B 及医疗、数学、学术推理三类数据上报告 95%–98% 的识别率。

**相关性简评：** 其「以内部表示做样本级判定」的探针与分类器思路，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态究竟保留了哪些信息，以及轨迹训练下的贡献分配/归因做法；但论文本身不涉及视觉或多模态推理，线索偏向方法借鉴。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** inLoRA-MINT: Internal Representations for Auditing Training Data in Domain-adapted LLMs

**abstract/A1：** This work investigates the application of the Membership Inference Test (MINT) to large language models (LLMs) fine-tuned with LoRA, aiming to determine whether specific samples were used during training and address concerns about data privacy, leakage, and transparency. Building on our previous LoRA-MINT framework, which relies exclusively on perplexity under a strict black-box setting, we propose an approach based on intermediate model representations, including activations and parameter-dependent signals. These representations enable a MINT classifier to distinguish training from non-training samples without requiring full access to model parameters. We evaluated the method on four LLMs (Qwen, Phi-4, DeepSeek-V3, and LLaMA 3.2-3B) fine-tuned on three datasets covering medical, mathematical, and academic reasoning tasks. Results show consistent performance across architectures and domains, achieving scores between 95% and 98%, with robustness to variations in model configurations and data distributions. The proposed approach enables efficient auditing of sensitive training data and supports data provenance and compliance with emerging privacy and AI governance regulations. Although our experiments focus on LoRA-based fine-tuning, the methodology can be extended to other LLM adaptation techniques and, more broadly, to other AI models.

</details>

### 486. [From Policy Evaluation to Off-Policy Control: Provable Emergence of In-Context Q-Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18057v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18057

**作者：** Yingjun Mo、Yajie Zhao、Fang Kong

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18057v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18057v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文证明两层纯注意力 Transformer 能在上下文中实现有限温度形式的 Q-learning（τ→0 时退化为 window Q-learning），仅用输出级监督在随机 MDP 任务上训练，验证理论预测的参数结构与内部贪心动作选择机制会随训练涌现，并分析收敛到解流形的梯度步数随 τ 增大的代价。

**相关性简评：** 该文不涉及视觉或多模态，但其「Transformer 在上下文中实现迭代式自举状态更新」与「输出监督下内部算法回路可被证明地涌现并收敛到解流形」的结论，或可为 LVR 的循环/迭代隐状态生成、轨迹训练与监督分配提供方法线索，需核查其可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** From Policy Evaluation to Off-Policy Control: Provable Emergence of In-Context Q-Learning

**abstract/A1：** Transformers can implement reinforcement-learning algorithms in context, yet how off-policy control emerges within Transformers remains poorly understood. We study Q-learning, a foundational model-free control algorithm that combines off-policy bootstrapping with greedy policy improvement. We prove that a two-layer attention-only Transformer can implement a finite-temperature form of Q-learning, where the temperature $τ&gt;0$ controls the approximation to greedy action selection, recovering window Q-learning as $τ\\to0$. We train the structured Transformer on randomly generated MDP tasks using output-only supervision. Experiments show that the theoretically predicted parameter structure emerges during training, including the internal greedy action-selection mechanism, and that the trained Transformer achieves performance comparable to Q-learning on unseen tasks. Our theoretical analysis further shows that the equivalent realizations form a solution manifold and that, under suitable task-diversity conditions, the training iterates converge locally to this manifold at an exponential rate. For the random-task model analyzed here, the local worst-case number of gradient steps needed to reduce the distance to the manifold by a factor $ε$ is $Θ\\left(τ^{-5}\\log(1/\\varepsilon)\\right)$, quantifying the increasing optimization cost as the learned update approaches window Q-learning.

</details>

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 WorkRover 框架，让构建智能体递归演化语义对齐的工作上下文、可执行任务与验证器，并结合 FCR 回放修复与 VTCA 回合级信用分配来后训练长时程协作智能体。

**相关性简评：** VTCA 依据工具输出与产物依赖，把轨迹级优势按工作区进度拆解并回传给前置回合，可供核查其思路能否迁移到 LVR 的 latent 轨迹贡献分配与监督。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** WorkRover: Scaling Long-Horizon Cowork Agent Training Via Recursive Environment Evolution

**abstract/A1：** Scaling interactive environments is important for training long-horizon agents through reinforcement learning. These environments often require further testing and refinement after initial generation, and correcting defects in a task may also require updating its work context and verifier. However, existing construction pipelines offer limited support for such iterative refinement while keeping these components aligned. We introduce WorkRover, a framework for training long-horizon cowork agents through recursive environment evolution. Its harness-driven synthesis enables construction agents to jointly build and validate semantically aligned work contexts, executable tasks, and evidence-grounded verifiers, adapting their actions to workspace state and execution feedback rather than following a fixed construction workflow. To support environment evolution, we introduce Factorial Compatibility Replay (FCR), which uses rollout feedback to evaluate combinations of component revisions through dependency-closed replay and selects the smallest validated repair among tested candidates while preserving task requirements and evaluation constraints. To provide finer-grained training signals, we propose Verifier-to-Turn Credit Assignment (VTCA), which augments trajectory-level GRPO advantages with signals from deterministic workspace-progress checks and assigns a bounded share of positive-progress credit to prerequisite turns using recorded tool-output and artifact dependencies. Using WorkRover, we post-train Qwen3.5-35B-A3B to obtain WorkRover-35B-A3B and evaluate it on several cowork-agent benchmarks. Its reported scores exceed those of Qwen3.5-35B-A3B by 26.27 percentage points on JobBench, 29.32 percentage points on OfficeQA Pro, and 413.25 Elo points on GDPval v2. These results suggest that WorkRover offers a promising foundation for scalable training of long-horizon cowork agents.

**内容简述：** 论文研究截断数据（hard selection）下的因果发现，给出 Additive Noise Model 的一般性结果：确定性截断同时保持联合分布的 score 及其 Jacobian，并据此提出无需选择过程外部信息、对截断数据鲁棒的 score-matching 因果发现方法。

**相关性简评：** 该工作与 VLM 推理主线无直接关联，但「确定性截断不改变 score 与 score Jacobian」这一性质可能可供核查于扩散/score 驱动的 latent 状态生成，以及在视觉证据被筛选或部分缺失时维持内部表示稳定的问题，属方法借鉴线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Causal Discovery Under Hard Selection Bias: A New Robust Score-Matching Approach

**abstract/A1：** Selection bias is a difficult yet widespread problem in causal discovery, occurring whenever non-random selection processes lead to data that is not representative of the underlying populations. Due to its practical importance, related works have been proposed to address the problem under local \[Versteeg et al., 2022\] or interventional settings \[Dai et al., 2025a\], but general algorithms for observational data remain elusive. In this paper, we focus on truncated data (hard selection), and provide a general result for Additive Noise Models (ANM). We show that score-based methods are a surprisingly suitable candidate due to a special property of the score function ($\\nabla \\log p(x)$): deterministic truncation preserves both the score of the joint distribution as well as the Jacobian of the score. While established score-matching algorithms still fail in most settings, we actively leverage this observation to propose a new method for causal discovery that is robust under truncated data with ANMs. Overall, our approach offers a general, robust solution that is agnostic to external information about the selection process and still achieves comparable performance to the state-of-the-art approaches when selection is not present.

**comment/C1：** 30 pages, NeurIPS 2026

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 BELIEFWEAVER，在长程 terminal 智能体中维护跨尝试与回滚的关系型 belief state，用执行与诊断证据更新 frontier 优先级，并以隐式 world model 评估修复假设、预测进展，再将其推理组件蒸馏到 9B 学生模型，在三个基准上提升最终分数并降低教师调用成本。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本 agent 的 belief 更新、证据门控与前瞻假设评估，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态维护、证据筛选及停止／修复决策的借鉴线索，但原文不涉及视觉或多模态推理，迁移属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Failure Recovery via Belief Updates and World Modeling for Long-Horizon Agents

**abstract/A1：** Long-horizon agents often struggle to recover from failures whose causes lie several steps earlier, beyond what local reflection or backtracking can resolve. We introduce BELIEFWEAVER, a framework that combines persistent evidence across attempts with prospective reasoning over repair directions. It maintains a relational belief state over frontiers, attempts, observations, and checkpoints. Execution evidence updates related frontier priorities across attempts and rollback, while diagnostic evidence gates execution. An implicit world model (IWM) evaluates repair hypotheses, predicts progress, and identifies relations among frontiers to guide exploration. We further distill these recurring IWM reasoning components into a 9B student through supervised fine-tuning and on-policy distillation (OPD). Across three terminal-based benchmarks, BELIEFWEAVER improves aggregate final score by 5.1 percentage points over native Terminus-2 continuation, with positive trends in exploration efficiency. The distilled 9B student improves final score by 9.8 percentage points over the reported native baseline while reducing estimated teacher API cost by 54.8% relative to the matched teacher. These results show that persistent evidence and prospective reasoning can improve recovery in long-horizon agent tasks while substantially reducing reliance on teacher-model inference.

</details>

### 490. [One-Sided Verification Under Limited Expert Review](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18089v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18089

**作者：** Fan Nie、Haotian Ye、Shurui Liu、Zihao Wang、Stefano Ermon、James Zou

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 OSVerify 框架，把「错误提议」与「错误验证」解耦：用分层分解在多个粒度上搜索候选解中的错误，再由验证器区分实质错误与轻微或幻觉性错误，在有限人工评审预算下最大化无效候选的拒绝率并最小化人工成本。

**相关性简评：** 其「提议-验证」解耦、单边验证目标（TNR 最大化、FNR 约束）与验证器后训练，可能为 latent reasoning 轨迹的错误检测、证据筛选与停止决策及验证器监督提供可核查的方法线索；但该工作面向科学发现的文本候选，向多模态推理的迁移可行性尚待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** One-Sided Verification Under Limited Expert Review

**abstract/A1：** AI has become increasingly helpful in scientific discovery, yet human expert review remains essential for those problems without reliable automated evaluation, posing a fundamental challenge as candidate generation scales beyond available review capacity. This paper studies verification under limited human effort, where rare valid solutions need to be prioritized while invalid candidates should be filtered out to reduce human workload. We adopt the one-sided verification objective that maximizes the rejection rate of invalid solutions (TNR) under a constraint on the false-rejection rate of valid ones (FNR), making human review cost an explicit term to minimize. Drawing on the intuition that verifying a specific error can be easier than discovering one, we introduce OSVerify, an algorithmic framework that decouples error proposal from error validation. The error proposer searches for errors in solutions across different granularities by hierarchical decomposition, while the validator distinguishes substantial errors from minor or hallucinated ones. Experiments on competition- and research-level benchmarks show that OSVerify reduces the number of human reviews of invalid solutions by 46% on average compared to voting baselines under the same empirical low FNR constraint. Our post-training of the validator further improves the reduction to 57%. As high-impact real-world use cases, we apply OSVerify to identify errors in published research papers that are subsequently confirmed by the original authors and help resolve three Langlands open conjectures that are confirmed by experts, demonstrating its utility to facilitate human-AI research collaboration.

</details>

**相关性简评：** 其区间覆盖、可行候选保留与独立测试保留三者分离的结论，以及验证预算（需 25 次校验、32 次上限下直接验证弃权）与局部代理在有限干预下失效的分析，可能为 LVR 中 latent 内容或支持组合的验证、停止决策与贡献分配提供可核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** From Spectral Saliency to Finite Deletion: Evaluating Selective Language Model Edits

**abstract/A1：** Deleting singular components offers a precise way to remove a capability from a language model, yet the first-order spectral saliency used to rank components predicts only a local loss change, whereas deletion is a finite intervention. In this paper, we study how prediction error affects selective editing, where selective editing requires degradation of a target task while preserving others. We decompose the error into derivative transfer across item splits and nonlinear response along the deletion path. We establish that outer interval screening retains every feasible candidate when every candidate's intervals contain its finite validation loss changes on every task. We evaluate these effects using one answer-only negative log-likelihood objective for search, validation, and test, with disjoint calibration and evaluation masks. The primary configuration targets arithmetic in Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 while preserving code and question answering; extensions cover Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and reversed target roles. In the primary study, which deletes 1024 coordinates from a support of 7168, calibrated intervals cover 968 of 1024 evaluation masks. Outer screening reaches the direct-selected edit after 25 verification checks, whereas direct verification abstains at a 32-check cap, but it rejects 4 of 74 feasible masks. All three selected edits pass validation, yet only one meets every test constraint. Interval coverage, feasible-candidate retention, and independent test preservation are therefore distinct properties and require separate assessment.

**comment/C1：** 25 pages, 9 figures

</details>

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文分析混合架构中注意力层与其他层的类型与顺序选择，证明在固定资源约束下最优层配置高度依赖任务，并在检索、关联回忆等任务上展示不同层顺序之间高达满分与低于 0.5 的性能分离，同时考察各层贡献。

**相关性简评：** 注意力层的位置与顺序直接决定关联回忆和检索类信息的保持能力，可为 LVR 中 latent 状态容量、视觉细节保留以及深度与位置对状态的影响提供可核查的架构线索；但原文不涉及视觉或多模态推理，需自行迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The Effect of Layer Ordering in Hybrid Architectures

**abstract/A1：** Hybrid attention is rapidly becoming the dominant architectural choice for frontier models. Despite their successes, such architectures complicate model design by introducing additional choices, including the types and locations of layers. This combinatorially large design space has been studied empirically, but given the vast expense of training and evaluating models with different configurations, a principled understanding of the effects of layer selection and ordering is needed. We provide the first such analysis, showing that the dominant hybrid architecture is highly task-specific. Concretely, for any layer configuration, we prove that there exists a task where we can construct a model with this configuration that provably outperforms any other model of any different configuration under fixed resource constraints. Empirically, we observe that for standard training, learned hybrid architectures exhibit separations between layer orderings that match our theoretical findings. For instance, under the same memory budget, the optimal architecture predicted by our theory for a segmented retrieval task consistently achieves perfect accuracy, whereas the next strongest plateaus below 0.5. These results extend to deeper models, where \`\`containing'' the dominant architecture for a task indicates whether the model attains high performance. In addition, we investigate the mechanisms learned by hybrids, observing that Transformer layers contribute the largest share of performance on associative recall across architectures. This work establishes insights into task-dependent hybrid architecture design relevant to the training and scaling of frontier-scale hybrids.

</details>
