**title/T1：** SYNPRED: A Synergistic Approach to Multimodal Learning for Clinical Prediction

**abstract/A1：** Multimodal medical data captures complementary aspects of disease. It provides a comprehensive basis for diagnosis and the identification of biological associations linked to progression or treatment response. Established contrastive learning approaches exploit shared information across modalities, but fall short in exploiting complementary, modality-specific signals relevant for a task. Here, we propose a synergistic multimodal variational autoencoder (VAE) framework that separates task-relevant unimodal and multimodal information from instance-specific variation task-irrelevant, allowing complementary signals across modalities to be leveraged for prediction. The method yields benefits even if modalities are missing at test time. We evaluate the method on a treatment response prediction task using medical imaging and RNA data. Empirical comparison with alignment-based and multimodal VAE state-of-the-art approaches demonstrates improved multimodal prediction performance, and consistent benefits for prediction from a single modality after multimodal training. The full code can be found here: https://github.com/cirmuw/SYNPRED.

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18126

**作者：** Ayoub Merimi、Souhail Bakkali、Abdeljalil Sakat

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.GT、cs.IR、cs.MA

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18126v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18126v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出决策有效性的时间戳理论与持久化 decision ledger：为每个 LLM 决策记录时间、证据与背景知识，并用决策时刻写入的 watch 条件索引后续新信息，把准确性分解为信息路由与时间判断两种能力，在 8B 到前沿的五个模型上验证四条预测。

**相关性简评：** 其「决策时刻 vs 执行时刻」的新鲜度上限，以及按 watch 条件把新证据路由到受影响决策的持久状态索引机制，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态何时失效、何时重新 LOOK 或修订提供可核查的状态失效判定与证据路由线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Fresh at Decision, Stale at Action: Routing New Information to LLM Decisions Already Made

**abstract/A1：** Freshness shapes an LLM decision at the moment it is made; the action it commits to is latent, carried out later, in a changing world. We therefore introduce a timestamp theory of decision validity and a decision ledger that realises it. Six timestamps define a decision; a freshness ceiling bounds what up-to-date evidence guarantees at action time, placing the remaining risk in information published afterwards. Accuracy then factorises into two capabilities: routing, which delivers that information to affected decisions before their revision deadlines, and temporal judgment, which reads it for the time of action. The ledger is persistent state holding each decision's times, evidence and background knowledge, indexed by watch conditions written at decision time. Controlled decision streams with exact labels confirm four predictions across five LLMs, from 8B to frontier scale: freshness alone yields exactly the accuracy the ceiling predicts; models act on decisive news once it arrives, so accuracy follows routing; the ledger's index sets what routing reaches, and watch conditions reach indirect dependencies at low exposure; and the remaining errors concern when a change takes effect. Freshness makes a decision right when it is made; routing and temporal judgment keep it right when it is carried out.

**comment/C1：** A timestamp theory of LLM decision validity with a decision ledger

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** FlowCred 面向文本到视频的联合后训练，提出双层框架：用匹配的 prompt-seed rollout 网格做层级信用分配，将 prompt 层面的贡献与生成器残差分离，并通过在真实生成轨迹状态上探测替代 prompt 来实现 prompt 与生成器的功能协调。

**相关性简评：** 虽属视频生成领域，但其「共享随机性下的配对 rollout 分离条件贡献与生成贡献」的层级信用分配思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 轨迹训练时的贡献分配与监督信号解耦问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FlowCred: Hierarchical Credit Assignment and Functional Coordination for Joint Text-to-Video Post-Training

**abstract/A1：** Prompt optimization and generator post-training are two complementary ways to improve text-to-video (T2V) generation, and recent systems increasingly train both modules jointly. However, optimizing a prompt policy and a video generator from the same terminal reward creates two ambiguities: prompt quality is confounded with stochastic generation, and the two modules may realize overlapping local improvements. We introduce FlowCred, a two-level framework for joint T2V post-training. First, hierarchical credit assignment uses matched prompt-seed rollout grids to separate prompt-level credit from prompt-conditioned generator residuals under shared randomness. Second, functional coordination probes alternative current-policy prompts at states from actual generation trajectories, providing generator-aware evidence for prompt optimization while selectively attenuating generator updates already supported by conditioning changes. Across multiple T2V benchmarks, FlowCred consistently improves matched joint-training baselines. On LTX-2.5, FlowCred improves a strictly matched joint-training control from 61.47 to 64.46 on T2V-CompBench and from 55.58 to 58.08 on StoryEval, without increasing decoded-video or reward-model-call budgets. Factorial and realized-update analyses show complementary contributions from prompt shaping and generator routing, while human evaluation and transfer across backbones and updater families provide further supporting evidence.

</details>

### 496. [Back to the Future: Reverse-Consequence Modeling for Long-Horizon Particle Dynamics](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18168v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18168

**作者：** Leyan Zhang、Nantian He、Jiajun Ma、Yanpeng Zhao、Yunbo Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18168v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18168v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ReStep：先用随机模型直接预测运动的终点状态，再用 Anchored Diffusion 以两端边界状态为条件生成中间轨迹，并将其作为 3D Gaussian Splatting 的物理引擎，以缓解长时程粒子动力学自回归展开中的误差累积。

**相关性简评：** 「先预测终点、再由边界条件生成中间轨迹」的机制，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理轨迹的生成方式与 AR 误差累积抑制提供借鉴，其目标条件化的中间状态生成与双端约束线索可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Back to the Future: Reverse-Consequence Modeling for Long-Horizon Particle Dynamics

**abstract/A1：** Accurate prediction of object trajectories is fundamental to mechanical understanding and robotic control. However, autoregressive models inherently suffer from cumulative errors, leading to severe drift in long-horizon rollouts. Observing that in many physical systems with dissipative or convergence-to-rest behavior, the final states are often more predictable than transient dynamics (e.g., a sliding object resting under friction or a pendulum stabilizing at equilibrium), we propose ReStep, a cascaded approach that reverses the conventional forward-prediction paradigm. ReStep first employs a stochastic model to directly predict the final state, then leverages Anchored Diffusion to generate goal-conditioned intermediate trajectories. By conditioning on both ''boundary states'', it effectively constrains dynamics and reduces uncertainty, producing physically plausible and temporally coherent transitions. We further integrate ReStep dynamics as the physical engine within a 3D Gaussian Splatting pipeline, enabling a unified physical-visual framework for intuitive inference from images. Extensive experiments on diverse rigid and non-rigid collision datasets show that ReStep achieves superior long-term accuracy, substantially mitigating error accumulation via reverse-consequence modeling.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出 Neuro-Symbolic Graph Transformer：用可学习拓扑偏置把 Human Reasoning Graph 注入自注意力，并以可微一阶逻辑损失作结构正则，从多模态人体活动序列中做四层级（原子动作、复合活动、低/高层意图）意图识别，并附带合成数据与一致性指标评估。

**相关性简评：** 其「可微逻辑损失作分层结构正则」与「注意力拓扑偏置」可能为 latent 推理状态的多层级监督、结构化状态表示及注意力权重作为可解释证据提供方法线索；但任务为人体活动/意图识别，与 VLM 视觉推理主线距离较远，迁移可行性可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Neuro-Symbolic Graph Transformers for Hierarchical Intention Recognition from Multimodal Human Activity Sequences

**abstract/A1：** Proactive human-robot collaboration requires autonomous systems to infer not only immediate actions but also the underlying hierarchical intentions governing human behavior. Current deep learning approaches predominantly focus on flat action classification, failing to capture the structural dependencies connecting kinematic motion to high-level goals. A Neuro-Symbolic Graph Transformer (NSGT) is proposed within this multimodal framework, a Human Reasoning Graph (HR-G) is integrated into the self-attention mechanism via learnable topological biases. Furthermore, the architecture is augmented with a differentiable First-Order Logic (FOL) loss, acting as a structural regularizer by which ontological consistency is enforced across four levels: atomic actions, composite activities, Low-Level Intentions, and High-Level Intentions. Evaluation is performed on the synthesized NTU-Hierarchy dataset, a four-level ontological extension of NTU RGB+D 120, wherein existing sequences were mapped into 119,383 complex hierarchical episodes (85 actions, 16 activities, 8 LLIs, 4 HLIs). To prevent circular supervision, strict isolation between label generation and FOL constraints was maintained. In the base configuration, 91.65% top-1 action accuracy is achieved by the NSGT. When the FOL loss is incorporated into the baseline, logic consistency is improved by 3.26 percentage points to 96.67%. Through the HR-G biases, a tunable trade-off between accuracy and structural coherence is established. In the primary consistency-maximizing configuration ($λ$ = 0.5), a logic consistency of 94.59% is reached and ontological contradictions are reduced by 33%, while a robust 89.90% top-1 action accuracy is retained. Finally, interpretable reasoning evidence is provided by the learned HR-G weights, wherein transition edges are strongly exploited ($β$ trans $\\approx$ +2.6) without explicit supervision.

</details>

### 498. [Reinforcement Learning for Large-Scale Lifelong Multi-Agent Path Finding with Shared Spatial Fields](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18186v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出一种大规模终身多智能体路径规划导航策略：卷积网络每时间步在地图上计算一次共享空间场，再由紧凑的目标条件算子导出各智能体的移动偏好，并以吞吐量为奖励的平均奖励强化学习端到端训练，无需规划器示范。

**相关性简评：** 「一步共享空间场＋轻量条件算子读出」的结构及无示范训练方式，可能为 LVR 中共享 latent 状态复用、低成本读出与监督分配提供方法线索，其向更大未见布局与智能体规模的零重训迁移可供核查；但任务域是多智能体路径规划，与 VLM 推理无直接关联。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Reinforcement Learning for Large-Scale Lifelong Multi-Agent Path Finding with Shared Spatial Fields

**abstract/A1：** Large-scale applications of lifelong multi-agent path finding (LMAPF) call for computationally inexpensive movement decisions under changing traffic conditions and across varied layouts. We propose a navigation policy in which a convolutional network computes a shared spatial field over the map once per timestep and a compact goal-conditioned operator derives agents' movement preferences. The complete policy is trained end-to-end using average-reward reinforcement learning with throughput as the reward, without planner demonstrations or a separate online path planner. For structured and unstructured layouts, we train one policy per class on mixtures of small maps and deploy each without retraining on larger, unseen layouts and agent populations. Across six layouts with 10000 agents, our policies achieve throughput comparable to or higher than the strongest evaluated baselines. The proposed method has an average execution time below 10 ms per step, more than an order of magnitude faster than several established planners.

</details>

### 499. [VARI: Robust Text-to-Video Generation via Group-Structured Intent Alignment](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18189v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18189

**作者：** Mingxuan Zhu、Hohei Chan、Shiyuan Liu、Yuanxing Zhang、Lu Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18189v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18189v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 VARI 框架，把自动验证的同一视觉意图的多种提示表述视为一个共享监督单元，通过跨形式交叉打分与意图审计，用组一致蒸馏与形式对比 Flow-DPO 提升 text-to-video 生成对改写表述的鲁棒性。

**相关性简评：** 其「等价形式共享监督单元＋跨形式交叉打分」的组级监督与偏好构造，可能为 LVR 中跨改写输入的监督归因、轨迹训练与贡献分配提供线索，但原文面向视频生成，与推理期状态的关系需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** VARI: Robust Text-to-Video Generation via Group-Structured Intent Alignment

**abstract/A1：** Modern text-to-video (T2V) models generate visually compelling videos, yet meaning-preserving changes in prompt wording can substantially alter semantic realization and overall quality. Existing prompt rewriting modifies the inference input, whereas conventional post-training constructs supervision from one prompt formulation at a time; neither explicitly optimizes reliability across equivalent forms. We introduce VARI (Verified Alignment over Representations of Intent), a group-structured framework that treats automatically verified formulations of the same visual intent as a shared supervision unit. VARI builds matched form-seed rollout pools, cross-scores each video against all forms, and applies a wording-independent structured intent audit to identify valid realizations and hard semantic failures. Group-Consistent Distillation (GCD) aligns every verified form with interchangeable valid realizations, while Form-Contrastive Flow-DPO (FC-DPO) learns group-level preferences from audited positive-negative pairs, prioritizing same-seed, different-form contrasts. On HunyuanVideo-1.5, VARI attains the highest T2V-CompBench, VBench, and StoryEval scores among the evaluated methods. On prompt-form extensions of T2V-CompBench and VBench, it improves weakest-form alignment over the strongest prompt-level baselines by 2.45 and 3.55 points and reduces cross-form drop by 30.5% and 32.2%, respectively, while preserving visual quality. Human evaluation, natural-caption controls, prompt-enhancement experiments, diversity analyses, and transfer to LTX-2.3 further support the robustness and transferability of these gains, while VARI requires no additional inference-time module.

</details>

### 500. [Closing the Estimation Gap: Training-Free Transductive Inference for Cross-Domain Few-Shot Action Recognition](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18209v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18209

**作者：** Changyi Li、Zeyu Yang、Yu Xiao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18209v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18209v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究跨域少样本动作识别的推理瓶颈：用 oracle 原型与决策边界量化出「表示已含判别信息、但少样本原型估计失败」的估计差距，并提出免训练转导框架 TRACE，先用高置信查询精化原型，再逐 episode 适配轻量分类器。

**相关性简评：** 其测试期转导式估计修正与置信度筛选伪标签的机制，可能为 LVR 中测试期证据筛选、答案读出状态的迭代精化可供核查，但研究对象是视频动作分类而非多模态推理状态，迁移属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Closing the Estimation Gap: Training-Free Transductive Inference for Cross-Domain Few-Shot Action Recognition

**abstract/A1：** Cross-domain few-shot action recognition (CD-FSAR) aims to recognise unseen action classes in a target domain from a handful of labelled videos. Despite advances in representation learning, CD-FSAR inference still relies on prototypes estimated from extremely limited support examples. To assess this bottleneck, we perform an oracle analysis with the representation fixed. Constructing oracle prototypes and decision boundaries from ground-truth query labels improves 5-way 1-shot accuracy by 7--20 percentage points across five target datasets. This reveals a substantial estimation gap: the representation contains useful discriminative information, but prototypes and boundaries estimated from scarce supports fail to capture each episode's true class structure. Motivated by this, we propose TRACE, a training-free transductive inference framework that improves episode-level estimation without modifying the backbone. TRACE comprises two complementary stages. Confidence-Thresholded Transductive Prototype Refinement (CTPR) refines support-based prototypes using confidently predicted queries. The refined prototypes initialise a lightweight per-episode classifier, which Transductive Classifier Refinement (TCR) further adapts by encouraging confident, class-balanced predictions over all queries. Together, the two stages improve prototype and boundary estimation, enabling better use of information in the unlabelled queries. Across five target datasets (HMDB51, UCF101, SSv2, Diving48, and RareAct) in both 1-shot and 5-shot settings, TRACE consistently improves a strong CD-FSAR baseline, including gains of more than six percentage points on HMDB51 1-shot, while recovering much of the oracle-estimated gap. These results suggest that improving test-time estimation is a powerful, broadly applicable complement to representation learning for CD-FSAR under extreme support scarcity.

**comment/C1：** Accepted by BMVC Workshop 2026

</details>

### 501. [Heading Hierarchy Reconstruction for Complex and Long Documents with Level-Wise Multimodal Memory](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18238v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18238

**作者：** Qian Chen、Xianyin Zhang、Lifan Guo、Chi Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18238v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18238v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出基于 VLM 的框架，用「层级多模态记忆」按页增量重建长文档的标题层级，并构建了 CLDoc-HHRBench 基准（250 篇文档、11212 页）进行评测。

**相关性简评：** 其以锚点选取各级最近节点、用紧凑记忆维持跨页一致性的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与缓存/状态压缩提供可核查的方法线索，但论文本身不涉及 latent 推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Heading Hierarchy Reconstruction for Complex and Long Documents with Level-Wise Multimodal Memory

**abstract/A1：** Vision-language models (VLMs) have been widely adopted for document parsing and optical character recognition (OCR), as they can accurately extract page-level elements. However, downstream applications such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) also require coherent document-level structure. Although these models indicate heading levels using different numbers of preceding \`\`\\#'' symbols, page-by-page prediction often lacks document-level consistency. In practice, input-resolution and context-length constraints make it infeasible for a VLM to jointly process all page images in documents containing tens or hundreds of pages. To address this limitation, we propose a VLM-based framework that incrementally reconstructs heading hierarchies with a \\emph{level-wise multimodal memory}. The memory retains a compact subset of all previously processed pages, selected by anchors. Our framework supports flexible anchor selection, and in this work we select the most recent node at each level, allowing the VLM to observe the visual, textual, and layout patterns of headings at every level. For comprehensive evaluation, we also introduce the Complex and Long Document Heading Hierarchy Reconstruction Benchmark (CLDoc-HHRBench), comprising 250 documents and 11,212 pages with expert-verified annotations. Experiments on CLDoc-HHRBench and three existing benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.

</details>

### 502. [Beyond Answer Sharing: TrueMAD for Targeted Peer Engagement in Multi-Agent Debate](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18240v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18240

**作者：** Dezheng Bao、Sihang Du、Renhong Huang、Zhizhang Yuan、Yifei Sun、Yang Yang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18240v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18240v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 TrueMAD，一种骨干无关的测试时插件，在多智能体辩论的答案广播与自我修订之间插入一对一、自由形式的同伴建议，由来源智能体对目标当前推理给出支持、反驳、细化或追问，目标自行决定如何修订，从而提升准确率。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本多智能体辩论，不含视觉或 latent 状态；但其「定向同伴建议」机制可能为 LVR 中 latent 假设的验证、证据筛选与修正归因提供测试时线索，可供核查其向多模态推理的迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Answer Sharing: TrueMAD for Targeted Peer Engagement in Multi-Agent Debate

**abstract/A1：** Multi-agent debate (MAD) aims to improve large language model reasoning by exposing agents to alternative solutions and enabling iterative revision. However, standard broadcast-style MAD makes peer answers visible without requiring agents to engage with a particular peer claim. As a result, reliable reasoning may be suppressed by conflicting or majority responses, limiting achievable performance, while erroneous reasoning may persist and degrade final predictions without actionable feedback. We propose TrueMAD, a backbone-agnostic test-time plug-in that introduces one-to-one, free-form peer advice between answer broadcasting and self-revision. Each source agent responds to a target's current reasoning through support, rebuttal, refinement, or further questions, while the target retains control over how to revise. The same mechanism can augment standard MAD and its improved variants without parameter updates. Across AIME, GPQA-Diamond, and TruthfulQA with Qwen3-30B-A3B, TrueMAD improves agent-level and strict-majority accuracy over MAD by 3.62 and 3.52 percentage points on average, while TrueDMAD improves DMAD by 4.72 and 4.06 points, respectively. Analyses at the utterance, agent-transition, and group levels further show more peer-specific deliberation, more correction-oriented revisions, and more favorable consensus dynamics.

</details>

### 503. [Teach Me After You Learn It: Lookahead Self-Distillation for RLVR](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18256v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18256

**作者：** Zepeng Zhai、Meilin Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18256v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18256v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 LEAD：在 on-policy 自蒸馏中让教师先在不同 rollout 子集上做虚拟 RL 更新，再对另一子集提供跨组 token 级监督，并用「和谐调制」按两类信号一致性调整 GRPO 优势，在科学推理与交互智能体基准上评测。

**相关性简评：** 其特权信息自蒸馏、跨组密集 token 监督与优势调制，可能为 LVR 的轨迹训练、贡献分配及监督信号冲突调和提供线索；但该工作为纯文本 RLVR，未涉及视觉或 latent 推理状态，迁移适用性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Teach Me After You Learn It: Lookahead Self-Distillation for RLVR

**abstract/A1：** On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) has emerged as a popular training paradigm for LLMs, providing dense, token-level supervision by aligning a model's own distribution with the distribution induced by privileged information. However, existing OPSD methods derive supervision solely from privileged information of the same instance, leaving inter-instance supervision largely unexplored. We propose Lookahead Self-Distillation (LEAD), which introduces inter-instance distillation by allowing the teacher to first learn from other on-policy rollouts before teaching the student. LEAD constructs lookahead teachers through virtual RL updates on disjoint subsets of on-policy rollouts, and uses each teacher to provide cross-group token-level supervision for the other subset. To reconcile the complementary yet potentially conflicting signals from OPSD and RLVR, we introduce harmonious modulation, which adaptively modulates the GRPO advantage based on the agreement between the two signals. Extensive experiments on scientific reasoning and interactive-agent benchmarks show that LEAD achieves the best in-domain average performance across model scales while maintaining out-of-domain generalization comparable to GRPO.

**comment/C1：** 18 pages, 3 figures

</details>

### 504. [LongForcing: Scaling Temporal Manifold Matching for Long-Horizon World Rollout](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18289v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18289

**作者：** Ziyu Zhu、Zhaoxu Sun、Fan Jiang、Mengchao Wang、Junfeng Ni、Ting-Bing Xu、Zhicheng Liu、Mu Xu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18289v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18289v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究自回归视频扩散模型在远超训练窗口的长时程世界推演中出现的渐进漂移，指出「监督时程缺口」（短窗蒸馏使后续 rollout 状态缺少直接监督），提出 LongForcing：保留短时程 teacher-forcing 与因果 ODE 蒸馏阶段，在最终分布匹配阶段用扩展时程的双向教师监督学生的长自rollout，不改变学生结构、不增加推理成本。

**相关性简评：** 其「短窗匹配不能决定长时程行为、需在自生成长轨迹上施加监督」的训练思路，可能为 LVR 中长程 latent 轨迹训练、状态漂移与信息坍缩的缓解提供可核查线索，但属训练期监督设计，与推理期 latent 状态生成不同，具体迁移需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LongForcing: Scaling Temporal Manifold Matching for Long-Horizon World Rollout

**abstract/A1：** Autoregressive video diffusion models have emerged as a foundation for long-horizon world rollout. However, when extended far beyond their training windows, these models suffer from progressive drift: visual quality deteriorates, motion becomes inconsistent, and object identity gradually collapses as generated frames are recursively reused as context. We study a supervision-horizon gap: short-horizon distillation leaves later rollout states without direct supervision. We show that matching short-window marginals need not determine long-horizon behavior, while longer on-policy trajectories expose delayed failures to training. This motivates temporal manifold matching at scale for long-horizon world models. Building on this insight, we introduce LongForcing, a distillation approach that scales teacher supervision to long student self-rollouts. LongForcing preserves the short-horizon teacher-forcing and causal ODE-distillation stages, while replacing the realscore teacher in the final distribution-matching stage with an extended-horizon bidirectional teacher. The long-horizon teacher supervises extended student self-rollouts using the standard distribution-matching formulation, without modifying the student architecture or increasing inference cost. We evaluate LongForcing on text-to-video generation and interactive action-conditioned world models, achieving a VBench Quality score of 85.52 and improving WorldRoamBench 60s action score by 23.9 points in first-person ablations. Qualitative stress tests further sample interactive rollouts up to 24 hours, far beyond the training horizon. These results suggest that scaling supervision along the temporal axis is a practical step toward long-horizon world models. The project website and code are at https://github.com/Fantasy-AMAP/LongForcing.

</details>

### 505. [Output Discipline Sets the Floor: A Falsification-Guided, Model-Agnostic Agent Protocol for Auditable Hypothesis-Driven Decision Making](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18298v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18298

**作者：** Jing Liu、Yongxing Qi、Ping Yao、Ting Wu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18298v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18298v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在中医证候辨证基准 TCMEval-SDT 上提出一个模型无关的五阶段闭环 agent 协议，以「候选×证据」逐条证伪矩阵强制输出纪律，并测量其在不同基座模型上的收益与成本，同时迁移到抗错误前提的数学推理。

**相关性简评：** 其对非终止推理、终止拯救（STOP）与推理结构成本/收益的量化，以及候选—证据逐项证伪的验证流程，可能为 LVR 的停止决策、视觉证据筛选与协议代价评估提供可供核查的方法线索；但研究对象是纯文本决策任务，不涉及视觉状态或 latent 表示，迁移需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Output Discipline Sets the Floor: A Falsification-Guided, Model-Agnostic Agent Protocol for Auditable Hypothesis-Driven Decision Making

**abstract/A1：** What binds large language models on auditable, hypothesis-driven decision tasks, where every candidate can be checked against the evidence? On the public TCMEval-SDT benchmark for Traditional Chinese Medicine syndrome differentiation (200 cases), the binding constraint is output discipline and reasoning structure, not model capability alone: two years of model scaling move zero-shot scores by only -0.03 to +0.08, while output-discipline failures (non-terminating reasoning, format non-compliance, large run-to-run spread) persist even in frontier models. We test this with a model-agnostic agent framework formalizing decision making as a five-stage closed loop, enforced by a candidate x evidence matrix falsification protocol: every candidate is judged against every evidence item, at least half of the candidates must be falsified before a conclusion is licensed, and survivors are emitted in a machine-verifiable single-line format. Across five base models, the effect is sign-conditional on zero-shot output discipline: it rescues models whose discipline fails (DeepSeek-V4-Flash: +0.267/+0.271, entirely termination rescue), reduces a high-variance model's run-to-run standard deviation from 0.218 to 0.007 (Kimi K3), and significantly costs already-disciplined models (-0.087 to -0.120 on budget-matched Qwen3-4B/32B). Ablations attribute the cost to the candidate-bounded format layer and show the effect is independent of injected knowledge content (protocol-knowledge decoupling). The protocol also transfers to misinformation-robust mathematical reasoning, detecting injected false premises at 89.8% recall with a 6.8% false-positive rate (MCC 0.54; a flag-everything baseline scores 0) and restoring accuracy to the no-misinformation ceiling. Where zero-shot output discipline is weak, the reasoning protocol sets the floor; base-model capability always sets the ceiling.

**comment/C1：** 24 pages, 5 figures, 12 tables

</details>

**内容简述：** 提出 Omni-RS 遥感统一框架，支持四类理解任务与五类生成任务：先让多模态大模型适配遥感理解，再用其隐状态引导 diffusion transformer 生成，并构建统一多任务生成数据集 UniGen，另用 VAE 编码的视觉条件支持需参考图的生成任务。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Omni-RS: Unifying Multi-Task Understanding and Generation in Remote Sensing

**abstract/A1：** Practical remote sensing applications often require both understanding and generation capabilities for the same geographic scene. However, most existing methods address either understanding or generation in isolation, while existing unified remote sensing models' generative ability is limited to text-to-image. To bridge this gap, we propose Omni-RS, a unified framework supporting four remote sensing understanding tasks and five generation tasks. Specifically, we introduce the "Scene-Guided Two-Stage Training" strategy, which first adapts a multimodal large language model to remote sensing understanding and then uses its hidden states to guide a diffusion transformer for image generation. To enable joint learning across diverse generation tasks, we construct UniGen, a unified multi-task generation dataset, by organizing heterogeneous remote sensing data into a unified format. Furthermore, we introduce "Detailed Visual Conditioning", which uses visual conditions encoded by a VAE to guide the generation process, thereby supporting additional generation tasks that require reference images. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Omni-RS performs exceptionally well in understanding tasks and has achieved outstanding results in a variety of generative tasks.

</details>

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SchemaPose：为 RGB 单目类别级 9D 位姿估计引入显式参数化 schema，建模类别共性并刻画实例级结构变化，用推断出的 schema 变量在端到端 query 框架中引导位姿预测，并统一支持模板实例化与合成标注。

**相关性简评：** 该文把「类别共享＋实例特有」的结构化 latent 变量直接用于引导预测，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的几何信息保留、任务必要信息解耦与容量分配设计提供可核查线索；但其面向位姿回归而非推理循环，与 THINK/LOOK/STOP 等主线问题的关联需人工确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SchemaPose: RGB-Based Category-Level Pose Estimation with Parametric Category Schema

**abstract/A1：** RGB-based category-level 9D pose estimation remains highly challenging because a monocular system must generalize across unseen object instances while jointly inferring 3D translation, 3D rotation, and 3D size. Unlike instance-level pose estimation, the category-level setting requires the network to learn both what is shared across objects within a category and how individual instances vary in structure. This challenge is amplified in the RGB-only setting, where pose cues, category-level commonality, and instance-specific variation are entangled in appearance without direct geometric constraints, making it difficult for existing frameworks to learn a representation that is truly aligned with the category-level estimation objective. To address this problem, we propose SchemaPose, a schema-guided framework for RGB-based category-level pose estimation. SchemaPose equips the estimation pipeline with an explicit parametric schema for modeling category-level regularities together with structured instance variation, and uses the inferred schema variables to guide pose-related prediction in an end-to-end query-based framework. The same formulation also supports template instantiation, synthetic annotation, and pose learning within a unified framework. Experiments on synthetic and real data show that SchemaPose achieves state-of-the-art performance among RGB-based methods for category-level 9D pose estimation.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://souglad21.github.io/SchemaPose/

</details>

### 508. [PRISM: Calibrating Black-Box Judges with Counterfactual Probes](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18389v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18389

**作者：** Kakei Yamamoto、So Kuroki

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18389v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18389v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** PRISM 在固定被评内容的前提下，通过强调或弱化属性构造反事实探针，测量黑箱评审分数的变化，将其视为替代雅可比并以岭回归学习对基线分数的校正，从而无需 rubric 即提升与人类排名的一致性，在 SummEval、HANNA 上验证。

**相关性简评：** 其「反事实探针＋回归校正」的敏感性度量思路，可能可供核查 LVR 评估中评审分数是否对视觉证据与推理轨迹属性的强调做出合理响应，即把判分偏差与状态敏感性分离，具体对应关系仍需阅读原文判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PRISM: Calibrating Black-Box Judges with Counterfactual Probes

**abstract/A1：** Large language models are increasingly used as judges to reduce reliance on costly human evaluation, yet their scores can systematically disagree with human judgments. We ask whether responses to an explicitly imposed evaluative bias can help correct a judge's implicit scoring biases. We introduce PRISM (Probe-based Residual Inference of Scoring Misalignment), which holds the evaluated content fixed and measures score changes when attributes are emphasized or de-emphasized. A local sensitivity model motivates representing these responses as a surrogate Jacobian. Ridge regression on human labels learns a correction to the baseline score. The resulting scoring protocol is rubric-free: it uses overall scores without requesting criterion-level ratings. In the main Jev and Sol comparisons on SummEval summarization and HANNA story evaluation, PRISM and its learned-baseline variant significantly improve agreement with human rankings over uncalibrated scores while remaining competitive with rubric-based methods. A controlled SummEval comparison yields similar agreement for rubric-derived quality probes and style probes, supporting calibration without reproducing rubric criteria. The learned coefficients reveal shared and opposing correction directions across judges.

</details>

### 509. [CoTL: Compact Token Learning for 3D Scene Representation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18446v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18446

**作者：** Han Liang、Sibo Wu、Anpei Chen、Rüdiger Westermann

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18446v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18446v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 CoTL：用编码器把无位姿多视图图像压缩为每视图少量 latent token，聚合成视图一致的紧凑场景表示，并用查询式 Gaussian 解码器重建可渲染的 3D Gaussian，以新视角渲染监督端到端训练。

**相关性简评：** 其「紧凑 latent 瓶颈＋查询解码器重建显式输出」的监督思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态是否保留任务必要信息、以及用解码或探针验证 latent 内容的做法，但需确认与推理状态生成的关联。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CoTL: Compact Token Learning for 3D Scene Representation

**abstract/A1：** We present CoTL, a framework that learns a compact set of tokens that preserves scene geometry and appearance from unposed multi-view images. Our encoder compresses the input images into small per-view sets of latent tokens that aggregate information across views to form a view-consistent scene representation. Each additional view expands the representation with only a small, resolution-independent set of tokens, allowing its capacity to grow with the available observations. To force this compact bottleneck to retain sufficient scene information, a query-based Gaussian decoder uses scene-independent queries to attend to the learned tokens and recover an explicit, renderable set of 3D Gaussian primitives. Novel-view rendering supervision trains the compact representation end to end through the reconstructed Gaussian scene. Experiments on \\retenk{} and ACID show that the resulting compact, unstructured token set supports competitive novel-view synthesis and can serve as the latent space of a generative model for 3D Gaussian scene generation. Together, these results show that 3D Gaussian reconstruction is an effective objective for compact scene representation learning and the learned token space provides a basis for broader downstream tasks in 3D vision.

</details>

### 510. [$\\mathrm{S}^3$-PnP: Plug-and-Play Denoising for Scientific Imaging with Self-Supervised Score Priors](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18458v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18458

**作者：** Yukun Cui、Jiangshe Zhang、Shuang Xu、Lilun Deng、Haowen Bai、Tao Feng、Haotong Qin、Konrad Schindler、Zixiang Zhao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18458v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18458v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 S³-PnP：一种自监督即插即用复原框架，直接从观测导出的 ADMM 中间状态学习 score 先验，无需干净目标或外部预训练权重，并分析修正后 ADMM 的收敛与重构误差，在 HSI、MRI 任务上验证。

**相关性简评：** 其「从迭代中间状态自监督学得先验以纠正下一轮输入」以及显式处理去噪器输入分布与目标分布错配的思路，或可作为 LVR 中循环 latent 状态分布漂移与轨迹监督的借鉴线索，需人工核查可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** $\\mathrm{S}^3$-PnP: Plug-and-Play Denoising for Scientific Imaging with Self-Supervised Score Priors

**abstract/A1：** Modern image restoration methods increasingly rely on large-scale supervised training, yet clean targets are often prohibitively difficult to obtain in scientific imaging modalities such as hyperspectral imaging (HSI) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). Plug-and-play ADMM (PnP-ADMM) with pretrained diffusion priors offers a promising alternative, but the learned prior distribution can mismatch both the target scientific image distribution and the distribution of ADMM denoiser inputs induced by dual feedback. To mitigate these mismatches, we propose $\\mathrm{S}^3$-PnP, a self-supervised plug-and-play restoration framework that learns a score prior directly from observation-derived ADMM intermediate states, without clean training targets or externally pretrained weights. Specifically, the learned score corrects the input to the analytical prior update, combining observation-driven corrections with analytical regularization. We further analyze the convergence and reconstruction error of the corrected ADMM algorithm assuming an ideal score and quadratic data fidelity. Experiments on reference-guided HSI restoration, single-image HSI denoising, and MRI denoising demonstrate consistent improvements over competing methods.

</details>

### 511. [Teacher-Guided Tool Learning for Small Language Models via Bidirectional KL Constraints](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18459v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18459

**作者：** Haoxuan Gao、Qin-Wen Luo、Xiang Chen、Yu Tian、Zequn Sun、Xiaofeng Cao、Jiangchao Yao、Sheng-Jun Huang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18459v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18459v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SeTPO：在低奖励轨迹上把反向 KL 得到的 token 级教师反馈并入策略优势，并用前向 KL 辅助监督维持教师示范行为，从而让小型语言模型学到工具调用能力，在 BFCL v4 与 API Bank 上对比 SFT、RL 与蒸馏基线。

**相关性简评：** 论文不涉及视觉或多模态 latent 状态，但其「按轨迹质量选择性地注入 token 级双向 KL 约束、并保证保留一定教师概率质量」的做法，可能为 latent 推理轨迹训练中的监督选择与信息坍缩问题提供可核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Teacher-Guided Tool Learning for Small Language Models via Bidirectional KL Constraints

**abstract/A1：** External tools can extend the capabilities of small language models (SLMs), enabling their deployment in resource constrained environments. However, their limited capabilities make it difficult for SLMs to discover effective tool use behaviors through reinforcement learning alone, while direct teacher supervision suffers from teacher student behavioral distribution mismatch and may propagate erroneous preferences. To address these challenges, we propose Selective Teacher guided Policy Optimization (SeTPO), which coordinates student exploration with selective teacher guidance and persistent demonstration supervision. Specifically, SeTPO incorporates reverse KL derived token level teacher feedback into policy advantages on low reward trajectories, while auxiliary forward KL supervision preserves teacher demonstrated behaviors throughout training. Under an idealized bidirectional KL objective, we theoretically establish that the optimal policy achieves expected reward no lower than the teacher's while retaining a guaranteed fraction of the teacher's probability mass. Extensive experiments on BFCL v4 and API Bank demonstrate that SeTPO achieves superior overall performance over supervised fine tuning, reinforcement learning, and distillation baselines across all three student scales.

</details>

### 512. [Readout Scaling Shapes Sparse Feature Recovery](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18462v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18462

**作者：** Brain Xiao、Sarah Wilson

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18462v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18462v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究稀疏自编码器（SAE）中读出缩放如何影响稀疏特征的恢复，提出「读出规范化决策空间」（RC-DS）坐标以剥离奇异值增益、保留决策信息，并在受控坐标匹配实验、神经策略与多个语言模型检查点上比较特征恢复与 logit 重建表现。

**相关性简评：** 其「消除读出缩放增益、保留决策信息」的表示分析工具，可能可供核查 LVR/VLM 内部状态中被读出层掩盖的视觉与任务信息，但论文未涉及多模态或 latent reasoning，迁移为推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Readout Scaling Shapes Sparse Feature Recovery

**abstract/A1：** Readout scaling changes what a sparse autoencoder (SAE) learns, but the benefit of removing it depends on the data. We use readout-canonicalized decision-space (RC-DS) coordinates to remove singular-value gains while preserving retained decision information. At a fixed readout condition number, changing the generating distribution reverses which training coordinates recover known factors best. In our controlled coordinate-matching study, recovery is highest when training restores the space in which the factors were generated. When factors are generated before readout scaling, RC-DS increases mean sparse-factor recovery from 0.506 to 0.913 at condition number 100, compared with centered-logit training under the same budget. An exact wrapper reproduces RC-DS training to numerical precision, isolating training geometry rather than additional information. In neural policies, RC-DS improves mean logit reconstruction under the tested budgets. On three fixed language-model checkpoints, RC-DS has higher mean gain-free reconstruction in all 18 tested task-sparsity settings, while centered-logit SAEs reconstruct output logits better in 17. Small-label-head controls show that longer training reduces the reconstruction gap from 0.0198 to 0.0016. Together, these results show how readout scaling, the data distribution, and training shape sparse learning. RC-DS provides an information-preserving method for studying and controlling the readout's contribution. Separate label-detection and steering tests distinguish these reconstruction effects from task-specific feature usefulness.

</details>

### 513. [Simplifying and Improving On-Policy Distillation for Few-Step Diffusion](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18472v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18472

**作者：** Jiawei Zhang、Ziyu Wan、Nanye Ma、Long Zhao、Dong Chen、Hongyu Liu、Qifeng Chen、Dongdong Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG、eess.IV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18472v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18472v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Simplified Matching Distillation（SMD），用简单的 on-policy velocity 回归蒸馏少步扩散/流模型，并引入训练期残差代理 Pivot，把局部修正与学生的区间均值预测分离，同时排斥较弱教师预测，从而在无需辅助 score 模型与对抗训练的情况下实现 4-NFE 生成。

**相关性简评：** 其 on-policy 蒸馏与「局部修正＋区间均值」的残差分解属于训练期逐步监督机制，可能为 LVR 轨迹训练中的步级贡献分配与监督提供线索；但研究对象是扩散生成而非多模态推理，迁移可行性需人工核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Simplifying and Improving On-Policy Distillation for Few-Step Diffusion

**abstract/A1：** Few-step distillation reduces the sampling cost of diffusion and flow models, but existing approaches often require auxiliary score models or specialized architectures. We show that simple on-policy velocity regression already provides a strong foundation for 4-NFE generation. To represent teacher velocity variation within each coarse transition, we introduce Pivot, a training-only residual proxy that separates local corrections from the student's interval-mean prediction. We further repel the student from weaker teacher predictions, providing a lightweight mechanism for avoiding undesirable modes. The resulting framework, Simplified Matching Distillation (SMD), remains entirely regression-based, requires neither online score estimation nor adversarial training, and leaves the deployed generator unchanged. We evaluate SMD on image generation and editing, 3D generation, video synthesis, and joint audio--video generation, scaling to 33 billion parameters. At 4-NFE, SMD outperforms strong few-step baselines and surpasses multi-step teachers on several benchmarks. It also supports cross-model, multi-teacher, and causal-video distillation.

**comment/C1：** Project Page: https://zjwfufu.github.io/SMD-Page/

</details>

### 514. [ProTok: Unified Protein Tokenization via Modular Multi-Codebook Quantization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18481v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18481

**作者：** Romain Hardy、Xiaoman Zhang、Pranav Rajpurkar

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18481v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18481v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** ProTok 提出统一的蛋白质 tokenizer，用带分模态码本组的产品量化与 modality dropout，把序列、结构、功能注释三类模态编码进同一套离散词表；单一 checkpoint 可在任意模态子集下推理，并在结构相关基准与零样本功能检索上超过单模态基线，其 token 还能支撑从零训练的小模型联合生成骨架与序列。

**相关性简评：** 其「分模态码本组 + 产品量化 + modality dropout」为多模态内部状态如何在不同模态子集（如缺失视觉）下仍保留可解码信息提供了可核查的方法线索，或可类比 LVR 中视觉旁路与信息坍缩的表示设计问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ProTok: Unified Protein Tokenization via Modular Multi-Codebook Quantization

**abstract/A1：** Protein sequence, structure, and functional annotations each capture complementary aspects of protein biology, yet existing tokenizers encode each modality independently, limiting the expressiveness of discrete protein representations. We present ProTok, a unified protein tokenizer that maps all three modalities into a modular discrete vocabulary via product quantization with per-modality codebook groups and modality dropout. A single ProTok checkpoint supports flexible inference from any modality subset without retraining. On seven StructTokenBench benchmarks spanning 14 tasks and 28 test splits, ProTok achieves an average rank of 1.4 across all structure-only tokenizers, placing first on 21 splits and among the top two on 27 of the 28. These gains come without sacrificing reconstruction: ProTok's tokens reach 0.939 lDDT on CATH 4.2, showing that multi-codebook quantization and multi-modal training yield tokens that are both reconstructable and informative. ProTok's structure tokens further lead all baseline structure tokenizers on zero-shot functional retrieval across CATH, Enzyme Commission, and Gene Ontology label hierarchies. The vocabulary also supports generation: a compact language model trained from scratch over ProTok tokens jointly generates backbone and sequence, with 52% of sampled backbones designable versus 21% for a parameter-matched GeoBPE baseline. ProTok shows that structure, sequence, and function can share one discrete vocabulary, motivating protein language models that reason over a unified token stream.

**comment/C1：** 22 pages, 2 figures, 10 tables

</details>

### 515. [ReTerm: Recovery Training for Self-Improving Terminal Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18484v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18484

**作者：** Wei Xie、Kaituo Feng、Shiming Fu、Yong Liu、Xiangyu Yue、Shuangjia Zheng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG、cs.SE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18484v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18484v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 ReTerm：先构建 ReTerm-10K 恢复演示数据做 SFT 冷启动，再用 ReTerm-GRPO 从 agent 自身失败状态分叉出多条独立恢复尝试，以任务是否最终完成作为奖励进行在线 RL，使终端 agent 学会从错误中自我恢复。

**相关性简评：** 其「从失败状态分叉多条尝试、按最终成败做信用分配」的机制，可能可供核查 LVR 中失败轨迹复用、轨迹级监督与贡献分配问题；但对象是纯文本终端 agent，与视觉推理无直接关联。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ReTerm: Recovery Training for Self-Improving Terminal Agents

**abstract/A1：** Terminal agents have shown strong abilities in complex coding tasks. However, they often struggle to recover from errors during long-running execution (e.g., command errors, faulty implementations), eventually leading to task failures. To this end, we present ReTerm, a self-improving terminal agent trained by learning how to recover from its own failed terminal tasks. To support its training, we construct a customized data pipeline and produce ReTerm-10K, a high-quality dataset that provides effective recovery demonstrations for SFT cold start. Furthermore, we propose ReTerm-GRPO, an online RL algorithm that forks from the agent's own failure states to generate multiple independent self-recovery attempts. By learning from whether these attempts successfully complete the task, the agent self-improves through its own recovery experience. Built on Qwen3.5-9B, our ReTerm-9B achieves 34.8% Pass@1 on Terminal-Bench 2.0, improving over the base model by 14.6 points. Further analysis shows that our method achieves consistently higher recovery rates across diverse error categories compared with standard GRPO training. All code, data and model are released at https://github.com/twothsnd/ReTerm.

**comment/C1：** Project page: https://github.com/twothsnd/ReTerm

</details>

### 516. [Judges Follow the Reference: The Derivation Gap in Verifying Tool-Call Arguments](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18497v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18497

**作者：** Linhai Ma、Yan Wang、Lingfei Qian、Yupeng Cao、Victor Gutierrez Basulto

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18497v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18497v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文考察工具调用评审模型（judge）对参数取值的判定：当输入中缺少说明该值应为何值的参考文本时，正确取值被接受的比例下降，作者称之为「derivation gap」，并在七个 judge 上复现；为此提出 DeRef，用一个单独模型在不看候选值的情况下读取完整历史、写出参考供 judge 使用。

**相关性简评：** 其「判定高度依赖输入中可见参考、来源被隐藏即偏向错误值」的结论，可能为 VLM 推理答案核验、证据筛选与 latent 内容使用程度的诊断提供可借鉴的方法线索，但该工作本身限于文本工具调用场景，与视觉推理无直接关联。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Judges Follow the Reference: The Derivation Gap in Verifying Tool-Call Arguments

**abstract/A1：** Tool-call judges evaluate argument values proposed by LLM agents. We find that they accept a correct value less often when their input holds no reference for it, that is, no text that says what the value should be. This happens when the value is a default value from the function schema that the user did not mention, when it has to be inferred, or when the text it comes from was cut from the judge input. We call this drop in acceptance the derivation gap. It appears across all seven judges we evaluate, including System One models CLM and Jev. The gap is not only a truncation artifact: correct default values have the largest gap on a benchmark with no truncation. A controlled source-relocation test shows that judges follow the reference in their input: they favor a visible incorrect value over a correct value whose source is hidden. We introduce DeRef (Derived Reference): a separate model reads the full history without seeing the candidate and writes a reference for the judge. Across three benchmarks, DeRef improves overall argument AUROC for all judges tested. On the controlled test, it raises AUROC from chance or below to between 98.40 and 99.59.

**comment/C1：** 28 pages, 6 figures, 18 tables

</details>

### 517. [Two For The Price Of One: Curvature-Aware Pruning Preserves Influence Functions Too](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18516v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18516

**作者：** Mehdi Makni、Natalia Ponomareva、Rahul Mazumder

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18516v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18516v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究后训练剪枝中如何保持压缩模型与稠密模型的影响函数（梯度）对齐，提出基于 ADMM 的优化器 CACTUS，同时支持剪枝与稀疏加低秩分解，显著加速剪枝并改善困惑度与逐样本梯度余弦相似度，还可用于数据选择。

**相关性简评：** 其以「压缩—稠密」逐样本梯度余弦相似度量化内部信息保留、并用影响函数做训练数据选择的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态是否保留任务必要信息、以及轨迹训练的数据与贡献分配提供可核查的度量线索，但论文本身未涉及视觉或多模态推理，迁移属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Two For The Price Of One: Curvature-Aware Pruning Preserves Influence Functions Too

**abstract/A1：** Post-training pruning enables efficient deployment, but conventional methods do not explicitly preserve internal-gradient alignment between sparse and dense models. We study novel connections between downstream performance of compressed models and the ability to retain gradient information via influence-function preservation. Central to this connection is a curvature-aware objective that accounts for both layer activations and backpropagated gradients. Despite its promise, this objective remains underexplored in pruning due to a lack of efficient solvers. We introduce $\\texttt{CACTUS}$, a novel ADMM-based optimizer supporting both pruning and sparse-plus-low-rank decompositions of pre-trained weights. Compared to LLM-Surgeon which targets the same objective, $\\texttt{CACTUS}$ can achieve over an order-of-magnitude speedup. At $50\\%$ pruning of Qwen3-4B, $\\texttt{CACTUS}$ reduces the C4 perplexity gap to the dense model by $45\\%$, improves compressed-to-dense per-sample gradient cosine similarity on WikiText-2 from $0.670$ to $0.755$, and runs over $28\\times$ faster than LLM-Surgeon on substantially weaker hardware. By preserving influence functions, $\\texttt{CACTUS}$ supports effective data selection. On Llama-3.2-3B, fine-tuning a fresh dense model on the $5\\%$ of data selected by $\\texttt{CACTUS}$ achieves $49.44\\%$ accuracy on BIG-Bench Hard, compared with $47.22\\%$ using ALPS and $49.54\\%$ using dense-model selection. Finally, integrating $\\texttt{CACTUS}$ with LoGRA, a recent gradient-projection strategy, on Qwen3-4B with MLP layers pruned to 2:4 sparsity and a rank-64 correction retains a $0.711$ cosine alignment with dense LoGRA-projected C4 gradients.

</details>

### 518. [Beyond the Encoder: Object-Centric Representations Emerging from Segmentation Foundation Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18543v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18543

**作者：** Michalis Pistos、Bartłomiej W. Papież

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18543v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18543v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把 SAM2 分割通路中产生的对象指针（object pointers）当作可迁移表示，用于 PET/CT 肿瘤预测，并提出任务引导的辅助目标与分割联合塑造指针空间；结果显示仅靠分割监督的指针已含肿瘤判别信息，任务引导指针在癌型分类上优于常规 encoder 迁移与 radiomics。

**相关性简评：** 其对象级紧凑状态向量、以及用下游目标塑造内部表示空间的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉实体级 latent 状态的设计与监督提供借鉴线索；但该文不涉及推理期状态生成或多模态推理，属方法线索而非主线工作，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond the Encoder: Object-Centric Representations Emerging from Segmentation Foundation Models

**abstract/A1：** Foundation models are increasingly used as feature extractors for downstream tasks with limited data, typically through representations obtained from their encoders. However, foundation models trained for structured tasks such as segmentation also form object-specific representations during task execution, whose transferability remains largely unexplored. We investigate Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM2) object pointers, compact object-level representations produced through the segmentation pathway, as transferable representations for downstream tumour prediction. Through experiments on two PET/CT tumour prediction tasks, we find that object pointers learned using segmentation supervision alone already encode tumour-discriminative information, despite never being optimised for the downstream labels. We further introduce task-guided object pointers, where an auxiliary objective jointly shapes the object pointer space for the downstream prediction together with segmentation. Task-guided pointers improve cancer-type classification, outperforming conventional encoder-based transfer and radiomics, while segmentation-only pointers perform best on the more challenging recurrence prediction task. Representation analyses reveal associations between object pointers and interpretable radiomics features, class-dependent organisation of the learned representation space, and explicit spatial grounding around the segmented tumour. Together, these findings suggest that useful transferable representations can emerge through the execution of a foundation model's primary task, providing an alternative to conventional encoder-based transfer.

**comment/C1：** 20 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables

</details>

### 519. [Rethinking Quality in Large Language Model Routing: Security-Conditioned Model-and-Budget Selection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18566v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18566

**作者：** Yichi Zhang、Zhenxiang Huang、Yuyang Zhang、Yuchen Yang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18566v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18566v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 SCRouter，在混合负载下为每个查询分别预测效用与安全，并据「响应在预算内完成」的概率选择模型与输出 token 预算，同时构建了覆盖九个安全维度、144 种模型-预算组合的 SCRouterBench 基准。

**相关性简评：** 其按查询估计「预算内完成概率」、用小型探针加权不同目标的机制，可能为 LVR 中动态计算分配与 THINK/STOP 的成本-收益权衡提供可核查的方法线索；但该工作不涉及视觉或 latent 推理状态，迁移需自行验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Rethinking Quality in Large Language Model Routing: Security-Conditioned Model-and-Budget Selection

**abstract/A1：** Large language model (LLM) routers reduce serving cost by choosing which model to call and how many output tokens to grant it for each query. Existing routers rank model-budget actions using a single quality metric. This does not work for mixed workloads. For ordinary queries, a good answer is correct and useful (utility); for security-sensitive queries, a good answer refuses harmful requests or resists malicious instructions (security). These two objectives prefer different models and budgets. We propose SCRouter, a router that learns when to prioritize security and how to allocate the token budget. For each model-budget pair, it estimates the probability that the response finishes within budget. It uses this probability to predict utility and security separately. A small probe determines how to weight these two predictions for each query. SCRouter then selects the model and budget by balancing the weighted utility and security against cost. We also build SCRouterBench, a benchmark of 38,869 utility and security queries spanning nine security dimensions, each answered under all 144 combinations of 12 models and 12 budgets, plus 2,753 out-of-domain queries. SCRouter improves the baselines by 13-29 points in-domain and 19-23 points out-of-domain.

</details>

### 520. [Detecting Unreliable Classifications from Quantized Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18575v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18575

**作者：** Ananya Kotla、Jorge T. Gomez

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18575v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18575v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出一种免标签的量化模型可靠性检测方法：对每个预测计算 FP32 与 INT8 模型输出概率向量之间的余弦相似度，仅需一次前向，在四种架构上按固定百分位划分即可分离低准确率预测，并优于仅用置信度的基线。

**相关性简评：** 以「两个模型变体的输出分布一致性」作为免标签可靠性信号，可能为 LVR 中无标注条件下的推理可靠性判断与停止决策提供方法线索；但此处比较的是分类概率向量而非 latent 推理状态，能否迁移到 latent 相似度或证据累积需要核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Detecting Unreliable Classifications from Quantized Models

**abstract/A1：** Post-training INT8 quantization is typically validated by checking accuracy retention, which requires ground-truth labels often unavailable in low-resource clinical settings. We show a label-free alternative: comparing a model's own output before and after quantization. We compute cosine similarity between the FP32 and INT8 models' output probability vectors for each prediction, which requires only a single forward pass. This output-agreement similarity separates lower-accuracy predictions across four evaluated architectures (ResNet-50, VGG-16-BN, Wide ResNet-50, and ViT-B/16) under fixed-percentile splits, outperforming a confidence-only baseline for all four. These results show that quantized models can be compared to their baselines to assess their drift and determine whether they are well suited for clinical deployment.

**comment/C1：** 1 figure, 5 tables

</details>

### 521. [Compare to Correct: Pairwise-Guided Logit Adjustment for LLM Test-Time Scaling](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18583v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18583

**作者：** Cong Hua、Qianqian Xu、Zitai Wang、Zhiyong Yang、Shilong Bao、Linchao Zhang、Qingming Huang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18583v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18583v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 PGLA，借鉴社会选择理论的 Condorcet 原则，对支持不同答案的推理路径做成对置信度比较，再用 KL 正则目标把比较证据与投票支持结合，并证明其等价于对投票 logits 的调整，在数学、知识推理与代码生成等 10 个基准、7 个模型上验证。

**相关性简评：** 其路径成对比较与 logit 调整机制可能为 LVR 中多 latent 假设的筛选、答案选择与投票排序纠错提供可核查的借鉴线索，但该方法仅在纯文本测试时扩展中验证，能否用于 latent 状态尚待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Compare to Correct: Pairwise-Guided Logit Adjustment for LLM Test-Time Scaling

**abstract/A1：** Sampling-based test-time scaling enhances LLM reasoning by aggregating multiple reasoning paths for the same query. Existing methods use answer frequencies or path confidence to compute candidate scores, which do not explicitly characterize comparisons between competing answers. Inspired by the Condorcet principle in social choice theory, we introduce pairwise confidence comparisons between paths supporting different answers to capture answer-level comparative advantage. We combine this comparative evidence with voting support through a KL-regularized objective. Theoretically, we show that this comparative-advantage is equivalent to the adjustment to the traditional voting logits. In this way, our proposed Pairwise-Guided Logit Adjustment (PGLA) framework allows comparative evidence to compensate for weaker voting support and correct voting-based ranking errors. Experiments on 10 challenging benchmarks including mathematical reasoning, knowledge reasoning, and code generation with 7 models ranging from 1.7B to 32B parameters speak to the effectiveness of this plug-and-play term. Additional evaluations with external reward scores and online sampling further demonstrate its applicability.

</details>

<a id="paper-522"></a>

### 522. [LLM2R: From Large Language Models to 3D Reassemblers](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18604v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18604

**作者：** Zhouhan Zhong、Qiuhong Shen、Xingyi Yang、Jinyi Xu、Xinchao Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18604v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18604v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 LLM2R，将 3D 零件装配转化为序列建模：Point-BERT 编码器与 Q-Former 把每个零件压缩成一块几何 token，拼接后由 LoRA 微调的因果 LLM 一次前向处理，并在序列末尾附加可学习的 summary token 聚合整体装配状态，由 part-aware 位姿头融合后一次性非自回归预测所有零件的旋转与平移。

**相关性简评：** 末尾 summary token 块以恒定 token 成本聚合全集合状态、part-aware 头融合局部与全局状态，可能为 LVR 的全局工作区、支持组合与 latent 状态聚合提供可核查的方法线索；其在零件数增多时的优势与零样本泛化也可能关联长度泛化问题，但属推测，需阅读原文确认。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LLM2R: From Large Language Models to 3D Reassemblers

**abstract/A1：** 3D part assembly aims to reconstruct a complete shape from a set of unassembled parts by predicting a rigid SE(3) transformation for each part. Because the placement of a part is rarely determined by its own geometry, the task demands reasoning over the entire part set, and existing methods, which rely on pairwise relations or iterative generation and verification, scale poorly to objects with many parts. We present LLM2R, which casts part assembly as sequence modeling with a pretrained decoder-only large language model (LLM): a Point-BERT encoder and a Q-Former compress each part into a block of geometric tokens, the blocks of all parts are concatenated, and a causal LLM adapted with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) processes the sequence in one forward pass. Causal attention, however, lets the hidden states of a part observe only the parts that precede it. LLM2R therefore appends a block of learnable summary tokens after the last part: these tokens follow every part, so their states aggregate the whole assembly at a constant token cost, and a part-aware pose head fuses each part's states with them before predicting its rotation and translation. One architecture thus handles semantic and geometric assembly and predicts all poses in a single non-autoregressive pass. LLM2R achieves the highest part accuracy and success rate on all three PartNet categories, the best rotation error, translation error, and part accuracy on PartNeXt, and the lowest translation error and fastest inference on Breaking Bad, where only a fracture-specialized method is more accurate. Its advantage grows with the number of parts: at 100 parts it exceeds GARF by 33.5 points in part accuracy on Breaking Bad and Assembler by 29.1 points on PartNet, and it transfers zero-shot to unseen categories with more than 16 points higher part accuracy than the strongest of three baselines.

**comment/C1：** 20 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables

</details>

### 523. [Beyond Answer Voting: Fine-Grained Correction of LLM Reasoning through Graph Alignment across Sampled Traces](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18606v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18606

**作者：** Haotian Liu、Yingjian Chen、Xiaohang Xu、Lang Huang、Yusuke Iwasawa、Yutaka Matsuo、Irene Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18606v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18606v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 DDRG 框架：为采样到的推理轨迹构建基于来源的主张图（claim graph），通过图对齐定位主张级分歧，把局部冲突交给「答案盲」验证器；仅当验证器支持的反驳触及多数答案的支持路径时触发一次聚焦修复，否则原样返回自一致性投票结果。

**相关性简评：** 该工作面向纯文本的轨迹级验证与纠正，而非视觉 latent 状态；但其用图对齐定位主张级分歧、并据此决定「是否值得修复、何时退回原投票」的选择性验证机制，可能为 LVR 中证据筛选与停止/修复决策提供方法线索，需核查其对齐粒度与额外计算成本。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Answer Voting: Fine-Grained Correction of LLM Reasoning through Graph Alignment across Sampled Traces

**abstract/A1：** Large language models increasingly tackle tasks that require multi-step reasoning, where errors in intermediate claims can affect the final answer. Self-consistency (SC) improves reasoning by voting over sampled final answers, but its vote leaves intermediate disagreements unresolved. To address this problem, we introduce DDRG (Disagreement-Driven Verification Guided by Reasoning Graphs), a framework for selective correction from a frozen bank of reasoning traces. Our insight is that graph alignment can expose claim-level disagreements and provide correction evidence without expanding the sampled trace bank. DDRG builds source-grounded claim graphs and sends localized conflicts to an answer-blind verifier. A verifier-supported refutation that reaches the majority answer's supporting path triggers one focused repair; otherwise, DDRG returns the exact SC vote. Experimental results across five benchmarks show that native zero-shot DDRG improves macro-average accuracy over direct answering by 8.65 and 15.83 percentage points for Qwen2.5-7B and Llama3.1-8B. It also exceeds CoT, the evaluated GoT and GoV question-answering adaptations, and SC on this macro metric. DDRG links local verification to selective correction without enlarging the initial candidate bank.

**comment/C1：** 19 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Under review

</details>

### 524. [Recasting DiT for Extreme Image Compression with Hierarchical Visual Priors](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18607v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18607

**作者：** Yunuo Chen、Jingnan Gao、Bing He、Jinjing Zhao、Chuqin Zhou、Xiaoyue Ling、Li Song、Guo Lu、Wenjun Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18607v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18607v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 PrismCodec，将预训练 DiT 改造为以解码表示为条件的一步生成式解码器：用投影后的 codec state 作为生成起始状态，再由同一 latent 导出分层视觉先验提供语义与结构引导，并通过渐进适配（含噪邻域内的条件传输学习、蒸馏为一步映射、端到端中把源扰动退火到零）弥合随机迭代生成与确定性一步解码的差距。

**相关性简评：** 该工作属图像压缩生成解码，不涉及推理；但其把迭代随机生成蒸馏成单步映射、以 latent 状态初始化生成并用分层视觉先验约束细节的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的初始化、少步更新的监督方式与视觉信息保留提供可供核查的训练线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Recasting DiT for Extreme Image Compression with Hierarchical Visual Priors

**abstract/A1：** Pretrained diffusion models provide powerful generative priors for extreme image compression, but their stochastic, iterative generation processes are not designed to decode compressed representations directly. We present PrismCodec, which recasts a pretrained Diffusion Transformer (DiT) as a bitstream-grounded one-step generative decoder. PrismCodec uses the decoded representation in two complementary roles: a projected codec state defines the starting state for generation, while hierarchical visual priors derived from the same decoded latent provide semantic and structural guidance. To bridge the gap between stochastic, iterative generation and deterministic one-step decoding, we develop a progressive adaptation strategy. We first learn codec-conditioned transport from a noisy neighborhood centered on the codec state, distill it into a one-step mapping, and finally anneal the source perturbation to zero during end-to-end optimization. The resulting decoder reconstructs deterministically from the received representation without additional conditioning bits. Across Kodak, CLIC, and DIV2K, PrismCodec consistently improves rate-perception performance over prior generative codecs, achieving BD-rate reductions of 70-75% in LPIPS and 75-81% in DISTS over StableCodec. Code will be released upon acceptance.

</details>

<a id="paper-525"></a>

### 525. [Deterministic Prediction as Global Velocity: Flow Matching for Probabilistic Time-Series Forecast](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18621v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18621

**作者：** Jiajing Hu、Xu Han、Li-Ping Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18621v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18621v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 DV-Flow：把确定性预测器作为并行速度分量融入 flow matching，而非置于传输路径终点，以稳定端到端联合训练、统一若干已有公式，并在六个真实时间序列数据集上提升概率预测表现。

**相关性简评：** 其将确定性预测与生成式传输路径解耦、以并行速度分量联合训练的思路，可能为 LVR 中「直接答案生成」与「latent 推理状态生成」如何协同训练提供可核查的方法线索，但迁移到多模态推理的可行性需人工核实。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Deterministic Prediction as Global Velocity: Flow Matching for Probabilistic Time-Series Forecast

**abstract/A1：** Accurate uncertainty quantification is critical for many time series forecasting applications, and recent studies have increasingly adopted generative models to capture predictive uncertainty. Existing approaches often combine deterministic forecasting with generative modeling to improve predictive performance. However, their joint training is typically unstable because the deterministic model is embedded within the generative process, resulting in deep computational graphs and changing the probability transport path. In this work, we propose DV-Flow, a unified flow-matching formulation that incorporates the deterministic predictor as a parallel velocity component rather than as the endpoint of the transport path. This design enables stable end-to-end optimization while subsuming several existing formulations as special cases, allowing direct comparisons among them. Extensive experiments on six real-world datasets demonstrate that DV-Flow consistently improves probabilistic forecasting performance over strong baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/tufts-ml/dv-flow-time-series.

</details>

### 526. [Geometric Calibration of Supervised Fine-Tuning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18634v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18634

**作者：** Jianzhu Bao、Jia-Chen Gu、Qingyuan Liu、Haozhen Zhang、Kai-Wei Chang、Nanyun Peng、Wenya Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18634v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18634v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文从权重谱几何角度分析监督微调（SFT）沿预训练权重主方向产生稠密更新、可能破坏原有知识，并提出免数据、免训练的后处理方法 SPACE：将落在预训练权重主子空间内的 SFT 更新分量回退、保留正交补分量，在多个模型与领域上缓解 OOD 能力退化并提升 ID 表现。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本权重几何与参数更新工作，不涉及视觉或 latent 推理；其「按主子空间选择性回退微调更新」的思路或可供核查——在 LVR 训练中是否可用来减轻推理训练对视觉先验的扰动，但迁移性属推测，需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Geometric Calibration of Supervised Fine-Tuning

**abstract/A1：** Recent studies investigate the weight geometry through its spectral structure, which characterizes how the weights transform different input directions. Within this view, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is shown to induce dense updates that perturb the spectral geometry of pre-SFT weights along their principal directions, potentially disrupting the model's prior knowledge. These observations motivate using the geometry of pre-SFT weights as a reference for refining learned SFT updates. We study this perspective as Geometric Calibration and develop SPACE Subspace Projection for Adapted Checkpoint Enhancement), a lightweight post-hoc method that selectively reverts SFT update components within the principal subspace of the pre-SFT weights while preserving those in its orthogonal complement. SPACE is a data-free, training-free method that requires only the pre- and post-SFT checkpoints. We evaluate SPACE on Qwen2.5, Qwen3, Qwen3.5, Llama-3.1, and Olmo-3 models ranging from 2B to 14B, across mathematical, coding, and medical SFT, as well as several SFT variants. Overall, SPACE mitigates out-of-domain (OOD) capability regression while further improving in-domain (ID) performance over the uncalibrated SFT checkpoints. For math SFT, SPACE yields average ID/OOD gains of 2.85/2.26 points on Qwen2.5-7B, and 2.41/1.52 points on Qwen3-14B-Base, respectively. These results highlight how the geometric relationship between SFT updates and pre-SFT weights shapes the adapted model's capabilities and, more broadly, motivate geometry-aware parameter updates for continual model improvement.

</details>

### 527. [To Align or Not To Align: Check Your COMPASS Before You Train](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18638v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18638

**作者：** Fabian Gröger、Petar Damjanović、Maria Brbić

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18638v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18638v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 COMPASS，一种在跨模态对齐或模型合并之前估计模型对兼容性的诊断指标：用两个编码器间的 k-NN 重叠刻画「配对的易对齐程度」，并用训练范式允许的最大重叠刻画「范式上限」，据此对候选模型对排序并给出是否追加算力的建议，在 72 组跨模态对齐与 392 次模型合并实验中显示与下游成功度的强相关。

**相关性简评：** 其「局部邻域重叠衡量表示收敛」的思路，可能可借用作廉价诊断，检查视觉编码器特征是否保留局部结构、进而判断 latent 状态中视觉证据是否坍缩或走视觉旁路；但该工作面向训练期对齐/合并的配对选择，与推理期 latent 生成与使用仍有距离，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** To Align or Not To Align: Check Your COMPASS Before You Train

**abstract/A1：** Combining pretrained models is a common strategy for building AI systems, whether by aligning a vision encoder with a language model or merging fine-tuned checkpoints. However, finding compatible pairs typically requires costly empirical search, as compatibility is known only after alignment or merging. We propose COMPASS (COMPatibility ASsessment Score), a theoretically motivated diagnostic that estimates whether a model pair will be compatible prior to alignment or merging. Building on the observation that representational convergence is most robust at the level of local neighborhoods, COMPASS decomposes model compatibility into two cheap-to-compute axes: a pair-specific ease, defined as the $k$-NN overlap between the two encoders, and a paradigm-level ceiling, capturing the maximum overlap their training paradigms allow. Together, these two axes provide a ranking of candidate model pairs and prescribe how to act on each pair: (i) prioritize pairs that already agree and whose paradigms are compatible, (ii) invest additional compute on pairs with compatible paradigms but low initial agreement, (iii) switch the pretraining paradigm when it cannot support sufficient agreement, or (iv) deprioritize pairs that score poorly on both axes. We apply COMPASS to $72$ cross-modal alignment experiments and $392$ task-arithmetic model merges and show that compatibility estimates by COMPASS strongly correlate with downstream success, achieving average Pearson correlation of $0.91$ on cross-modal alignment tasks and $0.70$ on model merging.

**comment/C1：** NeurIPS 2026 camera-ready

</details>

### 528. [MultiAlloc: Budget-Aware Precision Allocation for KV Cache Quantization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18642v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18642

**作者：** Yangchengyu Zhou、Zhiping Wu、Runchang Jiang、Dongdong Ren、Youfang Han、Wei Zhao、Dongqi Cai、Wenbin Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18642v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18642v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 MultiAlloc，一个由轻量离线 profiling 驱动的 KV cache 量化框架，在固定显存预算下自适应地在「层级精度提升」与「token 级信息保留」两类策略之间分配量化资源，并直接落成推理期策略，无需在线搜索。

**相关性简评：** 其按 token 重要性保留信息、并按层敏感度分配有限精度预算的思路，可能为 LVR 中「在显存/计算预算下保留关键视觉证据于内部状态」提供可核查的分配与筛选线索；但该工作仅面向纯文本 LLM 的长上下文推理，能否迁移到多模态 latent 状态尚需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MultiAlloc: Budget-Aware Precision Allocation for KV Cache Quantization

**abstract/A1：** The Key-Value (KV) cache constitutes a dominant source of memory consumption during large language model (LLM) inference, particularly in long-context and complex reasoning scenarios. Existing KV cache quantization methods have explored different compression granularities, including layer-wise precision adjustment and token-level information preservation. In practical deployment, however, the key challenge is not merely compression, but how to allocate limited quantization resources among heterogeneous precision preservation strategies under a fixed KV cache memory budget. We propose MultiAlloc, a profiling-guided precision allocation framework for KV cache quantization that adaptively distributes limited quantization resources between layer-wise precision enhancement and token-wise preservation. MultiAlloc employs lightweight offline profiling to characterize layer sensitivity and token importance, enabling adaptive precision allocation under a fixed memory constraint. Guided by the profiled memory--accuracy trade-off, it automatically derives an effective precision allocation strategy without online allocation search, and applies the resulting policy during inference. Extensive experiments on reasoning and long-context benchmarks demonstrate that MultiAlloc consistently improves over layer-wise, token-wise, and recent multi-granularity KV cache quantization methods under matched memory budgets across diverse models, including Mistral, Llama, DeepSeek-Qwen, and QwQ.

**comment/C1：** Code: https://github.com/RL-MIND/MultiAlloc

</details>
