### 529. [ST-GRU PredRNN-V2: A GRU-Based Reformulation of PredRNN-V2 for Video Prediction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18645v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18645

**作者：** Augusta van Haren、Hanna Hoogen、Luca Pattavina、Quincy Rommen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18645v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18645v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ST-GRU：用 GRU 式的更新门与重置门替代 ST-LSTM 的复杂门控，并把时间记忆状态并入隐状态，参数减少约 5%，再嵌入 PredRNN-V2 在 Moving MNIST 上按原协议评测，效果基本持平或略逊于原 ST-LSTM 版本。

**相关性简评：** 其循环单元的状态更新与「双记忆合一」设计，或可为 LVR 中 latent 状态更新、长期信息保持与参数开销权衡提供可核查的结构线索，但该工作仅针对像素级视频预测，与多模态推理的联系尚需核实。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ST-GRU PredRNN-V2: A GRU-Based Reformulation of PredRNN-V2 for Video Prediction

**abstract/A1：** Video prediction requires models to capture complex spatiotemporal dependencies and to retain relevant information over long sequences. PredRNN and its successor PredRNN-V2 address this challenge with spatiotemporal Long Short-Term Memory (ST-LSTM) units that maintain two separate memory states, at the cost of a relatively complex recurrent building block. In this work, we investigate whether the simpler gating of Gated Recurrent Units (GRUs) can be transferred to spatiotemporal predictive learning. To this end, we develop a spatiotemporal GRU (ST-GRU) unit as a GRU-based alternative to the ST-LSTM. The ST-GRU replaces the ST-LSTM's three gates per memory state with two GRU-style gates (update and reset), and merges the temporal memory state into the hidden state, which reduces the number of parameters by about 5%. We incorporate the ST-GRU into PredRNN-V2 and evaluate the resulting model on the Moving MNIST video prediction benchmark, following the original experimental protocol. Averaged over ten predicted frames, the ST-GRU-based PredRNN-V2 achieves an MSE of 55.1, an SSIM of 0.883, an LPIPS of 0.065 and a PSNR of 19.53dB. It does not surpass the original ST-LSTM-based PredRNN-V2 on MSE, SSIM or PSNR, but it achieves a lower LPIPS and performs on par with the earlier ST-LSTM-based PredRNN, while using a simpler recurrent cell. These results suggest that ST-GRUs are a promising building block for spatiotemporal predictive learning and motivate further work on their design and integration.

</details>

### 530. [Does Pretraining Teach Chemical Language Models Chemistry?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18651v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18651

**作者：** Leif Sieben、Yoel Zimmermann

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL、physics.chem-ph

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在 64 个分子性质预测数据集上系统检验化学语言模型预训练的收益：下游提升不随预训练规模扩展、性能饱和且低于梯度提升基线，仅基于传统理化描述符的监督预训练带来稳定改善，模型解析分子结构的能力也不优于随机初始化编码器。

**相关性简评：** 其「预训练模型 vs 随机初始化编码器 + 经典特征基线」的受控诊断范式，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态是否真编码视觉证据而非仅保留低层 token 统计，属方法线索而非直接主线研究。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Does Pretraining Teach Chemical Language Models Chemistry?

**abstract/A1：** Chemical language models (CLMs) are pretrained on large corpora of molecules with the aim of learning representations that transfer to diverse downstream tasks. Here, we systematically study the effects of pretraining using a series of such CLMs across 64 molecular property prediction datasets. We find that the downstream gains of pretraining in CLMs do not scale and performance saturates below gradient-boosting baselines. Across the regimes evaluated, only supervised pretraining on traditional physico-chemical descriptors consistently improves downstream performance for the CLMs tested whereas some forms of pretraining result in models worse than a randomly initialized encoder. While models can resolve molecular structure well, they do so no better than a randomly initialized model, suggesting that, at best, CLMs learn descriptor-like properties in addition to low-level token statistics during pretraining, but surprisingly little chemistry beyond what classical molecular features already capture.

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.IR

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 KSA V2，针对 summary-token 与 full attention 交替的混合架构，允许各层使用不同的摘要压缩窗口以实现更灵活的 KV cache 压缩，并让 summary token 兼作 KV 记忆与稀疏索引器，以降低 full attention 层的预填充计算。

**相关性简评：** 其「按层可变压缩窗口」与 summary token 兼具记忆和稀疏索引两种角色的设计，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态在跨深度缓存、内容压缩与视觉证据筛选方面的线索提供可核查参考，但该工作面向纯文本效率，未涉及多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Kwai Summary Attention V2 Technical Report

**abstract/A1：** Summary-token architectures such as Kwai Summary Attention (KSA) compress distant context into learnable Summary token per chunk, and hybrid variants interleave these layers with full attention to retain exact access to the original text. In such hybrid KSA-Full architecture, the interleaving inserted summary tokens are served as a streaming flow role across different layers. Although effective, however, it also introduce some bottlenecks: (1) the different layers summary compression chunk must be same, therefore hard to reach a flexible KV Cache compression, e.g., different layer set different summary compression chunk window. (2) in the full-attention layers, the summary token introduced additional computation cost, but such layer ignore them and still pay quadratic prefilling, therefore unfriendly to the computation side. Motivated by them, we developed the KSA V2, which not only achieves a more flexible KV cache memory compression but also reduces the computation cost in Full attention layer. Specifically, we found that the summary tokens can serve two roles: the KV memory and sparse indexer.

**comment/C1：** Work in progress

### 532. [Model-Based Online Decision Making via Generative Trajectory Planning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18677v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18677

**作者：** Haldun Balim、Yilun Du、Na Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.RO、eess.SY

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18677v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18677v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出基于模型的规划框架 GTP：不直接优化动作序列，而是把扩散生成模型学成动作序列上的提议分布，再用学到的动力学、奖励与价值模型对采样候选做精化，在连续控制与长时程操作任务上取得与主流方法相当或更好的表现。

**相关性简评：** 其「生成式提议分布 + 模型精化」的候选轨迹采样—验证流程，可能为 LVR 中候选 latent 推理状态的生成、筛选与迭代更新（以及生成结果是否真被使用）提供方法线索，但迁移到视觉多模态推理的可行性尚待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Model-Based Online Decision Making via Generative Trajectory Planning

**abstract/A1：** Online decision-making faces a tension between efficient inference and long-horizon reasoning. Value-based methods rely on short-horizon bootstrapping that limits the propagation of long-term information, while trajectory optimization methods plan explicitly but must solve a high-dimensional optimization problem at every decision step. We propose Generative Trajectory Planning (GTP), a model-based framework that addresses this tension by learning a generative model as a proposal distribution over action sequences. Instead of optimizing sequences from scratch, GTP samples candidate sequences from a diffusion prior and refines them using learned dynamics, reward, and value models, enabling efficient trajectory-level reasoning. Across continuous control and long-horizon manipulation tasks, GTP matches or exceeds state-of-the-art model-free, diffusion-policy, and model-based baselines, and remains stable in regimes where strong baselines degrade. Our results suggest that generative models are best understood not as policies, but as structured proposal distributions for planning, offering a new perspective on how to integrate generative modeling with model-based decision-making.

</details>

### 533. [ProAS: A Progress-Aware Advantage Shaping Framework for Multi-Turn Agentic Reinforcement Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18683v1>)

**作者：** Bowen Ding、Mingda Wan、Yuhan Chen、Jiyao Yuan、Qi Zhu、Futing Wang、Heyuan Deng、Fei Mi、Lifeng Shang、Tao Lin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18683v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18683v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对多轮 LLM agent 强化学习中 GRPO 等无 critic 算法将轨迹级优势平均广播给所有动作的问题，提出 ProAS：用动态演化的 Agentic Reference Graph 做细粒度信用分配，通过掩蔽不合理激励与非对称惩罚再分配，在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上提升成功率和收敛速度。

**相关性简评：** 该方法关于步骤级信用分配与「早期关键偏差的下游级联影响」的处理，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理步的贡献分配与监督信号设计提供可核查的线索，但论文面向纯文本 agent、不涉及视觉或 latent 状态，迁移需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ProAS: A Progress-Aware Advantage Shaping Framework for Multi-Turn Agentic Reinforcement Learning

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as the primary paradigm for optimizing Large Language Model (LLM) agents, yet efficient critic-free algorithms (e.g., GRPO) suffer from a fundamental uniform credit assignment dilemma that broadcasts trajectory-level advantages equally to all actions. Our analysis reveals that this uniformity inherently reinforces structurally invalid actions in preferred trajectories and ignores the downstream cascading influence of early pivotal deviations in unpreferred ones. To resolve this without introducing critic overhead, we propose Progress-Aware Advantage Shaping (ProAS), a plug-and-play framework that leverages a dynamically evolving Agentic Reference Graph (ARG) to achieve fine-grained credit assignment via Masking Unreasonable Incentives (MUI) and Asymmetric Penalty Redistribution (APR). Extensive experiments across Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct demonstrate that ProAS universally elevates mainstream group-based baselines to new state-of-the-art performance, achieving peak success rates of 91.9\\% and 94.3\\% on ALFWorld, alongside 66.7\\% and 70.8\\% on WebShop, respectively. Furthermore, it accelerates training convergence by up to $2.44\\times$ while maintaining strong robustness against imperfect or distilled ARGs. Codes: https://github.com/LINs-lab/ProAS.

</details>

**作者：** Yidi Liu、Haozhe Wang、Jie Xiao、Kai Zhu、Xueyang Fu、Zheng-Jun Zha

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18688v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18688v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 RSIgen，一个任务中心的互惠自改进框架：用匹配干预的 Dynamic Responsibility Routing 决定统一多模态骨干中理解（agent）与生成两种角色谁该学习，并在生成器更新后固定分支输入重评动作效用以刷新 agent 监督，再据此递归构建课程。

**相关性简评：** 其「责任分配 + 监督刷新」线索可能与 LVR 中轨迹训练的贡献分配、更新后陈旧监督问题相关，可供核查；但论文面向 agentic 视觉生成而非 VLM 推理，迁移到 latent 推理状态是否成立尚需核实。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RSIgen: Reciprocal Self-Improvement for Agentic Visual Generation

**abstract/A1：** Agentic visual generation produces experience that can improve the native understanding (agent) and generation roles of a unified multimodal backbone, but task success alone does not determine which role should learn. Generator updates can also make the agent's action supervision stale. We introduce RSIgen, a task-centric reciprocal self-improvement framework linking learning allocation, supervision refresh, and recursive curriculum construction. Dynamic Responsibility Routing (DRR) uses matched interventions on evidence, inputs, and supported actions to select learning recipients and construct compatible training targets. After generator learning, RSIgen re-evaluates the relative utility of tested actions with branch inputs held fixed to refresh agent supervision; the retained roles then construct the next curriculum. Across BAGEL, Qwen-Image, and Wan-Image-7B, RSIgen improves AgentGen-Bench Full Overall9 by 3.2--3.3 points over a three-cycle SearchGen adaptation with action costs. Wan controls support allocation gains at matched role-level training exposure, refresh gains at a matched adaptation budget, and benefits from updated curriculum sources while recipients continue learning. In blind evaluation on 200 real-user requests, pooled tie-adjusted preference scores against the same baseline reach 70.0% for task completion and 64.9% for visual quality.

</details>

### 535. [Learning Source Structure: Bayesian Prediction with Transformers](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18725v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18725

**作者：** Meir Feder、Ruediger Urbanke

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18725v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18725v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把 transformer 训练视为对源族与先验的贝叶斯学习，用「informed Bayes」作为可定量证伪的参照，在含隐藏编码、共享转移行和混合族的 Markov 源上预测并验证模型的四种行为。

**相关性简评：** 其将注意力刻画为充分统计量的选择与累积、前馈网络学得由先验固定的估计量，并分析复制起始深度与有限记忆泛化边界，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态如何生成与行为可否预测提供核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning Source Structure: Bayesian Prediction with Transformers

**abstract/A1：** A transformer trained on sequences whose source parameters are drawn afresh each time can learn only what the sequences share: the source family and its prior. The Bayesian predictor that knows both, which we call informed Bayes, is the unique minimizer of the training loss and is computable from the family alone; we use it as a quantitative, falsifiable reference. Where earlier work compared transformers with Bayes on sources whose contexts can be learned independently, we build Markov sources with up to 64 symbols in which observations in one context inform prediction in another: product sources with known or hidden encodings, transition rows sharing an unknown base law and depth, and a mixture of three families. Our main result is that informed Bayes predicts, from the family and prior alone, how a trained transformer behaves in four tests that go beyond the learning curve: the loss that remains under a source outside the training family (predicted 2.237 bits, measured 2.309), the doubling of the extra loss when two independent components change rather than one (0.345 predicted, 0.350 measured), the benefit of other contexts when a token appears for the first time, and the depth at which copying an earlier continuation starts to pay. On the learning curves themselves, small transformers match informed Bayes when the shared structure is visible in the tokens, and hidden structure needs more layers and training, with gaps below 0.01 bits per token for the largest models. We explain why the imitation is possible and where it must fail: informed Bayes decomposes into sufficient statistics that attention selects and accumulates and an estimator, fixed by the prior, that the feed-forward network learns; training pays the complexity of informed Bayes under the architecture's prior, and finite-memory universal prediction bounds how closely a bounded network can reach it.

**comment/C1：** 45 pages, 12 figures. 9 pages of main text. Code at https://github.com/urbanke/learning-source-structure

</details>

### 536. [SP$^2$ec: Adaptive Self-Speculative Decoding for Vision-Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18735v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18735

**作者：** Yuqi Huang、Xingyao Li、Yunlong Hou、Fengzhuo Zhang、Jiachun Pan、Vincent Y. F. Tan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18735v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18735v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出免训练的 bandit 算法 SP²ec，在生成过程中自适应选择自推测解码的 draft 配置，利用已有自推测方法的单峰吞吐模式，以最小化 wall-time regret 为目标，在 Qwen2.5-VL 与 LLaVA-NeXT 上比原始方法最高提升约 11% 吞吐。

**相关性简评：** 该文不涉及 latent 推理状态或视觉证据使用，与 LVR 主线无直接关系；但其用 bandit 在线选择计算配置、以实际 wall-time 为目标并给出 regret 保证的思路，可能为 LVR 中动态计算预算分配与停止决策的成本建模提供可核查的借鉴线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SP$^2$ec: Adaptive Self-Speculative Decoding for Vision-Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Speculative Decoding (SD) has demonstrated its efficacy in accelerating large language model inference, but for Vision-Language Models (VLMs), the diverse input modalities make it difficult for a small trained drafter to achieve consistently high throughput. Self-speculative decoding reuses parts of the target model as a drafter which retains the multi-modal capability of the VLMs, yet its efficiency depends on choosing a suitable draft configuration for each prompt. We propose Single-Peak SPeculative decoding (SP$^2$ec), a training-free bandit algorithm that adapts the draft configuration during generation. SP$^2$ec exploits the single-peak throughput pattern observed in existing self-speculative methods, including SWIFT, KnapSpec, SpecVLM, and our simple cosSim. Our algorithmic design explicitly minimizes a novel notion of wall-time regret for each given query, corresponding to the empirical wall-time latency. Theoretical guarantees on the wall-time regret show that SP$^2$ec can exploit the optimal draft configuration, with negligible exploration cost. Extensive experiments on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct and LLaVA-NeXT-Mistral-7B across visual and textual tasks show consistent improvements of up to 11\\% over the original self-speculative methods, demonstrating the wide applicability of the proposed SP$^2$ec algorithm.

</details>

### 537. [Enabling Token-wise Importance Sampling in Off-Policy RLVR with Proximal KL Regularization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18738v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18738

**作者：** Hao Bai、Jiarui Yao、Tong Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18738v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18738v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文研究 off-policy RLVR 中 token 级重要性采样带来的梯度偏差问题，证明在覆盖与局部表达能力条件下「完整未来 KL credit」使 proximal 优化器有唯一平稳策略，并提出用有界未来 KL 替代 PPO 裁剪的 Proximal KL 方法，在 Qwen3 系列八个数学基准上优于 GRPO。

**相关性简评：** 其 token 级（而非整条响应）信用分配与有界未来 KL 约束，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理步骤的贡献分配与轨迹训练监督提供可核查的训练线索，但不涉及视觉状态或 latent 表示，需人工判断迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Enabling Token-wise Importance Sampling in Off-Policy RLVR with Proximal KL Regularization

**abstract/A1：** Off-policy data in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) can arise from asynchronous generation, rollout-training mismatch, and response reuse. Token-wise importance weighting avoids multiplying likelihood ratios across a response but generally biases policy gradients. We prove that, under coverage and local expressiveness conditions, full future KL credit makes the exact proximal optimizer the update's unique stationary policy, even for mixtures of older policies, without full-response weights or a fitted critic. We further establish convergence of continuous-time tabular population updates under persistent coverage and time-varying behavior policies, and a finite-sample reward guarantee for linear logistic models under additional assumptions. These results motivate Proximal KL, a practical off-policy RLVR method that separates the proximal reference from the sampling policy and replaces PPO clipping with bounded future KL credit. Across all seven matched off-policy comparisons on Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-4B, spanning two learning rates, response reuse, and rollout staleness, Proximal KL outperforms GRPO in micro-averaged accuracy over eight math benchmarks by up to 2.58%. A separate on-policy comparison yields comparable aggregate accuracy. In periodic-refresh experiments, Proximal KL avoids the collapses observed in PG and CISPO, exceeds GRPO's training accuracy, and reaches higher accuracy in fewer policy updates. Ablations show that token-wise correction outperforms sequence-level and unweighted controls. With token-wise correction retained, future KL feedback reduces sensitivity to the tested baseline perturbation relative to PPO clipping. A finite future horizon improves AIME24 mean@16 and pass@16 over the full tail, while fixed-policy measurements show that truncation reduces correction variance over the tested horizons.

</details>

### 538. [Beyond the Verdict: Agentic Code Judging with Verifiable Feedback](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18760v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18760

**作者：** Zheye Deng、Sha Li、Changlong Yu、Xin Liu、Qin Lu、Priyanka Nigam、Yangqiu Song

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18760v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18760v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出只用题面与源码判定并诊断候选程序的 agentic 验证任务，构建 USACO-JUDGE 基准，并用强化学习在通用执行沙箱中训练 35B MoE 验证器 ARBITER，以生成反例作为可核查证据，提升判定准确率并用于候选代码的选择与改进。

**相关性简评：** 以「生成反例作为可核查证据」驱动候选选择与修订，与 LVR 中为 latent 候选做证据获取、验证及停止/选择决策存在方法上的可比线索，可供核查；但该工作是代码文本验证，未涉及视觉状态或多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond the Verdict: Agentic Code Judging with Verifiable Feedback

**abstract/A1：** Test-time scaling for large language models (LLMs) can involve generating multiple candidate solutions for selection or revising an earlier attempt. To guide selection and revision, we need a verifier that can estimate candidate correctness and provide evidence of failure. In competitive programming, however, official judging systems provide authoritative verdicts under finite submission budgets, without revealing failure explanations or failing inputs. To provide informative feedback without consuming official submissions, we formulate a task in which a model judges and diagnoses a candidate program using only the problem statement and source code, with generated counterexamples serving as checkable evidence. To evaluate this task, we build USACO-JUDGE from the USACO 2026 contests, using accepted and unaccepted programs written by human experts and multiple LLMs. We then train ARBITER, a 35B mixture-of-experts (MoE) agentic verifier, with reinforcement learning in a generic execution sandbox. Training raises counterexample success on incorrect programs from 40.61% to 62.67% and mean binary verdict accuracy on USACO-JUDGE from 71.41% to 87.41%, approaching frontier verification performance. Beyond verification, ARBITER outperforms baselines in both code selection and refinement. In an IOI 2026 case study, ARBITER-guided refinement raises GPT-OSS-120B's expected score above the gold-medal threshold under the official submission limit.

**comment/C1：** 28 pages

</details>

### 539. [LayerCanvas: Infographic Generation in AI Learning Assistants via Hybrid Layer-Set Diffusion](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18763v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18763

**作者：** Keshav Gupta、Jeremy Owen、Christopher Lloyd、Shaunak Mishra、Manav Sharma

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18763v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18763v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 LayerCanvas，用于 AI 学习助手的信息图生成：保留 SVG 作为承载语义、结构与排版的可编辑程序，只用扩散模型美化非文字内容，并将 SVG 元素划分为 z 序的不重叠元素集合，由多路相互通信的并行 RGB 生成流分别处理，最后确定性重组图层。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接关联，但作者对「把内容与布局压平成单张图会丢失元素归属与遮挡关系」的分析，以及 z 序元素集合加通信并行生成流的做法，可能为 parallel latent 状态生成与信息坍缩问题提供可核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LayerCanvas: Infographic Generation in AI Learning Assistants via Hybrid Layer-Set Diffusion

**abstract/A1：** Online learning platforms are increasingly deploying AI assistants to provide personalized, on-demand tutoring. These can leverage infographics to communicate complex information and improve the learning experience. However, automating effective infographic generation remains a challenging task, requiring a combination of visual richness with precise typography, structured layouts, and continued editability. Existing representation methods satisfy these goals only in part: Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) representations preserve geometry, hierarchy, and text but provide limited aesthetic flexibility, while raster diffusion models produce richer appearances by flattening content and layout into a single image. Conditioning a diffusion model on a rasterized SVG does not resolve this conflict because the raster preserves approximate placement but discards element ownership, occlusion relationships, and the structure needed to modify and recompose the result. We introduce LayerCanvas, a hybrid approach that retains SVG as the semantic, structural, and typographic program while using diffusion to aestheticize non-text content. Rather than generating one flattened raster, LayerCanvas partitions SVG elements into z-ordered sets of mutually non-overlapping elements and processes them through communicating parallel RGB generation streams. The resulting layers are independently editable and deterministically recomposed, while text is rendered from preserved vector metadata. Our approach combines rich visual synthesis with accurate typography and localized editing. LayerCanvas substantially improves text fidelity over state-of-the-art raster image generators while achieving the highest overall aesthetic quality. We further demonstrate non-destructive content editing, localization, asset reuse, and animation.

</details>

### 540. [GAD: Geometry Attention Distillation for Consistent Video Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18779v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18779

**作者：** Junfeng Ni、Ziyu Zhu、Fan Jiang、Yu Liu、Chiyu Wang、Jiawei Zhang、Zhaoxu Sun、Mu Xu、Siyuan Huang、Yixin Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18779v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18779v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文先诊断视频扩散模型的注意力难以在跨帧间建立可靠对应（响应分散于多区域），再提出 Geometry Attention Distillation：把冻结几何模型的跨帧对应关系蒸馏进视频注意力，并按噪声时间步选择学生层，从而提升长程场景与动态一致性且不增加推理模块。

**相关性简评：** 其「结构形成随噪声时间步发生在不同深度层、据此选择蒸馏层」的线索，可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据/实体对应关系在哪些层与推理阶段被保留，以及能否以注意力对应作为内部状态的监督信号。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GAD: Geometry Attention Distillation for Consistent Video Generation

**abstract/A1：** Video diffusion models generate visually compelling short-term sequences but often struggle to preserve scene geometry and object structure over time. In this paper, we first demonstrate that current video attention cannot identify reliable correspondences across frames, with responses dispersed across multiple regions even after recognizable scene structure has emerged. We argue that reliable cross-frame associations are essential for information exchange as scene structure forms in video generation. Thus, we introduce Geometry Attention Distillation (GAD), which transfers correspondences from a frozen geometry model's attention to video attention. Extracted from clean videos, these correspondences link the same static surface or moving object across frames. Since structure formation begins in deeper layers at higher noise and shallower layers at lower noise, we apply attention distillation at a student layer selected according to the noise timestep. After training, video attention focuses more consistently on corresponding locations. Experiments across all three video backbones demonstrate improved long-range scene consistency and dynamic temporal consistency, with geometric gains across generation lengths. On Wan2.2 5B, GAD improves cross-frame matching accuracy by at least 30% over the Wan baseline on both long-range benchmarks. Notably, GAD achieves these gains without additional inference modules, offering a promising approach to efficient and consistent video-based world simulation. Project page: https://fantasy-amap.github.io/GAD/.

**comment/C1：** Project page: https://fantasy-amap.github.io/GAD/

</details>

### 541. [SkillScaffold: Scaffolding Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Policy-Adaptive Skill Credit Assignment and Selective Injection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18807v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18807

**作者：** Wenlin Zhong、Hao Wang、Kun Yuan、Fan Yang、Jinluan Yang、Dian Jin、Xu Tan、Yiquan Wu、Kun Kuang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18807v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18807v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SkillScaffold：一种策略自适应的 agentic RL 训练脚手架，复用已验证的交互轨迹低成本估计候选技能的效用，据此决定是否注入、注入哪个文本技能，并在无候选有用时保留无技能执行；同时联合训练技能生成器与执行器，推动技能内化到无技能推理。

**相关性简评：** 其「效用驱动的选择性注入与弃用」与 LVR 中是否触发额外计算（THINK/LOOK/STOP）及 latent 内容的贡献分配相近，技能内化到无技能推理也可能为「训练时使用 latent、推理时去除」提供可供核查的线索；但论文面向纯文本 agent、无视觉状态，仅属方法层面借鉴。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SkillScaffold: Scaffolding Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Policy-Adaptive Skill Credit Assignment and Selective Injection

**abstract/A1：** Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) enables large language models (LLMs) to learn from multi-turn interactions with verifiable outcomes. Textual skills can improve exploration by distilling prior interactions into reusable guidance. However, existing skill-based RL approaches often either assume skill injection is beneficial or rely on indirect feedback or rollout-intensive evaluation to assess its utility. Our pilot studies show that rollout-based utility estimation for skill credit assignment is costly and unstable under limited sampling, while skill benefits vary across candidates and depend on the current policy's competence on each query. To address these challenges, we introduce SkillScaffold, a policy-adaptive training scaffold that combines low-cost skill-utility estimation with selective skill injection. By reusing outcome-verified training trajectories, SkillScaffold generates candidate skills and estimates their utility through outcome-aware likelihood comparisons, without candidate-specific environment rollouts. The resulting utility guides whether and which skill to inject, retaining skill-free execution when no candidate is estimated to help. Joint training enables the Generator to produce skills tailored to the evolving Executor. Scaffolded RL encourages skill internalization for skill-free inference. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, ScienceWorld, and $τ^2$-Bench demonstrate gains over strong agentic-RL and skill-based RL baselines across both short- and long-horizon tasks. Ablations and further analyses support the importance of utility-based selection and abstention. Our code is available at https://github.com/Vaidurya00/SkillScaffold.

</details>

### 542. [Depth Memory](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18809v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18809

**作者：** David González-Martínez、Philipp Nazari、T. Konstantin Rusch、Shiwei Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18809v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18809v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把 Transformer 的跨深度表示混合视为「跨层存储与检索」，用一个统一框架刻画 PreLN、mHC 与 AttnRes 中的表示流，并提出以递归最小二乘求解深度检索的 Linear Depth Memory（LDM）及配套硬件感知实现，在 400M/1.5B 语言建模上取得更低困惑度。

**相关性简评：** 纯文本语言建模工作，但其「记忆流被查询以丰富每层输入、输出再写回」的视角，以及 AttnRes 对逐层表示缓存的注意力式聚合，可能为 LVR 的推理状态更新、深度与缓存对 latent 相似度的影响提供可供核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Depth Memory

**abstract/A1：** Residual connections propagate information through a network by additively accumulating layer outputs. Recently proposed alternatives, such as Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) and Attention Residuals (AttnRes), instead use more expressive depth aggregation mechanisms that improve language modeling performance at scale. In this work, we consider the mixing of representations over depth as a problem of storing and retrieving information across layers. Formalizing this perspective, we introduce Depth Memory (DM), a unified framework that describes the standard pre-layer-norm (PreLN) transformer, mHC, and AttnRes in terms of streams that carry representations through the network. One such stream, for example, could be an explicit memory stream that is queried to enrich the input to every layer, and whose output is subsequently written back into the memory for use by later layers. For AttnRes, this memory stream is a growing cache of explicit layer representations. For mHC, it is an expanded residual stream. Building on this view, we propose Linear Depth Memory (LDM), which formulates information retrieval across depth as a regression problem solved using recursive least squares. The resulting architecture propagates three streams across depth: the standard residual stream, a linear associative memory stream, and an inverse covariance stream. For high-throughput training and inference, we propose a hardware-aware implementation of LDM that reduces peak activation memory and memory traffic. LDM consistently achieves the lowest perplexities among PreLN, mHC and AttnRes baselines at the 400M and 1.5B parameter scales, alongside competitive zero-shot accuracy.

</details>

### 543. [DuplexBridge: Coordinating Understanding and Generation for Unified Image Editing](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18819v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18819

**作者：** Yidi Liu、Jie Xiao、Chaojie Mao、Jingfeng Zhang、Xueyang Fu

**相关性简评：** 其「理解与生成各自局部监督 + 门控选择性接收全局反馈」的拆分与贡献分配思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态生成与答案使用之间的监督归因、以及何种全局反馈可以注入内部状态提供可核查线索；但研究对象是图像编辑，需确认是否真有可迁移机制。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DuplexBridge: Coordinating Understanding and Generation for Unified Image Editing

**abstract/A1：** Complex image editing requires faithful task interpretation and accurate execution, but a failed edit does not reveal which responsibility failed. We present DuplexBridge, which uses a unified model's own understanding capability to enhance prompts for its own generation capability, without an external understanding module. A source-grounded bridge specifies targets, final-state changes, and preservation constraints. Understanding is supervised on fidelity to the original request without observing the generated image; generation is supervised on execution of the condition it actually receives. Reciprocal trust checks selectively admit global task feedback to each role while retaining independently valid local supervision. We introduce CE-Bench, a 1,200-task benchmark measuring joint satisfaction of task-derived change and preservation requirements. Across three model configurations, the full system improves complete compliance over direct editors by 21.75-25.75 percentage points, with gains also observed on KRIS-Bench, RISEBench, ImgEdit, and GEdit-Bench. From a common supervised Wan-Image initialization, gated joint training reaches 77.08% complete compliance, compared with 70.92% without gates and 75.00% when generation-local supervision instead checks the original task with both gates retained. These results support distinct local responsibilities and selective shared feedback for joint understanding-generation adaptation.

</details>

### 544. [Read the Room Before Your Model Generates](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18820v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18820

**作者：** Muyao Kong、Zhihao Lin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18820v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18820v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Scenario-Actor 温度选择框架：从 Transformer 隐状态中抽取情境相关结构，构造几何化的 scenario embedding，据此自适应地确定解码温度，并在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 的交互社交、开放式指令跟随与多轮对话任务上验证。

**相关性简评：** 其「从隐状态读出结构化表示并据此调节生成」的做法，可能与 LVR 中依据内部 latent 状态动态控制解码或推理步长的思路相通，可供核查；但该工作为纯文本、不涉及视觉证据筛选，联系较弱。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Read the Room Before Your Model Generates

**abstract/A1：** Large language models (LLMs) generally rely on sampling temperature to regulate the amount of randomness in their outputs. Mainstream methods for selecting temperature typically involve fixed, heuristic global settings and context or token-level calibration, rather than a geometrically interpretable representation of the communicative scenario. In this work, we introduce a simple and interpretable temperature selection framework, the \\textbf{Scenario-Actor}, which adapts decoding to the inferred situational characteristics. Scenario-Actor extracts scenario-relevant structures from Transformer hidden states and determines the temperature from scenario embedding, a structured geometric representation of the communicative setting. Empirical results show that on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Scenario-Actor achieves strong goal-completion performance in interactive social scenarios, significant gains on open-ended instruction following, and competitive performance on multi-turn conversation compared to multiple baselines.

**comment/C1：** 17 pages, 7 figure, AACL-IJCNLP 2026 Main Conference

</details>

### 545. [Fast Rates for Offline Q-Learning with KL Regularization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18839v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18839

**作者：** Yize Hao、Guangxin Jiang、Shuang Qiu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18839v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18839v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究有限时域 MDP 的离线 Q-learning：先提出 KL 正则化 Q-learning（KLQ），证明无需显式悲观即可达到 Õ(1/ε) 样本复杂度；再提出加入悲观性的 KLPQ，在保留该速率的同时消除对 KL 参数与时域的指数依赖。

**相关性简评：** 该文属离线强化学习理论，与视觉推理无直接关联；其「KL 正则化使增量式随机逼近更新获得快速率」的分析，可能为 LVR 中循环状态更新的稳定性、轨迹训练正则化与样本效率设计提供可供核查的方法线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Fast Rates for Offline Q-Learning with KL Regularization

**abstract/A1：** This paper investigates offline Q-learning for finite-horizon Markov decision processes with Kullback-Leibler (KL) regularization. Recent studies have shown that KL regularization can yield fast rates in offline decision-making problems. However, it remains unclear whether Q-learning, which adopts incremental stochastic approximation updates, can achieve such fast rates in the offline setting. We first propose KL-regularized Q-Learning (KLQ), a simple variant of classical Q-learning. By exploiting KL regularization, we prove that KLQ achieves a sample complexity of $\\widetilde{O}(1/ε)$ without explicit pessimism. This guarantee, however, has an exponential dependence on the KL regularization parameter and the horizon. To address this limitation, we further propose KL-regularized Pessimistic Q-Learning (KLPQ), which incorporates pessimism into KLQ. We prove that KLPQ retains the same \\(\\widetilde O(1/ε)\\) rate while removing the explicit exponential dependence, thereby further improving the sample complexity. To the best of our knowledge, these results establish the first fast-rate guarantees for offline Q-learning in tabular finite-horizon KL-regularized MDPs.

</details>

### 546. [The Last Remote Sensing Model Built by Humans? Casting Any Earth Observation Task as Recursive Self-Improvement](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18845v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18845

**作者：** Sijie Zhao、Zeqi Zhou、Heli Qi、Xuanchao Fu、Zhuo Zheng、Junshi Xia、Junjue Wang、Weihao Xuan、Naoto Yokoya

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.CL

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18845v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18845v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文将任意可验证的地球观测任务表述为「harness + verifier」，让通用编码智能体自行构建并递归改进 EO 模型，在光学、SAR 与多光谱基准上以约 1% 标签取得超越 SOTA 的精度。

**相关性简评：** 其「可验证任务 + 递归自改进」的设定，可能为 LVR 中推理轨迹的监督、验证与自改进训练提供可核查的方法线索；但研究对象是遥感模型构建，本身不涉及视觉 latent 状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The Last Remote Sensing Model Built by Humans? Casting Any Earth Observation Task as Recursive Self-Improvement

**abstract/A1：** Earth observation (EO) models are still built by hand. For each new task, experts design a training recipe and tune it against a benchmark. We show that this loop can be handed to an agent. Any verifiable task can be cast as a harness and a verifier, where the harness defines what the agent may use and the verifier defines what counts as success. Every EO task can be made verifiable, through labeled benchmarks, independent sensors, physical models or the repeated observation of the same place. Given only these two components, a general-purpose coding agent builds the EO model and improves it recursively on its own outputs. Settings long treated as separate research problems, from learning with a handful of labels to adapting across domains, become choices of harness and verifier. On four EO benchmarks spanning optical, SAR and multispectral time-series imagery, agent-built models surpass the state of the art and keep most of that accuracy from about 1% of the training labels. This establishes a new paradigm for EO, in which people design harnesses and verifiers and agents build the models, so EO models improve as agents do.

**comment/C1：** Ongoing project

</details>

### 547. [Two Clocks: Why Larger Rollout Batches Learn Slower but Fail on Schedule in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18853v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18853

**作者：** Yuante Li、Junwei Quan、Kai Qiu、Kate Zhang、Yicheng Tao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18853v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18853v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 two-clock 框架，把 RLVR 中「取得进展所需样本」与「崩溃前消耗样本」分开，在局部二次模型下推导出 critical batch 与失效时钟，并用 Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B 的 GRPO 实验在 16 倍 batch 范围内验证，进而给出一套多步 batch 调度。

**相关性简评：** LVR 常用 RLVR 类目标训练，其 critical batch、平方根缩放与双时钟分析可供核查：rollout 规模与更新步长如何影响 latent 推理训练的样本效率与失效时机；但原文不涉及视觉或多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Two Clocks: Why Larger Rollout Batches Learn Slower but Fail on Schedule in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards

**abstract/A1：** Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) relies on costly model-generated responses, motivating larger rollout batches and square-root learning-rate scaling. Reported to approximately preserve progress per sample with one optimizer step per rollout, this rule is less understood in practical multi-step training. We develop a two-clock framework that separates the samples needed to make progress from those consumed before collapse. Under a local quadratic model, the square-root rule preserves first-order drift per sample but not progress: larger batches take fewer, longer updates and lose more to curvature, yielding a learning-rate-dependent critical batch beyond which sample efficiency degrades. A drift-threshold hypothesis predicts a complementary failure clock whose sample count remains approximately invariant along the square-root rule. Controlled GRPO experiments on Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B across a $16\\times$ batch range support both predictions. Ratio clipping delays failure, especially for larger batches, but the progress gap persists without it. Widening the clip trades stability for a transient speed gain. The progress gap reappears on another dataset, a general-purpose checkpoint, and a 7B model. Finally, we use the two-clock framework to derive a simple multi-step RLVR schedule: start below the critical batch and switch to a larger batch before failure. Our code is available at: https://github.com/WinstonLiyt/two-clocks-rlvr.

</details>

### 548. [AesCode: Aesthetic Code Generation with Decoupled Cross-Modal Rewards](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18860v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18860

**作者：** Xin Gao、Yifan Yang、Xin Li、Pan Wang、Yan Li、Muzhao Tian、Mingxi Cheng、Bei Liu、Kai Qiu、Qi Dai、Dong Chen、Yue Dong、Leandros Tassiulas、Rex Ying、Ji Li、Chong Luo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18860v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18860v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 AesCode，将幻灯片、海报等视觉产物的代码生成表示为 design graph，用确定性验证器与基于 Visual Graph Rubric 的 VLM judge 构造解耦跨模态奖励，以 RL 联合优化布局、美观与可验证正确性，并构建分开评测正确性与视觉质量的基准。

**相关性简评：** 其把画布拆为可归因属性并分别设计奖励通道与归一化的做法，可能为 LVR 的训练监督设计与 latent 内容贡献分配提供线索，可供核查；该文本身不研究 latent visual reasoning 或推理期状态生成。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AesCode: Aesthetic Code Generation with Decoupled Cross-Modal Rewards

**abstract/A1：** Generating information-rich visual artifacts such as slides, posters, and dashboards as code is appealing because the outputs are structured, editable, and verifiable. Yet code models cannot see how their choices of layout and color come together on the canvas, often limiting spatial planning and aesthetic quality. Image generators excel at visual design but can misrender requested content, making their outputs unreliable targets for direct reproduction. We therefore introduce AesCode, which generates code grounded in the content prompt while using an image generated from the same prompt as an aesthetic guidance. To do so, AesCode represents the target as a design graph that describes the whole canvas and makes each property attributable. From this graph, we derive complementary cross-modal rewards: deterministic verifiers score properties parsable from code and rendering, while a VLM judge assesses the non-parsable ones with a sample-specific Visual Graph Rubric (VGR) tied to graph elements and relations. We optimize these decoupled rewards through reinforcement learning with per-channel normalization to jointly improve spatial planning, aesthetic quality, and verifiable correctness. To evaluate this setting, we build a benchmark that scores verifiable correctness and visual quality separately, with visual scores highly consistent with human judgments. We find that reference images substantially improve the visual quality of code generated by existing models, and ablations show that AesCode benefits from references both as model input and as a source of visual rewards. Relative to same-scale Qwen3-VL baselines given the same references, AesCode-8B and AesCode-32B improve visual quality by 31.1 and 22.4 percentage points, reaching scores comparable to those of closed-source frontier models such as GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus 4.8.

**comment/C1：** 44 pages,18 figures

</details>

### 549. [PLAYGROUND: Progressive Layout Generation with Render-Grounded Planning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18865v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18865

**作者：** Jaeho Lee、Junhwan Heo、Junghyun Park、WonJun Moon、Eunju Yang、Seungho Jang、Seongchan Kim、Seungryong Kim

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18865v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18865v1>)

**研究分类：** METHOD · 方法迁移

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 PlayGround：面向可编辑图形设计的渐进式布局生成框架，由 Progressive Planner、Layout Generator、Visual Verifier 与 Structure-Aware Retriever 组成设计循环，并构建两阶段数据流程为规划器提供回合级逐步监督。

**相关性简评：** 其「依据当前渲染画布动态规划、由视觉验证器判断是否细化、并用回合级轨迹做逐步监督」的机制，可能为 LVR 中的中间状态更新、视觉证据筛选与停止/细化决策、监督信号分配提供可核查线索；但任务本身是版面设计，与 VLM 推理仅有结构类比。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PLAYGROUND: Progressive Layout Generation with Render-Grounded Planning

**abstract/A1：** Generating editable graphic designs requires arranging visual and textual elements into a coherent composition while preserving their content and editability. Although recent MLLM-based approaches employ iterative generation and visual refinement to reflect the real-world design workflows, their high-level plans are predetermined prior to execution, limiting their adaptability as the design evolves. To address this limitation, we propose PlayGround, a progressive layout generation framework that dynamically adapts to the current rendered canvas. PlayGround establishes a progressive design loop comprising a Progressive Planner, a Layout Generator, and a Visual Verifier, guided by a Structure-Aware Retriever. Given an initial set of unordered elements, the Structure-Aware Retriever initially infers a coarse layout structure to retrieve structurally similar reference designs. Subsequently, at each turn, the Progressive Planner examines the current rendered canvas alongside the remaining elements, forms the next functional group, and plans its composition. The Layout Generator then predicts editable layout attributes, while the Visual Verifier evaluates rendered candidates and provides feedback when refinement is necessary. To train the Progressive Planner with step-wise supervision, we construct a two-stage data generation pipeline that extracts functional groups and turn-level planning trajectories from completed designs. Experiments on Crello and LICA demonstrate the effectiveness of PlayGround over existing methods. Our code and weights will be publicly released.

</details>

### 550. [PRIME: Frequency-Aware Unified Pruning and Merging for MoE Compression](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13982v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.13982

**作者：** Shanfeng Huang、Rongqian Zhang、Zhou Fang、Song Xiao、Hai Du

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13982v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.13982v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** PRIME 提出 MoE 模型压缩的统一框架，把专家剪枝与合并的离散分配统一建模为使用频率加权的整数线性规划，并在 Qwen3-30B-A3B 与 Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 上验证精度保留与部署端的显存、吞吐收益。

**相关性简评：** 该工作处理的是纯文本 MoE 的冗余单元剪枝与合并，与 LVR 主线无直接联系，但其「按使用频率选代表、统一分配可合并单元」的表述可能为 latent 状态或视觉 token 的冗余合并与表示压缩提供借鉴线索，需核查是否可迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PRIME: Frequency-Aware Unified Pruning and Merging for MoE Compression

**abstract/A1：** Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have emerged as an effective paradigm for scaling large language models, yet their massive parameter footprint poses severe memory challenges for deployment. Existing compression methods typically treat expert pruning and merging as disjoint operations and rely on greedy heuristics, often leading to irreversible information loss or representational pollution. In this paper, we propose PRIME, a unified optimization framework for MoE compression via adaptive PRunIng and MErging. PRIME casts the discrete prune-merge assignment step as a global Integer Linear Programming over a frequency-weighted surrogate objective, jointly selecting pruning and merging decisions while accounting for expert usage. We motivate the frequency-aware objective through an error-bound analysis under fixed representative assignments, and show that the formulation favors high-frequency experts as centroids, promoting routing stability. Extensive experiments on Qwen3-30B-A3B and Qwen3.5-122B-A10B demonstrate that PRIME achieves strong accuracy retention across knowledge, coding, math, and long-context tasks, while serving benchmarks of merged models quantify the memory and throughput benefits of expert compression in vLLM.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Posterior Flow Matching 框架，用高斯后验模型同时学习条件速度均值与逐分量方差，使同一次模型评估既给出传输预测又给出终点不确定性，并据此构造均值驱动的 ODE 与噪声尺度随预测不确定性自适应的后验驱动 SDE，在图像、点云、分子与动作生成上验证效果。

**相关性简评：** 「在中间状态即可读出终点不确定性」的机制，可能与 LVR 中基于置信度的 STOP 决策、latent 状态更新的不确定性感知相呼应，可供核查；但论文属连续生成建模，与 VLM 推理无直接联系，迁移设想需自行验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Posterior Flow Matching

**abstract/A1：** Flow matching learns how to transport noise toward data, but its mean prediction does not directly report the endpoint uncertainty remaining at an intermediate state. This paper introduces Posterior Flow Matching (PFM), a general generative modeling framework that learns conditional velocity means and componentwise variances with a Gaussian posterior model. The same model evaluation supplies both a transport prediction and endpoint uncertainty, making posterior diagnostics available throughout generation. These learned moments support a mean-driven ordinary differential equation (ODE) and a posterior-driven stochastic differential equation (SDE), whose local noise scales adapt to the predicted uncertainty. Across image, point-cloud, molecular, and action generation, PFM improves generation quality and provides endpoint-posterior readouts throughout generation.

</details>

**title/T1：** Showing versus Doing: Teaching by Demonstration

**abstract/A1：** People often learn from others' demonstrations, and inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) techniques have realized this capacity in machines. In contrast, teaching by demonstration has been less well studied computationally. Here, we develop a Bayesian model for teaching by demonstration. Stark differences arise when demonstrators are intentionally teaching (i.e. showing) a task versus simply performing (i.e. doing) a task. In two experiments, we show that human participants modify their teaching behavior consistent with the predictions of our model. Further, we show that even standard IRL algorithms benefit when learning from showing versus doing.

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文借用算法信息论、通用预测与贝叶斯一致性的已知结果，论证语言模型在均匀意义上无法逼近 Solomonoff 归纳，并从 Kraft 不等式视角把预测成功视为固定预算，讨论哪些性质可继承、哪些应避免，以及在上下文窗口内能保留什么。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉/多模态推理无直接关联，但其「预测成功预算的分配」「in-context learning 作为摊销贝叶斯推断」「上下文窗口内保留什么」的框架，可能为 latent 推理状态的容量边界与泛化评价提供概念类比，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** What Can Language Models Inherit from Solomonoff Induction? Limits, Attainable Properties, and What Served Conditionals Reveal

**abstract/A1：** A familiar line of reasoning runs as follows: language models are flexible approximators trained under a strictly proper loss, so scale brings them closer to Solomonoff induction, and their predictive success is evidence of that approach. We apply known results from algorithmic information theory, universal prediction and Bayesian consistency. In its uniform form the conclusion holds for no computable model: each has cheap environments it never learns, and every uniformly computable family of total predictors shares one on which each member fails beyond a horizon growing with its index, so \`\`closer'' can hold only pointwise, one environment at a time. Nor could the offered routes certify even that: finite evaluation cannot certify agreement on rarely reached contexts, perfect corpus fit selects the corpus law as prior, and asymptotic criteria cannot see the constants that carry Solomonoff's guarantee. Our lens is the Kraft inequality read for predictors. Every model has at most the same budget of predictive success, so Solomonoff's predictor, which leaves part of it unspent, differs from a language model not in having more of it but in where it spends it; on mutually singular families this is exact, and only full-mass Bayes mixtures reach the frontier. We then discuss what is inheritable, including in-context learning as amortised Bayesian inference; what survives within a context window; which Solomonoff-like properties a deployed system should have or avoid; and what served conditionals determine. A closing table states what common practices certify and what to report. Tests are developed in a companion paper.

</details>

### 554. [SIRNET: Causal Adaptation of Pretrained Embeddings for Semiparametric Treatment-Effect Estimation Under Surrogacy](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14011v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14011

**作者：** Lei Shi、Qiuran Lyu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ME

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14011v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14011v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 SIRNET，在存在处理后非结构化替代变量（文本、图像、视频等）时，从预训练编码器嵌入出发，通过共享 adapter 联合学习结果预测、处理倾向与分臂替代变量边缘化，再用交叉拟合的正交得分给出半参数有效的处理效应估计与置信区间，并在合成、半合成实验与 A4 脑 MRI 试验上验证。

**相关性简评：** 该工作指出通用预训练嵌入可能强调与目标无关的信息，需针对下游目标改造表示——这可作为「任务必要信息是否保留在内部状态」这一问题表述的远域类比，但论文本身不涉及多模态推理状态生成或视觉证据筛选，借鉴价值需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SIRNET: Causal Adaptation of Pretrained Embeddings for Semiparametric Treatment-Effect Estimation Under Surrogacy

**abstract/A1：** Modern experiments increasingly produce rich post-treatment objects---such as text, images, and video---that may provide early surrogate signals for outcomes that are delayed, expensive, or observed only for a subset of participants. A pretrained encoder can turn such an object into a strong generic embedding, but the embedding is not trained for the estimation tasks required by a causal estimator and may emphasize information irrelevant to the causal target. We propose SIRNET, a Surrogate-Informed Representation adaptation framework for neural-NETwork-based causal estimation in the presence of unstructured post-treatment surrogates. Starting from pretrained surrogate embeddings, SIRNET learns a shared adapter jointly for outcome prediction, treatment propensity, and arm-specific surrogate marginalization, beyond the generic pretraining objective. The resulting covariate and surrogate representations provide a common interface for these nuisance tasks. The final treatment-effect estimate and confidence interval are obtained from cross-fitted orthogonal scores that attain the semiparametric efficiency bound under the stated nuisance-rate conditions. We also validate SIRNET's performance in synthetic and semisynthetic experiments, as well as the Anti-Amyloid in Asymptomatic Alzheimer's Disease (A4) trial, using frozen pretrained brain-MRI embeddings as surrogates for a long-term outcome.

</details>

### 555. [Physics-Informed State Space Models for Day-Ahead Photovoltaic Power Forecasting](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14014v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14014

**作者：** Phil Aupke、Muhammad Hassan、Khalid Ali、Seema、Andreas Kassler、Andreas Theocharis

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14014v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14014v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出物理信息状态空间框架，用可微光伏转换模型提供结构化基线，再由选择性状态空间骨干（PowerMamba）在 24 小时尺度上学习残差修正，用于日前光伏功率预测。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接关联，但「物理基线 + 学习残差」的分解、选择性 SSM 的状态递推与长时程约束可供核查：或可类比于给 latent 推理状态加结构化先验、限制状态在可行域内以抑制坍缩，属推测性借鉴。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Physics-Informed State Space Models for Day-Ahead Photovoltaic Power Forecasting

**abstract/A1：** Accurate day-ahead photovoltaic (PV) power forecasting requires both strong temporal modeling and adherence to physical PV system constraints. Purely data-driven models often ignore the underlying PV conversion process and may produce predictions that are outside the operational range of a PV system. In this paper, we propose a physics-informed state space framework that combines a differentiable PV conversion model with a selective state space backbone (PowerMamba). Our approach follows a physics-residual decomposition. The physics module provides a structured baseline based on solar geometry, irradiance, temperature effects, and inverter limits, while the state space model learns residual corrections from numerical weather prediction (NWP) inputs over a 24-hour horizon. Experiments on one year of utility-scale PV data show that the proposed method significantly improves forecasting accuracy, reducing RMSE by 38.5% and MAE by 45.8% compared to a physics-only baseline, and outperforming a purely data-driven model. Results further show that incorporating system-level physics provides the largest performance gains, while additional refinements offer only marginal improvements. Beyond accuracy, the model improves robustness by constraining predictions toward physical feasibility, reducing unrealistic predictions under corrupted measurements.

</details>

### 556. [Barycentric Anchored Weight Search for Robust Model Merging](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14017v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14017

**作者：** Antoni Buades、Jose-Luis Lisani

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14017v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14017v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Barycentric Anchored Search：在预训练初始化与两个微调 checkpoint 之间构造权重重心候选，用少量 OOD 验证集驱动无梯度搜索来挑选合并权重，在 CLIP ViT-B/32 上考察鲁棒性与 ImageNet 精度权衡。

**相关性简评：** 权重空间合并与几何搜索本身不涉及推理期 latent 状态生成，但「以验证反馈迭代筛选候选权重」的做法与 LVR 中候选 latent 轨迹的搜索、选择及停止策略可能有类比线索，可供核查其是否影响视觉表示的细节保留。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Barycentric Anchored Weight Search for Robust Model Merging

**abstract/A1：** We propose Barycentric Anchored Search, a post-hoc weight-space procedure for improving fine-tuned vision models under distribution shift without additional gradient training or increased inference cost. Given a pre-trained initialization and two checkpoints fine-tuned on a source dataset, the method constructs barycentric candidate weights and performs a small derivative-free search along directions connecting each candidate to the pre-trained model. Candidate weights are selected using a small validation subset of one or more out-of-distribution (OOD) datasets; the selected model is then evaluated on the held-out portions of those datasets, on additional OOD benchmarks, and on the ImageNet validation set to quantify the robustness-accuracy trade-off. The method is inspired by simplex-based derivative-free optimization, including Nelder-Mead and Torczon multidirectional search, but is specialized to the geometry of neural network weight merging. Unlike Model Soup, which typically benefits from many fine-tuned checkpoints, and unlike Model Stock, which applies a fixed geometric merge, our approach uses only two fine-tuned checkpoints and iteratively adapts the merge using validation feedback from OOD data. Experiments with CLIP ViT-B/32 show that the proposed search substantially improves performance on held-out OOD data, including ImageNet-A, ImageNet-R, and ImageNet-Sketch, while keeping ImageNet accuracy competitive. The resulting weights also improve transfer to OOD datasets not used during candidate selection, outperforming the original fine-tuned checkpoints, naive model soups, and Model Stock in our evaluations. These results suggest that lightweight optimization in anchored weight space provides a practical alternative to fixed weight-averaging rules, geometric merging, or single-model selection.

</details>

### 557. [Beyond a Better Score: Long-Horizon Agentic ML Development and Evaluation Protocol for Physics Time Series](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14024v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14024

**作者：** Yue Ma、Lucas Venetoulias、Akbota Assan、Aobo Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、hep-ex

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14024v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14024v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 SIDERIUS 这一 LLM agent 系统，用于物理时间序列上的长程 ML 开发，通过契约化可组合能力、人在回路、多层科学评估协议与资源感知探索，区分科学有效模型与走捷径、刷分或退化的模型，并在 TIDMAD 等基准上验证。

**相关性简评：** 其「多层评估协议区分有效模型与 gaming 模型」及资源感知探索，可能为 LVR 中检测视觉旁路、latent 未被真正使用（信息坍缩）和动态计算分配提供评价与诊断思路，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond a Better Score: Long-Horizon Agentic ML Development and Evaluation Protocol for Physics Time Series

**abstract/A1：** Physics time-series data are central to fundamental discoveries involving dark matter, neutrinos, and gravitational waves. Machine learning has shown strong potential to recover weak scientific signals buried in complex noise. Recent LLM-agent systems further automate ML development, but existing approaches are often driven primarily by one or a few numerical scores. In pursuit of a better score, agents may exploit shortcuts, trigger mode collapse, or game the evaluation procedure, producing models that achieve high scores but are scientifically invalid. We introduce SIDERIUS, an LLM agent system designed to move beyond a better score toward scientifically valid, long-horizon ML development. SIDERIUS combines contract-defined composable capabilities for flexible orchestration and human-in-the-loop, a multi-layer scientific evaluation protocol that distinguishes valid models from unhealthy or gaming models, and resource-aware exploration for computationally expensive scientific ML. In our TIDMAD benchmark, SIDERIUS with a GPT-based orchestrator achieves the highest Valid-model proposal rate of 63.8% and the best valid denoising score of 2.744, compared with 1.6% and -0.647, respectively, for the same GPT model using the general-purpose Codex coding agent. We further benchmark SIDERIUS on three additional physics time-series datasets, demonstrating its reuse and performance across different tasks. Together, these results suggest that progress in agentic scientific ML should be measured beyond a better score, by how an agent explores and by whether the models it produces can be trusted as science.

**comment/C1：** 43 pages, 10 figures, 15 tables

</details>

### 558. [Human Pose Estimation by Probabilistic Mixtures of Gaussian and Uniform Distributions](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14093v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14093

**作者：** Santiago Reina Alguacil、Ezequiel López Rubio

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14093v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14093v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出一种后处理式的连续概率框架，把 HPE 的原始热图建模为高斯混合加空间均匀分布，无需改架构或重训，用空间期望解码，并借助多模态 GMM 参数化做不确定性校准、多尺度增强聚合与 3D 多视角扩展。

**相关性简评：** 其用混合分布显式隔离竞争性空间假设、以几何协方差体积校准不确定性的做法，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选、latent 状态表示与 STOP 决策提供参照，但任务与推理机制差异大，具体迁移线索需人工核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Human Pose Estimation by Probabilistic Mixtures of Gaussian and Uniform Distributions

**abstract/A1：** Despite advancements in sub-pixel decoding, modern Human Pose Estimation (HPE) architectures remain constrained by deterministic coordinate extraction from discrete heatmaps, which systematically fails under dense occlusions and Out-of-Distribution (OoD) ambiguities. To address these limitations, we propose a post-hoc continuous probabilistic framework that intercepts raw heatmaps and models them as a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) augmented with a spatially agnostic uniform distribution, requiring no architectural modifications or retraining. This continuous representation allows us to comprehensively explore the distinct contributions of density modeling to HPE. We show that the spatial expectation of our fitted GMM achieves precision parity with leading sub-pixel decoders without heuristic post-processing. Leveraging this continuous space, our test-time augmentation aggregates probability distributions rather than discrete activations, mitigating multi-scale heatmap poisoning. Furthermore, because our multimodal GMM parameterization isolates competing spatial hypotheses, it naturally interfaces with geometric regularizers such as Markov Random Fields. However, our analysis exposes the inherent vulnerabilities of 2D kinematic priors under perspective foreshortening and visual degradation. Crucially, this density formulation yields significant improvements in uncertainty quantification: our calibrated geometric covariance volume outperforms standard peak-intensity heuristics in OoD anomaly detection under severe occlusion. For in-distribution calibration, dynamically fusing our geometric metric via Adaptive Softmax reduces or matches baseline Area Under the Sparsification Error (AUSE) across benchmarks and degradation levels. Finally, we establish that this continuous parameterization is extensible to multi-view 3D architectures, bypassing the $\\mathcal{O}(N^3)$ voxel memory bottleneck.

**comment/C1：** 38 pages, 11 figures, 20 tables. Includes supplementary material. Code available at https://github.com/santiago-git19/probabilistic-pose-gmm

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在 CTI-REALM 安全检测基准上用统一 harness、评分器与 LLM 评审团评测 26 个开源与闭源模型，发现给予足够轮数后开源模型能以不到十分之一成本匹配最强闭源模型；并指出基准的消息轮数上限构成混淆（超限任务全部记零），提出按阶段执行检测查询、对照答案键打分的阶段级指标。

**相关性简评：** 虽非视觉或 latent 推理工作，但其关于轮数上限导致评价「部分衡量谁先完成」、thinking token 占比与奖励脱钩、以及不同模型各擅阶段因而按阶段路由的观察，可能在计算预算、THINK/STOP 成本收益与评价设计上对 LVR 有类比启发，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Unconstrained CTI-REALM with Open-Weights

**abstract/A1：** Organisations that want language-model agents for security work face a choice between open-weight models, which they can run and audit themselves, and far more expensive closed frontier models. We study that choice on CTI-REALM (arXiv:2603.13517), a benchmark in which an agent turns a threat-intelligence report into a working detection by querying a live telemetry store. We evaluate twenty-six models, nineteen open-weight and seven closed, under a common harness, scorer and panel of LLM judges. Our main finding is that an open-weight model can match the strongest closed models at less than a tenth of their cost, provided it is given enough turns. The benchmark's published limit on agent messages is a confound: a task that exhausts the limit scores zero on every checkpoint, including those it had already passed, so results at that limit partly measure which models finish in time. At the published limit the leading open-weight and closed models cannot be distinguished. With the limit relaxed, the models it was truncating recover, and the highest rewards belong to open-weight models. Among the leading models, price is a poor guide to capability: models with similar rewards differ in cost by more than an order of magnitude. Because the benchmark's checkpoint scores largely record what an agent did or mentioned, we also introduce stage-level metrics that score what the agent submits, by executing its detection queries in the telemetry store and judging its outputs against the answer key. Rather than combining them into one more overall reward, we show that different models lead different stages, which suggests routing each stage of the workflow to the model that performs it best rather than choosing a single model by its overall score. We also report how many tokens each model generates, and find that the share of output spent on thinking does not track the reward.

</details>

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Refined Grid Sampling for Efficient Implicit Neural Representations of Large-Scale Scientific Data

**abstract/A1：** Implicit neural representations (INRs) offer a powerful framework for modeling high-dimensional physical fields, but their training remains inefficient because evaluating dense coordinate grids is computationally expensive. Existing coordinate-pruning strategies rely on local error functions that can oversample correlated points and incur substantial overhead from full-grid error evaluation. We introduce Refined Grid Sampling (RGS), which combines stratified grid sampling, error-based refinement, and dynamic grid-resolution adjustment. This design reduces spatial redundancy without evaluating errors over the full grid. On high-resolution Navier--Stokes fields, RGS achieves higher reconstruction accuracy within a fixed wall-clock budget and reaches the accuracy of full-grid training up to $6\\times$ faster than the evaluated baselines.

**内容简述：** 论文提出一种云端大模型写程序、设备端小模型在运行期解释用户数据的混合智能体架构，并在 AppWorld 上比较其与纯代码智能体、云端 ReAct 循环的成功率与数据本地性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Should SLMs be in the Driver's Seat? A Study of Local Models as Interpreters in Cloud-Written Agent Programs

**abstract/A1：** The most accurate agents executing user-provided tasks are driven by large, cloud-hosted models, which solve them by reading the private data of the user. Agents powered by models small enough to run on edge devices keep that data local, but yield far worse results. A third option is to have cloud models write a program that devices execute: the data stays local, but as the program is written before any data is seen, it fails whenever a step depends on interpreting content that appears only at run time. We explore an intermediate architecture, in which the cloud-written program defers bounded questions over user data to a small local model through an ordinary function call. On AppWorld this improves the success rate of a code-only agent in all six combinations of backbone model and test partition we evaluate, by up to 14.9pp, recovering a substantial part of the gap to a cloud-hosted ReAct loop while keeping user data on the device.

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出 EGKE，把 KLE 中基于 NLI 的语义图替换为 BGE 句嵌入上的 RBF 核，保留图拉普拉斯、热核与 von Neumann 熵框架，用于 LLM 幻觉检测，并在 30 组问答数据集与开源模型设置上用 AUROC/AUARC 评估。

**相关性简评：** 其用嵌入空间相似图上的熵度量生成样本间语义分歧，可能为 LVR 中 latent 轨迹间相似度刻画与 STOP/置信判断提供可核查的线索；但对象是文本输出分布而非内部推理状态，且不涉及视觉，联系较间接。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Embedding Graph Kernel Entropy (EGKE): Fine-grained Hallucination Detection for LLMs from Embeddings

**abstract/A1：** Hallucination detection is critical for ensuring the reliability of Large Language Models (LLMs) in real-world deployments. While recent works, such as Semantic Entropy (SE) and Kernel Language Entropy (KLE), identify hallucinations by measuring semantic disagreement across multiple generated responses using Natural Language Inference (NLI) models, these methods depend on separately loaded NLI classifiers to estimate pairwise semantic similarity, introducing significant computational overhead. We propose Embedding Graph Kernel Entropy (EGKE), a variant of Kernel Language Entropy (KLE) that replaces its NLI-derived semantic graph with a Radial Basis Function (RBF) kernel applied to dense sentence embeddings generated by a BGE embedding model, while retaining KLE's graph Laplacian, heat kernel, and von Neumann entropy formulation unchanged. By computing similarities directly in a continuous embedding space, the proposed method provides a symmetric and computationally efficient alternative to NLI-based semantic comparison. We evaluate our approach across 30 experimental setups (covering multiple question-answer datasets and open-weight LLM families) using both AUROC and AUARC, and demonstrate that this RBF-based method achieves competitive hallucination detection performance against state-of-the-art methods.

**comment/C1：** Accepted for ICKG 2026

</details>

<a id="paper-563"></a>

### 563. [Harness^2: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14224v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14224

**作者：** Ruiyao Xu、Yanfei Chen、Zhongying CuiZhu、Bhavana Dalvi Mishra、Yifei Ming、Han Yu、Rujun Han、Chen-Yu Lee、Tomas Pfister

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14224v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14224v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Harness^2，一个即插即用的递归式 agent harness 自改进框架：任务级递归以对比式 Propose-Probe-Compose 在无真值验证器的情况下修正当前任务的执行框架，框架级递归把编辑经验沉淀为持续改进的 harness，并在三个专业基准、四组模型-框架配置上验证增益。

**相关性简评：** 属纯文本 agent 自我改进，与视觉推理无直接关系；但其「无真值验证器下引导运行时修改」与递归预算和收益的关系，可能为 LVR 的停止决策、贡献分配及无监督候选筛选提供可核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Harness^2: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World

**abstract/A1：** LLM agents' capabilities depend not only on their underlying models but also on their execution harnesses. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a promising approach to automatically evolve these harnesses. However, deploying RSI in open-world settings still faces two critical challenges. First, open-world tasks are typically unseen during the harness design phase and novel at test time, leaving no ground-truth verifiers to reliably guide online harness edits. Second, the RSI process remains highly task-specific and fails to generalize to novel scenarios. We introduce Harness^2, a plug-and-play, recursive agent harnessing framework that addresses these challenges through two connected levels of recursion. Task-level recursion refines the current task's harness using a contrastive Propose-Probe-Compose step that reliably guides edits without ground-truth verifiers, and can be scaled further via parallel or sequential recursion. Harnessing-level recursion then extracts experience from these edits to update a continual improvement harness, enabling the agent to better adapt to future tasks. Across three professional benchmarks and four model-harness configurations, a single step consistently improves GLM-5 and Gemini 3.5 Flash over their base harnesses, yielding gains of up to 11.5 points on WorkBuddy-Bench, 4.5 points on JobBench, and 11.8 percentage points on LAB, with further gains as the task-level recursion budget increases.

</details>

### 564. [Learning Non-Gaussian SEMs with Conditional Risk, and Why the Direction of Recursion Matters](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14246v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14246

**作者：** Ujas Shah、Panagiota Birmpa、Rebecca Morrison

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14246v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14246v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究非高斯线性结构方程模型的结构识别，用「条件风险」（噪声分布下线性预测的最小期望损失）替代条件方差，把自顶向下与自底向上两种递归识别方法推广到非高斯噪声，并证明二者在非高斯下不再等价：top-down 在有限微分熵下即正确，bottom-up 需额外正则条件且可能失效，模拟予以验证。

**相关性简评：** 「以匹配噪声分布的损失而非方差作为递归选择准则」及递归方向（源节点优先 vs 汇节点优先）的不对称性，可能为 latent 推理中状态更新顺序、步序方向与选择准则的设计提供类比线索，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning Non-Gaussian SEMs with Conditional Risk, and Why the Direction of Recursion Matters

**abstract/A1：** Variance-based methods recover a Gaussian linear structural equation model (SEM) with equal or suitably constrained error variances, either by recursively identifying the source nodes with smallest conditional variance (top-down method) or sink nodes with highest conditional variance (bottom-up method). We show that the use of conditional variance is incidental: replacing it with the conditional risk, i.e., the minimal expected loss of linear prediction under the negative log-likelihood of the noise distribution, extends both methods to non-Gaussian noise. Existing methods are the least-squares special case. This yields two main results. First, exploiting the noise distribution improves structure recovery: the matched-loss procedures recover the SEM more accurately than their least-squares counterparts and the LiNGAM methods, which are designed for non-Gaussianity. Second, the two methods, interchangeable in the Gaussian setting, separate under non-Gaussian noise: the top-down method is correct for every noise density with finite differential entropy, whereas the bottom-up method requires a regularity condition and can fail without it, for instance under mean-zero exponential or Cauchy noise. Simulations confirm both results.

**comment/C1：** 15 pages, 5 figures

</details>

### 565. [Image Diffusion Models Are Good 3D Human Motion Generators](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14254v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14254

**作者：** Siyuan Yang、Chong Wang、Hao Cheng、Jun Liu、Bihan Wen、Alex Kot、Hedvig Kjellstrom

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14254v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14254v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究用图像扩散架构生成3D人体动作：将根中心关节轨迹组织为拓扑感知的 joint–time 图像，并以互补的 root latent stream 承载全局根运动，由文本条件 SiT 联合生成两路 latent，在 HumanML3D 与 KIT-ML 上验证共享建模的收益。

**相关性简评：** 其「图像兼容表示 + 双 latent stream 联合扩散生成」的线索，可能与 LVR 中 diffusion 式 latent 推理状态的产生与多流耦合问题相通，可供核查；但任务为动作生成，远离视觉推理，迁移性需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Image Diffusion Models Are Good 3D Human Motion Generators

**abstract/A1：** Text-to-motion generation typically relies on dataset-specific skeletal representations, with models trained separately for benchmarks with different joint layouts. We investigate whether image diffusion architectures can model 3D human motion through a common image-compatible representation that accommodates heterogeneous skeletal layouts while preserving motion-specific kinematic structure. To this end, we organize root-centered joint trajectories into topology-informed joint--time images and model global root dynamics through a complementary latent stream. A motion autoencoder conditions local-motion decoding on the root latent, while a text-conditioned Scalable Interpolant Transformer (SiT) jointly generates both latent streams, with supervision on decoded 3D joint positions further constraining generation in motion space. In addition to dataset-specific models, we train a single motion autoencoder on HumanML3D and KIT-ML, followed by a single text-conditioned SiT shared across both datasets, preserving their respective skeletal definitions without skeleton retargeting to a common joint layout. Experiments on HumanML3D and KIT-ML show that our dataset-specific models achieve state-of-the-art performance, while shared training yields further gains on both benchmarks, demonstrating the benefits of shared modeling across heterogeneous skeletal layouts.

**comment/C1：** 16 pages; under review. The first two authors contributed equally to this work

</details>
