### 566. [Variance Fingerprints: Component-Wise Identification of Content Factors by Augmentation Design](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14260v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14260

**作者：** D. Hudson Smith

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14260v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14260v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出为每个实例记录固定的增强强度，使内容因子在各视图间的波动模式（方差指纹）不同，从而在条件高斯模型下证明单个因子可辨识，并给出可少视图学习的联合估计器，在合成数据与 dSprites 上验证坐标对齐改善。

**相关性简评：** 该工作从增强设计与因子可辨识性角度讨论表示几何，可能为核查 LVR 内部状态中哪些视觉因子被区分保留提供概念线索，但它不涉及多模态推理或 latent 状态生成，迁移价值有待人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Variance Fingerprints: Component-Wise Identification of Content Factors by Augmentation Design

**abstract/A1：** Augmentation-based self-supervised learning can recover the content shared across views without separating its underlying factors into individual coordinates. We ask whether augmentations can be designed to make those factors identifiable. Our approach allows content factors to fluctuate across augmented views while preserving their mean for each source instance. Each instance receives a fixed, recorded set of augmentation strengths that controls how much its factors fluctuate. When factors respond differently to changes in these strengths, their patterns of variation provide information that distinguishes them. Under suitable decoder and support assumptions, we prove that these differences identify individual factors in a conditional Gaussian model, up to permutation, scaling, and translation. We then develop a learner that uses the recorded strengths to estimate these patterns jointly across instances, enabling learning from few views per instance. Synthetic experiments demonstrate near-perfect factor recovery through nonlinear mixing. Controlled dSprites experiments show improved coordinate alignment using augmentations that target known factors, even without telling the learner which augmentation corresponds to which representation coordinate. These results suggest a route to component identification in self-supervised learning: augmentation design can supply identifying information beyond shared content alone.

**comment/C1：** 28 pages, 4 figures

</details>

### 567. [BigCell: Generating Gigapixel Whole-Slide Images](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14261v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14261

**作者：** Srikar Yellapragada、Alexandros Graikos、Zilinghan Li、Kostas Triaridis、Tarak Nath Nandi、Ji Dong K Bai、Beatrice Knudsen、Tahsin Kurc、Prateek Prasanna、Rajarsi R. Gupta、Ravi K Madduri、Joel Saltz、Dimitris Samaras

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14261v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14261v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** BigCell 面向病理全切片图像生成，用 flow-matching transformer 加滑窗推理合成原生千兆像素（最高 32768×32768）图像，并提出按区域重要性自适应调度的加速策略及由病理报告文本生成稠密条件的 8k 文本到图像模型。

**相关性简评：** 核心是显式图像生成而非推理，但其「按重要性自适应调度区域」以及滑窗式高分辨率生成，可能与 LVR 中动态计算分配、视觉区域／证据筛选的思路有可供核查的类比线索，属推测性借鉴。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** BigCell: Generating Gigapixel Whole-Slide Images

**abstract/A1：** Whole-slide images (WSIs) are gigapixel-scale digital scans of histopathology tissue and serve as the primary basis for cancer diagnosis. Existing histopathology generative models operate at the patch scale, producing fixed-size tiles of at most 1024$\\times$1024 pixels which encompass only a small fraction of the WSI. In contrast, text reports for clinical diagnoses and slide-level diagnostic labels -- the supervision that exists at scale -- operate at the whole-slide level. We present BigCell, the first approach to generate coherent whole-slide histopathology images at native gigapixel resolution. BigCell trains a flow-matching transformer at 2048$\\times$2048 pixels on over 120,000 publicly available WSIs spanning multiple organ types. Conditioning on embeddings from pathology foundation models and using an inference-time sliding-window pipeline, BigCell generates coherent images of up to 32,768$\\times$32,768 pixels, outperforming prior tile generators on both tile-level and slide-level fidelity metrics. To make gigapixel synthesis practical, we introduce an adaptive scheduling strategy that prioritizes important slide regions, speeding up image generation by over 3\\ttimes with minimal quality degradation. Furthermore, we propose the first text-to-image synthesis at 8k resolution by training a separate model that produces dense conditioning grids directly from pathology text reports. We demonstrate that augmenting with synthetic samples improves slide-level few-shot classification performance by up to $18 \\%$ over baselines trained on real data.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://histodiffusion.github.io/docs/projects/bigcell/

### 568. [Echo: Error-Compensated 4-Bit Tensor-Parallel Communication for LLM Training and Inference](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14277v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14277

**作者：** Xingyu Xie、Xiaoyong Xie、Zhouchen Lin、Kim-Chuan Toh

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14277v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14277v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Echo，一种面向张量并行的 4-bit all-reduce 通信方案：数据以 4 bit 传输、以高精度求和，并把每次调用中暴露的量化误差反馈进后续调用，从而让旧误差相互抵消，证明累计误差与深度无关；在 A100 上取得加速并基本保持精度。

**相关性简评：** 其「误差反馈使累计误差有界、不随深度增长」的机制，可能与 LVR 中 latent 状态跨步量化或被压缩时的误差累积、以及多步轨迹训练的监督分配问题存在概念联系，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Echo: Error-Compensated 4-Bit Tensor-Parallel Communication for LLM Training and Inference

**abstract/A1：** Tensor parallelism ends every layer with an all-reduce that sits between two dependent matrix multiplications, so its cost cannot be hidden and grows as compute outpaces interconnect bandwidth. Sending 4-bit instead of 16-bit values would cut this cost by nearly 4x, but the all-reduce must add the values it carries, and rounding the sum injects an error at every call. Model quality depends on how these errors accumulate over layers, yet existing methods treat each call on its own. We present Echo, a 4-bit all-reduce for training and inference that controls the accumulated error. Echo moves data in 4 bits and sums in high precision, so each value is quantized at most twice per call for any number of GPUs. The summation reveals each injected error, and Echo feeds it back into later calls, so old errors cancel instead of accumulating. We prove that the accumulated error stays bounded independently of depth. On A100 GPUs, Echo is 2.09x faster than the 16-bit NCCL all-reduce on 1 GB messages. It speeds up the time to first token by up to 1.16x and the training step by up to 1.09x on an idle interconnect, and by up to 1.44x and 1.38x as background traffic grows. It keeps the average accuracy over seven benchmarks within 0.4 points of 16-bit inference on Qwen3-8B. In 10B-token pretraining, its final loss is less than 0.9% above that of 16-bit training. Echo needs no FP8 or FP4 hardware.

</details>

### 569. [Controllable Diverse Sampling through Pullback Directions](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14294v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14294

**作者：** Sylvain Dehayem Kenfouo、Aaron Zweig、Mingxuan Zhang、Elham Azizi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14294v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14294v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出一种免训练方法：利用条件嵌入空间到图像空间映射所诱导的 pullback 几何，找出输出最敏感的方向，沿这些方向引导不同采样轨迹，从而在保持提示一致的同时提升生成多样性，并在 MS-COCO 与 BrushNet 上验证。

**相关性简评：** 其用 pullback 几何定位条件嵌入空间中「输出敏感方向」的思路，可能可供核查 latent 推理状态中哪些维度真正承载任务必要视觉信息，但论文属图像生成多样性研究，与 VLM 推理的联系需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Controllable Diverse Sampling through Pullback Directions

**abstract/A1：** Conditional diffusion models can generate high-quality images that align closely with a given prompt. However, samples generated from different random seeds may remain visually similar, limiting creative exploration. Existing approaches can increase variation, but often require additional optimization or sampling overhead, while stronger perturbations may introduce distortions that degrade image quality or prompt alignment. We propose a training-free method that leverages the local pullback geometry induced by the mapping from the conditioning-embedding space to the image space to identify directions of maximal output sensitivity. By steering different sampling trajectories along these directions, we encourage distinct generations while maintaining consistency with the conditioning signal. Experiments on MS-COCO and BrushNet show the efficacy of the method in improving diversity on prompt-conditioned image generation and inpainting.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at the DynaFront workshop at NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 570. [Manifold Navigation Learning Using Recurrent Networks: Efficient Training Techniques](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14325v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14325

**作者：** Sarah Harkins Dayton、Sathya Rengaswami、Vasileios Maroulas、David L. Boothe、Ioannis D. Schizas

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14325v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14325v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把流形上的导航形式化为速度驱动的追踪任务，提出在坐标卡欧氏表示中学习、再经 immersion 映射回流形计算误差的框架，比较多种循环结构后选用 GRU 做序列位置预测，并对比自定义损失、MSE 与朴素向量相加基线，在解析流形和 LiDAR 重建曲面上验证。

**相关性简评：** 来自几何导航这一较远领域，其「在简化表示中更新循环状态、映射回原空间再算误差」的思路与面向长时程的自定义损失，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态更新方式与轨迹级监督设计提供类比线索，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Manifold Navigation Learning Using Recurrent Networks: Efficient Training Techniques

**abstract/A1：** Position tracking is a well-studied problem in Euclidean navigation, yet comparatively little attention has been given to navigation on general manifolds, where motion is governed by the underlying geometry of the space. In this work, we formalize the problem of manifold navigation as a velocity-driven tracking task and propose a coordinate-chart-based learning framework in which learning models operate entirely in a Euclidean representation. Predicted trajectories are mapped to the manifold via an immersion function prior to error computation, allowing geometric consistency to be evaluated without explicitly enforcing manifold constraints during learning. Within this framework, we focus on Gated Recurrent Units (GRUs) for sequential position prediction on curved manifolds after comparisons with alternative recurrent architectures. We evaluate our GRU models, trained with pertinent custom loss functions, against both a standard MSE loss function and a naive vector-addition baseline. We evaluate our approach on both analytically (and numerically) defined manifolds, as well as a surface reconstructed from a LiDAR point cloud. Our results show that recurrent models can learn to approximate manifold-constrained dynamics from velocity sequences and consistently outperform Euclidean baselines. Our results demonstrate that certain custom loss functions significantly improve long-horizon prediction accuracy compared to conventional point-wise loss functions.

</details>

### 571. [Class-Conditional Conformal Prediction for Signal Temporal Logic Inference with Many Classes](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14352v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14352

**作者：** Yixuan Wang、Danyang Li、Matthew Cleaveland、Roberto Tron、Mingyu Cai

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14352v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14352v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究多类时间序列分类中的信号时序逻辑（STL）推断：指出分类准确不等于公式被满足，提出正满意度与码字满意度指标，并用两阶段流程（边际目标学习公式、固定结构后精修谓词阈值）配合按类校准的共形预测，给出有限样本类条件覆盖。

**相关性简评：** 其「结构化时序公式的满意度度量＋类条件共形校准」可能为 LVR 提供两点线索：如何诊断内部推理状态是否真正满足任务必要约束，以及如何用校准方式支撑停止与判定；迁移可行性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Class-Conditional Conformal Prediction for Signal Temporal Logic Inference with Many Classes

**abstract/A1：** Signal Temporal Logic (STL) inference provides interpretable formulas for time series classification. For multiclass classification, however, accurate predictions do not necessarily ensure that the inferred formulas are satisfied consistently with the true class. We introduce the positive satisfaction rate and codeword satisfaction rate to quantify satisfaction of required formulas and consistency with the complete class codeword, respectively. We develop a two-stage procedure that first learns discriminative formulas using a margin-based objective and then refines predicate thresholds toward a small positive robustness target while fixing the formula structure and temporal intervals. Satisfaction and ranking penalties discourage violations of required formulas and loss of class separation. The decoding loss is used as a nonconformity score and calibrated separately for each class, providing finite-sample class-conditional coverage under intra-class exchangeability. Experiments on naval, synthetic, and robot manipulation trajectories demonstrate discrepancies between classification accuracy and formula satisfaction. The results further reveal a data-dependent tradeoff between robustness tightness and satisfaction, while class-conditional calibration mitigates undercoverage that can be hidden by pooled calibration.

</details>

<a id="paper-572"></a>

### 572. [The Sample Complexity of Multicalibration with an ERM Oracle](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14363v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14363

**作者：** Princewill Okoroafor

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.DS、cs.GT

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14363v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14363v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究在只能通过 ERM oracle 访问 auditor 函数类时学习多校准（multicalibration）预测器所需样本量，给出约 O(d/ε³) 的算法与匹配下界，并说明 oracle 效率在维度项上多付 1/ε 的代价，还比较了 swap 多校准与误差估计的计算难度。

**相关性简评：** 以函数类作为 auditor 审计各子群可靠性的框架，以及统计样本量与计算（oracle 调用）代价之间的权衡，可能为 LVR 中按 latent 假设分组核验证据、评估动态计算收益与成本提供概念类比，但属于较远领域，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The Sample Complexity of Multicalibration with an ERM Oracle

**abstract/A1：** A predictor is multicalibrated with respect to a class of subpopulations (formally, of functions on the inputs, called auditors) if, for every subpopulation in the class and every value the predictor outputs, the average outcome among the members of that subpopulation who receive that value is close to the value itself. For finite classes, about $\\varepsilon^{-3}$ samples are necessary and sufficient to learn a predictor with multicalibration error $\\varepsilon$, but the algorithms that attain this rate enumerate the class, which is impossible for the large classes of interest. We ask how many samples suffice when the learner accesses the class only through an empirical risk minimization (ERM) oracle. We give an algorithm that uses $\\tilde{O}(d/\\varepsilon^{3})$ samples and polynomially many ERM calls, where $d$ is the VC dimension of the class. Its dependence on $\\varepsilon$ is optimal for all learners. When $d$ is at least about $1/\\varepsilon$, every learner that can only access the class through polynomially many ERM calls needs $\\tildeΩ(d/\\varepsilon^{3})$ samples. Learners with unlimited computation need only $\\tilde{O}(\\varepsilon^{-3}+d\\varepsilon^{-2})$ samples, so the extra factor $1/\\varepsilon$ on the dimension term is the price of oracle efficiency. For swap multicalibration, which allows a different function from the class for each predicted value, $\\tildeΘ(d/\\varepsilon^{3})$ samples are necessary and sufficient. For estimating the error of a given predictor, the ordinary notion is the harder one: the swap error can be estimated with an ERM oracle, whereas the ordinary error is NP-hard to approximate even for classes with linear-time ERM. Consequently, there are classes for which it is computationally easier to learn a multicalibrated predictor than to compute the multicalibration error of a given predictor.

**comment/C1：** 58 pages

</details>

### 573. [A Gated Catchment Hydrology Model (GCHM) for Physically-Interpretable Rainfall-Evapotranspiration-Runoff Simulation Across Diverse Hydroclimatic Regimes](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14493v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14493

**作者：** M Jawad、HV Gupta、MA Farmani、A Behrangi、GY Niu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14493v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14493v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 GCHM：基于质量守恒感知机的门控流域水文模型，用冠层截留、雪、土壤水、地下水、径流生成五个储量状态与受约束门控刻画降水分配、蒸散、入渗、基流等过程，在 50 个 CAMELS 流域上以 JKGE 评估，并与消融变体和 RNN 基准比较。

**相关性简评：** 其「显式状态 + 受约束门控」的隐状态设计、状态可解释性与消融分析，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的职责划分、各状态对输出的贡献分配提供可供核查的类比，但领域相距较远，联系属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A Gated Catchment Hydrology Model (GCHM) for Physically-Interpretable Rainfall-Evapotranspiration-Runoff Simulation Across Diverse Hydroclimatic Regimes

**abstract/A1：** Recent advances in machine learning have improved rainfall-runoff prediction, yet most data-driven models remain difficult to interpret and do not explicitly enforce physical conservation laws. We present the Gated Catchment Hydrology Model (GCHM), a mass-conserving architecture based on the Mass-Conserving Perceptron (MCP). GCHM uses five storage states representing canopy interception, snow, soil moisture, groundwater, and streamflow generation. Constrained gates govern precipitation partitioning, evapotranspiration, infiltration, seepage, runoff, and baseflow while learning context-dependent process relationships. We evaluate GCHM across 50 CAMELS catchments spanning snowmelt-dominated, recent-rainfall, historical-rainfall, and arid regimes, using NOAA AORC meteorological forcing and remotely sensed vegetation and land-surface data. Performance is assessed using the Jawad-Kling-Gupta Efficiency (JKGE) metric, which accounts for stationary and non-stationary hydrologic behavior. We compare the full architecture with ablated variants and recurrent neural network benchmarks. GCHM reproduces streamflow dynamics across diverse hydroclimatic regimes, including arid catchments, while maintaining interpretable states and fluxes. Ablation experiments show that simplified architectures may perform adequately under wet conditions but struggle to represent flow persistence and recession during dry periods, when groundwater storage sustains low flows. Learned gates recover hydrologically plausible relationships governing snowmelt, runoff, seepage, and evapotranspiration. GCHM combines competitive predictive performance with mass conservation and interpretability, providing a foundation for hydrologic modeling and counterfactual analysis.

</details>

### 574. [Rethinking Activation Functions: Reducing Bias Can Improve Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14500v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14500

**作者：** Zirui Peng、Heyi Zheng、Ziming Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14500v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14500v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究激活函数普遍存在的「activation bias」（激活后均值非零）对学习动态的影响：用受控模型证明该偏差加速早期损失下降但带来过冲、不平滑轨迹和更陡的损失面，减小偏差会减慢早期学习却得到更低最终损失，在较大视觉与语言模型上也观察到类似规律。

**相关性简评：** 作者指出模型会利用编码在激活偏置分量中的任务相关信息，这一内部信息通道与损失面几何，可能为 latent 推理状态的表示几何、优化稳定性与训练监督提供可供核查的类比线索，但论文本身未涉及多模态推理或 LVR。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Rethinking Activation Functions: Reducing Bias Can Improve Learning

**abstract/A1：** Many widely used activation functions, including ReLU, GELU, Swish, and Sigmoid, produce predominantly positive outputs, resulting in a nonzero post-activation mean that we term activation bias. Despite its ubiquity, the effect of activation bias on learning dynamics remains poorly understood. Using controlled models, we show that activation bias accelerates initial loss reduction but is accompanied by overshooting, non-smooth trajectories, and a steeper loss landscape. This early advantage also coincides with the model's use of task-relevant information encoded in the activation bias component. In contrast, reducing activation bias slows initial learning but ultimately yields a lower final loss. Experiments on larger vision and language models exhibit a similar pattern: smaller activation bias is associated with better late-stage performance. Thus, this seemingly minor property can substantially redirect learning and warrants explicit consideration in future activation function design.

**comment/C1：** 26 pages, 21 figures, 2 tables

</details>

### 575. [Spatiotemporal Recognition of Abdominal Wall Layers During Optical Trocar Entry](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14512v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14512

**作者：** Shreeram Athreya、Andrew Melehy、Carter Prentice、Michael Robinson、Corey Arnold、James Wu、William Speier

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14512v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14512v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究光学套管针进入时腹壁组织层次的时空识别：将每帧划分为 28 个极坐标网格扇区，用颜色、邻域与位置特征训练梯度提升发射分类器，再叠加时序平滑、空间正则、解剖有序隐马尔可夫模型与后验融合，并评估腹膜起始时点的定位误差。

**相关性简评：** 其以邻域和位置特征聚合局部证据、用有序隐状态做时序平滑与后验混合、并量化起始时点误差与「依赖未来观测」的设定，或可作为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、latent 状态时序一致性与状态转移/停止判定的远域类比线索，但跨界较远，需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Spatiotemporal Recognition of Abdominal Wall Layers During Optical Trocar Entry

**abstract/A1：** Objective. To evaluate whether spatial context and temporal modeling improve tissue recognition during optical trocar entry, where multiple abdominal-wall tissues may be visible simultaneously. Methods. We retrospectively analyzed 71 recordings with 1,516 annotated keyframes and 29,151 clinician-annotated sectors. Each frame was divided into 28 polar-grid sectors assigned to nine tissue classes. Color, neighboring-sector, and positional features were used by a gradient-boosted emission classifier. The full pipeline added learned temporal smoothing, spatial regularization, an anatomically ordered hidden Markov model, and posterior blending. Five-fold cross-validation was grouped by recording, with cross-fitting to prevent within-recording leakage. Primary evaluation used clinician-derived targets; ablations assessed classification, probability quality, spatial consistency, and peritoneum-or-deeper onset timing. Results. The complete pipeline achieved accuracy 0.646, macro-F1 0.507, and macro-AUROC 0.882, versus 0.600, 0.440, and 0.861 for emissions alone. Macro-F1 improved by 0.066 across all five folds. Label changes decreased from 66.2 to 19.5 per sector-minute, and median onset error decreased from 15.58 to 2.45 seconds. Frames with a tissue-depth-code span of at least three decreased from 53% to 26%, versus 22% for clinician annotations. Performance remained limited for preperitoneal fat and bowel, and the full model retained a 44% premature-onset proportion. Conclusions. Combining appearance, spatial context, and temporal constraints improved retrospective tissue recognition and onset localization. Tissue-specific limitations, residual timing errors, and reliance on future observations warrant external validation and prospective evaluation of causal models before clinical use.

**comment/C1：** 16 pages, 3 figures

</details>

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ScienceBuddy-PV: A Verifier-Governed Recursive Improvement Protocol for Panvascular Intervention Research

**abstract/A1：** ScienceBuddy-PV adapts the ScienceBuddy recursive-in-recursive design to panvascular intervention research through a structured evidence ledger, device-vessel ontology, abstention contract and retained failure bank. Recursive harness optimization and outer-loop model learning, including reinforcement learning, are specified but not executed. We audit a fixed component, rather than the complete agent system, using separate ARCADE syntax and stenosis tasks (1,000 training, 200 validation and 300 test images per task). A shared task-masked convolutional model was trained once per representation setting; its parameters and the heuristic support gate were then held fixed, with the stenosis threshold selected on validation data. On the locked test sets, syntax Dice was 0.475 (95% CI 0.459-0.490) and stenosis Dice was 0.231 (95% CI 0.214-0.249). Stenosis pixel AUROC was 0.957 and AUPRC was 0.180 at prevalence 0.00975. The gate accepted 76.7% of stenosis-frame outputs versus 100% for a score-only comparator. In a constructed mask audit, it accepted 44.3% of reference candidates and rejected 55.7%, exposing the cost of abstention. Acceptance does not establish correctness or clinical safety. This public-data component audit makes support and abstention measurable and provides a reproducible protocol for future collaborative agent studies. It does not demonstrate recursive improvement, patient-level validity or clinical device recommendations.

**comment/C1：** 17 pages, 17 figures, 19 references. Public-data component audit; recursive improvement is specified as a protocol and not experimentally demonstrated

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14525

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文从能量视角重审 Test-Time Discovery，指出已知/未知类之间的能量差易坍缩，遂提出 Energy Ring：用轻量适配器在保持已知类方向的前提下扩大范数能量间隔，用扰动一致性模块聚集未知类，并在测试时以能量引导的置信加权和基于稳定性的校正机制抑制不可靠更新。

**相关性简评：** 其特征能量/范数几何与「已知-未知特征坍缩」的诊断思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态表示坍缩与视觉证据筛选提供类比评价线索，稳定性校正机制也与 latent 更新可靠性的判断形式相通，但领域相距较远，可比性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Energy Ring: Stabilizing Feature Energy for Reliable Test-Time Discovery

**abstract/A1：** Test-Time Discovery (TTD) aims to recognize known classes and detect novel ones while the model is already deployed, operating directly on a continual unlabeled test-time stream. Existing TTD methods are overly conservative, making known and unknown features collapse together and difficult to separate during test-time adaptation. In this paper, we revisit TTD from an energy perspective and find that the natural energy gap between known and unknown classes is unstable and easily collapses. We therefore propose Energy Ring to stabilize this gap by anchoring the two types of classes on separate energy rings. A lightweight adapter enlarges the norm-based gap while preserving known-class directions, and a perturbation consistency module forms compact clusters for unknown classes. During testing, energy-guided confidence weighting improves prediction, and a stability-based rectification mechanism corrects unreliable updates. Experimental results show that Energy Ring significantly improves TTD performance against existing TTD methods.

</details>

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FDE-Bench: Evaluating End-to-End Delivery from Underspecified Real-World Business Requests

**abstract/A1：** Real-world business requests often leave key requirements unstated because frontline practitioners struggle to articulate rules they know from experience. Forward-deployed engineers (FDEs) must elicit these requirements through dialogue and iteratively optimize solutions until they meet customer acceptance criteria. Existing optimization benchmarks typically start from explicit objectives, while clarification benchmarks often introduce information gaps into existing tasks. We introduce FDE-Bench, the first benchmark built from real customer projects to evaluate agents on end-to-end delivery tasks that require interactive requirement clarification and iterative optimization. Its 49 cases span combinatorial optimization and machine learning. Clarification targets are distilled from discussions between frontline practitioners and FDEs. Agents elicit missing requirements from a simulated customer, and case-specific evaluators assess final artifacts against acceptance criteria using customer-accepted FDE solutions as quality references. Across 18 agent configurations, the highest mean delivery score is only 0.5510, compared with an FDE reference of 1.0. The highest delivery success rate (DSR), defined as the fraction of planned runs reaching this reference, is only 6.12%. These results show that reliable FDE-level end-to-end delivery remains out of reach for the evaluated agents on underspecified real-world business tasks. The benchmark project page is available at https://baidubce.github.io/FM-Agent/FDE-Bench/.

</details>

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文是一篇关于语言智能体「递归自我改进」（RSI）的综述/立场论文，提出涵盖更新目标、更新组织、更新调度与范围、反馈与选择四组九个维度的统一分类法，并梳理其与优化、正则化、持续学习、进化计算及在线/离线评测基准的联系，以启发新研究思路。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接关系，但其「反馈与选择」「更新调度与范围」等设计维度可能为 latent 推理状态的迭代更新、轨迹训练中的贡献分配与监督组织提供类比线索，属远领域启发，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** From Existing Methods to New Research Ideas: Two Perspectives on Recursive Self-Improvement

**abstract/A1：** Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a route to AI systems that participate in their own continued development. Recent methods allow language agents to retain changes to their parameters, memory, skills, and code for subsequent execution and improvement. We examine how these methods can inform new research ideas through two complementary perspectives. First, we introduce a unified taxonomy with nine design dimensions organized into four groups: update targets, update organization, update schedule and scope, feedback and selection. This taxonomy places existing methods in a shared design space, where examining individual dimensions and their interactions can inspire new research ideas. Second, we examine how existing RSI methods draw on traditional deep learning, for example through optimization, regularization, data augmentation, continual learning, and adversarial learning. We develop further ideas by examining more specific learning mechanisms and drawing on evolutionary computation. We also review how existing benchmarks assess self-improvement under online, offline, and offline-to-online settings. Together, these perspectives help researchers develop new RSI research ideas from existing designs and learning mechanisms. RSI papers and resources are available at https://prism-shadow.github.io/awesome-rsi/.

</details>

### 580. [TagBO: LLM-Driven Task-Aware Graph Bayesian Optimization for Scientific Discovery](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14626v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14626

**作者：** Xinzhe Yuan、Zimu Zeng、Zhuo Chen、Jianshu Zhang、Jinzong Dong、Jingyi Chen、Nanyang Ye、Huan Xiong、Qinying Gu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14626v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14626v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 TagBO，将 LLM 输出的关系判断视为可能含噪的任务感知序关系先验，与结构描述符共同构建相似度表示，并在混合离散-连续空间上做受约束高斯过程贝叶斯优化，用于化学与材料配方的样本高效搜索。

**相关性简评：** 其「LLM 输出不宜直接当预测分数、需与任务目标对齐」以及用有限昂贵评估决定下一步取点的思路，可能与 LVR 中 latent 相似度的内容对齐、LLM 监督噪声处理及证据获取与停止的成本权衡存在可供核查的概念联系，属推测性借鉴。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TagBO: LLM-Driven Task-Aware Graph Bayesian Optimization for Scientific Discovery

**abstract/A1：** Mixed-variable optimization in scientific discovery often requires exploring large combinatorial spaces under costly experimental evaluations, making sample?efficient Bayesian optimization (BO) essential. However, existing BO methods typ?ically rely on structural descriptors to define similarity among categorical variables, implicitly assuming that structural similarity reflects similarity in task performance. In scientific optimization, this assumption is often violated, leading to surrogate representations that are poorly aligned with the optimization objective. To address this limitation, we propose TagBO (Task-aware Graph Bayesian Optimization), a method that integrates LLM-derived relational priors with descriptor-based struc?tural information for mixed-variable Bayesian optimization. Rather than directly using LLM outputs as predictive scores, TagBO treats LLM outputs as a potentially noisy source of task-aware relational priors and extracts coarse ordinal relational signals from LLM reasoning to construct task-aware similarity structures for scien?tific optimization. TagBO then performs constrained Gaussian process Bayesian optimization over the resulting joint discrete-continuous representation space. Ex?periments on diverse chemistry and materials formulation tasks demonstrate that TagBO consistently improves sample efficiency under fixed evaluation budgets across LLMs of varying capabilities.

**comment/C1：** NeurIPS 2026 spotlight poster accepted

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14647

**作者：** Yuyi Zhi、Min Du、Bill Shi、Guodong Yuan、Junheng Liang、Peifan Liao、Xin Guan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.RO

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文以两个固定评测协议的案例，检验合成 UAV 图像基准能否保持真实数据上的模型选择结论，并用 bootstrap 与规模匹配重采样分析排序反转，另审计五个业务场景的类别、密度与目标尺度失配。

**相关性简评：** 其关于「合成基准的可信度是条件性的、语义覆盖不足以保证模型排序」的论证，可能启发对 LVR 评测协议（如合成或构造工作量、小目标等细粒度证据）能否支撑方法排序的核查；bootstrap 反转检验亦可作为比较 latent 方案收益是否稳健的候选手段。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Can Synthetic UAV Benchmarks Be Trusted? Real-Synthetic Validation for UAV Model Selection

**abstract/A1：** Synthetic UAV imagery can expand pre-deployment test evidence when task-specific Real data are scarce, but visual plausibility or semantic label alignment alone does not establish validity for model selection. We study when Synthetic evaluation preserves the model-selection conclusions obtained from Real UAV data through two complementary cases under fixed evaluation protocols. In a requirement-specific road-debris benchmark, four language-conditioned perception systems obtain lower absolute F1 on Synthetic data, yet the point-estimate ordering and top-ranked model are preserved; bootstrap analysis yields no supported pairwise reversal, and size-matched resampling preserves the top-model decision. In contrast, a closed-set stress test on a separately materialized business corpus, using four VisDrone-compatible detectors over eight empirically supported classes, changes the point-estimate top-ranked detector and reverses three of six pairwise point-estimate preference directions. A complementary audit of five UAV business scenarios further reveals substantial Real-Synthetic mismatch in class composition, object density, and target scale, including systematic under-representation of small targets. These results show that Synthetic UAV benchmark trust is conditional: semantic coverage is insufficient, and validity must be established empirically for the task, operating regime, and model panel of interest.

**comment/C1：** 8 pages, 5 figures

</details>

### 582. [RASSG: Repair-Aware Semantic Survival Gating for Streaming Tool Execution](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14659v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14659

**作者：** Daijin Hu、Xi Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14659v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14659v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究流式语音助手中工具提前启动的执行风险：用户随后的自我纠正会使看似稳定的参数失效，导致过期执行且效果不可逆。作者提出 RASSG，以连续三次识别结果参数一致作为启动条件，并在效果不可逆前结合校准的参数失效风险与执行成本决定是否取消，在 ReCAST 等数据集上用受控执行时钟评估。

**相关性简评：** 其「证据稳定才提交、在不可逆前取消」的联合控制，可能与 LVR 中 STOP 决策及动态计算、证据获取的收益—成本权衡形成类比，可供核查停止准则与不可逆承诺的建模；但领域相距较远，迁移需较多工作。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RASSG: Repair-Aware Semantic Survival Gating for Streaming Tool Execution

**abstract/A1：** Streaming speech assistants can launch tools before users finish speaking, overlapping execution with incoming speech to reduce user waiting time. However, subsequent self-corrections can invalidate apparently stable arguments, causing stale execution whose irreversible effects persist even after the final call is corrected. We propose Repair-Aware Semantic Survival Gating (RASSG) to jointly control tool launch and cancellation during streaming speech. RASSG launches a tool when three consecutive speech recognition results arrive with identical nonempty arguments, then combines calibrated argument invalidity risk with execution costs to decide cancellation at the last feasible opportunity before effects become irreversible. Evaluation on ReCAST, FDB-v3, and Audio2Tool uses a controlled execution clock with fixed tool runtimes and cancellation parameters. On ReCAST's prospective-repair subset, RASSG reduces the stale execution rate from LocalAgreement-2's 50.00% to 3.15%, with a mean delay of 3.676s across successful trajectories. The stale reduction also holds against every early-execution baseline on both public speech datasets. Ablations with identical initial launches support active cancellation, showing the value of controlling ongoing calls before their effects become irreversible. Code and data are available at https://github.com/daijinhu/RASSG.

</details>

### 583. [Understanding Hidden Spatial Preferences in Bayesian Optimization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14696v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14696

**作者：** Maria Bånkestad、Jens Sjölund

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14696v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14696v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究贝叶斯优化中高斯过程后验方差在边界、棱角处的系统性偏置如何影响探索，通过空间权重场解耦预测模型与探索项的偏好，并借助神经代理摊销其构造，在基准函数和机器人推物任务上比较三种探索原则。

**相关性简评：** 其「不确定性并非空间中性、会隐式决定探索位置」的论点，可能为 LVR 中 LOOK/证据获取的偏好偏置与动态计算分配提供类比线索，但领域相隔较远，需人工核查迁移价值。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Understanding Hidden Spatial Preferences in Bayesian Optimization

**abstract/A1：** Bayesian optimization uses posterior uncertainty to decide where to explore, but this uncertainty is not spatially neutral. On bounded domains, Gaussian-process posterior variance is typically larger near faces, edges, and corners, giving variance-based acquisition functions a systematic boundary bias. This spatial preference is usually inherited from the surrogate rather than chosen as part of the exploration strategy. We separate these roles by keeping the predictive model fixed and modifying the spatial preference of the exploration term. We control the preference with spatial weight fields and amortize their construction with neural surrogates. Controlled experiments show that the Gaussian process' default boundary bias changes which parts of the domain are explored and which optima are reached. We compare three alternative exploration principles and find, across standard benchmark functions and stochastic robot-pushing tasks, that they can often lower regret, particularly early in the optimization. The spatial structure of posterior uncertainty is therefore not a neutral default: it shapes the exploration strategy and can materially affect optimization performance.

</details>

### 584. [DSABench: Benchmarking Source Discovery, Coordination, and Execution for Multi-Database Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14700v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14700

**作者：** Jinlong Luo、Haoran Wu、Bo Xu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14700v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14700v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** DSABench 面向大规模数据目录下的多数据库智能体，用 815 个任务联合评测来源发现、跨源协调与执行，并提供 RouteEnv 与澄清（clarification）协议，报告路由、协调与执行各阶段的成功率。

**相关性简评：** 该工作虽属纯文本多数据库场景，但其「先选证据来源、再协调依赖、必要时澄清」的评测设计，可能与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、动态获取与停止/澄清决策的评价方式可供核查，也可借鉴其把路由与执行分开度量的思路。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DSABench: Benchmarking Source Discovery, Coordination, and Execution for Multi-Database Agents

**abstract/A1：** Most text-to-SQL benchmarks provide the target database. In a large data catalog, however, choosing the sources is part of the problem: an agent must find every database needed for a request, determine how their results fit together, and execute the resulting workflow. We present DSABench to evaluate these capabilities jointly. Its 815 human-reviewed tasks draw on Spider, BIRD, and LiveSQLBench; 618 require several databases to contribute, and 105 allow more than one interpretation of the required sources. Executable contracts define source participation, cross-source dependencies, and source-local execution, while RouteEnv lets agents inspect public catalog evidence without revealing the gold annotations. In our routing-only study across seven model backends, the highest RA-Set score is 60.55%, compared with a highest RA-Graph score of 34.66% when coordination requirements are included. The gap becomes more pronounced when execution is required. Across four backends, median non-privileged Route+Exec-Graph success ranges from 6.69% to 7.98% without clarification and from 11.44% to 13.25% with one clarification; the best observed clarified configuration reaches 16.99%. On ambiguous tasks, clarification improves exact branch-source recovery by 39.8-43.2 percentage points. These findings illustrate why retrieving plausible databases or producing correct local SQL is not enough: an agent must carry the right information through the entire multi-database workflow.

**comment/C1：** 39 pages

</details>

### 585. [PixARG: Pixel-Asynchronous Retrieval-Augmented Diffusion for Fast and Realistic Image Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14713v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14713

**作者：** Zewei Xin、Qinya Li、Chaoyue Niu、Fan Wu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14713v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14713v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出检索增强扩散生成框架 PixARG：依据文本与检索图像的像素级亲和图构造异质噪声初始化，并配套像素级异步去噪调度器与时空去噪器，在显著减少扩散步数的同时提升真实感与语义对齐。

**相关性简评：** 图像生成与主线相隔较远，但「按亲和度分区调节噪声强度、并作像素级异步去噪」可能为 LVR 中按相关性动态分配计算、有选择地保留或扰动视觉证据提供可供核查的启发。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PixARG: Pixel-Asynchronous Retrieval-Augmented Diffusion for Fast and Realistic Image Generation

**abstract/A1：** While diffusion models achieve impressive image generation capabilities, they suffer from high computational costs, implausible artifacts, and limited adaptability to dynamic or private data due to static, centralized training. To address these, we propose PixARG, a novel retrieval-augmented generative framework that integrates dynamic real-world image retrieval into the diffusion pipeline to simultaneously enhance efficiency and visual realism. Specifically, PixARG constructs a pixel-level affinity map between the user's text prompt and the retrieved image to guide a heterogeneous noise initialization. By modulating noise intensity across spatial regions, this mechanism preserves semantically relevant structural priors while perturbing less relevant areas, thereby significantly accelerating convergence. To accommodate this spatially non-uniform noise and ensure synchronized generation, we introduce a pixel-wise asynchronous denoising scheduler and a spatiotemporal denoiser conditioned on the affinity map. Furthermore, we derive an affinity-adaptive training objective that elegantly balances deterministic restoration with stochastic regeneration across pixels. Experiments on LAION and COYO datasets across offline, online, and user-specific settings show PixARG enhances realism and semantic alignment while drastically reducing diffusion steps.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to ACM Multimedia 2026 (MM '26) as a poster presentation

</details>

### 586. [Multi-Token Random-Walk Learning via Meeting-Triggered Information Exchange](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14716v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14716

**作者：** Taichun Yeh、Xingran Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14716v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14716v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究去中心化学习中的多 token 随机游走，比较 token 相遇时「平均梯度」与「平均模型」两种信息交换策略，在完全图上给出非凸、凸与强凸目标的迭代复杂度下界，并实验对比两者在平均 token 损失与最优 token 损失上的差异。

**相关性简评：** 多 token 并行探索、相遇触发交换以及「并行探索 vs 梯度干扰」的权衡，可能为 LVR 中多个并行 latent 假设的信息交换、聚合与按均值/最优评价提供概念类比，具体对应关系可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Multi-Token Random-Walk Learning via Meeting-Triggered Information Exchange

**abstract/A1：** Random walk (RW)-based algorithms are widely used in decentralized learning due to their low communication overhead and scalability. While most existing methods rely on a single token, multiple tokens can explore the network in parallel and exchange information upon meeting. However, the fundamental benefits of such meeting-triggered interactions remain unclear. In this work, we investigate multi-token RW learning under two information exchange policies: \\textsc{Average-Gradient} and \\textsc{Average-Model}, which average stochastic gradients and updated models, respectively, when tokens meet. We establish iteration complexity lower bounds for non-convex, convex, and strongly convex objectives on complete graphs, which apply to both exchange policies. Compared with single-token RW learning, the scaling factor in these bounds is reduced by a factor of $m^2$ for non-convex and convex objectives, and by an exponentially in $m$ for strongly convex objectives, where $m$ denotes the number of tokens. Numerical experiments reveal distinct behaviors of the two policies under two performance criteria: mean-token loss (the average loss across all tokens) and best-token loss (the minimum loss across all tokens). \\textsc{Average-Model} achieves lower mean-token loss and is relatively insensitive to the network-to-token ratio $N/m$, where $N$ is the number of nodes. In contrast, \\textsc{Average-Gradient} achieves lower best-token loss but exhibits a trade-off between parallel exploration and gradient interference as $N/m$ decreases.

</details>

### 587. [More Domains, No Gains? FLO: Fast-Slow Reciprocal Learning for Multi-Domain Graph Pre-training](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14748v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14748

**作者：** Yupeng Tong、Lianze Shan、Jitao Zhao、Di Jin、Dongxiao He

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14748v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14748v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文指出多域图预训练中「域越多收益越少」，归因于单一消息传递范式的局限与域对齐中的跨域干扰，并提出 FLO：用无传播的属性分支预测节点关系并回馈模型，同时以快、慢双过程稳定跨域知识获取。

**相关性简评：** 「快过程适配当前域、慢过程整合跨域知识」的双时间尺度更新，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的循环更新与稳定性提供类比线索；无消息传递的预测分支回馈主模型，也可供核查旁路信息是否真正被使用的类似问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** More Domains, No Gains? FLO: Fast-Slow Reciprocal Learning for Multi-Domain Graph Pre-training

**abstract/A1：** Inspired by the great success of foundation models in the development of artificial general intelligence, Graph Foundation Models (GFMs) have recently attracted significant attention and have the potential to advance graph intelligence. Exhibiting such intelligence requires effectively learning knowledge from large-scale, multi-domain graph data during pre-training. Increasing domain diversity during pre-training is expected to yield richer and more generalizable knowledge. Most existing methods pursue this goal by designing domain alignment strategies that help a single graph model learn from multiple domains. However, we observe that existing methods struggle to benefit from increasing domain diversity. Through empirical and theoretical analysis, we reveal two key limitations. Firstly, pre-training in most GFMs is confined to a single message-passing paradigm. Since propagation flattens relations among neighboring nodes, the graph model can hardly perceive the knowledge beyond propagation, namely the attribute-predictable component of these relations. Secondly, domain alignment strategies often rely on randomly initialized parameters that are jointly updated with the graph model using immediate loss feedback, leaving early knowledge acquisition vulnerable to cross-domain interference. To address these issues, we propose FLO, a Fast--sLow reciprOcal approach for multi-domain graph pre-training. Specifically, a propagation-free attribute branch predicts the graph model's relations without message passing and returns these predictions to refine the model. We further stabilize knowledge acquisition by pairing a fast process that adapts to the current domain with a slow process that integrates knowledge across domains. On 12 datasets, FLO benefits from increasing domain diversity and achieves the best average performance in cross-domain and cross-task transfer.

**comment/C1：** 28pages,7 figures

</details>

### 588. [Formalizing Forgetting: Theory of Forgetting for Online Continual Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14787v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14787

**作者：** Renjie Cao、Yifei Cheng、Li Shen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14787v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14787v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在强凸与一般凸目标下分析单遍 Shuffle SGD 的在线持续学习，给出期望最终遗忘量的显式上界，并讨论每任务数据量、任务相似度与任务顺序如何进入该上界，再用 Split-CIFAR-100、PMNIST 上的神经网络实验佐证趋势。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接联系，但其关于任务顺序、相似度和数据量如何决定遗忘的理论刻画，可能为分析多阶段或序列化训练 latent 推理轨迹时早期推理能力被覆盖的问题提供概念框架，需人工核查其凸设定能否外推到 VLM。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Formalizing Forgetting: Theory of Forgetting for Online Continual Learning

**abstract/A1：** Online continual learning (OCL) requires a learner to acquire a sequence of tasks in a single pass over the data, and catastrophic forgetting of earlier tasks remains its central challenge. Despite the many methods proposed to mitigate forgetting, the theoretical understanding of forgetting in OCL is still limited: existing analyses mostly focus on linear, overparameterized, or neural tangent kernel regimes, and it remains unclear which factors govern forgetting and how they affect it. To fill this gap, we analyze single-pass Shuffle SGD under strongly convex and general convex objectives and derive explicit upper bounds on the expected final forgetting. Further analysis of these bounds shows how the per-task data amount, task similarity, and task ordering enter them, and that their effects can differ across objective classes. Moreover, experiments with neural networks on Split-CIFAR-100 and PMNIST show that the trends suggested by our theory also appear in practice, indicating that these insights extend beyond the convex setting.

</details>

### 589. [Counterfactual Regret for Reflective Agents with Lean-Verified Guarantees](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14790v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14790

**作者：** Zhongnian Li、Shi Xu、Mengting Xu、Peng Ying、Xinzheng Xu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14790v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14790v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文为复用反馈与记忆、不更新权重的反思型语言智能体，从局部生成与部署保证推导次线性反事实遗憾的充分条件，并在 Lean 中形式化验证十三条理论结果。

**相关性简评：** 其资源约束下质量、覆盖与硬预算的权衡，以及反事实遗憾对策略选择与长期表现的界定，可能为 LVR 中 latent 轨迹的贡献分配、动态计算与停止决策提供问题表述或评价视角，可供核查能否迁移到多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Counterfactual Regret for Reflective Agents with Lean-Verified Guarantees

**abstract/A1：** Reflective language agents reuse feedback and memory to adapt across tasks without updating model weights. However, existing guarantees for policy selection and action generation do not by themselves establish when local reflection yields long-term performance guarantees for the complete agent under resource constraints. In this paper, we address this gap by deriving sufficient conditions for sublinear counterfactual regret from local generation and deployment guarantees, while retaining the native controller. Specifically, we establish a resource-sensitive transfer that bounds full-state deployment discrepancies along actual execution paths and preserves the own-history laws of both learner and comparator. Besides, local generation reliability yields a cumulative generation opportunity bound, linking policy acquisition to long-term performance through an explicit quality, coverage, and hard-budget tradeoff. To verify these guarantees, we formalize the conditional proof chain for all thirteen numbered theoretical results in Lean, including a native instance with repeated policy growth and imperfect validation.

</details>

### 590. [GREAT-ESDD: Graph Edge Attention Network for Effectively Steered Delivery Decisions](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14792v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14792

**作者：** Attila Lischka、Ze Zhou、Xuegang、Ban、Balázs Kulcsár

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14792v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14792v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对当日达配送，提出基于 Graph-Edge-Attention-Network 的神经 CVRP 求解器，批量快速估算上门与外部取货点的路径成本并据此动态定价，再用 Thompson 采样与 Laplace 近似后验在线学习顾客偏好，把顾客引导至成本更低的外部取货方式。

**相关性简评：** 其图边注意力神经求解器对组合状态的表示与部分执行路径的在线重优化，以及用近似后验信念状态驱动决策的做法，可能为 LVR 的状态抽象、动态计算与决策/停止策略提供远域线索，但联系间接，需人工核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GREAT-ESDD: Graph Edge Attention Network for Effectively Steered Delivery Decisions

**abstract/A1：** Online, same-day delivery requires operators to constantly update their routes, and the routing cost for deliveries increases with the number of customers. Out-of-home (OOH) delivery options can help companies handle increasing customer numbers while keeping delivery costs low. We develop a dynamic pricing-and-routing framework for this online ordering scenario with home and OOH delivery options. First, we develop a neural solver for the capacitated vehicle routing problem (CVRP) based on the Graph-Edge-Attention-Network (GREAT). We train it to solve CVRP with varying instance sizes and starting conditions, allowing it to reoptimize partially executed routes under changing conditions. It is fast while achieving solution quality competitive with traditional baselines. Our solver processes several CVRP instances in parallel in batches and we use it to solve the candidate routing problems that arise from an incoming customer's choice of home or OOH delivery. This provides an estimate of the delivery cost increase per option, which we use to set dynamic prices. Further, it directly provides the updated route once the customer decides. We trade off delivery fees against routing costs and steer customers toward OOH delivery when home delivery would be costly. However, effective steering requires us to know the customer preferences. To learn those online, we use Thompson sampling with a Laplace-approximated posterior. We call the resulting framework GREAT-ESDD (GREAT for Effectively Steered Delivery Decisions). Compared to a traditional routing solver, it increases profit by around 11% under a similar pricing decision time budget. Moreover, we show that we can estimate customer preferences successfully, outperforming a static pricing strategy after only 5 days of simulated operations.

**comment/C1：** 28 pages, 12 figures

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 ASIWorld：一个持久化世界与角色状态的生存沙盒基准，让智能体在部分观测、延迟效应和相互依赖的任务（生产与探索）中执行长期目标，并以任务成功、成就达成和生存成本及执行轨迹来评估，对九种智能体配置做了探索性研究。

**相关性简评：** 该基准关注部分观测下的持久状态、延迟效应与跨模型调用的持续程序，可能为 LVR 中跨调用维持的推理状态、状态抽象与停止/成本决策提供问题表述上的启发；但全文未涉及视觉表征或 latent 推理，联系需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ASIWorld: Benchmarking Autonomous Agents in a Persistent Survival Sandbox

**abstract/A1：** Evaluating autonomous agents requires examining whether they can translate goals into coherent action across extended interactions. In persistent environments, this requires coordinating interdependent actions under incomplete observations, accounting for delayed effects, and adapting as earlier decisions shape subsequent opportunities. We introduce ASIWorld, a survival sandbox that combines persistent world and character state with character-scoped observations and a programmable asynchronous interface to study sustained goal execution. Agents pursue interdependent production and exploration tasks through direct actions or agent-authored programs that continue running between model calls. The evaluation assesses task success, the attainment of development achievements, and survival costs, complemented by an analysis of execution behavior. In an exploratory study of nine agent configurations using a common harness, eight complete the production task and six complete both tasks. Analyses of execution trajectories and performance across difficulty levels reveal different preparation, combat, and recovery behaviors among configurations with similar task outcomes. Incomplete preparation is associated with stalled progression, while configurations that complete the tasks differ in survival costs and the fulfillment of additional achievement criteria. These findings illustrate the value of assessing sustained goal execution through both task outcomes and the behaviors and costs associated with achieving them.

**comment/C1：** 15 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. Project website: https://asigameworld.github.io/

</details>

### 592. [Groups Don't Move as One: A Bregman Clustering View of Linearized Group Influence](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14809v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14809

**作者：** Hyunho Choi、Jaeseung Heo、Youngbin Choi、MoonJeong Park、Dongwoo Kim

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14809v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14809v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文为线性化群组影响给出 Bregman 质心形式化，用 Bregman information 量化被求和聚合掩盖的成员间差异，进一步按簇分解群组影响并联合优化各簇贡献权重，以更好预测目标变化。

**相关性简评：** 研究主题本身属训练数据影响估计，与 LVR 主线距离较远；但「用 Bregman 信息度量聚合所抹去的变异」可能可供核查 latent 状态聚合中的信息坍缩度量，簇分解贡献的思路也可能类比推理轨迹的贡献分配，需读原文确认可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Groups Don't Move as One: A Bregman Clustering View of Linearized Group Influence

**abstract/A1：** Influence functions provide an efficient alternative to retraining for assessing the effects of removing or reweighting training data. For groups, however, the standard first-order estimate reduces individual contributions to a sum that can conceal substantial differences among members, including opposing effects that cancel. We establish a Bregman centroid formulation of the linearized group influence objective, interpreting this aggregate as a single representative and using Bregman information (BI) to quantify the variation it omits. Extending this formulation to multiple clusters reveals distinct contributions whose sum recovers the original estimate. We further propose an estimator that jointly optimizes the weights of these cluster contributions, rather than simply summing them. Experiments uncover cluster-specific influence patterns and a positive association between target-specific BI and approximation error. The proposed estimator achieves higher $R^2$ than standard group influence in predicting target changes under the nonlinear proximal Bregman response function. Simplified clustering and correction variants reduce computational cost. The centroid view thus explains what additive group influence leaves out and provides a basis for using that information to improve estimation.

</details>

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 EvoCowork，一个覆盖演示、文档、表格与跨办公流程的 240 任务基准，在固定模型权重下评估 harness 层面的递归自我改进，并把反馈、修订选择与最终测试分离，同时记录能力、迁移与成本。

**相关性简评：** 其「反馈任务上的提升未必迁移到协调型流程」这一观测与分离式评测协议，可供核查 LVR 中训练所得推理程序是否真正迁移（如长度与任务泛化）以及计算预算的记账方式；但对象是办公 agent harness，联系较远，属可能的概念借鉴。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** EvoCowork: A Benchmark for Real-World Office Tasks

**abstract/A1：** Office workflows are a demanding testbed for self-improving agents because their deliverables must be correct, natively editable, and mutually consistent. A central question is whether gains on feedback tasks reflect reusable procedures rather than task-specific fixes. We introduce EvoCowork, a 240-task benchmark for evaluating harness-level recursive self-improvement across four office modalities, with model weights held fixed. The benchmark covers presentations, documents, spreadsheets, and cross-office workflows, and scores submitted artifacts for content, native structure, formulas, cross-file consistency, and visual quality where needed. Its protocol separates feedback, revision selection, and final testing: methods learn from single-modality tasks, then are evaluated on unseen single-modality tasks and cross-office workflows under a shared initial harness and explicit budgets. In static evaluations of two models and four harnesses, the best configuration scores 42.25 overall and 30.62 on cross-office tasks. Starting from the same MSA harness with GLM 5.3, ACE and AHE improve in-domain scores by 4.90 and 2.64 points, respectively, but change cross-office scores by only +0.03 and -1.72. Thus, gains on the file types that provide feedback do not necessarily transfer to coordinated workflows. EvoCowork makes this distinction explicit while recording the capability, transfer, and cost of harness evolution. Code and task packages: https://github.com/DeepThinkingZhouLiu/cowork-evolution-benchmark.

### 594. [Sequence-Structured Decision Learning for Branch-and-Bound in Mixed-Integer Linear Programming](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14835v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14835

**作者：** Tengfei Liu、Jinrun Liu、Bai Yan、Yuhui Shi、Qi Zhao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14835v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14835v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Seq-BnB，将分支定界中节点创建、更新、选择与分支事件序列化为带类型的 token，用自注意力编码全局搜索历史，配合二部图神经网络编码当前 LP 松弛，并以 DAgger 式数据聚合训练分支与节点选择策略，在四个 MILP 基准上处理更少节点。

**相关性简评：** 该工作来自组合优化，但把演进中的搜索过程写成因果事件序列并用全局表示驱动决策，与 LVR 中「推理轨迹的状态表示与更新」可能相通；其针对专家示范与学习策略分布偏移的 DAgger 式聚合，可供核查 latent 轨迹训练与监督分配问题，属推测性借鉴。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Sequence-Structured Decision Learning for Branch-and-Bound in Mixed-Integer Linear Programming

**abstract/A1：** Branch-and-bound (BnB) solves mixed-integer linear programs by constructing and exploring a search tree. Node selection and branching are two recurrent decisions that directly determine the tree. Learning-based approaches typically optimize either decision in isolation and condition on a mostly local view, leaving the coupled evolution of the search tree insufficiently modeled. This paper proposes Seq-BnB, a sequence-structured framework that learns branching and node selection from a shared global representation of the evolving BnB process. Seq-BnB serializes node creations, node updates, node-selection events, and branching events into typed tokens, producing a causal event sequence of the search trajectory. A self-attention encoder summarizes this global search history, a bipartite graph neural network encodes the current LP relaxation, and context-conditioned decision heads score branching variables and open nodes. To reduce distribution shift between expert demonstrations and learned policies, Seq-BnB is trained with DAgger-style data aggregation. On four MILP benchmark families, Seq-BnB consistently processes fewer BnB nodes than heuristic and learning-based baselines, with strong solution times on both standard and larger transfer instances. While this paper evaluates Seq-BnB instantiation for branching and node selection, it accommodates additional solver decisions, such as cut selection, by introducing new action tokens and decision heads.

</details>

### 595. [Pre-Registered Genesis Accounting for Recursive Self-Improvement: First Audited Operator-Genesis Events in a Physics-Discovery Runtime](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14843v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14843

**作者：** Wenbin Mao、Pei Zou

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14843v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14843v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出预注册的两级核算框架，区分机器在给定词表内产出的内容（M1）与机器自行撰写并注册进运行时的机制（M2），并在物理发现运行时中以留出验证证书审计首批「机制创生」事件。

**相关性简评：** 其「自撰机制 vs 复用给定词表」的核算、留出验证证书以及审计中发现评测协议泄漏（自变量由待检验律反推）的做法，可能为 LVR 中的 latent 贡献分配、视觉旁路与捷径检测、停止与验证信号提供借鉴，需核查迁移可行性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Pre-Registered Genesis Accounting for Recursive Self-Improvement: First Audited Operator-Genesis Events in a Physics-Discovery Runtime

**abstract/A1：** Claims of recursive self-improvement are easy to make and hard to falsify: did improvement come from re-using designer-provided mechanisms, or from mechanisms the system authored itself? We introduce a pre-registered, two-tier accounting: M1 counts machine-generated content instances within a designer-provided vocabulary, while M2 counts machine-authored mechanism types (new operators registered into the runtime's own vocabulary, with a held-out-validation certificate). We report the first audited M2 genesis events. In the primary event, depth-limited compositional search over elementary operators, judged by held-out R^2 on real NIST hydrogen Balmer measurements, produced the operator sq(inv(n)) = 1/n^2 -- the Rydberg-level form -- which no standard-library transform could express (held-out R^2: -0.546 best standard transform vs. 1.0000000 composed). A protocol flaw (independent variable built by inverting the very law under test) was caught in audit and repaired via an independent-label protocol; extrapolation to unseen levels (n=8,9 trained on n&lt;=7) attains relative error ~10^-6, four to six orders beyond the best standard operator. A second event independently recovered sqrt(inv(a)) -- Kepler's velocity law -- from JPL ephemeris vectors. Also incorporated: an audited compounding channel (first domain-level measurement: 1.109x accuracy ratio on a real held-out domain) and blind, decurated genesis exams whose honest tally is zero. The Kepler event passes line audit; the hydrogen gap reproduces on He II; the certificate is threshold-stable. Against eleven prior systems, the contribution is the measurement and governance of machine-authored mechanisms, not the search algorithm or rediscovered physics. Limitations: exams were curated by agents who knew the textbook answer, triggers manual, grammar observer-injected; both events demonstrate capability to author, not yet autonomous genesis.

**comment/C1：** 7 pages, 1 figure

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 CAST，一个拓扑感知的单目视频动作捕捉框架：当目标骨架拓扑与视频中主体不同时，用学到的局部旋转预测配合由预测全局骨骼方向引导的几何校正，并通过可观测性分析界定哪些旋转分量可由出射骨方向约束，再以可靠性门控按父到子顺序校正合成朝向；另提供因果流式变体与跨骨架基准评测。与 VLM 推理无关。

**相关性简评：** 属于动作捕捉这一远领域，但「可观测性分析界定哪些状态分量受观测约束、未约束部分交由学习预测器、以可靠性门控校正」的结构，可能为 LVR 中「哪些 latent 状态维度真正由视觉证据支撑、哪些需模型自行填补」以及证据筛选式更新提供类比性线索，需人工核查其可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CAST: Real-Time Motion Capture for Any Skeleton Topology

**abstract/A1：** This paper studies the problem of recovering motion from monocular video, even when the target skeleton topology differs from the subject observed in the video. Although previous methods have made efforts to resolve this problem, they remain vulnerable to joint-rotation errors that are coupled across the skeleton and can propagate along its kinematic hierarchy. To mitigate these errors, we present CAST, a topology-aware motion capture framework that combines learned local rotations with geometric correction guided by predicted global bone directions. Our observability analysis characterizes which rotational components can be constrained by outgoing bone directions. Guided by this analysis, GRACE uses reliability-gated alignment to correct composed orientations in parent-to-child order, leaving unconstrained components to the learned rotation predictor. The motion predictor and correction module are trained jointly with motion-derived supervision, using a frozen image encoder. Experiments under the TopoCap evaluation protocol show that the proposed framework improves motion recovery across different target topologies, including unseen structures. Reference-based cross-skeleton evaluation on a curated Mixamo benchmark and a user preference study further assess transfer to different target structures. A causal CAST-B variant achieves over 51 FPS on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU, with timing covering image encoding and motion prediction. Code repository: https://github.com/fankewen/CAST.

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14862v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14862v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该工作提出 CoDE，在共享三维体素网格上融合原子占据、实验电子密度及其梯度幅值，用通道式 ViT 做掩码原子/密度通道联合重建预训练，并在亲和力回归与口袋条件配体生成上评估冻结编码器。

**相关性简评：** 其「把不确定性、局部密度支持与结构坐标并列为多通道证据并联合重建」的表示与预训练思路，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据与置信度如何保留在 latent 状态、以及证据通道贡献分配提供可核查的类比线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Blending experimental electron density information to protein-ligand interaction

**abstract/A1：** Machine learning models for protein-ligand interactions commonly rely on atomic coordinates, which are constructed by fitting molecular models to experimental electron-density maps. However, most models represent each complex as a single fitted structure, which can omit information about conformational heterogeneity, positional uncertainty, and local density support for individual atoms at binding interfaces. To fill this gap, we present CoDE, a Coordinate and Density Encoder, pre-trained on experimental density maps. We represent each binding site on a shared three-dimensional voxel grid combining atomic occupancy, experimental electron density, and its gradient magnitude. Using approximately 100K curated complexes, we pre-train a channel-wise vision transformer to jointly reconstruct masked atomic and density channels, learning a representation that integrates structural and experimental information. We evaluate the frozen encoder on two downstream tasks: (i) binding-affinity regression under leakage-controlled splits and (ii) pocket-conditioned ligand generation. Across these settings, CoDE improves over an identically pre-trained coordinate-only encoder and remains competitive with task-specific baselines, showing that density complements fitted atomic coordinates for protein-ligand interaction modeling and that the density-blended representation is useful for structure-based ligand generation.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14875

**作者：** Francisco J. Sáez-Maldonado、Luis A. Ortega、Andrés R. Masegosa、Thomas D. Nielsen

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究对比学习表示的事后不确定性估计，提出基于线性化拉普拉斯近似（LLA）的框架：刻画对比目标的曲率并做半正定修正以获得有效局部高斯近似，再把编码器不确定性传播到下游检索与聚类决策，在宏基因组分箱和图像分类上验证校准与可靠核心选择。

**相关性简评：** 其对表示损失曲率与嵌入后验几何的分析，可能为 LVR 中评估 latent 视觉证据是否可靠、以及停止决策的置信依据提供可核查线索，但论文未涉及多模态推理状态生成，联系较为间接。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Contrastive Linearized Laplace: Loss Geometry, Valid Repairs, and Reliable Cores

**abstract/A1：** While contrastive learning is widely used to learn deterministic representations, it does not inherently provide estimates of uncertainty. Post-hoc uncertainty estimation methods, such as the Linearized Laplace approximation (LLA), offer a way to quantify uncertainty without retraining the encoder. However, we show that directly using the LLA induced distribution over the contrastive embedding does not yield reliable pointwise uncertainty estimates for downstream tasks: embedding variance alone does not reflect whether decisions such as nearest-neighbor retrieval or cluster assignment are stable. To address this limitation, we develop a post-hoc framework based on LLA that propagates encoder uncertainty through the downstream task. We characterize the curvature of contrastive objectives and introduce positive-semidefinite repairs where needed to obtain valid local Gaussian approximations without retraining the encoder. We test the proposed approach in metagenomic binning and image classification tasks. For metagenomic binning, posterior coassignment probabilities support consensus partitions and the selection of reliable cores, leading to improvements over existing baselines. Additional image classification experiments show calibration improvements on standard benchmarks and real histopathology datasets.

</details>

<a id="paper-599"></a>

### 599. [Prediction with Expert Advice under Heavy-Tailed Losses](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14904v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14904

**作者：** Yuki Shibukawa、Shinji Ito

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14904v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14904v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究重尾损失（(1+ε) 阶矩有界）下的专家建议预测问题，刻画 minimax 伪遗憾率与自受限环境中的间隙依赖下界，并提出无需已知 ε、θ 的自适应 Heavy-Tailed FTRL/OMD 算法。

**相关性简评：** 专家建议聚合与遗憾界可能为 LVR 中多个 latent 假设的动态筛选与计算预算分配提供理论表述工具，其重尾鲁棒性与自适应尺度线索可供核查；但原文不涉及多模态推理，联系属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Prediction with Expert Advice under Heavy-Tailed Losses

**abstract/A1：** We study prediction with expert advice over $T$ rounds with $K$ experts under heavy-tailed losses whose $(1+ε)$-moment is bounded by $θ&gt;0$ for some $ε\\in(0,1\]$. In this setting, existing algorithms designed for the case $ε=1$ can be suboptimal when $ε&lt;1$, suffering an additional polynomial dependence on $K$. We characterize the minimax pseudo-regret rate as $Θ((θT)^{\\frac{1}{1+ε}}(\\log K)^{\\fracε{1+ε}})$ and establish gap-dependent lower bounds in a self-bounded environment. To attain this minimax rate without prior knowledge of either $ε$ or $θ$, we propose Adaptive Heavy-Tailed FTRL, which uses robust data-dependent scale adaptation together with truncation. We further develop Adaptive Heavy-Tailed OMD, which likewise requires neither $ε$ nor $θ$ and achieves near-optimal regret guarantees in both adversarial and self-bounded environments. Finally, when $ε$ and $θ$ are known, an FTRL algorithm with Shannon-entropy regularization achieves optimal regret guarantees in both environments.

**comment/C1：** 49 pages

</details>

### 600. [Predicting how model propensities generalize out of distribution](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14937v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14937

**作者：** June Hunter、Lily Wen、Owen Terry、Johannes Taraz、Ben Cohen、Niels Warncke

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14937v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14937v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究语言模型行为倾向的分布外泛化：用 system prompt、few-shot、SFT、GRPO 等诱导方式增强某一倾向，构建跨诱导溢出矩阵，发现同种技术下不同模型溢出高度相关，而 SFT/GRPO 谱系不同；并观察到与目标倾向无关的 drift，以及 EFA 归出的三类特质簇，还测试了 LLM 能否预测溢出。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接关联，但该文用「跨诱导矩阵＋因子分析」刻画能力迁移/溢出的结构与可预测性，可能可供核查其思路能否用于评估 latent 推理能力在更长更难任务上的泛化与迁移预测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Predicting how model propensities generalize out of distribution

**abstract/A1：** How do language models generalize from their training data? This is a central challenge for alignment: models reliably learn their training distribution given enough samples, but we want models that behave well when deployed in new contexts. We study out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization of propensities. Our central experiment uses a range of elicitation techniques -- system prompting, few-shot learning, SFT on reference answers, and GRPO -- to increase a target propensity in a model, then measures how it spills over onto others across the resulting cross-elicitation matrices. We find that spillover is highly correlated between models when the same elicitation technique is used, but our SFT and GRPO runs induce different spillover profiles. Elicitation of benign traits can sometimes generalize towards undesired traits, for example a model trained to claim that it is sentient often becomes more power-seeking. We further find that spillover partially resembles trait correlations found in humans and identify three clusters of traits that account for about half of the variance using exploratory factor analysis (EFA). Across many elicitation runs, we observe that models change in characteristic ways that don't depend on the targeted trait, a phenomenon we refer to as drift. Drift moves Qwen3.5-9B towards its base model. When investigating if LLMs are able to predict spillover, we find that Claude Opus 5.5 predicts spillover slightly better than the models themselves, but worse than data-driven approaches using alternative elicitation methods or models. Overall, no single dominant predictor emerges, and generalization remains hard to predict. Code and data are available at https://github.com/nielsrolf/propensity-spillover.

**comment/C1：** 29 pages, 21 figures. Code and data: https://github.com/nielsrolf/propensity-spillover

</details>

### 601. [Engram Neuron Inspired Adaptive Memorization for Lifelong Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14940v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14940

**作者：** Suiyang Jiang、Bomin Wang、Hangqi Zhou、Jianfeng Feng、Xiahai Zhuang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14940v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14940v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文借鉴「印迹神经元」（engram neuron）的完整记忆生命周期，从梯度表示中构建结构化记忆，用它调节参数更新并指导记忆管理，在四个基准上验证长期任务序列中的稳定性与灵活适应。

**相关性简评：** 属持续学习领域，与 VLM 推理无直接关系，但其「由梯度表示构造结构化记忆并据此控制更新」的记忆生命周期视角，可能为 LVR 中推理状态的维护、记忆保留与新旧信息整合提供可核查的类比线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Engram Neuron Inspired Adaptive Memorization for Lifelong Learning

**abstract/A1：** Lifelong learning enables artificial systems to adapt to changing environments. To achieve this, an effective artificial learner should dynamically reorganize past and new experiences, maintaining stability while enabling flexible knowledge integration. However, existing efforts primarily mitigate catastrophic forgetting, lacking the ability to adaptively update memory akin to biological systems. Here, by integrating the full memory life cycle of engram neurons into artificial learners, we propose a framework that constructs a structured memory from gradient representations, which regulates parameter updates and guides memory management. Through comprehensive evaluations on four benchmarks, our approach shows promising lifelong learning capability, maintaining stability over long task sequences and supporting flexible adaptation. Beyond the performance gains, our approach offers a computational perspective on robust and flexible lifelong learning, echoing mechanisms observed in biological memory systems.

</details>

### 602. [Counterfactual Rollouts for Offline Contrastive Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14953v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14953

**作者：** Tingrui Huang、Ai Bo、Junzhe Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14953v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14953v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究离线目标条件强化学习中示范者持有隐藏信息造成的混杂问题，用混杂 MDP 形式化，引入反事实转移以区分数据可识别与不可识别的关联，并据此提出 CauCRL：从正负示范学习悲观反事实转移，在反事实 rollout 上训练 critic，在混杂任务上提升成功率。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接关联，但因果可识别性、正负示范对比与反事实 rollout 可能为 latent 轨迹训练、负例监督以及「latent 内容是否被因果使用」的评估提供概念线索，需人工核查其可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Counterfactual Rollouts for Offline Contrastive Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning

**abstract/A1：** Contrastive reinforcement learning (CRL) learns goal-conditioned values by associating state--action pairs with the states subsequently reached, assuming that no unobserved variable jointly affects the recorded action and its outcome. When offline demonstrations come from a demonstrator with information hidden from the learner, this assumption fails and the critic absorbs spurious action--outcome associations. We formalize this setting with confounded Markov decision processes and introduce counterfactual transitions that separate what the data identify from what they do not; minimizing over all compatible transitions yields a worst-case occupancy that lower-bounds the true one. Causal Contrastive Reinforcement Learning (CauCRL) learns a pessimistic counterfactual transition from positive and negative offline demonstrations and trains the critic on counterfactual rollouts, substantially improving success rates over standard CRL on confounded goal-reaching tasks.

</details>
