### 603. [HiPAD: A Unified Gait, Audio-Visual, and Personality Fusion Network for Depression Detection, with a Hierarchical Personality Ablation and the Calibration Limits of Domain-Adapted LLMs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14961v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14961

**作者：** Karol Chlasta、Piotr Struzik

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL、cs.CV、cs.SD

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14961v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14961v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** HiPAD 是一个统一的多模态抑郁检测融合网络，用共享 BiLSTM 编码步态、音视频，并在至少两模态存在时做跨模态注意力，人格描述仅拼接融合；作者据此做人格描述的四级消融、LoRA/QLoRA 域适应以及手工与深度特征对比，发现约 150 token 的人格文本比音频、视频、步态合计携带更多信号。

**相关性简评：** 远领域工作，但其「短文本属性压过视觉等模态」的消融证据与域适应后输出校准反而变差的观察，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据是否真被使用、信息旁路与评价指标张力的诊断设计提供参照，具体可核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** HiPAD: A Unified Gait, Audio-Visual, and Personality Fusion Network for Depression Detection, with a Hierarchical Personality Ablation and the Calibration Limits of Domain-Adapted LLMs

**abstract/A1：** We present HiPAD, a single fusion network submitted to all six sub-tracks of the MPDD-AVG 2026 depression-detection challenge, covering the Elder and Young cohorts and three modality sets (gait, audio-visual, and both), each combined with personality descriptions. The network encodes each available modality with a shared BiLSTM, zero-pads absent modalities, and applies cross-modal attention only when at least two of gait, audio and video are present. Personality, which dominates our results, is kept out of the attention and fused by concatenation. Because the architecture is identical in every sub-track, differences between them reflect the data rather than the model, and we use this to study three questions. Our main finding is that the personality description, roughly 150 tokens about who the subject is, carries more depression signal than audio, video, and gait combined: gait plus personality alone (TLS 0.647) beats every configuration that includes audio and video. First, a four-level ablation of the personality description (L0-L3) quantifies this: removing every personality-derived feature, including the Big Five scores that earlier MPDD ablations keep, lowers the Track-Level Score by 0.499 to 0.507 and leaves the model at chance. Second, domain-adapting the personality encoder with LoRA (7B) or QLoRA (72B) on PHQ-8/9 data raises binary Cohen's $κ$ by 0.13 but lowers the overall score by distorting the PHQ-9 regression; a frozen RoBERTa-large encoder does better at this sample size. Third, at fixed architecture, handcrafted clinical features (eGeMAPS, OpenFace action units) outperform generic deep features (wav2vec2, DenseNet) on the audio-visual tracks. The unified system reaches a cross-track G-Score of 0.482; with under 100 subjects per cohort, the limiting factors are the size of the representation and the calibration of the outputs, not the choice of architecture.

**comment/C1：** 9 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM '26), Rio de Janeiro, Grand Challenge track. Authors' extended version: the appendices restore the extended related work, figures, tables and discussion omitted from the conference version for length

</details>

### 604. [Cross-Material Magnetic Core Loss Prediction via Operating-Condition Matching and Partial Optimal Transport](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14964v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14964

**作者：** Cong Yao、Yu Zheng、Zehao Hou、Rui Xu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14964v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14964v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 T-PCOT：用频率、磁通摆幅、温度等工况描述符构建可比工况稀疏图，以容量受限的偏最优传输把对齐努力分配到各源测量并保留不匹配的目标质量，配合重要性加权采样训练 Transformer，用于测量有限的跨材料磁芯损耗预测。

**相关性简评：** 其「按支撑条件筛选可比样本、用容量约束控制每个源样本的对齐贡献」的思路，可能与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、latent 状态对齐贡献分配及不匹配信息的舍弃相关，可供核查，但领域差异大、迁移性未验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Cross-Material Magnetic Core Loss Prediction via Operating-Condition Matching and Partial Optimal Transport

**abstract/A1：** Cross-material magnetic core loss prediction requires adapting to new material responses with limited measurements. Global feature alignment overlooks differences in source and target excitation coverage. This motivates selecting comparable samples and controlling each source measurement's alignment contribution. This paper proposes T-PCOT, a Transformer transfer method based on condition-supported partial optimal transport. Frequency, flux excursion, temperature, and waveform descriptors define a sparse graph of comparable operating conditions. A capacity-constrained transport plan distributes alignment across source measurements and leaves costly target mass unmatched. The plan is constructed from measured inputs before training and guides local waveform-feature consistency. An importance-weighted sampling scheme preserves both uniform source regression and the transport objective during minibatch optimization. Experiments on three material pairs and three target label budgets show that T-PCOT reduces mean relative error (MRE) and 95th-percentile error (P95) relative to Transformer-based multiple-kernel maximum mean discrepancy (T-MKMMD) in all nine comparisons. Macro MRE decreases from 12.60% to 9.65%, and macro P95 from 30.94% to 25.06%, corresponding to relative reductions of 23.41% and 19.01%. Controlled comparisons and ablations examine the roles of input processing, condition correspondence, and source capacity. The results demonstrate the predictive advantage of organizing cross-material alignment through operating-condition support over the compared global alignment method. The proposed method achieves state-of-the-art predictive performance in magnetic core loss transfer learning.

**comment/C1：** 11 pages, 9 figures, 6 tables

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14966

**作者：** Yuxuan Liu、Zhaochen Su、Hangyu Guo、Shijue Huang、Zhixiong Zhang、Kawai Chung、Zhongwei Xie、Tianshi Zheng、Wei Fan、Qing Zong、Haochen Shi、Baixuan Xu、Haoran Li、Yangqiu Song

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14966v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14966v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** SkillHorizon 用技能组合在七个业务环境中自动生成带输入输出依赖与共享状态的长程 agent 任务，并在 64K–1M token 交互负载下评测五个语言模型的局部目标完成与整体任务交付。

**相关性简评：** 虽为纯文本工具智能体基准，但其工作量增长下完成率下降、任务未完成却提前提交最终答案（且工具额度仍有剩余）的现象，可能为 LVR 的 STOP 决策与长度泛化的收益—成本评估提供参照。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SkillHorizon: Constructing Long-Horizon Agent Tasks through Skill Composition

**abstract/A1：** Long-horizon agents must complete workflows in which later activities depend on earlier outputs and changes to shared state. A key challenge for evaluation is to expand task requirements and their dependencies while keeping tasks executable and outcomes verifiable. We introduce SkillHorizon, a benchmark that constructs long-horizon tasks through skill composition in seven business environments. Its generators use domain-specific rules to turn reusable skill procedures into concrete business activities. These activities are connected through input-output dependencies, shared resources, and state updates, allowing workload and coordination demands to grow together. Successful reference executions validate task feasibility and measure interaction workload, while programmatic evaluators assess local completion and whole-task success. We evaluate five language models on 1,050 tasks with reference interaction workloads ranging from 64K to 1M tokens. Across these scales, mean local-goal completion falls from 90.4% to 46.8%, as completed work fails to keep pace with growing requirements. At larger workloads, agents more often submit unsuccessful final answers with substantial work unfinished and tool-call allowance remaining. Trace analysis also identifies cases where scripts execute successfully but their outputs fail downstream business checks. SkillHorizon provides a configurable testbed for studying sustained progress, dependency coordination, and complete task delivery in growing workflows. Our code is available at https://github.com/KnowComp/SkillHorizon.

**comment/C1：** 29 pages, 7 figures

</details>

### 606. [Mixing Regularization for Average-Reward $Q$-Learning and $Q$-Planning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14988v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.14988

**作者：** Julien Roger、Sam Bodmer、Jian Qian、Benjamin Riviere

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、math.OC、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14988v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.14988v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在平均奖励强化学习设定下，研究向 m-step mixing policy 正则化的 Q-learning 与 Q-planning，给出有限时间收敛分析，并刻画正则项对收缩性、探索与算子偏差的影响。

**相关性简评：** 其「planning 即时域局部化的学习、规划视界 H 在边界值偏差与样本复杂度间权衡」的结论，可能为 LVR 中 latent 迭代步数（计算预算）与推理偏差的取舍、以及何时停止推理，提供概念类比，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Mixing Regularization for Average-Reward $Q$-Learning and $Q$-Planning

**abstract/A1：** The average-reward setting for reinforcement learning is challenging because its Bellman operator is known to contract in span only when the underlying Markov chain is mixing. Whereas existing work typically assumes a contraction property, e.g., through environment mixing, we consider the setting where we are given a reward-agnostic $m$-step mixing policy, and we control the contraction and exploration properties of the learned policy by regularizing toward the mixing policy. We provide finite-time analysis of $Q$-learning algorithms that can be instantiated with multiple choices of regularization, with guarantees measured with respect to the regularized fixed point. Our framework exposes novel regularizer-dependent objects that control contraction, exploration, and operator bias. In the one-step setting, our rates match the best known rates for $Q$-iteration and synchronous $Q$-learning, and for $m$-step mixing we derive new rates. We also study $Q$-planning variants, and show that planning acts as time-localized learning, where the planning horizon $H$ trades off the bias from the boundary value against the sample complexity. Finally, we present numerical studies validating the analysis: (i) knowledge of a strong mixing policy improves convergence and exploration, and its advantage increases with bottleneck severity and, (ii) our theory predicts the convergence and bias rankings of regularizers from the $α$-divergence family.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages main body, 56 pages references and appendix, 8 figures. Under review

</details>

### 607. [On the Complexity Gap Between POMDPs and Multi-Environment POMDPs](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15010v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15010

**作者：** Eline M. Bovy、Caleb Probine、Marnix Suilen、Ufuk Topcu、Nils Jansen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15010v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15010v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文刻画多环境 POMDP（ME-POMDP）与单环境 POMDP 之间的复杂度差距，对有限时域、最坏环境奖励最大化问题证明多类子类分别属于 NP、PSPACE 或 ∃ℝ 完备。

**相关性简评：** 部分可观测下的信念状态、模型不确定性与计算成本刻画，可能为 LVR 中动态计算、停止决策及多 latent 假设筛选的鲁棒性评价提供概念参照，供人工核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** On the Complexity Gap Between POMDPs and Multi-Environment POMDPs

**abstract/A1：** Multi-environment POMDPs (ME-POMDPs) generalize POMDPs by encoding a finite set of possible environments, capturing model uncertainty. The finite-horizon robust reward maximization problem for a ME-POMDP asks for a policy that maximizes reward in the worst environment, and recent work has shown this problem to be $\\mathsf{PSPACE}$-complete. We expand the complexity landscape of ME-POMDPs by identifying which subclasses retain this $\\mathsf{PSPACE}$-completeness. In particular, we take subclasses of POMDPs that are tractable in the single-environment case, and investigate the computational complexity of these classes when extended to the multi-environment setting. We first prove the $\\mathsf{NP}$-completeness of multi-environment blind MDPs and deterministic POMDPs using a certain closure-under-mixture condition. We then prove $\\mathsf{PSPACE}$-completeness for a range of subclasses that do not satisfy that closure condition, yielding new complexity results for multi-observation POMDPs. Finally, we show existential theory of the reals ($\\exists \\mathbb{R}$)-completeness for numerous ME-POMDP problems under time-dependent Markovian policies or finite-state controllers that are $\\mathsf{NP}$-complete for standard POMDPs. These results reveal a subtle relationship between POMDP and ME-POMDP complexity that depends heavily on the subclasses involved.

**comment/C1：** 45 pages, 9 figures

</details>

### 608. [Conformal Sequential Decision Making With Cost and Sublinear Policy Regret Guarantees](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15011v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15011

**作者：** Jayadev Naram、Giuseppe Durisi、Matteo Zecchin、Osvaldo Simeone

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15011v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15011v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把「每回合须满足硬性成本预算、同时累计回报接近参考策略」的形式化为带任意状态序列的情节式在线决策问题，提出 OCEA：每回合用受 regret 控制的算法选一个候选动作，当剩余预算无法承担再一轮的最大成本时切换到零成本动作，并证明每回合成本约束成立且期望策略 regret 次线性。

**相关性简评：** 其「剩余预算不足以承担下一轮最大成本即停止/切换」的规则与次线性 regret 分析，可能为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的计算预算分配与停止决策提供可核查的形式化工具；但该工作不涉及视觉或多模态状态，迁移到 latent 推理成本核算的可行性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Conformal Sequential Decision Making With Cost and Sublinear Policy Regret Guarantees

**abstract/A1：** Automated decision makers, such as AI agents that control robots or network devices, must often satisfy hard cost constraints while maintaining competitive performance. In such settings, a cost measure, such as a safety violation rate, energy consumption, or a distortion level, must stay within a given budget in every episode of operation. Furthermore, a cumulative reward metric, accounting for per-step performance, must stay close to the reward of a meaningful reference policy. We formulate this setup as an episodic sequential decision problem in which the state sequence is arbitrary, and the reward and cost may depend on past actions within the same episode. We propose the online conformal episodic agent (OCEA), a policy that selects one candidate action per episode using a regret-controlled algorithm, and switches to a zero-cost action when the remaining budget cannot absorb the maximum cost of one more round. We prove that OCEA satisfies per-episode cost constraints for every state sequence and for every realization of its internal randomness, while achieving a sublinear expected policy regret with respect to the best action sequence in hindsight from a comparator class satisfying the same per-episode cost constraints. We apply OCEA to risk-averse control and online compression with distortion guarantees.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15020

**作者：** Amin Najafgholizadeh、Mohsen Afsharchi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文指出现有合成节点分类基准 PATTERN 的生成器在训练与测试划分中复用同一批 pattern，因而可仅从训练标签读出 pattern 并在测试图中查找，无需任何训练参数即达 99.2 加权准确率，超过已发表模型；据此建议在新模板上评测、公开由生成器构造的基线。

**相关性简评：** 其「模型是否真的使用任务信息，还是走了记忆捷径」的诊断与「fresh vs reused 模板」评测协议，可能为 LVR 中判断 latent 是否真正承载视觉证据、是否发生视觉旁路，以及设计反捷径对照基线提供可核查的借鉴。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PATTERN Can Be Solved from Memory: Generator-Aware Baselines for Synthetic Node Classification

**abstract/A1：** PATTERN, a synthetic node-classification benchmark still used to rank graph networks, plants a random subgraph in a random host graph and asks which nodes belong to it. Its generator draws 100 patterns once and plants the same ones in every split, so each test graph carries a pattern that also appears in 100 training graphs. A matcher that reads these patterns off the training labels and looks them up in each test graph reaches 99.2 class-weighted accuracy with no trained parameters, against 89.8 for the best published model. Inference under the generator without the patterns reaches 86.8. Two published models, CKGConv and GRIT, score lower on patterns they have not seen: on new graphs with fresh patterns both fall below this pattern-blind predictor, and withholding patterns from CKGConv's training lowers its accuracy on the test graphs that carry them. Training CKGConv with a new pattern in every graph raises its accuracy on fresh patterns by about 2 points, to the level of the pattern-blind predictor, at some cost on the reused patterns. The same kind of inference under the generator matches the best published result on CLUSTER and, without any training, scores above every published result we found on Minesweeper's released board. We recommend that synthetic benchmarks report scores on fresh templates beside reused ones, publish baselines built from their generators, and state how their metric is weighted and pooled.

**comment/C1：** 30 pages, 4 figures

</details>

### 610. [Appearance Compensation in Volume Rendering](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15030v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15030

**作者：** Jianghong Zhou

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15030v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15030v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究体渲染中外观补偿问题：独立参数化的有效光源能否掩盖密度错误，证明存在外部 RGB 视角完全不变而密度翻倍、相对 L² 误差超 14.5% 的 SH2 物理歧义，并刻画角容量、空间分辨率与传输测量对密度可辨识性的作用。

**相关性简评：** 其「观测完全等价却内部状态错误」的不可辨识性结论，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态是否保留任务必要视觉信息、信息坍缩与视觉旁路的评价设计提供概念类比，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Appearance Compensation in Volume Rendering

**abstract/A1：** Can a volume that reproduces every external RGB view still have an incorrect density? We study this question in emission-absorption rendering with an independently parameterized, physically bounded effective source. Appearance compensates a density change by replacing the radiance that it removes from the rest of each ray. We characterize the surviving density information with a shared spatial appearance field. Our first result is an optimal density-only gain after finite-degree spherical-harmonic source refitting. A coupled tensor gauge and physical localized packets identify the sharp limiting nonlinear inverse coefficient as its reciprocal. Our second result realizes positive gain at every fixed finite degree for a residual set of isotropic spatial sources at one fixed density. At the same references, growing angular capacity hides a fixed nonzero density error while retaining physicality and any prescribed finite set of smoothness bounds. Local identifiability and the absence of a capacity-uniform recovery modulus therefore coexist. Our third result constructs an exact physical SH2 ambiguity: central density doubles and relative density $L^2$ error exceeds $14.52\\%$, yet every external RGB ray is unchanged. We connect these continuum results to shared finite representations, continuous pixel measurements and density-sensitive acquisition. Complete-class certificates separate SH0, SH1 and SH2 fits at one learned density. Finite-camera results expose the distinct role of spatial capacity, and transmission measurements separate otherwise identical RGB fields. Controlled training tests and captured-smoke profiles supply mechanism evidence with explicit observation scopes. The results show why rendering accuracy alone cannot certify density: recovery also depends on appearance capacity, spatial resolution and measurement design.

**comment/C1：** 139 pages, 18 figures

</details>

### 611. [Sparsity Saves Compute, Not Samples: Oracle Inequalities for Dense and Sparse Mixture of Experts](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15039v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15039

**作者：** Sagar Ghosh、Huy Nguyen、Alessandro Rinaldo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15039v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15039v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文用 Gated Hilbert Space 刻画专家与门控误差，为 Lipschitz 参数化下最小二乘 MoE 估计器推导 oracle 不等式，覆盖 dense 与 Top-k/Top-p 稀疏路由，并给出最优 minimax 下界。

**相关性简评：** 其「稀疏只省计算不省样本」及路由选择复杂度（Natarajan 维）结论，可能为 LVR 中在多个 latent 假设/专家间动态选择与计算预算的收益—成本分析提供理论视角，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Sparsity Saves Compute, Not Samples: Oracle Inequalities for Dense and Sparse Mixture of Experts

**abstract/A1：** Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models combine specialized experts through an input-dependent routing mechanism, and their sparse variants underpin many modern large-scale systems. Yet the statistical cost of adaptive routing remains only partially understood. We study the estimation error of least-squares MoE estimators when both the experts and the gating network are Lipschitz in their parameters. We represent each MoE as a gate--expert pair in a Gated Hilbert Space, whose norm $\\\|\\cdot\\\|\_Δ$ separates the contributions of routing and expert discrepancies. Using its empirical representation, we derive an oracle inequality with a fast rate of order $\\tilde{\\mathcal O}\\big((Kd\_{\\mathrm{pr},e}+d\_{\\mathrm{pr},g})/n\\big)$ for dense MoEs with $K$ experts. For sparse Top-$k$ and Top-$p$ routing, the selection map is discontinuous in the gating parameters. We handle this by partitioning the gating class according to the selection patterns it induces on the sample. The resulting bounds match the dense rate up to an additive routing cost governed by the Natarajan dimension of the selector. We show that such a routing-complexity condition cannot be dropped: Lipschitz continuity in the parameters alone does not suffice. For linear softmax gating, the routing cost is of the same order as the gating term. Finally, for linear experts, we establish a matching minimax lower bound of order $Kd\_{\\mathrm{pr},e}/n$, showing that the rates are optimal up to logarithmic factors.

</details>

### 612. [Belief Embedding Tree Search](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15046v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15046

**作者：** Christopher Solinas、Radovan Haluška、Martin Schmid、Michael Buro、Nathan R. Sturtevant、Michael Bowling

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15046v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15046v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 BETS，在 POMDP 的蒙特卡洛树搜索中用生成式分布嵌入表示每个节点的信念，并随动力学递推更新，同时以真实隐藏状态为监督训练信念模型，与策略和价值网络联合学习，在 RockSample、LightDark、PocMan 六个配置上与 BetaZero 及无学习组件的规划器比较。

**相关性简评：** 其「信念状态」作为可递推更新的嵌入表示、以监督目标约束其信息含量、并供策略与价值函数使用，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的更新方式、监督来源及 latent 内容是否真正被使用提供类比线索，但领域距离较远，需核查其表示是否具备可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Belief Embedding Tree Search

**abstract/A1：** Beliefs in a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) are posterior distributions over the hidden state given the agent's history of actions and observations. They summarize everything the history says about the state, so planning in a POMDP is planning in a Markov decision process (MDP) over beliefs. Belief MDPs have continuous state spaces even for finite POMDPs, and exact planning in them is intractable in general. Planners must therefore approximate beliefs and estimate values. Monte Carlo planners do both inside a search tree, with an approximate belief at every node and a value estimate at every leaf. Approximations usually consist of sets of sampled states, with leaf values coming from rollouts, hand-designed bounds, or learned networks. Policies and values computed from these approximations are limited by their quality, and prior methods with learned networks rely on hand-chosen summaries of the sampled states. A belief representation should be computable from the parent node's representation through the POMDP's dynamics, let the search sample from it, and be learned so that it provides the information that policies and value functions need. We present Belief Embedding Tree Search (BETS), a Monte Carlo planner that meets these requirements by representing each node's belief with a generative distribution embedding (GDE) while updating it through the POMDP dynamics. BETS trains its belief model alongside its policy and value networks through experience, with the realized hidden state of the POMDP as the belief model's training target. We evaluate BETS on six configurations of RockSample, LightDark, and PocMan against BetaZero and three planners without learned components. BETS is competitive or leading on all six, while every baseline falls far behind on at least one. Where beliefs are highest-dimensional, it outperforms them by a large margin, even without search.

</details>

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Inference on Demand（IoD），把 split inference 抽象为类 CAMARA 的网络 API，并在 5G 用户面随路承载 split-aware tensor context；在基于可编程 UPF 的测试床上以可切分视觉 AI 负载验证自适应切分选择，避免静态配置的固定成本。

**相关性简评：** 其自适应切分体现了通信—计算权衡下的动态计算分配，可能为 LVR 中动态计算预算、停止决策与真实成本建模提供类比，但全文不涉及 latent 推理状态或视觉证据筛选，需核查借鉴可行性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Exposing AI Inference as a Telco Network API over the 5G User Plane

**abstract/A1：** Supporting edge Artificial Intelligence (AI) inference as a network service is challenging because current mobile systems can transport tensors but do not expose or understand the inference context that gives those tensors operational meaning. Prior studies have addressed this gap through dynamic partitioning, collaborative inference, and split pipelines; however, these solutions remain application-bound, network-blind, or context-free. This work proposes Inference on Demand (IoD), an inference-on-demand abstraction that exposes split inference through a CAMARA-like Application Program Interface (API) and carries a split-aware tensor context in-band across the 5G user plane path. We evaluate the IoD on a programmable user plane function (UPF)-based testbed using a partitionable visual AI workload, showing that adaptive split selection can operate as a network-facing service while avoiding the rigid cost profile of static configurations. Including our findings, split inference becomes more than offloading when the service intent, runtime partitioning, and tensor transport are made visible to the mobile data plane. This opens a path toward network-native AI services, in which programmable telco infrastructure coordinates computation, context, and connectivity for user-facing applications.

**comment/C1：** Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the IEEE Future Networks World Forum 2026 (Portugal)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文关注多类分类中随机 kitchen sinks 特征（W-RKS）的冗余与低效问题，将特征选择表述为序贯嵌套模型选择，提出 SEED-MAX 算法递归以经验风险差挑出最简约而具信息量的特征子集，给出正确选择概率的解析下界，并用 Fisher 检验加速剪枝；在 UCR 时序分类数据上约 92% 剪枝率且精度几乎不降。

**相关性简评：** 其「按序贯准则挑选/剪除特征并给出选择正确性下界」的思路，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选、冗余 latent 状态剪枝与停止时机判断提供可核查的方法线索，但领域较远，可迁移性需阅读原文判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Random Feature Pruning for Multi-Class Classification

**abstract/A1：** Weighted sums of random kitchen sinks (W-RKS) is a commonly used feature extraction technique for supervised learning tasks. A major drawback of this method is the redundancy and ineffectiveness of many extracted random features. This paper investigates efficient methods for reducing such redundancy in multi-class classification problems. We specifically formulate feature selection as a variant of the sequentially nested model selection problem and introduce the Successive Empirical Excess Risk Difference Maximization (SEED-MAX) algorithm. It recursively computes empirical risks to identify the most parsimonious yet informative set of features. We derive an analytical lower bound for the probability of correct feature selection by the SEED-MAX algorithm. This lower bound on the probability of correct feature selection can be made arbitrarily close to one by increasing the training dataset size. To further enhance the rate of pruning, we evaluate the features retained by SEED-MAX using the Fisher test (F-Test). Empirical evaluations on UCR time-series classification datasets show that the sequential application of SEED-MAX with the Fisher test achieves approximately 92 percent rate of pruning with negligible degradation in classification accuracy. Implementations of the SEED-MAX and SEED-MAX-F-Test methods are available at https://github.com/OmidiAmin/seed-max-ftest.

### 615. [To Defer or Not to Defer? Online Learning with LLMs and Congested Experts](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15128v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15128

**作者：** Vasileios Saketos、William Reveillard、Alexandre Proutiere、Sebastian Dalleiger、Ming Xiao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15128v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15128v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把「直接输出 LLM 答案还是转交给容量受限的人类专家」建模为在线序贯决策问题：置信信号的可靠性未知、且反馈只对已延迟样本可见并受排队延迟影响，作者提出基于 KL 下置信界的 KL-PBD 算法，给出 gap-dependent 与最坏情形的 regret 上下界，并在 GSM8K、NuminaMath、MedMCQA 上用 Qwen 验证。

**相关性简评：** 其「置信度—转交/停止」决策与 LVR 中 STOP 时机、不确定性估计和计算成本权衡问题表述相近，且「反馈仅对延迟样本可见且有延迟」的设置可能为 latent 推理中的部分可观测监督与贡献分配提供可核查的线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** To Defer or Not to Defer? Online Learning with LLMs and Congested Experts

**abstract/A1：** Modern AI systems increasingly combine large language models (LLMs) with human experts, using the LLM to handle routine queries while deferring uncertain cases for expert review. When expert capacity is limited, however, deferral decisions must account not only for the reliability of the LLM but also for congestion in the expert queue. We formulate this as an online sequential decision-making problem in which, for each query, the system observes the confidence signal of the LLM's answer and must decide whether to output the answer or defer the query to a capacity-constrained expert. The reliability of the confidence signal is initially unknown and must be learned from expert feedback, which is both selectively observed (only deferred queries are labeled) and delayed by queuing. We propose \\texttt{KL-PBD}, a learning algorithm that uses Kullback--Leibler lower confidence bounds on the unknown reliability parameters to guide deferral decisions. For $K$ confidence levels and horizon $T$, \\texttt{KL-PBD} achieves $O(K\\log T)$ gap-dependent regret when the accuracy at every confidence level is bounded away from the deferral boundary, and $\\widetilde{O}(\\sqrt{KT})$ worst-case regret. We establish matching lower bounds, showing that these rates are optimal up to logarithmic factors. Finally, we validate our approach on synthetic instances and real-world question-answering datasets, namely GSM8K, NuminaMath, and MedMCQA, using Qwen LLMs.

</details>

### 616. [Trust Hinders Bidirectional Human-AI Alignment](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15136v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15136

**作者：** Michaela Benk、Kacper Sokol

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.HC

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 一篇立场论文，主张以「信任校准」主导 AI 辅助决策的框架过于狭窄，转而提出三个维度：信任只是应对不确定性的策略之一、「大世界」问题中信任校准常被误用、此类情境需处理高阶决策过程，并据此讨论面向过程的人机耦合系统设计。

**相关性简评：** 其关于不确定性可有多重管理策略、以及在任务过程中动态识别与协商不确定性的讨论，或可类比启发 LVR 中「何时依赖内部 latent 内容、何时追问视觉证据」的策略与停止决策问题；但对象是人的信任而非模型内部状态，属远领域概念线索，需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Trust Hinders Bidirectional Human-AI Alignment

**abstract/A1：** Trust calibration remains the dominant framing of AI-assisted decision making: the goal is to close the gap between perceived and actual trustworthiness of AI systems so that users exhibit appropriate reliance on them. We argue that this approach, while useful for decision problems that are well-defined and clearly scoped, overly restricts what it means to make a decision with AI support. To overcome this limitation, we develop three dimensions of AI-assisted decision making. First, trusting AI is only one of several possible strategies for managing uncertainty. Second, trust calibration is often misapplied when AI models "large-world" decision problems, i.e., ill-defined situations where goals and states are only partially known or unknowable. Third, in such settings human-AI alignment requires addressing higher-order decision processes. We conclude by reflecting on the implications of our observations on the design of process-oriented human-AI coupled systems that jointly identify and negotiate uncertainty throughout the decision-making task.

**comment/C1：** 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Workshop: Dynamic Alignment in Human-AI Coupled System (BiAlign Workshop)

</details>

### 617. [Single-step Retrosynthesis via Reinforcement Learning from Forward Feedback](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15141v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15141

**作者：** Zixun Lan、Zhenfu Liu、Yi Li、Xinheng Wang、Mingmin Chi、Qibiao Wang、Jie Zhu、Xiaohui Tian、Fei Ma

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15141v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15141v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 RetroRLFF：在监督训练的解码器 Transformer 上生成候选反应物，用冻结的正向反应模型预测产物，构造「参考一致性 + 正向一致性 + 无效输出惩罚」的序列级奖励，以直接优势策略优化更新策略，在 USPTO-50K 上提升往返准确率并保持 top-1 参考复现。

**相关性简评：** 把外部前向模型反馈当作序列级奖励来训练生成策略，可能与 latent 推理中的轨迹监督、验证器反馈和贡献分配有可借鉴线索；其一多对多问题与单一参考评估的错配，也可能启发 LVR 多假设与证据筛选的评价方式，均需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Single-step Retrosynthesis via Reinforcement Learning from Forward Feedback

**abstract/A1：** Single-step retrosynthesis is a one-to-many inverse problem, yet most models are trained and evaluated against a single recorded reactant set. Reference-based training gives no explicit positive signal for unrecorded alternatives, and exact-match evaluation rejects non-matching predictions regardless of chemical plausibility. We propose Retrosynthesis via Reinforcement Learning from Forward Feedback (RetroRLFF), which optimizes reactant generation using both reference agreement and forward consistency with the target product. Starting from a supervised decoder-only Transformer, RetroRLFF generates complete reactant candidates and uses a frozen forward reaction model to predict products. A sequence-level reward combines reference agreement and forward consistency while penalizing invalid outputs. Direct Advantage-Based Policy Optimization updates the policy without human preference annotations or a preference-trained reward model. On USPTO-50K, RetroRLFF outperforms all 14 baselines in candidate-level round-trip accuracy at k = 1, 3, 5, and 10. With approximately 50 million parameters, it achieves 90.1% top-1 round-trip accuracy, exceeding R-SMILES, the strongest competing baseline on this metric, by 8.5 percentage points. Compared with its supervised policy, round-trip accuracy increases from 83.1% to 90.1%, while exact-match accuracy is maintained at 57.9% versus 57.5%. In an anonymized expert assessment of 131 randomly selected test cases, organic synthesis experts prefer RetroRLFF over EditRetro in 67.9% of comparisons. These results support forward feedback as a training signal for improving forward consistency while retaining top-1 reference recovery. Expert assessment provides complementary evidence of synthetic feasibility on the selected cases, although neither forward consistency nor expert preference establishes experimental feasibility.

</details>

### 618. [Sensor-Aware Joint Data Fusion and State Estimation under Sparse Multi-rate Distribution Grid Sensing](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15156v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15156

**作者：** Pooja Algikar、Stefano Fenu、Kumarsinh Jhala、Siby Plathottam

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15156v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15156v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 针对配电网在多速率、稀疏、异构传感器下观测性退化的状态估计问题，提出将测量函数与采样过程按类型局部化到具体母线的异构 latent graph ODE，并配以 graph-transformer 状态估计器，在多个 IEEE 标准拓扑上验证。

**相关性简评：** 该文把「类型化、局部化的观测函数」嵌入连续时间 latent 状态演化，可能为 LVR 中稀疏且异步到达的视觉证据如何更新 latent 状态、分配贡献提供可核查的类比，但属远领域，迁移性待人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Sensor-Aware Joint Data Fusion and State Estimation under Sparse Multi-rate Distribution Grid Sensing

**abstract/A1：** Distribution-system state estimation is a growing necessity for the modern power grid as the addition of local storage and generation add system complexity that an operator or aggregator is not able to directly monitor. Classical methods work well when all system elements are time-synchronized and at least partly observable, but multi-rate monitoring of sparse heterogeneous sensors typically relies on machine learning approaches. It is a common practice in the literature to structure this task as a two-stage pipeline, first fusing data from disparate sensors and then feeding the fused pseudo-measurements to a separately trained state estimator. We propose a heterogeneous latent graph ODE in which measurement functions and sampling processes are typed and localized on specific buses, paired with a graph- transformer state estimator solving DSSE specifically for multi-rate heterogeneous sensor placements, and demonstrate its effectiveness across multiple IEEE standard topologies as observability degrades.

</details>

### 619. [TRIG: Toward Measuring Texture Realism in Image Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15164v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15164

**作者：** Zhiwei Xu、Jiali Cui、Zhiqiang Lao、Heather Yu、Liang Peng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15164v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15164v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 TRIG，一个面向生成图像纹理真实感的评价指标：以预训练于纹理数据集的 GAN 判别器为骨干，微调 plausibility head 识别局部纹理退化（同时把自然的失焦与传感器噪声视为正例），再在该特征上计算真实图像集与生成图像集之间的分布距离，报告其与人类真实感评分的一致度高于基线指标。

**相关性简评：** 其核心观察——为分类或图文对齐训练的特征对承载纹理的低层变化不变，导致表示偏向语义与全局结构——可能从评价側侧面呼应 LVR 关注的低层视觉细节是否在内部状态中被压缩或坍缩，可供核查「以目标函数诱导的不变性造成视觉信息损失」这一类问题；但该工作本身是图像生成质量指标，与 latent 推理状态、生成与停止决策无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TRIG: Toward Measuring Texture Realism in Image Generation

**abstract/A1：** This paper studies the backbone used by metrics for evaluating the quality of generated images. Although generative models have advanced rapidly, some outputs still exhibit unrealistic texture characteristics, and these differences are difficult to measure. Widely used evaluation metrics provide limited insight into texture realism, since they often rely on a backbone trained for another objective, such as image classification or image-text alignment. Such objectives typically encourage invariance to low-level variations that carry texture, so the resulting features primarily encode semantic and global structure. As a result, texture-specific discrepancies may not be explicitly captured. We propose TRIG, a metric directed at the texture realism of generated images. Its backbone is instead the discriminator of a generative adversarial network pre-trained on a texture dataset, which provides a learned prior for the local statistics of natural textures. A plausibility head is fine-tuned to identify local texture degradations, while preserving natural defocus and sensor noise as positive cases. On the features of this backbone, we compute a standard distributional distance between a reference set of real images and a set of generated ones. We apply TRIG to several generative models and observe closer agreement with human realness ratings than baseline metrics.

**comment/C1：** 22 pages, 19 figures

</details>

### 620. [ExeWorldBench: Benchmarking Code-Based Executable 3D World Modeling](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15166v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15166

**作者：** Xinge Peng、Zhen Fang、Ruibing Wang、Yongxuan Lv、Haodong Li、Guohui Zhang、Xiaoxiao Ma、Yiting Lu、Lin Chen、Zehui Che、Feng Zhao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15166v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15166v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出 ExeWorldBench，一个通过代码构建可执行 3D 世界来评测「世界理解」（结构、机械与因果原理）与「可执行实现」的基准，含机制可执行、组合可执行与意图驱动合成三项递进任务，并报告前沿模型存在明显不足。

**相关性简评：** 该基准把「从视觉观察推导因果/机械结构并转写为可执行代码」作为评测信号，可能为核查 VLM 内部是否真正保留任务必要的视觉与因果信息提供外部化验证思路，但无 latent 状态或推理期机制，实际启发需进一步核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ExeWorldBench: Benchmarking Code-Based Executable 3D World Modeling

**abstract/A1：** Coding agents are increasingly evolving beyond reproducing what a world looks like toward constructing executable worlds that capture how a world works. This shift calls for executable world modeling, which integrates two core capabilities: world understanding, reasoning about the underlying structural, mechanical, and causal principles of a world, and executable realization, translating that understanding into a code-based system whose behavior emerges from physical interactions. However, existing benchmarks provide only fragmented evaluations centered on physical reasoning, visual fidelity, or behavioral correctness, leaving the integration of these capabilities insufficiently assessed. To bridge this gap, we introduce ExeWorldBench, to our knowledge the first benchmark to comprehensively evaluate world understanding and executable realization through code-based 3D world construction. ExeWorldBench comprises three progressively challenging tasks: Mechanism Executability, which evaluates the realization of individual mechanisms from visual observations; Compositional Executability, which extends to multi-stage systems with spatial, mechanical, and causal dependencies; and Intent-Driven Executable World Synthesis, which requires constructing executable worlds from high-level goals and physical requirements. Extensive experiments on frontier models reveal substantial limitations in executable world modeling, offering insights into the development of more physically grounded and causally coherent world construction systems.

</details>

### 621. [LexiCan: Lexicographic Canonicalization of Point Clouds for Machine Learning Applications](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15171v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15171

**作者：** Daniel Sanchez、Djordje Mihajlovic、Federica Valeau、Luka Benić、Raghuwansh Raj、Soutrik Sarangi、Snir Hordan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15171v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15171v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出 LexiCan，一种为 3D 点云选取唯一轨道代表的字典序规范化方法，声称在 O(3)/SO(3) 下可证不变、在 QM9 与 QM-sym 上经验不变性达约 1e-6 埃、缓解不连续跳变且速度显著更快，并能提升分子性质预测与 ModelNet40 形状分类。

**相关性简评：** 论文不涉及多模态推理，但其关于表示几何、唯一轨道代表选取及不变性误差与不连续跳变的讨论，可能为核查 latent 视觉状态中同等变换下的表示稳定性与连续性提供概念线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LexiCan: Lexicographic Canonicalization of Point Clouds for Machine Learning Applications

**abstract/A1：** Canonicalization resolves the rotational and permutation ambiguity of 3D point clouds by selecting a unique orbit representative, maintaining their geometric information while allowing standard architectures, such as Transformers, to operate on them. Existing canonicalizations, however, exhibit discontinuity jumps on molecular configurations and non-trivial invariance errors in popular molecular datasets, which lead to ambiguity in their representation. To bridge this gap, we introduce LexiCan, a canonicalization that is provably invariant under either $O(3)$ or $SO(3)$, empirically invariant to rotations to within $\\sim 10^{-6}$ angstroms on the QM9 and QM-sym molecular datasets, and mitigates discontinuity jumps on QM-sym, while running orders of magnitude faster than an existing canonicalization. Finally, non-invariant models perform better on QM9 property prediction and ModelNet40 shape classification with LexiCan than with that canonicalization.

</details>

### 622. [Game-Theoretic Reinforcement Learning based Topology-Agnostic Defense for Virtual Power Plants](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15183v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15183

**作者：** Pooja Algikar、Stefano Fenu、Kumarsinh Jhala、Siby Plathottam

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、eess.SY

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15183v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15183v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究虚拟电厂聚合分布式能源的拓扑无关网络物理防御，提出在贝叶斯信念更新框架下把博弈论规划与无模型强化学习结合，用多输出高斯过程推断攻击者类型与检测置信度，并让 RL 策略自适应整合领导者动作。

**相关性简评：** 其显式的信念状态维护、后验不确定性传播与「信念不确定性—动作对齐」的闭环效用界，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态如何携带不确定性、以及何时据此做出停止或继续的决策提供类比线索，需核查其抽象是否可迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Game-Theoretic Reinforcement Learning based Topology-Agnostic Defense for Virtual Power Plants

**abstract/A1：** The rapid proliferation of distributed energy resources (DERs) aggregated by virtual power plants (VPPs) elevates cybersecurity risk by expanding the attack surface. A coordinated cyberattack has the potential to disrupt distribution-system, bulk-system, and market operations. Existing cyberphysical defense strategies largely assume access to grid network models and operating conditions, which may not be available to third-party aggregators. This paper proposes a novel hybrid, perturbation-based cyber-physical defense for VPP-operated DERs that blends game-theoretic planning with model-free reinforcement learning (RL) under a Bayesian belief-update framework. Topology agnosticism is defined from the VPP information and implementation perspective: the VPP does not require access to the feeder topology, line parameters, switching configuration, or full system state. This work advances the state of the art through three contributions: (1) a multi-output Gaussian process with Hamiltonian Monte Carlo for discrete attacker-type inference, probability of detection, and confidence of detection for modeling the belief distribution; (2) moment-matched Gaussian propagation of posterior beliefs across episodes; and (3) an RL policy that adaptively integrates Stackelberg leader (VPP) actions with exploration. Furthermore, we establish equilibrium existence and derive an episode-level closed-loop utility bound connecting attacker-belief uncertainty with GT-RL action alignment. Evaluations on IEEE 13- and 123-Bus feeders with DER portfolios demonstrate effective detection under attacker-model uncertainty and evaluated feeder re-configuration conditions, while requiring no explicit feeder-topology knowledge. Overall, the results indicate that combining bi-level game-theoretic planning, nonparametric Bayesian inference, and adaptive RL is a promising direction for VPP cybersecurity.

</details>

**title/T1：** SocraticRepair: Planning-Guided Socratic Tutoring for Program Debugging and Misconception Repair

**abstract/A1：** Large language models are increasingly used in computer science education. However, the teaching abilities of even the most powerful LLMs are limited: they tend to reveal the solution prematurely and may lose focus on the learner's current debugging objective. To address this, we introduce SocraticRepair, a planning-guided Socratic tutoring framework for program debugging and miscon- ception repair that adapts prior planning-guided tutoring work (Li et al., 2026b). The framework is instantiated in the Python programming domain by fine-tuning Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct on synthetic multi-turn tutoring dialogues constructed from four preprocessed programming datasets. The system is evaluated using a predefined set of independent metrics and benchmarked against a general-purpose LLM. The experiments show that SocraticRepair achieves higher scores on stepwise scaffolding and question quality while also substantially reducing premature solution disclosure. The results also identify reliable pedagogical plan generation as an important remaining challenge.

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15228

**作者：** Xinnan Dai、Kaiqi Yang、Yaxin Li、Cheng Luo、Wanli Li、Mingqing Xiao、Xinyang Jiang、Daoan Zhang、Kaitao Song、Fengze Liu、Zefan Cai、Caihua Shan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15228v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15228v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出一个闭环物理交互基准，让 LLM 控制连接机械臂、相机与传感器的装置，按指令获取环境物理反馈、解读状态并调整下一步动作，并用代表性模型刻画其失败模式（如幻觉状态变化、异常恢复差、长程计划不稳定）。

**相关性简评：** 其「行动—感知反馈—状态解读—修正」的闭环设定与执行不确定性，可能与 LVR 中视觉证据获取、内部状态更新与停止决策的收益成本问题相关，可供核查；但该工作面向具身智能体，不直接研究 latent 视觉推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Words to World: Benchmarking LLMs in Interactive Physical Environments

**abstract/A1：** Words are increasingly becoming an interface for action: large language models (LLMs) can now invoke tools, operate devices, and make decisions that affect the physical world. However, current benchmarks largely evaluate LLMs through static text responses, offline tool calls, or simulated tasks, leaving open the question of how well they can act in real physical environments. We present a benchmark for measuring LLMs in closed-loop physical interaction, where models control a harness system connected to real-world components including robotic arms, cameras, and sensors. In each task, the model must issue instructions, receive physical feedback from the environment, interpret the resulting state, and adapt its next action accordingly. This setting evaluates capabilities beyond language understanding, including grounded perception, action planning, tool selection, spatial reasoning, feedback-driven correction, and robustness to execution uncertainty. Through experiments with representative LLMs, we characterize their ability to translate linguistic reasoning into physical actions and identify common failure modes such as hallucinated state changes, poor recovery from unexpected outcomes, and unstable long-horizon plans. Our benchmark aims to provide a systematic foundation for evaluating LLMs as interactive agents that connect words, tools, and the physical world.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** FragFlex 提出片段级可变长度离散扩散模型，在去噪中联合学习图的大小、片段身份与片段间连接，再用附着位点预测器和化合价感知装配器生成原子级分子，在千万级生成量下兼顾化学合法性与唯一性。

**相关性简评：** 其「节点插入/删除 + 尺寸与连接联合建模」的可变长度离散扩散机制，可能为 LVR 中可变长度 latent 状态的生成与长度泛化提供借鉴线索，是否可迁移需人工核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FragFlex: Fragment-Based Flexible Molecular Generation for Exploring Vast Chemical Space

**abstract/A1：** Drug discovery requires efficient exploration of an astronomically large chemical space. Molecular graph diffusion models offer a promising approach to this task, but many require graph size to be fixed before generation. Although atom-level insertion and deletion can enable flexible-size generation, jointly modeling molecular size, atom types, and bonds while maintaining chemical validity remains challenging. We introduce FragFlex, a flexible-length discrete diffusion model that performs node insertion and deletion at the fragment level. During denoising, FragFlex jointly learns the size, fragment identities, and inter-fragment connectivity of the fragment graph. A neural attachment-site predictor and valence-aware assembler then convert the generated fragment graph into an atom-level molecule. In large-scale experiments generating 10 million molecules, FragFlex achieves near-perfect chemical validity while maintaining high uniqueness, demonstrating a strong balance between the two.

**comment/C1：** 15 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Drug Discovery: Bridging the Translation Gap

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15292

**作者：** Xiangqing Lu、Tao Zhu、Liang Yu、Shuangjian Li、Lulu Ban、Furong Duan、Mingxing Nie、Liming Chen、Yaping Wan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 OntoAR-HAR，一个本体引导的 agentic RAG 框架，用树状活动本体把分类拆解为语义相近活动间的局部决策，并结合静态群体检索样例、离线挖掘的可执行信号特征与推理期收集的个性化记忆，让 LLM 沿本体遍历输出活动标签。

**相关性简评：** 任务域是传感器 HAR，与视觉 latent 推理无直接关系；但其「按语义层级把判别拆成局部候选决策」和「个性化证据库＋动态检索」的思路，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选、候选剪枝与何时停止取证的决策提供可核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** OntoAR-HAR: Ontology-Guided Agentic RAG with Personalized Memory for Human Activity Recognition

**abstract/A1：** LLMs increasingly support sensor-based human activity recognition (HAR) by linking motion signals with activity semantics and physical knowledge. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds decisions in sensor examples and domain features, enabling training-free target-user inference with less dependence on raw numerical arrays. However, existing LLM/RAG-based HAR typically searches single-level activity spaces using static population knowledge. Consequently, they compare many unrelated candidates using the same static population evidence and overlook personalized motion patterns. We propose OntoAR-HAR, an ontology-guided agentic RAG framework combining static population and personalized knowledge. Its tree-structured activity ontology decomposes classification into local decisions among semantically related activities. The static store supplies node-constrained examples, while offline-discovered executable signal features provide numerical evidence for local distinctions. During inference, the personalized store collects selected user observations, which the LLM integrates with static knowledge and signal features while traversing the ontology to an activity label. Cross-subject and heterogeneous-sensing experiments show complementary gains from hierarchical retrieval and personalized memory across multiple LLM backbones, achieving state-of-the-art performance. By explicitly modeling hierarchical relations across activity granularities, OntoAR-HAR also addresses the long-overlooked semantic inclusion problem and avoids treating related labels as independent categories.

</details>

### 627. [WisdomNet: trustable machine learning toward error-free classification](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15299v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15299

**作者：** Truong X. Tran、Ramazan S. Aygun

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15299v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15299v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 WisdomNet 架构，额外引入一个「conjugate neuron」判断网络能否正确分类，若无法确定则拒绝决策或转交人类专家，在 MLP、CNN 与深层网络上把误分类率降到 0%，拒绝比例约在 10% 以内。

**相关性简评：** 这种「能否正确作答」的自评神经元与拒绝机制，可能为 LVR 中 STOP 决策与答案验证头的训练和置信门槛提供线索，可供核查其是否依赖逐样本正确性标签进行监督。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** WisdomNet: trustable machine learning toward error-free classification

**abstract/A1：** Misclassification is a critical problem in many machine learning applications. Since even the classifier models with high accuracy (e.g., &gt; 95%) still introduce some misclassification error, it may not be possible to rely on the output of a classifier. In this paper, we introduce trustable learning, which prompts the learning model to yield only the true output, thus avoiding misclassifications. Whenever the model cannot decide the output accurately, the learning model should indicate that there could be a misclassification error if it is forced to classify, and hence, it should reject to make a decision or defer it to a human expert. Therefore, we develop a methodology for trustable learning and apply it to artificial neural networks and show that it is possible to develop a classifier with 0% misclassification error. We propose a novel neural network architecture named WisdomNet that could provide zero prediction error by introducing an additional neuron named as conjugate neuron that would indicate whether the network is able to classify the data correctly or not. The WisdomNet architecture can be applied to any previously built model, and we have evaluated WisdomNet with several network architectures such as multilayer perceptron, convolutional neural network, and deep network on different data sets. The results show that the WisdomNet is able to reduce the classification error rate to 0%, while labeling the data is difficult to classify as \`reject' at a low percentage of within around 10%.

</details>

### 628. [Channel Match: Calibrating Shape Latents for Few-Step 3D Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15321v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15321

**作者：** Di Yang、Zhihao Li、Yanhai Xiong、Yufei Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15321v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15321v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 面向原生 3D 生成，提出基于连续自一致性训练与解析速度回归的少步蒸馏框架以加速高分辨率采样，并揭示采样引起的 latent 分布漂移虽保持几何正确却破坏 PBR 纹理生成，进而提出免训练、逐通道自适应的 latent 校准方法 Channel Match。

**相关性简评：** 虽属 3D 资产生成而非 VLM 推理，但其「采样导致的 latent 分布漂移」诊断与免训练逐通道校准思路，可能可供核查 latent 推理状态的分布漂移、通道结构及对下游使用的影响。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Channel Match: Calibrating Shape Latents for Few-Step 3D Generation

**abstract/A1：** Recent native 3D generators achieve high-quality asset creation by modeling structured 3D latents with flow-based transformers, but their high-resolution generation remains computationally expensive due to costly iterative sampling. In this work, we introduce a few-step distillation framework for native 3D generation, enabled by continuous self-consistency training with a custom JVP FlashAttention kernel and an analytic velocity regression objective for sparse structured 3D latents. To stabilize joint optimization, we further introduce an adaptive loss weighting strategy that automatically balances them without manual tuning. Beyond acceleration, we reveal a previously overlooked failure mode of few-step native 3D generation: sampling-induced latent distribution drift preserves geometric correctness but disrupts downstream PBR texture synthesis, causing texture artifacts on geometrically valid assets. To address this issue, we propose Channel Match, a training-free adaptive per-channel latent calibration method that restores the latent distribution without modifying either generator. We validate our approach on TRELLIS.2 at the $1024^3$ resolution setting. Our two-step model achieves $4.5\\times$ faster geometry sampling while maintaining geometry quality comparable to the many-step teacher, and Channel Match further improves rendering quality by recovering the latent interface between geometry and appearance generation.

</details>

### 629. [Full Waveform Inversion with a Learned Preconditioner](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15331v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15331

**作者：** Jeongjin Park

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、physics.geo-ph

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15331v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15331v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在地震全波形反演中，该工作用 RTM 图像训练的神经算子充当学习式预条件器，比较投影 FWI、FNO 与 Jacobian 信息增强的 JI-FNO，并报告仅预测前向 RTM 图像、把神经输出直接对齐 FWI 梯度会导致目标空间不匹配的下滑方向失效。

**相关性简评：** 其「学习算子必须带准确导数并在目标空间中一致使用」的失败诊断，可能与 LVR 中 latent 状态如何参与答案生成、贡献分配与监督设计存在类比线索，可供人工核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Full Waveform Inversion with a Learned Preconditioner

**abstract/A1：** Full-waveform inversion (FWI) is a powerful approach for reconstructing subsurface velocity models, but its practical performance is limited by ill-conditioning, sensitivity to the update direction, and the high cost of curvature-based methods. In this project, we investigate whether a neural operator trained on reverse-time-migration (RTM) images can provide a useful learned preconditioner for FWI. We compare projected FWI against neural-preconditioned FWI using either a standard Fourier neural operator (FNO) or a Jacobian-informed FNO (JI-FNO). The neural preconditioner applies the normal operator of the learned RTM map to modify the true Devito FWI gradient. Our experiments show that the JI-FNO preconditioner achieves the lowest model error while maintaining data-residual decay comparable to baseline projected FWI. In contrast, the standard FNO preconditioner is unstable and gives worse model recovery, despite using the same neural-preconditioning framework. We also identify a failure mode of a nonlinear neural Gauss Newton-type inner solve: directly matching the neural RTM output to the FWI gradient creates an objective-space mismatch and does not yield a reliable descent direction. These results suggest that forward RTM-image prediction alone is insufficient for learned preconditioning; accurate learned derivatives and objective-consistent use of the neural operator are critical for producing useful inversion updates.

</details>

**内容简述：** 提出 MultiFlow，一个基于条件流匹配的生成式 fMRI 编码框架：用 SISFM 让源分布以刺激为条件（可学习时间卷积塑造源均值、方差头缩短传输路径），以 DiT-X 解码器、十个冻结视觉/音频/语言骨干的异构融合实现单模型编码，并给出刺激条件下的不确定性与样本多样性。

**相关性简评：** 论文指出同一刺激对应一个神经响应分布而非单点估计，「刺激条件下源分布 + 方差头缩短传输路径」可能为 latent 推理状态的初始化与分布建模提供线索，多样本采样与不确定性估计或可供核查「多种 latent 假设」的取舍与评价，但属较远领域，迁移性需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** MultiFlow: Vision-Driven Multimodal fMRI Encoding via Stimulus-Informed Source Flow Matching

**abstract/A1：** Current fMRI encoding models frame prediction as deterministic regression, yet identical stimuli evoke a distribution of neural responses (arising from physiological noise, hemodynamic variability, and cognitive fluctuations) that a single point estimate cannot capture. This work introduces MultiFlow, a generative fMRI encoding framework based on Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) and a formulation termed Stimulus-Informed Source Flow Matching (SISFM). SISFM generalises CFM by conditioning the source distribution on the stimulus: a learnable temporal convolution shapes the source mean with an HRF-length receptive field, while a variance head shrinks its scale, shortening the expected transport path. SISFM is instantiated with a Diffusion Transformer (DiT-X) decoder parameterising the velocity field, with sub-layer Attention Residuals, heterogeneous fusion of ten frozen vision, audio, language, and audiovisual backbones, and per-subject Yeo-network heads. On the Algonauts 2025 dataset, a single MultiFlow checkpoint recovers most of the benefit of large deterministic ensembles: it trails the 1000-model TRIBE ensemble in-distribution by 0.003 PCC (0.3163 vs. 0.3195), and the strongest in- and out-of-distribution ensembles (VIBE-20, MedARC-50) by 0.010 and 0.009 PCC, using a single trained model rather than an ensemble of 20-1000. The same checkpoint also provides stimulus-conditioned uncertainty estimates and sample-based diversity.

**comment/C1：** 17 pages, 7 figures, 7 tables. Accepted at the British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC) 2026

</details>

### 631. [Adversarial Detection for Pre-trained Classifiers via Lipschitz-Margin Analysis with Certification](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15359v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15359

**作者：** Rui Zhang、Xinle Cao、Huazhen Yu、Jian Liu、Youwen Zhu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15359v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15359v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文面向预训练分类器提出「认证式对抗检测」：证明可从 certified ℓ2 鲁棒性归约到 certified detection，把问题化为单一 Lipschitz 常数，并给出两种无需重训练的检测器，在 MNIST/CIFAR-10/ImageNet 多骨干上对比五种基线。

**相关性简评：** 其 Lipschitz 常数与 margin 几何刻画的是表示空间对输入扰动的敏感度，可能为判断内部视觉证据是否被扰动扭曲、评估 latent 推理状态的稳定性提供可核查的分析工具，但原文不涉及多模态推理或 latent 状态生成，迁移价值需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Adversarial Detection for Pre-trained Classifiers via Lipschitz-Margin Analysis with Certification

**abstract/A1：** Deep classifiers deployed in safety-critical services like autonomous-driving perception remain vulnerable to small adversarial perturbations. Certified $\\ell\_2$ defenses today face a costly trade-off: randomized smoothing (RS) requires hundreds of noisy queries per input, while Lipschitz networks (LN) constrain the architecture and sacrifice clean accuracy. We take a detection-oriented approach instead: rather than certifying that predictions are invariant inside an $\\ell\_2$ ball, we certify that adversarial inputs within an $\\ell\_2$ ball are \\emph{detected} --- a guarantee aligned with security-critical deployments where missing an attack is costlier than flagging a clean input. To realize this, we prove a Lipschitz-margin reduction from certified $\\ell\_2$ robustness to certified detection, which reduces the problem to handling a single Lipschitz constant $L$. We introduce two detector families: $\\mathbb{D}\_{Adv}$, which estimates $L$ from a single defender-side perturbed pair, and $\\mathbb{D}\_{lc}$, which augments that pair with a local margin centroid to keep the estimate above what the certificate requires. Both deploy on any pretrained classifier without retraining. With a valid global bound, the detector is fully certified at that radius; with a local estimate $L'$, certification is sample-wise and applies only when our certified condition holds. Across MNIST, CIFAR-10, and ImageNet-1k on four backbones (LeNet-5, VGG16, ResNet-50, ViT-B/16), our detectors match or outperform five baselines (CTT, SortNet, CRM, ContraNet, A$^2$D). For CIFAR-10 with 1-Lipschitz SortNet, our reduction delivers $100\\%$ certified detection at the lowest FPR among compared certified detectors; on the standard CIFAR-10 VGG16, our detectors reject all evaluated in-budget adversarial examples, with 62-82\\% both rejected and formally certified.

**comment/C1：** 21 pages, 17 tables, accepted by NDSS 2027

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文从逼近论角度分析对比表示学习：将 PMI 目标与紧算子相联系，说明 D 维内积模型的评分相当于秩 D 谱逼近，误差由谱尾部控制；并给出深度网络评分函数的普遍一致性、依 PMI 光滑性的误差率、低秩结构数据下中等宽度编码器的改进率，以及从对比超额风险到下游检索误差的校准率。

**相关性简评：** 纯理论工作，但其「有限维内积状态等价于秩 D 谱逼近、误差由谱尾决定」的分析视角，或许可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态维度容量与视觉信息保留、信息坍缩边界的问题表述；与 VLM 推理本身无直接实验联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Approximation in Contrastive Representation Learning

**abstract/A1：** Contrastive representation learning (CRL) is a fundamental paradigm for learning transferable representations. Recent work identifies its population target as the pointwise mutual information (PMI) $\\log\\frac{p(x,y)}{p\_X(x)p\_Y(y)}$ between two modalities $X,Y$, where $p$ is the joint density function and $p\_X,p\_Y$ are the marginals. However, it remains unclear why standard inner-product scores $f(x)^\\top g(y)$ can effectively approximate a generally nonseparable population target PMI. In this paper, we address this question from the aspect of approximation for CRL. By linking PMI to a compact operator, we show that $D$-dimensional inner-product models perform rank-$D$ spectral approximation, with error controlled by the spectral tail. We then study neural network realizations: in general settings, we show that deep neural network scoring functions are universally consistent, and the approximation error rates depend on the smoothness of the PMI function; under structured low-rank data models we obtain improved rates attained by moderate-width encoders. Finally, we establish a fast calibration rate from contrastive excess risk to downstream retrieval error under a density-ratio Tsybakov noise condition.

**comment/C1：** 54 pages, accepted by NeurIPS 2026

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 DC-FLOW，用延迟耦合流匹配分阶段生成靶标条件环肽：先让骨架成形，再激活序列与侧链，并通过流耦合使骨架几何与残基身份协同演化，同时以带 3D 提议的级联 test-time scaling 提前终止无望的细化。

**相关性简评：** 其「延迟激活＋耦合更新」的分阶段生成与基于轨迹反馈的提前终止，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态与答案的协同更新、以及成本感知的停止决策提供类比线索，迁移可行性待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DC-Flow: Target-Conditioned Cyclic Peptide Design via Delayed-Coupling Flow Matching

**abstract/A1：** Target-conditioned cyclic peptide design requires coordinating interfacial side chains with macrocyclic closure. Existing end-to-end generators concurrently update geometric and chemical variables from noise, assigning residues to disordered coordinates. Meanwhile, predictor-assisted workflows often get stuck in local traps because they lack feedback in the propose-and-filter stage and ignore 3D structural proposals during sequence search. To overcome the drawbacks of these two paradigms, we propose DC-FLOW, a staged generative framework built around Delayed-Coupling Flow Matching. In principle, DC-FLOW postpones sequence and side-chain activation until a target-conditioned backbone takes shape, resolving structural ambiguity before chemical assignment. Then, it feeds delayed activations back into the backbone, achieving co-evolution of backbone geometry and emerging residue identities by coupling their flows. This mechanism enables more reliable macrocyclic closure and favorable interface packing. For predictor-assisted workflows, DC-FLOW supplies 3D proposals with in-trajectory guidance, enabling cascaded test-time scaling to prune redundant backbones and terminate unpromising refinement early. Extensive experiments show that DC-FLOW improves cyclization fidelity, diversity, and interface energetics, substantially increasing the yield of confident cyclic peptide binders under a fixed final-candidate budget. Our code is available at https://github.com/mianqiu00/DCFlow.

</details>

### 634. [Riemannian Graph Tokenizer for Structural Knowledge Transfer](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15427v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Riemannian Graph Tokenizer：以黎曼几何定义由树、环、序列构成的几何词表，构建带黎曼直通估计器的量化器把跨域图结构离散成 token，并用几何对齐解码器将各流形上的 token 投影到统一切空间，以支持结构知识的跨域迁移。

**相关性简评：** 其「把隐表示离散量化、再把不同几何空间的表示对齐到统一切空间」的做法，可能与 LVR 中 latent 状态的离散化、跨空间/跨模型 latent 对齐以及表示几何分析存在概念联系，可供核查，但原文面向图基础模型，与视觉推理相去较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Riemannian Graph Tokenizer for Structural Knowledge Transfer

**abstract/A1：** Foundation models are at the forefront of artificial intelligence. A tokenizer, converting the raw input into discrete representations that the model can understand, plays an important role to the success of foundation models. Unlike the text tokenizer that is well studied in large language models, graph tokenizer is still at its early stage, facing the challenges of tackling the non-Euclidean structures and capturing the structural semantics. How to design a graph tokenizer for structural knowledge transfer? To this end, we propose a Riemannian Graph Tokenizer (RGT) that bridges the structural knowledge and quantized representations to support cross-domain structural knowledge transfer. The connection is established by Riemannian geometry. Specifically, we first define the geometric vocabulary (trees, cycles and sequences), which captures fundamental structural patterns and reflects the intrinsic geometry of graph. Second, we construct a Riemannian quantizer with Riemannian Straight-Through Estimator to tokenise graph structures across multiple domains into discrete tokens. To ensure consistency and transferability across diverse geometric spaces, RGT further incorporates a geometry-aligned decoder that projects manifold-specific tokens into a unified tangent space. The theoretical analysis and geometric interpretations are provided to support the effectiveness of our proposed method. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets demonstrate that RGT significantly enhances structural knowledge transferability across graph domains.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at WWW26

</details>

### 635. [OceanFlow: Coherent Flow Matching for Probabilistic Ocean Modeling](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15518v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15518

**作者：** Yuan Gao、Fan Xu、Hao Wu、Xiaomeng Huang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15518v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15518v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 OceanFlow，用 coherent flow matching 做概率式全球海洋建模：先建立稳定的条件均值锚点，再学习状态条件的路径概率律以联合重塑残差分布，并用 Factorized Dynamics Operator 参数化均值锚点与残差流速度，以获得更可靠的集合预报。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接关联，但其「用 flow matching 联合建模条件状态分布而非独立扰动生成集成成员」的思路，可能为 latent 推理状态的分布建模与多轨迹一致性提供概念借鉴，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** OceanFlow: Coherent Flow Matching for Probabilistic Ocean Modeling

**abstract/A1：** Probabilistic ocean modeling is essential for risk-aware marine operations, climate analysis, and scientific decision-making, where downstream decisions depend on the conditional distribution of future ocean states rather than a single deterministic trajectory. Recent data-driven ocean models have made deterministic global ocean modeling increasingly accurate and efficient, but probabilistic ocean modeling remains underdeveloped. Specifically, perturbation-driven ensembles can create spread without explicitly optimizing the joint distribution of their members, often yielding poor calibration and physical inconsistency. To address these issues, we propose OceanFlow, a coherent flow matching framework for probabilistic global ocean modeling. OceanFlow first establishes a sharp, stable mean anchor for the conditional ensemble. Flow matching then learns a coherent state-conditioned pathwise law that jointly reshapes the residual distribution around this anchor at each transition, preserving the predictive center while refining state-dependent uncertainty. We further introduce a Factorized Dynamics Operator (FDO), which combines factorized transitions with a learned state-conditioned response to parameterize the mean anchor and residual-flow velocity. Extensive experiments show that OceanFlow improves ensemble-mean accuracy, probabilistic reliability, and physical-consistency diagnostics over competitive baselines, supporting coherent flow matching as an effective route toward data-driven probabilistic ocean modeling. Code is available at https://github.com/YuanGao-YG/OceanFlow.

</details>

### 636. [Agent-Canary-Mas: End-to-End Evaluation of Protocol Risk in Long-Horizon Multi-Agent Systems](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15529v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15529

**作者：** Xiuming Liu、Le Gai、Zhiyuan Chang、Peiyang Li、Bin Zhu、Shuo Wang、Chao Feng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15529v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15529v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Agent-Canary-Mas，一个端到端评估系统，沿长程多智能体任务追踪 A2A、ANP、BCS 协议的 5 类 13 子类风险，用 975 对匹配的恶意—良性任务区分「局部协议攻击成功」与「下游后果转化」，并评估在关键交接处检查对象权限的 Guard。

**相关性简评：** 其把局部成功与最终后果分离、并靠跨智能体留存证据做参与者归因（Audit-F1 29.7%→95.5%）的做法，可能为 latent 推理中「中间状态是否真正被下游使用」的贡献分配与轨迹证据追踪提供可核查的类比；但该工作不涉及视觉表示或 latent 状态，联系较远，需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Agent-Canary-Mas: End-to-End Evaluation of Protocol Risk in Long-Horizon Multi-Agent Systems

**abstract/A1：** Agent-to-agent protocols allow LLM agents to discover peers, exchange results, and coordinate tool use. A locally successful protocol attack, however, may be rejected by a later agent or propagated into a consequential task decision. Measuring local exploitability alone leaves this difference unresolved and provides limited evidence about which participant caused the final outcome. We present Agent-Canary-Mas, an end-to-end evaluation system that follows protocol risk through long-horizon multi-agent tasks. It covers five risk classes and 13 subclasses across A2A, ANP, and BCS, with 975 matched malicious--benign task pairs in five business domains. A shared OpenClaw framework runs autonomous, tool-using agents under different underlying models while preserving the task and execution setup. Matched runs separate local protocol success from downstream consequences; retained evidence connects participant selection, message consumption, tool activity, and task-state changes. We further evaluate a protocol-context Guard that checks an object's authority at consequential handoffs. Across three model conditions, local attack success is frequently at or above 90%, while consequence conversion ranges from 7.1\\% to 100.0\\%. Cross-agent evidence raises macro-averaged Audit-F1 from 29.7% to 95.5%. On Finance tasks, the Guard lowers average ASR from 86.1% to 53.8% and PTCR from 65.5% to 31.2%, with a measurable completion tradeoff. These results show that protocol risk depends on how agents use exchanged objects throughout the task, and that evaluating this path supports more informative risk assessment, attribution, and defense.

**comment/C1：** 21 pages, 8 figures

</details>

### 637. [Sensitivity Fidelity Reveals Physical Dependencies Beyond Forecast Accuracy in Deep-Learning Earth-System Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15540v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15540

**作者：** Qi Chen、Peng Zhan、Hongxing Cui、Wenqing Cui、Ibrahim Hoteit

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、physics.ao-ph、physics.geo-ph

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15540v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15540v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出「敏感性保真度」这一额外评判标准，在理想化 Rayleigh-Bénard 对流基准与 ENSO 预测中比较多个深度学习地球系统模型：除预测误差外，还检验模型对输入扰动的响应是否与伴随参考或已知物理前兆一致，发现预测能力与敏感性保真度并不必然吻合。

**相关性简评：** 其「低预测误差不等于依赖关系可信、需用扰动响应诊断模型真正依据了什么输入」的评估思路，可能为 LVR 中判断答案是否真正使用视觉证据、而非依赖语言先验或视觉旁路提供类比线索，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Sensitivity Fidelity Reveals Physical Dependencies Beyond Forecast Accuracy in Deep-Learning Earth-System Models

**abstract/A1：** Deep-learning models increasingly rival numerical simulation in Earth-system forecasting, yet forecast error alone cannot determine whether their learned input-output dependencies are physically consistent. Here we introduce sensitivity fidelity as an additional criterion: alongside prediction error, model responses to input perturbations should be examined against a trusted reference or established physical knowledge. In an idealized Rayleigh-Bénard convection benchmark, four surrogate architectures achieved low forecast errors yet encoded markedly different sensitivities. Quantitative comparison with a matched adjoint distinguished the models far more sharply than forecast accuracy and showed that predictive skill and sensitivity fidelity need not coincide, while finite-perturbation experiments further linked these differences to the propagation of initial-condition uncertainty. We then applied this strategy to El Niño-Southern Oscillation prediction, where no adjoint reference exists and learned sensitivities showed event-wise robustness, validity under finite perturbations, and consistency with established precursors. These results identify gradient-based evaluation as a discriminating complement to forecast-error metrics, providing a practical test of whether data-driven Earth-system models learn physically credible dependencies.

</details>
