### 638. [A Plausible Future Is Not a Causal Future: Can Video Models Generate How the World Unfolds?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15562v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15562

**作者：** Jialiang Li、Zhengning Xu、Zongyang Ma、Shaobo Cui

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15562v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15562v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文构建 CausalCascade 基准，用 50 个 Blender 场景、结构化事件图、图接地的诊断式 VQA 与 2832 个受控反事实变体，从运动、事件、反事实三个层面评估九个 image-to-video 模型能否忠实生成完整因果级联。

**相关性简评：** 其「物理干预—选择性响应」的反事实诊断设计，可能为 LVR 中判断 latent 内容是否真正因果地影响答案、以及视觉证据使用与失败定位提供可核查的评价思路；但研究对象是视频世界模型，与 VLM 内部推理状态无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A Plausible Future Is Not a Causal Future: Can Video Models Generate How the World Unfolds?

**abstract/A1：** Large-scale video generation models are increasingly viewed as a promising path toward world models, yet their ability to capture causally coherent physical dynamics remains poorly understood. Existing evaluations largely emphasize visual quality, prompt adherence, or broad physical plausibility, leaving open whether a model can faithfully realize a complete causal cascade, in which an initiating event propagates through causally dependent interactions to a terminal outcome. We introduce CausalCascade, a simulator-grounded benchmark centered on 50 event-rich Blender scenes with structured event graphs, graph-grounded diagnostic VQA, three levels of future-event specification, and 2,832 controlled counterfactual variants, and use it to evaluate nine image-to-video models with complementary motion-, event-, and counterfactual-level diagnostics. Across the evaluated models, generated motion is more reliably localized spatially than realized with correct spatiotemporal evolution, while richer future-event specification improves event recovery but leaves physical realization limited. Counterfactual evaluation further reveals weak selective responsiveness to physical interventions, while most audited failures are foundational, arising at scene consistency or event occurrence. Together, these results position causal cascade generation as a process-level test of world modeling and highlight the need to jointly recover the intended future, faithfully realize its physical evolution, selectively respond to physical interventions, and maintain a coherent physical world over time. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/SJTU-DeepDeltaLab/CausalCascade .

**comment/C1：** 81 pages, 17 figures

</details>

### 639. [UNISON: A Unified Framework for Learning from Scored Bags](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15564v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15564

**作者：** Ofek Kirshenboim、Or Shkuri、Shani Finkelshtein、Yoram Louzoun

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15564v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15564v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 UNISON 统一框架，把多示例学习与个性化推荐都看作对「(例项, 分数) 包集合」的学习，分三阶段学习通用物品表示、轻量包特定偏好与包级推断，并对线性包打分给出泰勒余项分析、冷启动闭式解与迭代收敛保证，在书籍、电影、TCR 分类和微生物组等任务上验证。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接关系，但其中「由示例级分数反推包级特征、并恢复驱动分数的 latent 因子」的思路，可能可供核查视觉证据聚合与贡献分配，以及线性聚合近似何时成立。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** UNISON: A Unified Framework for Learning from Scored Bags

**abstract/A1：** We introduce UNISON, a unified framework that bridges multiple instance learning and recommendation systems by treating both as instances of learning from scored bag collections of (item, score) pairs. Unlike traditional approaches that address bag-level classification and personalized recommendation as separate problems, UNISON decomposes learning into three interconnected stages: (1) learning universal item representations, (2) modeling bag-specific preference patterns through lightweight personalized parameters, and (3) inferring bag-level characteristics from learned preferences. We justify the architectural choice of linear bag-specific scoring through a first-order analysis: when item embeddings are sufficiently smooth in the score, a linear function approximates the score up to a Taylor remainder controlled by the curvature of the underlying preference function. For cold-start scenarios, we show that the cold-bag fitting problem reduces to ridge-less linear regression with a closed-form solution, and provide convergence guarantees for the iterative variant. Empirically, UNISON matches or outperforms state-of-the-art approaches across diverse domains: entertainment (books, movies), immunology (T cell receptor (TCR) based classification), and microbiome, offering superior computational efficiency and interpretability. A controlled synthetic experiment further confirms that the bag-specific parameters ($w\_j, b\_j$) recover the latent factors that drive item scores even when the projection $φ$ has no access to the original scoring mechanism (AUC &gt; 0.998). UNISON is available at https://github.com/louzounlab/UNISON.

</details>

### 640. [Inverse Garment Design with Visual Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15582v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15582

**作者：** Nanxiang Jiang、Yunuo Chen、Zeng Tao、Zizhang Li、Qi Guo、Jiajun Wu、Yin Yang、Chenfanfu Jiang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15582v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15582v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 DressAgent，用分层智能体从单图重建多层可仿真 3D 服装的缝纫样板：先做层规划与粗估，再由 Tailor、Critic、Orchestrator 组成「编辑—仿真—评判」闭环细化，并配有进化记忆与纹理生成，同时构建首个 15K 多层样板数据集。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线领域距离较远，但其依据视觉与测量证据的闭环细化、评判式验证与收敛停止机制，可能为 LVR 的迭代证据获取、验证与停止决策提供类比线索，可供人工核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Inverse Garment Design with Visual Agents

**abstract/A1：** We study the problem of inverse garment design, reconstructing simulation-ready 3D outfits with arbitrary layers from a single image, with visual agents. Unlike differentiable optimization that is time-consuming, or feed-forward methods limited by training data, we introduce DressAgent, a hierarchical agentic system that recovers garment sewing patterns through planning and closed-loop refinement grounded in physical simulation. To this end, we first present an enhanced representation based on GarmentCode for diverse styles and arbitrary dressing layers, and build the first multi-layer sewing pattern dataset with over 15K outfits for supervision and benchmarking. Inverse design then proceeds coarse to fine: In layer planning and coarse estimation, agents infer layer order and relations, peel each layer into its own view, and estimate coarse patterns. In fine-grained refinement, an agentic trio of Tailor, Critic, and Orchestrator refines patterns in a closed loop of editing, simulating, and judging against the reference with visual and measured evidence. Carefully designed tools and an evolving memory make this refinement converge on the target geometry. We also design an agentic generation method for high-fidelity textures. DressAgent outperforms feed-forward methods by a large margin, surpasses or matches differentiable optimization in a fraction of the time, and generalizes to complex layering, diverse poses, and body shapes.

</details>

### 641. [An Attention-Guided Graph Neural Network Surrogate for Boundary Integral Computation in Physical Field Reconstruction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15590v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15590

**作者：** RongZe Gao、YuWei Wu、XinRan Ji、XingYue Ren

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出 GNN-BEM 框架，用注意力引导的图神经网络加 VAE，将离散边界上的物理量编码到 latent 空间，由已知边界量预测缺失边界量，再用传统边界元积分重建内部物理场，在二维 Laplace 与 Poisson 方程数值算例上验证重建精度与稳定性。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接交集，但其「由部分可观测边界信息推断缺失信息并重建内部状态」的 latent 空间设定及注意力建模变量间关联的做法，可能与 LVR 中证据不完整时内部状态如何承载并补全任务必要信息的表述有概念呼应，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** An Attention-Guided Graph Neural Network Surrogate for Boundary Integral Computation in Physical Field Reconstruction

**abstract/A1：** In practical engineering and scientific computing, a real physical system can be reduced to a boundary value problem, and the adequate boundary information to determine the interior spatial distribution and evolutionary state of the physical field can be solved with linear equations, alternatively, the the real physical problem can be treated with boundary problems with in adequate information problems in field of machine learning. This paper proposes a deep learning framework for the recovery of missing boundary information using an attention-guided graph neural network (GNN) surrogate. The framework extracts features from the physical information on the discretized boundary into a latent space, and the missing boundary quantities are then predicted by the network. Thus, the nonlinear mapping from known boundary quantities to missing boundary quantities is learned using a variational autoencoder (VAE) architecture, while an attention mechanism is incorporated to better model the correlations among different types of boundary information. Furthermore, the interior physical field can be reconstructed using the conventional boundary element method (BEM) integral formulation. The effectiveness of the GNN-BEM framework is evaluated using numerical examples of the two-dimensional Laplace and Poisson equations, which demonstrate good performance in reconstruction accuracy, local detail preservation, and model stability. The results show that GNN-BEM provides a feasible computational framework for boundary information recovery and fast interior physical field reconstruction for partial differential equations under complex boundary conditions.

</details>

### 642. [CondMSP: Condition-Informed and Resource-Aware Inorganic Materials Synthesis Planning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15603v1>)

**作者：** Heewoong Noh、Gyoung S. Na、Elton Pan、Namkyeong Lee、Chanyoung Park

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 CondMSP，把无机材料合成规划从配方预测扩展为执行感知规划：用联合预测器加变量专属专家预测温度、时间与气氛，再把这些条件同时用作过程上下文（支撑操作序列的生成与检索）和执行需求（规定热阶段如何共享炉次与成本），并在炉次预算下通过约束优化统一选择候选路线、分配热阶段。

**相关性简评：** 其「在固定资源预算下按统一效用从候选路线中联合选择并分配执行阶段」的约束优化框架，可能为 LVR 的动态计算分配、多条候选 latent 轨迹的筛选与停止决策提供类比线索，可供核查；但领域相距较远，需人工判断迁移可行性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CondMSP: Condition-Informed and Resource-Aware Inorganic Materials Synthesis Planning

**abstract/A1：** Materials synthesis planning (MSP) connects AI-driven materials discovery to experimental realization by proposing precursors, synthesis operations, and processing conditions for a target material. Existing approaches predict these components separately or in pairs and treat conditions only as a prediction target. Consequently, MSP remains centered on recipe prediction: it leaves unexplored how conditions can serve as process context for constructing synthesis routes, and it does not address which candidate routes should be executed under limited experimental resources. We propose CondMSP, which extends MSP from recipe prediction to execution-aware planning. CondMSP predicts temperature, time, and atmosphere by combining a joint predictor with variable-specific experts, and then uses these predictions both as process context, grounding the generation and retrieval of operation sequences, and as execution requirements, specifying which thermal stages can share a furnace run and at what cost. This specification is held fixed across all compared methods; within it, CondMSP ranks routes across precursor sets by a common utility and, under furnace budgets, jointly selects routes and allocates their thermal stages by constrained optimization. CondMSP improves condition and operation prediction and, under this shared constraint, raises reference-recipe recovery from 27.9% to 32.9% at three simulated furnace runs per target and from 34.7% to 40.0% at 30 trials, while a new evaluation set of 2,344 targets supports generalization beyond oxide-dominated training chemistry.

</details>

### 643. [The Price of Precision: A Calibrated Cost Model for Mixed-Precision LLM Serving](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15629v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15629

**作者：** Mukund Athmaram、Manoj Rao、Liang Ma

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15629v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15629v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文为 LLM 混合精度推理服务构建了一个标定的代价模型：区分计算、权重加载与 KV cache 访问中真正限制速度的「约束资源」，用它预测服务延迟，并结合逐张量精度代价，通过动态规划在延迟或精度预算下选择配置。

**相关性简评：** 其「按约束资源建模 + 动态规划在预算下分配」的思路可能可供核查：LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的收益成本也可能受不同瓶颈资源支配，而非单一代理量（如字节数或 token 数），可类比为在延迟预算下分配精度或计算。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The Price of Precision: A Calibrated Cost Model for Mixed-Precision LLM Serving

**abstract/A1：** Choosing a mixed-precision configuration for large language model (LLM) serving trades speed against accuracy. Allocators that use average bit-width or a memory budget as a speed proxy can miss changes in the resource that limits execution. We argue that served speed can be limited by compute, weight loading, or key-value (KV) cache access, depending on the phase, batch size, and context length. A byte-based proxy does not capture all of these costs, so fewer bits do not always mean faster serving. To address this gap, we build a cost model that accounts for the binding resource and use it in two ways. First, as a predictor: given a configuration and operating point, it estimates serving latency using constants calibrated for the model, GPU, and serving stack. We evaluate its accuracy across three hardware classes. Second, as an allocator: we combine modeled time costs with measured per-tensor accuracy costs and use a dynamic program to select a configuration under a latency or accuracy budget. We compare its configurations against byte-aware and sensitivity-only allocation.

</details>

### 644. [Big-Big-SycoBench: A Benchmark to Detect Sycophancy Through Model Responses to Valid vs. Invalid Arguments](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15634v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15634

**作者：** Marthe Ballon、Arne Vanhoyweghen、Seorin Kim、Francesca Carlon、Lynn Delcon、Melika Mobini、Vincent Holst、Lukas Van de Voorde、Tibo Vanleke、Mathieu Louis、Bert Verbruggen、Brecht F. Verbeken、Andres Algaba、Vincent Ginis

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15634v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15634v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Big-Big-SycoBench 基准，用 450 个文本对象与 5400 条有效或无效论证，测试模型能否在有效批评下修正评分、在无效压力下坚持原判断，并在十个模型上区分「响应性」与「顺从性」。

**相关性简评：** 其「有效证据才应改变判断」的评测思路，可能与 LVR 关注的视觉证据筛选及 latent 状态是否真正驱动答案更新问题有概念联系，可供核查其更新阈值与证据有效性判别设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Big-Big-SycoBench: A Benchmark to Detect Sycophancy Through Model Responses to Valid vs. Invalid Arguments

**abstract/A1：** Sycophancy in large language models risks amplifying unsupported claims or beliefs across the knowledge ecosystem as these systems increasingly contribute to research synthesis, evaluation, and decision-making. A reliable model should revise its judgement when a user identifies a genuine flaw, but should resist pushback based on fallacies, emotion, or irrelevant appeals to authority. While sycophancy is usually measured on questions with a verifiable answer, the evaluative tasks in which it is most difficult to detect have no such ground truth. We introduce Big-Big-SycoBench, which measures sycophancy through argument discernment: the ability to revise an evaluation after valid criticism while resisting invalid pressure. The benchmark consists of 450 text artefacts with 5,400 arguments for raising or lowering their quality scores, each reviewed by one or more of twelve human annotators. An LLM scores each artefact twenty times to establish its baseline score and uncertainty. The model is then given a valid or invalid argument and asked to update its score. We only count a revision if it exceeds the model's own baseline variability. We use the resulting score delta to distinguish responsiveness to valid arguments from compliance with invalid ones. Across ten models, responsiveness is 88-95\\% for seven, 76-77\\% for Kimi K3 and GLM-5.3, and 32\\% for Opus 5.5. Compliance ranges from 0.2\\% for GPT-6 Astra to 95\\% for GPT-4o. Big-Big-SycoBench is intended to guide the development of models whose judgements can be corrected by sound arguments, but not displaced by unsupported pressure.

</details>

### 645. [Radioactive Feedback: Tracing Models Trained by Label-Only LLM Supervision](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15685v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15685

**作者：** Yuejia Li、JunHeng Li、Hao Wu、Ke He、Mang Ye

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15685v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15685v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究仅有标量评分、无教师示范的 LLM-as-a-Judge 蒸馏设定，提出「Radioactive Feedback」：评估方在质量达标回复上加有界微调，把注册的行为偏好编码进奖励，使其经反复优化转移到他人训练的模型中，并在代码与数学任务上展示跨数据集的偏好转移与黑盒检测。

**相关性简评：** 该工作把低带宽标量奖励当作可承载结构化偏好的监督通道，可能可供核查 LVR 中纯结果型奖励能否塑造 latent 推理状态的结构与内容，以及监督信号的可追溯性与贡献分配问题；但其任务均为文本代码与数学，向多模态推理状态的迁移仍待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Radioactive Feedback: Tracing Models Trained by Label-Only LLM Supervision

**abstract/A1：** Conventional distillation transfers capability through teacher-generated demonstrations. LLM-as-a-Judge knowledge distillation offers a distinct and increasingly practical alternative. In the label-only variant studied here, the student generates every response and improves from scalar scores alone. Prior work shows that this non-demonstrative feedback can improve student capability, but it creates a fundamentally different provenance problem. No teacher-generated answer enters the student's training set, so any evaluator-specific trace must pass through a low-bandwidth reward signal rather than copied text. Existing watermarks and distillation detectors do not cover this score-only channel. We introduce Radioactive Feedback, which encodes a registered pattern of behavioral preferences in the rewards themselves. The evaluator applies bounded pointwise adjustments to quality-qualified responses, allowing repeated optimization to transfer the pattern to a student trained by another party. Experiments on code and mathematics show that the registered preferences transfer through scores alone and across datasets, enabling black-box detection against a fixed reference pool.

</details>

### 646. [FARL: A Fully Automated Pipeline of RL Interface and Solver Design](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15691v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15691

**作者：** Tianyu Jin、Liuyu Xiang、Chaowen Yang、Xingyang Chang、Pei Pei Li、Zhaofeng He

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15691v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15691v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 FARL，一个全自动强化学习设计框架，联合搜索观测与奖励程序、学习算法及训练配置，并借助训练统计与行为诊断失败、保留多样候选，用分阶段预算先筛选再投入长训练，在导航、运动与操作任务上优于所评估的自动化基线。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 无直接视觉推理关联；但其「分阶段预算先筛后训」可能可类比推理期的动态计算与 STOP 决策，行为统计驱动的失败诊断与「带条件的经验记忆」可供核查推理轨迹训练中监督与贡献分配自动设计的线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** FARL: A Fully Automated Pipeline of RL Interface and Solver Design

**abstract/A1：** Existing reinforcement learning (RL) largely focuses on optimizing learning algorithms within a pre-defined task formulation, while applying RL to new tasks still relies heavily on human expertise to design the learning pipeline: what an agent observes, how it is rewarded, which algorithm it uses, and how training is configured. Automating these choices is challenging because they are tightly coupled. We introduce FARL (Fully Automated Reinforcement Learning), a framework that automates RL design by jointly searching observation and reward programs, learning algorithms, and training settings. FARL uses training statistics and observed behavior to diagnose failures, propose changes, and test whether they improve learning. Its search preserves diverse candidates and the controls needed for these tests, using a staged budget to screen designs before investing in longer training. Experimental memory records each finding together with its conditions, so an unsuccessful component can be reconsidered in a different combination. Across expert-withheld and expert-available settings, FARL outperforms the evaluated automated baselines on challenging navigation, locomotion, and manipulation tasks. On Adroit Hand Relocate, FARL achieves 97.1% success at 5M training steps per policy, compared with 0% for Eureka and LiMEN and 1.0% for native Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) under the same policy training budget.

**comment/C1：** 43 pages, including references and appendices. Code and recorded experimental results are included as ancillary files

</details>

### 647. [Suggested Is Not Superseded: A Pre-Registered Evaluation of a System-One Model as a Memory-Retirement Gate](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15710v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15710

**作者：** Xupeng Chen、Chenqian Le

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15710v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15710v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文为助手长期记忆设计「退休门」，用任务契约把新话语对旧记忆的取代关系分为已确立取代、需确认与兼容三类，标注 500 个测试对，并在预注册假设下评测一个二元「System One」决策模型，发现其主要失败是过早退休仅被暗示的变更，三路决策可压低错误但代价超出预算，级联升级在开发数据上的选择不可靠。

**相关性简评：** 其「三类门控＋不确定时升级到更强推理模型」的决策结构，可能为 LVR 中证据筛选、停止决策与动态计算提供类比；关于 gold 标注与同族模型共享误差的分析，可供核查 latent 内容评测中的偏差来源。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Suggested Is Not Superseded: A Pre-Registered Evaluation of a System-One Model as a Memory-Retirement Gate

**abstract/A1：** Long-term memory for assistants needs a gate that decides when a new utterance retires an old stored claim. Benchmark labels for this step mark a pair as changed or not, so they cannot tell a gate that acts on established change from one that acts on a hint. We write a task contract that separates the two (SUPERSEDED vs. NEEDS-CONFIRMATION vs. COMPATIBLE), label 500 test pairs built from STALE (change pairs plus same-user controls) with three LLM annotators and two human adjudicators (one author and a second annotator; provenance reported), and evaluate Jev, a typed "System One" decision model, under pre-registered hypotheses. Of the 179 test pairs STALE marks as changed, 72 meet the contract's bar for an established change. Jev never retired a claim on 141 same-conversation non-changes. Its failure is premature retirement: the binary gate retires 39.2% of claims whose change is only suggested. A three-way decision cuts this to 15.5% at a 15.3-point detection cost, which misses our pre-registered 10-point budget, and it lands on the binary gate's own threshold frontier; these verdicts hold under three readings of the gold labels. On a held-out vault scored against a second annotator's labels, a cascade that escalated uncertain cases to a reasoning model and looked best on development data was indistinguishable from simply raising the threshold (premature retirement 26.8% vs. 6.5% on dev). Part of the gap comes from the gold labels: relative to that annotator's reading, LLM-majority gold shares most of its errors with a same-family escalation model, and an identity for binary labels says how much such shared errors hide. The rest is small-sample selection on development data. For builders this means a binary score should not be wired to delete: route suggested changes to pending evidence, and do not trust a cascade selected on development data of this size.

**comment/C1：** 11 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15711

**作者：** Vincenzo Yuto Civale、Andrew David Bagdanov、Alberto Magi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在 57 个基因组分类任务上，把五个 DNA 基础模型的冻结表征与归一化 k-mer 频率基线对比，并用拼接增量、线性可预测成分与残差分解、保 6-mer 洗牌等诊断，检验冻结表征是否提供超出序列组成的预测信息。

**相关性简评：** 「浅层组成特征作为必要对照」「线性可恢复性不能可靠指示下游效用」「顺序敏感性洗牌检验」等诊断思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态是否携带超出文本先验或浅层基线的视觉证据；属跨领域类比，需人工判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** What DNA Foundation Models Learn Beyond Sequence Composition

**abstract/A1：** Do genomic foundation models (FMs) provide predictive information beyond simple sequence composition? We evaluate frozen representations from five DNA FMs against normalized k-mer frequencies across 57 genomic classification datasets and two exploratory gene-expression regression tasks. Simple k-mer features remain competitive with most models, whereas NTv3 shows a consistent advantage; the ranking is robust to globally fixed and multi-scale k-mer baselines and alternative downstream probes. To test incremental predictive utility directly, we compare global 6-mer features with their concatenation with each FM embedding under a matched Random Forest protocol. NTv3 improves 46 of 57 datasets (mean $Δ$MCC = +0.072), while Caduceus provides smaller gains and the other models do not improve mean MCC. We separately decompose embeddings into a component linearly predictable from 6-mer frequencies and a ridge residual, finding that linear recoverability does not reliably indicate downstream utility. Exact 6-mer-preserving shuffles further reveal task-relevant sequence-order sensitivity, most pronounced for NTv3, although order sensitivity alone does not guarantee predictive improvements. Our results establish compositional features as essential controls and offer complementary diagnostics for evaluating the added value of frozen genomic representations, without making claims about fine-tuning capacity.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations &amp; Datasets Track). 9 pages of main text, 5 main figures, with references and appendices

### 649. [Uncovering the Generative Landscape of Diffusion Models: A Spectral-Guided Quality-Diversity Diffusion Framework](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15724v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15724

**作者：** Hannah Janmohamed、Joao Correia、Penousal Machado、Antoine Cully

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15724v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15724v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 将 Quality-Diversity 优化与扩散模型结合，直接搜索模型的 latent noise 与条件嵌入并用嵌入模型度量多样性，再以输入-激活 Jacobian 的主奇异向量构造 h-space 谱变异算子，在文生图上改善质量与多样性的权衡。

**相关性简评：** 其用 Jacobian 谱分析定位对语义最敏感的 latent 方向、并以多样解集方式搜索 latent 空间，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态敏感方向识别与多假设保持提供启发，但属图像生成与多样性优化场景，迁移性仅供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Uncovering the Generative Landscape of Diffusion Models: A Spectral-Guided Quality-Diversity Diffusion Framework

**abstract/A1：** Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models have emerged as powerful generative priors across domains ranging from molecular design to high-resolution image synthesis. However, standard diffusion sampling is inherently biased toward high-likelihood regions, often limiting the diversity of outputs. In many domains, a single, high-likelihood sample is insufficient. Instead, diverse portfolios of high-performing solutions are required, motivating methods that uncover a model's full expressive range. Here we show that integrating Quality-Diversity (QD) optimisation with diffusion models enables the discovery of diverse, high-performing outputs. We first propose Quality-Diversity Diffusion, a framework that adapts QD to diffusion models by directly optimising the model's latent noise and conditioning embeddings and leveraging embedding models to quantify diversity. Second, we introduce a novel h-space Spectral Mutation operator, which guides search along directions of maximal semantic sensitivity by analysing principal singular vectors of the model's input-to-activation Jacobian. We evaluate our combined approach, Spectral-Guided Quality-Diversity Diffusion, on text-to-image generation. Against 12 baselines, our method consistently achieves the lowest FID score, demonstrating an excellent balance of image quality and diversity.

</details>

### 650. [Hyperbolic Time Series Forecasting with Learnable Decomposition and Manifold Dynamics](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15760v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15760

**作者：** Sarang Rajendra Patil、Vishal Fenn、Mengjia Xu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15760v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15760v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 HyperForecast，把级联分解出的时间片段嵌入 Poincaré 球，让径向距离承载由低频到高频的嵌套层级，并以两种流形动力学（Poincaré 残差自回归、以及一次性并行预测所有未来片段）完成长期时间序列预测。

**相关性简评：** 虽属时间序列的较远领域，但其用双曲几何的径向位置编码层级结构、并用 AR 与 parallel 两套状态演化生成表示的思路，可能为 LVR 的 latent 表示几何、深度/位置效应及两种推理状态生成方式的对照提供可供核查的线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Hyperbolic Time Series Forecasting with Learnable Decomposition and Manifold Dynamics

**abstract/A1：** Multiscale structure is central to time series forecasting: temporal signals contain slowly varying trends, intermediate seasonal patterns, and high-frequency residuals. Traditional forecasters model this multiscale structure in Euclidean space, without representing the ordering it induces among components. We identify that cascaded decomposition orders components by their characteristic frequencies, forming a natural frequency hierarchy. This hierarchy aligns with the exponential volume growth of hyperbolic space, which provides increasing representational capacity with radius and naturally accommodates nested hierarchies. We propose HyperForecast, the first long-term time series forecasting (LTSF) framework operating in hyperbolic space. HyperForecast embeds decomposed temporal segments on the Poincaré ball where radial distance captures this nested structure, from low-frequency components near the origin to high-frequency components near the boundary. We model geodesic velocity through two manifold-dynamics variants: (a) autoregressive forecasting via Poincaré residual dynamics, and (b) non-autoregressive forecasting that predicts all future segments in parallel. HyperForecast consistently outperforms existing and state-of-the-art baselines on 9 of 11 long-term forecasting benchmarks, achieving up to 58% lower mean squared error at long horizons. Further analysis reveals that the learned radial embeddings recover the frequency hierarchy and that hyperbolic geometry contributes substantially to forecasting performance.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15807

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Totem，一种以物体为中心的 3D 记忆框架：为每个选定物体建立对齐统一世界坐标的持久 3D 记忆与专属状态，并用双流条件架构结合物体记忆与场景几何合成目标视角视频，同时以 3D 结构约束注意力以保持物体表面与相对布局。

**相关性简评：** 该工作以持久化的物体级状态跨视角维持对象一致性，并提供结构约束注意力的机制，可供核查 LVR 中实体级状态抽象与视觉细节保有的思路，但属视频生成领域、与 VLM 推理无直接关联。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Totem: Object-Centric 3D Memory for World-Consistent Video Generation

**abstract/A1：** Generating coherent videos grounded in a unified underlying world remains a major challenge, particularly under large viewpoint changes, where existing methods often struggle to maintain stable representations of individual objects. To this end, we introduce Totem, an object-centric 3D memory framework for world-consistent video generation. Totem first represents each selected object as a persistent 3D memory aligned to a shared world frame, assigning it a dedicated state. Based on these memories, we design a dual-stream 3D conditioning architecture that combines object memories with scene geometry for target-view synthesis. Moreover, these object memories constrain the model's attention with 3D structural information, thereby preserving object surfaces and relative spatial layouts. Extensive experiments on world-generation and object-centric benchmarks demonstrate that Totem generates videos depicting a more object-consistent 3D world under challenging camera trajectories, while supporting versatile applications.

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文比较两种几何条件化的 U-Net 代理模型（固定画布中显式编码房间尺寸的 CaNN 与使用归一化坐标通道的 CoNN）在房间尺寸变化下实时预测室内气流与温度场的效果，结果显示 CaNN 与 CFD 结果更一致。

**相关性简评：** 其核心变量是几何条件的编码方式（保留绝对位置区域 vs 归一化坐标）如何影响跨尺寸泛化，可能为 LVR 中几何与位置信息怎样留在内部表示并影响泛化提供可核查线索；但该文不涉及推理状态生成、证据筛选或停止决策，仅属远端启发。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Comparative Study of Canvas- and Coordinate-Based Geometry-Conditioned Neural Networks for Real-Time Prediction of Indoor Environments with Varying Room Dimensions

**abstract/A1：** Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) is computationally expensive for iterative building design. Deep learning surrogates offer faster predictions, but generalization across varying room dimensions remains challenging. This study compares two geometry-conditioned neural network surrogate models for rapid indoor airflow and temperature field prediction under varying room sizes. During the architectural design stage, this method is relevant for real-time assessment of whether conditioned supply air will effectively provide fresh and cool air throughout rooms with varying heights and lengths. The canvas-based neural network (CaNN) explicitly encodes room size by preserving different occupied regions within a fixed canvas, whereas the coordinate-based neural network (CoNN) uses normalized coordinate channels. Both employ U-Net autoencoders to separately predict airflow and temperature fields. Evaluation uses simplified rooms with varying heights and lengths as a controlled benchmark. The results show that CaNN achieves higher agreement with CFD results than CoNN, demonstrating its potential to support performance-driven building design.

</details>

### 653. [Sample-Optimal Multi-Group Learning with an ERM Oracle](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15916v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15916

**作者：** Princewill Okoroafor

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.DS、cs.GT

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15916v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15916v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究多组学习中能否仅通过加权 ERM oracle 达到最优样本复杂度，给出 $\\tilde{O}((d\_G+d\_H)/\\varepsilon^2)$ 的算法与匹配下界，并分析每个样本至多属于 k 个可列举组的特例。

**相关性简评：** 其「按子群体逐个保证超额风险」与 oracle 高效训练的框架，或可启发 LVR 中跨视觉子群体的推理表现评价目标及受限接口下的高效训练，属较远领域的潜在借鉴线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Sample-Optimal Multi-Group Learning with an ERM Oracle

**abstract/A1：** In multi-group learning, a single predictor must perform nearly as well as the best hypothesis in a class on every group in a rich, possibly infinite and overlapping, collection of subpopulations. The known algorithms with the optimal sample complexity keep track of every pair of a group and a hypothesis, which is impossible for the large classes of interest, and the known oracle-based algorithms have a worse rate. We ask whether the optimal rate can be attained by a learner that accesses the classes only through an empirical risk minimization (ERM) oracle. We give an algorithm that uses $\\tilde{O}((d\_G+d\_H)/\\varepsilon^2)$ samples and polynomially many calls to a weighted ERM oracle over pairs of a group and a hypothesis, where $d\_G$ and $d\_H$ are the VC dimensions of the group and hypothesis classes and $\\varepsilon$ bounds the excess risk on every group, weighted by its probability. We also show a matching lower bound of $Ω((d\_G+d\_H)/\\varepsilon^2)$ samples for every learner even with unlimited computation, so oracle efficiency costs no additional samples. We also consider a natural special case in which every input belongs to at most $k$ groups and these groups can be listed. In this case, an ERM oracle for the hypothesis class alone suffices, with $\\tilde{O}((d\_H+\\log k)/\\varepsilon^2)$ samples in the agnostic setting and $\\tilde{O}((d\_H+\\log k)/\\varepsilon)$ samples when every group has a hypothesis that is correct on it.

</details>

### 654. [Mesh-Free Convolution: Learned Spectral Attenuation and Transport](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15931v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15931

**作者：** Niloufar Zakariaei、Manav Manav、Eldad Haber

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15931v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15931v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Mesh-Free Convolution：在连续空间定义滤波、仅在求值时离散化，学习随尺度平滑衰减并含方向性项（类输运）的滤波，用于 PDE 算子自回归长程预测时的稳定性与跨分辨率迁移。

**相关性简评：** 其关于连续滤波、尺度相关衰减与自回归误差反复传播的分析，可能为 LVR 中循环/自回归 latent 状态更新的稳定性、跨步信息衰减及分辨率/长度泛化提供可核查的类比视角。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Mesh-Free Convolution: Learned Spectral Attenuation and Transport

**abstract/A1：** Learning solution operators for partial differential equations (PDEs) requires models that can represent spatial structure across grids and scales. This becomes especially important in time-dependent problems, where the learned operator is often used autoregressively: each predicted state is fed back as input to predict future states. In this setting, small spatial errors can be repeatedly propagated through the learned dynamics, leading to instability and drift, vitiating long-term solution fidelity. We propose Mesh-Free Convolutions (MFCs), filters defined in continuous space and discretized only at evaluation time. This allows the same learned filters to be applied across resolutions. Rather than imposing a grid-dependent stencil or a fixed spectral cutoff, MFCs learn smooth scale-dependent filtering and include directional terms for transport-like behavior. Across fluid-dynamics and weather-forecasting benchmarks, MFC-based models produce stable long-horizon rollouts, transfer reliably across resolutions, and better preserve long-time statistics. These results suggest that continuous, mesh-free filtering is a useful inductive bias for PDE operator learning, especially in autoregressive prediction.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 655. [Vision: "What Don't I Know About User's Preferences?" How Uncertainty Estimation Improves Proactive Assistant Alignment](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15948v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15948

**作者：** Zhiyu An、Ziyi Xuan、Yu Yang、Wan Du

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.HC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15948v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15948v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 这篇 vision 论文主张为用户偏好预测补充不确定性估计，以说明预测可靠程度、置信来源（群体先验还是个体数据）以及歧义究竟来自用户内在偏好变化还是数据不足，并借鉴轨迹预测、个性化活动识别、信息采集与基于模型的控制等邻近领域，设想不确定性感知的主动助手。

**相关性简评：** 其把不确定性拆成「证据来源」与「歧义成因」的思路，可能与 LVR 中 STOP 决策、证据充分性判断和视觉证据筛选存在概念联系，可供核查，但论文面向普适计算而非多模态推理，属远领域启发。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Vision: "What Don't I Know About User's Preferences?" How Uncertainty Estimation Improves Proactive Assistant Alignment

**abstract/A1：** Proactive Smart Assistants (PSAs) increasingly use general knowledge, learned patterns from group-level data, patterns from individual user's data, and recent sensor observations to anticipate which action a user may prefer. Existing systems typically select actions from predicted user preference likelihoods, but these likelihoods alone do not reveal how reliable the prediction is, which evidence supports it, or why ambiguity remains. In this vision paper, we argue that uncertainty estimation can provide this missing information and substantially change appropriate downstream behavior. Using the example of a home assistant, we introduce the questions that uncertainty estimation aims to answer, i.e. how sure is the assistant about the predicted preference likelihood, whether the confidence come from group-level assumptions or individual's data, and whether likelihood ambiguity reflect the user's intrinsic preference variability or insufficient data for the particular situation. We further introduce uncertainty estimation applications in neighboring domains, such as human trajectory prediction, personalized activity recognition, information-collection, and model-based control. Finally, we draw on insights from neighboring domains to envision how future uncertainty-aware proactive assistants may address key challenges in proactive interaction.

**comment/C1：** Published in Companion of the 2026 ACM International Joint Conference on Pervasive and Ubiquitous Computing (UbiComp Companion '26) PEACE Workshop

</details>

### 656. [Instance-Adaptive Online Multiclass Multicalibration](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15954v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15954

**作者：** Zhiming Huang、Jamie Morgenstern、Aaron Roth、Claire Jie Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15954v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15954v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究在线多类 multicalibration：当对抗选择的结果均值落在未知 s 维仿射子空间时，算法在不知道子空间及其维度的情况下取得优于最坏情况的校准误差率，并给出 minimax 最优性与随机情形下的平方根率。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 无直接关联，但其「自适应未知内在结构、超越最坏情况」的实例自适应界，可能为推理期动态计算/长度分配与成本评价提供类比模板，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Instance-Adaptive Online Multiclass Multicalibration

**abstract/A1：** We study online multiclass multicalibration over $T$ rounds, and give an algorithm with beyond-worst-case guarantees. With $n$ possible outcomes, forecasts lie in a simplex of dimension $d=n-1$. In the worst case, cumulative $\\ell\_1$ multicalibration error scales with $\\widetildeΘ(T^{(d+1)/(d+2)})$, which becomes untenable once $d$ exceeds a small constant. Our algorithm adapts to the geometry of the realized sequence: if the sequence of adversarially selected outcome means lies in an affine subspace of dimension $s$, it obtains error $\\widetilde O(n^{1/(s+2)}T^{(s+1)/(s+2)})$ with high probability. The algorithm adapts to this structure without knowing the subspace or its dimension. For $T\\ge n\\ge2$, this rate is minimax optimal up to polylogarithmic factors. For a stochastic instance with a fixed conditional mean, the bound specializes to $\\widetilde O(\\sqrt{nT})$, giving a square-root dependence on the horizon.

**comment/C1：** 52 pages

</details>

### 657. [Softmax-Free Attention in Spiking Transformers as the Zero-Temperature Limit of Two-Level Systems](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15968v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15968

**作者：** Roberto C. Sotero、Pouya Taghipour、Jose M. Sanchez-Bornot

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15968v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15968v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文证明脉冲 Transformer 中无 softmax 的阈值化二值注意力恰为独立二能级系统之积的零温极限，用热力学相图统一刻画标准与神经形态注意力，并据此解释替代梯度消失导致的优化困难。

**相关性简评：** 用熵成本与物理下界刻画注意力组织的视角，可能与 latent 推理中注意力熵坍缩、信息坍缩以及每步计算成本的核算形成类比线索，但本文不涉及多模态推理状态，能否借鉴需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Softmax-Free Attention in Spiking Transformers as the Zero-Temperature Limit of Two-Level Systems

**abstract/A1：** Spiking Transformers achieve energy efficiency by discarding softmax normalization in favor of thresholded, binary attention. However, this removal breaks the thermodynamic framework used to analyze attention networks, as the normalized measure and partition function cease to exist. We restore this theoretical foundation by proving that softmax-free spiking attention operates exactly as the zero-temperature limit of a product of independent two-level systems. This correspondence places spiking attention strictly in the frozen ordered phase of the thermodynamic phase diagram for all inputs. Consequently, the entropic cost of organizing attention collapses, replaced by a Landauer-type physical floor governed by action-potential generation. Furthermore, this ordered-phase pinning mathematically explains the optimization difficulty caused by vanishing surrogate gradients. We validate this theory with forward-relaxation experiments, placing both standard and neuromorphic attention mechanisms on a unified thermodynamic axis.

</details>

### 658. [PopGen: Generating Semantically Diverse Populations for Zero-Shot Coordination](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15969v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15969

**作者：** Paul Teiletche、Kanghyun Ryu、Kyungjoon Park、Dhruva Tirumala、Markus Wulfmeier、Negar Mehr

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.MA

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15969v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15969v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 PopGen，用 LLM 从零生成多样化的智能体行为文本描述并转译为可执行策略代码，以此构建多智能体强化学习的训练种群，使合作者能对未见伙伴实现更稳健的零样本协作，并在四个协作环境中超过 population-play 基线。

**相关性简评：** 其「以语义描述而非轨迹级代理来度量行为多样性」的思路，可能为 LVR 中区分 latent 相似度的实质内容与表层差异、以及训练分布多样性如何影响长度与任务泛化提供可核查的启发；但论文属多智能体协作领域，无视觉或 latent 推理状态，联系较间接。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PopGen: Generating Semantically Diverse Populations for Zero-Shot Coordination

**abstract/A1：** In multi-agent reinforcement learning, exposing a cooperator to partners with diverse strategies during training is key to better collaboration at test time. However, existing methods typically rely on trajectory-level proxies to measure diversity, which may label two distinct trajectories of the same strategy as diverse. Instead, our key insight is to leverage LLMs' ability to describe behaviorally distinct agents in environments, similar to how humans can recognize high-level strategies. To this end, we introduce PopGen, a framework that synthesizes semantically diverse agents from scratch using LLMs. PopGen first generates a diverse set of textual descriptions of agent behaviors, then translates each behavior into a code policy that can be executed within the environment. We show that cooperators trained against PopGen populations achieve robust zero-shot cooperation with unseen partners, outperforming population-play baselines across four collaborative environments. We further show that semantic diversity scales with PopGen population size, improving the cooperator's worst-case performance, and we identify design choices that preserve population quality while maximizing diversity. Our code is available at https://github.com/labicon/PopGen.

**comment/C1：** Submitted to ICLR 2027

</details>

### 659. [Handoff Curves: Initial Selection, Later Handoff, and Supervision Targets in Multi-turn LLM Routing](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15993v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.15993

**作者：** Daniel Matos、Lu Liu、Yanfeng Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15993v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.15993v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究多轮 LLM 任务中的路由决策，用「handoff 曲线」比较初始选型与中途切换模型对成功率与成本的影响，并考察不同监督目标（如单调拟合的成功曲线、描述剩余工作所需能力的标签）对训练路由器的效果。

**相关性简评：** 其「何时切换/停止」的效用-成本权衡与噪声监督目标设计，可能与 LVR 中 STOP 决策的收益评估及轨迹监督信号构造形成类比，可供核查，但对象是模型间路由而非 latent 推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Handoff Curves: Initial Selection, Later Handoff, and Supervision Targets in Multi-turn LLM Routing

**abstract/A1：** We study how initial model selection, later handoff, and training targets affect success and cost in LLM tasks that span multiple turns. We compare several router architectures using handoff curves, which record task success and cost as the handoff step changes. Our dataset contains 34,204 complete executions of three Qwen models across BFCL, MultiWOZ, and $τ$-retail, providing offline supervision for routing decisions. In our primary comparison, with Qwen3.5 35B-A3B as the starting model, allowing a later handoff does not establish an improvement in utility over initial selection on BFCL or MultiWOZ, and increases cost on BFCL across a range of cost weights. Changing the supervision targets improves router performance on both our dataset and TwinRouterBench. On our dataset, replacing noisy training success curves with monotone fits raises success by 0.2 to 4.1 percentage points at the same cost across the reported operating points. On TwinRouterBench, we construct targets that describe the model capability needed for the remaining work and difficult steps ahead. Compared with training on the benchmark's per-step labels, these targets raise trajectory pass scores by 7.8 percentage points and cost savings by 6.3 percentage points on the full static bank. A live deployment of the router trained with these targets resolves 79 of 100 instances at a router cost of 0.59 US dollars per instance.

</details>

### 660. [Computational Reflective Equilibrium for Agentic AI: A Rawlsian Alignment Scaffold for Governance](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16015v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16015

**作者：** Quanyan Zhu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16015v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16015v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 agentic reflective equilibrium（ARE）框架：在 agent harness 中用类型化的支持与攻击关系连接系统提示与运营政策原则、审慎判断、工具证据和候选动作，代理在均衡状态下行动，仅在调用工具或提问的收益高于其成本时执行（除非有尽职义务），并给出均衡的博弈性质与两个治理案例。

**相关性简评：** 其「仅在收益值得成本时才调用工具/提问」的计算价值门控与何时停止获取证据的规则，可能为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的收益—成本权衡、证据筛选与停止决策提供远领域的概念线索，需人工核查其形式化条件能否迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Computational Reflective Equilibrium for Agentic AI: A Rawlsian Alignment Scaffold for Governance

**abstract/A1：** The rapid deployment of agentic AI has introduced complex challenges for the ethics and governance of AI systems. Agents built on large language models act through tools on behalf of people, and each deployment case brings its own instructions, policies, evidence, and stakeholders, so alignment must be formed case by case. To this end, this work proposes agentic reflective equilibrium (ARE), a computational reflective equilibrium framework that serves as an ethical alignment scaffold in the agent harness. Drawing inspiration from the reflective equilibrium of John Rawls, the scaffold links principles from the system prompt and operator policy, considered judgments, tool evidence, and candidate actions through typed support and attack relations, with provenance encoding the instruction hierarchy. The agent acts on an equilibrium of this state and calls tools or asks questions only while doing so is worth its cost, unless a due-diligence mandate requires them. Governance enters through value priorities, source authority, prohibitions, human-in-the-loop triggers, and mandates, and certificates attribute each action to the sources whose commitments drove it. We show that equilibria are Nash equilibria of a mutual-adjustment game and establish monotonicity, lexical priority, stability certificates, and a quarantine theorem for prompt injection. Two case studies illustrate the framework: a computer-use assistant told to win a refund "whatever it takes" files an honest warranty claim, refuses a fake review, and ignores an injected request for personal data; a hiring agent showcases how authority, oversight triggers, audit mandates, and hard prohibitions shape discrimination, privacy violations, and escalation. The framework offers traceability, coherence, and adaptivity, facilitating safe, secure, and trustworthy agentic AI.

**comment/C1：** 51 pages, 7 figures

</details>

### 661. [Removing the Compute Bottleneck for Event-based Visual Place Recognition with Spiking Neural Networks](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16022v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16022

**作者：** Somayeh Hussaini、Tobias Fischer、Michael Milford

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16022v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16022v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对事件相机视觉地点识别（VPR），用附加 STDP 训练两层 SNN 使权重呈双峰分布后做激进幅度剪枝，推理时仅读取查询活跃像素对应的存活权重、把神经元打分退化为整数计数，从而在通用 CPU 上以数十微秒完成检索；在三个基准上召回超过 LENS，延迟降低 5.5–6.2 倍，并刻画了召回与延迟随活跃像素数和参考地点数的伸缩关系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Removing the Compute Bottleneck for Event-based Visual Place Recognition with Spiking Neural Networks

**abstract/A1：** Neuromorphic sensing and computing promise low latency and high energy efficiency for robotics, yet most event-based visual place recognition (VPR) pipelines reintroduce dense, frame-like computation downstream of an inherently sparse sensor, forfeiting the sensor's latency advantage. In this paper, we address the problem of resolving an event-based VPR query in tens of microseconds on a commodity CPU. We train a two-layer spiking neural network (SNN) with additive spike-timing-dependent plasticity (STDP), which drives the learned weight matrix towards a strongly bimodal distribution, amenable to aggressive magnitude pruning. At inference, our pipeline exploits this sparsity by reading only the pruned weights corresponding to the query's active pixels. As surviving weights share a near-uniform magnitude, each neuron's score reduces to an integer count of matching synapses instead of a weighted sum, lowering per-query latency. This computation is small enough to remain resident in a CPU's fast on-chip cache. On three event-based VPR benchmarks, our sparse SNN exceeds the recall of LENS, an existing event-based SNN, while reducing per-query latency by 5.5-6.2x to tens of microseconds. It matches the recall of a dense variant of our network and of the sum-of-absolute-differences (SAD) baseline, while reading 10x fewer weights than the dense variant. We further characterise how recall and latency scale with the number of active pixels and reference places. These results suggest that the sparsity of both event-based input and learned weights can already be exploited for low-latency inference on conventional processors.

**comment/C1：** 8 pages, 6 figures, under review

</details>

<a id="paper-662"></a>

### 662. [Backward Conformal Prediction under Covariate Shift](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16048v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16048

**作者：** Amin Meghrazi、Yuanyuan Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16048v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16048v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 将 backward conformal prediction（固定预测集大小、估计未覆盖率）扩展到协变量偏移：用重要性加权维持保证，并提出在排序后的非一致性分数向量上估计密度比，证明可渐近恢复同一报告并刻画偏差。

**相关性简评：** 其「固定预算下估计可靠性」与未覆盖率控制框架，可能与 LVR 的 STOP 决策及 latent 推理评估在分布偏移下的可信度相关；「报告只取决于漏检校准样本的相对权重」这一结论可供核查加权或缓存结构对估计的影响，属推测性借鉴。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Backward Conformal Prediction under Covariate Shift

**abstract/A1：** Backward conformal prediction (BCP) fixes the size of a prediction set and estimates its miscoverage, but assumes calibration and test data are exchangeable. We extend BCP to covariate shift through importance weighting, preserving its guarantees when the density ratio is known. We show that BCP's tight miscoverage report depends only on the relative weight assigned to missed calibration examples, explaining why a better domain classifier can sometimes produce a worse estimate. Motivated by the fact that BCP depends only on nonconformity scores, we propose estimating density ratios on sorted score vectors rather than high-dimensional inputs. We prove that this approach recovers the same report asymptotically under an interpretable condition and characterize the resulting bias otherwise. Experiments with simulated and benchmark distribution shifts show that the proposed method improves BCP's miscoverage estimates, while score-based weighting consistently yields more accurate estimates than embedding-based weighting.

**comment/C1：** 26 pages, 2 figures, 19 tables

</details>

### 663. [Interpretable Graph Partitioning for Spatial Prediction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16063v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16063

**作者：** Yuta Shikuri

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16063v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16063v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把空间预测的可解释性表述为图划分问题：用连通子图构建逼近黑箱预测的全局代理模型，以簇内残差最小化为目标，并引入排除人工连接的约束，给出该约束对划分影响的理论分析和边界调整算法，实验得到空间连贯且边界灵活的划分。

**相关性简评：** 属空间统计中的代理建模与区域化，与 VLM 推理无直接关联；但其按残差最小化把预测空间切成连贯可解释单元的图划分思路，可能对 LVR 中把内部状态或视觉证据切分为可解释、可检验单元（状态抽象、证据筛选）的表述有所启发，可供核查，迁移性尚不确定。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Interpretable Graph Partitioning for Spatial Prediction

**abstract/A1：** Spatial prediction estimates unobserved values from spatially distributed observations. Although flexible predictive models are increasingly available, their practical use remains limited when interpretability is essential. In this study, we formulate a graph partitioning problem to construct a global surrogate model that approximates black-box predictions with simpler representations. Specifically, we select connected subgraphs to minimize within-cluster residuals in vertex-level predictions. Although this formulation can be viewed as a variant of spatial regionalization, it operates on model-based predictions at individual locations rather than predefined areal units. With many locations, this point-level formulation may produce artificial connections between regions, reducing interpretability. We therefore introduce a constraint that excludes such connections while retaining flexible partition boundaries. We theoretically analyze how this constraint affects the resulting partition. We also develop a computational procedure for adjusting partition boundaries. Experimental results show that the proposed method yields spatially coherent partitions with flexible boundaries.

</details>

### 664. [Understanding and Reducing Misalignment in Persuasion Optimization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16070v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16070

**作者：** Boyi Wei、Ruta Desai、Peter Henderson、Wenyue Hua

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16070v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16070v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在纯文本多智能体说服场景中研究 RL 说服训练的失准后果：仅优化接收方信念变化会使模型使用的失准策略种类增逾 25%、每局捏造次数增至 4 倍以上，并比较策略引导、干净示范、失准惩罚与捏造检测等缓解手段，认为引导加惩罚的组合权衡最佳。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线的联系是间接且需核查的：该文显示只对结果施加奖励会诱导模型「捏造证据」而非真实使用证据，这一激励失配现象可能启发审视 VLM 推理训练中是否同样出现视觉旁路或伪造依据；但它不涉及 latent 状态、视觉表征或推理期状态更新。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Understanding and Reducing Misalignment in Persuasion Optimization

**abstract/A1：** Frontier models are now trained for complex multi-agent tasks, from running a company to engaging in negotiations. These tasks necessitate training models to be persuasive. But what does this optimization pressure mean for model alignment? In this work, we study how reinforcement learning (RL) training for persuasion affects models' use of misaligned strategies such as evidence fabrication and belief coercion, and what techniques can reduce such misalignment. We find that optimizing sender models solely for receiver belief shifts causes the average number of distinct misaligned strategies used per game to increase by more than 25%, and fabrications per game increase to more than 4 times relative to pre-RL models. We compare various mitigation approaches, including stronger strategy guidance, clean demonstrations, penalizing misaligned strategy usage, and improving the model's ability to detect fabrications. We find that navigating the persuasiveness-misalignment trade-off in this setting is challenging, with the best trade-offs coming from combining guidance on aligned persuasion strategies with reward penalties on misalignment. Overall, our work provides a testbed for assessing misalignment stemming from RL-based persuasion training and shows concrete paths for reducing misalignment. Importantly, it highlights that without direct intervention, persuasion-involved RL environments are likely to naturally lead to large increases in the use of misaligned strategies.

**comment/C1：** 33 pages, 13 figures

</details>

### 665. [GUIDE: Computationally Augmented Consensus for Trustworthy Clinical Practice Guidelines](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16108v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16108

**作者：** Yuanfan Lin、Jie Di、Xujin He、Zhenzhe Lin、Jialing Chen、Ruiyang Li、Changyu Zheng、Yuanrui Shang、Weiqin Peng、Jingxi Qin、Xiong Wang、Dongxin Ye、Yining Huang、Guoqiang Li、Andi Xu、Sijia Yu、Ruixin Wang、Yahan Yang、Xiaohang Wu、Duoru Lin、Jingjing Chen、Zhenzhen Liu、Wenben Chen、Haotian Lin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.HC、cs.MA

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16108v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16108v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** GUIDE 是一个面向临床实践指南生成与更新的多智能体协作系统，把文献筛选、证据确定性分级、推荐形成等繁重步骤交给专用 AI agent，同时保留专家判断与最终仲裁，并在 NICE 眼科等 12 个数据集及多个学科数据上评估召回率、评分一致性与推荐一致性，还做了专家干预消融和前瞻验证。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接关联；但其多智能体证据聚合与专家仲裁机制、以及「判断密集步骤中去掉人类干预会掉分」的消融，可能为 latent 推理中的多假设筛选、证据可信度加权与停止/仲裁决策提供概念参照，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GUIDE: Computationally Augmented Consensus for Trustworthy Clinical Practice Guidelines

**abstract/A1：** Maintaining up-to-date clinical practice guidelines (CPGs) is essential for evidence-based medicine, but rapid evidence growth and complex expert consensus formation limit timely updates. We developed GUIDE, a multi-agent copilot system for human-AI collaborative guideline generation and updating. GUIDE delegates labor-intensive tasks to specialized AI agents while preserving expert judgment and final arbitration. In 12 NICE ophthalmology datasets, GUIDE achieved 88.85% literature recall, 86.06% alignment in certainty-of-evidence ratings, and 91.67% recommendation agreement, requiring 162.17 minutes per dataset on average (28.68% human intervention). Performance remained stable across 20 additional datasets from cardiology, endocrinology, gastroenterology, and respiratory medicine. Ablation analysis showed that removing expert intervention reduced performance in judgment-intensive steps such as Risk-of-Bias assessment. In six post-cutoff datasets, GUIDE maintained robust end-to-end performance on unseen evidence. Prospective real-world validation showed that GUIDE reduced expert workload and produced more clinically acceptable recommendations than the original decade-old guideline (mean score, 3.73 vs. 1.53; agreement, 66.7% vs. 13.3%), with outcomes comparable to human-only updating (P = 0.588) but substantially less time and effort. GUIDE offers a practical framework for timely, trustworthy, expert-centric guideline development and validates computationally augmented consensus.

**comment/C1：** 108 pages total, 28 pages main text, 5 figures, 4 supplementary figures, 8 supplementary tables. Research article

</details>

### 666. [Beyond Perfect Teammates: Multi-Agent Collaboration with Unreliable Colleagues](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16117v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16117

**作者：** Chen Huang、Yiyang Zhang、Yuhao Wu、Yang Deng、Wenxuan Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.MA

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16117v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16117v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出多智能体协作基准 UnCoBench，以 Misaligned、Incomplete、Missed 三类失败刻画不可靠协作者，并给出可验证、可扩展的自动生成流程，评测十个模型在证据收集失败下的恢复能力。

**相关性简评：** 虽属纯文本多智能体协作这一较远领域，但其对证据缺口诊断、纠正性追问缺失及冗余查询与低效等待的分析，可能与 VLM 推理中的证据获取与停止决策（LOOK/STOP）存在概念联系，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Perfect Teammates: Multi-Agent Collaboration with Unreliable Colleagues

**abstract/A1：** LLM-based multi-agent collaboration is increasingly used to solve complex tasks by dividing work among specialized agents and integrating complementary expertise. Yet existing systems and evaluations largely rest on an implicit perfect-colleague assumption: collaborators provide correct and complete information and respond promptly to requests. In realistic teamwork, however, collaborators may return information that does not answer the intended question, provide insufficient detail to support a decision, or fail to respond to a request. To separate task-solving competence from the ability to recover an unreliable evidence-gathering process, we introduce the Unreliable Colleagues Benchmark (UnCoBench), which organizes behavioral failures through Misaligned, Incomplete, and Missed settings. The main agent need to verify contextual correctness, diagnose information gap and track unresolved dependencies in order to obtain the correct evidence for solving the task. We also introduce a verifiable and scalable automated generation pipeline that pairs LLM-based scenario generation with executable checks of answer uniqueness and role necessity. Results across ten models show that similar reliable-setting performance can result in different robustness to unreliable evidence. Trace analysis reveals frequent omissions of corrective follow-up, and the recovery behavior involves inefficient waiting and redundant queries. These findings show that robust collaboration requires not only sound reasoning, but also targeted action to diagnose evidence failures, recover relevant information, and integrate it into decisions. Our data and source code are available at https://github.com/iNLP-Lab/UnCoBench.

**comment/C1：** 24 pages, 8 figures, 8 tables

</details>

**title/T1：** XForecast: The KDD 2026 Finance Day Challenge on News-Grounded Financial Forecasting

**abstract/A1：** Financial forecasting has traditionally relied on numerical time-series (TS) signals, while textual information such as news remains largely underutilized. We introduce XForecast, a benchmark and competition for news-grounded financial forecasting, where the task is to predict stock price movements four weeks ahead using both historical price data and paired news signals. XForecast combines stock price data with curated financial text generated using FinTexTS, a multimodal dataset generation method. It covers 100 large-cap stocks from 2019--2023, with training on 2019--2022 and evaluation on 2023. To better evaluate models that leverage textual signals, we adopt a weighted hit rate metric that places greater emphasis on instances where news information is expected to have stronger influence. The XForecast Challenge, hosted on Kaggle as part of KDD 2026 Finance Day, aims to benchmark methods for integrating financial TS and textual information.

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16134

**作者：** Yijin Wei、Yawen Zou、Wenqi Cai、Guang Li、Hangli Ge、Katsuya Hotta、Chunzhi Gu、Chao Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16134v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16134v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 ProMoDD，用类别级原型条件化的运动扩散模型生成候选骨架序列，再按特征空间中的稠密/稀疏区域在固定预算下混合选择真实与生成序列，以蒸馏骨架动作识别数据集。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线距离较远，但「原型条件生成 + 特征空间内按预算筛选候选」的思路可能可供核查如何构造并筛选紧凑的 latent 证据或假设。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ProMoDD: Dataset Distillation for 3D Human Motion via Prototype-Conditioned Diffusion Models

**abstract/A1：** Dataset distillation (DD) aims to retain the training utility of a large dataset in a much smaller set of examples. For skeleton-based action recognition, this requires capturing discriminative motion variation without disrupting the geometry and temporal continuity of articulated bodies. Directly optimizing joint coordinates can violate these constraints, while plausible motion generation alone does not ensure useful training examples. We propose Prototype-Conditioned Motion Dataset Distillation (ProMoDD), which conditions a motion diffusion model on class-wise prototypes of temporally resolved recognition features. We further tailor diffusion training to motion data, enabling the generator to model both skeletal configurations and their temporal evolution. We then construct each compact training set through budget-aware hybrid selection: representative real sequences cover densely populated regions of the pooled recognition space, while selected generated candidates complement them in less-populated regions. This couples prototype-guided generation with feature-space selection, balancing the reliability of observed motions with the variation of synthesis under a fixed per-class sequence budget. Across five difficulty-stratified subsets of the single-person classes in NTU RGB+D 60, ProMoDD achieves its largest gains under tight distillation budgets, reaching 40.32% top-1 accuracy on Full49 with three sequences per class, 4.57 percentage points above class-wise k-means. These gains reflect the complete framework. The same distilled sets train ST-GCN, MS-G3D, and CTR-GCN without regeneration.

</details>

### 669. [All-St3R SLAM: Real-time RGB Dynamic SLAM with Pixel-wise Motion Masking](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16143v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16143

**作者：** Yewon Kim、Paul Hongsuck Seo、Sang Chul Ahn

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16143v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16143v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 All-St3R SLAM：用 DUSt3R 的 ego-motion 预测与 All-Tracker 点跟踪的差异，在像素级只剔除真正运动的区域，仅凭 RGB 在约 10 FPS 下实现动态环境实时 SLAM。

**相关性简评：** 其「双路运动来源差异」可作为视觉证据可靠性与动态筛选的类比线索：可能启发 LVR 中按当前有效性而非固定标签选择视觉 token 或证据，供核查，但不涉及 latent 推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** All-St3R SLAM: Real-time RGB Dynamic SLAM with Pixel-wise Motion Masking

**abstract/A1：** SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping) is a core technology in autonomous systems that enables them to estimate their own position and build a map of unknown environments simultaneously. SLAM systems in dynamic environments are of great practical importance. However, existing dynamic SLAM approaches still have several limitations like over-removal and high computational costs. To address these limitations, we propose a real-time RGB Dynamic SLAM framework that precisely removes moving objects at the pixel level without relying on predefined labels or segmentation models. Our system combines pixel motion predicted by ego-motion using DUSt3R with point tracking from All-Tracker, removing only actually moving pixels by analyzing discrepancies between the two motion sources. Unlike object-level masking methods, our approach eliminates only currently moving regions, allowing temporarily static parts to be utilized for tracking. Operating at approximately 10 FPS, the system achieves real-time performance on standard 30 FPS video streams by subsampling every 3 frames. Relying solely on RGB inputs, this significantly improves upon state-of-the-art dense dynamic SLAM approaches (0.5-3 FPS), presenting a highly practical solution.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to the IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) 2026. Project Page: https://yellowon0103.github.io/all-st3r-slam/

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16146

**作者：** Hui Shan、Keyang Luo、Binjia Zhou、Ming Li、Kai Li、Xin Wang、Zhenyang Li、Zesong Yang、Weikai Chen、Runze Zhang、Xin Wang、Yanwei Fu、Zhen Chen、Xiangru Huang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16146v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16146v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出免训练框架 Unravel，从单张图像重建可交互 3D 场景：由 VLM 规划完全可见的物体、图像编辑器逐层剥离并修补被遮挡区域，每步编辑经核验后才并入重建，随后逆序重建并做物理沉降与审查。

**相关性简评：** 其「逐步剥离遮挡—核验通过再纳入—按逆序重装」的迭代证据获取与验证循环，可能与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、LOOK 步骤的收益成本及提交/停止决策存在可核查的概念联系，但研究目标是 3D 资产重建而非推理状态，迁移属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Unravel: Recovering an Interactive 3D Scene from a Single Image

**abstract/A1：** We present Unravel, a training-free framework that turns a single image into an interactive 3D scene, where every object is an independent and movable asset. Existing generators either produce one entangled geometry in which no object can be moved, or predict all objects in one feed-forward pass, where a wrong guess cannot be detected or repaired. Unravel instead takes a different approach: it first takes the scene apart, and then puts it back together. Starting from the input image, an agentic harness that iteratively peels the image layer by layer, and adopts point cloud as major modality for spatial relationship recovery. Specifically, a vision-language model plans which objects are fully visible, an image editor removes them and restores the occluded regions. Every edit is verified before being incorporated into the reconstruction. This process gradually turns occluded parts of the scene into direct observation, allowing objects to be reconstructed when they are best exposed rather than hallucinated from the original image alone. The scene is then rebuilt in reverse removal order, so that the supporting objects are naturally placed before the objects they support. Since a single-view image only reveals part of an object, we treat the observed points as a lower bound on its size: an asset may grow to cover its points, but can not shrink away from them. Finally, we physically settle the reconstructed scene to remove floating objects and interpenetrations, followed by an agentic audit that corrects remaining placement errors. Extensive experiments on diverse indoor scenes show that Unravel recovers more objects, places them more faithfully, and produces scenes that are more physically-plausible than existing methods.

</details>

### 671. [Fisher information and the geometry of memorization in neural networks](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16161v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16161

**作者：** Daniel T. Bernstein、Chase Goddard、Luca Di Carlo、Vudtiwat Ngampruetikorn、David J. Schwab

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cond-mat.dis-nn、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16161v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16161v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在 CIFAR-10 加可控噪声的视觉模型上考察 Fisher 信息作为区分泛化与记忆的诊断工具，发现把权重投影到 top Fisher 特征向量可使通用任务性能与噪声样本记忆解耦，并比较该解耦在不同层间的差异，另在小型 transformer 的合成 in-context 学习任务与可解析线性模型中复现同类现象。

**相关性简评：** 其「用损失/表示几何区分可泛化结构与样本特异噪声」的分析视角，可能可供核查用于判断 latent 状态中保留的是任务必要视觉信息还是记忆成分，并与关注 latent 相似度中内容、深度、缓存结构差异的问题表述相关。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Fisher information and the geometry of memorization in neural networks

**abstract/A1：** A fruitful approach towards understanding generalization in machine learning involves characterizing how models separate generalizable structure from idiosyncratic or even corrupted features of training data. Fisher information has emerged as a diagnostic tool for this separation, leveraging loss geometry to distinguish generalization from memorization. Here we investigate this connection in vision models trained on CIFAR-10 with controlled noise that can be learned only through memorization. We show that projecting model weights onto the top Fisher eigenvectors decouples general task performance from noisy sample memorization, and we investigate how this decoupling presents differentially across layers. We show that the same phenomena are present in small transformers trained to solve a synthetic in-context learning task, and are reproduced in closed form in a simple, analytically solvable linear model. Our results reveal that Fisher information captures aspects of the geometric structure underlying how neural networks allocate capacity between generalization and memorization.

**comment/C1：** 20 pages (10 pages main text), 11 figures (6 figures main text), NeurIPS 2026

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 发布 EWM 电子竞技世界模型数据集，覆盖 StarCraft II、Dota 2 与 CS2 共 3053 局、约 4880 玩家视角小时，用回放时钟把渲染视频、原生动作、结构化状态与事件对齐，并以玩家级实体记录区分实时观测与记忆快照。

**相关性简评：** 其「实时观测 vs 记忆快照」的记录与跨对立视角的实体关联，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、信念状态以及被遮蔽信息可用性的诊断提供数据与评测线索，是否迁移到 VLM 推理尚需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Esports World Model Dataset

**abstract/A1：** Interactive world models must capture how multiple participants jointly change a shared environment while observing different parts of it. Competitive games make this challenge concrete: players cooperate and compete, while fog of war, team vision and camera placement determine what each can see. Modeling these interactions requires data that connect individual observations and actions to shared state and events. We introduce the Esports World Model Dataset (EWM), a collection of human gameplay spanning StarCraft II, Dota 2 and Counter-Strike 2, with 3,053 games and maps and approximately 4,880 player-view hours, including estimated hours for the ongoing CS2 extension. It includes 4,628 completed StarCraft II views, all ten perspectives for 303 Dota 2 matches, and up to ten views per round in CS2. Across these views, replay-clock alignment connects rendered video with game-native actions, structured state and events from the same match. The three games expose complementary observation conditions: private fog of war, shared team vision and first-person viewpoints. In StarCraft II, player-specific entity records further distinguish live observations from remembered snapshots and link co-observed entities across opposing views. Together with temporal alignment, these records allow researchers to distinguish legitimate information differences from disagreement about shared state. By connecting human decisions, shared dynamics and player-specific information, EWM supports research toward jointly controlled multiplayer world models and interactive environments populated by teammates and opponents learned from human play.

</details>

### 673. [Interactive 4D Volumetric Liquid Forecasting under Moving-Solid Interaction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16167v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16167

**作者：** Jongwon Ryu、Sunjae Yoon、Junyeong Kim

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CE、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16167v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16167v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出「交互式 4D 体积液体预测」任务：在固体物体运动条件下预测未来三维液体速度场的时空演化，并给出两级循环框架 TIDE/TIDES，通过局部界面预测、输运耦合与显式稳定化抑制长时域 rollout 误差，配以基准、消融与 OOD 评估。

**相关性简评：** 其两级循环状态更新、局部界面驱动与抑制误差累积的稳定化设计，以及长时域与运动/尺度 OOD 评估，可能为 LVR 的循环 latent 状态更新与长度泛化评价提供类比线索，需核查可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Interactive 4D Volumetric Liquid Forecasting under Moving-Solid Interaction

**abstract/A1：** We propose the task of Interactive 4D Volumetric Liquid Forecasting: predicting the spatiotemporal evolution of a future dense 3D liquid velocity field conditioned on how a solid object moves through it. This task provides an upstream physical forecasting primitive for systems that need to reason about motion-conditioned liquid response, including robotic liquid manipulation, digital twins, and rigid-fluid video generation. Existing works have made efforts in predicting flow around static or prescribed solid geometries and synthesizing visually plausible fluid motion. Yet these approaches provide limited coverage for interactive liquid dynamics, as they are not capable of forecasting how a moving solid induces a future full-domain liquid response. In this forecasting scenario, the hydrodynamic effect is condensed near an evolving liquid-solid interface, but the prediction target is a global spatiotemporal rollout. To address this challenge, we propose a two-level recurrent forecasting framework, TIDE/TIDES: TIDE isolates localized interface-driven forecasting, while TIDES adds transport-aware coupling and explicit stabilization to reduce accumulated rollout error. Across adapted neighboring baselines, controlled component ablations, motion/size OOD tests, and long-horizon evaluation, TIDES achieves the best forecasting performance and the ablations identify localized interaction, transport coupling, and stabilization as the key contributors. Together, our task formulation, benchmark, and TIDE/TIDES study establish a controlled foundation for moving-solid-conditioned dense liquid forecasting. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/jongwonryu/TIDE-TIDES.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16175

**作者：** Zhaoyu Fan、Bowen Han、Jincheng Ou、Yanwei Ren、Zehua He、Kaiyu Huang、Pengcheng He、Shanshan Ni、Chengchen Gong、Shuai Xue、Qingjiang Shi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16175v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16175v1>)
