**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 ProCARE，把 EHR/理赔等真实世界研究（RWS）的自动化重构为「受约束编译」：先将数据 profile 转成规定可用变量、时间属性与证据边界的 Evidence Contract，再把研究目标编译为强类型中间表示 RWS-IR，并用确定性校验与局部修复检查生成的流程；在 36 个 EHR 任务上优于 LLM agent 基线。

**相关性简评：** 其「Evidence Contract + 强类型中间表示 + 确定性验证」显式约束了可用证据与证据边界，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、证据充分性判断与停止决策的表述方式提供概念线索，尚需阅读原文核查可否迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ProCARE: Real-World Study Automation via Profile-Grounded Evidence Contracts

**abstract/A1：** Real-world studies (RWS) analyze routinely collected healthcare data, such as electronic health records and insurance claims, to estimate treatment effects, monitor safety, and identify risk factors outside randomized trials. Automating RWS with large language model agents is appealing but brittle: valid analyses depend on dataset-specific clinical semantics, including index dates, follow-up windows, patient/event-level units, and outcome boundaries that are often implicit in observational data. This leads to schema mismatches, temporal errors, inconsistent analytical granularity, and unsupported clinical claims. We present ProCARE, a profile-grounded framework that reformulates RWS automation as constrained compilation. ProCARE converts heterogeneous data profiles into Evidence Contracts specifying available variables, temporal attributes, distributions, and evidentiary limits, and compiles study objectives into RWS-IR, a strongly typed intermediate representation for variables, time relations, analysis units, and statistical tasks. Deterministic validation and localized repair then check and revise generated workflows across schema mapping, cohort construction, variable derivation, analysis, and interpretation. On 36 EHR-based benchmark tasks, ProCARE outperforms strong LLM-agent baselines in code executability, semantic consistency, and conclusion traceability, with automated violation diagnoses showing moderate-to-substantial agreement with blinded expert review.

**comment/C1：** 42 pages, 5 figures, including appendix. Accepted by NeurIPS'26. Code and benchmark: https://github.com/ZyFanTJ/ProCARE

### 675. [DIGS: Distribution-Informed Gaussian Splatting for Training-Free Open-Vocabulary 3D Segmentation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16177v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16177

**作者：** Zhifan Zeng、Wenbo Xiao、Arcot Sowmya、Changming Sun

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16177v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16177v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出免训练的开放词汇 3D 高斯分割框架 DIGS，为每个高斯基元维护显式 top-M 标签分布并用 tempered Dirichlet 规则更新，经双向状态机聚合为类无关实例本体，再融合 CLIP 视觉与 LLM 属性文本编码支持原生 3D 查询。

**相关性简评：** 其「保留多峰标签分布、延迟 argmax 渲染」的表示为每个基元保留多个候选而非硬判定，可能与 LVR 中维持多种 latent 假设、待证据充分后再落定答案的问题构成类比；双向状态机的分布聚合与更新方式可供核查作为循环状态维护的线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DIGS: Distribution-Informed Gaussian Splatting for Training-Free Open-Vocabulary 3D Segmentation

**abstract/A1：** Open-vocabulary 3D Gaussian segmentation typically binds semantic features to the per-Gaussian state via per-scene gradient training (1-4 h) or the more recent closed-form distillation. Both commit each primitive to a single feature; therefore, boundary Gaussians spanning multiple 2D instances are forced into a hard decision that degrades retrieval accuracy and yields unstable mask boundaries at render time. We present DIGS, a training-free framework with two stages, class-agnostic mapping and multi-modal encoding, that decouples instance discovery from linguistic naming. At the Gaussian level, our distribution-informed representation maintains an explicit top-$M$ label distribution per primitive, updated by a tempered Dirichlet rule; preservation of multi-peaked label distributions at boundary primitives allows a late-argmax renderer to recover clean instance boundaries. A bidirectional state machine aggregates these distributions into a persistent class-agnostic instance ontology. The instance-level encoding stage then fuses the CLIP visual embedding of each instance's isolated 3D footprint with the CLIP-text embedding of an LLM-generated attribute description, disambiguating visually similar instances. On a single A100, DIGS completes mapping and instance encoding on LERF-OVS in 1.0-3.2 min per scene, depending on whether LLM fusion is enabled, and serves native 3D queries in 5.4 ms. It reaches 71.95% mean mIoU on LERF-OVS, outperforming both the training-free SFS and training-based LaGa baselines. DIGS also achieves the highest mean mIoU on LERF-Mask and 3D-OVS and surpasses Gaga and ObjectGS on Replica under their respective evaluation protocols. Code is available at https://github.com/ZephyrZos/DIGS.

</details>

**内容简述：** 论文用 WearGait-PD 133 名参与者的 159 项步态压力通道特征做帕金森分类，发现仅凭采集站点即可达到 AUC 0.955，高于步态特征模型，且在加入步态特征后判别力无提升；同站点与跨站点评估 AUC 明显下降，说明参与者隔离的池化验证未能剥离站点混淆。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When Participant Disjoint Validation Is Not Enough to Establish Generalization in Parkinson's Gait Classification

**abstract/A1：** Participant-disjoint cross-validation prevents direct participant overlap, but it may still produce optimistic estimates when acquisition site and diagnosis are structurally dependent. We examined Parkinson's disease classification using 159 pressure-walkway summary features from 133 WearGait-PD participants, including 65 participants with Parkinson's disease and 68 controls. The cohort was non-factorial: two sites contained only one diagnostic group, whereas VA-Seattle was the only site containing both groups. In repeated participant-level nested cross-validation, site alone achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.955 plus or minus 0.003, exceeding the gait-feature model (0.882 plus or minus 0.014). Under the evaluated logistic-regression pipelines, adding gait features to site, age, and sex produced no measurable improvement in pooled discrimination. More site-controlled evaluations produced lower and imprecise estimates: VA-Seattle same-site AUC was 0.668 (95% bootstrap confidence interval 0.477 to 0.836), and the JHOC + Bayview-to-VA-Seattle transport stress test achieved 0.576 (0.375 to 0.770). Supporting within-diagnosis site-prediction and site-conditioned permutation analyses showed that the gait representation retained substantial acquisition-site structure. These findings indicate that participant-disjoint pooled validation did not isolate disease-related discrimination from site-associated variation. They encourage careful examination of site-label dependence and, where possible, support for pooled results through within-site or independent validation before broader claims are made about generalization across institutions.

**comment/C1：** 9 pages, 5 figures. Includes supplementary analyses integrated into the appendices

**abstract/A1：** In-silico optimization of nucleic acids relies on predictive oracles that imperfectly capture biological function, so sequences optimized against one model may exploit model-specific artifacts and fail to generalize to independent models. In this work, we use agentic program search to iteratively propose, execute, evaluate, and revise code for nucleic-acid designers. We describe the successful strategies used to prompt the search. AutoNovo designers achieved the best observed mean among the evaluated methods on 3/3 DNA-design tasks in terms of in-silico performance, and 6/6 transfer tasks in terms of independent models. 摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该工作将模拟连续介质动力学基础模型 Walrus 用仅 12 段野型果蝇囊胚层视频微调，评估其在未见温度与基因扰动条件下对组织速度场的自回归零样本预测表现。

**相关性简评：** 其「跨动力系统预训练表示在严重分布偏移下迁移更稳健」的零样本评估设定，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态表示的泛化评价提供类比线索；但领域与视觉语言推理相距较远，是否有实质借鉴可供核查。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** From Simulated Fluids to Living Tissue: Zero-Shot Foundation Model Transfer to Perturbed Embryos

**abstract/A1：** Morphogenesis is driven by the interplay of genetic regulation and tissue mechanics. In vivo video data is limited, particularly under genetic mutations and environmental perturbations, making generalization beyond the most representative conditions in the dataset challenging. However, at tissue scales, the dynamics of Drosophila can be described as a continuum flow, motivating the usage of representations learned across other physical systems as priors for developmental dynamics. We investigate finetuning Walrus, a Continuum Dynamics Foundation Model pretrained across a broad set of simulated continuous systems, on tissue velocity fields from only 12 wild-type Drosophila blastoderm videos. We evaluate autoregressive prediction both in-distribution and zero-shot under unseen temperature and genetic perturbations. Zero-shot refers to evaluation on perturbation conditions never seen during wild-type finetuning, without any additional training. In-distribution, a Fourier Neural Operator model trained from scratch achieves best performance on VRMSE. However, Walrus (CRPS) is the strongest model under the most severe distribution shift of unseen samples of mutated embryos and temperature conditions. Interestingly, predictions capture the shape of the mean surface tissue velocity trajectory and its separation between 17°C and 27°C, including the timing of the peak at Germ Band Extension onset, a biologically meaningful milestone of embryo development. Our results provide preliminary support that representations learned from different dynamical systems can transfer to experimental morphogenesis in developmental regimes, provided they admit a continuum description. More broadly, our results motivate further study of physics foundation models as a new complementary tool for the simulation of morphogenesis in low-data regimes.

**title/T1：** Reflected Proximal Dynamics for Accelerated High-Accuracy Log-Concave Sampling

**abstract/A1：** We study sampling from $π(x)\\propto\\mathrm{e}^{-V(x)}$ on $\\mathbb{R}^d$, where $V$ is $α$-strongly convex and $β$-smooth with condition number $κ=β/α$. For this problem, the proximal sampler preserves the target exactly and recovers overdamped Langevin dynamics in the small-step limit, but its Gaussian resampling step discards directional information. Underdamped Langevin dynamics retains such information through momentum to accelerate exploration, motivating a proximal construction that combines target preservation with directional persistence. We introduce \\textit{reflected proximal dynamics}, which combines proximal sampling with an exact reflection of the auxiliary variable, conditional kinetic motion, and controlled refreshment. We develop two realizations: a flux-resampled underdamped half-turn and a persistent-momentum quarter-turn. From a warm start with constant $χ^2$ divergence, both methods achieve total variation error $\\varepsilon$ using $\\widetilde O(\\sqrtκd^{1/4})$ expected oracle queries. We further remove the supplied warm-start assumption by combining either sampler with existing posterior samplers in a proximal initialization stage with an optimized coarse step size. Accounting for both initialization and sampling yields $\\widetilde O(κ^{6/7}d^{1/4})$ expected oracle queries. In both regimes, the dependence on the target accuracy $\\varepsilon$ is $\\mathrm{polylog}(1/\\varepsilon)$, making reflected proximal dynamics a promising framework for accelerated high-accuracy log-concave sampling.

**comment/C1：** Under Review

</details>

### 680. [Spectral Considerations on Unsupervised Time-domain EEG Representation Learning with Deep Networks](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16264v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16264

**作者：** David Aquilué-Llorens、Abel Puigseslloses、Angel Blanco、Claire Braboszcz、Aureli Soria-Frisch

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16264v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16264v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文系统研究无监督时域 EEG 表示学习中的频谱约束，比较 LSTMVAE、VAEEG、Transformer 及一个 EEG 基础模型，指出 MSE 重建损失在 1/f 谱下产生幅度驱动的掩蔽效应，使自编码器系统性地欠表示高频信息，并讨论潜在维度、紧凑性与生成稳定性之间的权衡。

**相关性简评：** 虽属远领域信号处理，但其「潜在状态系统性丢失高频细节、增大维度只能以紧凑性换取保真」的机制，可能与 LVR 中视觉细节在 latent 中的信息坍缩问题形成类比，其频谱域损失与梯度平衡思路可供核查是否可迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Spectral Considerations on Unsupervised Time-domain EEG Representation Learning with Deep Networks

**abstract/A1：** Electroencephalography (EEG) is a non-invasive, scalable source of quantitative biomarkers for the early diagnosis of brain disorders, and deep representation learning has become a powerful paradigm for extracting information-rich latent features from raw signals. However, neural networks tend to under-represent high-frequency information, a concern that is especially acute for EEG given its oscillatory nature and characteristic $1/f^χ$ power decay, which risks masking disease-relevant high-frequency signatures. In this study, we systematically investigate the spectral constraints of unsupervised time-domain feature extraction across three autoencoder architectures (LSTMVAE, VAEEG, Transformer) and a state-of-the-art EEG foundation model. Using synthetic experiments and empirical validation, we show that while autoencoders capture macro-scale shifts such as alpha slowing, they remain biased against higher frequencies due to a magnitude-driven masking effect induced by the Mean Squared Error loss under 1/f-decaying spectra. Increasing latent dimensionality mitigates this attenuation but sacrifices latent compactness and generative stability. We argue that, as the field advances toward large-scale foundation-level feature extractors, it is imperative to move beyond simple time-domain reconstruction and to integrate spectral-domain loss terms and gradient-balancing techniques, so that the subtle high-frequency transients critical for diagnosing complex brain disorders are preserved in the latent representation.

</details>

### 681. [Graph3R: Unifying View Graph Initialization with Feed-Forward Reconstruction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16272v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16272

**作者：** Jingwen Yu、Hengli Wang、Jianhao Jiao、Zhonghang Liu、Ping Tan、Hong Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16272v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16272v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** Graph3R 在 π³ 的多视图共享特征上训练一个轻量验证头预测成对共视关系，构建 view graph 把输入视图划分为不同场景组，再按组掩码共享特征、一次前向解码相机位姿与稠密几何，从而在混合场景图像集合上统一视图关联与重建。

**相关性简评：** 其「用共享特征验证视图相关性并据此分组、掩码后再解码」的机制，可能为 LVR 中针对视觉证据（token/view）的可信度筛选与 latent 状态分组提供可核查的类比线索，但领域相距较远，仅为启发式联想。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Graph3R: Unifying View Graph Initialization with Feed-Forward Reconstruction

**abstract/A1：** Feed-forward reconstruction recovers camera poses and dense geometry from image sets whose views are assumed to come from a single scene. In practice, uncurated image collections often contain views from disjoint scenes, and reconstructing these views jointly can corrupt camera poses and geometry. Existing pipelines typically resolve view associations in separate stages before final reconstruction, leaving view graph initialization and reconstruction inference only loosely coupled. We introduce Graph3R, which unifies view graph initialization with feed-forward reconstruction through a shared geometric representation. A lightweight verification head predicts pairwise covisibility from the multi-view features of $π^3$ to construct a view graph. This graph classifies the input views into scene groups. For each group, we mask the shared features before decoding camera poses and dense geometry. Reusing the multi-view features allows Graph3R to reconstruct disjoint scenes separately with a single backbone pass. Across three benchmarks, Graph3R improves average maximum recall at 100% precision by upto 8.99 percentage points over the baseline, while improving reconstruction quality on mixed-scene inputs. Regarding the multi-session mapping task, Graph3R improves cross-session localization and achieves competitive pose estimation accuracy, while delivering a runtime speedup of approximately $35.9\\times$ over the baseline when reconstructing the query group. By integrating learned view association with geometric inference, our approach takes a step toward end-to-end reconstruction from uncurated image collections.

</details>

### 682. [agent-risk: Risk Assessment for Changes to AI Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16280v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16280

**作者：** Yue Zhao、Zixiang Xu、Angela Huyue Zhang、S. Alex Yang、Xiyang Hu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16280v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16280v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 agent-risk，用于评估对已部署 AI agent 的变更（如更严的安全门、换模型）：给定现有日志，通过日志重放、声明的停止值以及按需的存档状态重跑或界限来判定变更是否获批，证明日志必须记录哪些字段才能精确重放，并在 bash 沙箱实验中检验重跑预算与对线上行为的容许漂移。

**相关性简评：** 其「证据必须提前设计」的框架与 STOP 决策、差异筛选和评价成本问题可能相通：当内部状态无法完整观测时，如何用有限重跑预算界定决策证据与容错漂移，或可供核查地迁移到 latent 推理的贡献评估与停止门限验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** agent-risk: Risk Assessment for Changes to AI Agents

**abstract/A1：** Before changing a deployed AI agent (a stricter safety gate, a new model), organizations must approve the change, starting from existing logs. Extending classical risk analysis to partial records and partial changes to running systems, agent-risk replays logged episodes, assuming nothing else changes and the agent does not anticipate the change. The log settles episodes acting as before, a declared stop value settles stopped ones, and the rest need logged support, a saved-state rerun, or a bound. We prove what logs must record for exact replay and which saved states serve a gate family. For independent episodes, we bound the reruns a decision needs and tolerable drift from live behavior. In a bash sandbox, a 7,200-episode log alone decided neither of two retry gates, which let the agent act after refusals the log never shows. Rerunning only each gate's blocked episodes from saved states reached both live decisions at half the agent calls of a live test sized post hoc for them, given the log. Without per-step harm, a stopping gate's certified harm ceiling rose up to 2.5-fold, since the log hides whether harm preceded the stop. Approval thus needs evidence designed in advance: log fields, saved states, targeted reruns.

**comment/C1：** 43 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Code, registrations, and logs: https://github.com/yzhao062/agent-risk

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16293

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.RO

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ClothAtlas，用共享的图条件 flow-matching 模型从部分点云与规范网格库中同时完成衣物识别与完整构型估计，并以观测拟合度对候选网格排序。

**相关性简评：** 自遮挡下「补全观测需要先验、识别身份又依赖构型」的鸡生蛋结构，与 LVR 中 latent 假设与视觉证据互相依赖、按证据匹配度筛选候选假设的问题可能相通，可供核查其候选排序与拟合评分的设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ClothAtlas: Joint Garment Identification and State Estimation under Self-Occlusion

**abstract/A1：** Garment manipulation requires inferring both garment identity and complete configuration from partial, self-occluded observations. This creates a chicken-and-egg problem: completing a partial observation requires a garment-specific deformation prior, while identifying the garment requires a configuration that explains the observation. We introduce ClothAtlas, which jointly identifies garments and estimates their complete configurations from partial point clouds and a library of canonical meshes. A shared graph-conditioned flow-matching model samples configurations for each candidate mesh and ranks candidates by observation fit. The model accommodates different mesh shapes, vertex counts, and connectivities, allowing new garments to be added from canonical meshes alone without retraining. On held-out DexGarmentLab garments, ClothAtlas ranks the correct mesh first among 221 candidates for all 22 test garments from a single flat observation. From a single self-occluded observation, it identifies 15/22 garments, compared with 8/22 for a deterministic graph estimator. Persistent vertex identities support grasp-target localization on real garments, reducing mean error from 15.4 to 6.4 cm overall and from 17.0 to 8.3 cm on occluded targets compared with dense descriptor matching. Project page: https://clothatlas.github.io/

**comment/C1：** 9 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Project page: https://clothatlas.github.io/

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16297

**作者：** Lingbei Meng、Rui Huang、Zhirong Shen、Jinxin Liu、Lingxiao Jing、Haorui Chen、Yaosong Du、Haowei Lin

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16297v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16297v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 SLDBench v2，把 scaling law 发现基准扩展到 127 个场景（含视觉-语言迁移），并新增主动设定：智能体自行挑选实验、按记录成本付费、随结果修订定律，用隐藏外推目标评估 8 个前沿智能体系统。

**相关性简评：** 主动实验选择、成本约束下的证据获取与随新信息修订假设，可能为 LVR 中「何时 LOOK／何时停止」及计算预算内获取视觉证据的评价设计提供线索；但任务本身是纯文本的 scaling law 发现，与视觉 latent 状态无直接联系，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SLDBench v2: Active Scaling Law Discovery

**abstract/A1：** Scaling laws predict large-model performance from small experiments, but finding a reliable law itself requires costly experiments. SLDBench tests whether language-model agents can discover scaling laws when all experimental results are given upfront. We introduce SLDBench v2 with two extensions. First, we expand the corpus from 8 to 127 scenarios spanning language-model pretraining, downstream performance, and vision-language transfer, and select 30 challenging scenarios on which a reference power-law fit reaches $R^2 \\le 0.8$; they represent at least $1.09 \\times 10^{23}$ FLOPs of source-reported training compute. Second, we introduce active scaling law discovery: an agent chooses which experiments to run, pays each one's recorded cost (e.g., training FLOPs), and revises its law as outcomes arrive, and is scored on the same hidden extrapolation targets as in the passive setting. Across 8 frontier agent systems, median $R^2$ drops from 0.72-0.75 (passive) to 0.24-0.57 (active), and prediction error rises 1.5-4.7 times, depending on the system. Agents favor cheap experiments, spending 8-44% of the full-pool cost on average; low-cost acquisition can yield strong predictions, but cheap purchases also leave experimental conditions needed for extrapolation unobserved. Experimental planning thus remains a key open challenge for agents that assist model development in the prevailing AI-for-AI study.

</details>

We propose a neural surrogate that jointly predicts bubble trajectories and interface deformation in a compact, shared representation, replacing costly mesh-resolved simulation with fast generative inference. Because two-phase flow dynamics is nonlinear and chaotic, we treat forecasting as a conditional generative problem rather than deterministic regression, predicting entire future windows in a single pass. We train and evaluate the surrogate on BubbleSH, a Front-Tracking dataset of rising deformable bubble swarms, assessing performance using trajectory, shape, and distributional metrics over kinematic, morphological, and interaction-based properties. 摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文构建 Throwing4 数据集（500 段精英投掷视频的 2D 姿态序列、帧级阶段标注与官方距离标签），将广播姿态下的投掷距离预测建模为回归任务，并比较整段序列建模与按四个技术阶段划分、融合各阶段运动表示的相位条件建模。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Throwing4: Phase-Aware Pose Modeling for Throw-Distance Prediction in Elite Athletics

**abstract/A1：** Elite athletics throwing provides a structured biomechanical action sequence together with an objective continuous outcome, namely throw distance, making it a suitable setting for performance-oriented sports analytics. In this work, we investigate whether explicit phase alignment of pose dynamics improves throw-distance prediction under realistic broadcast conditions. To support this study, we curate Throwing4, a dataset of 500 elite throwing clips spanning javelin, discus, hammer, and shot put, with corresponding two-dimensional pose sequences, frame-level phase annotations, and official distance labels. We formulate throw-distance prediction from broadcast-derived pose as a regression problem and compare full-sequence modeling against a phase-conditioned approach that partitions each attempt into four technique stages and fuses phase-specific motion representations. Experiments across multiple graph-based pose encoders show a consistent reduction in prediction error when phase structure is incorporated, indicating that phase-aligned modeling provides a more stable representation than treating the entire motion as an unstructured sequence. These findings suggest that explicit biomechanical phase information is a useful inductive prior for pose-based performance modeling in elite athletics throwing. Beyond score prediction, the dataset and protocol provide a basis for future work on fine-grained technique analysis, interpretable sports analytics, and robust modeling from broadcast video.

**comment/C1：** Accepted for publication in Sports Engineering

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16391

**作者：** Ye Rin Kim、Yongjun Jeong、Seongjun Yun、Hanbum Ko、Soohyun Oh、Sungbin Lim、Sungwoong Kim

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 RetroPlanner，一个基于 LLM 的多步逆合成规划器：它在 AND-OR 图上同时扩展并比较多条候选路线，训练模型依据结构进展、键变化与反应类型等化学证据进行推理，并按反应合理性、往返一致性和原料价格等多目标排序，以在有限搜索预算下提升路线质量与成功率。

**相关性简评：** 该工作将规划建模为在预算约束下比较多条候选路线并按多目标排序，可能与 LVR 中多 latent 假设的并行扩展、证据驱动的候选筛选及推理成本与收益的权衡形成概念类比，可供核查其路线比较与预算分配机制能否迁移。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** RetroPlanner: Multi-Route Expansion and Multi-Objective Reasoning for LLM-Based Retrosynthesis Planning

**abstract/A1：** Multi-step retrosynthesis planning is often considered solved once a route to purchasable starting materials is found, but such a route should also be practical in real-world chemistry. Recent LLM-based planners formulate this process as sequential decision-making over an AND-OR graph, yet typically expand a single molecule per turn and are optimized for solvability alone, leaving alternative routes uncompared across the multiple objectives that determine practicality before the search budget is committed. We introduce RetroPlanner, an LLM-based planner that jointly compares multiple routes to steer the search toward higher synthesizability, as measured by reaction plausibility, round-trip consistency, and starting-material price. RetroPlanner is trained to reason over chemical evidence: structural progress from the target molecule, bond changes and reaction classes, where candidate routes diverge from one another, and how they rank across multiple objectives. Experiments on multi-step retrosynthesis benchmarks demonstrate that RetroPlanner recovers more alternative routes than prior LLM-based planners while improving synthetic route quality and maintaining a high success rate.

</details>

### 689. [Sampling from Neural Operator Priors to Solve Partial Differential Equations](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16396v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16396

**作者：** Andrew Millard、Joshua Murphy、Zheng Zhao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16396v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16396v1>)

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文将神经算子先验与伪 bootstrap 序贯蒙特卡洛（pBS SMC）结合，在函数空间中用稀疏观测和 PDE 残差做引导采样求解 PDE，并把 DPM++ 改造成无需可解密度的新提议分布，在五个基准系统上对比误差—时间权衡。

**相关性简评：** 其粒子滤波式引导采样、无解析密度的提议分布与逐步加权机制，可能为 LVR 中多假设 latent 状态的维护、证据筛选与停止决策提供概念借鉴，但需核查其与视觉推理状态的迁移空间。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Sampling from Neural Operator Priors to Solve Partial Differential Equations

**abstract/A1：** Guided sampling with sparse observations and PDE residuals has recently been combined with neural operator priors to solve partial differential equations in function space, their natural setting. We pair such a prior with pseudo-bootstrap sequential Monte Carlo (pBS SMC), a guided sampling framework that accommodates proposals without tractable densities, and introduce a new proposal by adapting the DPM++ algorithm to the guidance setting. Across five benchmark PDE systems this proposal attains the best error--time trade-off at every step count tested, and wrapping it in pBS gives the lowest error on most inverse-problem settings, with the largest gains when few sampling steps are used.

</details>

### 690. [Recovering from Pose-Selection Failures in Repeated Visual Localization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16409v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16409

**作者：** Jaehyun Kim、Wonseok Kang、Tae-Wan Kim

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16409v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16409v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 History-Guided Pose Reselection（HPR）：用最近至多五次定位输出做粗略位置预测，当某个候选被所有预测一致支持时，才替换定位器选择的位姿，从而缓解重复结构导致的错误候选被选中问题，并在 HLoc、MASt3R、JIST 等配置上提升召回。

**相关性简评：** 把历史输出当作隐式信念状态来校验候选、仅在多源预测一致时才接受的保守决策方式，可能为 LVR 中的候选筛选与停止/接受判据提供线索，但其非多模态、非 latent 生成，具体可迁移性仍需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Recovering from Pose-Selection Failures in Repeated Visual Localization

**abstract/A1：** Repetitive structures can give an incorrect pose candidate more inlier support than an accurate one, causing visual localization to select it. History-Guided Pose Reselection (HPR) uses coarse position forecasts from up to five past localization outputs to distinguish well-separated current-query candidates. The best-fitting forecast proposes an alternative; HPR accepts it only if every well-fitting forecast is much closer to it than to the localizer's pose. HPR needs no odometry and returns the selected candidate unchanged, using prediction for selection rather than pose refinement. With one development-set threshold, HPR improves recall within 5 meters and 10 degrees in all 12 main configurations of Hierarchical Localization (HLoc), MASt3R-based pose generation, and JIST-based retrieval, losing successes on fewer than 0.4 percent of queries. On NAVER Gangnam B1, HPR corrects 97 HLoc failures and loses six successes; gains persist within 0.25 meters and 2 degrees on all three HLoc test sets. Median HPR runtime on HLoc candidates is below one millisecond, excluding pose generation. Recovery weakens under less frequent localization.

**comment/C1：** 9 pages, 3 figures

</details>

### 691. [Not All Challenges Are Equal: Evaluating Interactive Liveness Detection Against Real-Time Face Swaps](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16417v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16417

**作者：** Anton Firc、David Drtil、Martin Perešíni、Milan Šalko、Vojtěch Staněk、Kamil Malinka

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.CR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16417v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16417v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在 108 个实时会话（6 名被试、24 个被冒充身份、DeepFaceLive 与 FaceFusion 两款换脸工具经虚拟摄像头注入）中评估随机手势挑战，比较静态标定段与各主动手势窗口的检测 AUC，并考察端到端响应时间这一信号。

**相关性简评：** 其「哪些手势真正暴露攻击」接近 LVR 关注的视觉证据筛选与证据信息价值问题，响应时间区分攻击与真实会话也可能对推理中的停止决策或动态计算信号提供类比线索，但属较远领域，需核查是否有可迁移之处。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Not All Challenges Are Equal: Evaluating Interactive Liveness Detection Against Real-Time Face Swaps

**abstract/A1：** Remote identity verification assumes that a camera stream shows a live person, yet public real-time face-swap tools can replace that person before the stream reaches the verifier. Passive deepfake detectors generalize poorly to new generators, while interactive challenges are often selected without evidence of which gestures expose current attacks. We evaluate randomized gesture challenges in 108 live sessions with six subjects, 24 impersonated identities, and two face-swap tools, DeepFaceLive and FaceFusion, injected through a virtual camera. The static calibration segment reaches a session-level AUC of 0.878 with a frozen UCF spatial detector, while the mean across the active-gesture windows reaches 0.988. Pose and combined gestures have the highest point estimates, whereas expressions show no clear improvement. Hand occlusion against FaceFusion, configured with an occlusion mask, scores below the static baseline. The end-to-end time required to satisfy the validator also distinguishes attacks from genuine sessions, achieving a session-level AUC of 0.732, although this signal includes synthesis and transport delays. These results show that challenge sets should be tested against current attack configurations and that response time can provide an additional, deployment-specific signal.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at BIOSIG 2026

</details>

### 692. [ECHO: Correcting Time Series Foundation Model Forecasts with Historical Analogues and Errors](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16433v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16433

**作者：** Boya Zhang、Xilin Dai、Yilin Wang、Qiang Xu、Luyao Dong、Xing He、Wen Wu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16433v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16433v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 ECHO，一种黑盒时序基础模型预测修正框架：用 AnalogE 从检索到的历史相似情境学习可迁移修正，用 RecentE 从过往预测误差学习目标域残差修正，并按实际表现动态组合两者，在 5 个模型、9 个数据集上均降低 MSE。

**相关性简评：** 该工作虽属时序预测，但「检索历史相似证据 + 从历史误差学习修正 + 按观测表现动态组合两路互补信号」可能为 LVR 中多 latent 假设的筛选、证据组合与动态加权提供可核查的类比，是否真正可迁移需读原文。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ECHO: Correcting Time Series Foundation Model Forecasts with Historical Analogues and Errors

**abstract/A1：** Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) provide general-purpose forecasting capabilities, yet their forecasts can remain misaligned with the temporal characteristics of a target domain. This motivates lightweight forecast correction even when only black-box access to the TSFM is available. Our key observation is that two forms of historical information provide complementary correction signals: historical analogues reveal how similar contexts evolved, while past forecast errors reveal a TSFM's characteristic deviations in the target domain. Based on this observation, we propose ECHO, a black-box forecast correction framework that learns from both sources. ECHO uses AnalogE to assess retrieved historical analogues together with the current context and base forecast, learning transferable corrections through cross-domain pretraining. In parallel, RecentE learns target-specific residual corrections from past forecast errors and refines them as causally available feedback accumulates. ECHO dynamically combines the two corrections according to their observed forecasting performance. Across 5 representative TSFMs and 9 real-world datasets, ECHO reduces MSE in all 45 backbone--dataset settings, yielding an average relative reduction of 9.26\\% in macro-average MSE. Its gains also extend to long-horizon forecasting.

**comment/C1：** 26 pages, 12 tables, 6 figures

</details>

### 693. [Auditing Observation-Quality Shortcuts in the Evaluation of Person-Centered Motion for Video Anomaly Detection](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16471v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16471

**作者：** Chaehyun Kim、Changwon Lim

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16471v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16471v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对以人为中心的视频异常检测，检验基于运动的异常判别究竟反映任务相关运动信息，还是检测、姿态估计与跟踪带来的观测质量差异；提出包含质量诊断、质量平衡、运动正交化和稳健性分析的评估框架，并在 UCF-Crime 上显示质量特征可构成强捷径，经基数匹配后多线索运动才稳定优于质量特征。

**相关性简评：** 其「观测质量捷径审计＋混杂控制」的评估思路可能可迁移到 LVR 评测：用于核查 latent 推理的判别究竟来自真实视觉证据，还是来自输入质量、检测可靠性等代理线索，具体对应关系供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Auditing Observation-Quality Shortcuts in the Evaluation of Person-Centered Motion for Video Anomaly Detection

**abstract/A1：** Video anomaly detection (VAD) identifies deviations from normal patterns, but such deviations do not necessarily correspond to safety-critical events. We focus on human-centered emergencies and violence and investigate whether motion-based anomaly discrimination reflects task-relevant motion information or observation-quality differences arising from person detection, pose estimation, and tracking. We introduce an observation-quality-aware evaluation framework that combines quality diagnostics, quality balancing, motion orthogonalization, and robustness analyses. On human-centered categories of UCF-Crime, quality-only features match or exceed the discrimination of multi-cue motion in the original cohort, revealing a strong observation-quality shortcut. After cardinality matching brings all 11 measured quality variables below a prespecified marginal balance threshold, multi-cue motion consistently outperforms quality-only features across Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and RBF-SVM, yielding ROC-AUC gains of 0.046-0.141. Because nonlinear quality-only prediction remains above chance after matching, we interpret this result as additional discrimination beyond measured marginal quality rather than as evidence of quality-free or causal motion understanding. These findings show that high VAD performance should not be interpreted as evidence of abnormal-motion modeling without auditing the reliability of the person-observation pipeline. Our study provides a systematic protocol for evaluating observation-quality shortcuts and for assessing whether motion-based discrimination survives explicit control of detection, pose-estimation, and tracking reliability.

**comment/C1：** 9 pages, 2 figures

</details>

### 694. [PXRD-Bench: How Close Are We to Determining Crystal Structures from Powder Diffraction?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16480v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16480

**作者：** Dongyeop Woo、Nofit Segal、Nayoung Kim、Minkyu Kim、Rafael Gomez-Bombarelli、Sungsoo Ahn

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cond-mat.mtrl-sci

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16480v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16480v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 PXRD-Bench，一个从粉末 X 射线衍射图谱反推晶体结构的统一基准，覆盖未知元素组成、双相混合物与实验图谱，并给出参考基线模型 Bragglite 及对建模选择的系统研究。

**相关性简评：** 其「从观测信号恢复离散隐结构」的设定、对未见组成/结构原型的泛化评估、以及双相混合物的成分解耦与「模拟训练模型未必受益于真实图谱」的发现，可能为 LVR 中隐状态假设组合、组合泛化与视觉/真实证据利用的评价设计提供类比线索，需人工核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PXRD-Bench: How Close Are We to Determining Crystal Structures from Powder Diffraction?

**abstract/A1：** Determining crystal structures from powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD) would enable routine characterization of newly synthesized materials, including those absent from reference databases. Generative models offer a promising approach, but existing evaluations remain fragmented and largely assume single-phase samples with known composition. To fill this gap, we introduce PXRD-Bench, a unified benchmark that extends evaluation to unknown per-element atom counts and recovery of both structures in two-phase mixtures. It provides approximately 4.1 million training structures with simulated PXRD, tests generalization to unseen compositions and structural prototypes, and evaluates recovery from experimental PXRD after excluding structurally matching training entries. To provide a strong reference baseline, we also introduce Bragglite, a PXRD-to-structure model developed through a systematic study of PXRD modeling choices. It achieves a 44.2\\% Top-1 match rate on experimental RRUFF patterns with known composition, 24.6\\% above the strongest prior baseline. Further analysis yields several key findings: some models fail to benefit from experimental PXRD, while generalization to unseen structural prototypes and recovery from two-phase mixtures remain challenging. Together, our benchmark, systematic studies, and Bragglite clarify the capabilities and limitations of current PXRD-to-structure models.

</details>

<a id="paper-695"></a>

### 695. [pi-Net: Empirical Latent Representations for Differentiable Physics Heads in Data-Scarce Systems](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16504v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16504

**作者：** Akshay Dhalpe、Arnab Chattopadhyay、Shahriar Bakrani Balani、Eric Cortanéa、Sasu Tarkoma

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16504v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16504v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 pi-Net，一个物理信息潜变量模型：编码器将输入映射到物理归一化的 latent 空间，再由可微物理头部解码出预测，用以补全量纲分析计算图产生的欠定系统；在数据稀缺的 GMAW 焊接案例上仅用 60 个样本达到 R²=0.864。

**相关性简评：** 其「结构化归一化 latent 空间 + 可微解码头」的做法可能与 LVR 中 latent 状态的表示约束、状态抽象与可解释性有潜在概念联系，可供核查，但领域较远、不涉及视觉或多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** pi-Net: Empirical Latent Representations for Differentiable Physics Heads in Data-Scarce Systems

**abstract/A1：** Developing reliable predictive models for multi-physics systems often forces a compromise between computationally demanding physical simulators and data-hungry, opaque machine learning (ML) algorithms. While incorporating dimensional analysis into directed computation graphs offers a structurally sound alternative to explicitly solving partial differential equations (PDEs), such formulations typically yield underdetermined systems that act as imperfect simulators. We introduce pi-Net, a physics-informed latent variable model that resolves these imperfect simulators. The hybrid pi-Net architecture consists of an encoder that maps inputs into physically normalized latent space, which are then decoded into final predictions by a differentiable physics head. Evaluated on a real-world, data-scarce Gas Metal Arc Welding (GMAW) case study, the framework achieves an R2 of 0.864 with only 60 experimental samples. The results demonstrate that pi-Net significantly outperforms purely data-driven baselines in data-scarce regimes while providing causal, process-level explainability.

</details>

### 696. [Boosting the Learning for Ranking Patterns](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16511v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16511

**作者：** Nassim Belmecheri、Noureddine Aribi、Nadjib Lazaar、Yahia Lebbah、Samir Loudni

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16511v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16511v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把「为特定用户学习模式排序函数」形式化为多准则决策问题，用 AHP 依据用户偏好导出各有趣性度量的权重，并提出基于敏感度的主动学习启发式以减少用户排序查询，实验报告相比现有方法更快、排序更准且对用户错误更稳健。

**相关性简评：** 其按敏感度挑选最有信息量查询以最小化交互成本的思路，可能与 LVR 中预算受限的证据获取与停止决策形成概念类比，可供核查；但领域属模式挖掘，与视觉推理距离较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Boosting the Learning for Ranking Patterns

**abstract/A1：** Pattern mining is a valuable tool for exploratory data analysis, but identifying relevant patterns for a specific user is challenging. Various interestingness mea- sures have been developed to evaluate patterns, but they may not efficiently estimate user-specific functions. Learning user-specific functions by ranking patterns has been proposed, but this requires significant time and training samples. In this paper, we present a solution that formulates the problem of learning pattern ranking functions as a multicriteria decision making problem. Our approach uses Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) to elicit weights for different interestingness measures based on user preference. We also propose an active learning mode with a sensitivity-based heuristic to minimize user ranking queries while still providing high-quality results. Experiments show that our approach significantly reduces running time and returns precise pattern ranking while being robust to user error, compared to state-of-the-art approaches.

</details>

### 697. [Asymptotic Risk of Learning-Rate Schedules for Least-Squares Regression with Discretely Distributed Features](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16518v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16518

**作者：** Noé Colomban、Francis Bach、Fabian Schaipp

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、math.OC、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16518v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16518v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在离散分布特征（Slock 模型）的流式最小二乘上分析 SGD 末次迭代，推导恒定与 Warmup-Stable-Decay 调度的精确有限时间风险与渐近等价，给出风险随 horizon 的缩放律及关于 batch size 的临界行为。

**相关性简评：** WSD 冷阶段任意短的 cooldown 都带来多项式风险收益、以及最优风险只通过 bT 依赖批量与 horizon 的结论，可能为 latent reasoning 训练的步长/算力分配与训练长度外推提供线索，与多模态训练实际调度的对应性尚待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Asymptotic Risk of Learning-Rate Schedules for Least-Squares Regression with Discretely Distributed Features

**abstract/A1：** We study the last iterate of stochastic gradient descent (SGD) on streaming least squares with discretely distributed features (Slock's model), which decouples the dynamics across eigendirections. Under power-law source and capacity conditions, we derive the exact finite-time risk and asymptotic equivalents of constant and Warmup-Stable-Decay (WSD) schedules. With a tuned base learning-rate, the resulting scaling law decays as $Θ(T^{-q})$, where $T$ is the horizon, and $q$ is independent of the cooldown length $c \\in (0,1\]$ but is strictly smaller for the constant schedule: any cooldown of fixed relative length $c &gt; 0$, however short, improves the risk by a polynomial factor, while its length only affects the constant, which is minimized by linear decay ($c = 1$). Finally, we show that the optimal risk depends on the batch size $b$ and horizon $T$ only through $bT$, up to a critical batch size.

**comment/C1：** 42 pages, 9 figures

</details>

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Reinforcement Learning with Hawkes-Structured Networks for Market Making

**abstract/A1：** Market making under realistic order-flow dynamics is challenging due to the clustered, self-exciting nature of order arrivals, which are naturally modeled by non-Markovian Hawkes processes. We propose a model-free reinforcement learning (RL) framework for market making with general Hawkes order-flow dynamics. We first establish non-asymptotic performance bounds that quantify the loss incurred by approximating the infinite-dimensional Hawkes state using a finite collection of exponentially weighted features. Guided by this analysis, we introduce the Hawkes-Structured Network (HSN), a novel neural architecture that encodes historical order flow through a learnable mixture-of-exponentials filter. HSN is trained end-to-end using model-free RL, jointly optimizing the feature representation and quoting policy directly from reward feedback. Experiments on single- and multi-asset market-making problems with mixture-of-exponentials, power-law, and regime-switching kernels demonstrate that HSN outperforms general-purpose neural architectures, achieving higher trading rewards while implicitly recovering the underlying order-flow intensities.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to ACM ICAIF 2026

</details>

<a id="paper-699"></a>

### 699. [Learning Graded Sparse Mechanisms: A Representation Theorem and Certified Generalization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16537v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16537

**作者：** Mark Kozdoba、Shie Mannor

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.MA、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16537v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16537v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文公理化地定义「graded sparse mechanisms」：元素更新强依赖少数、弱依赖多数，且重要元素的身份与数量随状态变化；证明该类恰为加权多集上某 transport 度量的 Lipschitz 球，给出依赖数据稀疏剖面与经验差异的泛化界，并在 Vicsek 群集仿真上验证证书非空。

**相关性简评：** 其状态依赖的「少数强、多数弱」依赖结构与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选和元素权重几何可能有概念联系，加权多集上的 transport 度量或可供核查作为比较 latent 状态／证据权重的候选工具；但该文未涉及视觉或多模态推理，迁移属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning Graded Sparse Mechanisms: A Representation Theorem and Certified Generalization

**abstract/A1：** In a variety of multi-agent and physical environments, an element's update depends strongly on a few other elements and weakly on many, and both the identity and the number of the elements that matter change with the state of the system. Such graded sparse mechanisms are common, for instance, in flocks, crowds, learned particle simulators and the neighborhood aggregation of graph networks, yet they have received little systematic study as a class of functions with the grading given. In this paper we study the supervised learning of the mechanism when the grading is provided by the environment, as a weight on every element. First, we define the class by axioms, where each element's influence is capped by its weight, the dependence on the weights is regular, and no element is distinguished, and prove a representation theorem: the class is exactly the Lipschitz ball of a transport metric on weighted multisets, and the metric is forced by the axioms. Next, the geometry of the representation gives generalization bounds that depend on the data in two ways. One is via the sparsity profile of the data -- the law of how many elements matter and by how much -- which bounds the rate over all designs with that profile, with an exponent from the profile and no dependence on the number of elements. In a number of natural cases we also show matching lower bounds, up to constants in the exponent. The other is empirical: due to the representation result, classical empirical discrepancy bounds apply to the class as they stand, and the resulting bound is the transport distance between the two halves of the sample in the class's own metric, computed exactly by a matching, with an additional concentration term. Finally, we study a simulated Vicsek flock under four interaction rules at two noise levels, and show that the certificate is non-vacuous, a small fraction of the trivial value on every rule.

</details>

**title/T1：** AI Discovery in Combinatorics: From Problems to Solutions and Back to Bigger Problems

**abstract/A1：** We introduce $qt$Bench, a benchmark of 29 open problems in algebraic combinatorics. These problems ask for a simple combinatorial algorithm that explains given polynomial coefficients or identities. To help AI agents search for such algorithms, we provide a scaffold for playing with combinatorial objects, countering cheating attempts, and testing candidate solutions. To explore how far frontier AI systems can go on these problems, we collaborated with OpenAI, whose researchers obtained proposed solutions to several of them. This highlights bigger meta-problems: is AI discovery at scale ethical? How should these results be released? How should proof digestion be organized? We discuss these questions and give our views.

### 701. [Optimal Transport PAC-Bayes Bounds](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16560v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16560

**作者：** Armin Beck、Peter Ochs、Jalal Fadili

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16560v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16560v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文将 PAC-Bayes 泛化界中的 KL 散度替换为一般最优传输（OT）距离（含全变差距离与 Wasserstein-p 距离），推出新的分布相关泛化界，以放宽支撑约束并引入概率空间几何信息。

**相关性简评：** 纯理论工作，与 VLM 推理无直接关联，但其用 OT 取代 KL、强调分布几何与支撑不受限的散度，可能为「表示几何」议题提供线索，供核查其在比较 latent 推理状态分布或几何感知训练目标上的可用性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Optimal Transport PAC-Bayes Bounds

**abstract/A1：** PAC-Bayesian generalization bounds are among the strongest distribution-dependent guarantees in statistical learning and are typically expressed in terms of the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence between a prior and posterior distribution. While analytically convenient, the KL divergence requires the posterior to be absolutely continuous w.r.t. the prior, imposing support constraints that can substantially restrict the choice of posterior. Moreover, the KL divergence does not account for the underlying geometry of the probability space. In this work, we derive new PAC-Bayesian bounds replacing the KL divergence with general optimal transport (OT) distances, including the total variation and Wasserstein-$p$ distances.

</details>

### 702. [CineRecon: Benchmarking Frontier Models for Agentic Cinematic Reconstruction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16577v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16577

**作者：** Jialei Wang、Zehan Wang、XiaoYang Wu、Ziang Zhang、Siyu Chen、Jiaer Huang、Yujia Zhang、Tianyu Pang、Hengshuang Zhao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16577v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16577v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 CineRecon 基准：用 50 段参考视频与 360 个标注片段，考察智能体在 Proxy、Simplified、Detailed 三种表示要求下重建可编辑动态 3D 场景的能力，并以 VLM 评判器对时间戳对齐的渲染帧打分。

**相关性简评：** 其表示层级受控比较与按时间戳对齐的清单式 VLM 评判，可能为 LVR 中「任务必要视觉信息是否保留」「证据使用是否到位」的评测设计提供线索，可供核查；但论文本体属视频与 3D 重建，与 latent 推理状态联系较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CineRecon: Benchmarking Frontier Models for Agentic Cinematic Reconstruction

**abstract/A1：** Reconstructing reference videos as editable dynamic 3D scenes is an important path toward controllable video generation for filmmaking: these scenes provide modifiable, renderable visual proxies that enable explicit control over scene layout, subject actions, and camera behavior. To evaluate agents' ability to reconstruct editable dynamic 3D scenes from dynamic reference videos, we introduce CineRecon, a benchmark comprising 50 reference videos and 360 annotated evaluation clips. The reference videos span film, real-world footage, and games. Given a complete video, an agent uses tools to construct, animate, render, and refine its reconstruction. We evaluate this task under three representation settings: Proxy, Simplified, and Detailed. These settings increase geometric and appearance requirements while retaining the same requirements for spatial relations, camera behavior, and subject dynamics. This design tests whether agents can reproduce the events in a video when detailed appearance is unnecessary, and how performance changes as representation requirements increase. For evaluation, we construct checklists that associate observable properties and events with specific entities and times. A vision-language judge compares timestamp-aligned reference and rendered frames across 11 categories, grouped into camera, static, and dynamic consistency dimensions. We evaluate 12 models using their corresponding agent harnesses and find failures across all three dimensions. Subject motions and interactions remain difficult to reproduce even under the Proxy setting.

**comment/C1：** 24 pages, 19 figures. Project page: https://cinerecon.github.io/

</details>

### 703. [OctMole: Multiscale 3D Molecular Generation with Hierarchical Spatial Flows](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16586v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16586

**作者：** Yu-Tong Jin、Yi-Yang Tian、Qiwei Ye、Peng-Shuai Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16586v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16586v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** OctMole 提出面向三维分子生成的多尺度八叉树流框架：分层占据流由粗到细确定分子支撑区域，联合原子流在占据叶子上分配原子类型与胞内连续偏移；中间占据状态与选定区域还能作为空间条件，支持形状条件生成、区域编辑与插值，无需任务特定重训练。

**相关性简评：** 其「粗到细层次状态生成、且中间状态可直接作条件」的思路，与 LVR 中多尺度推理工作区、中间 latent 状态复用与可解释控制的关注点存在概念类比，可供核查是否迁移到视觉推理的状态分层与停止决策。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** OctMole: Multiscale 3D Molecular Generation with Hierarchical Spatial Flows

**abstract/A1：** Generating accurate 3D molecules requires jointly determining a variable number of atoms, their identities, and geometry across spatial scales: global shape emerges coarsely, whereas chemical bonds demand fine local precision. Existing atom-based diffusion and flow models operate largely at a single scale, while dense spatial fields become costly at high resolution. We introduce OctMole, a multiscale octree flow framework for 3D molecular generation. A hierarchical occupancy flow progressively resolves sparse molecular support from coarse to fine, and a joint atom flow assigns atom types and continuous in-cell offsets to occupied leaves. This decomposition combines efficient global structure with subcell geometric precision, while cell corruption improves robustness to generated support. On QM9 and GEOM-DRUG, OctMole achieves strong chemical, distributional, and geometric quality, with particularly clear gains over Uni-3DAR on GEOM-DRUG and substantial efficiency gains over dense 3D generation. As an additional capability, intermediate occupancy states and selected regions provide spatial conditioning without task-specific retraining, supporting multiscale shape conditioning, regional editing, linker generation, and shape interpolation. Code and pretrained checkpoints are available at https://github.com/octree-nn/octmole and https://huggingface.co/Disembo/octmole, respectively.

**comment/C1：** 28 pages, 22 figures, and 17 tables

</details>

### 704. [HyBRA-EEG: Hyperbolic Global-Local Brain-Region Aggregation for Self-Supervised EEG Representation Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16589v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16589

**作者：** Xin Liu、Feng Lu、Wei Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16589v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16589v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出 HyBRA，一个自监督 EEG 表示学习框架：用双曲空间中的全局—局部脑区聚合，把异构电极通道映射到固定区域 token 空间，并加入通道证据注入分支保存细粒度判别线索，再用 Region-Time Transformer 做潜特征与区域信号的掩码重建。

**相关性简评：** 其双曲匹配与「证据注入」分支可视为表示几何与细节保留的一种设计，可能为 LVR 中 latent 相似度的几何度量、聚合时视觉细粒度信息旁路与坍缩问题提供核查线索，但领域差异较大，需较多迁移验证。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** HyBRA-EEG: Hyperbolic Global-Local Brain-Region Aggregation for Self-Supervised EEG Representation Learning

**abstract/A1：** Electroencephalography (EEG) representation learning is challenged by noisy signals, inter-subject variability, and heterogeneous electrode montages in different datasets and recording settings. Recent self-supervised EEG pretraining methods improve transferability by converting heterogeneous recordings into unified token or sequence representations, but channel-aware designs may still encode montage- or dataset-specific regularities. We propose HyBRA, a self-supervised framework based on hyperbolic global-local brain-region aggregation. HyBRA maps heterogeneous channel observations into a fixed regional token space by combining electrode coordinates, region priors, and feature-dependent hyperbolic distances. A channel-evidence injection branch preserves fine-grained discriminative cues during aggregation. The resulting tokens are processed by a Region-Time Transformer and pretrained with masked reconstruction of latent features and region-level signals. HyBRA outperforms the compared methods in average balanced accuracy on six benchmark datasets. Under a controlled six-fold evaluation on OpenBMI-MI, HyBRA matches CSBrain in balanced accuracy, improves AUROC by 1.84 percentage points and AUPRC by 5.23 percentage points, and uses 96.8\\% fewer parameters. Matched comparisons on TUAB and TUEV show higher balanced accuracy for hyperbolic matching than for Euclidean distance or cosine similarity.

</details>

### 705. [Answer It or Not? Towards Prompt-Adapted Adversarial Images on Vision Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16622v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16622

**作者：** Shunyuan Bai、Yuchen Ren、Le Yang、Chenhao Lin、Chao Shen、Zhengyu Zhao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16622v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16622v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 ProAda 提示自适应对抗图像：通过迭代更新文本提示并用简单分类器判断提示有害性是否仍成立，以更准确的对抗方向优化扰动，使 VLM 拒绝有害提问同时仍能正确回答合法提问，在视觉隐私数据集上实现双向超过 90% 的成功率并具备跨模型迁移性。

**相关性简评：** 其「提示条件化的对抗扰动—拒绝/回答」范式可能充当探针，用于核查 VLM 答案是否真正依赖视觉证据、即视觉旁路问题，并可启发对提示依赖与证据筛选的评测设计，但与原论文的 latent 状态生成机制是否有实质关联尚待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Answer It or Not? Towards Prompt-Adapted Adversarial Images on Vision Language Models

**abstract/A1：** With the advancement in language modeling, research on adversarial images has recently shifted from image classifiers to vision-language models (VLMs). Despite the new, text-prompt-driven nature of VLMs, we find that existing VLM adversaries have largely overlooked the dynamics of text prompts. In a typical use case, adversarial images can protect visual privacy by rejecting VLMs from answering questions about the image. However, existing protections are prompt-agnostic, i.e., indiscriminately rejecting any question, including those for potential legitimate use of the image. To address this limitation, we propose Prompt-Adapted (ProAda) adversarial images, which are optimized to balance the rejection of harmful prompts and the correct response of legitimate prompts. In particular, to achieve a more accurate adversarial direction, the text prompt is also iteratively updated with a simple classifier judging whether the harmfulness of the prompt remains. Extensive experiments on visual-privacy-related datasets validate that ProAda can reject over 90% of harmful prompts while allowing over 90% of legitimate ones, demonstrating superior overall performance compared to existing prompt-agnostic VLM adversaries. In addition, our ProAda achieves competitive overall cross-model transferability and improved robustness against countermeasures.

**comment/C1：** 20 pages, 7 figures

</details>

### 706. [Counting with Attention and LayerNorm: Norm Scaling and Representation Geometry](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16653v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16653

**作者：** Ayyub Shaffy、Manoj Dhakal、Safal Shrestha、Keith W. Ross

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16653v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16653v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在单层单头注意力上研究长度 L 内的计数任务，分析 softmax 注意力与 LayerNorm 位置如何塑造读出计数的表示几何，推导精确计数所需最小参数范数 B\_min 随 L 的紧致增长速率（无归一化为 L、post-norm 为 L^{3/2}、可学习 post-norm 为 L^{3/4}），并比较回归与分类读出的差异及实验验证。

**相关性简评：** 该工作从表示几何与范数缩放角度刻画注意力、归一化对内部状态承载信息（计数）的长度相关成本，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的容量、长度泛化与表示几何分析提供线索，但研究对象为纯文本计数、非视觉多模态推理，联系需人工核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Counting with Attention and LayerNorm: Norm Scaling and Representation Geometry

**abstract/A1：** Counting is a simple task on which transformers can nevertheless fail at long sequence lengths. We study the cost of counting in a single attention layer, up to a maximum length $L$, focusing on how softmax attention and layer normalization shape the representation from which the count is recovered. We mainly focus on regression read-out but also consider classification read-out. For regression, we show unnormalized linear attention counts exactly at parameter norms independent of $L$. For softmax attention, regression cannot count exactly with finite parameters; it recovers the count after rounding, but only when the vector parameter norms grow with $L$. We measure this cost by $B\_{\\min}$, the smallest bound that can be placed on every trainable vector to ensure exact counting after rounding, and derive tight rates. At fixed model dimension, $B\_{\\min}$ grows as $L$ without normalization, as $L^{3/2}$ under bare post-normalization, and as $L^{3/4}$ with learned post-normalization. The last rate is unexpected: post-normalization discards the magnitude that carries the count and might be expected to make counting harder, yet with a learnable gain it counts at a smaller norm than softmax without normalization. Bare pre-normalization is different: it bounds the attention scores, so beyond a finite length no parameter norm suffices. A classification read-out keeps every norm bounded under every placement, but a dense head stores one output vector per count and costs more in storage. Experiments on the post-normalized model reproduce this split between the two read-outs. Together, our theoretical and empirical findings characterize how self-attention, layer-normalization placement, and read-out choice shape the representation geometry and parameter cost of counting in the minimal single-head architecture studied here.

**comment/C1：** 29 pages, 8 figures, 3 tables

</details>

### 707. [NFMap: Topographic 2D Manifold Learning with Invertible Normalizing Flows](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16750v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16750

**作者：** Héléna Alexandra Gaspar

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16750v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16750v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** NFMap 是一种降维可视化方法，用可逆 normalizing flow 扩展 GTM：在 2D 网格先验上学习参数化嵌入，并给出显式似然；其潜空间分为 2 维可导航地图与 off-manifold 残差，还支持重尾 Student-t 混合成分以缓解地图拥挤。

**相关性简评：** 可逆映射与体积收缩惩罚迫使被残差挤出的方差回流到可视流形，这一「局部邻域保真 vs 全局距离保真」的取舍可能启发对 LVR 内部状态中细节保留与几何结构的理解，其似然作为分布外信号也可供核查是否能类比为证据或停止决策信号；但属较远领域，联系仅为概念层面。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** NFMap: Topographic 2D Manifold Learning with Invertible Normalizing Flows

**abstract/A1：** We present NFMap, a dimensionality reduction method for 2D visualisation that extends Generative Topographic Mapping (GTM) with a bijective normalizing flow. Like GTM, NFMap places a fixed mixture grid prior over a 2D latent map, giving a parametric embedding, an explicit likelihood, and the ability to project new points onto an existing map; the likelihood is an effective out-of-distribution signal on chemical datasets. Unlike GTM, whose latent-to-data mapping is an RBF network of bounded flexibility, NFMap's mapping is a normalizing flow, and is therefore fully invertible: any location on the map can be carried back to data space. To alleviate map crowding on large datasets, NFMap additionally supports heavy-tailed Student-t mixture components. NFMap maps data to a latent space of the same dimension, split into a 2-dimensional navigable map and an off-manifold residual. Because the flow is bijective and its objective penalises volume contraction, variance squeezed out of the residual must reappear in the navigable map. The residual scale is the main control between local neighbourhood fidelity and global distance fidelity; its effect depends on the dimensionality of the data and is coupled to the extent of the latent grid.

**comment/C1：** 20 pages, 10 figures. Code: https://github.com/hagax8/nfmap

</details>

### 708. [Is the Platform Part of the Measurement? A Protocol and Simulation Study for Cross-Platform Equivalence of Machine-Labelled Policy Sentiment](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16757v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16757

**作者：** Asad Ikram、Ella Haig

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CL、cs.CY、cs.SI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16757v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16757v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把「平台」视为分类器测量的一个 facet，借用心理测量学的等价工具（概化理论、测量不变性/DIF、分数链接）提出六步协议，并用 500 次重复的已知真值仿真说明不做事先链接的合并指数会在近四分之一天数上报出错误的总体情感符号，另以一个跨 Twitter/X、Reddit、YouTube、Quora 的 BERT 政策情感分类器为案例。

**相关性简评：** 其测量等价与分数链接框架可能为 LVR 的可核查线索：判断同一 latent 读出或探针在不同模态、数据集与条件下是否测量同一构念，并把分数方差归因于平台、任务等 facet，而非直接研究视觉推理本身。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Is the Platform Part of the Measurement? A Protocol and Simulation Study for Cross-Platform Equivalence of Machine-Labelled Policy Sentiment

**abstract/A1：** Comparing machine-labelled sentiment across social media platforms is now routine: differences in classifier scores between platforms are read as differences in public opinion. These comparisons rest on an assumption that the classifier measures the same construct, on the same scale, on every platform. Some studies check a classifier's validity platform by platform, but to our knowledge none has modelled the platform as a facet of the classifier's measurement. We adapt the psychometric equivalence toolkit (generalizability theory, measurement invariance and differential item functioning, and score linking) to machine-labelled policy sentiment, treating the platform as a survey mode, and specify a six-step protocol with anchor events fixed in advance, an anchor-density audit, and a two-classifier convergence control. A simulation with known ground truth illustrates what the assumption can cost in one generating configuration fixed in advance: across 500 replications, because the platforms measure through different functions, a pooled index that takes platform scores at face value reports the wrong sign of aggregate sentiment on nearly a quarter of days, whereas an index adjusted with each platform's known measurement function does so on under one day in sixty on average. A case study of the instrument from the first author's MSc dissertation, a fine-tuned BERT classifier over 255,446 UK economic-policy comments from Twitter/X, Reddit, YouTube, and Quora, motivates the design and illustrates the instrument-dependence the protocol addresses. The full four-platform application, under fresh collection with the pre-specified design, is the designated follow-up study. The protocol lets a researcher test whether pooling platforms is defensible in a given corpus, or whether platform scores must be linked before any average is taken.

**comment/C1：** 25 pages, 12 figures, 2 tables. Includes an original 500-replication simulation study. Code: https://github.com/asadfix/platform-measurement (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23105129)

</details>

**title/T1：** Game-Creation-Agents: Autonomous Game Production

**abstract/A1：** Game-Creation-Agents (GCA) turns a natural-language request into a runnable Phaser 4 browser game. The pipeline first builds a multimodal game design document that couples mechanics and scene contracts to grounded visual references. It then projects that document into a runtime scaffold, machine-readable contracts, and deterministic tests. Eight specialized agents next carry out production: scenes are implemented serially, assets are produced in parallel, and one reduced manifest joins the two branches into a single build. Build-linked real-UI checks and a code-blind critic then verify that build and decide whether the game may ship. Each blocker returns to the agent that owns the affected artifact for a bounded repair, and the game is released once all the gates pass. We evaluate finished games separately, through their rendered interfaces alone, over prompt-matched tasks run under a common protocol. GCA achieves stronger requirement satisfaction, core mechanics, content depth, and functional visuals than a comparable open pipeline. In a side-by-side human study, raters also score GCA's games higher on every dimension and prefer them overall.

### 710. [DASS: A Solver-Adaptable Dynamic Auxiliary Search Strategy for Symbolic Regression](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16812v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16812

**作者：** Yuxiao Hu、Qian Li、Ding Wang、Yekun Zheng、Jinyue Yan、Yuntian Chen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16812v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16812v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 DASS，一种可适配不同求解器的动态辅助搜索策略：用一组高潜力基函数张成辅助搜索子空间，通过多环境评估估计项效用、过滤不稳定引导，并用 Gibbs 后验更新项的潜力分数，再由求解器反馈的高质量解反哺基项集合，形成子空间与求解器的闭环优化。

**相关性简评：** 其「辅助子空间表征 + 效用过滤不稳定引导 + 后验校准 + 求解器反馈闭环」与 LVR 中 latent 工作区的表示、视觉证据筛选及监督贡献分配可能存在概念对应，可供核查，但属符号回归的远领域，迁移线索较间接。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DASS: A Solver-Adaptable Dynamic Auxiliary Search Strategy for Symbolic Regression

**abstract/A1：** Symbolic regression (SR) aims to discover interpretable mathematical expressions from data and plays a key role in scientific discovery. However, existing methods face a common bottleneck: the enormous search space and severe combinatorial explosion make it difficult to achieve a favorable trade-off between accuracy and algorithmic efficiency. We argue that, in addition to designing increasingly complex solver-specific SR strategies, an equally promising direction is to equip them with a shareable auxiliary strategy that can provide reliable search guidance. To this end, we propose DASS, a solver-adaptable Dynamic Auxiliary Search Strategy that improves SR by constructing and refining a high-potential auxiliary search subspace. DASS represents the auxiliary search space as a functional subspace spanned by a set of high-potential basis function terms. It estimates term utility through multi-environment evaluation, filters unstable guidance, and updates term potential scores with a Gibbs posterior, thereby calibrating the subspace to provide more reliable guidance for downstream solvers. The high-quality solutions produced by the solver are used to update the set of basis terms. This forms a virtuous closed-loop optimization process: the subspace guides the downstream solver, and the solver feedback reshapes the subspace for subsequent exploration. DASS can be easily integrated with various types of SR solvers. Extensive experiments on LLM-SRBench show that DASS significantly improves the accuracy of original solvers with a manageable increase in runtime.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 711. [Carve VFM: Carving Specialists out of Generalists, Automatic Task-Specific Compression of Vision Foundation Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16813v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16813

**作者：** Lotfi Abdelkrim Mecharbat、Abdelrahman Elsayed、Ibrahim Almakky、Martin Takáč、Mohammad Yaqub

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16813v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16813v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出 Carve VFM，在给定 VFM、校准集与参数预算下，联合搜索逐层的任务敏感容量分配与移除后行为的低秩恢复，从而在单卡数分钟内剪出稠密任务专用编码器。

**相关性简评：** 属于模型压缩方向，与 LVR 无关，但其「按任务敏感度分配各层容量、并用自适应准则权衡移除与可恢复性」的预算分配视角，可能可供核查 LVR 中动态计算预算分配与停止决策问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Carve VFM: Carving Specialists out of Generalists, Automatic Task-Specific Compression of Vision Foundation Models

**abstract/A1：** Vision foundation models (VFMs) provide transferable visual representations, but their inference cost limits deployment in many settings. Fine-tuning specializes a VFM without shrinking it; distillation shrinks it, but through expensive teacher-guided training. Structured pruning offers a more direct route by extracting a compact subnetwork from the VFM. However, as compression gets aggressive, existing methods fail because they treat subnetwork selection and recovery as separate axes. Across layers, capacity must follow task sensitivity rather than spread uniformly. Within a layer, a removal cannot be judged by importance alone; its impact also depends on how well the lost contribution can be recovered from what remains. Selection and recovery must therefore be decided jointly. We introduce Carve VFM, which resolves this interdependence. Given a VFM, a calibration set, and a parameter budget, it (i) searches for task-specific capacity allocations across layers; (ii) guides the search via an adaptive recovery-aware fitness criterion; and (iii) reconstructs removed behavior through iterative closed-form low-rank corrections merged into the surviving weights. The result is a dense encoder produced in minutes on a single GPU without backbone retraining. Across twelve benchmarks and four models from DINOv3 and MetaCLIP-2, Carve VFM achieves the highest reported mean accuracy in seven of eight backbone-budget configurations among the evaluated dense structured-pruning methods. Further fine-tuning surpasses the strongest evaluated edge model (88.1% vs. 85.8%), and carved models cut compute and memory while delivering 1.3-2.0x higher GPU throughput than the uncompressed one. These results show that the compact model you need is inside the VFM; it only has to be carved out.

**comment/C1：** 24 pages, 6 figures, 11 tables

</details>

### 712. [Mean Accuracy Is the Wrong Estimand for a Release Decision](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16825v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16825

**作者：** Jaewon Choi、Jihye Kang、Namhyuk Ahn

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16825v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16825v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文论证平均准确率不适合作为模型发布依据，因微调会引发双峰模式坍缩、尾部失败被均值掩盖；作者审计 2124 个微调模型并提出 recipe cards，用精确有限样本二项界认证重跑尾部失败率，并设最低样本量门槛、在域与任务迁移时拒绝未验证主张。

**相关性简评：** 与研究中的评价环节可能相关：latent 推理方法的收益常以少数种子的均值汇报，这一统计认证思路可供核查如何评估跨种子鲁棒性、失败尾部与样本量下限。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Mean Accuracy Is the Wrong Estimand for a Release Decision

**abstract/A1：** A release decision about a fine-tuned model is an operational commitment about the \\emph{next} rerun of its training recipe. Yet standard benchmark reporting gives only the mean accuracy of past seeds. These target fundamentally different questions: release decisions depend on catastrophic tail risk, whereas standard evaluation reports only central tendency. Because fine-tuning induces bimodal mode collapse, high average accuracy frequently conceals severe failure rates. Auditing $2\\,124$ fine-tuned models across eleven language models, we show that shipping models based on mean accuracy violates a $10\\%$ deployment failure budget $48.0\\%$ of the time. Common heuristics like $\\bar b - 2σ$ prove equally dangerous: by underestimating variance on small samples, they become most permissive when evidence is weakest. We introduce \\textbf{recipe cards}, an evaluation framework that directly certifies rerun tail failure rates using exact finite-sample binomial bounds. Recipe cards reduce held-out budget violations to $0.6\\%$, enforce a mathematical sample floor ($N \\ge 22$) that prevents certification on thin evidence, and explicitly refuse unverified claims under domain and task shifts.

</details>

### 713. [Same Operation, Different Permission: Evaluating Whether Guardrails Honor Authorization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16838v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16838

**作者：** Huihao Jing、Shaojin Chen、Wenbin Hu、Yuxuan Liu、Haochen Shi、Zhongwei Xie、Haoran Li、Yangqiu Song

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.SE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16838v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16838v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出一个基准，用同一操作在「有无授权」下的对照场景（专家标注情景＋已验证操作＋外部原生策略请求）检验防护栏的判定是否真正依据授权，并按正确性、可用性与实际效果评估，还追踪防护栏改动后的请求迁移。

**相关性简评：** 其「同一输入、不同权限证据」的对照式评测与逐项检查判定是否由证据支撑，可能为 LVR 中「推理是否真正使用视觉/任务必要证据、如何做贡献分配」提供评价思路，但领域相距较远，联系仅供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Same Operation, Different Permission: Evaluating Whether Guardrails Honor Authorization

**abstract/A1：** As language-model agents write code, move money and change records on behalf of users, deciding whether an action is authorized has become a central safety problem. Guardrails are often placed in front of these actions, yet few evaluations ask whether their decisions follow authorization: blocking unauthorized actions while still allowing the same actions under valid permission. We introduce \\bench{}, a benchmark that contrasts authorization evidence for the same operation in its language track. It combines expert-annotated natural-language scenarios with executed and verified operations, plus externally sourced native-policy requests. \\bench{} checks each decision for correctness, usability and resulting effect, and tracks each request across guardrail changes. Our experiments show that many blocked operations stem from failed reviews, not correct denials. Repairing the output format restores usable decisions but changes which authorized requests are honored, and adding a second reviewer removes some errors while rejecting valid authorization. Guardrails should therefore be evaluated on both the unauthorized actions they stop and the authorized actions they let through.

</details>
