### 714. [Few-for-Many Best-Arm Identification in Multi-Objective Bandits](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16840v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16840

**作者：** Bo Xue、Yilu Liu、Haodong Jing、Hongzong Li、Xi Lin、Shuang Qiu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16840v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16840v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究多目标 bandit 中的 few-for-many 最优臂识别：用少量臂最小化相对各目标最优的最坏加权退化，覆盖已知目标组与仅由代表预算指定的隐组，并给出 GFM-Elim、AFM-Elim 的实例相关样本复杂度与下界。

**相关性简评：** 其隐组发现与预算受限的采样分配、停止决策，可能与 LVR 中跨子问题共享观测、按需获取视觉证据及何时停止存在可类比的形式化线索，具体映射尚待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Few-for-Many Best-Arm Identification in Multi-Objective Bandits

**abstract/A1：** Real-world systems often serve many objectives but can deploy only a few options, whose performance must be learned from noisy feedback. Modeling each option as an arm in a multi-objective bandit, we introduce \\emph{few-for-many best-arm identification}, which seeks a small set of arms minimizing the worst weighted degradation from the objective-wise optima, rather than the best arm for every objective. We consider both known objective groups and latent groups specified only by a representative budget, and propose \\textsc{GFM-Elim} and \\textsc{AFM-Elim} with instance-dependent sample-complexity guarantees. For Gaussian rewards, we further derive a lower bound for the latent-group setting and show that it is asymptotically attainable with high probability by an oracle-based Track-and-Stop procedure. Our results show that sharing observations across objectives and ignoring irrelevant objective-wise distinctions can substantially reduce the sampling cost, as confirmed by experiments on synthetic and real-world tasks.

</details>

**内容简述：** 论文研究在下载候选视频之前，用 LLM 依据元数据做预筛，以降低视频分类数据集构建的存储、时间与标注成本；以四位标注者的严格多数投票为参照，将 LLM 预筛与两种关键词启发式基线比较，并通过 LOO 与 AORI 机制评估 LLM 充当虚拟标注者的表现，最后给出成本对比。

**相关性简评：** 「先看廉价元数据、再决定是否付出昂贵获取成本」这一决策结构与 LVR 中成本感知的证据获取和提前停止（LOOK/STOP 的收益-成本权衡）可能相关，可供核查；但该工作面向视频数据集策展，不涉及内部推理状态或 latent 表示，联系属于概念层面的远距离启发。

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Towards Cost-Efficient Video Dataset Construction with Large Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Research on video classification models has witnessed significant growth recently, accompanied by a significant increase in the demand for datasets to train such models. Existing video dataset curation approaches share a common bottleneck: candidate videos must be downloaded before any relevance judgment is made, which results in storage, time and annotation costs. In this work, we present a filtering step, using Large Language Models (LLMs) to pre-screen videos based on their metadata, before actually downloading these videos, thereby saving on these costs. We evaluate the LLMs against a strict human majority vote derived from four independent annotators and validate the reliability of the annotations through inter-annotator agreement analysis (Gwet's AC1). We compare the LLM pre-filter against two no-LLM baselines, namely two keyword heuristics. Via a Leave-One-Rater-Out (LOO) mechanism and an Add-One-Rater-In (AORI), we evaluate the performance of the LLMs as virtual annotators. Finally, we report cost comparisons relative to existing approaches. To ensure reproducability, we made our implementation available on github.

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该研究用时间分辨的表征相似性分析（RSA）比较 8 岁、12 岁儿童与成人 EEG 同 CLIP 及纯视觉模型的对齐程度，并通过残差分析显示两类模型捕获互补的表示结构，语义维度（类别、生命性）随发育增强，低级图像属性对齐始终较弱。

**相关性简评：** 其「RSA 加残差分解」思路可能为核查 VLM 内部状态中语义与低级视觉信息如何互补共存提供分析工具，但该文研究的是人脑发育而非模型推理或 latent 状态生成，联系仅属可核查的推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Vision Models Capture Complementary Representations in Children That Converge in Adults

**abstract/A1：** How the relationship between image-text aligned and vision-only models changes across development remains unknown. We applied time-resolved representational similarity analysis to EEG data from 8-year-olds, 12-year-olds, and adults. CLIP showed significant model-brain alignment already in children, whereas vision-only models aligned more strongly later in development. Residual analyses revealed complementary structure, with CLIP retaining alignment beyond an architecture-matched vision-only model from age 8. Much of the model-brain alignment reflected semantic structure, with EEG representations of category and animacy strengthening toward adulthood, while alignment with low-level image properties remained weak across age. Together, these findings suggest that image-text aligned and vision-only models capture complementary aspects of developing visual representations and may provide useful constraints for AI systems that aim to learn and adapt over time.

### 717. [From Parallel to Sequential: Small-Batch Noise Restores Simplicity Bias of Muon](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16868v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16868

**作者：** Tom Jacobs、Rebekka Burkholz

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16868v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16868v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究为何基于谱下降的 Muon 优化器在全批次下并行学习特征、缺少 simplicity bias，指出小批次随机噪声会平滑谱下降算子、恢复 saddle-to-saddle 式的序列特征学习，并在低秩矩阵重构、ViT 与 LLM 上验证。

**相关性简评：** 其「并行 vs 序列」特征学习与噪声平滑更新算子的分析，可能为理解 latent 推理中并行与自回归式状态更新的差异与切换条件提供类比线索，属远领域推测，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** From Parallel to Sequential: Small-Batch Noise Restores Simplicity Bias of Muon

**abstract/A1：** Simplicity bias, which can arise from sequential feature learning during training, has been proposed as a general explanation for the success of deep learning. An important driver of this phenomenon is saddle-to-saddle behavior, in which the gradient flow trajectory remains close to a sequence of saddle manifolds while learning one feature at a time. However, Muon, a state-of-the-art optimizer based on spectral descent, does not exhibit such dynamics in the full-batch setting and instead learns features in parallel. How is it then that Muon is so successful in deep learning settings? We show that stochastic gradient noise fundamentally changes this behavior: small-batch noise restores sequential feature learning, providing a mechanism for simplicity bias that is absent from full-batch Muon. We explain this transition through stochastic smoothing of the spectral descent operator underlying Muon. When gradients are small relative to the noise scale, the expected spectral update becomes approximately proportional to the actual gradient, which restores gradient-flow-like dynamics. We formalize this mechanism for deep linear models by deriving the effective continuous dynamics of noisy spectral descent. Experiments on low-rank matrix reconstruction, vision transformers, and large language models (LLMs) support these findings.

**comment/C1：** 27 pages, 13 figures

</details>

### 718. [Learning Operators for Symmetry Discovery: From Lie Groups to Local Symmetry Geometry](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16884v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16884

**作者：** Pavan Karjol、Scindhiya Laxmi、Prathosh AP

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16884v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16884v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究能否跨一族函数学习「函数到其对称结构」的映射，将连续对称发现表述为类似逆 PDE 的逆对称算子：用表示系数与无穷小群作用给出对称李代数的零空间刻画，并证明该算子对坐标变换等变；随后用保留解析几何结构、仅学习统计困难部分的混合估计，在全局、非紧与局部对称基准上验证。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接关联，但其「把几何不变结构从有限样本估计中剥离」的算子式刻画、等变性以及沿不变方向的状态语义，可能对 LVR 内部状态如何保持任务必要几何信息提供表示几何层面的启发线索，需人工判断可迁移程度。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning Operators for Symmetry Discovery: From Lie Groups to Local Symmetry Geometry

**abstract/A1：** Continuous symmetry discovery is typically formulated as a separate estimation problem for each function or dataset. We instead investigate whether the map from a function to its symmetry structure can be learned across a family of functions from finite observations. Using the infinitesimal differential characterization of continuous symmetries, we formulate this map as an inverse symmetry operator, analogous to an inverse PDE problem. For global Lie-group symmetries, we establish a representation-theoretic population characterization: the symmetry Lie algebra is the nullspace of a positive-semidefinite operator constructed from representation coefficients and the infinitesimal group action. We also show that the inverse symmetry operator is equivariant under coordinate changes through the adjoint action. This characterization separates the geometric symmetry map from finite-sample estimation, motivating a hybrid approach that amortizes statistically difficult components while retaining analytic structure. On SO(5) benchmarks, amortized equivariant estimation of harmonic coefficients improves symmetry recovery from sparse observations, whereas ordinary least squares suffices for SL(2,R). We extend this viewpoint to local symmetries, where symmetry directions form smoothly varying tangent distributions rather than a fixed Lie algebra. Under the Lie-bracket consistency condition, Frobenius' theorem guarantees local integral submanifolds along which observables remain unchanged. We recover this geometry using a hybrid estimator that learns observation weights while preserving analytic differential and geometric recovery. Across global, non-compact, local, and physically motivated synthetic benchmarks, our results support learning the statistically difficult finite-sample components while preserving the known geometric structure of symmetry recovery.

</details>

### 719. [AI-Assisted Tumor-Growth Law Discovery from Sparse Data: Refitting and LLM-Based Ranking](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16891v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16891

**作者：** Yitian Lu、Weinan Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16891v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16891v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该工作用符号回归、数学可容许性检查、系数重拟合与 LLM 排序，从稀疏含噪的肿瘤生长数据中推断生长律，并分别评估轨迹拟合、预测与真实机制恢复，发现轨迹拟合良好与生长律正确可以并存，LLM 排序未稳定优于按训练误差选择。

**相关性简评：** 其「候选假设排序＋拟合优度与机制正确性分离评价」的思路，可能为 LVR 中多种 latent 假设的筛选、以及答案正确与内部状态是否真正使用视觉证据的区分提供评价参照，需核查其可用性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AI-Assisted Tumor-Growth Law Discovery from Sparse Data: Refitting and LLM-Based Ranking

**abstract/A1：** Inferring tumor-growth laws from sparse, noisy observations requires more than accurate curve fitting. We study an AI-assisted workflow involving symbolic regression, mathematical admissibility checks, coefficient refitting, and large language model (LLM) ranking. Synthetic Gompertz data allow trajectory fit, forecasting, and recovery of the governing growth law to be assessed separately. A dense noiseless control recovers the generating family, but sparse noisy sampling frequently leads to alternative forms. Among retained candidates in the tested configurations, physics-informed neural network refitting often increases growth-law error, whereas classical nonlinear least squares usually reduces it. A separate exploratory analysis of archived LLM rankings shows no consistent improvement over selection by training error and identifies errors in mathematical reasoning. Plausible saturation, accurate trajectory fits, and convincing explanations can therefore coexist with incorrect growth laws. Mathematical validity and law recovery require evaluation alongside predictive performance.

</details>

### 720. [Observe, Share, or Predict? Disentangling Partner Information in Embodied Multi-Agent Collaboration](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16895v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16895

**作者：** Adrián Szlatincsán、Filippo Ziliotto、Bruno Lepri、Luciano Serafini、Massimiliano Luca、Tommaso Campari

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16895v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16895v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 在 Habitat PARTNR 基准上引入严格个体感知的解耦部分可观测设定，把「观察伙伴状态（OAS）」「物体知识交换（KE）」「预测伙伴下一动作（OANA）」三类信息拆开，用四个 planner 在 1000 个验证任务上做 2×2×2 评估。

**相关性简评：** 该文发现显式预测伙伴动作反而在 16 组设定中 15 组降低成功率、协调收益主要来自响应共享状态而非显式预测，这种「显式中间预测未必有用」的负结果与 LVR 中 latent/显式中间步骤是否真正贡献答案、监督与贡献分配的疑问可能同构，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Observe, Share, or Predict? Disentangling Partner Information in Embodied Multi-Agent Collaboration

**abstract/A1：** LLMs are used as high-level controllers for embodied agents, but it remains unclear whether they support collaborative reasoning, such as anticipating a collaborator's actions in real-time teamwork without dialogue. We ask if observing the partner's state, exchanging object knowledge, and predicting the partner's next action, shape task outcomes and coordination when agents can share percepts but never intentions, plans, or task-level messages, and whether the two agents occupy symmetric roles. Using the Habitat-based PARTNR benchmark, we introduce a Decoupled Partial Observability regime that enforces strictly individual perception, and we augment decentralized zero-shot ReAct planners with Other Agent's State (OAS) observation, object Knowledge Exchange (KE) between co-located agents, and Other Agent's Next Action (OANA) prediction, evaluated on the full 2 x 2 x 2 grid with four planners on 1,000 validation tasks. OAS observation improves task quality, reducing extraneous effort for every planner, whereas KE primarily improves execution efficiency, cutting simulation steps by up to 25% with little change in success. The two are largely redundant for strong planners but complementary for the weakest, for which KE without the OAS is the worst configuration. OANA prediction lowers the success rate in 15 of 16 model x context pairs while raising explicit partner mentions to 55-100%, and its accuracy gains lie mainly in the coarse action type, partly because agents recognize the action the partner is already performing. The robot retrieves objects sooner and completes its tasks earlier than the simulated human. Shared context reduces total task time by shortening the remaining duration that the human works alone. Also, coordination benefits arise from responding to shared context, especially the OAS, rather than explicit anticipation, yielding shallow, planner-dependent partner modeling.

</details>

### 721. [Neural Bayesian Networks for Modular and Scalable Decision-Making Under Uncertainty](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16902v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16902

**作者：** Giovanni Briglia、Marco Lippi、Stefano Mariani、Franco Zambonelli

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16902v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16902v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Neural Bayesian Networks（NBN）：在保持贝叶斯网络图结构与分解不变的前提下，把每个条件分布换成可微的、张量化的机制，从而支持任意可学习条件分布与 GPU 原生并行推断，并发布 PyTorch 库和公开基准。

**相关性简评：** 来自概率推理这一较远领域：把条件机制参数化为可微张量、并按批量 query 并行推断的做法，可能启发 LVR 中对 latent 推理状态做模块化因子化表示与不确定性建模，但与本主线尚无直接联系，仅可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Neural Bayesian Networks for Modular and Scalable Decision-Making Under Uncertainty

**abstract/A1：** Bayesian Networks (BNs) are established tools for letting agents reason under uncertainty in sequential decision-making. They split a joint distribution into local conditional mechanisms arranged on a directed acyclic graph, which makes them modular, interpretable, and ready to perform probabilistic inference. Their classical formulation, however, has limitations in both expressiveness and scale: each conditional is usually stored as a table or a linear-Gaussian form, and inference evaluates the graph one node and one query at a time. In this paper we introduce Neural Bayesian Networks (NBNs), in which each conditional is a differentiable, tensor-valued mechanism, while the graph and its factorization are unchanged. NBNs retain the modularity and local mechanisms of BNs, can represent any learnable conditional distribution, and run natively on GPUs. We also release NBN, a PyTorch-based library for learning and inference in NBNs, together with a public benchmark. Our evaluation shows gains in both expressiveness and scale: NBNs fit distributions that classical BN libraries struggle to represent, and on large networks and large batches of queries they run two orders of magnitude faster thanks to GPU parallelization. NBN is available at https://github.com/Giovannibriglia/NeuralBayesianNetworks.

### 722. [Audit tools of the trade: Automated Auditor Elicitation Can Be Sensitive to the Context the Auditor Is Given](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16911v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16911

**作者：** Ben Slater、Ryan Lundqvist、Leo Richter、Kevin Wei

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文用 Petri 工具审计 LLM 编码智能体，在四组审计者-目标模型对与三类行为上，测试向审计 LLM 提供外部代码库或基准 transcript 是否改变其打分，发现显著效果基本只出现在 reward hacking 上，且随场景、资源组合与表述方式大幅波动。

**相关性简评：** 其核心结论「LLM judge 的行为评分对给定上下文与配置决策高度敏感」可能可供核查 LVR 研究中使用 LLM 评判 latent 推理内容使用、证据选择或答案质量时的稳健性与可复现性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Audit tools of the trade: Automated Auditor Elicitation Can Be Sensitive to the Context the Auditor Is Given

**abstract/A1：** Does providing additional context to automated AI auditors improve their effectiveness? Using the Petri tool to audit LLM coding agents, we test the impact of providing two types of resources (an external codebase and benchmark transcripts) to LLM auditors, across four auditor-target LLM pairs and three behaviours (harmful compliance, reward hacking, sycophancy). (1) External codebase: We provide the auditor LLM with a fixed, external open source codebase, which prior work finds improves the realism of synthetic audits. Providing this resource suppresses reward hacking in both auditor-target pairs whose baseline rate is above the floor (4.8 to 1.3 and 3.9 to 1.8 on Petri's default 1-10 scale); the remaining two pairs sit at the floor throughout. The suppression recurs in three of four pairs under a different scenario and resource bundle. (2) External benchmark transcripts: We provide the auditor with transcripts of the target's performance on benchmarks measuring similar behaviours, intended to inform the auditor about the target's behavioural patterns. Providing this resource raises reward hacking scores in all four pairs (from 1.7 to 6.1 in one case). However, subsequent experiments show that supplying only the related benchmark's abstract, without transcripts, also increases reward hacking, and the effect is absent under a different framing of the same behaviour. Overall, we find no consistent effect of either resource outside reward hacking, but we find substantial variability in judge-scored behaviour across conditions. Our results underscore the importance of careful piloting with tools such as Petri, as the measured rate of target behaviour is highly sensitive to configuration decisions. We hope our results inspire more research into the reliability and robustness of automated alignment auditing.

### 723. [KNN Implementation Details Can Dramatically Change Performance: An Example from Cover Trees](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16940v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16940

**作者：** Amol Khanna、Edward Raff

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.IR

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16940v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16940v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文以 Cover Tree 为例，用统一的 Rust 实现 RustKNN 检验三种构建变体与三种查询模式下的实现细节，发现查询策略、base 参数默认值、微优化以及基准设置都会显著改变近邻搜索的运行时间与算法排名结论。

**相关性简评：** 近邻检索是视觉证据筛选与检索式推理流程中的底层操作，该文关于查询模式随 k 和数据规模反转成本结论、默认超参不安全的发现，可能供核查 LVR 中证据检索的成本-精度权衡，以及比较 latent 推理方法时对实现细节与基准设置的控制。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** KNN Implementation Details Can Dramatically Change Performance: An Example from Cover Trees

**abstract/A1：** Nearest neighbor search algorithms are widely used and have a long history, but we find that key implementation details are seldom reviewed in articles about them. These details can materially impact performance, and thus change the conclusions one makes about a given algorithm's superiority. In this article, we highlight these impacts by reviewing the Cover Tree as an example, producing RustKNN, a unified Rust implementation of three construction variants of the Cover Tree with three query modes. Our analysis reveals: (1) the optimal query strategy depends on $k$ and on the dataset (single-tree search is fastest at $k{=}1$ on three of our four largest datasets, while dual-tree search is fastest at $k{\\ge}5$ on the three largest), and choosing the wrong query mode can cost up to a $7.5\\times$ factor in runtime; (2) the cover tree base parameter, set to 2 in theory and 1.3 in practice, is not a safe default for dual-tree search: 1.3 is optimal on only one of seven datasets, and on covtype it is $1.6\\times$ slower than the optimum; (3) among five micro-optimizations, only early-exit distance computation has a consistent effect, and that effect grows with dimension (none at $d{=}32$, $1.31\\times$ at $d{=}54$, and $1.49\\times$ at $d{=}784$); and (4) all-nearest-neighbor and held-out benchmarks yield different implementation rankings. All main timing tables report medians over 20 independent allocations with bootstrap 95% confidence intervals. RustKNN is open source at https://github.com/CrowdStrike/RustKNN.

### 724. [Learning to Design Convex Relaxations for Nonconvex Optimization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16948v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16948

**作者：** Jinrun Liu、Bai Yan、Tengfei Liu、Qunfeng Liu、Jian Yang、Shi Cheng、Yuhui Shi、Qi Zhao

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.MS

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16948v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16948v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 AutoConvexRelax，把非凸问题的符号形式化表示为「变量—符号项—目标/约束位置」的三部图，学习一个把符号重写组合成问题特定松弛轨迹的策略，并证明所生成有限动作序列在若干一致性条件下保持松弛有效性、给出误差界与全局最优认证条件。

**相关性简评：** 其「在演变中的符号状态上逐步施加变换、并为每步变换给出显式有效性条件」的设定，可能为 LVR 的 latent 轨迹生成与逐步监督/验证设计提供类比线索（如状态抽象、轨迹合法性论证、形式化增长与收益的权衡），但领域距离较远，是否可迁移需人工核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning to Design Convex Relaxations for Nonconvex Optimization

**abstract/A1：** Convex relaxations make nonconvex optimization tractable by replacing hard nonconvex problems with convex surrogates that give valid bounds. Yet their design is still largely manual: a human expert must decide where to relax, which relaxation to use, and how much formulation growth is worth paying. We show that this design process can be learned. The method proposed in this paper, AutoConvexRelax, represents the symbolic formulation of a nonconvex problem as a tripartite graph linking variables, symbolic terms, and their objective or constraint positions. It then learns a policy that composes symbolic rewrites into problem-specific relaxation trajectories as the formulation evolves. We prove that finite action sequences generated by the learned policy preserve relaxation validity under explicit domain, occurrence-context, and representation-consistency conditions. We further establish computable error bounds for mixed relaxations and sufficient conditions for feasible recovery and global-optimality certification. As a first instantiation, we apply the method to nonconvex quadratic problems and fractional problems. On 241 benchmark quadratic instances, the learned policy strengthens McCormick lower bounds by 13.52%. Its mean lower bound is 3.70% below strengthened semidefinite relaxations on the normalized comparison metric, while it uses substantially smaller formulations. The learned policy retains this trade-off on fractional instances and reaches near-semidefinite bounds on beamforming and sensor-network localization instances. These results suggest that convex relaxation design can move from a fixed handcrafted choice to an automated learning process that adapts to problem structures. Code is available at https://github.com/auto4opt/AutoConvexRelax.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出「Proactive Physical AI」设定：系统持续观察不断变化的物理世界，自主判断是否需要以及何时介入，并构建端到端系统 ProAgent（Jev 式流式时机模型 StreamingJev 加响应模型），配套把视频自动转成介入时机监督的数据管线，在真实机器人上验证介入时机与误触发表现。

**相关性简评：** 其流式「是否/何时介入」的时机判定与视频自动构造监督，可能与 LVR 的 STOP 决策和过程监督同构，可供核查该 timing 模型能否迁移为 latent 推理的停止判据；但属机器人主动感知场景，与多模态推理主线距离较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Proactive Physical AI through Continuous Observation and Timely Intervention

**abstract/A1：** Physical AI is commonly formulated around an explicitly specified task: given a goal or instruction, a system perceives, reasons, and acts. In many real-world settings, however, important tasks emerge from continuously changing world states before a person explicitly formulates them. We study this complementary problem as Proactive Physical AI, where an AI system continuously observes the physical world, identifies situations that warrant intervention, and initiates appropriate actions at the right time. We develop ProAgent, an end-to-end system built around two components: a Jev-style proactive timing model (dubbed StreamingJev) that determines whether and when intervention is needed, and a Response Model that generates responses for people or invokes available device capabilities for physical execution. To support learning at scale, we develop an automated data pipeline that converts videos into supervision for proactive timing. Experiments demonstrate strong proactive performance under both explicit objectives and standing roles, combining more accurate intervention timing with fewer false triggers than the source-backbone baseline. Real-robot evaluations further demonstrate ProAgent's ability to identify emerging needs and translate them into appropriate physical actions.

**comment/C1：** 33 pages, 5 figures, including appendices

</details>

### 726. [Constant-Depth Rational-Weight GNNs and their Connection to Schanuel's Conjecture](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16993v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16993

**作者：** Daumantas Kojelis、Carsten Lutz

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.LO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16993v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16993v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文追问常数深度 GNN 能否在仅用有理数（甚至整数）权重时达到 1-WL 的表达能力，证明在 Schanuel 猜想成立时可行，并给出部分逆定理与实验验证。

**相关性简评：** 其「固定深度下的表达能力上界/下界」与跨图规模一致性的形式化工具，可能为 LVR 中 latent 迭代步数与可达推理能力的对应、以及长度或规模泛化的理论刻画提供可核查的论证范式，但领域距离较远。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Constant-Depth Rational-Weight GNNs and their Connection to Schanuel's Conjecture

**abstract/A1：** A landmark result states that the expressive power of graph neural networks (GNNs) is bounded from above by the 1-dimensional Weisfeiler-Leman (1-WL) test. We ask whether a constant-depth GNN can match the expressive power of 1-WL while using only rational weights. We prove that this is the case when Schanuel's conjecture, a famous open problem from transcendental number theory, is taken to be true. Our GNN construction works even with integer weights, and more generally with a broad range of rational weights. As the activation function, it may use logistic sigmoid, hyperbolic tangent, or related functions. It is uniform across all graph sizes. We also prove a partial converse: if a GNN with exponentiation, hyperbolic sine or hyperbolic cosine as activation matches the expressive power of the 1-WL test in a slightly more expressive setting where graphs may contain certain auxiliary vertices, then this implies Schanuel's conjecture restricted to the numbers that arise in computations of the GNN. We also conduct experiments showing that the constructed GNNs indeed match the 1-WL test.

</details>

### 727. [Intrinsic Geometry Matching: learning observation-equivariant process geometry](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16995v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.16995

**作者：** Manuel Lecha、Michael Bronstein、Iolo Jones

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、math.DG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16995v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.16995v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Intrinsic Geometry Matching（IGM），利用数据自带的自然扰动（如时间序列的步进）学习过程本身的 carré du champ 算子，从而在观测变换下等变地恢复未被观测扭曲的内在扩散几何，并在分子动力学、图像与视频数据上验证其性能与扩展性。

**相关性简评：** 其「观测等变地学习内在几何」的思路，可能与 LVR 中 latent 状态如何在观测扰动下保留任务必要几何信息、以及表示几何的评价方式相通，可供核查；但原文面向几何学习与动力系统，未涉及多模态推理或 latent 推理轨迹，联系属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Intrinsic Geometry Matching: learning observation-equivariant process geometry

**abstract/A1：** Real data are often arbitrary, indirect observations of an unknown underlying process, and those observations can distort its geometry. Existing geometric methods equip data with the induced geometry of the ambient space, but this entangles the true geometry of the process with the distortion of the observation. To address this, we introduce Intrinsic Geometry Matching (IGM): a scalable approach to learn the intrinsic geometry of the underlying process. Specifically, we learn the carré du champ operator of the process, allowing us to recover its diffusion geometry. Our method uses the fact that data often come with natural perturbations, like steps in a time series, to recover the intrinsic carré du champ while transforming naturally with changes in observation: it is observation-equivariant. Furthermore, since this equivariance relates the geometry of different spaces, we can train a model using additional sources of data, even when that data lies in another space. We evaluate IGM on molecular dynamics, image, and video data and find better performance and scaling than existing neural and graph-based geometric tools.

</details>

### 728. [ProbabilityBench: Model Evaluation and Calibration with Exact Ground-Truth Uncertainty](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17016v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17016

**作者：** Yuyang Dai、Yuting Tang、Futoshi Futami、Takashi Ishida

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17016v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17016v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ProbabilityBench，在同行评审、隐蔽信息传递、信用风险三个模拟文本域中提供精确的实例级类别概率与 Bayes 误差，并据此评测 16 个模型的概率报告质量以及常用校准指标、Bayes 误差估计器本身的准确性。

**相关性简评：** 其「已知真值不确定性 + 校准度量元评估」的思路可能为 LVR 中基于置信度的停止决策（STOP）与推理预算分配提供评价线索，但材料完全基于文本与静态概率，未涉及视觉或多模态 latent 状态，可迁移性仍需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ProbabilityBench: Model Evaluation and Calibration with Exact Ground-Truth Uncertainty

**abstract/A1：** Evaluating model uncertainty on real-world data is challenging because each instance provides only a single observed label, leaving true conditional class probabilities unknown. To address this, we introduce ProbabilityBench, a benchmark that provides exact, instance-level class probabilities across three simulated text-based domains: peer review, covert information transfer, and credit risk. By explicitly defining the full data-generating process for each environment, we analytically compute both exact class probabilities and Bayes error. Furthermore, we provide a theoretical guarantee that rendering these cases into natural-language memos strictly preserves their underlying generative probabilities. This exactness enables direct measurement of reported probability quality via KL divergence. Across 16 evaluated models, most models on the observed cost-quality Pareto frontiers are decision models, including Jev and Perplexity Decider. Finally, ProbabilityBench serves as a meta-evaluation framework, leveraging known ground-truth values to benchmark the accuracy of standard calibration metrics and Bayes-error estimators themselves.

</details>

### 729. [LLM Evaluation is a Forecasting Problem](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17018v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17018

**作者：** Rahul Thomas、Adam Block、Micah Goldblum

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17018v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17018v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文指出网络文本分布随时间是高度非平稳的，模型在各基准上的表现也随时间连续变化，因此未来性能更适合用近期评测数据以及历史性能上的时间序列预测器来预测，并据此选择部署模型以提升实际下游准确率。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接关联，但其把「时间」作为评测基本变量、强调分布漂移下用预测而非历史成绩做模型选型的思路，可能可供核查 latent reasoning 模型在基准时序漂移下的评测与选择问题。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LLM Evaluation is a Forecasting Problem

**abstract/A1：** Standard procedure in machine learning is to randomly split train and test data, emulating IID draws from one underlying data distribution. In practice, models are trained on past data and deployed in the future, which may come from distinct distributions. In this paper, we find that web text is indeed highly non-stationary, as text distributions shift over time. We further observe that model performance changes continuously over time across diverse benchmarks. Consequently, future model performance is better predicted by measurements made on recent evaluation data, and is best predicted by time series forecasters applied to historic performance rather than by historic performance itself. Choosing which model to deploy based on forecasted accuracy enables more reliable selection of performant models, thus improving downstream accuracy in the regime practitioners care about: deployment. Taken together, our experiments suggest that time should be treated as a fundamental variable in LLM evaluation. We release our code and data.

</details>

### 730. [Benchmarking Quantum Kernel SVMs for Credit Card Fraud Detection: Performance Realities Under NISQ Constraints](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17027v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17027

**作者：** Hitanshi Arora、Mohit Swarnkar、Aswani Kumar Cherukuri

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17027v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17027v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在高度类别不平衡的信用卡欺诈检测任务上，对 Angle、ZZFeatureMap、IQP 三种量子编码的量子核 SVM 与严格对齐样本量、特征数的经典基线做受控基准比较，并将 SMOTE 直接嵌入量子 Gram 矩阵流程，最后在真实量子硬件上测试噪声与门错误带来的性能下降。

**相关性简评：** 量子核 Gram 矩阵实质是在高维嵌入空间中对样本做相似性度量，论文指出把特征压缩到小量子寄存器会带来严重信息损失，这一「编码方式决定相似性几何、压缩导致信息坍缩」的观察可能与 LVR 中 latent 表示相似度的内容依赖与压缩代价分析形成类比，可供核查；但其任务与视觉多模态推理无直接联系，迁移属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Benchmarking Quantum Kernel SVMs for Credit Card Fraud Detection: Performance Realities Under NISQ Constraints

**abstract/A1：** Detecting credit card fraud is notoriously difficult because fraudulent charges make up less than 0.2% of total transactions. Quantum Machine Learning (QML), particularly Quantum Kernel Support Vector Machines (QSVM), promises richer feature representations by embedding classical data into high-dimensional Hilbert spaces. However, whether this theoretical advantage holds up when managing real-world financial data bottlenecks remains unclear. We designed a controlled benchmark comparing three quantum encodings, Angle, ZZFeatureMap, and IQP against classical models while keeping sample sizes, feature counts, and scaling strictly matched. To handle class skew without corrupting quantum state overlaps, we embedded synthetic minority oversampling (SMOTE) directly into the quantum Gram matrix workflow, raising PR-AUC scores by roughly +0.04 across feature maps. When trained on the full European credit card dataset with 30 features, classical baselines reached a top PR-AUC of 0.983. However, restricting classical models to match QSVM hardware constraints (500 samples, 4 PCA features) dropped their PR-AUC to 0.750. This puts our best quantum result 0.730 PR-AUC using IQP encoding on 150 samples into realistic context. Testing on physical quantum hardware reduced performance further to 0.62 due to CNOT gate errors and thermal noise. Overall, our findings pinpoint two main operational bottlenecks for near-term quantum kernels: the scaling of Gram matrix evaluation and heavy information loss from squeezing features onto small qubit registers.

</details>

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 SPLICE，用凸优化从无机制标签的混合轨迹中推断各候选神经算子的贡献，再以校准检验为发现的算子指派其所实现的机制，从而零样本组合模拟新方程，并可在冻结库上无标签、无遗忘地扩展新机制。

**相关性简评：** 其无标签推断多个模块对状态的贡献、以及在库缺少所需机制或机制不可分时检测失败，可能为 LVR 的 latent 贡献分配、证据/机制缺失识别与停止决策提供跨领域启发，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SPLICE: Sparse Physics Library Identification and Compositional Expansion

**abstract/A1：** Neural operator splitting composes a library of neural operators, one per physical mechanism, into zero-shot simulators of new equations. Existing approaches, however, require these mechanisms and their labels to be specified in advance. We ask whether a pretrained library can instead be adapted and grown from unlabeled trajectories in which multiple mechanisms act simultaneously. We introduce SPLICE, a framework that discovers operators without mechanism labels on mixture data. The contributions of the candidate operators to each trajectory are inferred by solving a convex optimization problem. A calibrated test then assigns each discovered operator the mechanism it implements. Failure cases are also detectable, when the library lacks the required physics or when mechanisms are insufficiently separable. Across one and two dimensional systems, the discovered operators recover mechanisms from unlabeled mixtures and compose into zero-shot simulators of unseen equations; a frozen library can also grow an operator for physics absent from pretraining, without labels and without forgetting. On Navier-Stokes, the discovered operators compose about as accurately as their supervised counterparts.

**comment/C1：** 24 pages, 6 figures

</details>

**作者：** Guillermo Terrén-Serrano、Michael Ludkovski

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出一种非参数方法，将日前预测与当日已实现的局部曲线，通过基于相似性度量的加权近邻检索补全为完整轨迹，从而给出可再生能源日内概率预测，并用泛函深度构造预测带、以 PIT 校准调参，在合成与真实风电数据上验证校准效果。

**相关性简评：** 其「局部观测 + 先验预测 → 检索相似完整轨迹并按权重融合成完整假设」的思路，可能为 LVR 中部分视觉证据下的 latent 假设筛选与融合、以及预测分布校准评价提供概念类比，但领域相距较远，需核查相似性度量与融合权重的设计是否有可迁移之处。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Nearest Neighbor Functional Curve Completion for Intraday Probabilistic Revisions of Renewable Generation Forecasts

**abstract/A1：** We propose a nonparametric approach that fuses deterministic initial forecasts and a partial realization into a probabilistic forecast using the framework of functional curve completion. Our motivation is to construct intra-day forecasts for renewable energy generation, which is a key operational task in modern power grids. The aim is to combine the day-ahead (DA) forecast and the morning realized generation profile to create trajectories for the rest of the day, quantifying operational uncertainty. Starting with a large database of complete forecast-actual pairs across many assets, we adopt a functional point of view and construct a weighted neighborhood based on similarity metrics for the observed partial curve, the DA forecast, the day, and the geographical location. The selected complete nearest-neighbor curves provide a full predictive distribution, including functional focal envelopes and predictive bands based on functional depth. The hyperparameters governing neighborhood size, distances, and fusion rates are tuned across forecast update times and directly target probabilistic calibration in terms of the predictive probability integral transform. Three case studies using synthetic wind and solar assets, as well as real-life regional wind generation, showcase that our algorithm is able to achieve excellent calibration.

</details>

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 DiaryBridge，将家庭出行日记整体 token 化为变长序列（含车辆/成员/行程计数 token 与 padded、hidden、unobserved、inapplicable 等区分符号），用掩码扩散模型以任意顺序解掩，单模型即可在给定任意观测子集时同时做合成与部分补全，并在巴尔的摩真实调查数据上优于学习基线。

**相关性简评：** 其「区分 hidden/unobserved 位置并以任意顺序逐步解掩」的掩码扩散机制，可能与 LVR 中 latent 状态更新顺序、被遮挡或缺失视觉证据的表示处理及部分观测下的条件生成有概念性联系，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Masked Diffusion for Travel Diaries Synthesis

**abstract/A1：** Because household travel surveys combine household characteristics, variable-length person rosters, vehicle rosters, and trip chains, existing synthesis pipelines split them across separate models or flatten them into cropped fixed-length vectors. Representation, rather than modeling, becomes the bottleneck: splitting severs cross-segment dependence, and cropping truncates the household-structure distribution. We instead tokenize the diary and keep the object whole: each household-day becomes one token sequence with count tokens for vehicles, persons, and trips, and distinct symbols for padded, hidden, unobserved, and inapplicable positions. We introduce DiaryBridge, a masked diffusion model that bridges the fully hidden sequence to the distribution of complete diaries by unmasking positions in any order. One trained model, conditioned on any observed subset, performs synthesis and partial-diary completion alike. Experiments on real data extracted from the 2017/2018 Regional Travel Survey of the Baltimore region show that DiaryBridge generates travel reflecting vehicle availability and employment status, recovers shared trips using other household members' observed diaries, and better reproduces aggregate demand across modes, purposes, and departure periods than the learned baselines.

</details>

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 OpenDGO：覆盖六个真实领域、三种协作设定（顺序依赖、并行分解、信息集成）的多智能体组织基准，在任务、智能体、工具和资源预算匹配的条件下比较固定与学习到的组织结构，并拆分考察通信图、角色分配、输入分配和组件故障的影响。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉推理主线无直接关联，但其「没有通用组织」的结论与对结构、资源预算、组件故障的分解式评测，可能为 LVR 中推理结构选择、贡献分配与实际成本的评价提供类比线索，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** OpenDGO: Benchmarking Multi-Agent Organizations Across Diverse Application Domains

**abstract/A1：** Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems are increasingly applied across diverse domains, yet different applications require different forms of agent organization. Existing studies typically adopt predefined organizations, such as Star, Chain, and Tree, or learn communication graphs to improve performance on specific tasks. However, these methods are largely designed and evaluated within a limited set of application domains, providing little understanding of whether an organization effective in one domain remains suitable for others with different collaboration requirements. We present \\textbf{OpenDGO}, a controlled benchmark and analysis framework covering six real-world domains and three collaboration settings: Sequential Dependency, Parallel Decomposition, and Information Integration. Under matched tasks, agents, tools, and resource limits, OpenDGO compares fixed and learned organizations while separately examining communication graphs, role assignments, input assignments, resource budgets, and component failures. Our results show that there is no \`\`one-organization-for-all'' solution: preferred organizations vary across applications, and even the same communication graph can yield different outcomes under different role and input assignments. These findings highlight the need for application-dependent organization design, aiming to understand \\emph{which organization is suitable for a given application, under what conditions, and why}.

</details>

### 735. [The Format is the Filter: Scoring Format Fixes What an LLM Judge Can Express](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17158v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17158

**作者：** Lovedeep Gondara、Jekaterina Novikova、Sagarika Suresh、Jack Ji、Jithin Pradeep

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL、cs.SE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17158v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17158v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文固定候选池、判官提示与解码预算，用三种 LLM judge、五种打分格式（二值、1–5、0–100、比较）为 15,406 条 UltraFeedback 数据打分，微调 66 个模型并评测，发现格式几乎独立地决定可用判别层级与并列比例，并提出四项应报告的量。

**相关性简评：** 该文讨论打分「格式」本身限定了判官可表达的信息、导致大量并列只能随机取舍，并揭示排序指标会掩盖这一点；这可能为 LVR 中奖励／验证信号的设计与评估（格式约束下的判别力与随机选择）提供可核查的类比线索，但本身不涉及 latent 推理状态。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** The Format is the Filter: Scoring Format Fixes What an LLM Judge Can Express

**abstract/A1：** When an LLM judge filters instruction-tuning data, its scoring format (binary verdict, 1--5 rating, 0--100 score, or comparison) is rarely justified or ablated. Holding the candidate pool, judge prompt, decoding and selection budget fixed, we score 15,406 UltraFeedback candidates under five formats with three judges, curate, fine-tune 66 models, and evaluate them with four judges. A 0--100 scale is worth only 7--12 equally used levels, two to three times a 1--5 scale rather than twenty, and a binary verdict leaves the top score tied in 77--78\\% of prompts, so most selections are made at random. These properties are set by the format almost independently of the judge. Kendall's $τ\_b$ hides them: it ranks binary best while $τ\_a$ and top-1 agreement rank it last, because it discounts the ties a selector must break at random. Both comparative formats inherit a slot bias whose sign differs across judges. Downstream, curated data beat random selection under every evaluation judge, robust to length and markdown adjustment, but no ordering among formats is detectable. We propose four quantities that judge-based curation pipelines should report.

</details>

### 736. [Learning Perceptual Geometry of Natural Odor Mixtures from LLM-Derived Descriptors](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17164v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17164

**作者：** Farhad Pashakhanloo、Venkatesh N. Murthy

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL、q-bio.NC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17164v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17164v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文以 1,200 余种食物挥发物混合物为数据，用 LLM 生成混合物级感知描述作监督，预测留出混合物的感知相似度，并学习低秩分子嵌入。

**相关性简评：** 其「语言派生描述作可扩展监督、并检验低秩嵌入几何与人类描述空间对齐」的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的监督方式与表示几何评价提供类比线索，迁移价值需人工核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning Perceptual Geometry of Natural Odor Mixtures from LLM-Derived Descriptors

**abstract/A1：** The relationship between odor chemistry and perception remains incompletely understood. Many existing studies focus on the perception of single molecules, whereas natural odors contain tens to hundreds of components, adding extra layer of complexity to percept formation. Here, we explore the relationship between molecular composition and perceived similarity in natural odor objects. We study this using a database of more than 1,200 volatile-compound-in-food mixtures containing more than 8,000 molecular components, and use large language models (LLMs) as a scalable surrogate for deriving mixture-level perceptual descriptions. We find that language-derived representations provide useful supervision for predicting held-out mixture similarities from molecular composition. The prediction was consistently strongest when perceptual targets were derived from chemosensory prompts than from other sensory prompts. Further, during the mixture-level training, we learned low-rank molecular embeddings that enabled better prediction of held-out mixture similarities than component-overlap metrics, even for mixture pairs with no shared molecules. Although no single-molecule labels were used during training, the learned molecular geometry showed significant alignment with the independent human odor-descriptor space. Finally, we explored the use of external molecular features in our mixture-similarity prediction task. These features showed modest zero-shot alignment with mixture-level perceptual similarity. They improved prediction under limited supervision but offered little additional predictive benefit with the full training set. Together, these results show that language-derived descriptions can provide scalable supervision for predicting the perceptual organization of complex natural mixtures, contributing to a quantitative understanding of how molecular composition gives rise to odor perception.

**comment/C1：** 26 pages, 14 figures

</details>

### 737. [Size Generalization for Diffusion Routing Solvers](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17192v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17192

**作者：** Barak Itzchak Davidovitch、Eli Meirom、Ethan Fetaya、Gal Chechik

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17192v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17192v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ResizeCO：用强化学习（GRPO，以路径长度为信号）在大规模实例上微调只在小子规模实例上训练的扩散式路径求解器，并把 k-opt 建模为树搜索在 GPU 上做 beam search，从而在 TSP/CVRP 上实现规模泛化。

**相关性简评：** 任务领域较远，但其「训练分布外的规模/长度泛化 + 用任务指标做 RL 适配 + beam search 式验证」与 LVR 中长度泛化、latent 状态更新的监督信号及质量—时间 Pareto 评价可能有可供核查的类比线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Size Generalization for Diffusion Routing Solvers

**abstract/A1：** Routing problems, like the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) and the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP), are NP-hard and slow to solve for large instances. Diffusion-based solvers can be trained in a supervised way using sets of optimal solutions, and then quickly solve new test instances. However, for large instances, optimal solutions are hard to find, and diffusion models fail to generalize to instance sizes outside their training distribution. Here we describe ResizeCO, a label free size-generalization approach that addresses both the change in statistical properties of larger instances, and the computational challenge of solving them quickly. It uses reinforcement learning on large-scale instances to adapt a diffusion model trained on small instances. Specifically, we adapt GRPO to this problem, using route length as the training signal. ResizeCO also formulates k-opt as a tree search, solved by a beam search on the GPU. In size-generalization experiments on TSP and CVRP instances with up to 10000 nodes, ResizeCO achieves a Pareto front over route quality and time that dominates learned solvers, and also outperforms other solvers at short run times, setting a new state of the art.

</details>

### 738. [Compute-optimal data scaling for neural surrogates via multi-fidelity training](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17221v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17221

**作者：** Paul Setinek、Fabian Paischer、Nils Thuerey、Johannes Brandstetter、Felix Koehler

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17221v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17221v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把 PDE 神经代理的训练建模为「数据量×保真度」的联合优化，在固定数据生成算力预算下混用低保真模拟作为额外训练信号，跨六个 PDE 问题、四类架构验证其可达 Pareto 最优误差 scaling，节省最多 6.3× 生成算力。

**相关性简评：** 将保真度视为离散谱、按算力预算做 Pareto 分配的问题表述，可能与 LVR 中「推理步数与视觉证据粒度／分辨率之间的算力分配」有概念联系，可供核查其预算分配框架能否迁移到 THINK/LOOK 的成本权衡。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Compute-optimal data scaling for neural surrogates via multi-fidelity training

**abstract/A1：** Neural surrogates for Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) are usually trained on synthetic data from numerical simulators. As models grow and scaling laws demand larger datasets, the cost of data generation often outweighs the training cost and becomes the bottleneck in the scaling quest. Unlike data in other domains, however, each PDE sample has a tunable cost that depends on its numerical fidelity, with the resulting cost-accuracy trade-off governed by known convergence rates. We exploit this property by formalizing neural surrogate training as a function of both data quantity and fidelity under a fixed data generation compute budget, treating fidelity as a fine-grained discrete spectrum rather than a binary distinction. Building on this, we show that multi-fidelity training enables Pareto-optimal error scaling against data generation compute. By using simulations at lower fidelities as an additional training signal, training on the optimal fidelity mixture matches the accuracy of high-fidelity-only training, with up to $6.3\\times$ less data generation compute across our settings. We validate these findings across six PDE problems spanning structured grids and unstructured meshes, two distinct error sources (discretization and iterative-solver error), and four surrogate architectures, totaling over 7,000 training runs.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://psetinek.github.io/multi-fidelity-neural-surrogates/ Code: https://github.com/psetinek/multi-fidelity-neural-surrogates

</details>

### 739. [AReA: Adaptive Receptive-Field Attention for Efficient High-Resolution Diffusion Transformers](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17227v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17227

**作者：** Javad Rajabi、Koorosh Roohi、David B. Lindell、Babak Taati

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17227v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17227v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文针对 Diffusion Transformer 超出训练分辨率时 token 激增与结构失真问题，观察到去噪过程中注意力有效感受野由全局逐渐收窄，提出免训练的 AReA：早期对下采样键值做跨尺度粗注意力，后期在收缩窗口内做局部注意力，在多种分辨率与模型上更快更省。

**相关性简评：** 属于图像生成领域，但「随生成进程由粗到细收缩注意力范围」的观察与调度，可能为 LVR 中动态计算预算分配、视觉证据筛选与「何时看多细」的决策提供类比线索，需人工核查其可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AReA: Adaptive Receptive-Field Attention for Efficient High-Resolution Diffusion Transformers

**abstract/A1：** Generating images beyond the training resolution of Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) remains challenging, as the number of tokens grows rapidly with resolution, full attention becomes expensive, and outputs often suffer from structural distortions and degraded detail. We identify uniform full attention as the common source of both problems. Attending to all tokens at every step causes quadratic cost and exposes the model to more tokens and relative distances beyond the training range, pushing the model out of distribution. We observe that attention's effective receptive field narrows during denoising, from global in early steps that form structure to local in later steps that refine details. We propose AReA, a training-free attention mechanism whose receptive field evolves from coarse to fine, following the denoising progression. In early steps, AReA applies cross-scale coarse attention over downsampled keys and values, capturing global context, while in later steps it applies local attention within progressively shrinking windows. Without additional parameters or training, experiments show that AReA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art training-free baselines across target resolutions and different models, while also being faster and more efficient.

**comment/C1：** 27 pages, 14 figures. Project page: https://rajabi2001.github.io/area/

</details>

**相关性简评：** 其反事实干预与 agent trace、harness 对比可能为 LVR 中验证行为、证据获取与停止决策的评价提供线索，但研究对象是编码代理的物理重建，与 latent 推理状态生成和使用无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** PhysCodeGym: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Physically Verifiable 4D Reconstruction

**abstract/A1：** Building physical simulations from video requires coding agents to translate observations into executable models and refine them through tool use. We introduce PhysCodeGym, a benchmark for physically verifiable 4D reconstruction with $156$ tasks covering rigid-body, liquid, deformable, and wind-driven motion. Agents autonomously inspect videos, write and run Blender programs, and revise their scenes using simulation feedback. Six metrics combine rule-based measurements with rubric-based judgments to assess visual and physical reconstruction quality. Program inspection, scene measurements, and counterfactual interventions test physical consistency under original and modified conditions. Experiments with frontier coding agents reveal a tradeoff between artifact quality and completion across reasoning-effort settings, while harness comparisons and agent traces link verification behavior with reconstruction performance. Case studies show that matching visible objects and events can coexist with physical defects. Counterfactual tests further expose latent contact and support failures in reconstructions that pass ordinary physical checks, highlighting the gap between reproducing observations and building reliable physical models. Code is available at https://github.com/ShaoShuai0605/PhysCodeGym.

</details>

### 741. [Beyond Successful Play: Diagnosing Opponent Modeling in Large Language Models](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17310v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17310

**作者：** Hanbo Xie、Yue Zhao、Robert C. Wilson

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、q-bio.NC

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17310v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17310v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出重复捉迷藏基准与诊断框架，通过实时交互、固定历史评估和受控信息干预，区分 LLM 智能体的适应性行为、对手动作预测与对递归信念的跟踪，并用监督微调与信息有无条件测试小模型和前沿模型的预测与决策表现。

**相关性简评：** 该文属多智能体心智理论与信念状态研究，其「表现提升≠信念跟踪」的区分、以及提供或隐去对手信念/类型的干预设计，可能为 LVR 中判断 latent 状态是否被真正利用、区分行为捷径与内部状态推理提供问题表述与评价线索，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Successful Play: Diagnosing Opponent Modeling in Large Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Language-model agents are expected to adapt to others whose behavior changes through interaction. Yet adaptation may rely on learned behavioral patterns rather than theory of mind (ToM): the ability to infer others' mental states, including beliefs and intentions. We introduce a benchmark and diagnostic framework for repeated hide-and-seek against algorithmic opponents with explicitly defined recursive belief updates. Their ground-truth beliefs and action probabilities let us distinguish adaptive play, action prediction, and belief tracking through live interaction, fixed-history evaluation, and controlled information interventions. With structured elicitation and behavioral supervised fine-tuning (SFT), we find improved play in several tested settings, but diagnostics reveal limitations in opponent prediction and belief tracking. We test whether supervising opponent action probabilities can address this predictive deficit in Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. Predictions improve when the model is told the opponent's type and parameter settings, but become less accurate when it must infer the opponent from history without this information. Training on examples that also omit these details reduces the gap, although improvements vary across opponents. Is this limitation specific to smaller open-weight models, or does it also appear in a frontier model? GPT-5.4 also benefits from correct opponent beliefs: supplying them improves its predictions and choices, whereas deeper explicit belief reports and self-generated memory do not consistently improve forecasting from interaction history. This contrast suggests that using useful belief information is easier than inferring it autonomously, even for a frontier model. Together, our findings distinguish improved play and action prediction from reliable belief tracking, providing a framework for evaluating mentalizing and testing targeted improvements.

</details>

### 742. [A Geometrical Approach to Constructing Neural Networks for Perfect Training-set Classification](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17312v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17312

**作者：** Akos Hajnal

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17312v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17312v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文提出一种几何构造法：通过分析输入数据生成分离超平面，构建含两层隐藏层（类间分离层与线性可分变换层）的神经网络，并以斜决策树的叶节点直接对应神经元，在 MNIST 上实现训练集完美分类且模型紧凑。

**相关性简评：** 其超平面分离与斜决策树叶节点—神经元对应，可能为分析 VLM 内部分层几何结构与表示可分性提供可核查的视角，但与 latent 推理状态的生成、使用及视觉证据筛选无直接联系，属较远领域的概念线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A Geometrical Approach to Constructing Neural Networks for Perfect Training-set Classification

**abstract/A1：** This paper proposes a method for constructing a neural network that achieves perfect classification of all samples in a given training set, without taking regularization into account. The network is constructed on-demand, with its layer sizes and neuron parameters determined through a geometrical analysis of the input data, in which separating hyperplanes are created and mapped to neurons with step activation functions. The proposed architecture consists of two hidden layers with distinct roles: inter-class separation and transformation of the data into a linearly separable representation. Inter-class separation requires every bi-chromatic pair of samples belonging to different classes to be separated by at least one hyperplane. We show that when this separation is achieved through a hierarchical partitioning of the data, the leaf nodes of the oblique decision tree, obtained as a byproduct, directly define the neurons of the linear separability layer, whose size is only one neuron greater than that of the inter-class separation layer. Experiments on the MNIST dataset demonstrate that the proposed method achieves perfect training-set classification, and compact models. The direct correspondence between the decision tree and network neurons enhances interpretability and explainability, while the construction procedure offers opportunities for parallel implementation and improved scalability.

**comment/C1：** 8 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 JEDI-net 这一统一架构，在优化过程中周期性对 SHAP 值聚类以发现具有相似特征重要性模式的潜在子群，并把子群身份直接嵌入网络，使预测随每个样本的预测结构自适应调整。

**相关性简评：** 该工作与视觉/多模态推理无直接关联，但其「按重要性剖面聚类出潜在子群、再动态条件化网络行为」的思路，可能与 LVR 中潜在推理模式的分组抽象、内部状态条件化，以及用贡献归因筛选视觉证据等问题的表述存在概念联系，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Joint Embedding with Dynamic Integration network (JEDI-net)

**abstract/A1：** Deep learning has become the dominant form of machine learning due in part, to its ability to automatically engineer complex meta features from data. However, even deep learning features can perform erratically because of unobserved latent factors. incorporating latent factor information explicitly, can improve performance by letting the model alter its behavior based on such inferred factors. Because neural networks often capture such complexity inherently, external clustering of the original feature space offers limited benefit. clustering observations by feature importance profiles, rather than raw features, offers a principled way to uncover latent structure, since observations with similar importance patterns may share predictive dynamics. In a prior work, Feature Oriented Representation with Clustering and Explanation (FORCE) we showed that this approach measurably improved neural network performance. In this article, we present JEDI-net(Joint Embedding with Dynamic Integration Network) a unified architecture that periodically clusters SHAP values during optimization to identify latent subgroups with similar feature importance patterns, embed their identities directly into the network, allowing predictions to adapt to each observations predictive structure.

</details>

### 744. [Near-Optimal Regret Bounds for Monotone Stochastic Optimization under Semi-Bandit Feedback](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17320v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17320

**作者：** Tao Hu、Rohan Ghuge

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.DS、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17320v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17320v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究半强盗反馈下单调随机优化的在线到离线归约：为强单调情形给出保持近似保证的 oracle 高效归约，达到 Õ(√(nT)) 期望遗憾界，并将坐标变化有界情形的 n 依赖从线性改进到 n^{3/4}。

**相关性简评：** 其覆盖最优停止与 Pandora's box（该探测哪个变量、何时停止）的遗憾界刻画，可能为 LVR 中 LOOK/STOP 的收益—成本权衡与动态计算预算提供形式化视角，属远领域线索，可供核查而与视觉推理无直接验证关系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Near-Optimal Regret Bounds for Monotone Stochastic Optimization under Semi-Bandit Feedback

**abstract/A1：** Stochastic optimization models sequential decision-making under uncertainty, typically assuming known input distributions. When these distributions are unknown, \\citet{agarwal2026semibandit} give an online-to-offline reduction for monotone stochastic optimization under semi-bandit feedback, where only probed variables are observed. Its expected regret relative to the offline guarantee is $\\widetilde O(n\\sqrt T)$, where $n$ is the number of variables and $T$ the horizon. For optimal stopping and Pandora's box, \\citet{liu2025improved} achieve $\\widetilde O(\\sqrt{nT})$ using problem-specific algorithms. \\emph{Can a general online-to-offline reduction achieve this improved rate?} We give such a reduction for strongly monotone stochastic optimization, answering the corresponding open question. Strong monotonicity is defined relative to the chosen offline algorithm. Our oracle-efficient reduction achieves $\\widetilde O(\\sqrt{nT})$ expected regret while preserving approximation guarantees for oracles satisfying the same condition. It combines Bernstein-type optimistic distribution estimates with a Hellinger stability bound for adaptive policy transcripts, aggregating squared marginal errors weighted by the executed policy's probing probabilities. The rate is optimal up to logarithmic factors for $T\\ge n$, even under full feedback. Under monotonicity and uniformly bounded coordinate-wise variation, the same algorithm achieves $\\widetilde O(n^{3/4}\\sqrt T)$ expected approximation regret, improving the previous linear dependence on $n$. The exponent $3/4$ is sharp for its ordinary regret over instances and exact oracle choices. Our framework applies to prophet inequality, Pandora's box, best-of-$K$ selection, stochastic knapsack, stochastic orienteering, and stochastic submodular maximization.

**comment/C1：** 68 pages, 20 figures, 1 table

</details>

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 mini-Lean-agent：一个只向模型暴露 bash 工具的最小编排（harness），模型自行检查与编辑仓库、检索本地库并调用 Lean，由独立可信评估器验证最终产物；在 Putnam 2025 上与 AxProverBase、Numina-Lean-Agent 对比，报告通用编码 agent 加最小 harness 即可取得较强表现。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 的具体联系可能在于把基座模型能力与外部编排/工具的贡献分离，以及在每题成本上限下如何决定继续搜索或提交，可供核查 VLM 推理中工具调用、证据获取与计算预算分配的设计；但论文本身不涉及视觉或多模态 latent 状态，属较远领域。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Do Theorem Provers Need Theorem-Proving Agents? mini-Lean-agent: A Coding-Agent Baseline for Lean

**abstract/A1：** General-purpose coding agents use standard shell and file interactions, yet formal theorem-proving agents often rely on specialized, ad-hoc tooling. This makes it difficult to determine which components of theorem-proving agents provide benchmark gains: an improved base model, a specialized harness, a specific tool, or a combination of any of them. We introduce mini-Lean-agent, a deliberately minimal agent for Lean tasks whose only model-visible tool is bash. The model must use bash to inspect and edit the repository, search local libraries, invoke Lean, and manage its own intermediate work, while a separate trusted evaluator verifies the final artifact. We compare mini-Lean-agent against AxProverBase and Numina-Lean-Agent on the Putnam 2025 benchmark. Experiments with Gemini 3.8 Flash as the base model show that mini-Lean-agent solves 7/12 problems at \\$2 per problem limit, compared with AxProverBase's 4/12. With Astra as the base model, mini-Lean-agent solves 12/12 problems at an average cost of \\$1.28 per problem. This suggests that a generic coding agent with a minimal harness can already achieve strong performance on Lean benchmarks. Our results motivate using mini-Lean-agent as a standard baseline when evaluating theorem-proving infrastructure.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at the 6th Workshop on Mathematical Reasoning and AI (NeurIPS 2026)

</details>

### 746. [On the Statistical Mechanics of Attention](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17347v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17347

**作者：** Jerry Yao-Chieh Hu、Yu-An Chen、Maojiang Su、Han Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cond-mat.dis-nn、cond-mat.stat-mech、cs.AI、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17347v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17347v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 用现代 Hopfield 模型从统计力学角度重新刻画 Transformer attention，建立自由能形式化以刻画参数区间与鲁棒推理阈值，识别玻璃态与鲁棒推理相之间的一阶相变，并扩展到随机 query/key 的情形。

**相关性简评：** 不直接研究视觉或多模态推理，但其「注意力即自由能极小化动力学」与相变视角可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态稳定性、信息坍缩和推理可靠性提供分析性概念工具，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** On the Statistical Mechanics of Attention

**abstract/A1：** We revisit the statistical mechanics of Transformer attention via modern Hopfield models. We present a free-energy formalism to characterize parameter regimes and critical thresholds for robust attention inference. The resulting free-energy landscape incorporates randomness in query states and attention weights. Attention then emerges as the equation of motion of the corresponding statistical-mechanical system (i.e., modern Hopfield model) through the standard free-energy minimization principle. This allows us to identify first-order phase transitions in attention between glassy and robust-inference phases. We further extend to attentions with stochastic queries and keys. Together, our results provide a rigorous statistical-mechanics framework for characterizing phase structure and inference reliability across a family of Transformer attention mechanisms.

</details>

### 747. [Robustly Reliable Learning for Regression](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17381v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17381

**作者：** Avrim Blum、Anh Tuan Nguyen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17381v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17381v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出回归设定下「鲁棒可靠学习」问题：给定训练集、损坏预算 b 与 L-Lipschitz 假设类，要求输出必然包含所有与除至多 b 个点外一致之预测器的预测区间；作者给出 b-th best 启发式、基于违例图的 FPT 算法及 SETH 下界。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 无直接关联，但其「在损坏预算下给出可证保证的预测区间」这一问题表述，可能为 noisy 监督或轨迹训练下的可靠性/验证（如 latent 状态或答案的可信范围）提供形式化视角，具体映射待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Robustly Reliable Learning for Regression

**abstract/A1：** We introduce the problem of robustly reliable learning for the regression setting in adversarial environments. Given a test point $x\_{test}$, a training dataset $S$ of $n$ data points, a corruption budget $b \\ll n$, and a real-valued hypothesis class $\\mathcal H$, our goal is to output the optimal prediction range $I^\*\_{x\_{test}}(S, b)$, such that any $L$-Lipschitz predictor consistent with all but at most $b$ points in $S$ must predict a value $h(x\_{test}) \\in I$. We then instantiate the analysis for $L$-Lipschitz hypothesis classes, a natural and widely studied class in the regression setting, focusing on two key scenarios. First, for the restricted case where the corrupted dataset is guaranteed to be $L$-Lipschitz consistent, we propose a simple and efficient $b^{th}$-best heuristic algorithm and prove its correctness in computing the tightest possible range $I^\*\_{x\_{test}}(S, b)$. We then establish its computational complexity of $O(n)$ and show that it is computationally optimal in this scenario. Building on this foundation, we address the general scenario where the dataset $S$ is no longer $L$-Lipschitz consistent. We demonstrate that computing the optimal range in this setting reduces to analyzing a violation graph, which models the pairwise $L$-Lipschitz violations among data points. By leveraging the structural properties of this graph's kernel, we propose a Fixed-Parameter Tractable (FPT) algorithm that computes the exact optimal range in $O(n^2 + b^4)$ time. Furthermore, under the Strong Exponential Time Hypothesis (SETH), we establish a computational lower bound of $Ω(n^{2 - o(1)})$, proving that our algorithm is computationally optimal. Finally, we discuss open directions for the problem of robustly reliable learning for regression.

**comment/C1：** 36 pages, 1 figure

</details>

### 748. [Variable Input Masked Autoencoders for Wrist-Worn Accelerometry](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17383v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17383

**作者：** Harish Haresamudram、Wanting Mao、Aditya Radhakrishnan、Maxwell A. Xu、James M. Rehg

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17383v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17383v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 VarMAE，一种可变输入掩码自编码器：预训练时对同一信号构造长时高频与短时低频两个视图，各自做掩码重建，并用长视图可见 token 预测短视图被掩码 token，配合裁剪与下采样形成的信息瓶颈，得到可在不同时长与采样率间复用的单一编码器。

**相关性简评：** 跨视图、跨分辨率的掩码重建与信息瓶颈目标，可能为 LVR 中如何通过监督信号约束 latent 状态保留跨配置任务相关信息提供线索，但其是否适用于视觉推理状态仍需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Variable Input Masked Autoencoders for Wrist-Worn Accelerometry

**abstract/A1：** Large-scale repositories of wearable sensor data have enabled the development of foundation models for human activities and behavior. However, existing models are pretrained using fixed input durations and sampling rates, despite substantial heterogeneity in recording conditions, downstream tasks, and deployment constraints. We introduce VarMAE, a variable input masked autoencoder that learns a single representation across sampling rates and temporal contexts. During pretraining we construct two views of the same signal: a long duration high frequency view, and a short duration lower frequency view, obtained via random cropping and downsampling. We perform masked reconstruction within each view and introduce a cross-resolution masked reconstruction objective that uses visible tokens from the long view to predict masked tokens from the short view. Cropping and downsampling impose complementary information bottlenecks, encouraging the model to learn representations that remain effective across input durations and sampling rate changes. We pretrain VarMAE on the large-scale NHANES dataset, producing a single pretrained encoder matching or outperforming controlled foundation model baselines on eight benchmark datasets. With only 3.82M parameters, VarMAE is parameter efficient and shows that a single foundation model can achieve broad transfer capabilities across sensing configurations.

</details>

### 749. [Cross-Market Meta-Learning for Electricity Price Forecasting](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17387v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17387

**作者：** Delaram Pirhayatifard、Terrence Alsup

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17387v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17387v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 MetaGrid，一个拓扑感知 transformer，把多个电力市场历史当作预训练语料做跨市场元训练，使单一、与区域数无关的参数集能适应未见电网，并在五个美国 ISO 的无泄漏基准上取得最低平均 MAE。

**相关性简评：** 跨域元训练得到可迁移到未见拓扑、不依赖节点数的单一参数集，与 LVR 关注的长度／规模泛化及预测工作区如何适应新结构可能存在可核查的类比线索，但属较远领域，需人工判断迁移价值。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Cross-Market Meta-Learning for Electricity Price Forecasting

**abstract/A1：** Day-ahead (DA) electricity price forecasting is usually posed per market, with a separate model fitted to each grid's own history. This caps accuracy: statistical and tree-based baselines saturate, while higher-capacity sequence models need more training data than a single market's few years of hourly prices can supply. Such methods also treat each node as an independent series, discarding the spatial dependencies induced by network topology and congestion. Because price formation across independent system operators (ISOs) is driven by shared physics and largely common market design, we instead treat cross-market history as a pretraining corpus. We present MetaGrid, a topology-aware transformer, meta-trained across markets so that a single zone-count-independent parameter set adapts to an unseen grid. On a leak-free benchmark of five U.S. ISOs, where every model receives the same prices, DA load forecasts and calendar features, MetaGrid attains the lowest average MAE, improving on the best baseline by 3.1\\% and on the same architecture trained from scratch by 7.7\\%.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI Foundations for Power Grids

</details>

### 750. [Learning to Detect Shifts in Unstructured Data Streams via Monitoring-by-Betting](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17399v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17399

**作者：** Siyu Zhou、Jialin Ouyang、Fan Xia、Adarsh Subbaswamy、Drew Prinster、Suchi Saria、Augusto Garcia-Agundez、Sarah Pollet、Jinoos Yazdany、Patrick Vossler、Jean Feng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17399v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17399v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把无结构数据流中的序贯分布漂移检测重述为「下注博弈」，提出 asymptotic e-detectors，用校准集近似漂移前分布并渐近控制误报，比较黑箱嵌入与 LLM 提出概念的自适应监控策略。

**相关性简评：** 其 anytime-valid 停止准则与自适应 witness（假设漂移方向）更新的统计框架，可能为 LVR 中动态计算与 STOP 决策提供误报可控的检验思路，LLM 提出假设概念的做法或可类比视觉证据筛选，均为推测性借鉴，有待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning to Detect Shifts in Unstructured Data Streams via Monitoring-by-Betting

**abstract/A1：** Continuous monitoring of generative AI systems requires detecting distribution shifts in the unstructured data they ingest and generate. Existing monitoring methods typically control false alarms by requiring the discrepancy measure used to detect shifts to be \*pre-specified\*. However, for unstructured data, pre-specification creates a sensitivity--breadth trade-off: a narrowly defined measure is sensitive to the anticipated shift but may miss unexpected changes, whereas a broadly defined measure may detect a wider range of shifts but with reduced sensitivity. Although adaptively hypothesizing the shift direction can overcome this limitation, such data-dependent adaptation generally invalidates conventional false-alarm guarantees. We reconcile adaptivity with statistical validity through testing-by-betting, reframing sequential changepoint detection as a betting game in which the bettor continually updates its hypothesized shift direction, or witness function, as new observations arrive. We introduce \*asymptotic e-detectors\*, which approximate the pre-change distribution using a calibration set of size $m$, and prove that they asymptotically control the average run length to a false alarm as $m$ increases. Empirically, calibration sets as small as $m=30$ provide effective control. We then develop adaptive monitoring strategies ranging from black-box bettors that learn from embeddings to interpretable bettors based on LLM-proposed concepts. Across three real-world datasets, including data from a clinical AI scribe deployment, adaptive monitors detect shifts faster than fixed monitors at the same false-alarm level. Further, when the true shifts are sparse and interpretable, LLM-concept monitors provide the fastest and most interpretable detection, while also guiding root-cause diagnosis for complex shifts.

</details>
