### 751. [Cross-View Time-Frequency Diffusion for Extreme-Aware Time-Series Generation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17407v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17407

**作者：** Lin Jiang、Rongchao Xu、Guang Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17407v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17407v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 CrossTF，利用时间域与频率域两个去噪器估计之间的「跨视角不对称」来生成含极端事件的时间序列，并在冻结两个去噪器后只学习晚期窗口内的分步融合参数，以在总体分布保真与极端保真之间取得平衡。

**相关性简评：** 其「两视角干净样本估计之间插值/外推、按去噪步骤动态融合」的机制，可能为 LVR 中多 latent 假设的合并与按深度/步骤加权提供类比线索，可供核查其阶段划分与融合参数化方式。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Cross-View Time-Frequency Diffusion for Extreme-Aware Time-Series Generation

**abstract/A1：** Generating realistic time-series requires faithfully reproducing rare but high-impact extreme events. Existing approaches often rely on specialized representations or extreme-focused training objectives, which may restrict the diversity of captured extremes or compromise overall distributional fidelity. We propose Cross-View Time-Frequency Diffusion (CrossTF), a framework that exploits discrepancies between time- and frequency-view denoisers for extreme-aware time-series generation. Our key empirical finding is extreme-sensitive cross-view asymmetry: moving along the direction connecting the two views' clean-sample estimates substantially changes extreme fidelity while having limited effects on overall generation quality. We further identify a late-stage cross-view window in which this discrepancy stabilizes and cross-view adjustments have a particularly strong effect on extreme fidelity. These findings motivate a staged optimization strategy in CrossTF: after training and freezing both denoisers, it only needs to learn step-specific fusion parameters within this window using an Extreme Value Theory-based objective under an energy-distance constraint. This formulation supports interpolation between and extrapolation beyond the view-specific estimates while limiting degradation in overall generation quality. Extensive experiments on seven real-world datasets against 11 baselines show that CrossTF improves extreme fidelity by 26.1% and overall performance by 7.4% relative to the strongest baselines. These results highlight cross-view discrepancy as an effective basis for low-dimensional optimization in extreme-aware time-series generation.

**comment/C1：** 42 pages, 17 figures

</details>

### 752. [Position: Beyond Training Time, Test-Time Coordination is Essential for Cooperative MARL](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17409v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17409

**作者：** Dongsu Lee、Sooraj Sathish、Joonkyung Kim、Woojun Kim、Amy Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17409v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17409v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 这是一篇立场论文，主张协作式多智能体强化学习应把测试时协调纳入问题定义，并提出 CTME 这一设计空间：训练后可存在一个观察全局状态、间断发出高层信号的协调者，CTDE 只是其极限情况。

**相关性简评：** 其「测试时信息通道与更新频率是建模选择而非必然」的论述，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的更新/重算节奏、何时补充视觉证据及停止决策提供问题表述上的类比线索，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Position: Beyond Training Time, Test-Time Coordination is Essential for Cooperative MARL

**abstract/A1：** We argue that cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) should treat test-time coordination as part of the problem definition rather than a deployment artifact. Our focus is on long-horizon, centrally monitored cooperative systems such as warehouse robotics, automated storage-and-retrieval systems, and cloud-resource scheduling, where teams share a reward, operate under shifting objectives, and already run with global telemetry at deployment. The dominant paradigm in this regime, centralized training with decentralized execution (CTDE), uses global information only during training and provides no coordination channel at execution. This is sufficient when agents are weakly coupled or the environment is stationary, but it fails when the team must realign after conditions change. The limitation is structural rather than algorithmic, and more training cannot add a channel that does not exist at execution time. We call this the recoverability gap. To address it, we name the underexplored design space of intermittent test-time coordination as centralized training with mixed execution (CTME), in which a coordinator observes global state and emits high-level signals while agents act locally. CTME is not a particular learning algorithm, but a cooperative MARL problem setting that makes test-time information structure explicit. It specifies team-level information, high-level signals, and update frequency after training, with CTDE recovered as a limit case. We do not argue that CTDE is obsolete. We argue that removing the test-time channel is a modeling choice, not a necessity, and the wrong default when global telemetry is available and teams must recover from drift.

**comment/C1：** NeurIPS Position Track 2026

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17410

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.DC、cs.HC、cs.MA

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17410v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17410v1>)

**内容简述：** 这是一篇 CACM 立场论文，主张「agency」可成为计算机科学继「process」之后的新组织抽象，并从执行、接口、正确性、监督、协调、持久性六个维度分析已部署智能体系统失败的抽象缺口。

**相关性简评：** 其关于有限资源下的目标追求、运行期监督与状态持久化的讨论，可能为 LVR 的停止决策、推理成本核算与状态管理提供问题表述与评价层面的启发，具体联系仍需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Agency as a New Organizing Abstraction for Computer Science

**abstract/A1：** Advances in large-scale machine learning have enabled agentic AI systems: persistent, autonomous computational entities that pursue goals, initiate actions, and interact with open environments. These systems are often framed as applications of foundation models. We argue that this framing is incomplete: agency is also a candidate new organizing abstraction for computer science. What is new is not the concept of an agent, nor runtime policy generation per se, but its general-purpose, open-ended form, in which systems can synthesize courses of action from goals, observations, and memory, over tools and environments for which no complete task-specific model was specified in advance. Thus agency becomes a systems-level abstraction as well as an AI modeling concept. Where the process abstraction organizes computation around executing programs, agency organizes it around pursuing goals under bounded resources: a process executes a program; an agent pursues a goal. From this perspective, the recurring failures of deployed agentic systems (runaway resource consumption, behavior redirected by adversarial content, opaque continuous operation) are symptoms of structural abstraction gaps, not isolated engineering defects. We examine these gaps across six dimensions (execution, interfaces, correctness, oversight, coordination, and persistence) and argue that closing them requires coordinated advances in systems,

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17424

**作者：** Tomas Karella、Emily Shinkle、Alice Elisabeth Anastasia Allen、Pieter J. Swart、Nicholas Lubbers、Roxana Bujack

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17424v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17424v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文基于经典不变量理论构造对 SE(2)（平移与旋转）具有不变性、且可证最小且信息保持的特征映射，并给出一个可插入标准 CNN 的即插即用模块，在不改动非线性与归一化层的前提下实现不变性，实验显示精度相当或更优而计算成本显著更低，并分析等变与不变的关系。

**相关性简评：** 「最小且信息保持的不变特征」这一目标与 LVR 关注的内部状态是否保留视觉细节、避免信息坍缩有概念联系，其不变性与等变对鲁棒性/灵活性的权衡也可能为 latent 表示设计提供核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** On Making $\\mathrm{SE}(2)$-Invariant Networks Optimal

**abstract/A1：** Respecting a-priori known symmetries of underlying data is a key principle in designing efficient neural architectures. Convolutional neural networks are a canonical example, encoding translation equivariance. Extending this inductive bias to richer symmetry groups such as $\\mathrm{SE}(2)$ in the most effective way possible is an ongoing architectural and computational challenge. Building on classical invariant theory, we derive invariant feature maps that are provably optimal: minimal and information-preserving with respect to the symmetry group. Our construction is designed to integrate seamlessly into standard architectures, requiring no modification to nonlinearities or normalization layers. As a concrete implementation, we introduce a plug-and-play module for convolutional neural networks that enforces $\\mathrm{SE}(2)$ invariance, capturing both translations and rotations within standard architectures. The resulting models are both efficient and expressive. Experiments show competitive or improved accuracy compared to state-of-the-art equivariant methods at significantly lower computational cost. Finally, we provide a theoretical and empirical analysis of the relationship between equivariance and invariance, offering insight into their roles in controlling robustness and flexibility.

**comment/C1：** Accepted to the main track of NeurIPS 2026

</details>

**内容简述：** 论文研究极端稀疏（≥99%）下动态稀疏训练的拓扑演化，形式化前向、反向与功能可达性并给出闭式期望，据此引导剪枝与再生长以保住输入-输出通路，在 CIFAR 与 Tiny ImageNet 上显著缩小与随机更新的差距。

**相关性简评：** 其「功能可达性」把通路是否存在而非参数多少作为判断依据，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据通路被切断、信息坍缩的度量与干预提供类比线索；但图结构假设与 latent 状态更新的可比性尚待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When Sparsity Breaks Connectivity: Functional Reachability and Guided Topology Dynamics in Extreme Sparse Training

**abstract/A1：** Dynamic Sparse Training (DST) periodically prunes and regrows connections, inducing a discrete dynamical mechanism over network topologies. At extreme sparsity ($\\ge 99\\%$), this dynamic tends to destroy input-output information pathways, and performance with standard magnitude/random updates degrades sharply. We formalize forward, backward, and functional reachability on layered sparse graphs, derive closed-form expectations for reachable neurons and edges, and show that Monte Carlo realizations match the theory. Guided by this reachability-based structure, we bias pruning toward non-functional edges and regrowth toward functionally consistent candidates. We introduce this reachability-driven modification of topology evolution as Reachability-guided in DST, referred to as guided DST. On CIFAR-10/100 and Tiny ImageNet, guided DST recovers large accuracy gaps versus unguided DST (up to $+14.4$ points at $99.9\\%$ sparsity on CIFAR-100), and on MLP-Mixer guided DST remains trainable at $99.99\\%$ sparsity while unguided random regrowth degrades sharply. These results cast extreme-sparse training as a connectivity-preserving dynamical process. Our implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/mzjaworski/ea\_dst.

</details>

### 756. [Large Language Models Extend Known Research But Do Not Create New Research Directions](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17439v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17439

**作者：** Zhihua Liu、Kurt Butler、Damian Machlanski、Danilo Bueno、Sotirios A. Tsaftaris

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文比较人类论文与八种 LLM 生成的科学假设，在预训练论文嵌入空间中嵌入 2690 万篇人类论文和 52.4 万条 LLM 假设，提出正交新颖性分数（ONS）区分「距离」与「方向」两类新颖性，发现 LLM 的想法离已有工作更远，但方向新颖性低于已发表论文。

**相关性简评：** 把新颖性分解为「距离」与「方向」并在共享概念空间做几何度量的思路，可能为判断 latent 推理状态是重复既有推理路径还是探索新方向、以及表示几何与覆盖度的评价提供参照，迁移到 LVR 是否可行尚需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Large Language Models Extend Known Research But Do Not Create New Research Directions

**abstract/A1：** The success of autonomous research systems relies on the quality of the scientific hypotheses they generate. Recent studies report that human reviewers often rate LLM-generated ideas as more novel than those from human experts, raising hope that AI can accelerate scientific discovery. Yet it is unclear whether these models can do more than extend existing knowledge. Can LLMs drive genuine innovation by revealing new research directions, or are they limited to repeating and recombining what science already knows? This unresolved question lies at the heart of discussions about AI and the future of science. To address this, we distinguish two types of novelty: distance, which measures how far a hypothesis lies from existing work, and direction, which captures whether the hypothesis pursues new lines of inquiry beyond those already present. These two measures diverge sharply for LLM-generated work. We represent scientific papers in a shared conceptual space using a pretrained scientific-paper embedding model. Within this space, we embed 26.9 million human-authored papers across 1,325 research topics in six natural-science fields and 524,308 LLM-generated hypotheses from eight models. Distance is measured using existing metrics. To quantify direction, we introduce the orthogonal novelty score (ONS). LLMs consistently generate ideas more distant from existing work than human-authored papers, up to 16\\% further when the LLM is given the papers farthest from the centre of the topic. However, LLM hypotheses have a 15--23\\% lower median ONS than published papers from the same topic. Thus, LLMs move further from what is already known, but remain within established directions. This pattern persists across changes in various configurations. As a result, LLMs excel at extending the frontier but the creation of new directions is still led by human scientists.

</details>

**title/T1：** On Sleep-Wake Disorder Identification from Polysomnographic Representations

**abstract/A1：** Self-supervised polysomnography foundation models (PSG FMs) aim to capture clinically useful information beyond sleep staging, yet are rarely compared with sleep-staging encoders pretrained at comparable scale and modality coverage. Using a common whole-night, missingness-aware state-space downstream modeling framework, we compared frozen representations from prominent large-scale, multi-cohort sleep-stage-supervised encoders and self-supervised PSG FMs for multilabel identification of six sleep-wake and circadian disorder groups in 7,906 PSGs from an unseen registry. Although PSG FMs outperformed an EEG-only, single-cohort supervised baseline, this ordering reversed when supervised pretraining approached comparable scale and modality coverage. Transfer learning from neural sleep scorers achieved higher overall performance while exhibiting greater downstream data efficiency. These findings underscore the need for scale- and modality-matched pretrained supervised baselines when assessing PSG FMs' downstream potential.

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 FDDA：冻结 latent 生成器，仅用 Fréchet 分布目标在「生成期 latent」上微调解码器，以消除解码器训练分布与推理输入分布不一致的问题，在 11 个 flow-based 与自回归 latent 生成模型上改善 gFID、gFDr⁶ 并大幅降低耗时。

**相关性简评：** 其「读取模块在训练 latent 上训练、却在推理期 latent 上部署」的分布错配诊断，与 LVR 中答案解码器是否对齐于推理期产生的 latent 状态、以及 latent 分布漂移问题可能相通，可供核查借鉴。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Efficient Fréchet Distributional Decoder Alignment for Latent Generative Models

**abstract/A1：** Fréchet Distributional (FD) objectives provide an effective distribution-level signal for post-training generative models. For latent generative models, however, existing FD-based post-training methods optimize only the latent generator while keeping the decoder frozen: the decoder is trained on reconstruction latents obtained from real images but deployed on generator-produced latents at generation time. When these latent distributions differ, this \\textbf{decoder train-generation mismatch} means that the decoder is deployed on inputs drawn from a distribution it was not directly trained on. We introduce \\textbf{Fréchet Distributional Decoder Alignment (FDDA)}, an efficient post-training method that freezes the latent generator and directly optimizes the decoder on generation-time latents using an FD objective. A single epoch of FDDA consistently improves gFID and gFDr$^6$ across diverse flow-based and autoregressive latent generative models. Across all 11 evaluated models, FDDA reduces gFDr$^6$ by 34.0-59.6\\% from the original pretrained models and provides a further 10.2-57.2\\% reduction after generator-side FD post-training. FDDA also reduces total wall-clock time by factors of $3.6\\times$-$328.7\\times$ relative to generator-side FD post-training across these models. These results show that generator-side post-training alone does not exhaust the benefits of FD optimization, and that further gains can be obtained by adapting the decoder at substantially lower cost.

<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Structure-preserving fidelity diagnostics for partial differential equations

**abstract/A1：** Machine learning surrogates of partial differential equations (PDEs) are commonly trained on data generated by numerical solvers. Therefore, the training data obey not the PDE but the modified equation of the numerical scheme, and the test loss, computed on data from the same solver, cannot distinguish a model that learned the physics from one that learned the discretization error. Here, we show that the difference is nevertheless visible in the trained model. We propose a suite of structure-preserving fidelity diagnostics, simple scores that measure whether a learned model respects one known property of the physics, such as a conserved quantity, a symmetry or a Hamiltonian structure, without access to the training data or the governing equation. Over five systems, the diagnostics track the error with respect to the true dynamics with a rank correlation of up to $0.94$, while the test loss is uncorrelated or anti-correlated with it. For the Burgers, Korteweg-de Vries and Navier-Stokes equations, the diagnostics separate numerical schemes that the test loss ranks as equivalent, including schemes of the same order. order.

**内容简述：** 该论文基于 Moodle 日志构建时间同步的 prequential（预序）在线评估框架，用于提前一周预测学生的停止活动，并比较 SGD-LR、OSELM 与 ESN 在固定、冻结与滚动阈值策略及四类行为特征下的判别性能与告警负担。

**相关性简评：** 其「只使用当时可得信息、无前视」的时序评估设计，可能为 LVR 中逐步生成状态、动态计算与停止决策的评价方式提供线索，阈值—召回—告警负担的权衡可供核查；但该工作属教育数据挖掘，与视觉多模态推理无直接关联。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** A Time-Synchronous Prequential Evaluation Framework for Next-Week Student Disengagement Prediction from Moodle LMS Logs

**abstract/A1：** Retrospective evaluation of early-warning models may not reflect information available when predictions are issued and outcomes become observable. We developed a time-synchronous prequential framework for online prediction of next-week student disengagement, operationalised as inactivity onset, from Moodle logs. Ordered by calendar time, models were updated only with available outcomes and remained unchanged for all predictions at each prediction cutoff; development, calibration and evaluation were chronologically separate. We compared stochastic gradient descent logistic regression (SGD-LR), online sequential extreme learning machine (OSELM) and echo state network (ESN) across predictive performance, fixed, frozen and rolling threshold policies, calendar-time variation and four behavioural feature sets. Held-out evaluation comprised 49,329 predictions with 37.68% inactivity-onset prevalence. Discrimination was similar (average precision 0.665-0.679; ROC-AUC 0.755-0.774). OSELM had the highest recall, SGD-LR the highest precision and specificity, and ESN the highest Matthews correlation coefficient and balanced accuracy. Lower thresholds increased recall and alert volume, whereas rolling adaptation did not improve MCC over frozen thresholds. Weekly performance and calibrated-probability distributions varied without sustained deterioration. During model selection, cumulative-and-temporal features achieved the highest individual-set AP, with modest gains from combining all feature groups. These findings indicate that streaming early-warning evaluation should consider calibration, threshold-dependent performance, alert burden and calendar-time variation alongside aggregate discrimination.

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CY

**内容简述：** 论文对 10 种权重-only 量化策略在多个 LLM、任务和 GPU 上做统一评测，比较精度、运行时与能耗，发现长输入短输出时能效相对全精度最高，且能耗与运行时高度同步。

**相关性简评：** 与视觉 latent 推理无直接关系，但其「能耗—运行时—输入输出长度」的成本刻画可能可供核查，用于衡量 latent 推理额外计算步骤与动态计算预算的实际成本。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Towards Green AI: Evaluating Energy Efficiency for Quantized LLM Inference

**abstract/A1：** While it is known that quantization of large language models (LLMs) reduces memory usage via lower-bit weights, studies quantifying the resulting impact on energy usage and carbon intensity are scarce. We present the first unified evaluation of weight-only quantization strategies for LLM inference across varying input/output lengths and GPUs, highlighting differences in energy efficiency in addition to accuracy degradation and runtime. We study quantized inference on Llama 2 7B, Phi 3.5 Mini Instruct, OLMo 1B, Qwen 2.5 7B, and Qwen 2.5 14B across GLUE MNLI, MMLU, HumanEval, and GSM8K datasets, evaluating 10 post-training quantization (PTQ) strategies on NVIDIA H100, A6000, A100, and L4 GPUs. We identify a novel trend showing that quantization techniques tend to exhibit peak energy efficiency relative to full-precision baselines when inputs are sufficiently long and outputs are short. Furthermore, we show that quantization strategies become marginally more energy-efficient relative to full-precision models as batch sizes increase, though gains are modest. Notably, fused-kernel implementations such as EETQ int8 and Bitsandbytes int8 offer the highest energy savings, up to 4x compared to FP32 on short text generation, with negligible accuracy loss. Finally, we observe that energy usage closely tracks runtime on our evaluated benchmarks, indicating that, in practice, latency optimization can serve as a reliable proxy for reducing the environmental footprint of LLM services. We conclude with suggested directions for strategically selecting low-carbon quantization strategies based on specific inference requirements.

</details>

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该工作在同一批 14 个分割、分类与回归任务上基准测试 23 个 3D 医学自监督基础模型，并把多种可迁移性估计器与微调后的排序结果对照，提出用任务相关冻结特征统计做候选排序的 InsightRank，并报告短名单可大幅降低抽取加训练成本。

**相关性简评：** 以冻结特征统计在微调前预测表示的下游可用性并筛选候选，可能可供核查 LVR 中低成本评估 latent 状态任务相关信息的思路，但该文面向医学影像模型选择，与视觉推理状态生成无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Benchmarking Self-Supervised 3D Medical Vision Foundation Models and Transferability Estimation

**abstract/A1：** Self-supervised pretraining has expanded the pool of 3D medical foundation models, but published evaluations use different datasets, endpoints and fine-tuning protocols. Models also differ in architecture, pretraining objective and data, while downstream targets range from voxel-level masks to patient-level diagnoses and outcomes. As a result, published findings provide little directly comparable evidence for choosing a model for a new task. Direct comparison of adaptation performance requires fine-tuning candidates on labelled target data, at substantial computational cost. We benchmark 23 candidates across the same 14 segmentation, classification and regression tasks spanning multiple anatomies and modalities. No candidate ranked among the top three across all segmentation tasks or across all classification and regression tasks; a convolutional encoder could outperform a transformer trained with the same objective on one task but underperform it on another. We benchmark transferability estimators against the fine-tuned rankings and find that their agreement varies across dense segmentation, classification and regression. InsightRank uses task-appropriate frozen-feature statistics and architecture-aware pairwise comparisons to rank candidates before fine-tuning. Across the 23-model pool, mean Kendall tau-b was 0.431 for segmentation and 0.352 for classification and regression. The segmentation Top 3 contained a task winner on four of nine tasks; the image-level Top 3 contained none on the five tasks, despite better full-ranking agreement than the matched conventional estimators. A three-model shortlist reduced recorded extraction-plus-training job time by 85.8% across seven segmentation tasks. Together, the benchmark provides a common reference for model selection and InsightRank offers a lower-cost way to prioritize fine-tuning, with shortlist performance that differs by target type.

</details>

### 763. [Physical-Field-Bridged Material Parameter Inference from Multi-View Deformation Videos](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17591v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17591

**作者：** Linrui Shou、Jie Li、Yu Liu、Tao Huang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17591v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17591v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出「物理场桥接」的单次前向框架：从多视角形变视频预测力/接触掩码、运动流场与投影应力响应图，再据此推断材料本构类型与连续参数，并构建含 5000 次仿真的 DeformFieldBench 与稠密物理监督。

**相关性简评：** 以稠密中间物理场替代逐场景反演与仿真内循环优化的「单次推断」思路，可能与 LVR 关心的用预测中间状态替代测试时迭代计算、以及中间表示是否忠实（论文亦报告域偏移与可辨识性缺口）可供核查；但任务与 VLM 推理相距较远，联系尚属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Physical-Field-Bridged Material Parameter Inference from Multi-View Deformation Videos

**abstract/A1：** Estimating simulation-ready material parameters from visual observations is crucial for deformable-object manipulation but challenging because material properties are only indirectly revealed through physical responses. We introduce physical-field-bridged material inference, a single-pass framework that uses dense physical responses to connect multi-view RGB deformation videos with constitutive-type classification and continuous parameter regression. Unlike inverse-physics methods requiring per-scene reconstruction, online tuning, or simulation-in-the-loop optimization, our model predicts force/contact masks, projected motion-flow fields, and projected stress-response maps, then conditions material inference on these fields to reduce reliance on appearance or category shortcuts. We construct DeformFieldBench, a 3DGS MPM learning environment comprising 5,000 simulations across 100 object shapes and five mechanically informative loading modes, with dense pixel-aligned physical supervision. Our method achieves the best median errors on all four continuous parameters, improves stress-hotspot recall from 0.0762 to 0.5121, and attains 0.8676 SSIM/36.82 dB PSNR in same-simulator replay on unseen objects. Under a protocol-matched GSO evaluation, inference and future-state prediction take approximately 30 seconds, compared with 15-120 minutes for per-scene optimization. The method also yields measurable replay agreement on five real-world sequences. These results support dense physical fields as an effective bridge for fast material inference, while cross-simulator and real-world tests reveal remaining domain and identifiability gaps.

</details>

### 764. [Tanawpamana: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models on Philippine Cultural Heritage Sites](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17596v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17596

**作者：** Ivan Yuri De Leon、Hiroki Ouchi、Sakriani Sakti

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI、cs.CL

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文构建 Tanawpamana 数据集与基准（4,046 项任务），基于菲律宾文化遗产登记信息考察七个 VLM 对文化遗产地的识别与知识，发现细粒度区分相似遗址比粗粒度识别更难，且从图像推断地理知识弱于从文本推断。

**相关性简评：** 该基准属识别与知识评测，未涉及 latent 推理状态或推理期证据生成；但「图像输入不如文本输入」的模态差距可能作为视觉证据是否被真正使用的诊断线索，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Tanawpamana: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models on Philippine Cultural Heritage Sites

**abstract/A1：** Vision-language models are increasingly used to identify and describe places, yet their recognition and knowledge of specific cultures remain poorly understood, particularly in underrepresented regions such as the Philippines. This study introduces the Tanawpamana Dataset, a repository of Philippine heritage site images with metadata based on the Talapamana registry of the National Commission for Culture and the Arts of the Philippines. We also introduce the Tanawpamana Benchmark, comprising 4,046 tasks designed to evaluate models' recognition and knowledge of heritage sites. Evaluating seven vision-language models, we find that they struggle more with fine-grained visual discrimination among similar heritage sites than with coarse recognition, and that their geographic knowledge is weaker when inferred from image inputs than from text.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at O-COCOSDA 2026

### 765. [Can Agents Truly Forget? Explore Machine Unlearning for LLM Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17659v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17659

**作者：** Junkai Lin、Ge Xu、Zheng Xu、Junkai Chen、Xiangyuan Lan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17659v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17659v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把「agent 遗忘」形式化为需从参数知识、持久记忆与工具调用获取三条信息通道中移除私有信息的问题，并构建带持久记忆、离线网页快照与来源追踪轨迹的 AUBench 基准，用其评测现有参数级与记忆级遗忘方法。

**相关性简评：** 其「被遗忘的信息仍可能残留在记忆工件或经工具调用重新获得」的多通道观察与来源追踪轨迹设计，可能与 LVR 中判断答案是否真正使用 latent 内容、而非经旁路泄漏这一核心问题存在概念联系，可供核查其评测思路能否迁移到视觉证据筛选与贡献分配的场景。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Can Agents Truly Forget? Explore Machine Unlearning for LLM Agents

**abstract/A1：** Large language model (LLM) agents have shown strong capabilities in interactive problem solving, tool use, and long-horizon task execution. However, they may also acquire sensitive or private knowledge during training and expose it during deployment. Retraining a model from scratch to remove such knowledge is prohibitively costly, making machine unlearning a more practical approach. Machine unlearning aims to remove targeted undesirable knowledge from trained models without retraining from scratch while preserving general utility. When language models are deployed as agents, parameter-level unlearning becomes insufficient: forgotten information may still persist in memory artifacts or be reacquired via tool calls. In this paper, we formulate the problem of agent unlearning as removing private information from an LLM-based agent across three information channels: parametric knowledge, persistent memory, and tool-call acquisition. To study this problem, we introduce we introduce Agent Unlearning Benchmark (AUBench), a controlled benchmark that extends the fictitious-author setting of TOFU into an agent environment with persistent memory, an offline web snapshot, tool-accessible documents, and provenance-tracked interaction trajectories. By evaluating existing parameter-level and memory-level unlearning methods in this setting, AUBench reveals the gap between model-level forgetting and system-level agent unlearning, and provides a foundation for developing unlearning methods that operate across the full lifecycle of LLM agents.

</details>

### 766. [Understanding Gene Expression-to-Image Learning: Spatial Structure and Information Fidelity](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17699v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17699

**作者：** Xiaoqing Lian、Pei Liu、Jiahui Tan、Quan Zou、Chen Lin、Xiangxiang Zeng

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG、q-bio.GN

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17699v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17699v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在固定网络与训练流程下研究基因表达到图像（GE2I）的学习机制，发现空间平滑性与基因级保真度之间的权衡：多个基因共用一个像素会模糊表达差异，而一对一基因—像素映射在多个视觉骨干上提升预测，且预训练与增强的收益依赖骨干与映射方式。

**相关性简评：** 其「空间平滑性 vs 信息保真度」权衡以及多基因挤占同一像素导致差异被模糊的现象，可能与 LVR 中视觉细节被压入有限 latent 槽位时的信息坍缩问题形成类比，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Understanding Gene Expression-to-Image Learning: Spatial Structure and Information Fidelity

**abstract/A1：** Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) enables cell-level analysis of biological heterogeneity, but learning effective representations from high-dimensional, unordered gene expression profiles remains challenging. Gene Expression-to-Image (GE2I) offers an effective learning strategy by arranging gene values on pixel grids for convolutional neural networks, but its underlying mechanisms remain unclear. We study GE2I on full-transcriptome data while keeping the network and training procedure fixed. Our results reveal a trade-off between spatial smoothness and gene-level fidelity. Structured mappings produce smooth, low-frequency patterns that support faster early optimization, whereas assigning multiple genes to the same pixel obscures expression differences and can reduce predictive performance. This trade-off explains why random mappings can compete with structured layouts when many genes are represented. One-to-one gene-to-pixel assignment improves prediction across the tested visual backbones even when image smoothness decreases. We further find that the benefits of pretraining and augmentation depend on the backbone and mapping. These findings provide practical guidance for pixel allocation and the transfer of vision priors to gene expression data.

</details>

### 767. [Where Small Mistakes Matter: Quantifying State Criticality for Imitation Learning](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17709v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17709

**作者：** Yusuf Umut Ciftci、Joonwon Kang、Ajay Suresha Sathya、Somil Bansal

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.RO

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17709v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17709v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文将模仿学习中的「状态关键性」形式化为专家动作受有界扰动时下游价值的最坏退化，并提出 SCRIM：围绕固定模仿策略训练对抗扰动策略与价值评论家，为每个演示状态打分，用于重加权行为克隆损失与筛选高价值演示子集，并在仿真与真实机器人操作任务上评估。

**相关性简评：** 其「关键性＝有界扰动下价值最坏退化」的度量与对抗扰动加价值评论家的估计方式，可能为 LVR 判断哪些 latent 推理状态或步骤对最终答案真正关键、以及据此重加权或筛选训练轨迹提供问题表述与评价线索，但是否可迁移到 latent 状态与推理步尚待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Where Small Mistakes Matter: Quantifying State Criticality for Imitation Learning

**abstract/A1：** Imitation learning typically treats every demonstration state as equally important, optimizing a behavior-cloning objective uniformly across the dataset. Yet not all states are created equal: in a small number of critical states, even a slight deviation from the expert action can lead to a failure, while in many other states such errors are recoverable and inconsequential. We formalize state criticality in imitation learning as the worst-case degradation in downstream value induced by a bounded perturbation of the expert action at a given state. We then propose SCRIM, a practical State CRIticality Measure that estimates this quantity by training an adversarial disturbance policy and a value critic around a fixed imitation policy. SCRIM assigns each demonstration state a score reflecting how vulnerable the task outcome is to small, policy-relevant action errors. We show that these scores can be used to reweight behavior-cloning losses, improving imitation at consequential states and increasing overall task performance. We further show that SCRIM enables data curation by selecting compact, high-value subsets of demonstrations that preserve performance while substantially reducing the amount of training data. We evaluate SCRIM across various simulated and real-world robotic manipulation tasks, and demonstrate that SCRIM improves policy training, enables efficient data selection, and provides interpretable insights into which moments in a demonstration are most critical for task success. Project website: https://sia-lab-git.github.io/SCRIM/

**comment/C1：** Accepted to the Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026). 18 pages, 10 figures, 8 tables. Project website: https://sia-lab-git.github.io/SCRIM/

</details>

### 768. [DuplexAct: How Interactive Are Frontier Full-Duplex Spoken Language Models?](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17738v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17738

**作者：** Jiaheng Dong、Shihong Tan、Gongping Huang、Jean Honorio、Abhirup Ghosh、Ting Dang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17738v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17738v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 DuplexAct 基准，为端到端全双工语音模型定义三级交互动作分类（8 类动作、24 种条件），并从「即时执行」与「后续跟进」两方面设计动作成功指标，覆盖 4,691 条测试实例。

**相关性简评：** 该工作把「动作是否发生」与「动作是否成功」分离，并用执行加跟进两阶段判定，这一评价思路可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 内容是否真正被使用、LOOK/STOP 决策何时算成功；但属语音交互领域，迁移可行性需自行判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** DuplexAct: How Interactive Are Frontier Full-Duplex Spoken Language Models?

**abstract/A1：** End-to-end (E2E) full-duplex spoken language models (FD-SLMs) enable simutanous listening and speaking continously, requiring models to take appropriate interaction actions as conversations unfold. However, existing benchmarks lack a structured action-level formulation, often evaluate action occurrence rather than success, and provide limited coverage of diverse real-world conversations. We introduce DuplexAct, a benchmark for evaluating interaction action taking in E2E FD-SLMs. DuplexAct defines a three-level action taxonomy spanning eight interaction actions and 24 corresponding interaction conditions. We further characterize successful action-taking through immediate execution and subsequent follow-through, and develop action-specific evaluation metrics for both. DuplexAct contains 4,691 test instances spanning casual conversation, meetings, customer service, and interviews, including 2,531 instances derived from real-world conversational recordings. Together, DuplexAct provides a structured and real-world-grounded framework for systematically assessing how E2E FD-SLMs participate in ongoing spoken interaction.

**comment/C1：** Under review

</details>

### 769. [Instructions Are Evidence, Not Objectives: Measuring Outcome Alignment of Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17757v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17757

**作者：** Kaiming Liu、Yuxuan Liu、Jinrui Ju、Minyuan Ruan、Xuanyu Lei、Peng Li、Yang Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.SE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17757v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17757v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 agent 的「outcome alignment」能力：把用户指令视为证据而非目标，从代码与运行环境推断真实需求；为此构建 TiGanEval 基准，评测八个前沿模型，发现从完整规格转为部分指令时成功率下降 53–67 分，多次提交的后果反馈也无法弥补。

**相关性简评：** 其「指令不完备、真实需求需从环境推断」的表述，可能与 LVR 中何时 LOOK、如何用环境证据补足未明示任务必要信息的决策问题相通，可供核查是否作为证据获取与需求推断的类比框架。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Instructions Are Evidence, Not Objectives: Measuring Outcome Alignment of Agents

**abstract/A1：** Large language model agents can follow complex human instructions to solve real-world tasks. In practice, however, initial instructions are often incomplete. In our analysis of 100 user-agent trajectories from SWE-chat, 56\\% of initial instructions omit requirements that later emerge as necessary, and 52\\% of the useful follow-up requirements could have been inferred from the project. A user states requirements from their own understanding of the task, and these \\textbf{stated requirements} often differ from the \\textbf{true requirements} that completing the task imposes. An agent should therefore treat the instruction as evidence rather than as the objective, inferring the true requirements from the instruction and the environment and satisfying them even when the user is not yet aware of all of them. We call this ability \\textbf{outcome alignment}. In this work, we construct \\textbf{TiGanEval}, a benchmark of software engineering and research tasks. In every task the user genuinely lacks part of the requirements, each requirement stays discoverable from the code and runtime behaviour of the environment, and requirements the agent infers are separated from those the user adds after observing delivered work. These properties together make outcome alignment measurable. Evaluating eight frontier models including GPT-5.6-Sol, we find outcome alignment broadly missing: the models lose 53 to 67 points of success rate when moving from the full specification to the partial instruction, and consequence feedback across four submissions does not close the gap. Furthermore, a plan-mode harness cannot compensate for the missing ability of the model itself, which places outcome alignment among the abilities the next generation of models should be developed for.

</details>

### 770. [Gaussian Process Bandits for AI System Optimization with Selectively Verified Feedback](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17760v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17760

**作者：** Shuang Wu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17760v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17760v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该文研究在动作先于诊断观测、可信反馈仅在未知诊断状态子集上有效的设定下，如何用高斯过程 bandit 优化 AI 系统配置：构造结合可靠性覆盖与奖励分离的固定审计设计，给出含硬审计预算的有限时间 regret 界，并提出保留识别下界与精确成本核算的安全自适应分配。

**相关性简评：** 其「廉价模型评估与可信结果不一致」及带预算的验证/审计设计，与 LVR 关注的可信证据获取、成本核算和停止决策有概念对应，可用于核查能否迁移为 latent 推理中的证据筛选与验证准则；但仅为较远领域的理论工作，属推测性启发。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Gaussian Process Bandits for AI System Optimization with Selectively Verified Feedback

**abstract/A1：** Gaussian process bandits exploit similarities among configurations to optimize prompts, retrieval systems, and agent workflows. In these applications, however, inexpensive model-based evaluations can disagree with trusted task outcomes. We study selective verification when an action is chosen before a diagnostic is observed and trusted feedback is informative on an unknown set of diagnostic states. A finite reliability class and a finite RKHS signal dictionary describe these two sources of uncertainty. We construct a fixed audit design that combines reliability coverage with reward separation and establish a finite-time regret bound that accounts for a hard audit budget and the rounds needed to obtain informative observations. A safe adaptive extension mixes this robust design with predictable Chernoff allocations while preserving a uniform identification floor and exact expected acquisition-cost accounting. For signed-coordinate kernels, structured and diffuse reliability classes require different audit scales despite sharing the same reward geometry. Synthetic experiments distinguish these certified designs from an adaptive posterior heuristic and GP controls. Safe adaptive allocation reduces aggregate regret relative to the fixed design under the exact dictionary, but its finite-budget error certificate is numerically loose. Conditional-feedback errors can remove the heuristic's advantage and target perturbations can reverse it. Separate AI-task replays assess feedback correction and fitted-dictionary policies without establishing end-to-end validation of a learned selective-verification method.

</details>

### 771. [Memory Echo in Single-Agent Long-Term Memory: Lifecycle Evaluation and Provenance-Guided Mitigation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17763v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17763

**作者：** Yufeng Li、Sheng Yao、Peng Zeng、Dezhang Kong、Shi Lin、Changting Lin、Xun Wang、Meng Han

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17763v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17763v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文定义「Memory Echo」为同源历史信息在缺乏独立证据下获得的额外检索曝光，构建 MEchoBench 评估其产生、抗纠正与持续影响，并提出 Family–Provenance–Authority 框架，在四个记忆框架的 190 个固定问题上提升准确率并降低决策污染。

**相关性简评：** 该工作研究智能体长时记忆中的同源信息放大，与 LVR 主线无直接关联；但其「无新证据仍可反复主导当前决策」的问题表述，可能与 latent 迭代中状态自我强化、视觉证据筛选与溯源约束形成类比，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Memory Echo in Single-Agent Long-Term Memory: Lifecycle Evaluation and Provenance-Guided Mitigation

**abstract/A1：** Long-term memory supports agents across sessions. Repeated retrieval and write-back can let one historical claim occupy multiple retrieval positions and influence current answers without independent evidence. Existing work examines retrieval, updating, and question answering, leaving same-source record accumulation and post-correction persistence underexplored. Motivated by research in social cognition and memory psychology on repeated exposure, retrieval, and revision, we define \\emph{Memory Echo} as the excess retrieval exposure gained by historical information from the same source without additional independent evidence, and introduce MEchoBench to evaluate its emergence, correction resistance, persistence, and effect on answers. To address this phenomenon, we introduce the Family--Provenance--Authority framework (FPA). Specifically, FPA selects one representative per source family, conditions the eligibility of old records for the answer context on verified corrections, and constrains final answers with authoritative evidence. In paired replay on 190 fixed questions across four memory frameworks, FPA raises accuracy from 0.825 to 0.920 with DeepSeek V4 Flash and from 0.782 to 0.916 with Kimi K2.6; mean Decision Contamination Effect falls from 0.106 to 0.030 and from 0.109 to 0.038, respectively. These results show that agent memory can preserve traceable history without allowing repeated historical information to govern current decisions. The code is available at https://github.com/OrcasSam/memory-echo-benchmark.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17786

**作者：** Nam V. Nguyen、Hoang Van Truong、Hieu D. D.、Duy Khuong Nguyen、Quang Pham、Tung Kieu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17786v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17786v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把工业故障诊断作为传感器时序窗口分类任务，提出 Agentic4PDM：LLM agent 与各类标注参考比对、识别未决差异并提出后续测量，再由确定性 host 控制器执行契约校验的门控裁决，按证据角色区分佐证与参考信息。

**相关性简评：** 该工作的「证据可采性」、观察结果前预提交工具批次、以及佐证性与参考性证据分级，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选、停止决策与贡献分配提供可核查的类比线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Agentic4PDM: Host-Governed Evidence Admissibility for Industrial Fault Diagnosis

**abstract/A1：** We study industrial fault diagnosis as a classification task that assigns sensor time-series windows to predefined health states or fault types. Scarce labels and changing operating conditions make repeated training of specialized classifiers costly. Yet structures such as periodicity, trends, and transients can remain diagnostically informative and be examined through reusable analytical tools. LLM agents can select and interpret these tools, but fixed rules or training-derived guidance may not resolve each signal's ambiguity, while unconstrained interpretation may overstate weak or conflicting results. We introduce Agentic4PDM, a framework that separates adaptive investigation from control over evidence use. LLM agents compare each signal with labeled references from every candidate class, identify unresolved distinctions, and propose follow-up measurements. A deterministic software controller, called the host, enforces contract-checked gated adjudication (CCGA): it checks requests, requires commitment to a complete tool batch before results are observed, and assigns evidence roles based on tool checks against labeled references. These roles distinguish corroborative support from advisory information. The Judge Agent proposes a diagnosis, while the controller checks protocol compliance and records the investigation. Agentic4PDM supports training-free diagnosis using pretrained representations and labeled references without task-specific diagnostic models, and a standard setting that additionally investigates trained-model predictions. Experiments on selected bearing and motor diagnosis challenges and an unfiltered industrial test set supplied by our customer show gains in aggregate macro F1 over the evaluated diagnostic and agentic baselines. Ablations further support the value of the governed workflow.

**comment/C1：** 67 pages, 12 figures, including appendices

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17794

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文构建 GIFT-Eval-CTX 基准，在 GIFT-Eval 上汇集 20 个数据集、10000 条实例，用 LLM 发现加确定性代码校验的智能体流程，从真实未来提取 Macro/Micro 结构化效应，并评测 TSFM、前沿 LLM 与工具型智能体能否把前瞻信息转成数值轨迹。

**相关性简评：** 虽属时间序列而非多模态，但其核心问题「模型是否真的把外部给定证据转化为输出」与核查 latent/VLM 推理是否实际使用视觉证据同构；将上下文拆成全局与局部效应、并强调「文本不保证对未来有信息量」的验证式标注流程，可能为视觉证据筛选与贡献分配实验提供参照，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** GIFT-Eval-CTX: A Benchmark For Contextual Forecasting Model Evaluation

**abstract/A1：** Contextual forecasting seeks to improve time series forecasting by incorporating forward-looking information, such as planned events, external conditions, and expert expectations. However, reliable evaluation remains difficult: existing benchmarks often have limited domain coverage, lack standardized history-future splits, or provide text that is not guaranteed to inform the future. We introduce GIFT-Eval-CTX, a benchmark that isolates whether forecasting methods can translate verified future information into accurate numerical trajectories. Built upon GIFT-Eval, GIFT-Eval-CTX contains 10,000 instances across 20 datasets. Each instance provides structured effects derived from the realized future: Macro effects describe horizon-wide behavior, while Micro effects specify localized changes. We construct these annotations with an agentic pipeline combining LLM-based discovery and deterministic code validation. We benchmark TSFMs, frontier LLMs, and tool-using agentic systems. The results show that structured effects reduce aggregate relative MASE by 40.7% for GPT-5.6 Sol and 29.6% for Claude Opus 4.8 relative to history-only prompting. The evaluated MoiraiAgent system achieves the best overall result. We further analyze the contributions of structured effects and agentic systems to performance, and identify opportunities for future research.

</details>

### 774. [SPARCL: Spatially Adaptive Regional Coverage for Active Learning in Chest X-ray Analysis](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17808v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17808

**作者：** Juho Jung、Seongjae Kang、Mijoo Kim、Sungduk Cho、Yunkyoung Jun、Sunghoon Joo、Yoona Hwang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17808v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17808v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 SPARCL：面向胸片病灶分割的主动学习策略，用凹形覆盖函数对已标注区域施加递减收益以平衡预测不确定性与空间覆盖，并以熵门在无空间变化时退回标准不确定性采样，另提出 SI 与 PC 两个区域级指标衡量各轮解剖公平性。

**相关性简评：** 其「覆盖优先」证据采集与次模贪心选择可能为 LVR 中 LOOK/证据筛选提供线索，SI、PC 这类区域级而非聚合指标也可供核查用于评估 latent 视觉信息的实际使用，但属远域迁移推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** SPARCL: Spatially Adaptive Regional Coverage for Active Learning in Chest X-ray Analysis

**abstract/A1：** Pixel-level annotation for chest X-ray (CXR) lesion segmentation is expensive, making active learning (AL) essential. However, existing AL strategies fail to account for the spatial distribution of selected samples, resulting in inconsistent performance across focal (e.g., aortic calcification) and diffuse (e.g., nodules) pathologies. In this paper, we propose SPARCL (Spatially Adaptive Regional Coverage for Active Learning) to dynamically balance predictive uncertainty with cumulative spatial coverage. By employing a concave coverage function, SPARCL imposes diminishing returns on previously annotated regions, naturally directing the annotation budget toward under-labeled areas. Furthermore, an entropy gate reverts the algorithm to standard uncertainty sampling when spatial variation is absent. This coverage objective is monotone submodular, guaranteeing near-optimal greedy batch selection. To address how aggregate metrics like Dice obscure regional failures, we further introduce two metrics---Spatial Inconsistency (SI) and Performance Coverage (PC)---to quantify anatomical fairness across AL rounds. Evaluated on an in-house calcification cohort and public CXR benchmarks, SPARCL reaches 95% of fully supervised performance using only 24% of the data, compared to 29% for the best baseline. Ultimately, SPARCL ensures robust spatial reliability, surfacing regional gains that aggregate metrics miss.

**comment/C1：** 10 pages, 7 figures

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17816v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17816v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 EC2-Bench，一个面向长时程 LLM agent 执行的边云协作基准，包含可执行数字工作区任务与统一评测框架（任务表现、资源开销、隐私暴露），并实证比较多种边云协作策略。

**相关性简评：** 其核心关注「何时让云端介入」的决策与性能-资源权衡，可能为 LVR 中动态计算分配、THINK/LOOK/STOP 的收益成本权衡及停止或委托策略提供可核查的类比评价视角，但对象是文本 agent、不涉及视觉状态，联系需进一步核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Empowering Edge Agents: A Systematic Analysis of Edge-Cloud Collaboration in LLM Agent Execution

**abstract/A1：** Edge-cloud collaboration combines the lower inference overhead and greater data locality of edge-side execution with the stronger capabilities of cloud-hosted models. However, as LLM agents increasingly operate in long-horizon scenarios, cloud participation becomes interleaved throughout execution rather than a one-shot decision for each query. Such interleaved participation introduces trajectory-level effects that remain insufficiently understood. To address this gap, we introduce EC2-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating edge-cloud collaboration in long-horizon agent execution. It provides executable digital-workspace agent tasks and a unified evaluation framework covering task performance, resource usage, and privacy exposure. Using this benchmark, we empirically study diverse forms of edge-cloud collaboration. Our study reveals three findings. First, collaboration achieves a favorable balance among task performance, resource usage, and privacy exposure compared with edge-only and cloud-only execution. Second, as edge models become stronger, collaborative execution approaches cloud-only performance, and performance differences across strategies shrink, while privacy exposure remains strongly strategy-dependent. Third, stronger edge capability shifts preferred collaboration from externally controlled cloud participation and direct cloud execution toward more edge-controlled collaboration. Further analyses identify cloud-invocation decision-making and instruction following as important edge-side abilities for effective collaboration. These findings provide a systematic understanding of edge-cloud collaboration in long-horizon agent execution and insights for designing future edge agents that effectively collaborate with cloud models. Code and resources are available at https://github.com/OpenBMB/EC2-Bench.

**comment/C1：** 23 pages, 5 figures, 12 tables

</details>

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 Agentic-MatriBO：用语言策略提出贝叶斯优化配方与候选方案，由能力编译器按注册目录校验、确定性执行层验证提交，并在四个离线材料化学候选池上与八个基线做描述性比较。

**相关性简评：** 其「证据门控 + 有限预算下顺序选择下一观测/停止」的机制，可能为 LVR 中 LOOK/STOP 的证据筛选与计算分配提供概念参照，属较远领域，可供核查但需读原文确认对应程度。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Agentic-MatriBO: Capability-Compiled Agentic Bayesian Optimization for Materials and Chemical Design

**abstract/A1：** Materials and chemical optimization must choose the next synthesis, characterization, or high-fidelity simulation from sequential observations under a limited budget. Large language models can use task knowledge to propose adjustments, but composing surrogates, acquisition functions, and search strategies is constrained by compatibility, parameter dependencies, and evidence requirements. We present Agentic-MatriBO, a capability-compiled agentic Bayesian optimization (BO) framework that represents BO components and selection conditions as composable capabilities. A language policy proposes BO recipes and candidate plans; a compiler checks proposals against the registered capability catalog; and a deterministic execution layer validates and commits candidates. Oracle observations are stored in research memory and inform later rounds. We compare Agentic-MatriBO with eight baselines on four offline finite candidate pools---COF, PCE10, Buchwald--Hartwig (BH), and Suzuki--Miyaura---using five seeds per condition; results are reported descriptively. Across the four tasks, Agentic-MatriBO has the best mean endpoint quality after orienting each objective so that higher is better. On COF, it reaches the tabulated optimum in all five seeds both in the end-to-end comparison and after shared initialization, where it also retains an advantage in cumulative quality. Its normalized area under the best-so-far quality curve during the BO stage (nAUC-BO) is substantially higher on COF, near parity with the best baseline on PCE10 and BH, and lower on Suzuki. COF ablations show that removing the capability compiler or evidence gate coincides with lower cumulative quality and fewer exact-optimum hits. The framework provides an inspectable interface for evidence-conditioned BO adaptation.

**comment/C1：** 28 pages, 9 figures, supplementary information included

</details>

### 777. [Persistence Positional Encoding: A Minimal Transformer Recipe for Persistence Diagrams](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17848v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17848

**作者：** Eunwoo Heo、Ganghyun Kim、Jaejun Yoo

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17848v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17848v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究如何把 persistence diagram 的 birth-death 点对最简地接入 Transformer：只用固定随机 Fourier 特征表示每个点、保持骨干不变（PPE），在 TU8、ORBIT5K 等基准上按统一协议与各类向量化、核方法和 Transformer 模型比较，并证明网格平均在任何分辨率下都留有重构误差，而固定随机频率的 Transformer 几乎必然通用。

**相关性简评：** 其「点表示主导、骨干次要」的对照结论与网格平均的不可重构性分析，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据如何编码进 latent 状态、固定分辨率网格是否导致细节坍缩提供类比线索；原文不涉及多模态推理，属远领域启发，需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Persistence Positional Encoding: A Minimal Transformer Recipe for Persistence Diagrams

**abstract/A1：** Persistence diagrams (PDs) represent multiscale topological information as multisets of birth-death pairs $(b,d)$. How best to use them with Transformers, however, remains unclear. Connecting PDs to Transformers requires choosing how topological information is tokenized and exposed to self-attention. Prior methods use specialized designs for tokenization, aggregation, Transformer blocks, or attention, but are hard to compare since reported results rarely share PD inputs, splits, or model-selection rules. We instead confine the diagram-specific design to point representation, mapping each birth-death pair through fixed random Fourier features while leaving the Transformer backbone unchanged, and call this recipe Persistence Positional Encoding (PPE). In matched controls on eight TU graph benchmarks (TU8), changing only point representation shifts macro accuracy by 5.49 to 6.47 percentage points (pp), against 0.47 to 1.45 pp from changing the downstream module, identifying point representation as the dominant design variable tested. We further reevaluate vectorizations, kernels, learned representations, and Transformer-based models under one protocol with shared PD inputs, outer folds, and validation-only selection. Among all evaluated PD methods and downstream configurations, PPE achieves the highest mean on most benchmarks, including TU8, ORBIT5K, and MCB-C. Finally, we prove that grid averaging leaves a reconstruction error at any resolution, whereas a Transformer with fixed random Fourier frequencies is almost surely universal. PPE thus offers a minimal, Transformer-native baseline for persistence diagrams, and a common protocol for future comparison.

**comment/C1：** 25 pages, 6 figures

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17864v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17864v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在常用时序数据上发现跨时间位置与变量重复出现的主导时序关系结构，据此提出 TStruct：直接参数化一组共享时序依赖矩阵，并用动态样本信息与静态变量先验生成归一化组合权重，实现共享结构约束下的自适应依赖建模。

**相关性简评：** 其「共享结构基元＋软分配权重」替代无约束拟合的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的共享基元分解与多种 latent 假设组合提供表示建模线索，需要人工核查该类比是否成立。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** TStruct: Learning Shared Temporal Structures for Long-Term Time-Series Forecasting

**abstract/A1：** Long-term time series forecasting requires temporal dependency modeling that remains stable and generalizable under temporal distribution shifts. However, real-world time series are often noisy and non-stationary, making deep learning models prone to fitting incidental temporal interactions in the training data. A key question is whether there exist temporal relationship structures that recur across different temporal positions and variables. We analyze temporal relationship matrices on commonly used time series datasets and find that samples from different temporal positions and different variables exhibit shared dominant temporal relationship structures. This indicates that temporal relationship structures contain patterns that recur stably across samples and variables. To learn such shared structures, we propose \\textbf{T}emporal \\textbf{Struct}ure Network (\\textbf{TStruct}), a simple yet effective network for directly learning shared and generalizable temporal dependencies. Specifically, TStruct directly parameterizes a set of shared temporal dependency matrices and generates normalized combination weights using dynamic sample information and static variable priors. These weights represent a soft allocation of each sample-variable pair over shared temporal dependency structures, enabling the model to generate adaptive temporal dependency matrices under shared structural constraints, rather than fitting incidental interactions in a fully unconstrained manner. Notably, this simple structure-aware design consistently outperforms several strong baselines across all datasets, achieving superior accuracy while maintaining high computational efficiency.

**comment/C1：** This paper has been accepted to NeurIPS 2026(Main Track)

</details>

**title/T1：** RT-J: Large-Scale Pretraining of Relational Transformers for Context-Efficient Predictions

**abstract/A1：** Foundation models for tables and relational databases are increasingly used for predictive tasks across various scientific and industrial domains. However, adapting existing models to unseen datasets requires tens of thousands of examples. Here we introduce RT-J, an 85M-parameter relational foundation model (RFM) that makes accurate predictions even with hundreds of in-context examples or fewer. To achieve this, we first assemble the Join, a large collection of 639 web-crawled databases with 6,023 LLM-generated forecasting tasks. We pretrain with long contexts of up to 8,192 database cells, using in-context examples from a novel lightweight random-walk retriever. Finally, we leverage context tuning and ensembling to scale up test-time compute. On in-context regression tasks from RelBench, RT-J requires 10x fewer examples on average to match strong feature engineering pipelines with LLM-agent or RDBLearn featurizers and TabICLv2 or LightGBM predictors. Overall, our work pushes the frontier for context-efficient predictions on relational data and highlights the importance of real-world semantics, context engineering and large-scale pretraining for RFMs.

### 780. [Deep Mesoscopic Dynamics](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17885v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17885

**作者：** Yue Zhao、Shiqi Wu、Yihang Ouyang、Sergey Grebenchuk、Magdalena Grzeszczyk、Xiaoxu Zhao、Kostya S. Novoselov、Maciej Koperski、Qianxiao Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cond-mat.stat-mech、physics.comp-ph

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17885v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17885v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 DeepMesoD，用神经网络在指定粗粒化尺度上从微观轨迹学习有效介观场方程（含空间相互作用核与满足涨落耗散关系的状态依赖耗散算符），并在 Ising-Kac、二维 Heisenberg 铁磁体与层状 CrBr₃ 上验证，长时 rollout 稳定且大幅加速。

**相关性简评：** 其“指定粗粒化尺度上学得的状态更新算符”与“rollout 远超训练时域仍稳定”，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态抽象、推理状态更新与长度泛化的评价方式提供类比线索，具体可迁移性需核查（属推测）。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Deep Mesoscopic Dynamics

**abstract/A1：** Microscopic simulations resolve spatial patterns but are feasible only over small domains and short timescales, whereas bulk descriptions erase those patterns through spatial averaging. Mesoscopic fields preserve this spatial organisation, but their effective equations are known only for selected microscopic systems and scaling limits. We introduce Deep Mesoscopic Dynamics (DeepMesoD), which uses neural networks to learn an effective mesoscopic field equation from microscopic trajectories at a prescribed coarse-graining scale. For the nonconserved dissipative dynamics studied here, DeepMesoD learns the free-energy functional with a spatial interaction kernel and a state-dependent dissipation operator constrained by the fluctuation-dissipation relation. We first validate the construction in the Ising-Kac model, where the learned mesoscopic equation recovers the known hydrodynamic limit and rollouts remain stable far beyond the training horizon. We then treat two systems without closed-form mesoscopic descriptions. For a two-dimensional Heisenberg ferromagnet governed by atomistic spin dynamics, DeepMesoD learns a mesoscopic model whose predictions match atomistic references up to 1 ns, and a rollout with an unseen initial condition remains bounded up to 25 ns. For layered CrBr$\_3$, the learned kernel captures the suppression and sign reversal of interlayer coupling at a stacking fault whose location and strength are not supplied as inputs. Controlled changes to the learned interaction show how fault number and placement shape multistep magnetic responses, complementing our magneto-photoluminescence measurements. Across the two atomistic systems, DeepMesoD achieves a three-to-four-order-of-magnitude reduction in wall-clock time compared with atomistic spin dynamics.

</details>

<a id="paper-781"></a>

### 781. [Interaction-as-a-Judge](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17895v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17895

**作者：** Wayne Chi、I-Hung Hsu、Li Chen、Wei-Lin Chiang、Ion Stoica、Anastasios Nikolas Angelopoulos、Ameet Talwalkar、Chris Donahue、Cho-Jui Hsieh

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.SE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17895v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17895v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 Interaction-as-a-Judge：让 computer-use agent 直接与应用交互来评测交互式程序（网页、桌面应用、游戏），并发布含人类偏好对比与需求标注的数据集；实验显示交互式评测在预测人类偏好和核查需求上优于非交互式方法，且交互质量越高效果越好，交互在推理期可修复需求、在训练期作奖励信号可提升生成质量。

**相关性简评：** 其「交互获取证据后再判定」的范式与 LVR 关注的 LOOK/STOP 证据获取与停止决策、以及把交互结果作为训练奖励信号的贡献分配问题可能存在概念对应，可供核查；但任务域是代码应用评测，与视觉 latent 状态、多模态推理的直接联系较弱。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Interaction-as-a-Judge

**abstract/A1：** Coding agents are tasked with producing sophisticated interactive applications such as websites, desktop applications, and games. While humans assess these applications interactively, current automated LLM evaluations primarily focus on code analysis and unit tests. This mismatch can cause LLM judges to miss failures that are immediately apparent to human users. We study Interaction-as-a-Judge, an evaluation paradigm where computer-use agents (CUAs) directly interact with an application. We demonstrate that Interaction-as-a-Judge can improve both \\emph{evaluation} and \\emph{generation} of interactive applications. To this end, we collect and release two complementary datasets: $6,858$ pairs of applications with human preferences and corresponding agent traces, and $222$ applications with human-verified requirement labels. Relative to standard non-interactive approaches, we find that Interaction-as-a-Judge improves evaluation in terms of predicting human preferences ($65.6\\% \\to 69.1\\%$) and requirement verification ($77.0\\% \\to 81.6\\%$). We also observe scaling benefits: across both preference alignment and requirement verification, higher-quality interactions improve performance. Finally, through both inference- and training-time experiments, we demonstrate that Interaction-as-a-Judge can also improve the quality of generated artifacts. At inference time, Interaction-as-a-Judge repairs $75.5\\%$ of broken requirements within five attempts, compared to $55.4\\%$ for code-only self-feedback. At training time, using Interaction-as-a-Judge as a reward signal improves win-rate over the base model by $6.7$pp while reducing both generated code length by $35.7\\%$ and build failure rates by $7.2$pp compared to a code-only reward signal.

</details>

### 782. [LinMorph: Learning to Morph Weights for Efficient Video DiT Linearization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17914v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17914

**作者：** Lingyi Long、Congyue Zhao、Xiaoou Li、Yanmin Qian、Tao Huang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17914v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17914v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究 Video DiT 的高效线性化：将 softmax 注意力替换为 Gated DeltaNet 时的权重迁移建模为可学习的 softmax-to-linear morphism，跨层共享该变换以生成逐层初始化，再经渐进蒸馏恢复质量，并指出瓶颈在初始化而非事后恢复。

**相关性简评：** 其权重空间可学习变换把预训练 softmax 注意力知识迁入循环线性注意力状态模块，可能为 LVR 中把预训练 VLM 改造成带 latent/循环状态模块时的初始化与监督方式提供线索；但论文面向视频生成加速，与推理主线距离较远，线索是否可迁移需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LinMorph: Learning to Morph Weights for Efficient Video DiT Linearization

**abstract/A1：** Post-hoc linearization is an attractive way to accelerate pretrained Video Diffusion Transformers (Video DiTs), yet existing methods largely treat the quality loss induced by attention replacement as a recovery problem. We show that a more fundamental bottleneck lies upstream: \\emph{initialization}. Random initialization discards pretrained knowledge, whereas manual weight reuse transfers it through rigid and incomplete source--target correspondences. We introduce \\textbf{LinMorph}, which recasts Video DiT linearization as a learnable softmax-to-linear weight transformation problem. Instead of copying predefined counterparts, LinMorph learns a cross-parameter morphism that lets each target Gated DeltaNet (GDN) parameter draw jointly from pretrained query, key, value, and output projections, including for parameters with no direct softmax counterpart. A single morphism is shared across layers and learned through local teacher alignment, while producing layer-specific initializations from their respective pretrained weights. The resulting weights are then materialized as independent GDN modules for progressive distillation and joint recovery.Since the morphism operates in weight space rather than token space, it can be learned on short, low-resolution clips and directly reused at larger video scales. Across pretrained Video DiTs, LinMorph enables markedly faster recovery and better final generation quality than random initialization and heuristic weight reuse. Results show that efficient linearization depends not only on how a converted model is recovered, but critically on how pretrained knowledge is transferred before recovery. Project page: https://lonelyling.github.io/LinMorph.

</details>

### 783. [Sea-Net: A Small and Inherently Interpretable Neural Network for Time Series Classification](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17939v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17939

**作者：** Ubaid Ur Rehman、Tanmoy Mondal

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17939v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17939v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 SEA-Net：用轻量多尺度深度可分离卷积编码器配合改进的 MIL 池化头（Top-k、门控变体），在时间序列分类上同时输出类别预测与时间区间层面的解释，并以约 41K–62K 参数取得优于 MILLET（约 424K 参数）的准确率与 NDCG@n 解释分数。

**相关性简评：** 其 MIL 池化对「哪些时间点/区间支撑预测」的显式选择与解释评分，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与「LOOK」决策评价提供建模与指标线索；但对象是 1D 时间序列、非生成式 latent 推理状态，迁移可行性需人工核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Sea-Net: A Small and Inherently Interpretable Neural Network for Time Series Classification

**abstract/A1：** Traditional time-series classification methods often operate as black boxes, providing a class prediction without indicating which time point or time interval within the series led to that prediction. To improve temporal interpretability, MILLET (Multiple Instance Learning with Temporal Explanation), which combines an InceptionTime encoder with Conjunctive Pooling, provides both classification and temporal explanations. However, MILLET contains approximately 424 K parameters, making it unsuitable for deployment on resource-constrained micro-controllers, and it achieves an overall time-series accuracy of 0.888 and an explanation score of 0.681 NDCG@n. We therefore propose SEA-Net, a lightweight architecture using small multi-scale depthwise-separable convolutional TSC encoders and improved Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) pooling heads. Our SEA-Net bottleneck encoder with Top-k pooling achieves 0.931 accuracy and 0.765 NDCG@n with only 41 K parameters. Another variant, using a gated encoder with Top-k pooling, achieves 0.955 accuracy and 0.750 NDCG@n with 62 K parameters. These results demonstrate that lightweight architectures can maintain strong classification performance and temporal explanations while substantially reducing model size. The proposed variants address specific limitations of the pooling strategy used by MILLET, providing a practical direction for interpretable time-series classification on resource-constrained edge devices.

</details>

### 784. [Improving Neural Symbolic Regression with a Diverse Prior and Post-training Alignment](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17994v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17994

**作者：** David Otte、Jörg K. H. Franke、Frank Hutter

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17994v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17994v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 RASR，通过更贴近真实数据的合成先验，以及「监督预训练＋强化学习后训练」两阶段训练来改进神经符号回归，并在 SRBench 2.0、Strogatz、Feynman 上与遗传规划等方法比较。

**相关性简评：** 主题远离视觉多模态主线，但其以留出拟合度为奖励、并惩罚表达式长度以对齐推理期用法的后训练，可能为 LVR 的轨迹监督、贡献分配与推理长度／停止控制提供借鉴线索，值得核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Improving Neural Symbolic Regression with a Diverse Prior and Post-training Alignment

**abstract/A1：** Symbolic regression is the problem of finding an expression that fits a dataset. Solving it requires searching a combinatorial space of candidate expressions. Neural symbolic regression can amortize that search by training a model once on synthetic data and then predicting expressions for a new dataset. But existing models still underperform genetic programming on real, noisy data. We argue that the deficit lies in the training rather than in the paradigm, and present RASR (Reinforced Amortized Symbolic Regression), a method with two key changes to the training recipe. First, we design a synthetic prior that narrows the gap with real-world data: inputs come from the prior of a tabular foundation model; constants are sampled bottom-up, conditioned on the data; targets carry heteroscedastic and structured noise; and everything is standardized. Second, we split training into two stages. Supervised pre-training maximizes the token-level likelihood of a reference expression. This is followed by reinforcement-learning post-training that aligns the model with its inference-time use by rewarding held-out fit and penalizing expression size. On the black-box track of SRBench 2.0, RASR achieves the best mean test $R^2$ rank of all evaluated methods. Three RASR variants, trained with different size penalties, make up most of the accuracy-complexity Pareto front. On Strogatz, our method recovers more ground-truth expressions than any baseline, and on Feynman it is competitive with the best-performing methods.

</details>

### 785. [Saliency-Guided Replay for Continual Learning in Deep Spiking Neural Networks](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17998v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.17998

**作者：** Francesco Panetta、Federico Di Valerio、Michela Proietti

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI、cs.CV、cs.NE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17998v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.17998v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究低延迟约束下深层脉冲神经网络（SNN）的持续学习，用 Batch Normalization Through Time 稳定的 VGG9 结合脉冲激活图（SAM）生成空间注意力图，据此挑选信息量高的图像块进行回放以缓解灾难性遗忘，在 Split CIFAR10/100 上验证精度与存储的权衡。

**相关性简评：** 其「用显著性/注意力图筛选值得保留的视觉证据」的思路，可能与 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与有限预算下的信息保留问题有概念联系，但领域为 SNN 持续学习；能否迁移到推理期状态选择尚需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Saliency-Guided Replay for Continual Learning in Deep Spiking Neural Networks

**abstract/A1：** Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) are promising for energy-efficient neuromorphic computing, but they still suffer from catastrophic forgetting when learning tasks sequentially. This work investigates the integration of Experience Packing and Replay (EPR) as a memory-efficient continual learning strategy for deep SNNs under low-latency constraints. The proposed framework combines Batch Normalization Through Time stabilized VGG9 SNNs with Spike Activation Maps (SAM), which provide forward-only explanations based on spike activity. These explanations are temporally aggregated into spatial attention maps and used to select the most informative image patches for replay, instead of storing full images. Experiments on Split CIFAR10 and Split CIFAR100 show that SAM-guided EPR improves the accuracy-memory trade-off under tight memory budgets, and remains competitive while requiring substantially less storage.

**comment/C1：** Streaming Continual Learning Workshop. In post-proceeding of International Workshops of ECML PKDD 2026

</details>

### 786. [Beyond Black Boxes: Visual Grounding for Text Embeddings](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18047v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18047

**作者：** Slimane Larabi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18047v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18047v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 sketch-based visual grounding 框架，把文本嵌入转成视觉地形草图，动机是可解释性、检索与「mental imagery」式推理，并在 MS-COCO 上比较 SBERT 与草图方法的文本检索表现及级联效果。

**相关性简评：** 其「把语义表示落成视觉草图」的思路可能与 LVR 中视觉内容作为内部推理媒介的表示问题有概念联系，可供核查；但论文聚焦文本嵌入可解释性与文本检索，未涉及 VLM 推理状态生成、证据使用或停止决策。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Beyond Black Boxes: Visual Grounding for Text Embeddings

**abstract/A1：** In this paper, our goal is to represent text embeddings as sketches for three main reasons. First, to visualize text representation and to explore their potential their potential for AI explainability. Second, to investigate the potential benefits of the sketch-based representation for information retrieval. Third, to explore their potential for reasoning, drawing inspiration from the concept of mental imagery. We propose a sketch-based visual grounding framework that transforms text representations into visual topographic sketches. Our approach aims to emphasis the semantics content encoded in the text embeddings through the corresponding sketch. Evaluations are conducted on the MS-COCO dataset to examine the utility of these sketches for text retrieval. The comparative study of SBERT and Sketch-based method reveals that SBERT retains an advantage in strict top-1 retrieval accuracy while achieving comparable performance to the sketch-based method in top-5 retrieval. A cascaded approach combining SBERT and the sketch-based method outperforms SBERT alone, suggesting that the Sketch-based representation could offer significant potential for information retrieval if trained directly on text.

</details>
