### 787. [Can Agents Forget When Asked? A Benchmark for Memory Unlearning in LLM Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18052v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18052

**作者：** Bofan Xie、Chaokun Wang、Guanchen Ge、Songyao Wang、Fang Niu、Hang Zhang、Wei Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18052v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18052v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出 Bemula——首个面向 LLM 智能体长时记忆「遗忘」的基准，含 50 组多轮对话、135 条六类遗忘请求与 1742 个测试问题，用无请求对照版本和五套测试分别衡量存储、删除、无关记忆保持、相似事实再学习与抗抽取攻击，并在六种记忆系统和多种主干模型上得到普遍失败的负面结果。

**相关性简评：** 虽为纯文本智能体记忆、与视觉推理无关，但其「先验证已存储、再检验定向移除、并考察无关内容是否受损」的对照式探测思路，可能可供核查地迁移为检验 latent 状态中特定视觉证据能否被精确定位与移除、而不破坏其余表征的评价设计。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Can Agents Forget When Asked? A Benchmark for Memory Unlearning in LLM Agents

**abstract/A1：** Long-term memory has become a core component of large language model (LLM) agents. As agents accumulate personal information over long-term use, users increasingly ask them to delete sensitive or outdated facts. A memory system should honor such requests. It should remove exactly what was requested and keep the rest of its memory intact. However, existing memory benchmarks evaluate only memory writing, retrieval, and organization, so whether agents can forget at the user's explicit request remains under-evaluated. To address this gap, we propose Bemula, the first benchmark dedicated to memory unlearning. It comprises 50 multi-session dialogue instances, 135 forget requests of six types, and 1,742 test questions. Each dialogue has a control version without the requests, so that only systems that have stored the target can earn credit for forgetting. Across the paired versions, five test suites measure storage, removal of the requested information, preservation of unrelated memories, relearning of similar facts, and resistance to extraction attacks. On Bemula, we evaluate six mainstream memory systems under three backbone LLMs, together with the Full Context LLM on two of them. The results are negative. Across all evaluated systems and backbones, no system passes more than 1.5% of forget requests end to end, and most pass none at all. These systems either leave the requested information extractable under simple attacks or delete far more than requested. Memory unlearning therefore remains an open challenge for agent memory design. We release our data and code at https://github.com/Nboxff/bemula-benchmark.

</details>

### 788. [Uncertainty Evaluation: Bridging Machine Learning and Measurement Science](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18066v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18066

**作者：** Dario Petri、Luca Mari

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18066v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18066v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文对比机器学习不确定度评估与计量科学（GUM 框架）的概念演进，指出将 ML 不确定度分为 aleatoric 与 epistemic 如同区分随机与系统误差一样依赖模型，主张改用系统识别、量化并传播不确定度来源的度量学式框架来评估单个预测的可信度。

**相关性简评：** 其不确定度来源分解与「结果级/过程级质量」、分布偏移下评估有效性的讨论，可能为 LVR 中 latent 内容贡献分配、停止决策及评价可信度提供概念参照，但全文不涉及视觉或多模态推理，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Uncertainty Evaluation: Bridging Machine Learning and Measurement Science

**abstract/A1：** Reliable uncertainty evaluation is essential for assessing the trustworthiness of machine learning (ML) predictions, particularly in safety-critical applications. This paper explores conceptual analogies between uncertainty evaluation in ML and measurement science, drawing on the evolution of metrology from error-based approaches to the framework established by the Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement (GUM). Particular attention is devoted to the distinction between process-level and result-level quality and to the limitations of the conventional classification of ML uncertainty into aleatoric and epistemic components. It is argued that this dichotomy, similarly to the traditional distinction between random and systematic measurement errors, is inherently model-dependent and provides an insufficient basis for a unified uncertainty evaluation framework. Further analogies between machine learning and measurement field of knowledge are identified concerning distribution shifts, anomalous operating conditions, and the validity of uncertainty evaluation. Building on the proposed considerations, the paper advocates a metrology-inspired approach based on the systematic identification, quantification, and propagation of uncertainty contributions. By extending the methodology already established in measurement science to ML, this approach could offer a potentially rigorous, consistent, and transferable framework for evaluating the trustworthiness of individual predictions.

</details>

<a id="paper-789"></a>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18083

**作者：** Wenhao Zhou、Jiajun Song、Haitao Wang、Zipeng Qiu、Yingqi Peng、Ruida Xu、Jiale Li、Wenshuang Li、Shusheng Xu、Wei Dong、Hao Dai、Tongkai Yang、Yi Gao、Binhang Yuan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18083v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18083v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 AReaL-RSI：由 leader agent 分配研究方向、条件化共享记忆、并在每轮用基于证据的评审更新研究者的方向与知识，组织长期多智能体研究，不更新主干权重，按评估结果与整体资源开销衡量扩展效果。

**相关性简评：** 远领域工作，其按「未解决/已支持」区分记忆共享内容、以及以系统总开销衡量扩展的做法，可能可供核查 latent 证据筛选与动态计算成本评价的类比；未涉及视觉或 latent 推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AReaL-RSI: Adaptive Scaling and Coordination of Recursive Self-Improvement

**abstract/A1：** Scaling recursive self-improvement requires additional computation to produce useful research progress in reaching persistent objectives. Intuitively, more researcher agents can explore more hypotheses, but early evaluation scores might misrepresent their promise, shared findings could lose their applicability conditions, and useful procedures could remain confined to completed investigations. In this paper, we present AReaL-RSI, a framework for organizing a persistent research team of agents without updating backbone LLM weights. We formulate the scaling problem in terms of evaluated outcomes and whole-system resource expenditure. Concretely, a leader agent selects task-appropriate research orientations and guides ongoing investigations; conditional memory sharing distinguishes unresolved problems from supported findings and enables recipient adaptation. During recursive evolution, after each campaign, evidence-based review revises researcher orientation, knowledge, and skills for later campaigns. Experiments compare AReaL-RSI with Codex-Goal on downstream harness optimization, GPU kernel optimization, and AI research tasks using two backbones. Under the reported resource allocations, AReaL-RSI improves Terminal Bench performance by 2.2 percentage points for each backbone and increases mean KernelBench speedup by 32.2-36.8%; further scalability comparisons favor the design of AReaL-RSI over native scaling: combining experience sharing with specialized researcher roles yields 1.9-27.5% lower kernel latency than independent exploration and 1.3-33.9% lower latency than sharing alone across all seven comparable task-backbone pairs.

**comment/C1：** 12 pages

</details>

### 790. [Same Function, Different Trajectory: No Standard Optimizer Is Equivariant to Transformer Reparameterization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18085v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18085

**作者：** Bum Jun Kim

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.NE

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18085v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18085v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文指出表示同一函数的两种 Transformer 参数化会在标准优化器下走出不同训练轨迹，理论分析表明块局部一阶优化器对这类重参数化不具等变性，并提出 SAGGS 与 Soft SAGGS，通过周期性均衡对称矩阵对的 Frobenius 范数修正尺度失衡，在语言模型上降低 PPL。

**相关性简评：** 重参数化对称与梯度尺度均衡属于表示/梯度几何议题，可能为循环或权重共享的 latent 推理模块训练中的尺度失衡与状态均衡提供可供核查的线索，但原文未涉及多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Same Function, Different Trajectory: No Standard Optimizer Is Equivariant to Transformer Reparameterization

**abstract/A1：** We show that two Transformers representing the same function can follow different training trajectories. For example, doubling a query matrix and halving its key matrix preserves the model's function but changes the gradient scales seen by the optimizer. Our theoretical analysis establishes that standard block-local first-order optimizers fail to scale updates with parameters under a shared learning rate. For AdamW, transforming the first- and second-moment estimates alone does not correct the mismatch between parameter and update scales. To make runs restarted from equivalent checkpoints follow the same trajectory, we balance matrix pairs and transform their moment estimates together, bringing distinct but equivalent training states to the same starting point. To correct scale imbalance between paired Transformer matrices without changing predictions, we propose Symmetry-Aware Gradient Geometry Stabilization (SAGGS), which periodically equalizes the Frobenius norms of exact symmetry pairs, and its damped variant, Soft SAGGS. SAGGS reduces perplexity (PPL) by $0.374\\pm0.026$ at 101M parameters on WikiText-103, and Soft SAGGS reduces PPL by $0.780\\pm0.040$ in a 31M modern-architecture replication, both under scale imbalance. In a 123.8M checkpoint-resume experiment, reciprocally rescaling matrix pairs barely changes validation loss at restart but increases final PPL by $3.78\\pm0.42$; hard and soft rebalancing recover to within $0.02$ PPL of the control.

**comment/C1：** 55 pages, 8 figures

</details>

### 791. [ResearchFlow-Eval: Tracing the Execution Gap in End-to-End Multi-Claim Autoresearch](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18088v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18088

**作者：** Peng Jiang、Dongyang Li、Quanying Liu、Xiaoxuan Jia

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18088v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18088v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 ResearchFlow-Eval 框架，以已发表论文为锚，按研究阶段与 claim 层级设计评分细则，评估多个 autoresearch/agent 系统在连续多阶段流程中的多 claim 完成与跨尝试修订能力，发现实验执行普遍落后于设计与规划。

**相关性简评：** 其按阶段与 claim 分解、并对多次尝试修订做过程级打分的方式，可能为 LVR 中推理轨迹（而非仅最终答案）的过程性评价、迭代与停止决策提供借鉴，但该文不涉及视觉或 latent 状态，rubric 是否可迁移需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** ResearchFlow-Eval: Tracing the Execution Gap in End-to-End Multi-Claim Autoresearch

**abstract/A1：** Autoresearch systems increasingly undertake entire research projects. In practice, scientific research requires systems to pursue multiple interdependent claims through a continuous, multi-stage workflow and revise experiments as evidence accumulates. Existing evaluations of autoresearch systems, however, typically score isolated tasks or final artifacts, leaving these process-level capabilities largely unmeasured. We therefore introduce ResearchFlow-Eval, a fine-grained framework for assessing continuous scientific execution and iteration at both the stage and claim levels. Each evaluation is grounded in a published anchor paper, from which we derive stage-specific rubrics that decompose each research stage into dimensions and separately scored rubric items. Using these rubrics, we score each research stage and examine experimental execution in detail, focusing on multi-claim completion and revisions across attempts. We apply the evaluation framework to general-purpose agent harnesses, skill-augmented harnesses, and systems with research-specific orchestration. Across all evaluated systems, experimental execution consistently lags behind design and planning. Within execution, systems struggle to produce high-quality results and meet claim requirements, and repeated attempts rarely yield measurable improvements. Moreover, neither skill augmentation nor research-specific orchestration reliably yields higher scores. ResearchFlow-Eval thus extends autoresearch evaluation beyond isolated, single-objective runs to continuous workflows in which systems pursue multiple claims and refine their work across iterations.

**comment/C1：** 24 pages, 6 figures

</details>

### 792. [When Missingness Follows the Graph: Beyond Feature Propagation for Missing Features](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18113v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18113

**作者：** Enrico Chialà、Francesco Ferrini、Antonio Longa、Bruno Lepri、Filippo Maria Bianchi、Manfred Jaeger、Veronica Lachi

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18113v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18113v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文指出 GNN 特征缺失研究中普遍假设缺失独立均匀，转而形式化「图结构化的缺失依赖」，并理论加实验分析传播式方法的失效，进而提出 PEMix：在消息传递前用全局结构表示条件化不完整节点特征的概率模型。

**相关性简评：** 其把「缺失」视为受结构约束、需显式概率建模的潜状态并先用结构信息条件化，可能为 LVR 中不完整或遮挡视觉证据的显式建模、以及视觉信息坍缩的诊断提供概念线索；属较远领域，迁移需人工核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When Missingness Follows the Graph: Beyond Feature Propagation for Missing Features

**abstract/A1：** Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) commonly assume that node features are fully observed, despite missing features being pervasive in real-world applications. By leveraging the dependence between node features and graph structure, existing graph-specific methods handle missingness by propagating observed feature values along graph edges. However, these methods have mainly been evaluated in overly optimistic settings, where feature entries are removed independently and uniformly across the graph. This overlooks realistic scenarios in which missingness propagates among connected nodes, as can occur during localized sensing failures in sensor networks. We formalize this complementary notion as graph-structured mask dependence, where the joint distribution of missingness indicators is shaped by the graph, and introduce a controlled mechanism that instantiates this setting. We study propagation-based methods theoretically and empirically in this setting, showing that their effectiveness changes substantially compared with the uniformly random regime. Motivated by this limitation, we propose PEMix, designed to remain effective under challenging graph-structured missingness. Rather than propagating observed values, PEMix uses global structural representations to condition a probabilistic model of incomplete node features before message passing. Experiments under controlled graph-structured missingness and naturally occurring missingness show that PEMix remains robust across complex missingness regimes, with particularly strong performance as missingness becomes severe.

**comment/C1：** 29 pages, 3 figures

</details>

### 793. [Human-Inspired Asymmetric Collaboration for Dual-Student Semi-Supervised Medical Image Segmentation](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18133v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18133

**作者：** Huiyi Ren、Ziming Fang、Jiaming Cai、Rui Xu、Haojie Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18133v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18133v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文面向半监督医学图像分割，提出 HAC 双学生非对称协作框架：以窗口级强化学习动态校准强增强难度，并用 Gramian 几何保持约束（全局体积与成对面积）防止共享监督使两个学生同质化。在 LA、Pancreas、BraTS-2019 上验证分割效果与难度校准能力。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接关系，但 G2PC 这类显式保持表示几何、抵抗监督导致的同质化（坍缩）的约束，以及用训练反馈闭环调节难度的机制，可能为核查 latent 状态表征坍缩与动态计算分配提供借鉴线索，需人工确认可迁移性。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Human-Inspired Asymmetric Collaboration for Dual-Student Semi-Supervised Medical Image Segmentation

**abstract/A1：** Dual-student learning enriches predictive diversity in SSMIS by introducing a strongly augmented view alongside a weakly augmented view. Insufficient strong augmentation may homogenize the students, whereas excessive augmentation can corrupt anatomical evidence and destabilize collaboration. This challenge echoes feedback-regulated human instruction, where learners receive differentiated tasks and the task difficulty is continually adjusted according to their evolving responses. Inspired by these, we propose Human-Inspired Asymmetric Collaboration (HAC), a closed-loop dual-student framework that maintains weak--strong learning through adaptive difficulty calibration and geometry preservation. Specifically, Reinforcement-guided Difficulty Calibration (RDC) formulates strong-augmentation control as a window-level reinforcement learning process, using augmentation history, realized perturbations, and training responses to dynamically adjust the augmentation magnitude, operation number, and magnitude range. Meanwhile, the Gramian Geometry Preservation Constraint (G2PC) preserves the early-stage three-branch geometry through global volume and pairwise area constraints, preventing shared supervision from homogenizing the two students. Comprehensive evaluations across LA, Pancreas, and BraTS-2019 validate both the segmentation effectiveness and capability-aware difficulty calibration of HAC.

</details>

### 794. [Learning a Group Element from Its Action: Galois Correspondences, Optimal ERM, and an Abel-Ruffini Threshold for the Natarajan Dimension](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18154v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18154

**作者：** Xiaoyu Li

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、math.GR、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18154v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18154v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究从作用样例 (x, gx) 学习未知群元素的问题：用 Galois 对应把多类维度（DS、图、Littlestone、教学维数）化归为群不变量，证明对称性下 ERM 在可实现与不可知情形均达最优样本复杂度上限，并给出 Natarajan 维数出现缺口的 Abel-Ruffini 型阈值。

**相关性简评：** 「从作用反推变换并刻画一致假设集」的视角与群不变量刻画容量，可能为 LVR 中视觉等变表示的保留方式以及训练监督/容量与样本复杂度分析提供概念线索，可供核查，但与原论文主线无直接交集。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning a Group Element from Its Action: Galois Correspondences, Optimal ERM, and an Abel-Ruffini Threshold for the Natarajan Dimension

**abstract/A1：** We study learning an unknown element $g$ of a group acting with finite orbits on a countable set, from examples $(x,gx)$. After a sample on $A$, the consistent hypotheses are the restrictions of a coset of the pointwise stabilizer of $A$, and the sample forces exactly the labels of points this stabilizer fixes; for a Galois group, they form the field generated by the data. Through this correspondence, multiclass dimensions become group invariants: the DS and graph dimensions equal the height, the Littlestone dimension the longest irredundant sequence length, and the teaching dimension the minimal base size. Among deterministic learners, symmetry makes empirical risk minimization optimal: on nondegenerate classes every consistent learner, whatever its tie-breaking, attains the optimal realizable sample complexity up to constant factors, and every consistent online learner the optimal mistake bound. Agnostically, every ERM's sample complexity exceeds the known lower bound by at most the DS-to-Natarajan ratio, up to constants. For finite Galois extensions of countable fields, the Natarajan dimension equals a group invariant, the coset-cube number, which is at least the number of complemented factors of any chief series of any subgroup. Hence the dimensions coincide for every solvable Galois group, while for the groups $A\_5$ and $S\_5$ of the quintic they are $2&lt;3$ and $3&lt;4$, and $A\_5$ is the smallest group with a gap. For the Galois group $S\_n$ of the general equation of degree $n$, they coincide exactly when $n\\le 4$, i.e., in characteristic zero, exactly when the equation is solvable by radicals; the implication is one-way, as the simple group $\\mathrm{PSL}(2,8)$ has no gap. For linear, orthogonal and unitary maps of $\\mathbb R^d$ or $\\mathbb C^d$ both dimensions equal $d$, and a two-fibered pseudo-cube is a disjoint union of Natarajan cubes exactly when its monodromy group is abelian.

**comment/C1：** 55 pages, 5 figures. The abstract has been shortened to meet arXiv's submission requirements

</details>

### 795. [When Do Learned Blocks Preserve Causal Meaning? Block Identifiability and Constructive Causal Abstractions](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18155v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18155

**作者：** Karim Zaghw、Wieland Brendel、Patrik Reizinger

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18155v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18155v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文把「块可辨识性」与构造性因果抽象联系起来，证明块对角可逆变换加兼容坐标置换构成保留此类因果抽象的最大变换类，并用加性自编码器的合成实验说明高层干预可在独立学得的表示间近似迁移。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 关心的「内部状态是否保留任务必要信息及其因果作用」可能相关：其最大变换类结论可供核查 latent 表示在坐标变换下因果意义保持的边界，但该工作面向一般表示学习理论，与视觉多模态推理尚无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When Do Learned Blocks Preserve Causal Meaning? Block Identifiability and Constructive Causal Abstractions

**abstract/A1：** Standard identifiability theory assumes one-dimensional latent factors, but learned representations can encode latent information across multidimensional blocks whose internal coordinates are not uniquely determined. When such blocks are used to represent and intervene on higher-level concepts, it is unclear whether their causal meaning survives the transformations left unresolved by block-identifiability. We connect block-identifiability to constructive causal abstraction. We show that block-diagonal invertible transformations followed by compatible coordinate permutations form the maximal class that preserves every constructive causal abstraction built on those blocks. This guarantee assumes that the correspondence between blocks and concepts is updated with the representation. A small synthetic experiment with additive autoencoders shows that high-level interventions can be transferred between independently learned representations while approximately preserving their intended effects.

</details>

### 796. [When and How Order-Flow Interventions Work After Dealers Adapt](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18158v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18158

**作者：** Guanghao Wu、Zhuo Cai、Zhidong Li、Shoujin Wang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18158v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18158v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究做市商自适应后订单流干预何时以及为何有效，提出 SOFA 合约，由 State Scorer 从滞后公开数据给市场状态打分、Commitment Scheduler 在报价前预先公布干预强度、Quote-to-Flow Allocator 把固定客户需求的一部分导向更紧报价，并用配对再适应协议在 ABIDES 市场中逐条切断组件来归因。

**相关性简评：** 其「配对再适应、一次只切断一个环节、并让竞争规则共享同一干预强度」的因果归因设计，可能可供核查 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 等机制贡献分配与计算预算对照实验的评估方法，但领域距离较远，属推测性迁移线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When and How Order-Flow Interventions Work After Dealers Adapt

**abstract/A1：** Learning dealer agents can settle on persistently wide quotes, raising what customers pay to trade. A venue can route more orders to tighter quotes, but a wide quote may reflect real risk, and once dealers adapt, an end-to-end comparison cannot show why a rule works: because it intervenes more, picks better moments, is announced in advance, or rewards the right quote. We propose SOFA (State-aligned Order-Flow Allocation), a public order-flow contract with three parts: a State Scorer ranks market states from lagged public data, a Commitment Scheduler announces a budgeted intervention strength before dealers quote, and a Quote-to-Flow Allocator shifts a bounded share of fixed customer demand toward tighter quotes. Our paired re-adaptation protocol gives competing rules the same intervention strengths, only re-timed, lets dealers re-adapt to each rule from a shared checkpoint, and breaks one link at a time. Across 20 independently trained dealer populations in an ABIDES market, concentrating the intervention in states that the score ranks as low-risk lowers low-risk execution cost relative to random timing in every population, by 0.040 tick on average, while a stale announcement or a broken quote-to-flow link raises this cost. In the primary setting the gain comes at the expense of high-risk trades, whose costs rise, so state alignment pays off only for a venue that weighs low-risk costs more than 1.38 times as heavily as high-risk costs. Our code is available at https://github.com/moderncavemann/state-aligned-order-flow-contracts.

</details>

### 797. [Random Probing for Structural Self-Interactions in Graph Neural Networks](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18164v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18164

**作者：** Saku Peltonen、H. Çağrı Bilgi、Kubilay Atasu

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 DIAL 消息传递层，用随机探针让节点以可学习、置换等变的方式访问图算子的对角元，使模型能表达环路计数、子图中心性与热核签名等结构特征，并在分子性质预测、环路计数与模式检测上验证。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 无直接关联，但「用随机探针把结构量注入节点状态而非依赖高阶架构」的思路，可能为研究 latent 推理状态如何保留并读取几何/结构证据提供可供核查的线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Random Probing for Structural Self-Interactions in Graph Neural Networks

**abstract/A1：** Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) fundamentally lack the ability to capture structural properties defined by node self-interactions, such as cycle counts, subgraph centrality, and heat kernel signatures. Existing solutions often rely on computationally expensive higher-order architectures or hand-crafted features. In this work, we introduce DIAL, a message-passing layer that gives nodes access to graph structure through the diagonal of graph-derived operators. Our approach uses randomized probing to provide nodes with learnable, permutation equivariant access to diagonal entries. We prove that our approach can express important structural features, including cycle counts, subgraph centrality, and heat kernel signatures. The proposed method can be integrated directly into message passing layers. Experiments on molecular property prediction, cycle counting, and pattern detection demonstrate the effectiveness of DIAL across a range of graph learning tasks.

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18198

**作者：** Naixing Xu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18198v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18198v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 QORH，把查询相关的规则头与有序规则体联合编码为超边，用置信度、覆盖率等统计证据做可学习规则选择，并通过角色感知的超图消息传递增强关系表示，以支持归纳式知识图谱链路预测。

**相关性简评：** 属较远领域（知识图谱链路预测），但「查询条件下有序规则体的组合编码 + 基于置信度/覆盖率的可学习规则筛选」可能为 LVR 中结构化推理状态表示、视觉证据筛选与监督贡献分配提供类比线索，是否可迁移需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** QORH: Learning Query-Specific Ordered Rule Hypergraphs for Inductive Knowledge Graph Link Prediction

**abstract/A1：** Knowledge graph link prediction involving unseen entities and relations requires learning transferable reasoning patterns from observed graph structure. Existing methods based on relation graphs primarily capture pairwise dependencies, limiting their ability to preserve the compositional semantics, relation ordering, and role information of complete path rules. To address this limitation, we propose QORH (Query-specific Ordered Rule Hypergraph), which jointly encodes rule heads and ordered rule bodies as hyperedges conditioned on the query relation, explicitly modeling joint dependencies among multiple relations. QORH performs learnable rule selection using statistical evidence, such as rule confidence and coverage, and enhances relation representations through role-aware hypergraph message passing to guide entity-level reasoning. The model's shared parameters are independent of specific entity or relation identifiers, enabling inductive prediction for unseen entities and relations. Extensive experiments on entity-inductive and fully inductive benchmarks demonstrate that QORH significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art baselines included in our evaluation, validating the effectiveness of rule hypergraph modeling for inductive link prediction.

</details>

### 799. [Operator Surrogates](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18210v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18210

**作者：** Christoph Schwab、Josephine Westermann、Jakob Zech

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18210v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18210v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该章节数学性地介绍算子代理：以有限参数映射近似无穷维函数空间之间的（通常非线性）算子，梳理编码器-近似器-解码器范式、各类表示系统（Banach frame、PCA、主动子空间、非线性自编码器）、谱方法与 FNO/transformer 等架构，并讨论近似与泛化误差的收敛率理论。

**相关性简评：** 其「编码到有限维隐空间—处理—解码」框架与算法展开（迭代/循环计算）可能为 LVR 的 latent 状态维度选择、循环更新与参数-误差界提供思路，但领域相距较远，联系属推测，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Operator Surrogates

**abstract/A1：** This chapter provides a mathematical introduction to operator surrogates, which are finite-parametric maps approximating complex (typically nonlinear) operators between infinite-dimensional (function) spaces. A typical approach to constructing operator surrogates is the encoder-approximator-decoder paradigm, whereby infinite-dimensional inputs are mapped to a finite-dimensional latent space, processed, and then mapped back to the infinite-dimensional output space. We discuss various methods for creating efficient representation systems, including stable linear frameworks like Banach frames and data-driven techniques such as Principal Component Analysis (PCA), Active Subspaces, and nonlinear autoencoders. Subsequently, we survey key surrogate architectures, contrasting spectral methods, based on polynomial chaos expansions and related technologies, with more recent neural network approaches. We further discuss architectures that do not rely on representation systems, such as Fourier Neural Operators and transformers. We elaborate on their relationship and how they relate to other neural network operator surrogates, particularly those obtained by so-called "algorithm-unrolling". Additionally, we provide an introduction to the theoretical analysis of approximation and generalization errors. We explain how underlying low-dimensional structures, provided for example by holomorphy, are essential to overcome the so-called "curse of dimensionality": this refers to the fact that the complexity of numerical algorithms tends to increase exponentially in the problem dimensionality. We present convergence rate bounds for holomorphic operators that depend on the number of trainable parameters and the regularity of the input and output data. Throughout, we prioritize intuition over detailed technical proofs and provide precise pointers to the literature for detailed arguments.

</details>

### 800. [Optimal Online Regret for Context-Lumpable Bandits](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18258v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18258

**作者：** Chenyu Lu、Zihan Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18258v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18258v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究未知 context-lumpable 结构的随机上下文老虎机：以 dyadic 精度层级、置信度早停与跨 context 消除设计算法，得到 Õ(√(r(S+K)T)) 遗憾并改进先前上界一个 r 因子。

**相关性简评：** 将 context 分块视为状态聚合/抽象，其置信早停与多尺度探索分配可能为 LVR 的停止决策、按需分配计算及冗余 latent 状态合并提供概念类比，具体可迁移性有待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Optimal Online Regret for Context-Lumpable Bandits

**abstract/A1：** We study stochastic contextual bandits with an unknown context-lumpable structure. The $S$ contexts are partitioned into $r$ blocks, and every arm has the same mean reward across contexts in the same block. Under arbitrary context distributions and without separation assumptions, we design an algorithm with expected regret $\\widetilde{O}(\\sqrt{r(S+K)T})$, matching the lower bound of Lee et al. (2023) up to logarithmic factors and improving their previous upper bound by a factor of $r$. The algorithm operates over dyadic accuracy levels, using a baseline policy and confidence-based early stopping to control exploration. It then performs cross-context elimination: since rewards are identical within a block, one selected arm eliminates all surviving records from that block, requiring at most $r$ selections at each level. Multi-scale exploration assigns finer accuracies to frequent blocks and coarser accuracies to rare blocks, yielding a near-optimal arm for every block while keeping the weighted policy error small.

</details>

### 801. [Reliable Risk Estimation with Kernel Mean Matching under Dependent Sampling](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18292v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18292

**作者：** Alexey Zaytsev、Diana Koldasbayeva、Egor Serov

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18292v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18292v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究依赖采样（几何强混合过程）下核均值匹配（KMM）的有限样本风险估计，用基于高斯过程假设的有效样本量替换经典证明中的名义样本量，得到分离重叠、依赖性与损失平滑度影响的界，并在合成实验与真实监控数据上给出覆盖率更好的预测置信区间。

**相关性简评：** 与 LVR 主线无直接关联，但其依赖采样下的有效样本量刻画及「更平滑损失保留更多依赖、降低有效样本量」的权衡，可能可供核查地借用于评估共享前缀或时序相关的多条推理轨迹与 latent 状态统计；迁移属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Reliable Risk Estimation with Kernel Mean Matching under Dependent Sampling

**abstract/A1：** Kernel Mean Matching (KMM) estimates risk under covariate shift by reweighting labelled source samples so that their kernel mean embedding matches that of unlabeled target samples. Existing finite-sample guarantees are usually stated for independent samples, although many applications involve temporal, spatial, or clustered dependence. We give a finite-sample KMM analysis under dependent sampling by replacing nominal sample sizes with effective sample sizes in the concentration steps used by the classical proof. The approach uses Bernstein inequalities for geometrically strongly mixing processes and derives a model-based effective sample size. The resulting bound separates overlap, dependence, and smoothness effects with specific constants derived under a Gaussian process assumption. This analysis yields an additional tradeoff: smoother losses preserve more input dependence and therefore reduce effective sample size, while also reducing function complexity and empirical-to-population risk gaps. Applying the result to prediction yields confidence intervals that achieve near-nominal coverage in synthetic experiments and substantially reduce undercoverage on real monitoring data.

**comment/C1：** 35 pages, 6 figures

</details>

### 802. [AffectWorld: Benchmarking Emotion-Driven Future World Prediction](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18305v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18305

**作者：** Changhao Song、Yacong Chen、Hui Gao、Yazhou Zhang、Peng Zhang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18305v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18305v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 AffectWorld 基准，用「情绪—动作—世界状态」链条上的三项任务（世界状态一致性、情绪—动作一致性、因果一致性）加一个反事实子集，配合八项指标评测五个 SoTA 世界模型，结果显示其在生成情绪驱动后果和响应情绪干预方面存在明显差距。

**相关性简评：** 其反事实干预设计与因果一致性评测思路，可能为检验 latent 内容对答案的因果作用、以及用 VLM/LLM 评判者做自动评估提供可核查线索。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AffectWorld: Benchmarking Emotion-Driven Future World Prediction

**abstract/A1：** The world encompasses both physical environments and human actors. Predicting its evolution requires understanding both physical laws and how emotions shape human actions. However, existing world model benchmarks primarily assess physical plausibility and perceptual quality, leaving emotion-driven world evolution largely untested.We introduce AffectWorld, a benchmark that evaluates the chain Emotion-Action-World State through three tasks: World-State Consistency, Emotion-Action Consistency, and Causal Consistency. It comprises 1,498 everyday video samples annotated with plausible emotions, action tendencies, and atomic world-state constraints. A counterfactual subset of 233 samples tests whether changing an agent's emotion under fixed scene and event conditions yields corresponding changes in actions and consequences. We define eight metrics across the three tasks and an additional counterfactual metric, combining automatic visual assessment with human-calibrated VLM/LLM judgments. Evaluations of five SoTA world models (e.g., Cosmos3) required world-state change scores of 0.100-0.280 and counterfactual emotion sensitivity scores of 0.027-0.070 on a \[0, 1\] scale. These results reveal substantial gaps in generating the consequences of emotion-driven actions and adapting future predictions to emotional interventions. AffectWorld provides a testbed for advancing world models that capture how emotions shape future physical and social states.

</details>

### 803. [Bayesian Optimization of CVaR with Unknown Hyperparameters](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18306v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18306

**作者：** Valentin Margraf、Jonas Hanselle、Viktor Bengs、Serafima Lebedeva、Eyke Hüllermeier、Marcel Wever

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18306v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18306v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究高斯过程超参数未知时对昂贵黑盒函数的 CVaR 贝叶斯优化，提出 HE-CV-UCB：维护候选模型集、剔除与观测不一致者、在幸存者分歧处主动查询，并返回对残余候选稳健的设计，理论上达到接近 oracle 的累积遗憾。

**相关性简评：** 其「淘汰与数据不一致的候选模型、在分歧处主动查询、并在模型不确定性下做稳健决策」的思路，可能与 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、不确定性驱动的证据获取与停止判断存在概念性联系，可供核查是否可迁移为动态取证的准则。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Bayesian Optimization of CVaR with Unknown Hyperparameters

**abstract/A1：** We study Bayesian optimization of the Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) of an expensive black-box function that depends on a decision and an environmental variable. Existing no-regret algorithms assume that the correct Gaussian process (GP) kernel and its hyperparameters are known. In practice, however, they must be estimated from limited data, often yielding a misspecified surrogate. This is especially damaging for CVaR because misspecification can distort the estimated tail-risk and thus lead to catastrophic decisions. We propose HE-CV-UCB, the first no-regret algorithm for CVaR Bayesian optimization with unknown GP hyperparameters. Given a finite candidate set containing a well-specified model, HE-CV-UCB adaptively eliminates those inconsistent with the observed data, actively queries where the survivors disagree, and returns a design that is robust across the surviving candidates. We prove that it attains cumulative regret matching the oracle rate of CV-UCB up to a factor depending only on the candidate set's size. Across synthetic benchmarks and three real-world applications, HE-CV-UCB achieves competitive performance and frequently outperforms existing CVaR Bayesian optimization methods.

**comment/C1：** 17 pages, 25 figures

</details>

**title/T1：** Complex materials engineering via Provenance Action Graphs: potential, structure and demonstration

**abstract/A1：** This work discusses and tests the potential of reaction graphs for material synthesis, in which events consist of reaction steps (actions) and their outputs (observations). The importance comes from the requirement to synthesize technologically useful materials, especially those that are kinetically stabilized. Often, it is a science that follows years of trial and error, culminating in (published) successful recipes, but is truly driven by far more (unpublished) failures. The entry into the era of AI provides an opportunity to use learning algorithms to encode rules from multi-dimensional synthesis pathways, regardless of their technological usefulness, and to decode both forward prediction and inverse learning modes. The main incentive is to accelerate material discovery by generating a global knowledge base that can be shared among data agents and contributed to by them. We will focus on several scenarios in the common synthesis process during solid-state synthesis, primarily because these reactions are kinetic in nature and require closer monitoring and control of the reaction history.

### 805. [Over-parameterization Is Neither Robust nor Fragile in Matrix Sensing: A Geometric Theory of Solution Robustness](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18318v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18318

**作者：** Runze Shi、Ziye Ma

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18318v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18318v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文在矩阵感知（可视为两层二次网络的训练）中研究 Burer-Monteiro 分解的过参数化与鲁棒性，提出秩感知的鲁棒性理论，说明敏感性同时取决于过参数化程度与二阶稳定点的局部几何，并提出用谱平衡与随机草图的轨迹感知算法把优化引向更不敏感的解。

**相关性简评：** 「解几何与优化轨迹共同决定敏感性、参数量本身不决定鲁棒性」的结论可能为 LVR 中 latent 表示的几何、过参数化与训练稳定性的关系提供类比线索，但领域相距较远，迁移可行性需要核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Over-parameterization Is Neither Robust nor Fragile in Matrix Sensing: A Geometric Theory of Solution Robustness

**abstract/A1：** Over-parameterization is ubiquitous in modern machine learning, yet its effect on robustness remains poorly understood. We study this question in matrix sensing, a canonical non-convex problem that can also be viewed, under an appropriate parameterization, as training a two-layer quadratic neural network. We develop a rank-aware robustness theory for the Burer-Monteiro factorization when the search rank k may exceed the target rank r\_star, thereby capturing over-parameterization. Our analysis shows that robustness depends jointly on the degree of over-parameterization and the local geometry of the attained second-order stationary point: increasing k generally worsens sensitivity, but stationary points with the same search rank can exhibit substantially different robustness. Motivated by this observation, we propose a trajectory-aware algorithm that uses spectral balancing and randomized sketching to steer optimization toward less sensitive solutions. In matrix-sensing experiments, the method reduces paired sensitivity by 18-29 percent for isotropic operators and 87-89 percent for weak-tail operators, without degrading reconstruction accuracy. These results demonstrate that parameter count alone does not determine robustness and identify solution geometry and the optimization trajectory as important levers for improving it.

</details>

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出从每个区域单张低空航拍 RGB 图像与已知相机参数出发，构建大规模实例级参数化 3D 城市，给出 CityCode 可操作表示（度量几何、道路拓扑、视觉语义与 3D 资产的持久实体标识及依赖感知版本化更新），并用 Air2Code 结合视觉结构提取与度量深度估计完成构建。

**相关性简评：** 其「持久状态 + 版本化更新 + 历史回滚」的显式状态表示与稀疏观测下补全证据的思路，可能为 LVR 中可更新、可核查的推理工作区与轨迹监督提供概念类比，但属 3D 重建生成领域，需较多核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** CityCode: Building Agent-Operable 3D Cities from Sparse Aerial Observations

**abstract/A1：** Urban spatial intelligence calls for 3D cities that agents can measure, interpret, and modify across successive tasks. Maintaining such cities as persistent, code-based states requires lightweight acquisition and support for consistent state updates without repeated dense reconstruction. We therefore formulate a new setting for grounded urban world construction: generating large-scale, instance-level parameterized 3D cities from one low-altitude aerial RGB image per region and known camera parameters, while recovering metrically scaled buildings and explicit road geometry and connectivity. We introduce CityCode, an agent-operable representation that unifies metric geometry, urban topology, visual semantics, and 3D assets through persistent entity identities, with dependency-aware versioned execution for validated updates and historical restoration. We further develop Air2Code to construct this representation by combining visual structure extraction with adapted metric depth estimation. To address occlusion and incomplete coverage, recovered structure and observed appearance guide generative completion and subsequent structure-aware 3D generation for buildings and backgrounds. Experiments on CitySample-Aerial and UrbanScene3D demonstrate substantially more accurate metric structure recovery and superior visual fidelity to the target cities compared with the evaluated baselines. Across 50 task chains of 50 steps each, CityCode supports continued querying, editing, planning, and historical restoration over evolving city states. Together, CityCode and Air2Code turn sparse aerial observations into persistent, agent-operable urban worlds for long-horizon urban spatial intelligence.

</details>

**title/T1：** Delegating Earth science model calibration to knowledge-guided LLM agents

**abstract/A1：** Applying process-based Earth science models to new sites and questions often requires expert calibration decisions. Reliable delegation to language-model agents must preserve scientific competence and reproducibility. Here we develop a general calibration harness (GCH) for end-to-end delegation from a calibration request to assessed results. Constrained by a knowledge infrastructure (KI) and a validation convention, agents define parameter domains, observation mappings and objectives, and generate model-specific code. GCH checks the formulations against the same declarations and freezes them before numerical search and assessment, which require no further agent judgement. Agent-authored workflows executed across six model families, with assessment identifying unmet criteria. In snow-model tests, five of five knowledge-guided specifications executed on the first attempt, compared with none of five given only the model name, achieving validation Nash-Sutcliffe efficiency (NSE) of 0.81-0.94 against 0.57 for defaults. Under a common objective, independent GR4J formulations yielded scores within 0.001 NSE; re-evaluating eleven saved parameter vectors reproduced their metrics. In ten paired VIC tests with matched budgets, fixed search was non-inferior to continuing agent proposals (margin, -0.02 NSE; median difference, -0.003). This separation enables end-to-end calibration delegation with inspectable scientific choices and reproducible numerical evaluation.

</details>

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Autonomous Science Bench: Evaluating AI Agents for Autonomous Scientific Discovery

**abstract/A1：** AI agents for autonomous scientific discovery must decide which experiments to run under a limited budget. Most benchmarks for science agents provide fixed datasets, while others that support active experimentation largely rely on simulation. We introduce Autonomous Science Bench, an initial release comprising six budgeted design-build-test-learn campaigns grounded in published experiments across biology, chemistry, and materials science. Agents select batches of designs, receive measurements from a lab service, and use the results to guide subsequent experiments before delivering a predictive model. Success requires passing two calibrated gates: a discovery gate, which evaluates the designs the agent measured, and a learning gate, which evaluates its model's ranking of held-out designs. In a pilot evaluation of eight agent-model configurations and 144 trials, the best configuration succeeds in 67% of trials, while the hardest campaign is solved in only three of 24 attempts. The two gates reveal different weaknesses: some agents build accurate rankings but find too few promising designs, while others find promising designs but fail to predict which unseen designs will perform well. These differences are obscured by overall success rates alone. We release version 0.1 of the campaigns, lab runtime, and public leaderboard at https://yibow.me/autonomous-science-bench.

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18456

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 该论文提出 PerturbEnergy，在自编码器潜空间上引入条件能量先验，使表示偏向给定扰动对应的区域，并证明其优化可提高表示与扰动间条件互信息的下界，用于细胞扰动响应预测。

**相关性简评：** 其出发点是扰动信号被复杂背景掩盖、潜表示难以保留条件信息，这与 LVR 中 latent 状态是否保留任务必要视觉信息、如何诊断信息坍缩的问题可能同构；条件能量先验与条件互信息下界或可供核查，作为评估 latent 内容与条件的对齐程度、以及用先验「倾斜」潜空间的线索，但属跨领域推测，未涉及视觉或多模态推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning Perturbation-Specific Representations through Conditional Energy Prior for Cellular Response Prediction

**abstract/A1：** AI-based cellular perturbation prediction is essential to accelerate drug discovery and therapeutic identification. However, perturbation-specific signals are generally obscured by cellular complexity, making it difficult for existing methods to correctly capture perturbation effects. To address this problem, we propose PerturbEnergy, which introduces a conditional energy-based prior over perturbation representations. It assigns lower energy (higher probability) to representations compatible with the given perturbation and higher energy to others, thereby explicitly tilting the latent space toward perturbation-preferred regions. Besides, PerturbEnergy can be integrated into autoencoder architectures as we find its Evidence Lower Bound (ELBO) is equivalent to the ELBO of the complete autoencoder. We further prove that optimizing PerturbEnergy increases the lower bound on the conditional mutual information between representation and perturbation. Extensive experiments on four benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our PerturbEnergy: it improves perturbation recognition especially in latent space with improvement of up to 83.2\\%; It also achieves state-of-the-art performance for predicting top-50/100/200 differentially expressed gene(DEG) response and remaining competitive on highly variable gene(HVG) prediction. The code is provided: https://github.com/BlueWhaleLab/PerturbEnergy

</details>

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18471v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18471v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文为基于 Transformer 的语言模型提出对称感知的图元网络：形式化完整 decoder-only LM 权重空间的对称群，构造对深度、宽度可迁移且对该群不变的图表示，并发布两个 Transformer 权重数据集及训练语料预测、微调检测等新任务。

**相关性简评：** 「不同权重可实现同一函数」的对称等价与 LVR 中潜状态、注意力配置的非唯一性存在概念类比，其群论形式化与等变构造或可供核查是否能用于刻画注意力结构与潜表示几何，但原文不涉及视觉推理。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Graph Metanetworks for Transformer Based Language Models

**abstract/A1：** Weight-space learning treats the weights of neural networks as data, processed by other models called metanetworks. A key challenge is that different weights can realize the same function, related by a group of symmetries the metanetwork should respect. While symmetry-aware metanetworks for simple architectures such as MLPs are well developed, a comprehensive treatment of transformers, and in particular transformer-based language models, is still missing. Importantly, their weight space has a richer symmetry group: beyond neuron permutations, attention introduces continuous general-linear symmetries of the attention matrices and permutations of entire heads. Existing methods for transformer weights either capture only part of these symmetries or are restricted to a single, fixed architecture, and none accounts for language-model-specific components such as the token embeddings. Building on graph metanetworks, we propose a graph-based approach that is both symmetry-aware and applicable across depths and widths. We formalize a weight-space symmetry group of complete decoder-only language models and provide a graph construction that is invariant to it. We further introduce two new transformer-population datasets with novel tasks, such as training-corpus prediction and fine-tuning detection, on which our approach notably outperforms existing baselines.

</details>

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Physics-Aware Deepfake Detection via Distance-Speech Consistency

**abstract/A1：** Recent progress in generative models has made talking-head deepfakes highly realistic and easy to create, jeopardizing public trust. However, most audio-visual deepfake detectors rely on lip-speech synchronization and are designed for static, frontal videos, limiting their reliability in dynamic, in-the-wild recordings where the speaker moves and lip cues are degraded or missing. As an alternative, we propose a physics-aware detector for dynamic speaking videos that leverages an acoustic constraint: in real recordings, speech energy varies predictably with speaker-to-camera distance, whereas deepfake generation can break this coupling. Our method combines distance estimates from video with distance-dependent acoustic measures from speech to detect deepfakes. Experiments on in-the-wild benchmarks show that the proposed physical cue is effective in dynamic scenarios, and that it complements lip-sync-based detectors, with a simple ensemble achieving consistent gains across datasets. Codes are available at https://byulharang.github.io/PADD/.

### 812. [Recalibrating Many Questions with Few Labels: Minimax Rates and Identification Limits](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18488v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18488

**作者：** Xiaoyu Li、Chiwun Yang

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18488v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18488v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究在多个相关问题各自仅有少量标签时，如何跨问题共享信息做重新校准：给出复合最小最大风险的精确率（含池化等渗拟合何时最优），并在随机效应下刻画辨识极限，指出超出少量标签后不可学部分几乎无关紧要。

**相关性简评：** 其「每问题少量标注下的可辨识极限与信息共享」概念可能为 LVR 中每样本监督预算、证据是否充分与停止判据提供参照，但结论针对校准误差而非 latent 状态，迁移性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Recalibrating Many Questions with Few Labels: Minimax Rates and Identification Limits

**abstract/A1：** Many related prediction problems, which we call questions, come with few labels each. What information can be shared across them, and what is actually necessary for good decisions? We answer both for recalibration, motivated by decision models such as Jev (TypeSafe AI, 2026) that return a probability for any yes/no question a developer writes. A predictor reports a probability $P$ with output law $μ$ on $m$ questions, each with $n$ labels and a nondecreasing map $g\_j(p)=\\mathbb{P}(Y=1\\mid P=p)$; the compound risk is the excess Brier score over the true maps, averaged over questions. Over maps within sup-distance $τ\\le 1$ and total variation $V\\le 2$ of one nondecreasing shape (fixed effects), the minimax compound risk is $(mn)^{-2/3}+\\min\\{τ^2,1/n\\}+\\min\\{τ^2,V^2,(V/n)^{2/3}\\}$ up to universal constants, for every non-atomic $μ$. A pooled isotonic fit with a per-question correction sized once, on held-out labels of all questions, attains it without knowing $τ$, $V$ or $μ$ ($n\\ge 2$, $m\\ge 3$); tuning each question on its own labels loses a factor of order $\\min\\{n,\\log(m^2/n)\\}$ when the maps differ by constants and $m^2/n$ is large. When the maps are drawn from an unknown prior (random effects), other questions need not identify the Bayes rule. The loss, the identification regret, is at most $2^{-n}$ once the law of a question's data is known, extending a bound of Skibinsky (1968) for coins, and in the worst case at least $β\_\\star^{-n}/(72\\sqrt{n})$ at every finite $m$, where $β\_\\star\\approx 3.583$. Beyond a few labels per question, what cannot be learned is nearly unnecessary. For constant maps (an uninformative predictor) and constant-map priors, the exponential base is exactly $β\_\\star$, not the 4 suggested by the moment range; for monotone maps it lies in $\[2,β\_\\star\]$.

**comment/C1：** 69 pages, 7 figures, 1 table

</details>

### 813. [LLM Agents for Automated Post-Training via Structured Recipe Optimization](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18572v1>)

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出「任务自适应配方空间优化」范式，用 LLM 的 Recipe-Space Designer 构造任务适配的显式配方空间，再由多域配方优化器基于结构化试验证据与多目标贝叶斯选择，在有限实验预算下自动完成 LLM 后训练的数据与训练配置组合。

**相关性简评：** 其「有限预算下的多目标贝叶斯试验选择 + 显式结构化选择空间」与 LVR 的动态计算、THINK/LOOK/STOP 的收益-成本权衡在问题上可能同构，或可提供停止与预算分配的决策线索，需人工核查可迁移性；与视觉推理和 latent 状态本身无直接关联。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** LLM Agents for Automated Post-Training via Structured Recipe Optimization

**abstract/A1：** Automated post-training transforms pre-trained large language models (LLMs) into models capable of handling diverse domains by automatically constructing and optimizing a recipe of coupled decisions over data sources, data processing, cross-domain composition, and training configuration under a limited experimental budget. Existing automation either searches predefined recipe spaces that enable systematic optimization but remain fixed rather than adapting their available choices to the target tasks, or uses open-ended agents that discover task-specific choices but leave them implicit in trial-level edits, limiting their systematic reuse and recombination across trials. To fill this gap, we introduce optimization over a task-adapted recipe space, a novel paradigm that can adapt the recipe space itself to the target tasks while representing its choices explicitly for systematic reuse, recombination, and joint optimization. We instantiate this paradigm with Structured Recipe Optimization (SRO), comprising an LLM-based Recipe-Space Designer that constructs the task-adapted recipe space and a Multi-Domain Recipe Optimizer that uses structured trial evidence to guide LLM candidate construction and multi-objective Bayesian trial selection. Extensive experiments show that SRO achieves the highest average score in all evaluated target-model and agent-LLM combinations. In joint post-training across three capability domains and six benchmarks, SRO reaches 41.1 versus 15.4 for the strongest baseline on Qwen3-1.7B with GPT-5.4, and 53.8 versus 40.8 on Qwen3-4B with DeepSeek-V4-Flash. Our code is available at https://github.com/RuohLiuq/SRO.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18577

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.AI

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18577v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18577v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 研究多目标 bandit 中的 best-arm identification，通过固定置信度下的特征时间下界，说明多目标在何种偏好序（Pareto、线性、字典序）下比单目标更易识别，并提出渐近最优的 Order-Aware Track-and-Stop 算法。

**相关性简评：** 其关于向量反馈相对坐标反馈的信息优势、以及何时该继续采样何时停止的下界刻画，可能与 LVR 中 LOOK/STOP 的收益—成本权衡和证据获取决策形成类比，可供核查，但领域距离较远，迁移属推测。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** When More Objectives Make Identification Easier: The Role of Preferences and Feedback

**abstract/A1：** Best-arm identification (BAI) aims to identify the optimal arm using as few samples as possible. While most existing work focuses on a single objective, many real-world applications involve multiple criteria, which motivates the study of BAI in multi-objective bandits. Intuitively, multi-objective identification seems harder, since the learner must identify optimal arms in a higher-dimensional reward space; however, the additional objectives also provide richer feedback that can reduce the required exploration. In this paper, we characterize when and why multiple objectives can make BAI easier. For Gaussian bandits, we establish a characteristic-time lower bound for fixed-confidence identification that holds uniformly across preference orders. Through explicit comparisons under Pareto, linear, and lexicographic preferences, we reveal three phenomena: (i) identifying a larger optimal set can require fewer samples than identifying a unique optimum; (ii) the advantage of vector feedback over coordinate feedback depends fundamentally on the preference order; and (iii) multi-objective identification can require fewer samples than even the easiest corresponding single-objective problem. Finally, we propose Order-Aware Track-and-Stop (OATS), an algorithm that is correct at any prescribed confidence level and asymptotically matches the lower bound.

</details>

**作者：** Hilda Adwubi Osei

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、cs.CY

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18593v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18593v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究 predict-then-optimize 流水线中把人口统计均等约束施加在预测结果上的后果：以预算受限分配为例，用实验和两部分理论界刻画真实结果上的公平性缺口如何随预测误差增大并饱和。

**相关性简评：** 其「约束在预测代理上看似满足、却在真实结果上系统性失效」的框架，可能与 LVR 中 latent 状态作为视觉证据代理时的可靠性与失效评估形成类比，属推测性借鉴线索，可供核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Fairness under Prediction Error in Predict-then-Optimize Pipelines

**abstract/A1：** Fairness constraints in predict-then-optimize pipelines are necessarily enforced on predicted outcomes $\\hat{y}$, since true outcomes $y$ are unobserved at decision time. We study whether a demographic parity constraint enforced this way continues to hold against $y$, and how the resulting violation scales with prediction error. Using a budget-constrained allocation problem solved as a linear program, we show empirically that the true-outcome fairness gap grows with prediction error $σ$ and saturates, well fit by $c(1 - e^{-σ/τ})$ with $c = 0.1545 \\pm 0.0103$ and $τ= 3.9045 \\pm 0.3745$; its mean is invariant to sample size while its variance decays at the standard $O(1/\\sqrt{n})$ rate. We derive a two-part theoretical bound: a closed-form local sensitivity result showing the gap's first-order response to prediction error depends on only two individuals per group, validated against the solver to within three significant figures; and a universal, error-independent ceiling following from the boundedness of the decision variable, confirmed consistent with but looser than the empirical saturation level. On US Census income data, enforcing demographic parity on a trained predictor's output reduces an unconstrained disparity in true income to roughly one-third of its original size, leaving 34.4% $\\pm$ 3.3% (California) and 35.7% $\\pm$ 1.8% (Texas) of the disparity intact and undetectable from the predictions alone -- consistent not only in mechanism but in approximate magnitude across two states with different demographics and income distributions, and stable across ten independent train/test splits in each. A fairness constraint that appears fully satisfied at decision time can mask a substantial, systematic violation of the outcome it was meant to protect.

</details>

**title/T1：** Two Routes to Interoceptive Prioritisation: Dissociating Likelihood Precision and Preference Reweighting in Active Inference

**abstract/A1：** An embodied agent must prioritise among competing bodily needs. In active inference, it can respond to an urgent need by increasing the precision of information about that need or by increasing its preference for outcomes that relieve it. We compare these two interventions, separately and together, in a foraging gridworld with three lethal needs, and ask how each changes survival, perception and the body model the agent learns. Precision sharpens interoceptive posteriors and improves survival. Preference reweighting keeps bodily states further from their lethal boundaries and changes the states from which the agent learns, so its learned model covers fewer need levels, with lower quality across all levels but slightly higher quality on the levels it visits. An experiment on 72 further layouts does not establish the predicted preference benefit on difficult layouts, but both interventions improve average survival there and their interaction is positive. Survival alone therefore gives an incomplete account of how a model prioritises needs and learns about its body.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at IWAI 2026, forthcoming in the Springer proceedings. 17 pages: the 13-page camera-ready paper, reproduced without alteration apart from one typographical fix, followed by 4 pages of supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/sgrimbly/interoceptive-prioritisation-iwai2026-snapshot

</details>

### 817. [Texture Interpolation as Texton Matching](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18655v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18655

**作者：** Ido Madar、Gal Oren、Shai Avidan

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.GR、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18655v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18655v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文研究纹理插值中「对应关系」的作用：将纹理表示为局部外观向量（texton）集合，在固定编码器、表示与解码器的条件下，用外观感知匹配替代按空间位置的配对，并比较软匹配与一对一指派对插值中点分布质量与过渡均衡性的影响。

**相关性简评：** 其「对应关系本身是一等设计选择」的结论与表示几何、状态对齐问题相通，可能启发 LVR 中对 latent 视觉状态如何跨分支或跨步骤配对与混合的思考，但领域相隔较远，可迁移性有待核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Texture Interpolation as Texton Matching

**abstract/A1：** Texture interpolation asks what should lie between two textures. Standard methods typically blend pixels or features at corresponding spatial locations, implicitly assuming that co-located elements should be mixed. For unrelated textures, however, this correspondence is arbitrary: a crack at one location has no particular relationship to a fiber at the same location in another image. We study whether this hidden pairing choice is itself a major determinant of interpolation quality. We represent textures as collections of local appearance vectors, or textons, and replace positional pairing with appearance-aware matching while keeping the encoder, representation, and decoder fixed. This isolates the effect of correspondence from changes in model capacity or training. Across texture pairs, appearance-aware matching consistently improves the distributional quality of interpolated midpoints over positional feature blending. Soft matching produces the strongest midpoint statistics, whereas one-to-one assignments yield more balanced transitions and closer agreement with the target endpoint. The same intervention also improves a second pretrained texture interpolator without retraining. These results identify correspondence as a first-class design choice in texture interpolation: meaningful transitions depend not only on how strongly two textures are mixed, but also on which local appearances are mixed with one another.

**comment/C1：** 28 pages. Code: https://github.com/Scientific-Computing-Lab/TextureMatcher

</details>

### 818. [BridgeTwist: Twisting Schrödinger Bridges for Training-Free Conditional Sampling](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18658v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18658

**作者：** Mengyu Li、Qianqian Qu、Jun S. Liu

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG、stat.ML

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18658v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18658v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 提出 BridgeTwist，一种面向预训练 Schrödinger bridge 生成模型的免训练条件采样器：用速度与 score 场构造闭式 twist 代理并配合时间变化指数降温，再以桥形推理期噪声日程和 telescoping 重要性权重实现渐近精确的后验采样。

**相关性简评：** 其 tempered twisted 序列蒙特卡洛（粒子滤波）与「早期引导不可靠故降权」的时间调度，可能为 LVR 中多个 latent 假设的序贯加权筛选及证据可信度随时间变化的问题提供借鉴，属较远领域线索，需人工核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** BridgeTwist: Twisting Schrödinger Bridges for Training-Free Conditional Sampling

**abstract/A1：** Generative models are often required to serve many downstream conditional tasks. In the training-free setting, a pretrained unconditional model is reused as a prior and combined with a task-specific likelihood to sample from the corresponding posterior. While such training-free samplers have been developed for diffusion and flow models, their counterpart for Schrödinger bridge (SB) models remains unexplored, despite the growing appeal of SBs as flexible stochastic transport models between general source and target distributions. We propose BridgeTwist, a training-free conditional sampler for pretrained SB generative models, formulated as a tempered twisted sequential Monte Carlo scheme. Its twist is a closed-form plug-in surrogate, obtained by combining the velocity and score fields exposed by SB pretraining into an endpoint predictor and evaluating the likelihood there. Since this surrogate is less reliable near the source, we temper the twist with a time-varying exponent, downweighting its influence at early steps. We further introduce a bridge-shaped inference-time diffusion schedule that concentrates the proposal noise in the interior of the path. Telescoping importance weights then cancel all intermediate twist factors, yielding an asymptotically exact sampler for the posterior. Empirically, BridgeTwist outperforms training-free baselines on class-conditional and text-prompted image generation, and is competitive with specialized inverse problem solvers on inpainting, deblurring, and super-resolution.

**comment/C1：** Accepted at NeurIPS 2026

</details>

### 819. [Knowing the User Is Not Knowing What We Established: Grounding Awareness in Personal Agents](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18684v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18684

**作者：** Jiajun Chen、Xinyue Chen、Yicheng Jiang、Hua Shen

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.HC、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18684v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18684v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出「Grounding Awareness」，即个人智能体能否区分用户已接受、未获确认、被修改和限定范围的安排，并构建受控基准测试多种智能体与记忆系统；结果显示强记忆性能并不保证该能力，给出更完整的用户信息反而增加执行未确认提议，且持久记忆会让智能体把提议当作指令。作者进一步提出免训练的 Grounding Layer，显式跟踪 grounding 状态并在有后果的动作前核查。

**相关性简评：** 该工作关于「已确立状态 vs 仅被提出的内容」的区分与行动前核查，可能与 LVR 中 latent 假设或视觉证据的来源归属、以及是否真被用于作答的核查问题相通，其免训练状态跟踪与门控做法可供核查借鉴。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Knowing the User Is Not Knowing What We Established: Grounding Awareness in Personal Agents

**abstract/A1：** Personal-agent memory has largely focused on learning what users know, prefer, and want. However, knowing the user does not necessarily mean knowing what the user and the agent have established together. An assistant's proposal should not become an authorized instruction merely because it is remembered. We introduce Grounding Awareness, the ability to distinguish accepted, unacknowledged, revised, and scoped arrangements when selecting actions. We develop a controlled benchmark to test whether agents can tell the difference between proposals users have accepted and those they have not, and whether they apply accepted arrangements only where appropriate. Across multiple agents and memory systems, we find that strong memory performance does not ensure Grounding Awareness. More surprisingly, providing more complete user information can increase execution of unacknowledged proposals, while persistent memory can cause agents to treat these proposals as if they were user instructions. We trace these failures through memory writing, retrieval, and action selection. Finally, we introduce Grounding Layer, a lightweight, training-free extension that explicitly tracks grounding status and checks consequential actions, substantially improving agent behavior without modifying models or memory systems.

**comment/C1：** Under Review

</details>

### 820. [AIRRI: Towards a Human-Readable, Machine-Resistant Reading Interface](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18724v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18724

**作者：** Emory Salaun、Syed Ayon、Kaleel Mahmood、Shaun Wallace

**arXiv 学科：** cs.CV、cs.HC、cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18724v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18724v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 AIRRI 框架，用图像变换（字距、行距、透明度、条纹叠加、噪声）与决策式对抗攻击（RayS、SurFree、ADBA）生成「抗机器读取」的教育作业内容，并在 Tesseract、EasyOCR、GOT-OCR2 上评估文本提取性能下降程度及人类可读性。

**相关性简评：** 其通过扰动视觉输入来削弱自动文本提取的做法，可能可供核查作为探测多模态模型是否真正依赖像素证据、筛选必要视觉细节的手段；但论文聚焦 OCR 鲁棒性与作业防 AI 抄袭，与 latent 推理状态的生成和使用无直接联系。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** AIRRI: Towards a Human-Readable, Machine-Resistant Reading Interface

**abstract/A1：** The rapid advancement of image-to-text extraction systems and large language models (LLMs) poses new challenges for educational assessment by making assignment materials easy to transcribe and solve with minimal human effort. To address this problem, we present AIRRI (Artificial Intelligence Resilient Reading Interface), a framework for generating machine-resistant educational content, a dataset of higher-education assignments for evaluation, and an initial evaluation of the human readability of AIRRI machine-resistant text designs. AIRRI employs two categories of machine-resistance techniques. First, AIRRI applies image transformations including character spacing, word spacing, line spacing, character opacity variation, stripe overlays, and image noise. Second, AIRRI applies decision-based adversarial attacks: RayS, SurFree, and ADBA. We evaluate AIRRI against three image-to-text systems: Tesseract, EasyOCR, and the transformer-based GOT-OCR2 model. Our results show that AIRRI substantially degrades automated text extraction performance. AIRRI increased character error rates for EasyOCR (6.9% to 55.9%), Tesseract (2.3% to 100.0%), and GOT-OCR2 (30.7% to 48.1%). Word error rates increased for EasyOCR (24.9% to 96.7%) and Tesseract (10.7% to 100.0%). Among the evaluated decision-based attacks, ADBA consistently produced the largest degradation in image-to-text performance, while RayS and SurFree produced more moderate reductions. EasyOCR and Tesseract were generally more susceptible to both image-based and adversarial perturbations than the transformer-based GOT-OCR2 model. Our findings suggest that AIRRI can significantly reduce the reliability of image-to-text-to-LLM workflows, increasing the effort required for AI-assisted assignment completion.

**comment/C1：** 12 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables

</details>

### 821. [Learning When to Transfer: Reinforcement Learning for Carbon-Footprint Modeling in New Manufacturing Domains](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18730v1>)

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18730

**作者：** Muhammad Umar Farooq、Daniel R. Cooper

**arXiv 学科：** cs.LG

[论文页面](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18730v1>) · [PDF](<https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.18730v1>)

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出一种强化学习的选择性知识迁移方法：由奖励将每次迁移机会与监督基线对比，在新制造域数据稀缺时选择按单一来源、来源子集、全池化或仅目标数据训练的预测器，并用验证门控决定是否采用迁移预测；在五种材料的挤出增材制造碳排放建模（729 组实验）上留一材料评估。

**相关性简评：** 其「是否迁移、何时采用外部来源预测」的学习策略与验证门控，可能为 LVR 中何时依赖外部证据或历史状态、以及 STOP 类决策提供远领域类比线索，但需核查该门控与奖励设计能否迁移到 latent 推理状态的选择与停止判断。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Learning When to Transfer: Reinforcement Learning for Carbon-Footprint Modeling in New Manufacturing Domains

**abstract/A1：** Manufacturers often need to characterize a new material, process, or product before enough operating data are available to train reliable predictive models for this new, target domain. Existing manufacturing operations contain potentially useful knowledge to accelerate this characterization, but indiscriminate reuse of data from existing source domains can cause negative transfer in learning of the new, target domain when the manufacturing domains differ sufficiently. This work proposes a reinforcement-learning method for selective knowledge transfer, where its reward scores each opportunity to transfer against supervised alternatives, so negative transfer is avoided and controlled during forward prediction instead of being diagnosed afterwards. Given limited data from a new target domain, the learned policy chooses among predictors based on individual source operations, subsets of the sources, or the supervised alternatives: fully pooled sources, or target data alone. A validation gate deploys the transferred prediction only when it improves upon the supervised alternatives. The method is designed for learning variables supporting carbon accounting, as well as performance and quality outcomes. We demonstrate the approach by quantifying the embodied greenhouse-gas emissions of parts produced via material-extrusion additive manufacturing, using data from 729 experiments spanning five materials: ABS, PETG, TPU, PLA, and recycled PLA. The response combines measured fabrication electricity with polymer-specific cradle-to-gate production factors, while 22 material, process, and toolpath features characterize each experiment. In leave-one-material-out evaluation, this method achieves a mean test RMSE of 5.2 g CO2e per part, 20.00% lower than target-only training (32.5% lower when only 5-10% of the target training data are available) and 10.30% lower than indiscriminate source-target pooling.

</details>

**arXiv ID：** 2610.18741

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

**优先级：** P2

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出一种上下文感知的多模态晚期融合方法：在概率校准框架内嵌入轻量门控网络，从环境上下文动态调节预训练检测器的输出而无需重训，在人工加雾的 KITTI 上相较非自适应晚期融合基线取得约 14% 相对提升，平均精度约 56%。

**相关性简评：** 其「按上下文估计各模态可靠性并动态加权」的做法，可能与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、何时信任视觉信息及概率式证据融合的问题有概念联系，但原文面向驾驶检测、无推理状态，迁移性需核查。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Context-aware Bayesian Fusion for Multimodal Object Detection

**abstract/A1：** Reliable detection of pedestrians and road users is essential for the safe operation of autonomous vehicles. However, this task becomes increasingly challenging under adverse environmental conditions, such as poor weather and low lighting, where the performance of state-of-the-art pre-trained object detectors and on-board sensors tends to degrade, which limits their effectiveness and reliability. Moreover, retraining models for each operating context imposes significant constraints due to high data requirements, computational resources, and time. Considering this, we propose a novel context-aware multimodal late fusion approach that integrates a lightweight gating network within our probabilistic calibration framework. The gating network extracts environmental context and dynamically modulates the detection outputs of pre-trained object detectors based on the inferred context, without retraining of the detectors. Our methodology is evaluated on a modified KITTI dataset, in which the camera images and lidar pointclouds are augmented for varying fog levels. Experimental results show that our approach yields an approximately 14% relative improvement over non-adaptive late fusion baselines, achieving a consistent average precision of 56% across different fog levels.

</details>

**arXiv 学科：** cs.AI、cs.CL

**研究分类：** EXPLORATORY · 探索性关联

摘要级简评；深入判断请结合原文人工阅读。

**内容简述：** 论文提出 CarryOn，一个面向长时程智能体的「面向对象」上下文运行时：以可复用任务对象（continuation carriers）、互补执行上下文和近期交互尾部组成上下文视图，并在每次折叠时只针对绑定证据与环境校验修订受影响记录、前推未受影响记录，从而在不重建完整表示的前提下保持续接依据有效；在 OSWorld 2.0 与 BrowseComp-Plus 上报告了准确率提升与 token 消耗下降。

**相关性简评：** 其「持久任务状态 + 增量修订、避免全量重建」的上下文维护机制，可能为 LVR 中潜在推理状态的增量更新、工作区缓存与长度泛化提供可借鉴线索，可供核查是否存在可迁移的「证据绑定 + 局部修订」状态维护思路。

<details>
<summary>来源材料：标题、摘要与备注</summary>

**title/T1：** Pack Light, CarryOn: Building Object-Oriented Context for Long-Horizon Agents

**abstract/A1：** Long-horizon agents accumulate progress in persistent task state, yet repeatedly process interaction histories describing how that progress was achieved. This raises a natural question: can long-horizon context instead be organized around reusable progress rather than the history that produced it? In this paper, we introduce CarryOn, an object-oriented context runtime that organizes continuation around reusable task objects. Rather than treating compressed histories or reconstructed accounts of progress as the primary basis for continuation, CarryOn builds a context view from continuation carriers, complementary execution context, and a live tail of recent interactions. A core challenge is keeping this reusable basis valid after its surrounding history is retired: how can CarryOn update the basis without reconstructing the full representation at every fold? CarryOn maintains carrier records across folds, revising affected records against bound evidence and applicable environment checks while carrying forward unaffected records and jointly updating execution context. Experiments on OSWorld 2.0 and BrowseComp-Plus show improved gains of 5.8% and 7.0% while reducing total token usage by 51.9% and 22.9%, respectively. Project page: https://ethannju.github.io/carryon
